import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
const p = new PrismaClient();
(async () => {
  const now = new Date();
  const r1 = await p.order.updateMany({
    where: { processedAt: null, status: { in: ["SHIPPED", "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY", "DELIVERED"] } },
    data: { processedAt: now },
  });
  const r2 = await p.order.updateMany({
    where: { outForDeliveryAt: null, status: { in: ["OUT_FOR_DELIVERY", "DELIVERED"] } },
    data: { outForDeliveryAt: now },
  });
  console.log(`backfilled: processedAt=${r1.count}, outForDeliveryAt=${r2.count}`);
  await p.$disconnect();
})();

FILE: prisma\check-copy.ts

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import prisma from "../src/lib/prisma";

// tsx (unlike the Prisma CLI / Bun) does NOT auto-load .env, and this project is CJS
// (no "type": "module"), so: manual .env load + everything inside async main()
// (top-level await is unsupported in the cjs output format).
try {
    for (const line of readFileSync(".env", "utf8").split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const m = line.match(/^\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(.*)\s*$/);
    const key = m?.[1];
    const val = m?.[2];
    if (key && val !== undefined && !(key in process.env)) {
      process.env[key] = val.replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "");
    }
  }
} catch {
  /* rely on already-exported env if .env is unreadable */
}

const slug = process.argv[2];

async function main() {
  if (!slug) {
    console.error("usage: npx tsx prisma/check-copy.ts <slug>");
    return;
  }
    if (slug.startsWith("like:")) {
    const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { slug: { contains: slug.slice(5), mode: "insensitive" } },
      select: {
        slug: true, name: true, active: true, ratingAvg: true, ratingCount: true,
        reviews: { select: { id: true } },
        images: { select: { kind: true } },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
    });
    if (!rows.length) console.log("no matches");
    for (const r of rows) {
      const showcase = r.images.filter((i) => i.kind === "SHOWCASE").length;
      console.log(
        `${r.slug}\n    reviews=${r.reviews.length} rating=${r.ratingAvg}/${r.ratingCount} showcase=${showcase} active=${r.active}\n    ${r.name}`,
      );
    }
    return;
  }

  const p = await prisma.product.findUnique({
    where: { slug },
    include: {
      images: true,
      specifications: true,
      reviews: true,
      questions: { include: { answers: true } },
    },
  });
  if (!p) {
    console.log(`NO PRODUCT for slug: ${slug}`);
    return;
  }
  const img = (k: string) => p.images.filter((i) => (i.kind ?? "GALLERY") === k).length;
  const spec = (k: string) => p.specifications.filter((s) => (s.kind ?? "SPEC") === k).length;
  console.log(`\n${p.slug}`);
  console.log(`  name       : ${p.name}`);
  console.log(`  active     : ${p.active}  featured: ${p.featured}`);
  console.log(`  rating     : ${p.ratingAvg}  count: ${p.ratingCount}`);
  console.log(`  sold/views : ${p.sold} / ${p.views}`);
  console.log(`  images     : GALLERY=${img("GALLERY")} SHOWCASE=${img("SHOWCASE")}`);
  console.log(`  specs      : SPEC=${spec("SPEC")} WARRANTY=${spec("WARRANTY")} MFG=${spec("MFG")}`);
  console.log(`  reviews    : ${p.reviews.length} (published ${p.reviews.filter((r) => r.published).length})`);
  console.log(`  questions  : ${p.questions.length} (answers ${p.questions.reduce((s, q) => s + q.answers.length, 0)})`);
}

main()
  .catch((e) => {
    console.error(e);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  })
  .finally(() => prisma.$disconnect());

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import prisma from "../src/lib/prisma";

try {
  for (const line of readFileSync(".env", "utf8").split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const m = line.match(/^\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(.*)\s*$/);
    const key = m?.[1];
    const val = m?.[2];
    if (key && val !== undefined && !(key in process.env)) {
      process.env[key] = val.replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "");
    }
  }
} catch {
  /* rely on already-exported env */
}

async function main() {
  const rows = await prisma.heroSlideProduct.findMany({
    include: {
      slide: { select: { headline: true } },
      product: { select: { name: true } },
    },
    orderBy: [{ slideId: "asc" }, { position: "asc" }],
  });
  if (!rows.length) console.log("no attached products on any slide");
  for (const r of rows) {
    console.log(`${r.slide.headline} | ${r.product.name}\n    image=${JSON.stringify(r.image ?? null)}`);
  }
}

main()
  .catch((e) => {
    console.error(e);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  })
  .finally(() => prisma.$disconnect());

============================================================
FILE: prisma\copy-reviews.ts
============================================================

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import prisma from "../src/lib/prisma";

// Same constraints as check-copy.ts: CJS project (no top-level await) and tsx does
// NOT auto-load .env (only the Prisma CLI / Bun do), so load it manually.
try {
  for (const line of readFileSync(".env", "utf8").split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const m = line.match(/^\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(.*)\s*$/);
    const key = m?.[1];
    const val = m?.[2];
    if (key && val !== undefined && !(key in process.env)) {
      process.env[key] = val.replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "");
    }
  }
} catch {
  /* rely on already-exported env if .env is unreadable */
}

const srcSlug = process.argv[2];
const dstSlug = process.argv[3];

async function main() {
  if (!srcSlug || !dstSlug) {
    console.error("usage: npx tsx prisma/copy-reviews.ts <source-slug> <target-slug>");
    return;
  }
  const src = await prisma.product.findUnique({
    where: { slug: srcSlug },
    include: { reviews: true, questions: { include: { answers: true } } },
  });
  const dst = await prisma.product.findUnique({
    where: { slug: dstSlug },
    include: { reviews: { select: { id: true } }, questions: { select: { id: true } } },
  });
  if (!src || !dst) {
    console.log(`not found: src=${!!src} dst=${!!dst}`);
    return;
  }
  if (dst.reviews.length > 0 || dst.questions.length > 0) {
    console.log(`target already has ${dst.reviews.length} reviews / ${dst.questions.length} questions — refusing to double-copy.`);
    return;
  }
  if (src.reviews.length === 0 && src.questions.length === 0) {
    console.log("source has no reviews or questions to copy.");
    return;
  }

  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    if (src.reviews.length) {
      await tx.review.createMany({
        data: src.reviews.map((r) => ({
          productId: dst.id,
          userId: r.userId,
          orderId: r.orderId,
          rating: r.rating,
          title: r.title,
          body: r.body,
          images: [...(r.images ?? [])],
          verified: r.verified,
          helpfulCount: r.helpfulCount,
          published: r.published,
          createdAt: r.createdAt,
        })),
      });
    }
    for (const q of src.questions) {
      const nq = await tx.question.create({
        data: {
          productId: dst.id,
          userId: q.userId,
          body: q.body,
          answered: q.answered,
          createdAt: q.createdAt,
        },
      });
      if (q.answers.length) {
        await tx.answer.createMany({
          data: q.answers.map((a) => ({
            questionId: nq.id,
            userId: a.userId,
            body: a.body,
            isOfficial: a.isOfficial,
            createdAt: a.createdAt,
          })),
        });
      }
    }
    await tx.product.update({
      where: { id: dst.id },
      data: { ratingAvg: src.ratingAvg, ratingCount: src.ratingCount },
    });
  });

  console.log(
    `copied ${src.reviews.length} reviews + ${src.questions.length} questions onto ${dstSlug}; rating set to ${src.ratingAvg} / ${src.ratingCount}`,
  );
}

main()
  .catch((e) => {
    console.error(e);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  })
  .finally(() => prisma.$disconnect());

FILE: prisma\list-addresses.ts

import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
const p = new PrismaClient();
(async () => {
  const rows = await p.address.findMany({
    orderBy: [{ userId: "asc" }, { isDefault: "desc" }, { createdAt: "desc" }],
    select: { id: true, userId: true, label: true, fullName: true, line1: true, city: true, pincode: true, isDefault: true },
  });
  console.log("TOTAL addresses in DB:", rows.length);
  const byUser = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const r of rows) byUser.set(r.userId, (byUser.get(r.userId) ?? 0) + 1);
  console.log("per user:", [...byUser.entries()].map(([u, n]) => `${u}=${n}`).join(", ") || "(none)");
  console.log("");
  for (const r of rows)
    console.log(`${r.isDefault ? "* " : "  "}[${r.label}] ${r.fullName} — ${r.line1}, ${r.city} ${r.pincode} (user ${r.userId})`);
  await p.$disconnect();
})();

FILE: prisma\order-otp.ts

import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";

const p = new PrismaClient();

(async () => {
  const rows = await p.order.findMany({ take: 20 });
  if (rows.length === 0) {
    console.log("No orders in the table at all.");
    await p.$disconnect();
    return;
  }

  console.log("columns:", Object.keys(rows[0]!).join(", "));
  console.log("");

  for (const o of rows) {
    const rec = o as Record<string, unknown>;
    const numEntry = Object.entries(rec).find(
      ([k, v]) => typeof v === "string" && /orderno|order_no|number|code/i.test(k),
    );
    console.log(
      "---- id:", rec.id,
      "|", numEntry ? `${numEntry[0]}: ${numEntry[1]}` : "(no order-number column)",
      "| status:", rec.status,
    );
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(rec)) {
      if (/otp/i.test(k)) console.log("     ", k, "=", JSON.stringify(v));
    }
  }

  await p.$disconnect();
})();

// prisma/otp-cleanup.ts
import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

(async () => {
  const now = Date.now();

  const expired = await prisma.otpCode.deleteMany({
    where: {
      expiresAt: {
        lt: new Date(now - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
      },
    },
  });

  const consumed = await prisma.otpCode.deleteMany({
    where: {
      consumedAt: {
        lt: new Date(now - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
      },
    },
  });

  console.log(
    `OTP cleanup: expired=${expired.count}, consumed=${consumed.count}`,
  );

  await prisma.$disconnect();
})();

model User {
  id               String    @id @default(cuid())
  email            String    @unique
  name             String
  phone            String?
  passwordHash     String
  role             Role      @default(CUSTOMER)
  whatsappOptIn    Boolean   @default(false)
  marketingOptIn   Boolean   @default(true)

  resetTokenExp    DateTime?
  lastLoginAt      DateTime?
  failedLoginCount Int       @default(0)
  lockedUntil      DateTime?
  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime  @updatedAt

  addresses       Address[]
  orders          Order[]
  reviews         Review[]
  questions       Question[]
  answers         Answer[]
  cart            Cart?
  wishlist        Wishlist?
  compareItems    CompareItem[]

  notifications   Notification[]
  supportTickets  SupportTicket[]
  supportMessages SupportMessage[]

  @@index([role])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

}

model Product {
  id               String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug             String   @unique
  groupId          String?
  name             String
  shortDescription String?
  categoryId       String
  brandId          String
  mrp              Int
  salePrice        Int
  showcaseImages   String[] @default([])
  discountPercent  Int      @default(0)
  stock            Int      @default(0)
  lowStockAt       Int      @default(5)
  ratingAvg        Float    @default(0)
  ratingCount      Int      @default(0)
  sold             Int      @default(0)
  views            Int      @default(0)
  featured         Boolean  @default(false)
  active           Boolean  @default(true)
  subtype          String?
  ram              String?
  storage          String?
  screenSize       String?
  processor        String?
  color            String?
  description      String?
  warrantyMonths   Int      @default(12)
  returnableDays   Int      @default(7)
  codEligible      Boolean  @default(true)
  emiEligible      Boolean  @default(true)
  exchangeEligible Boolean  @default(true)
  hsnCode          String?
  tags             String[] @default([])

FILE: prisma\seed-admin.ts

import { PrismaClient, Role } from "@prisma/client";
import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

const EMAIL_RE = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[a-z]{2,}$/i;

async function main() {
  const email = process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL?.trim().toLowerCase();
  const password = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD;
  const name = process.env.ADMIN_NAME?.trim() || "Urban Vogue Admin";

  if (!email || !EMAIL_RE.test(email)) {
    throw new Error(
      "ADMIN_EMAIL is missing or invalid. Set it in .env before running seed:admin.",
    );
  }

  if (!password || password.length < 10) {
    throw new Error(
      "ADMIN_PASSWORD is missing or too short. Use at least 10 characters.",
    );
  }

  const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(password, 12);

  const admin = await prisma.user.upsert({
    where: { email },
    update: {
      name,
      passwordHash,
      role: Role.ADMIN,
      active: true,
      marketingOptIn: false,
      whatsappOptIn: false,
    },
    create: {
      email,
      name,
      passwordHash,
      role: Role.ADMIN,
      active: true,
      marketingOptIn: false,
      whatsappOptIn: false,
    },
  });

  console.log(`Admin user ready: ${admin.email}`);
  console.log("Sign in at /admin/login");
  console.log(
    "After first login, rotate/remove ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD from environment.",
  );
}

main()
  .catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  })
  .finally(async () => {
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });

FILE: prisma\seed-brands.ts

import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

const SHIRTS = [
  "Louis Philippe", "Van Heusen", "Allen Solly", "Peter England", "Raymond",
  "Park Avenue", "John Players", "Mufti", "Indian Terrain", "Arrow",
  "Zara", "H&M", "Uniqlo", "Mango Man", "U.S. Polo Assn",
];

const TROUSERS = [
  "Raymond", "Van Heusen", "Louis Philippe", "Peter England", "Park Avenue",
  "Levi's", "Wrangler", "Pepe Jeans", "Mufti", "John Players",
];

const JACKETS = [
  "Raymond", "Van Heusen", "Allen Solly", "John Players", "H&M",
  "Zara", "Mufti", "Indian Terrain", "Pepe Jeans", "Arrow",
];

const ACCESSORIES = [
  "Nike", "Adidas", "Puma", "Clarks", "Casio",
  "Fossil", "Tommy Hilfiger", "Ray-Ban", "Titan", "Woodland",
  "Wildcraft", "American Tourister", "Skybags", "Targus", "Hidesign",
];

const ALSO_ACCESSORIES = [
  "Louis Philippe", "Van Heusen", "Allen Solly", "Peter England",
  "Raymond", "Park Avenue", "Levi's", "Zara", "H&M", "Uniqlo",
];
const EXTRA: Record<string, string[]> = {
  "Louis Philippe": ["Shirts & T-Shirts", "Pants & Trousers", "Jackets & Blazers"],
  "Van Heusen": ["Shirts & T-Shirts", "Jackets & Blazers"],
  "Allen Solly": ["Shirts & T-Shirts", "Jackets & Blazers"],
  "Raymond": ["Pants & Trousers", "Jackets & Blazers"],
  "Levi's": ["Pants & Trousers"],
  "Zara": ["Shirts & T-Shirts", "Jackets & Blazers"],
  "H&M": ["Shirts & T-Shirts", "Jackets & Blazers"],
  "Nike": ["Shoes & Accessories"],
  "Adidas": ["Shoes & Accessories"],
  "Puma": ["Shoes & Accessories"],
  "Casio": ["Shoes & Accessories"],
  "Fossil": ["Shoes & Accessories"],
};

function slugify(name: string): string {
  return (
    name.toLowerCase().normalize("NFKD").replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, "").trim()
      .replace(/[\s_]+/g, "-").replace(/-+/g, "-").replace(/^-|-$/g, "")
  ) || "brand";
}

async function main() {
  const cats = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const add = (n: string, c: string) => {
    if (!cats.has(n)) cats.set(n, new Set());
    cats.get(n)!.add(c);
  };
    SHIRTS.forEach((n) => add(n, "Shirts & T-Shirts"));
  TROUSERS.forEach((n) => add(n, "Pants & Trousers"));
  JACKETS.forEach((n) => add(n, "Jackets & Blazers"));
  ACCESSORIES.forEach((n) => add(n, "Accessories"));
  ALSO_ACCESSORIES.forEach((n) => add(n, "Accessories"));

  let added = 0, tagged = 0, skipped = 0;

  for (const [name, set] of cats) {
    const existing = await prisma.brand.findFirst({ where: { name } });
    if (existing) {
      const before = existing.categories ?? [];
      const merged = [...new Set([...before, ...set])];
      if (merged.length !== before.length) {
        await prisma.brand.update({ where: { id: existing.id }, data: { categories: merged } });
        tagged++;
      } else skipped++;
      continue;
    }
    const base = slugify(name);
    let slug = base, n = 2;
    while (await prisma.brand.findUnique({ where: { slug }, select: { id: true } })) slug = `${base}-${n++}`;
    await prisma.brand.create({ data: { name, slug, categories: [...set] } });
    added++;
  }

  console.log(`Brands: ${added} added, ${tagged} re-tagged, ${skipped} unchanged.`);
}

main().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exitCode = 1; }).finally(() => prisma.$disconnect());

FILE: prisma\seed-pincode.ts

// prisma/seed-pincode.ts
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";

const prisma = new PrismaClient();
const CSV = path.join(process.cwd(), "pincodes.csv");

function parseCsv(text: string): string[][] {
  const rows: string[][] = [];
  let row: string[] = [], field = "", q = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    const c = text[i];
    if (q) {
      if (c === '"') { if (text[i + 1] === '"') { field += '"'; i++; } else q = false; }
      else field += c;
    } else if (c === '"') q = true;
    else if (c === ",") { row.push(field); field = ""; }
    else if (c === "\n" || c === "\r") {
      if (c === "\r" && text[i + 1] === "\n") i++;
      row.push(field); field = "";
      if (row.some((v) => v !== "")) rows.push(row);
      row = [];
    } else field += c;
  }
  if (field !== "" || row.length) { row.push(field); if (row.some((v) => v !== "")) rows.push(row); }
  return rows;
}

const colIdx = (headers: string[], ...needles: string[]) =>
  headers.findIndex((h) => needles.some((n) => h.toLowerCase().includes(n)));

async function main() {
  if (!fs.existsSync(CSV)) {
    console.error(`Missing ${CSV}. Run Step 1 first.`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  
    console.log("Reading CSV...");
  const rows = parseCsv(fs.readFileSync(CSV, "utf8"));

  // Guard the first index (noUncheckedIndexedAccess makes rows[0] possibly-undefined).
  const headerRow = rows[0];
  if (!headerRow || headerRow.length === 0) {
    console.error("❌ CSV is empty or has no header row.");
    process.exit(1);
  }
  const head = headerRow.map((h) => h.trim());
  
  console.log("Detected columns:", head.join(", "));
  
  const iPin = colIdx(head, "pin");
  const iTaluk = colIdx(head, "taluk", "sub-district", "subdistrict", "division");
  const iDist = colIdx(head, "district");
  const iOffice = colIdx(head, "office name", "post office", "name");
  
  if (iPin < 0) { 
    console.error("❌ Could not find PIN column. Headers were:", head); 
    process.exit(1); 
  }
  
  console.log(`Using columns: pin[${iPin}], taluk/division[${iTaluk}], district[${iDist}], office[${iOffice}]`);
  
  const stripOffice = (s: string) => s.replace(/\s+(H\.?O\.?|SO|BO|Branch Post Office|Sub Post Office)$/i, "").trim();
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const data: { pin: string; city: string }[] = [];
  
  for (const r of rows.slice(1)) {
    const pin = (r[iPin] ?? "").trim();
    if (!/^[1-9]\d{5}$/.test(pin) || seen.has(pin)) continue;
    
    const city =
      (iTaluk >= 0 ? (r[iTaluk] ?? "").trim() : "") ||
      (iDist >= 0 ? (r[iDist] ?? "").trim() : "") ||
      (iOffice >= 0 ? stripOffice((r[iOffice] ?? "").trim()) : "");
    
    if (!city) continue;
    seen.add(pin);
    data.push({ pin, city });
  }
  
  console.log(`Found ${data.length} unique PINs to insert.\nUpserting…`);
  
  const CHUNK = 500;
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += CHUNK) {
    const slice = data.slice(i, i + CHUNK);
    await prisma.$transaction(
      slice.map((d) =>
        prisma.pincode.upsert({
          where: { pin: d.pin },
          update: { city: d.city },
          create: { pin: d.pin, city: d.city },
        }),
      ),
    );
    process.stdout.write(`  ${Math.min(i + CHUNK, data.length)}/${data.length}\r`);
  }
  
  console.log(`\n✅ Done. Pincode table has ${await prisma.pincode.count()} rows.`);
}

main()
  .catch((e) => { console.error("\n❌ Error:", e); process.exit(1); })
  .finally(() => prisma.$disconnect());

async function main() {
  console.log("Refreshing Urban Vogue hero slides...");
  for (const slide of slides) {
    const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { slug: { in: slide.productSlugs }, active: true },
      select: { id: true, slug: true },
    });
    if (!products.length) { console.warn(`Skipping ${slide.id}: no matching active products found.`); continue; }
    const order = new Map(slide.productSlugs.map((slug, index) => [slug, index]));
    const sorted = products.sort((a, b) => (order.get(a.slug) ?? 999) - (order.get(b.slug) ?? 999)).slice(0, 3);
    await prisma.heroSlide.upsert({
      where: { id: slide.id },
      update: { kind: "CUSTOM", active: true, badge: slide.badge, headline: slide.headline, highlight: slide.highlight, description: slide.description, ctaLabel: slide.ctaLabel, ctaHref: slide.ctaHref, secondaryLabel: slide.secondaryLabel, secondaryHref: slide.secondaryHref, gradient: slide.gradient, sortOrder: slide.sortOrder, startsAt: new Date(), endsAt: new Date(Date.now() + 90 * 86400000) },
      create: { id: slide.id, kind: "CUSTOM", active: true, badge: slide.badge, headline: slide.headline, highlight: slide.highlight, description: slide.description, ctaLabel: slide.ctaLabel, ctaHref: slide.ctaHref, secondaryLabel: slide.secondaryLabel, secondaryHref: slide.secondaryHref, gradient: slide.gradient, sortOrder: slide.sortOrder, startsAt: new Date(), endsAt: new Date(Date.now() + 90 * 86400000) },
    });
    await prisma.heroSlideProduct.deleteMany({ where: { slideId: slide.id } });
    await prisma.heroSlideProduct.createMany({ data: sorted.map((product, position) => ({ slideId: slide.id, productId: product.id, position })) });
    console.log(`Updated slide: ${slide.id}`);
  }
  console.log("Hero slides refreshed.");
}

main().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; }).finally(async () => { await prisma.$disconnect(); });

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

/* ───────────────────────── helpers ───────────────────────── */

function slugify(input: string): string {
  return input
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize("NFKD")
    .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, "")
    .trim()
    .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
    .replace(/-+/g, "-");
}

function img(seed: string, size = 900): string {
  return `https://picsum.photos/seed/${encodeURIComponent(seed)}/${size}/${size}`;
}

function discount(mrp: number, sale: number): number {
  if (mrp <= 0 || sale >= mrp) return 0;
  return Math.round(((mrp - sale) / mrp) * 100);
}

function gstComponent(gross: number, rate = 18): number {
  return Math.round(gross - gross / (1 + rate / 100));
}

function daysFromNow(days: number): Date {
  return new Date(Date.now() + days * 86400000);
}

}

async function getOrCreateOrder(orderNumber: string, factory: () => Promise<any>) {
  const existing = await prisma.order.findUnique({ where: { orderNumber } });
  if (existing) return existing;
  return factory();
}

async function seedCatalog() {
  const categoryMap = new Map<string, string>();
  const brandMap = new Map<string, string>();
  const productMap = new Map<string, string>();

  for (const c of categories) {
    const row = await prisma.category.upsert({
      where: { slug: c.slug },
      update: { name: c.name, description: c.description, icon: c.icon, sortOrder: c.sortOrder, active: true },
      create: { slug: c.slug, name: c.name, description: c.description, icon: c.icon, sortOrder: c.sortOrder, active: true },
    });
    categoryMap.set(c.slug, row.id);
  }

  for (const b of brands) {
    const row = await prisma.brand.upsert({
      where: { slug: b.slug },
      update: { name: b.name, countryCode: b.countryCode, logoUrl: `https://picsum.photos/seed/${b.slug}-logo/200/200`, active: true },
      create: { slug: b.slug, name: b.name, countryCode: b.countryCode, logoUrl: `https://picsum.photos/seed/${b.slug}-logo/200/200`, active: true },
    });
    brandMap.set(b.slug, row.id);
  }

  for (const p of products) {
    const categoryId = categoryMap.get(p.category);
    const brandId = brandMap.get(p.brand);
    if (!categoryId || !brandId) throw new Error(`Missing category/brand for product ${p.slug}`);

    const returnableDays = p.returnableDays ?? 7;
    const warrantyMonths = p.warrantyMonths ?? 7;
    const lowStockAt = p.lowStockAt ?? 5;
    const ratingAvg = p.ratingAvg ?? 0;
    const ratingCount = p.ratingCount ?? 0;
    const sold = p.sold ?? 0;
    const views = Math.max(25, sold * 11 + ratingCount * 3);
    const description = makeDescription(p.name, p.shortDescription, returnableDays);

    const row = await prisma.product.upsert({
      where: { slug: p.slug },
      update: {
        name: p.name, shortDescription: p.shortDescription, categoryId, brandId,
        mrp: p.mrp, salePrice: p.salePrice, discountPercent: discount(p.mrp, p.salePrice),
        stock: p.stock, lowStockAt, ratingAvg, ratingCount, sold, views,
        featured: p.featured ?? false, active: true,
        subtype: p.subtype ?? null, ram: p.ram ?? null, storage: p.storage ?? null,
        screenSize: p.screenSize ?? null, processor: p.processor ?? null, color: p.color ?? null,
        warrantyMonths, returnableDays, codEligible: true, emiEligible: true,
        exchangeEligible: p.category !== "accessories", hsnCode: p.hsnCode ?? null, tags: p.tags ?? [],
      },
      create: {
        slug: p.slug, name: p.name, shortDescription: p.shortDescription, categoryId, brandId,
        mrp: p.mrp, salePrice: p.salePrice, discountPercent: discount(p.mrp, p.salePrice),
        stock: p.stock, lowStockAt, ratingAvg, ratingCount, sold, views,
        featured: p.featured ?? false, active: true,
        subtype: p.subtype ?? null, ram: p.ram ?? null, storage: p.storage ?? null,
        screenSize: p.screenSize ?? null, processor: p.processor ?? null, color: p.color ?? null,
        warrantyMonths, returnableDays, codEligible: true, emiEligible: true,
        exchangeEligible: p.category !== "accessories", hsnCode: p.hsnCode ?? null, tags: p.tags ?? [],
      },
    });
    productMap.set(p.slug, row.id);

    await prisma.productImage.deleteMany({ where: { productId: row.id } });
    await prisma.productImage.createMany({
      data: [
        { productId: row.id, url: img(`${p.slug}-hero`), alt: `${p.name} primary view`, position: 0, isPrimary: true },
        { productId: row.id, url: img(`${p.slug}-angle`), alt: `${p.name} alternate view`, position: 1, isPrimary: false },
        { productId: row.id, url: img(`${p.slug}-detail`), alt: `${p.name} detail view`, position: 2, isPrimary: false },
      ],
    });

    await prisma.productSpecification.deleteMany({ where: { productId: row.id } });
    await prisma.productSpecification.createMany({
      data: [
        { productId: row.id, group: "General", label: "Brand", value: brands.find((b) => b.slug === p.brand)?.name ?? p.brand },
        { productId: row.id, group: "General", label: "Category", value: categories.find((c) => c.slug === p.category)?.name ?? p.category },
        ...p.specs.map(([group, label, value]) => ({ productId: row.id, group, label, value })),
      ],
    });
  }

  return { categoryMap, brandMap, productMap };
}

  const coupons = [

    { code: "STYLE200", description: "Flat ₹200 off on accessories above ₹1,499", type: CouponType.FIXED, value: 200, scope: CouponScope.CATEGORY, categorySlug: "accessories", minOrderValue: 1499, usageLimit: 800, perUserLimit: 2 },
    { code: "LP10", description: "Extra 10% off on Louis Philippe", type: CouponType.PERCENT, value: 10, scope: CouponScope.BRAND, brandSlug: "louis-philippe", minOrderValue: 2000, maxDiscount: 1000, usageLimit: 500, perUserLimit: 1 },
    { code: "WELCOME250", description: "Flat ₹250 off for first-time Urban Vogue buyers", type: CouponType.FIXED, value: 250, scope: CouponScope.ALL, minOrderValue: 2999, usageLimit: 2000, perUserLimit: 1 },
  ];

  for (const c of coupons) {
    await prisma.coupon.upsert({
      where: { code: c.code },
      update: { description: c.description, type: c.type, value: c.value, scope: c.scope, categoryId: (c as any).categorySlug ? categoryMap.get((c as any).categorySlug) ?? null : null, brandId: (c as any).brandSlug ? brandMap.get((c as any).brandSlug) ?? null : null, minOrderValue: c.minOrderValue, maxDiscount: c.maxDiscount ?? null, usageLimit: c.usageLimit ?? null, perUserLimit: c.perUserLimit, active: true, startsAt: new Date(), endsAt: daysFromNow(60) },
      create: { code: c.code, description: c.description, type: c.type, value: c.value, scope: c.scope, categoryId: (c as any).categorySlug ? categoryMap.get((c as any).categorySlug) ?? null : null, brandId: (c as any).brandSlug ? brandMap.get((c as any).brandSlug) ?? null : null, minOrderValue: c.minOrderValue, maxDiscount: c.maxDiscount ?? null, usageLimit: c.usageLimit ?? null, perUserLimit: c.perUserLimit, active: true, startsAt: new Date(), endsAt: daysFromNow(60) },

  }

  await prisma.banner.deleteMany({ where: { slot: { in: ["PROMO_STRIP", "SALE", "CATEGORY", "FOOTER"] } } });
  await prisma.banner.createMany({
    data: [
      { slot: "PROMO_STRIP", title: "Free delivery above ₹999", subtitle: "Standard shipping across serviceable PIN codes", ctaLabel: "Shop now", ctaHref: "/products/all", active: true, sortOrder: 1 },

      { slot: "CATEGORY", title: "Upgrade your wardrobe", subtitle: "Exchange bonus available on select styles", ctaLabel: "Browse shirts", ctaHref: "/products/shirts", active: true, sortOrder: 4 },
      { slot: "CATEGORY", title: "Jackets for every season", subtitle: "No-cost EMI from 3 months", ctaLabel: "Browse jackets", ctaHref: "/products/jackets", active: true, sortOrder: 5 },
      { slot: "FOOTER", title: "Need style help?", subtitle: "Talk to a fashion specialist before you buy", ctaLabel: "Contact support", ctaHref: "/contact", active: true, sortOrder: 6 },
    ],
  });

  async function upsertSlide(id: string, data: { badge: string; headline: string; highlight?: string; description?: string; ctaLabel: string; ctaHref?: string; secondaryLabel?: string; secondaryHref?: string; gradient: GradientTheme; sortOrder: number }, productSlugs: string[]) {
    await prisma.heroSlide.upsert({
      where: { id },
      update: { kind: "CUSTOM", active: true, startsAt: new Date(), endsAt: daysFromNow(90), ...data },
      create: { id, kind: "CUSTOM", active: true, startsAt: new Date(), endsAt: daysFromNow(90), ...data },
    });
    await prisma.heroSlideProduct.deleteMany({ where: { slideId: id } });
    const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({ where: { slug: { in: productSlugs }, active: true }, select: { id: true, slug: true } });
    const order = new Map(productSlugs.map((s, i) => [s, i]));
    const sorted = rows.sort((a, b) => (order.get(a.slug) ?? 99) - (order.get(b.slug) ?? 99));
    if (sorted.length) {
      await prisma.heroSlideProduct.createMany({ data: sorted.map((p, position) => ({ slideId: id, productId: p.id, position })) });
    }
  }

  await upsertSlide("seed-slide-new-season", {
    badge: "NEW SEASON", headline: "India's freshest,", highlight: "style drops",
    description: "New season shirts, trousers and jackets are live with launch pricing and exchange support.",
    ctaLabel: "Shop new arrivals", ctaHref: "/products/all?sort=newest", secondaryLabel: "See offers", secondaryHref: "/offers",
    gradient: GradientTheme.EMERALD_TECH, sortOrder: 1,
  }, ["louis-philippe-oxford-formal-shirt-white-slim", "van-heusen-single-breasted-blazer-navy", "raymond-slim-fit-formal-trousers-charcoal"]);

  await upsertSlide("seed-slide-sale", {
    badge: "MEGA SALE", headline: "Big savings on,", highlight: "wardrobe essentials",
    description: "Shirts, trousers, jackets and accessories at festival-style prices.",
    ctaLabel: "Browse collection", ctaHref: "/products/shirts", secondaryLabel: "Coupons", secondaryHref: "/offers",
    gradient: GradientTheme.SUNSET_DEAL, sortOrder: 2,
  }, ["levis-511-slim-fit-jeans-dark-indigo", "allen-solly-bomber-jacket-olive", "peter-england-solid-crew-neck-tshirt-black"]);

  await upsertSlide("seed-slide-premium", {
    badge: "PREMIUM EDIT", headline: "Own the look,", highlight: "pay in EMIs",
    description: "Selected blazers, overcoats and premium shoes available on 3, 6, 9 and 12-month no-cost EMI plans.",
    ctaLabel: "Explore jackets", ctaHref: "/products/jackets", secondaryLabel: "EMI offers", secondaryHref: "/offers",
    gradient: GradientTheme.STEEL_GRAPHITE, sortOrder: 3,
  }, ["raymond-wool-blend-overcoat-camel", "van-heusen-single-breasted-blazer-navy", "clarks-leather-oxford-shoes-tan"]);

  async function setFeature(section: FeatureSection, slugs: string[]) {
    await prisma.productFeature.deleteMany({ where: { section } });
    const unique = Array.from(new Set(slugs));
    const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({ where: { slug: { in: unique }, active: true }, select: { id: true, slug: true } });
    const order = new Map(unique.map((s, i) => [s, i]));
    const sorted = rows.sort((a, b) => (order.get(a.slug) ?? 99) - (order.get(b.slug) ?? 99));
    if (sorted.length) {
      await prisma.productFeature.createMany({ data: sorted.map((p, position) => ({ section, productId: p.id, position })) });
    }
  }

  await setFeature(FeatureSection.NEW_ARRIVALS, ["louis-philippe-oxford-formal-shirt-white-slim", "van-heusen-single-breasted-blazer-navy", "raymond-slim-fit-formal-trousers-charcoal", "zara-textured-polo-tshirt-navy-slim", "uniqlo-supima-cotton-tshirt-white", "raymond-wool-blend-overcoat-camel", "casio-edifice-chronograph-watch-silver", "tommy-hilfiger-leather-belt-brown"]);
  await setFeature(FeatureSection.HOT_DEALS, ["peter-england-solid-crew-neck-tshirt-black", "allen-solly-casual-linen-shirt-beige-relaxed", "levis-511-slim-fit-jeans-dark-indigo", "puma-suede-classic-sneakers-navy", "mufti-stretch-chinos-khaki-slim", "peter-england-cotton-boxer-pack-navy", "hm-oversized-denim-jacket-light-blue", "fossil-leather-bifold-wallet-dark-brown"]);
  await setFeature(FeatureSection.TRENDING, ["allen-solly-bomber-jacket-olive", "nike-air-force-1-sneakers-white", "van-heusen-stretch-formal-shirt-light-blue-regular", "park-avenue-cashmere-sweater-maroon", "ray-ban-aviator-sunglasses-gold", "john-players-leather-jacket-black"]);
  await setFeature(FeatureSection.BEST_SELLERS, ["peter-england-solid-crew-neck-tshirt-black", "louis-philippe-premium-silk-tie-burgundy", "levis-511-slim-fit-jeans-dark-indigo", "mufti-stretch-chinos-khaki-slim", "allen-solly-casual-linen-shirt-beige-relaxed", "adidas-ultraboost-running-shoes-black"]);

  await prisma.frequentlyBoughtPair.deleteMany({});
  const fbpPairs = [
    ["louis-philippe-oxford-formal-shirt-white-slim", ["louis-philippe-premium-silk-tie-burgundy", "raymond-slim-fit-formal-trousers-charcoal"]],
    ["van-heusen-single-breasted-blazer-navy", ["louis-philippe-oxford-formal-shirt-white-slim", "clarks-leather-oxford-shoes-tan"]],
    ["levis-511-slim-fit-jeans-dark-indigo", ["peter-england-solid-crew-neck-tshirt-black", "puma-suede-classic-sneakers-navy"]],
  ] as const;

  const fbpData: { primaryId: string; addOnId: string }[] = [];
  for (const [primarySlug, addOnSlugs] of fbpPairs) {
    const primaryId = productMap.get(primarySlug);
    if (!primaryId) continue;
    for (const addOnSlug of addOnSlugs) {
      const addOnId = productMap.get(addOnSlug);
      if (addOnId && addOnId !== primaryId) fbpData.push({ primaryId, addOnId });
    }
  }
  if (fbpData.length) await prisma.frequentlyBoughtPair.createMany({ data: fbpData, skipDuplicates: true });
}

async function seedUsersAndOrders(productMap: Map<string, string>) {
  const customerPassword = await bcrypt.hash("", 12);

  async function ensureCustomer(input: { email: string; name: string; phone: string; whatsappOptIn: boolean }) {
    return prisma.user.upsert({
      where: { email: input.email },
      update: { name: input.name, phone: input.phone, whatsappOptIn: input.whatsappOptIn, role: Role.CUSTOMER, active: true },
      create: { email: input.email, name: input.name, phone: input.phone, passwordHash: customerPassword, role: Role.CUSTOMER, whatsappOptIn: input.whatsappOptIn, active: true },
    });
  }

  const priya = await ensureCustomer({ email: "priya@example.com", name: "Priya Verma", phone: "9876543210", whatsappOptIn: true });
  const rahul = await ensureCustomer({ email: "rahul@example.com", name: "Rahul Nair", phone: "9812345678", whatsappOptIn: false });

  await prisma.address.deleteMany({ where: { userId: { in: [priya.id, rahul.id] } } });
  const priyaAddress = await prisma.address.create({ data: { userId: priya.id, label: "Home", fullName: "Priya Verma", phone: "9876543210", pincode: "560103", line1: "Flat 402, Prestige Meridian", line2: "Outer Ring Road", city: "Bengaluru", state: "Karnataka", isDefault: true } });
  const rahulAddress = await prisma.address.create({ data: { userId: rahul.id, label: "Work", fullName: "Rahul Nair", phone: "9812345678", pincode: "400705", line1: "Unit 703, Kalpataru Square", line2: "Andheri East", city: "Mumbai", state: "Maharashtra", isDefault: true } });

  type BuildLine = { slug: string; quantity: number };
  async function buildLines(lines: BuildLine[]) {
    const out: { productId: string; name: string; slug: string; brand: string; image: string; unitMrp: number; unitPrice: number; quantity: number; lineTotal: number; warrantyMonths: number }[] = [];
    for (const line of lines) {
      const p = await prisma.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { slug: line.slug }, include: { brand: { select: { name: true } }, images: { select: { url: true, isPrimary: true, position: true }, orderBy: { position: "asc" } } } });
      const image = p.images.find((i) => i.isPrimary)?.url ?? p.images[0]?.url ?? img(p.slug);
      out.push({ productId: p.id, name: p.name, slug: p.slug, brand: p.brand.name, image, unitMrp: p.mrp, unitPrice: p.salePrice, quantity: line.quantity, lineTotal: p.salePrice * line.quantity, warrantyMonths: p.warrantyMonths });
    }
    return out;
  }

  function totalsFromLines(lines: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof buildLines>>, opts: { deliveryFee: number; codFee: number; couponDiscount?: number }) {
    const subtotalMrp = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.unitMrp * l.quantity, 0);
    const subtotal = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.lineTotal, 0);
    const itemDiscount = subtotalMrp - subtotal;
    const payable = Math.max(0, subtotal - (opts.couponDiscount ?? 0));
    const total = payable + opts.deliveryFee + opts.codFee;
    const itemCount = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.quantity, 0);
    return { subtotalMrp, subtotal, itemDiscount, total, itemCount, gstComponent: gstComponent(total) };
  }

  const deliveredLines = await buildLines([{ slug: "peter-england-solid-crew-neck-tshirt-black", quantity: 1 }, { slug: "louis-philippe-premium-silk-tie-burgundy", quantity: 1 }]);
  const deliveredTotals = totalsFromLines(deliveredLines, { deliveryFee: 0, codFee: 0 });
  const deliveredOrder = await getOrCreateOrder("UVSEEDDELIVERED", () =>

        couponDiscount: 0, deliveryFee: 0, codFee: 0, total: deliveredTotals.total,
        gstRate: 18, gstComponent: deliveredTotals.gstComponent, deliveryMode: "STANDARD",
        etaFrom: daysFromNow(-7), etaTo: daysFromNow(-5), deliveredAt: daysFromNow(-4),

        items: { create: deliveredLines.map((l) => ({ productId: l.productId, name: l.name, slug: l.slug, brand: l.brand, image: l.image, unitMrp: l.unitMrp, unitPrice: l.unitPrice, quantity: l.quantity, lineTotal: l.lineTotal, warrantyMonths: l.warrantyMonths })) },
        payments: { create: { method: PaymentMethod.UPI, status: PaymentStatus.PAID, amountPaise: deliveredTotals.total * 100, razorpayOrderId: "order_seed_delivered", razorpayPaymentId: "pay_seed_delivered", razorpaySignature: "seed_signature", capturedAt: daysFromNow(-8) } },
        trackingEvents: { create: [
          { status: OrderStatus.PENDING, title: "Order placed", description: "Payment received. Your order is confirmed.", location: "Urban Vogue", createdAt: daysFromNow(-8) },
          { status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, title: "Order confirmed", description: "Moved to packing queue.", location: "Bengaluru Hub", createdAt: daysFromNow(-7) },
          { status: OrderStatus.PROCESSING, title: "Processing at fulfilment centre", description: "Quality checked and packed.", location: "Bengaluru Hub", createdAt: daysFromNow(-6) },
          { status: OrderStatus.SHIPPED, title: "Shipped", description: "Handed over to carrier.", location: "Bengaluru", createdAt: daysFromNow(-5) },
          { status: OrderStatus.OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, title: "Out for delivery", description: "Expected today.", location: "Bengaluru", createdAt: daysFromNow(-4) },

      },

  const shippedLines = await buildLines([{ slug: "van-heusen-single-breasted-blazer-navy", quantity: 1 }]);
  const shippedTotals = totalsFromLines(shippedLines, { deliveryFee: 0, codFee: 0 });

async function seedCommunity(productMap: Map<string, string>) {
  const priya = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: "priya@example.com" } });
  const rahul = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: "rahul@example.com" } });
  const admin = await prisma.user.findFirst({ where: { role: Role.ADMIN } });

  const tshirtId = productMap.get("peter-england-solid-crew-neck-tshirt-black");
  const blazerId = productMap.get("van-heusen-single-breasted-blazer-navy");

  if (priya && tshirtId) {
    await prisma.review.upsert({
      where: { productId_userId: { productId: tshirtId, userId: priya.id } },
      update: {},
      create: { productId: tshirtId, userId: priya.id, rating: 5, title: "Excellent quality cotton", body: "Arrived in two days, packaging was solid. The cotton feels premium and the fit is true to size. No complaints so far.", verified: true, helpfulCount: 4, published: true },
    });
    const reviewAggregate = await prisma.review.aggregate({ where: { productId: tshirtId, published: true }, _avg: { rating: true }, _count: true });
    await prisma.product.update({ where: { id: tshirtId }, data: { ratingAvg: reviewAggregate._avg.rating ?? 0, ratingCount: reviewAggregate._count } });
  }

  if (rahul && blazerId) {
    const existingQuestion = await prisma.question.findFirst({ where: { productId: blazerId, userId: rahul.id } });
    if (!existingQuestion) {
      const question = await prisma.question.create({ data: { productId: blazerId, userId: rahul.id, body: "Does this blazer come with a spare button?" } });
      if (admin) {
        await prisma.answer.create({ data: { questionId: question.id, userId: admin.id, body: "Yes. Each blazer comes with one spare button sewn inside the interior pocket.", isOfficial: true } });
        await prisma.question.update({ where: { id: question.id }, data: { answered: true } });
      }
    }
    const existingTicket = await prisma.supportTicket.findFirst({ where: { userId: rahul.id, subject: "Blazer sizing question" } });
    if (!existingTicket) {
      await prisma.supportTicket.create({ data: { reference: "UVSUP-SEED001", userId: rahul.id, email: rahul.email, subject: "Blazer sizing question", category: "PRODUCT", status: TicketStatus.OPEN, messages: { create: { userId: rahul.id, body: "I want to confirm the chest measurement for size 40 before placing the order." } } } });
    }
  }

  if (priya) {
    const existingFeedback = await prisma.feedback.findFirst({ where: { userId: priya.id } });
    if (!existingFeedback) {
      await prisma.feedback.create({ data: { userId: priya.id, name: priya.name, email: priya.email, productQuality: 5, delivery: 4, customerService: 5, packaging: 4, website: 5, overall: 5, comment: "Smooth checkout and clear order tracking. Wish there were more styling guides for formal wear." } });
    }
  }
}

async function main() {
  console.log("Seeding Urban Vogue database...");
  const { categoryMap, brandMap, productMap } = await seedCatalog();
  await seedMarketing(categoryMap, brandMap, productMap);
  await seedUsersAndOrders(productMap);
  await seedCommunity(productMap);
  console.log("Seed complete.");
  console.log("Demo customer password: Customer@12345");
  console.log("Run: npm run seed:admin");
}

main()
  .catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; })
  .finally(async () => { await prisma.$disconnect(); });

// prisma/sync-images.ts   →   npx tsx prisma/sync-images.ts --dry   then   npx tsx prisma/sync-images.ts [--replace-dead]
import { readFileSync, existsSync } from "node:fs";
import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";

// PASTE-PROOF .env loader: NO regex, NO backslashes. Split each line on the FIRST
// '=' only, so "KEY=value", "KEY = value", and values containing '=' (query params)
// all parse. Strips a leading "export ", surrounding quotes, skips blanks/comments.
// Crucially it does NOT swallow read errors — a missing/unreadable .env is reported.
function loadDotEnv(): void {
  const path = ".env";
  if (!existsSync(path)) { console.warn(`[env] no .env at ${process.cwd()} — relying on exported env vars`); return; }
  let text: string;
  try { text = readFileSync(path, "utf8"); }
  catch (e) { console.error(`[env] FAILED to read .env: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : e}`); return; }
  for (const raw of text.split(/\r\n|\r|\n/)) {
    const line = raw.trim();
    if (!line || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
    const eq = line.indexOf("=");
    if (eq === -1) continue;
    let key = line.slice(0, eq).trim().replace(/^export\s+/i, "");
    if (!/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/.test(key)) continue;
    const val = line.slice(eq + 1).trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "");
    if (!(key in process.env)) process.env[key] = val; // don't clobber an explicit export
  }
}
loadDotEnv();

function mask(u?: string): string {
  if (!u) return "(unset)";
  try { const x = new URL(u); return `${x.protocol}//${x.hostname}${x.port ? ":" + x.port : ""}/…(${u.length} chars)`; }
  catch { return `unparseable, len=${u.length}`; }
}

const DRY = process.argv.includes("--dry");
const REPLACE_DEAD = process.argv.includes("--replace-dead");
const DEAD = "picsum.photos"; // the one host the KB confirms is Cloudflare-403-blocking

// ASSERT before constructing anything — turns a cryptic Prisma stack into a clear message.
const LOCAL_URL = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
const NEON_URL  = process.env.NEON_DATABASE_URL;
console.log(`[env] DATABASE_URL      = ${mask(LOCAL_URL)}`);
console.log(`[env] NEON_DATABASE_URL = ${mask(NEON_URL)}`);
const missing: string[] = [];
if (!LOCAL_URL) missing.push("DATABASE_URL (local Docker) — add it to .env or export it");
if (!NEON_URL)  missing.push("NEON_DATABASE_URL (Neon POOLED url, ends in -pooler) — add it to .env or export it");
if (missing.length) { console.error("\nABORT — missing env:\n  - " + missing.join("\n  - ")); process.exit(1); }

async function main() {
  // Construct AFTER the asserts so a bad/missing URL can never reach a lazy connect.
  const local = new PrismaClient();                                       // uses process.env.DATABASE_URL
  const neon  = new PrismaClient({ datasources: { db: { url: NEON_URL! } } }); // classic override, Prisma 6.19.3

  try {
    // local products that actually HAVE a real (non-picsum) image — the only ones sync can copy from
    const locals = await local.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true },
      select: {
        slug: true,
        images: { orderBy: [{ isPrimary: "desc" }, { position: "asc" }],
          select: { url: true, alt: true, position: true, isPrimary: true, kind: true } },
      },
    });
    const withImgs = locals.filter((p) => p.images.some((im) => im.url && !im.url.includes(DEAD)));
    const slugs = withImgs.map((p) => p.slug);

    // map slug -> neon product id (cuids differ across the two DBs, so we match by slug)
    const neonRows = await neon.product.findMany({ where: { slug: { in: slugs } }, select: { id: true, slug: true } });
    const neonIdBySlug = new Map(neonRows.map((r) => [r.slug, r.id]));

    let added = 0, removedDead = 0, deadDetected = 0, skippedNoNeon = 0, errors = 0;
    const log: string[] = [];

    for (const p of withImgs) {
      const nid = neonIdBySlug.get(p.slug);
      if (!nid) { skippedNoNeon++; log.push(`  [no-neon-product] ${p.slug} -> create it on the live Vercel admin first`); continue; }

      const existing = await neon.productImage.findMany({ where: { productId: nid }, select: { id: true, url: true } });
      const deadIds  = existing.filter((e) => e.url?.includes(DEAD)).map((e) => e.id);
      const keptUrls = new Set(existing.filter((e) => !e.url?.includes(DEAD)).map((e) => e.url));
      deadDetected += deadIds.length; // counted in BOTH modes so one --dry tells you the flag

      // rows to add = local real urls not already kept on neon (avoids duplicates; idempotent)
      const toAdd = p.images
        .filter((im) => im.url && !im.url.includes(DEAD) && !keptUrls.has(im.url))
        .map((im) => ({ productId: nid, url: im.url, alt: im.alt, position: im.position, isPrimary: im.isPrimary, kind: im.kind ?? "GALLERY" }));

      if (!deadIds.length && !toAdd.length) continue; // neon already mirrors local -> nothing to do

      log.push(`  [add ${toAdd.length}] ${p.slug}  neon(kept=${keptUrls.size}, dead=${deadIds.length})`);
      if (DRY) { added += toAdd.length; continue; }

      try {
        if (REPLACE_DEAD && deadIds.length) { await neon.productImage.deleteMany({ where: { id: { in: deadIds } } }); removedDead += deadIds.length; }
        if (toAdd.length) { await neon.productImage.createMany({ data: toAdd }); added += toAdd.length; }
      } catch (e) { errors++; log.push(`  [ERROR] ${p.slug}: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : e}`); }
    }

    console.log(`${DRY ? "DRY-RUN" : "APPLIED"} | replace-dead=${REPLACE_DEAD} | products w/ real local imgs: ${withImgs.length}`);
    console.log(`real rows ${DRY ? "would be" : "were"} added: ${added}`);
    console.log(`dead picsum rows DETECTED: ${deadDetected}  (removed ONLY with --replace-dead; ${DRY ? "dry-run, nothing written" : `actually removed: ${removedDead}`})`);
    console.log(`skipped (no neon product): ${skippedNoNeon} | errors: ${errors}`);
    if (log.length) { console.log("details:"); for (const l of log) console.log(l); }
    console.log("\nA broken slug ABSENT from this list = local has no real image either -> paste its URL on the live Vercel admin (sync can't manufacture pixels).");
  } finally {
    await local.$disconnect(); await neon.$disconnect();
  }
}
main().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exitCode = 1; });

"use client";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ChevronRight, Package, Search, SlidersHorizontal } from "lucide-react";

export type OrderVM = {
  id: string;
  orderNumber: string;
  status: string;
  createdAt: string;
  confirmedAt: string | null;
  shippedAt: string | null;
  deliveredAt: string | null;
  cancelledAt: string | null;
  items: { name: string; quantity: number; image: string | null; brand: string }[];
};

type Filter = "ALL" | "DELIVERED" | "IN_TRANSIT" | "CANCELLED";

const milestone = (o: OrderVM): { label: string; date: string | null } => {
  if (o.status === "DELIVERED") return { label: "Delivered on", date: o.deliveredAt };
  if (o.status === "CANCELLED") return { label: "Cancelled on", date: o.cancelledAt };
  if (["SHIPPED", "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY", "PROCESSING", "CONFIRMED"].includes(o.status)) {
    return { label: "Arriving by", date: o.shippedAt ?? o.confirmedAt };
  }
  return { label: "Placed on", date: o.createdAt };
};

const filterMatches = (o: OrderVM, f: Filter) => {
  if (f === "ALL") return true;
  if (f === "DELIVERED") return o.status === "DELIVERED";
  if (f === "CANCELLED") return o.status === "CANCELLED";
  return ["CONFIRMED", "PROCESSING", "SHIPPED", "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY"].includes(o.status);
};

const fmtDate = (iso: string | null): string => {
  if (!iso) return "—";
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric" });
};

export function OrdersClient({ orders }: { orders: OrderVM[] }) {
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Filter>("ALL");
  const [showFilters, setShowFilters] = useState(true);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = q.trim().toLowerCase();
    return orders.filter((o) => {
      if (!filterMatches(o, filter)) return false;
      if (!needle) return true;
      if (o.orderNumber.toLowerCase().includes(needle)) return true;
      return o.items.some(
        (i) => i.name.toLowerCase().includes(needle) || (i.brand?.toLowerCase() ?? "").includes(needle),
      );
    });
  }, [orders, q, filter]);

  const grouped = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, OrderVM[]>();
    for (const o of filtered) {
      const key = new Date(o.createdAt).toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric" });
      const arr = m.get(key) ?? [];
      arr.push(o);
      m.set(key, arr);
    }
    return [...m.entries()];
  }, [filtered]);

  const chips: { id: Filter; label: string }[] = [
    { id: "ALL", label: "All" },
    { id: "DELIVERED", label: "Delivered" },
    { id: "IN_TRANSIT", label: "In Transit" },
    { id: "CANCELLED", label: "Cancelled" },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="container-x py-6">
      <h1 className="mb-4 font-display text-xl font-bold">My Orders</h1>

      <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="relative flex-1">
          <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" />
          <input
            value={q}
            onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search your order here"
            className="h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white pl-9 pr-3 text-[13px] outline-none focus:border-[#1a1a2e]"
          />
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setShowFilters((s) => !s)}
          className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 text-[13px] font-bold text-gray-800"
          aria-expanded={showFilters}
        >
          <SlidersHorizontal className="size-4" /> Filters
        </button>
      </div>

      {showFilters && (
        <div className="mb-4 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1 [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden">
          {chips.map((c) => (
            <button
              key={c.id}
              onClick={() => setFilter(c.id)}
              className={`shrink-0 rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-[12.5px] font-bold transition-colors ${
                filter === c.id ? "bg-gray-900 text-white" : "border border-gray-200 bg-white text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-400"
              }`}
            >
              {c.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {grouped.length === 0 && (
        <p className="rounded-xl bg-gray-50 p-6 text-center text-[13px] text-gray-500">
          No orders match {q ? `"${q}"` : "this filter"}.
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-6">
        {grouped.map(([day, dayOrders]) => (
          <section key={day}>
            <h2 className="mb-2 text-[12.5px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500">{day}</h2>
            <ul className="divide-y divide-gray-100 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-100 bg-white">
              {dayOrders.map((o) => {
                const ms = milestone(o);
                return (
                  <li key={o.id}>
                    {/* One card per order; item rows stack with no internal dividers, like the reference */}
                    <ul>
                      {o.items.map((item, iIdx) => (
                        <li key={iIdx}>
                          <Link
                            href={`/account/orders/${encodeURIComponent(o.orderNumber)}`}
                            className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 transition-colors hover:bg-gray-50"
                          >
                            <span className="relative size-16 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-gray-50">
                              {item.image ? (
                                // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                                <img src={item.image} alt={item.name} className="size-full object-contain p-1" />
                              ) : (
                                <span className="grid size-full place-items-center bg-gray-100 text-gray-400">
                                  <Package className="size-5" />
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </span>
                            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                              <span className="block truncate text-[14px] font-bold text-gray-900">
                                {ms.label} {fmtDate(ms.date)}
                              </span>
                              <span className="mt-0.5 block truncate text-[12.5px] text-gray-600">
                                {item.name}
                                {item.brand ? ` · ${item.brand}` : ""}
                              </span>
                            </span>
                            <ChevronRight className="size-4 shrink-0 text-gray-400" />
                          </Link>
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          </section>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default OrdersClient;

import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { OrdersClient, type OrderVM } from "./OrdersClient";

export default async function MyOrdersPage() {
  const me = await getActor();
  if (!me?.email) {
    return (
      <div className="container-x py-8 text-center">
        <p>Please log in to view your orders.</p>
        <Link href="/auth/login" className="mt-4 inline-block font-bold text-[#1a1a2e] hover:underline">Sign In →</Link>
      </div>
    );
  }
  
  const orders = await prisma.order.findMany({
    where: { OR: [{ userId: me.id }, { guestEmail: me.email }] },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    take: 50,
    include: {
      items: { select: { name: true, quantity: true, image: true, brand: true } },
    },
  });
  
  if (orders.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="container-x py-8 text-center">
        <h2 className="mb-2 text-lg font-bold">No orders yet</h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Start shopping to track deliveries!</p>
        <Link href="/" className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-[#1a1a2e] px-4 py-2 text-white hover:bg-amber-800">Browse Products <ArrowRight className="size-4"/></Link>
      </div>
    );
  }
  
  // Serialize dates (Date objects don't round-trip through RSC props cleanly).
  const serialized: OrderVM[] = orders.map((o) => ({
    id: o.id,
    orderNumber: o.orderNumber,
    status: o.status,
    createdAt: o.createdAt.toISOString(),
    confirmedAt: o.confirmedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    shippedAt: o.shippedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    deliveredAt: o.deliveredAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    cancelledAt: o.cancelledAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    items: o.items,
  }));
  
  return <OrdersClient orders={serialized} />;
}

"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Check, Copy } from "lucide-react";
import { copyText } from "@/lib/clipboard";

export function CopyButton({ value, label = "Copy order number" }: { value: string; label?: string }) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<"idle" | "copied" | "failed">("idle");

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={async () => {
        const ok = await copyText(value);
        setState(ok ? "copied" : "failed");
        window.setTimeout(() => setState("idle"), 1500);
        if (!ok) console.warn("[copy] clipboard unavailable for:", value);
      }}
      className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-50"
      aria-label={state === "copied" ? "Copied" : state === "failed" ? "Copy failed" : label}
      title={state === "copied" ? "Copied!" : state === "failed" ? "Copy failed — select & copy manually" : label}
    >
      {state === "copied" ? (
        <Check className="size-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
      ) : state === "failed" ? (
        <Copy className="size-3.5 text-rose-500" />
      ) : (
        <Copy className="size-3.5" />
      )}
    </button>
  );
}

import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import Link from "next/link";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { DeliveryTimeline } from "@/components/tracking/DeliveryTimeline";
import { CopyButton } from "./CopyButton";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  Banknote,
  Check,
  ChevronDown,
  CreditCard,
  Info,
  Landmark,
  QrCode,
  ShieldCheck,
  Star,
  Wallet,
} from "lucide-react";

type AddressSnap = { name?: string; line1?: string; line2?: string; city?: string; state?: string; pincode?: string; phone?: string };

const compact = (n: number) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en", { notation: "compact", maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(n);

const inr = (n: number) => `₹${Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-IN")}`;

const fmtDate = (d: Date | string | null | undefined): string =>
  d ? new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric" }) : "—";

const methodLabel = (m: string | null) =>
  m === "COD" ? "Cash On Delivery" : m === "CARD" ? "Card" : m === "UPI" ? "UPI" : m === "NETBANKING" ? "Net Banking" : m === "WALLET" ? "Wallet" : m ?? "—";

/** Small payment-method glyph for the "Paid By" row, like the reference. */
function MethodIcon({ m }: { m: string | null }) {
  const C =
    m === "COD" ? Banknote :
    m === "CARD" ? CreditCard :
    m === "UPI" ? QrCode :
    m === "NETBANKING" ? Landmark :
    Wallet;
  return <C className="size-3.5 text-gray-500" aria-hidden />;
}

/** Flipkart-style collapsible row: bold title + gray subtitle, square chevron button right. */

export default async function TrackOrderDetailPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ orderNumber: string }> }) {
  const { orderNumber } = await params;
  const decodedNum = decodeURIComponent(orderNumber);

  const me = await getActor();
  if (!me?.email) notFound();

  // items select no longer pulls the product relation: the recommendation grid used to
  // scope by category, but it is now a whole-catalog random draw, so categoryId is dead.
  const order = await prisma.order.findFirst({
    where: { orderNumber: decodedNum, OR: [{ userId: me.id }, { guestEmail: me.email }] },
    include: {
      items: {
        select: {
          name: true, quantity: true, unitPrice: true, image: true, brand: true, productId: true, slug: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });
  if (!order) notFound();

  const cancelled = order.status === "CANCELLED";
  const delivered = order.status === "DELIVERED";
  const inTransit = ["CONFIRMED", "PROCESSING", "SHIPPED", "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY"].includes(order.status);

  const statusSummary = delivered
    ? { tone: "green" as const, label: `Delivered, ${fmtDate(order.deliveredAt)}` }
    : cancelled
      ? { tone: "red" as const, label: `Cancelled${order.cancelledAt ? `, ${fmtDate(order.cancelledAt)}` : ""}` }
      : inTransit
        ? { tone: "blue" as const, label: `In Transit · ${order.status.toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, " ")}` }
        : { tone: "gray" as const, label: "Pending" };

  const RETURN_WINDOW_DAYS = 7;
  const returnWindowEnd = order.deliveredAt
    ? new Date(new Date(order.deliveredAt).getTime() + RETURN_WINDOW_DAYS * 864e5)
    : null;
  const returnWindowEnded = returnWindowEnd ? returnWindowEnd.getTime() < Date.now() : false;

  // addressSnapshot is read defensively (not in the confirmed scalar set); the money and
  // payment fields below ARE typed Order columns, so they're read directly (no casts).
  const addr = (order as unknown as { addressSnapshot?: AddressSnap | null }).addressSnapshot ?? null;
  const addrLine = addr ? [addr.line1, addr.line2, addr.city, addr.state, addr.pincode].filter(Boolean).join(", ") : null;
  const paymentMethod = order.paymentMethod;
  const paymentStatus = order.paymentStatus;
  const subtotalMrp = order.subtotalMrp;
  const subtotal = order.subtotal;
  const deliveryFee = order.deliveryFee;
  const codFee = order.codFee;
  const couponDiscount = order.couponDiscount;
  const gstComponent = order.gstComponent;
  const total = order.total;

  // "Products For You": a per-request RANDOM draw over the ENTIRE active+in-stock catalog
  // (no category gate, no deterministic orderBy, no fixed window), excluding this order's
  // own items. This is the dynamic guarantee: a product you publish later is eligible on
  // the next load with no rebuild. (Scale: id-only scan of the active set, same pattern as
  // the account sponsored pool; switch to a random-skip/TABLESAMPLE pick if it ever grows
  // very large.)
  const excludeSet = new Set(order.items.map((i) => i.productId));
  const candIds = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  const pool = candIds.filter((c) => !excludeSet.has(c.id));
  const shuffled = [...pool];
  for (let i = shuffled.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    const a = shuffled[i]!;
    shuffled[i] = shuffled[j]!;
    shuffled[j] = a;
  }
  const pickedIds = shuffled.slice(0, 12).map((r) => r.id);
  const forYouRows = pickedIds.length
    ? await prisma.product.findMany({
        where: { id: { in: pickedIds } },
        select: {
          id: true, slug: true, name: true, mrp: true, salePrice: true, ratingAvg: true, ratingCount: true,
          brand: { select: { name: true } },
          images: { select: { url: true, isPrimary: true }, orderBy: { position: "asc" as const } },
        },
      })
    : [];
  const byId = new Map(forYouRows.map((r) => [r.id, r] as const));
  const forYou = pickedIds
    .map((id) => byId.get(id))
    .filter((r): r is NonNullable<typeof r> => Boolean(r));

  return (
    <article className="container-x mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl space-y-4 px-4 py-6">
      <header className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5">
          <Link
            href="/account/orders"
            aria-label="Back to orders"
            className="grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="size-5" />
          </Link>
          <h1 className="truncate font-display text-[20px] font-bold">Order Details</h1>
        </div>
        <Link
          href="/account/support"
          className="shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-1.5 text-[13px] font-bold text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-50"
        >
          Help
        </Link>
      </header>

      <section className="space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-gray-100 bg-white p-4">
        {order.items.map((item) => (
          <Link
            key={item.productId}
            href={`/product/${item.slug}`}
            className="-mx-2 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl p-2 transition-colors hover:bg-gray-50 active:bg-gray-100"
          >
            <span className="relative size-20 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-gray-50">
              {item.image ? (
                // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                <img src={item.image} alt={item.name} className="size-full object-contain p-1" />
              ) : (
                <span className="grid size-full place-items-center bg-gray-100 text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-400">
                  {item.name.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
                </span>
              )}
            </span>
            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <span className="block text-[14.5px] font-semibold leading-snug text-gray-900">{item.name}</span>
              <span className="mt-1 block text-[12.5px] text-gray-500">
                {item.brand} · Qty: {item.quantity}
              </span>
              <span className="mt-1 block text-[14px] font-bold text-gray-900">
                {inr(Number(item.unitPrice) * item.quantity)}
              </span>
            </span>
            <ChevronDown className="mt-7 size-4 shrink-0 -rotate-90 text-gray-400" />
          </Link>
        ))}
      </section>

      <section className="px-1">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-[12.5px] font-medium text-gray-500">Order #{decodedNum}</span>
          <CopyButton value={decodedNum} />
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-100 bg-white">
        {/* Collapsed by default (chevron-down), matching the reference; tap to reveal the timeline. */}
        <details className="group">
          <summary className="flex cursor-pointer select-none items-center gap-3 p-4">
            <span
              className={`grid size-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full text-white ${
                statusSummary.tone === "green" ? "bg-emerald-500"
                : statusSummary.tone === "red" ? "bg-rose-500"
                : statusSummary.tone === "blue" ? "bg-[#1a1a2e]" : "bg-gray-400"
              }`}
            >
              <Check className="size-4" strokeWidth={3} />
            </span>
            <p
              className={`flex-1 text-[15px] font-bold ${
                statusSummary.tone === "green" ? "text-emerald-700"
                : statusSummary.tone === "red" ? "text-rose-700"
                : statusSummary.tone === "blue" ? "text-[#1a1a2e]" : "text-gray-700"
              }`}
            >
              {statusSummary.label}
            </p>
            <ChevronDown className="size-4 text-gray-400 transition-transform group-open:rotate-180" />
          </summary>
          <div className="border-t border-gray-100 p-4">
            <DeliveryTimeline
              order={{
                status: order.status,
                createdAt: order.createdAt,
                confirmedAt: order.confirmedAt,
                processedAt: (order as any).processedAt ?? null,
                shippedAt: order.shippedAt,
                outForDeliveryAt: (order as any).outForDeliveryAt ?? null,
                deliveredAt: order.deliveredAt,
                cancelledAt: order.cancelledAt,
              }}
            />
          </div>
        </details>
      </section>

      {delivered && returnWindowEnd && (
        <section className="space-y-2">
          <h2 className="text-[15px] font-bold text-gray-900">Urban Vogue&apos;s promise</h2>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-100 bg-white p-4">
            <span className="grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-amber-50 text-[#1a1a2e]">
              <ShieldCheck className="size-5" />
            </span>
            <p className="text-[13.5px] font-bold text-gray-900">
              Return window {returnWindowEnded ? "ended" : "ends"} on {fmtDate(returnWindowEnd)}
            </p>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {/* Our OWN promo banner in the reference's banner slot — same visual language (dark
          navy, corner mark, headline, orange action chip, big typographic offer), but it
          advertises Urban Vogue's /offers page, not a financial product we don't sell and not
          Flipkart's trademarked Pay-Later creative. Static marketing, no data needed. */}
      <Link
        href="/offers"
        className="group relative block overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#0a1a3f] via-[#102a5c] to-[#15306e] p-4 text-white shadow-sm sm:p-5"
      >
        <span className="absolute left-3 top-3 grid size-7 place-items-center rounded-md bg-yellow-400 text-[13px] font-black text-[#0a1a3f]">
          V
        </span>
        <span className="absolute right-3 top-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-blue-200">
          Urban Vogue Offers
        </span>
        <div className="mt-7 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="text-[15px] font-black leading-tight sm:text-[17px]">Extra savings on every order</p>
            <span className="mt-2 inline-block rounded bg-orange-500 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wide text-white transition-transform group-hover:scale-105">
              View offers ›
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="shrink-0 text-right">
            <p className="font-display text-[26px] font-black leading-none text-yellow-300 sm:text-[34px]">UP TO</p>
            <p className="font-display text-[32px] font-black leading-none text-yellow-300 sm:text-[44px]">50% OFF</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-200">Festival deals live</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Link>

      <InfoRow
        title="Delivery details"
        subtitle={`Delivered to ${addr?.name ?? "you"}${addr?.city ? ` in ${addr.city}` : ""}`}
      >
        <p className="font-semibold">{addr?.name ?? "Recipient"}</p>
        <p className="text-gray-600">{addrLine ?? "Address on file"}</p>
        {addr?.phone && <p className="text-gray-500">{addr.phone}</p>}
      </InfoRow>

      <InfoRow
        title="Price details"
        subtitle={`Paid ${inr(total)} by ${methodLabel(paymentMethod)}`}
      >
        <Row label="Listing price" value={inr(subtotalMrp)} />
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-gray-600">
            Special price
            <span title="Price after applicable item discounts" className="inline-flex">
              <Info className="size-3 text-gray-400" aria-hidden />
            </span>
          </span>
          <span className="font-medium text-gray-900">{inr(subtotal)}</span>
        </div>
        {couponDiscount > 0 && <Row label="Coupon discount" value={`-${inr(couponDiscount)}`} tone="mint" />}
        {deliveryFee > 0 && <Row label="Delivery fee" value={inr(deliveryFee)} />}
        {codFee > 0 && <Row label="COD fee" value={inr(codFee)} />}
        {gstComponent > 0 && <Row label="GST" value={inr(gstComponent)} />}
        <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-gray-100 pt-2">
          <span className="font-bold text-gray-900">Total amount</span>
          <span className="font-bold text-gray-900">{inr(total)}</span>
        </div>
                <div className="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2">
          <span className="text-gray-600">Paid By</span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium text-gray-900">
            <MethodIcon m={paymentMethod} /> {methodLabel(paymentMethod)}
          </span>
        </div>
        <a
          href={`/api/orders/${encodeURIComponent(decodedNum)}/invoice`}
          target="_blank"
          rel="noopener noreferrer"
          className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 text-[13px] font-bold text-gray-800 transition-colors hover:bg-gray-50"
        >
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" className="size-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden>
            <path d="M12 3v12" /><path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5" /><path d="M5 21h14" />
          </svg>
          Download Invoice
        </a>
        <p className="pt-1 text-[12px] text-gray-500">
          
          {paymentStatus === "PAID" ? "Payment successful" : "Awaiting payment"} · {methodLabel(paymentMethod)}
        </p>
      </InfoRow>

      {cancelled && (
        <section className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-sm text-red-700">
          This order was cancelled
          {order.cancelledAt ? ` on ${new Date(order.cancelledAt).toLocaleString("en-IN")}` : ""}.
          {order.cancelReason ? ` Reason: ${order.cancelReason}` : ""}
        </section>
      )}

      {forYou.length > 0 && (
        <section className="space-y-3">
          <h2 className="text-[15px] font-bold text-gray-900">Products For You</h2>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {forYou.map((p) => {
              const img = p.images.find((i) => i.isPrimary)?.url ?? p.images[0]?.url ?? null;
              const d = p.mrp > p.salePrice ? Math.round(((p.mrp - p.salePrice) / p.mrp) * 100) : 0;
              return (
                <Link key={p.id} href={`/product/${p.slug}`} className="block rounded-xl border border-gray-100 bg-white p-2">
                  <span className="relative block aspect-square overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-gray-50">
                    {img ? (
                      // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                      <img src={img} alt={p.name} className="size-full object-contain p-2" />
                    ) : (
                      <span className="grid size-full place-items-center bg-gray-100 text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-400">
                        {p.name.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {(p.ratingAvg > 0 || p.ratingCount > 0) && (
                      <span className="absolute bottom-1 left-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-white/95 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-800 shadow-sm">
                        {Number(p.ratingAvg).toFixed(1)} <Star className="size-2.5 fill-emerald-600 text-emerald-600" />
                        <span className="font-semibold text-gray-500">{compact(p.ratingCount)}+</span>
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </span>
                  <p className="mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-[12.5px] font-semibold leading-snug text-gray-900">
                    {p.brand?.name} {p.name}
                  </p>
                  <p className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-1.5">
                    {d > 0 && <span className="text-[11.5px] font-bold text-emerald-600">↓{d}%</span>}
                    {d > 0 && <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 line-through">{inr(p.mrp)}</span>}
                    <span className="text-[13px] font-bold text-gray-900">{inr(p.salePrice)}</span>
                  </p>
                </Link>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </section>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}
