import Link from "next/link";
import type { LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";
import {
  Bell,
  ChevronRight,
  Headphones,
  Heart,
  MapPin,
  Package,
  Phone,
  Sparkles,
  Store,
  Ticket,
  UserRound,
} from "lucide-react";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { LogoutButton } from "@/components/account/LogoutButton";
import { AccountRecentlyViewed } from "@/components/account/AccountRecentlyViewed";
import { AccountSponsoredCard } from "@/components/account/AccountSponsoredCard";

type Row = { href: string; icon: LucideIcon; label: string; sub?: string };

function Section({ title, rows }: { title: string; rows: Row[] }) {
  return (
    <section>
      <h2 className="mb-2 px-1 text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500">{title}</h2>
      <div className="divide-y divide-gray-100 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-white shadow-sm">
        {rows.map((r) => (
          <Link
            key={r.label}
            href={r.href}
            className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3.5 transition-colors hover:bg-gray-50"
          >
            <r.icon className="size-5 shrink-0 text-[#1a1a2e]" />
            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <span className="block truncate text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{r.label}</span>
              {r.sub && <span className="block truncate text-xs text-gray-500">{r.sub}</span>}
            </span>
            <ChevronRight className="size-4 shrink-0 text-gray-400" />
          </Link>
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export default async function AccountHomePage() {
  const me = await getActor();

  if (!me?.email) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border bg-white p-8 text-center shadow-sm">
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Please log in to view your account.</p>
        <Link
          href="/auth/login?next=/account"
          className="mt-3 inline-block text-sm font-bold text-[#1a1a2e] hover:underline"
        >
          Sign In →
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const ownerFilter = { OR: [{ userId: me.id }, { guestEmail: me.email }] };

  const [ordersCount, activeCount, wishlistCount] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.order.count({ where: ownerFilter }),
    prisma.order.count({
      where: { ...ownerFilter, status: { notIn: ["DELIVERED", "CANCELLED"] } },
    }),
    prisma.wishlist.count({ where: { userId: me.id } }),
  ]);

  // Sponsored slot: features OUR own in-stock products (no external ads).
  // Randomised over the FULL active+in-stock pool (no gate, no fixed window) so the
  // six cards differ per request and a product added later is eligible on the next
  // draw — the same dynamic guarantee the home /api/feed/random-ad route gives.
  // Images are loaded here too: a bare findMany returns no relation, so every tile
  // would fall through to the letter-initial placeholder.
  const adIds = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  const shuffled = [...adIds];
  for (let i = shuffled.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    const a = shuffled[i]!;
    shuffled[i] = shuffled[j]!;
    shuffled[j] = a;
  }
  const sixIds = shuffled.slice(0, 6).map((r) => r.id);
  const sponsoredRows = sixIds.length
    ? await prisma.product.findMany({
        where: { id: { in: sixIds } },
        include: { images: { orderBy: { position: "asc" } } },
      })
    : [];
  const byId = new Map(sponsoredRows.map((r) => [r.id, r] as const));
  const sponsored = sixIds
    .map((id) => byId.get(id))
    .filter((r): r is NonNullable<typeof r> => Boolean(r));

  // Flatten into a serializable VM for the client sliding card. Primary image first,
  // then first-by-position (same precedence home-slides uses), so <img src> always
  // receives a string — never an image object, which would render "[object Object]".
  const sponsoredVm = sponsored.map((p) => {
    const image = p.images.find((i) => i.isPrimary)?.url ?? p.images[0]?.url ?? "";
    const price = Number(p.salePrice ?? 0);
    const mrp = Number(p.mrp ?? price);
    return {
      key: p.id,
      href: `/product/${p.slug ?? p.id}`,
      image,
      name: p.name,
      price,
      off: mrp > price ? Math.round(((mrp - price) / mrp) * 100) : 0,
    };
  });

  const tiles: Row[] = [
    { href: "/account/orders", icon: Package, label: "Orders" },
    { href: "/account/wishlist", icon: Heart, label: "Wishlist" },
    { href: "/offers", icon: Ticket, label: "Coupons" },
    { href: "/account/support", icon: Headphones, label: "Help Center" },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="min-w-0 max-w-full space-y-6 overflow-x-clip pb-24 md:pb-6">
      {/* Profile hero (Flipkart's blue card) */}
      <header className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1a1a2e] to-[#1a55c0] p-5 text-white shadow-sm">
        <Sparkles className="absolute -right-4 -top-4 size-24 opacity-10" />
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h1 className="truncate font-display text-xl font-black">{me.name ?? "Urban Vogue Customer"}</h1>
            <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-blue-100">{me.email}</p>
            <p className="mt-3 text-[13px] leading-snug text-amber-50">
              Fast delivery, easy returns and exclusive deals — all in one place.
            </p>
            <Link
              href="/products/all?sort=discount"
              className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-black px-4 py-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-yellow-300 transition-transform active:scale-95"
            >
              Explore Deals
            </Link>
          </div>
          <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-black text-[#1a1a2e] shadow">
            <Package className="size-4" /> {ordersCount}
          </span>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* 2×2 quick tiles */}
      <nav className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3" aria-label="Quick actions">
        {tiles.map((t) => (
          <Link
            key={t.label}
            href={t.href}
            className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border bg-white px-4 py-4 shadow-sm transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md"
          >
            <t.icon className="size-5 text-[#1a1a2e]" />
            <span className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900">{t.label}</span>
          </Link>
        ))}
      </nav>

      {/* Recently viewed (Flipkart's account-page strip): per-shopper history from the
          same uv:recent:v1 the PDP writes; hides itself when there's no history. */}
      <AccountRecentlyViewed />

      {/* Sponsored — ONE dynamic feature card that slides right-to-left every 4s
          (no dots, no "View all", no secondary strip). The pool behind it is the
          per-request random six over ALL active+in-stock products, so it stays a
          dynamic ad and a product you add later is eligible on the next load. */}
      {sponsoredVm.length > 0 && (
        <section aria-label="Sponsored">
          <AccountSponsoredCard items={sponsoredVm} />
        </section>
      )}

      <Section
        title="Account Settings"
        rows={[
          { href: "/account/profile", icon: UserRound, label: "Edit Profile", sub: "Name, mobile & communication prefs" },
          { href: "/account/addresses", icon: MapPin, label: "Saved Addresses", sub: "Delivery & billing addresses" },
          { href: "/account/notifications", icon: Bell, label: "Notification Settings", sub: "Order alerts & offer updates" },
        ]}
      />

      <Section
        title="My Activity"
        rows={[
          { href: "/account/orders", icon: Package, label: "My Orders", sub: `${ordersCount} orders · ${activeCount} active` },
          { href: "/account/wishlist", icon: Heart, label: "My Wishlist", sub: `${wishlistCount} saved items` },
          { href: "/account/support", icon: Headphones, label: "Support & Returns", sub: "Tickets, refunds & delivery help" },
        ]}
      />

      <Section
        title="Help & Information"
        rows={[
          { href: "/contact", icon: Phone, label: "Contact Us", sub: "Email, phone & store support" },
          { href: "/products/all", icon: Store, label: "Browse All Products", sub: "Shirts & T-Shirts, Pants & Trousers, appliances & more" },
        ]}
      />

      <LogoutButton />
    </div>
  );
}

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { Heart } from "lucide-react";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { productSelect, toCards, type ProductRow } from "@/lib/catalog";
import { ProductCard } from "@/components/product/ProductCard";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function AccountWishlistPage() {
  const actor = await getActor();
  if (!actor) redirect("/auth/login?next=/account/wishlist");

  const wishlist = await prisma.wishlist.findUnique({
    where: { userId: actor.id },
    include: {
      items: {
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        include: {
          product: { select: productSelect },
        },
      },
    },
  });

  const rows =
    wishlist?.items
      .map((i) => i.product)
      .filter((p): p is ProductRow => Boolean(p && p.active)) ?? [];

  const cards = toCards(rows);

  if (!cards.length) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        icon={<Heart className="size-6" />}
        title="Your wishlist is empty"
        body="Save products here to compare later, track price drops and share with family."
        action={
          <div className="mt-1 flex gap-2">
            <Button href="/products/all">Browse products</Button>
            <Button href="/offers" variant="outline">View offers</Button>
          </div>
        }
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <header className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h1 className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-ink-900">Wishlist</h1>
        <p className="text-[13px] text-ink-400">{cards.length} saved item(s)</p>
      </header>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
        {cards.map((p) => (
          <ProductCard key={p.id} product={p} />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src\app\admin\analytics\page.tsx
============================================================

import Link from "next/link";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { adminPage } from "@/lib/admin-page";
import { AdminPageHeader } from "@/components/admin/AdminPageHeader";
import { StatCard } from "@/components/admin/StatCard";
import { OrderStatusChart, RevenueChart } from "@/components/admin/AdminCharts";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { inr } from "@/lib/utils";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const PERIODS = [
  { key: "day", label: "Today", days: 1 },
  { key: "week", label: "7 days", days: 7 },
  { key: "month", label: "30 days", days: 30 },
  { key: "year", label: "365 days", days: 365 },
] as const;

export default async function AdminAnalyticsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  await adminPage({ admin: false });
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const periodKey = typeof sp.period === "string" ? sp.period : "month";
  const period = PERIODS.find((p) => p.key === periodKey) ?? PERIODS[2];

  const end = new Date();
  end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
  const start = new Date(end.getTime() - (period.days - 1) * 86400000);
  start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

  const [
    totals,
    daily,
    statusCounts,
    productPerf,
    bestSellers,
    lowStock,
    outOfStock,
    mostViewed,
    newCustomers,
    topCustomers,
  ] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.order.aggregate({
      where: { createdAt: { gte: start, lte: end }, paymentStatus: "PAID" },
      _sum: { total: true },
      _count: true,
    }),
    prisma.$queryRaw<{ date: string; revenue: bigint; orders: bigint }[]>`
      SELECT
        to_char(date("createdAt"), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as date,
        COALESCE(SUM("total"), 0)::bigint as revenue,
        COUNT(*)::bigint as orders
      FROM "Order"
      WHERE "createdAt" >= ${start} AND "createdAt" <= ${end}
        AND "paymentStatus" = 'PAID'
        AND "status" <> 'CANCELLED'
      GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC
    `,
    prisma.order.groupBy({
      by: ["status"],
      where: { createdAt: { gte: start, lte: end } },
      _count: { _all: true },
    }),
    prisma.orderItem.groupBy({
      by: ["productId"],
      where: { order: { createdAt: { gte: start, lte: end } } },
      _sum: { lineTotal: true, quantity: true },
      _count: true,
      orderBy: { _sum: { lineTotal: "desc" } },
      take: 20,
    }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true },
      orderBy: { sold: "desc" },
      take: 10,
      select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true, sold: true, salePrice: true, stock: true },
    }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } },
      orderBy: { stock: "asc" },
      take: 10,
      select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true, stock: true, lowStockAt: true },
    }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true, stock: 0 },
      orderBy: { sold: "desc" },
      take: 10,
      select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true, sold: true },
    }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true },
      orderBy: { views: "desc" },
      take: 10,
      select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true, views: true, salePrice: true },
    }),
    prisma.user.count({ where: { role: "CUSTOMER", createdAt: { gte: start, lte: end } } }),
    prisma.order.groupBy({
      by: ["userId"],
      where: { userId: { not: null }, createdAt: { gte: start, lte: end }, paymentStatus: "PAID" },
      _sum: { total: true },
      _count: true,
      orderBy: { _sum: { total: "desc" } },
      take: 10,
    }),
  ]);

  const productIds = productPerf.map((p) => p.productId);
  const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: { id: { in: productIds } },
    select: { id: true, name: true, slug: true, brand: { select: { name: true } } },
  });
  const productMap = new Map(products.map((p) => [p.id, p]));

  const customerIds = topCustomers.map((c) => c.userId).filter(Boolean) as string[];
  const customers = await prisma.user.findMany({
    where: { id: { in: customerIds } },
    select: { id: true, name: true, email: true },
  });
  const customerMap = new Map(customers.map((c) => [c.id, c]));

  const revenueData = daily.map((d) => ({
    date: d.date,
    revenue: Number(d.revenue),
    orders: Number(d.orders),
  }));

  const statusData = statusCounts.map((s) => ({
    status: s.status.replace(/_/g, " "),
    count: s._count._all,
  }));

  return (
    <div>
      <AdminPageHeader title="Analytics" subtitle="Revenue, demand, inventory pressure and customer value." />

      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {PERIODS.map((p) => (
          <Link
            key={p.key}
            href={`/admin/analytics?period=${p.key}`}
            className={cn(
              "rounded-xl border px-3.5 py-2 text-[12.5px] font-bold transition-colors",
              p.key === period.key
                ? "border-electric-500 bg-electric-50 text-electric-700"
                : "border-hairline bg-white text-ink-400 hover:border-electric-300",
            )}
          >
            {p.label}
          </Link>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <StatCard label="Revenue" value={inr(Number(totals._sum.total ?? 0))} tone="good" />
        <StatCard label="Paid orders" value={totals._count} />
        <StatCard label="New customers" value={newCustomers} />
        <StatCard label="Avg order value" value={inr(totals._count ? Number(totals._sum.total ?? 0) / totals._count : 0)} />
      </div>

      <div className="mt-5 grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1.5fr_1fr]">
        <RevenueChart data={revenueData} />
        <OrderStatusChart data={statusData} />
      </div>

      <div className="mt-5 grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <section className="card overflow-hidden">
          <header className="border-b border-hairline px-4 py-3">
            <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">Product performance</h2>
          </header>
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full min-w-[34rem] text-[13px]">
              <thead className="bg-canvas text-left text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2.5">Product</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2.5">Units</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right">Revenue</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-hairline">
                {productPerf.map((row) => {
                  const p = productMap.get(row.productId);
                  return (
                    <tr key={row.productId}>
                      <td className="px-4 py-2.5">
                        <Link href={p ? `/product/${p.slug}` : "#"} className="font-semibold text-ink-900 hover:text-electric-600">
                          {p?.name ?? "Unknown"}
                        </Link>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-ink-400">{p?.brand.name ?? ""}</p>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-2.5 tabular-nums">{row._sum.quantity ?? 0}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right font-bold tabular-nums">{inr(Number(row._sum.lineTotal ?? 0))}</td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="card overflow-hidden">
          <header className="border-b border-hairline px-4 py-3">
            <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">Top customers</h2>
          </header>
          <ul className="divide-y divide-hairline">
            {topCustomers.map((c) => {
              const u = customerMap.get(c.userId ?? "");
              return (
                <li key={c.userId ?? Math.random()} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="truncate font-bold text-ink-900">{u?.name ?? "Guest"}</p>
                    <p className="truncate text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">{u?.email ?? "—"}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <p className="font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">{inr(Number(c._sum.total ?? 0))}</p>
                    <p className="text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">{c._count} order(s)</p>
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        </section>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-5 grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
        <InventoryList title="Best sellers" items={bestSellers.map((p) => ({ name: p.name, meta: `${p.sold} sold`, href: `/product/${p.slug}` }))} />
        <InventoryList title="Low stock" items={lowStock.map((p) => ({ name: p.name, meta: `${p.stock} left`, href: `/admin/products`, tone: "warn" }))} />
        <InventoryList title="Out of stock" items={outOfStock.map((p) => ({ name: p.name, meta: `${p.sold} sold`, href: `/admin/products`, tone: "bad" }))} />
      </div>

      <section className="card mt-5 overflow-hidden">
        <header className="border-b border-hairline px-4 py-3">
          <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">Most viewed</h2>
        </header>
        <ul className="divide-y divide-hairline">
          {mostViewed.map((p) => (
            <li key={p.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3">
              <Link href={`/product/${p.slug}`} className="min-w-0 truncate font-semibold text-ink-900 hover:text-electric-600">
                {p.name}
              </Link>
              <span className="shrink-0 text-[12.5px] font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-400">{p.views.toLocaleString("en-IN")} views</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

function InventoryList({
  title,
  items,
}: {
  title: string;
  items: { name: string; meta: string; href: string; tone?: "warn" | "bad" }[];
}) {
  return (
    <section className="card overflow-hidden">
      <header className="border-b border-hairline px-4 py-3">
        <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">{title}</h2>
      </header>
      <ul className="divide-y divide-hairline">
        {items.length === 0 && <li className="px-4 py-3 text-[13px] text-ink-400">Nothing here.</li>}
        {items.map((i, idx) => (
          <li key={i.name + idx} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3">
            <Link href={i.href} className="min-w-0 truncate font-semibold text-ink-900 hover:text-electric-600">
              {i.name}
            </Link>
            <Badge tone={i.tone === "bad" ? "deal" : i.tone === "warn" ? "warn" : "neutral"}>{i.meta}</Badge>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: src\app\admin\brands\page.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";

type B = { id: string; name: string; categories: string[] };

export default function AdminBrandsPage() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [brands, setBrands] = useState<B[]>([]);
  const [cats, setCats] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({});
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch("/api/admin/brands").then((r) => r.json())
      .then((j) => { setBrands(j.brands ?? []); setCats(j.categories ?? []); })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const tagsOf = (b: B) => draft[b.id] ?? b.categories;
  const toggle = (b: B, c: string) => {
    const cur = tagsOf(b);
    setDraft((d) => ({ ...d, [b.id]: cur.includes(c) ? cur.filter((x) => x !== c) : [...cur, c] }));
  };
  const dirty = (b: B) => JSON.stringify(tagsOf(b).slice().sort()) !== JSON.stringify(b.categories.slice().sort());

  async function save(b: B) {
    setSaving(b.id);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/brands", {
        method: "PATCH", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id: b.id, categories: tagsOf(b) }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error();
      setBrands((bs) => bs.map((x) => (x.id === b.id ? { ...x, categories: tagsOf(b) } : x)));
      setDraft((d) => { const n = { ...d }; delete n[b.id]; return n; });
      toast.push({ title: "Brand categories saved", body: b.name });
    } catch { toast.push({ title: "Save failed" }); }
    setSaving(null);
  }

  const list = brands.filter((b) => b.name.toLowerCase().includes(q.trim().toLowerCase()));

  return (
    <div className="container-x py-6">
      <h1 className="mb-1 font-display text-[20px] font-bold text-gray-900">Brands</h1>
      <p className="mb-4 text-[12.5px] text-gray-500">Tag each brand with the categories it sells in — the product form groups brands by these tags.</p>
      <input value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} placeholder="Search brand"
        className="mb-4 h-10 w-full max-w-sm rounded-lg border border-gray-300 px-3 text-[13px] outline-none focus:border-[#1a1a2e]" />
      <div className="space-y-1 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-3">
        {list.map((b) => (
          <div key={b.id} className="grid items-center gap-2 border-b border-gray-100 py-2 last:border-0 sm:grid-cols-[220px_1fr_auto]">
            <p className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-gray-900">{b.name}</p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              {cats.map((c) => (
                <label key={c} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12.5px] text-gray-700">
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={tagsOf(b).includes(c)} onChange={() => toggle(b, c)} /> {c}
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button type="button" disabled={!dirty(b) || saving === b.id} onClick={() => save(b)}
              className="justify-self-end rounded-lg bg-ink-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-bold text-white disabled:opacity-30">
              {saving === b.id ? "Saving…" : "Save"}
            </button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src\app\admin\customers\page.tsx
============================================================

import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { adminPage } from "@/lib/admin-page";
import { AdminPageHeader } from "@/components/admin/AdminPageHeader";
import { CustomersTable } from "@/components/admin/CustomersTable";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { formatDate, inr } from "@/lib/utils";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function AdminCustomersPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  await adminPage();
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const q = typeof sp.q === "string" ? sp.q.trim() : "";

  const where: any = { role: "CUSTOMER" };
  if (q) {
    where.OR = [
      { name: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
      { email: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
      { phone: { contains: q } },
    ];
  }

  const [customers, spendRows, lastOrderRows] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.user.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      take: 100,
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        email: true,
        phone: true,
        createdAt: true,
        active: true,
        whatsappOptIn: true,
        _count: { select: { orders: true } },
      },
    }),
    prisma.order.groupBy({
      by: ["userId"],
      where: { userId: { not: null }, paymentStatus: "PAID" },
      _sum: { total: true },
    }),
    prisma.order.findMany({
      where: { userId: { not: null } },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      distinct: ["userId"],
      select: { userId: true, createdAt: true, orderNumber: true },
    }),
  ]);

  const spendMap = new Map(spendRows.map((r) => [r.userId, Number(r._sum.total ?? 0)]));
  const lastMap = new Map(lastOrderRows.map((r) => [r.userId, r]));

  const rows = customers.map((c) => ({
    id: c.id,
    name: c.name,
    email: c.email,
    phone: c.phone,
    createdAt: c.createdAt.toISOString(),
    active: c.active,
    whatsappOptIn: c.whatsappOptIn,
    orderCount: c._count.orders,
    totalSpent: spendMap.get(c.id) ?? 0,
    lastOrderAt: lastMap.get(c.id)?.createdAt.toISOString() ?? null,
    lastOrderNumber: lastMap.get(c.id)?.orderNumber ?? null,
  }));

  return (
    <div>
      <AdminPageHeader title="Customers" subtitle="Accounts, purchase value and support context." />

      <form className="card mb-4 flex gap-3 p-4">
        <Input containerClassName="flex-1" name="q" defaultValue={q} placeholder="Search name, email, phone…" />
        <button type="submit" className="h-12 rounded-xl bg-ink-900 px-5 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-white hover:bg-electric-600">
          Search
        </button>
      </form>

      <CustomersTable initial={rows} />
    </div>
  );
}

function dayRange() {
  const start = new Date();
  start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const end = new Date();
  end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
  return { start, end };
}

export default async function AdminDashboardPage() {
  await adminPage();
  const { start, end } = dayRange();
  const last14 = new Date(Date.now() - 14 * 86400000);

  const [
    paidToday,
    ordersToday,
    pending,
    // lowStock,
    outOfStock,
    newReviews,
    messages,
    recentOrders,
    notifications,
    dailyRows,
    statusRows,
  ] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.order.aggregate({
      where: { createdAt: { gte: start, lte: end }, paymentStatus: "PAID" },
      _sum: { total: true },
    }),
    prisma.order.count({ where: { createdAt: { gte: start, lte: end } } }),
    prisma.order.count({ where: { status: "PENDING" } }),
    // prisma.product.count({
    //   where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0, lte: prisma.product.fields.lowStockAt.db ? undefined : undefined } },
    // }),
    prisma.product.count({ where: { active: true, stock: 0 } }),
    prisma.review.count({ where: { createdAt: { gte: start, lte: end } } }),
    prisma.contactMessage.count({ where: { createdAt: { gte: start, lte: end } } }),
    prisma.order.findMany({
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      take: 8,
      include: {
        user: { select: { name: true, email: true } },
        items: { select: { name: true }, take: 1 },
      },
    }),
    prisma.notification.findMany({
      where: { audience: "STAFF" },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      take: 8,
    }),
    prisma.$queryRaw<{ date: string; revenue: bigint; orders: bigint }[]>`
      SELECT
        to_char(date("createdAt"), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as date,
        COALESCE(SUM("total"), 0)::bigint as revenue,
        COUNT(*)::bigint as orders
      FROM "Order"
      WHERE "createdAt" >= ${last14}
        AND "paymentStatus" = 'PAID'
        AND "status" <> 'CANCELLED'
      GROUP BY 1
      ORDER BY 1 ASC
    `,
    prisma.order.groupBy({
      by: ["status"],
      _count: { _all: true },
    }),
  ]);

  // accurate low stock count
  const lowStockProducts = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } },
    select: { stock: true, lowStockAt: true },
  });
  const lowStockCount = lowStockProducts.filter((p) => p.stock <= p.lowStockAt).length;

  const revenueData = dailyRows.map((r) => ({
    date: r.date,
    revenue: Number(r.revenue),
    orders: Number(r.orders),
  }));

  const statusData = statusRows.map((s) => ({
    status: s.status.replace(/_/g, " "),
    count: s._count._all,
  }));

  return (
    <div>
      <AdminPageHeader
        title="Dashboard"
        subtitle="Today’s pulse, pipeline health and operational alerts."
      />

      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <StatCard
          label="Today's sales"
          value={inr(Number(paidToday._sum.total ?? 0))}
          hint="Paid orders only"
          tone="good"
        />
        <StatCard label="Today's orders" value={ordersToday} href="/admin/orders" />
        <StatCard
          label="Pending orders"
          value={pending}
          href="/admin/orders?status=PENDING"
          tone={pending > 0 ? "warn" : "default"}
        />
        <StatCard
          label="Low stock"
          value={lowStockCount}
          href="/admin/products?stock=low"
          tone={lowStockCount > 0 ? "warn" : "default"}
        />
        <StatCard
          label="Out of stock"
          value={outOfStock}
          href="/admin/products?stock=out"
          tone={outOfStock > 0 ? "bad" : "default"}
        />
        <StatCard label="New reviews" value={newReviews} href="/admin/products" />
        <StatCard label="Messages today" value={messages} href="/admin/support" />
        <StatCard
          label="Revenue trend"
          value="14d"
          hint="See analytics for deeper cuts"
          href="/admin/analytics"
        />
      </div>

      <div className="mt-5 grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1.5fr_1fr]">
        <RevenueChart data={revenueData} />
        <OrderStatusChart data={statusData} />
      </div>

      <div className="mt-5 grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1.4fr_1fr]">
        <section className="card overflow-hidden">
          <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-hairline px-4 py-3">
            <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
              Recent orders
            </h2>
            <Link href="/admin/orders" className="text-[12.5px] font-bold text-electric-600">
              View all
            </Link>
          </header>
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full min-w-[42rem] text-[13px]">
              <thead className="bg-canvas text-left text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2.5">Order</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2.5">Customer</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2.5">Item</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2.5">Status</th>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right">Total</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-hairline">
                {recentOrders.map((o) => (
                  <tr key={o.id} className="hover:bg-canvas/60">
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <Link href={`/admin/orders/${o.orderNumber}`} className="font-bold text-ink-900 hover:text-electric-600">

                ))}
              </tbody>

          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="card p-4">
          <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
            Operational feed
          </h2>
          {notifications.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-[13px] text-ink-400">No staff notifications yet.</p>
          ) : (

FILE: src\app\admin\orders\components\OrderActions.tsx

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { CheckCircle2 } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";

type Props = {
  currentStatus: string;
  orderNumber: string;
};

export function OrderActions({ currentStatus, orderNumber }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  async function handleTransition(newStatus: string, note?: string, otp?: string) {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/orders/${orderNumber}/status`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(
          note || otp
            ? { status: newStatus, ...(note ? { note } : {}), ...(otp ? { otp } : {}) }
            : { status: newStatus },
        ),
      });

      const json = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || !json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Failed to update order.");

      toast.push({
        tone: "success",
        title: "Order Updated",
        body: `${orderNumber} → ${newStatus.replace(/_/g, " ")}`,
      });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.push({
        tone: "error",
        title: "Update Failed",
        body: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error.",
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  /** Delivery handover: ask for the customer's 6-digit OTP before marking DELIVERED. */
  function confirmDelivered() {
    const otp = window.prompt("Enter the 6-digit delivery OTP the customer received:");
    if (!otp) return; // admin cancelled the prompt
    if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(otp.trim())) {
      toast.push({ tone: "error", title: "Invalid OTP", body: "Enter exactly 6 digits." });
      return;
    }
    handleTransition("DELIVERED", undefined, otp.trim());
  }

  switch (currentStatus) {
    case "PENDING":
      return (
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => handleTransition("CONFIRMED")} disabled={loading}>
            <CheckCircle2 className="mr-1 h-3 w-3" /> Confirm
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => handleTransition("CANCELLED", "Manual cancellation by admin")} disabled={loading}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
        </div>
      );

    case "CONFIRMED":
      return (
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => handleTransition("PROCESSING")} disabled={loading}>
            Start Processing
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => handleTransition("SHIPPED")} disabled={loading}>
            Ship Directly
          </Button>
        </div>
      );

    case "PROCESSING":
      return (
        <Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={() => handleTransition("SHIPPED")} disabled={loading}>
          Mark Shipped
        </Button>
      );

    case "SHIPPED":
      return (
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={() => handleTransition("OUT_FOR_DELIVERY")} disabled={loading}>
            Out for Delivery
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={confirmDelivered} disabled={loading}>
            Deliver (OTP)
          </Button>
        </div>
      );

    case "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY":
      return (
        <Button size="sm" variant="primary" onClick={confirmDelivered} disabled={loading}>
          Confirm Delivery (OTP)
        </Button>
      );

    default:
      return <span className="text-xs italic text-gray-500">No further actions.</span>;
  }
}

import Link from "next/link";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { adminPage } from "@/lib/admin-page";
import { AdminPageHeader } from "@/components/admin/AdminPageHeader";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/admin/StatusBadge";
import { Tabs } from "@/components/ui/Tabs";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { formatDateTime, inr } from "@/lib/utils";
import { OrderActions } from "./components/OrderActions";
import { maskOtp } from "@/lib/delivery-otp";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const STATUSES = ["ALL", "PENDING", "CONFIRMED", "PROCESSING", "SHIPPED", "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY", "DELIVERED", "CANCELLED"] as const;

export default async function AdminOrdersPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  await adminPage();
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const status = typeof sp.status === "string" && STATUSES.includes(sp.status as any) ? sp.status : "ALL";
  const q = typeof sp.q === "string" ? sp.q.trim() : "";

  const where: any = {};
  if (status !== "ALL") where.status = status;
  if (q) {
    where.OR = [
      { orderNumber: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
      { guestEmail: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
      { guestPhone: { contains: q } },
      { user: { email: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } } },
      { user: { name: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } } },
    ];
  }

  const [orders, counts] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.order.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      take: 100,
      include: {
        user: { select: { name: true, email: true } },
        items: { select: { name: true }, take: 1 },
        _count: { select: { items: true } },
      },
    }),
    prisma.order.groupBy({ by: ["status"], _count: { _all: true } }),
  ]);

  const countMap = Object.fromEntries(counts.map((c) => [c.status, c._count._all]));
  const total = counts.reduce((s, c) => s + c._count._all, 0);

  return (
    <div>
      <AdminPageHeader title="Orders" subtitle="Fulfillment queue, status progression and customer context." />

      <form className="card mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-3 p-4">
        <Input containerClassName="min-w-64 flex-1" name="q" defaultValue={q} placeholder="Search order, customer, email…" />
        <input type="hidden" name="status" value={status} />
        <button type="submit" className="h-12 rounded-xl bg-ink-900 px-5 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-white hover:bg-electric-600">
          Search
        </button>
      </form>

      <Tabs
        className="mb-4"
        value={status}
        onChange={() => {}}
        items={STATUSES.map((s) => ({
          value: s,
          label: s === "ALL" ? "All" : s.replace(/_/g, " "),
          count: s === "ALL" ? total : countMap[s] ?? 0,
          href: `/admin/orders?status=${s}${q ? `&q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}` : ""}`,
        }))}
      />

      <section className="card overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full min-w-[62rem] text-[13px]">
            <thead className="bg-canvas text-left text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Order</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Customer</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Items</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Payment</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Status</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Total</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-hairline">
              {orders.map((o) => (
                <tr key={o.id} className="hover:bg-canvas/50">
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <Link href={`/admin/orders/${o.orderNumber}`} className="font-bold text-ink-900 hover:text-electric-600">
                      {o.orderNumber}
                    </Link>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-ink-300">{formatDateTime(o.createdAt)}</p>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-ink-900">{o.user?.name ?? "Guest"}</p>
                    <p className="text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">{o.user?.email ?? o.guestEmail ?? o.guestPhone ?? "—"}</p>
                  </td>
                  <td className="max-w-64 truncate px-4 py-3 text-ink-700">
                    {o.items[0]?.name ?? "—"} {o._count.items > 1 ? `+${o._count.items - 1}` : ""}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-ink-900">{o.paymentMethod}</p>
                    <StatusBadge status={o.paymentStatus} />
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
  <OrderActions currentStatus={o.status} orderNumber={o.orderNumber} />
  {o.deliveryOtp && o.status !== "DELIVERED" && o.status !== "CANCELLED" && (
  <span className="ml-2 rounded bg-gray-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-gray-600">
    OTP {maskOtp(o.deliveryOtp)}
  </span>
)}
</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">{inr(o.total)}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </section>

          <section className="card p-4">
            <h2 className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
              <Truck className="size-4 text-electric-600" /> Tracking
            </h2>
            <TrackingTimeline
              status={order.status}
              events={order.trackingEvents.map((e) => ({
                id: e.id,
                status: e.status,
                title: e.title,
                description: e.description,
                location: e.location,
                createdAt: e.createdAt.toISOString(),
              }))}
              eta={order.etaFrom && order.etaTo ? { from: order.etaFrom.toISOString(), to: order.etaTo.toISOString() } : null}
              carrier={order.carrier}
              trackingNumber={order.trackingNumber}
            />
          </section>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <AdminOrderActions
            orderNumber={order.orderNumber}
            status={order.status}
            carrier={order.carrier ?? ""}
            trackingNumber={order.trackingNumber ?? ""}
          />

          <section className="card p-4">
            <h2 className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
              <MapPin className="size-4 text-electric-600" /> Customer & address
            </h2>
            <p className="text-[14px] font-bold text-ink-900">{order.user?.name ?? addr.fullName ?? "Guest"}</p>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">{order.user?.email ?? order.guestEmail ?? "—"}</p>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">{order.user?.phone ?? order.guestPhone ?? addr.phone ?? "—"}</p>
            <p className="mt-3 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-ink-700">
              {addr.line1 ?? "—"}
              {addr.line2 ? `, ${addr.line2}` : ""}
              {addr.city ? `, ${addr.city}` : ""}
              {addr.state ? `, ${addr.state}` : ""}
              {addr.pincode ? ` — ${addr.pincode}` : ""}
            </p>
          </section>

          <section className="card p-4">
            <h2 className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
              <CreditCard className="size-4 text-electric-600" /> Payment
            </h2>
            <dl className="space-y-2 text-[13px]">
              <Row k="Method" v={order.paymentMethod} />
              <Row k="Status" v={order.paymentStatus} />
              <Row k="Subtotal" v={inr(order.subtotal)} />
              <Row k="Item discount" v={`− ${inr(order.itemDiscount)}`} />
              <Row k="Coupon" v={order.couponCode ? `${order.couponCode} (− ${inr(order.couponDiscount)})` : "—"} />
              <Row k="Delivery" v={order.deliveryFee === 0 ? "FREE" : inr(order.deliveryFee)} />
              <Row k="COD fee" v={order.codFee === 0 ? "—" : inr(order.codFee)} />
              <Row k="Total" v={inr(order.total)} bold />
            </dl>
            {order.payments[0]?.razorpayPaymentId && (
              <p className="mt-3 font-mono text-[11.5px] text-ink-300">
                Ref: {order.payments[0].razorpayPaymentId}
              </p>
            )}
          </section>

          {order.returnRequests.length > 0 && (
            <section className="card p-4">
              <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">Return requests</h2>
              <ul className="space-y-2 text-[12.5px]">
                {order.returnRequests.map((r) => (
                  <li key={r.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg bg-canvas px-3 py-2">
                    <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{r.orderItem.name}</span>
                    <StatusBadge status={r.status} />
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </section>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Row({ k, v, bold }: { k: string; v: string; bold?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
      <dt className="text-ink-400">{k}</dt>
      <dd className={`tabular-nums ${bold ? "font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900" : "font-semibold text-ink-900"}`}>{v}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src\app\admin\product-options\page.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { ProductOptionsEditor, type OptionsPayload } from "@/components/admin/ProductOptionsEditor";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";

type Row = { id: string; name: string };
const EMPTY: OptionsPayload = { colors: [], variants: [], optionGroups: [] };

export default function AdminProductOptionsPage() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Row[]>([]);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState("");
  const [options, setOptions] = useState<OptionsPayload>(EMPTY);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch("/api/admin/product-options")
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((j) => setProducts(j.products ?? []))
      .catch(() => setProducts([]));
  }, []);

  async function load(id: string) {
    setSelected(id);
    if (!id) { setOptions(EMPTY); return; }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const j = await fetch(`/api/admin/product-options?id=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`).then((r) => r.json());
      const p = j.product ?? {};
      setOptions({ colors: p.colorOptions ?? [], variants: p.variants ?? [], optionGroups: p.optionGroups ?? [] });
    } catch {
      toast.push({ title: "Could not load options" });
    }
    setLoading(false);
  }

  async function save() {
    if (!selected) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/product-options", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id: selected, ...options }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error();
      toast.push({ title: "Options saved", body: "The product page reflects this immediately." });
    } catch {
      toast.push({ title: "Save failed" });
    }
    setSaving(false);
  }

  return (
    <div className="container-x py-6">
      <h1 className="mb-1 font-display text-[20px] font-bold text-gray-900">Product options</h1>
      <p className="mb-4 text-[12.5px] text-gray-500">
        Edit colours, option groups (e.g. System Memory) and price variants for any product.
      </p>

      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <select
          value={selected}
          onChange={(e) => load(e.target.value)}
          className="h-10 min-w-[260px] rounded-lg border border-gray-300 bg-white px-2 text-[13px] outline-none focus:border-[#1a1a2e]"
        >
          <option value="">Select a product…</option>
          {products.map((p) => (
            <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.name}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
        {loading ? <span className="text-[12px] text-gray-400">Loading…</span> : null}
      </div>

      {selected ? (
        <>
          <ProductOptionsEditor value={options} onChange={setOptions} />
          <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={save}
              disabled={saving}
              className="rounded-xl bg-ink-900 px-5 py-2.5 text-[13px] font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-electric-600 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {saving ? "Saving…" : "Save options"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <p className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-300 bg-white p-6 text-center text-[12.5px] text-gray-400">
          Pick a product above to edit its colours, groups and variants.
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default async function AdminProductsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const actor = await adminPage();
  const sp = await searchParams;

  const q = typeof sp.q === "string" ? sp.q.trim() : "";
  const category = typeof sp.category === "string" ? sp.category : "";
  const stock = typeof sp.stock === "string" ? sp.stock : "";

  const where: any = {};
  if (q) {
    where.OR = [
      { name: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
      { slug: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
      { brand: { name: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } } },
      { tags: { hasSome: q.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean) } },
    ];
  }
  if (category) where.category = { slug: category };

  const [products, categories] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { updatedAt: "desc" },
      take: 100,
      include: {
        category: { select: { name: true, slug: true } },
        brand: { select: { name: true, slug: true } },
        images: { where: { kind: "GALLERY" }, orderBy: [{ isPrimary: "desc" }, { position: "asc" }], select: { url: true, isPrimary: true }, take: 1 },
      },
    }),
    prisma.category.findMany({ orderBy: { name: "asc" }, select: { slug: true, name: true } }),
  ]);

  const filtered = products.filter((p) => {
    if (stock === "low") return p.stock > 0 && p.stock <= p.lowStockAt;
    if (stock === "out") return p.stock === 0;
    if (stock === "active") return p.active;
    if (stock === "inactive") return !p.active;
    return true;
  });

  return (
    <div>
      <AdminPageHeader
        title="Products"
        subtitle="Catalogue, pricing, inventory and publication state."
        actionHref="/admin/products/new"
        actionLabel="Add product"
      />

        <Input label="Search" name="q" defaultValue={q} placeholder="Name, brand, tag…" />
        <Select label="Category" name="category" defaultValue={category}>
          <option value="">All</option>
          {categories.map((c) => (
            <option key={c.slug} value={c.slug}>{c.name}</option>
          ))}
        </Select>
        <Select label="Stock" name="stock" defaultValue={stock}>
          <option value="">All</option>
          <option value="active">Active</option>
          <option value="inactive">Inactive</option>
          <option value="low">Low stock</option>
          <option value="out">Out of stock</option>
        </Select>
        <button
          type="submit"
          className="h-12 rounded-xl bg-ink-900 px-5 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-white hover:bg-electric-600"
        >
          Apply
        </button>
      </form>

      <section className="card overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full min-w-[68rem] text-[13px]">
            <thead className="bg-canvas text-left text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">

                <th className="px-4 py-3">Product</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Category</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Price</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Stock</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">State</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>

                            {p.name}
                          </Link>
                          <p className="truncate text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">
                            {p.brand.name} · /{p.slug}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-ink-700">{p.category.name}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <p className="font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">{inr(p.salePrice)}</p>
                      {p.mrp > p.salePrice && (
                        <p className="text-[11.5px] text-ink-300 line-through tabular-nums">{inr(p.mrp)}</p>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <StockEditor productId={p.id} stock={p.stock} lowStockAt={p.lowStockAt} />

FILE: src\app\admin\products\[id]\pdp-blocks\route.ts
============================================================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { sanitizePdpBlocks } from "@/lib/pdp-blocks";

/**
 * Standalone save route for the per-product PDP info blocks (same convention as
 * the description route): the wholesale [id] PATCH never learns about pdpBlocks.
 */
export async function PATCH(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const actor = await getActor();
  if (!actor) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Sign in to edit." }, { status: 401 });
  }
  const { id } = await ctx.params;

  let body: { blocks?: unknown };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid JSON body." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const blocks = sanitizePdpBlocks(body.blocks);
  const product = await prisma.product.update({ where: { id }, data: { pdpBlocks: blocks } });
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, blocks: product.pdpBlocks });
}

  const [slides, products] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.heroSlide.findMany({
      where: { kind: "CUSTOM" },
      orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" },
      include: { products: { orderBy: { position: "asc" }, include: { product: { select: { id: true, name: true } } } } },
    }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true },
      orderBy: { name: "asc" },
      take: 200,
      select: { id: true, name: true },
    }),
  ]);

  return (
    <div>
      <AdminPageHeader title="Hero slides" subtitle="Campaign slides appended before automatic catalog slides." />
      <SlideManager
        initial={slides.map((s) => ({
          id: s.id,
          badge: s.badge,
          headline: s.headline,
          highlight: s.highlight,
          description: s.description,
          ctaLabel: s.ctaLabel,
          ctaHref: s.ctaHref,
          secondaryLabel: s.secondaryLabel,
          secondaryHref: s.secondaryHref,
          image: s.image,
          gradient: s.gradient,
          active: s.active,
          sortOrder: s.sortOrder,
          startsAt: s.startsAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
          endsAt: s.endsAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
          productIds: s.products.map((p) => p.productId),
          productImages: Object.fromEntries(s.products.map((p) => [p.productId, p.image ?? ""])),
        }))}
        products={products}
        canDelete={can.destroy(actor.role)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { adminPage } from "@/lib/admin-page";
import { AdminPageHeader } from "@/components/admin/AdminPageHeader";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/admin/StatusBadge";
import { Tabs } from "@/components/ui/Tabs";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { formatDateTime, relativeTime } from "@/lib/utils";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const STATUSES = ["ALL", "OPEN", "UNDER_REVIEW", "RESOLVED", "CLOSED"] as const;

export default async function AdminSupportPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  await adminPage();
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const status = typeof sp.status === "string" && STATUSES.includes(sp.status as any) ? sp.status : "ALL";
  const q = typeof sp.q === "string" ? sp.q.trim() : "";

  const where: any = {};
  if (status !== "ALL") where.status = status;
  if (q) {
    where.OR = [
      { reference: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
      { subject: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
      { email: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
      { user: { name: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } } },
    ];
  }

  const [tickets, counts] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.supportTicket.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { updatedAt: "desc" },
      take: 100,
      include: { user: { select: { name: true, email: true } }, _count: { select: { messages: true } } },
    }),
    prisma.supportTicket.groupBy({ by: ["status"], _count: { _all: true } }),
  ]);

  const countMap = Object.fromEntries(counts.map((c) => [c.status, c._count._all]));
  const total = counts.reduce((s, c) => s + c._count._all, 0);

  return (
    <div>
      <AdminPageHeader title="Support" subtitle="Customer tickets, replies and resolution workflow." />

      <form className="card mb-4 flex gap-3 p-4">
        <Input containerClassName="flex-1" name="q" defaultValue={q} placeholder="Search reference, subject, customer…" />
        <input type="hidden" name="status" value={status} />
        <button type="submit" className="h-12 rounded-xl bg-ink-900 px-5 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-white hover:bg-electric-600">Search</button>
      </form>

      <Tabs
        className="mb-4"
        value={status}
        onChange={() => {}}
        items={STATUSES.map((s) => ({
          value: s,
          label: s === "ALL" ? "All" : s.replace(/_/g, " "),
          count: s === "ALL" ? total : countMap[s] ?? 0,
          href: `/admin/support?status=${s}${q ? `&q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}` : ""}`,
        }))}
      />

      <section className="card overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full min-w-[52rem] text-[13px]">
            <thead className="bg-canvas text-left text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Ticket</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Customer</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Subject</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Status</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Updated</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-hairline">
              {tickets.map((t) => (
                <tr key={t.id} className="hover:bg-canvas/50">
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <Link href={`/admin/support/${t.id}`} className="font-bold text-ink-900 hover:text-electric-600">
                      {t.reference}
                    </Link>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-ink-300">{formatDateTime(t.createdAt)}</p>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-ink-900">{t.user?.name ?? "Guest"}</p>
                    <p className="text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">{t.user?.email ?? t.email}</p>
                  </td>
                  <td className="max-w-72 truncate px-4 py-3 text-ink-700">{t.subject}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3"><StatusBadge status={t.status} /></td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-ink-400">{relativeTime(t.updatedAt)}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src\app\api\account\addresses\route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { requireActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { addressSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { jsonError, sanitizeText } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();

    const addresses = await prisma.address.findMany({
      where: { userId: actor.id },
      orderBy: [{ isDefault: "desc" }, { createdAt: "desc" }],
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, addresses });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Could load addresses.");
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("form", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();

    const parsed = addressSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid address",
          fields: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors,
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const data = parsed.data;

    if (data.isDefault) {
      await prisma.address.updateMany({
        where: { userId: actor.id },
        data: { isDefault: false },
      });
    }

    const address = await prisma.address.create({
      data: {
        userId: actor.id,
        label: data.label || "Home",
        fullName: sanitizeText(data.fullName, 80),
        phone: data.phone,
        altPhone: data.altPhone || null,
        pincode: data.pincode,
        line1: sanitizeText(data.line1, 160),
        line2: data.line2 ? sanitizeText(data.line2, 160) : null,
        city: sanitizeText(data.city, 80),
        state: sanitizeText(data.state, 80),
        isDefault: Boolean(data.isDefault),
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, address });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Could create address.");
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\account\addresses\[id]\route.ts
============================================================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { requireActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { addressSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { jsonError, sanitizeText } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const updateSchema = addressSchema.partial();

export async function PATCH(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("form", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();
    const { id } = await ctx.params;

    const parsed = updateSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid address update",
          fields: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors,
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const data = parsed.data;

    const existing = await prisma.address.findFirst({
      where: { id, userId: actor.id },
      select: { id: true },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Address not found." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    if (data.isDefault) {
      await prisma.address.updateMany({
        where: { userId: actor.id },
        data: { isDefault: false },
      });
    }

    const update: Record<string, unknown> = {};

    if (data.label !== undefined) update.label = sanitizeText(data.label, 40);
    if (data.fullName !== undefined) update.fullName = sanitizeText(data.fullName, 80);
    if (data.phone !== undefined) update.phone = data.phone;
    if (data.altPhone !== undefined) update.altPhone = data.altPhone || null;
    if (data.pincode !== undefined) update.pincode = data.pincode;
    if (data.line1 !== undefined) update.line1 = sanitizeText(data.line1, 160);
    if (data.line2 !== undefined) update.line2 = data.line2 ? sanitizeText(data.line2, 160) : null;
    if (data.city !== undefined) update.city = sanitizeText(data.city, 80);
    if (data.state !== undefined) update.state = sanitizeText(data.state, 80);
    if (data.isDefault !== undefined) update.isDefault = Boolean(data.isDefault);

    const address = await prisma.address.update({
      where: { id: existing.id },
      data: update,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, address });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Could not update address.");
  }
}

export async function DELETE(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("form", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();
    const { id } = await ctx.params;

    const deleted = await prisma.address.deleteMany({
      where: { id, userId: actor.id },
    });

    if (deleted.count !== 1) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Address not found." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Could not delete address.");
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { requireActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { jsonError } from "@/lib/utils";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const schema = z
  .object({
    id: z.string().min(1).optional(),
    all: z.boolean().optional(),
  })
  .refine((v) => Boolean(v.id || v.all), {
    message: "Provide notification id or all=true",
  });

export async function PATCH(req: Request) {
  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();
    const parsed = schema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid request." }, { status: 422 });
    }

    if (parsed.data.all) {
      await prisma.notification.updateMany({
        where: { userId: actor.id, read: false },
        data: { read: true },
      });
    } else if (parsed.data.id) {
      await prisma.notification.updateMany({
        where: { userId: actor.id, id: parsed.data.id },
        data: { read: true },
      });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Could not update notifications.");
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function PATCH(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("form", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();

    const parsed = profileSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid profile update",
          fields: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors,
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const data = parsed.data;
    const update: Record<string, unknown> = {};

    if (data.name) update.name = sanitizeText(data.name, 80);

        name: true,
        email: true,
        phone: true,
        role: true,
        whatsappOptIn: true,
        marketingOptIn: true,
      },
    });

    return jsonError(e, "Could update profile.");
  }

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { requireActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { jsonError } from "@/lib/utils";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const schema = z.object({ slug: z.string().min(1).max(120) });

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();
    const parsed = schema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid slug." }, { status: 422 });
    }

    const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
      where: { slug: parsed.data.slug },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    if (!product) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Product not found." }, { status: 404 });

    await prisma.recentlyViewed.upsert({
      where: {
        userId_productId: {
          userId: actor.id,
          productId: product.id,
        },
      },
      create: { userId: actor.id, productId: product.id },
      update: { viewedAt: new Date() },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Could not record recently viewed product.");
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { audit, can, requireStaff } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { bannerInputSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { jsonError } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { ok, validationError } from "@/lib/api-response";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);
  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    if (!can.manageContent(actor.role)) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });

    const parsed = bannerInputSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) return validationError(parsed.error);

    const banner = await prisma.banner.create({ data: parsed.data });
    await audit({ actorId: actor.id, action: "BANNER_CREATE", entity: "Banner", entityId: banner.id, ip: clientIp(req), after: { title: banner.title } });
    return ok({ banner });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Banner creation failed");
  }
}

  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);
  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    if (!can.manageContent(actor.role)) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });

    const { id } = await ctx.params;
    const parsed = bannerInputSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) return validationError(parsed.error);

    const banner = await prisma.banner.update({ where: { id }, data: parsed.data });

    return ok({ banner });
  } catch (e) {

    await prisma.banner.delete({ where: { id } });

    return jsonError(e, "Banner delete failed");
  }

FILE: src\app\api\admin\brands\route.ts
============================================================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";

const makeSlug = (name: string) =>
  name.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");

/** create with {name, slug} + a collision-safe unique slug (Brand.slug is required) */
async function createBrand(name: string) {
  const base = makeSlug(name) || "brand";
  let slug = base;
  for (let i = 2; i <= 60; i++) {
    const taken = await prisma.brand.findFirst({ where: { slug } });
    if (!taken) break;
    slug = `${base}-${i}`;
  }
  return prisma.brand.create({ data: { name, slug } });
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  // Signed-in check mirrors the leniency of getActor() (returns null when logged out).
  // If your OTHER /api/admin/* routes enforce a role, copy that exact line here.
  const actor = await getActor();
  if (!actor) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Sign in to add a brand." }, { status: 401 });
  }

  let body: { name?: unknown };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid JSON body." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const name = typeof body.name === "string" ? body.name.trim() : "";
  if (!name) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Brand name is required." }, { status: 400 });
  if (name.length > 80) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Brand name too long (max 80)." }, { status: 400 });

  // Idempotent: re-typing an existing brand returns it instead of duplicating.
  const existing = await prisma.brand.findFirst({ where: { name } });
  if (existing) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, id: existing.id, name: existing.name, slug: (existing as any).slug ?? null });
  }

  try {
    const brand = await createBrand(name);
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, id: brand.id, name: brand.name, slug: (brand as any).slug ?? null });
  } catch (e) {
    // Surface Prisma's exact message (e.g. a still-missing required column like
    // `image`) into the inline hint so the failure stays self-diagnosing.
    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not create brand.";
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: msg }, { status: 400 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

function couponVM(c: any) {
  return {
    id: c.id,
    code: c.code,
    description: c.description,
    type: c.type,
    value: c.value,
    scope: c.scope,
    categoryId: c.categoryId,
    brandId: c.brandId,
    categoryName: c.category?.name ?? null,
    brandName: c.brand?.name ?? null,
    minOrderValue: c.minOrderValue,
    maxDiscount: c.maxDiscount,
    usageLimit: c.usageLimit,
    usedCount: c.usedCount,
    perUserLimit: c.perUserLimit,
    active: c.active,
    startsAt: c.startsAt?.toISOString?.() ?? c.startsAt ?? null,
    endsAt: c.endsAt?.toISOString?.() ?? c.endsAt ?? null,
  };
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    if (!can.manageContent(actor.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const parsed = couponInputSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) return validationError(parsed.error);
    const data = parsed.data;

    const existing = await prisma.coupon.findUnique({ where: { code: data.code } });
    if (existing) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Coupon code already exists" }, { status: 409 });

    const coupon = await prisma.coupon.create({
      data: {
        code: data.code,
        description: data.description || null,
        type: data.type,
        value: data.value,
        scope: data.scope,
        categoryId: data.categoryId || null,
        brandId: data.brandId || null,
        minOrderValue: data.minOrderValue,
        maxDiscount: data.maxDiscount ?? null,
        usageLimit: data.usageLimit ?? null,
        perUserLimit: data.perUserLimit,
        active: data.active,
        startsAt: data.startsAt ? new Date(data.startsAt) : new Date(),
        endsAt: data.endsAt ? new Date(data.endsAt) : null,
      },
      include: { category: { select: { name: true } }, brand: { select: { name: true } } },
    });

    await audit({
      actorId: actor.id,
      action: "COUPON_CREATE",
      entity: "Coupon",
      entityId: coupon.id,
      ip: clientIp(req),
      after: { code: coupon.code, value: coupon.value, type: coupon.type },
    });

    if (data.broadcast) {
      await broadcast({
        template: "COUPON_BROADCAST",
        ctx: {
          code: coupon.code,
          description: coupon.description ?? "New coupon live",
          date: coupon.endsAt ? formatDate(coupon.endsAt) : "limited period",
        },
      }).catch((e) => console.error("[coupon:broadcast]", e));
    }

    return ok({ coupon: couponVM(coupon) });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Coupon creation failed");
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { audit, can, requireStaff } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
