export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function couponVM(c: any) {
  return {
    id: c.id,
    code: c.code,
    description: c.description,
    type: c.type,
    value: c.value,
    scope: c.scope,
    categoryId: c.categoryId,
    brandId: c.brandId,
    categoryName: c.category?.name ?? null,
    brandName: c.brand?.name ?? null,
    minOrderValue: c.minOrderValue,
    maxDiscount: c.maxDiscount,
    usageLimit: c.usageLimit,
    usedCount: c.usedCount,
    perUserLimit: c.perUserLimit,
    active: c.active,
    startsAt: c.startsAt?.toISOString?.() ?? c.startsAt ?? null,
    endsAt: c.endsAt?.toISOString?.() ?? c.endsAt ?? null,
  };
}

export async function PATCH(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    if (!can.manageContent(actor.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const { id } = await ctx.params;
    const before = await prisma.coupon.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!before) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Coupon not found" }, { status: 404 });

    const parsed = couponInputSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) return validationError(parsed.error);
    const data = parsed.data;

    if (data.code !== before.code) {
      const dup = await prisma.coupon.findUnique({ where: { code: data.code } });
      if (dup) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Coupon code already exists" }, { status: 409 });
    }

    const coupon = await prisma.coupon.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        code: data.code,
        description: data.description || null,
        type: data.type,
        value: data.value,
        scope: data.scope,
        categoryId: data.categoryId || null,
        brandId: data.brandId || null,
        minOrderValue: data.minOrderValue,
        maxDiscount: data.maxDiscount ?? null,
        usageLimit: data.usageLimit ?? null,
        perUserLimit: data.perUserLimit,
        active: data.active,
        startsAt: data.startsAt ? new Date(data.startsAt) : before.startsAt,
        endsAt: data.endsAt ? new Date(data.endsAt) : null,
      },
      include: { category: { select: { name: true } }, brand: { select: { name: true } } },
    });

    await audit({
      actorId: actor.id,
      action: "COUPON_UPDATE",
      entity: "Coupon",
      entityId: id,
      ip: clientIp(req),
      before: { code: before.code, active: before.active },
      after: { code: coupon.code, active: coupon.active },
    });

    return ok({ coupon: couponVM(coupon) });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Coupon update failed");
  }
}

export async function DELETE(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    if (!can.destroy(actor.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Admin only" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const { id } = await ctx.params;
    const before = await prisma.coupon.findUnique({ where: { id }, select: { id: true, code: true } });
    if (!before) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Coupon not found" }, { status: 404 });

    await prisma.coupon.delete({ where: { id } });
    await audit({ actorId: actor.id, action: "COUPON_DELETE", entity: "Coupon", entityId: id, ip: clientIp(req), before: { code: before.code } });
    return ok({ id });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Coupon delete failed");
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { requireStaff } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { jsonError } from "@/lib/utils";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(_req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  try {
    await requireStaff();
    const { id } = await ctx.params;

    const [user, orders, reviews, tickets, feedback, spend, orderCount] = await Promise.all([
      prisma.user.findUnique({
        where: { id },
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          email: true,
          phone: true,
          createdAt: true,
          active: true,
          whatsappOptIn: true,
          role: true,
        },
      }),
      prisma.order.findMany({
        where: { userId: id },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        take: 20,
        select: {
          id: true,
          orderNumber: true,
          status: true,
          paymentStatus: true,
          total: true,
          createdAt: true,
          _count: { select: { items: true } },
        },
      }),
      prisma.review.findMany({
        where: { userId: id },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        take: 20,
        select: {
          id: true,
          rating: true,
          body: true,
          createdAt: true,
        },
      }),
      prisma.supportTicket.findMany({
        where: { userId: id },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        take: 20,
        select: {
          id: true,
          reference: true,
          subject: true,
          status: true,
          createdAt: true,
        },
      }),
      prisma.feedback.findMany({
        where: { userId: id },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        take: 20,
        select: {
          id: true,
          overall: true,
          comment: true,
          createdAt: true,
        },
      }),
      prisma.order.aggregate({
        where: { userId: id, paymentStatus: "PAID" },
        _sum: { total: true },
      }),
      prisma.order.count({ where: { userId: id } }),
    ]);

    if (!user) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Customer not found." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      detail: {
        user: {
          ...user,
          createdAt: user.createdAt.toISOString(),
          totalSpent: Number(spend._sum.total ?? 0),
          orderCount,
          lastOrderAt: orders[0]?.createdAt.toISOString() ?? null,
          lastOrderNumber: orders[0]?.orderNumber ?? null,
        },
        orders: orders.map((o) => ({
          id: o.id,
          orderNumber: o.orderNumber,
          status: o.status,
          paymentStatus: o.paymentStatus,
          total: o.total,
          itemCount: o._count.items,
          createdAt: o.createdAt.toISOString(),
        })),
        reviews: reviews.map((r) => ({
          id: r.id,
          rating: r.rating,
          body: r.body,
          createdAt: r.createdAt.toISOString(),
        })),
        tickets: tickets.map((t) => ({
          id: t.id,
          reference: t.reference,
          subject: t.subject,
          status: t.status,
          createdAt: t.createdAt.toISOString(),
        })),
        feedback: feedback.map((f) => ({
          id: f.id,
          overall: f.overall,
          comment: f.comment,
          createdAt: f.createdAt.toISOString(),
        })),
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Customer lookup failed.");
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\admin\features\route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { audit, can, requireStaff } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { featureInputSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { jsonError } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { ok, validationError } from "@/lib/api-response";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function PUT(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);
  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    if (!can.manageContent(actor.role)) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });

    const parsed = featureInputSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) return validationError(parsed.error);
    const { section, productIds } = parsed.data;

    if (productIds.length) {
      const count = await prisma.product.count({ where: { id: { in: productIds }, active: true } });
      if (count !== productIds.length) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid product selection" }, { status: 422 });
    }

    await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.productFeature.deleteMany({ where: { section } });
      if (productIds.length) {
        await tx.productFeature.createMany({
          data: productIds.map((productId, position) => ({ section, productId, position })),
        });
      }
    });

    await audit({ actorId: actor.id, action: "FEATURE_UPDATE", entity: "ProductFeature", entityId: section, ip: clientIp(req), after: { count: productIds.length } });
    return ok();
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Feature update failed");
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\admin\orders\[orderNumber]\status\route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { audit, can, requireStaff } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { orderStatusSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { advanceStatus } from "@/lib/orders";
import { jsonError } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { ok, validationError } from "@/lib/api-response";
import { notifyStatusChange } from "@/lib/notify";
import { generateDeliveryOtp, verifyDeliveryOtp, maskOtp } from "@/lib/delivery-otp";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ orderNumber: string }> }) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    if (!can.manageOrders(actor.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const { orderNumber } = await ctx.params;
    const parsed = orderStatusSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) return validationError(parsed.error);

    const order = await prisma.order.findUnique({
      where: { orderNumber },
      select: { id: true, status: true },
    });
    if (!order) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Order not found" }, { status: 404 });

    if (order.status === "CANCELLED" && parsed.data.status !== "CANCELLED") {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Cancelled orders cannot be reopened" }, { status: 409 });
    }

    if (parsed.data.status === "DELIVERED") {
      const provided = typeof parsed.data.otp === "string" ? parsed.data.otp : "";
      const v = await verifyDeliveryOtp(order.id, provided);
      if (!v.ok) {
        const msg =
          v.reason === "mismatch" ? "Delivery OTP does not match."
          : v.reason === "no_otp" ? "No delivery OTP on this order yet — ship it first."
          : v.reason === "already_delivered" ? "Already delivered via OTP."
          : "Order not found.";
        return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: msg }, { status: 422 });
      }
    }

    const updated = await advanceStatus({
      orderId: order.id,
      status: parsed.data.status,
      actorId: actor.id,
      carrier: parsed.data.carrier ?? null,
      tracking: parsed.data.trackingNumber ?? null,
      note: parsed.data.note ?? null,
      location: parsed.data.location ?? null,
    });

    // ---- Audit timestamps for the customer tracking timeline ----
    // advanceStatus() only writes `status`; the milestone dates are ours to set.
    const now = new Date();
    if (updated.status === "CONFIRMED") {
      await prisma.order.update({ where: { id: updated.id }, data: { confirmedAt: now } });
    } else if (updated.status === "PROCESSING") {
      await prisma.order.update({ where: { id: updated.id }, data: { processedAt: now } });
    } else if (updated.status === "SHIPPED") {
      await prisma.order.update({ where: { id: updated.id }, data: { shippedAt: now } });
    } else if (updated.status === "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY") {
      await prisma.order.update({ where: { id: updated.id }, data: { outForDeliveryAt: now } });
    } else if (updated.status === "DELIVERED") {
      await prisma.order.update({ where: { id: updated.id }, data: { deliveredAt: now, deliveredByOtp: true } });
    } else if (updated.status === "CANCELLED") {
      await prisma.order.update({
        where: { id: updated.id },
        data: {
          cancelledAt: now,
          ...(parsed.data.note ? { cancelReason: parsed.data.note } : {}),
        },
      });
    }

    // Delivery handover: mint an OTP and include it in the customer notification.
    let sentOtp: string | undefined;
    if (parsed.data.status === "SHIPPED" || parsed.data.status === "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY") {
      const gen = await generateDeliveryOtp(updated.id);
      if (gen.ok) sentOtp = gen.otp; // handed to notify ONLY; never logged
    }

    await audit({
      actorId: actor.id,
      action: "ORDER_STATUS_UPDATE",
      entity: "Order",
      entityId: order.id,
      ip: clientIp(req),
      before: { status: order.status },
      after: { status: updated.status },
    });

    notifyStatusChange(updated.id, sentOtp); // <- add the 2nd argument

    return ok({
      order: {
        orderNumber: updated.orderNumber,
        status: updated.status,
        deliveryOtpHint: maskOtp((updated as any).deliveryOtp ?? sentOtp),
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Order status update failed");
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { parseProductOptions } from "@/lib/product-options";

const CAN_EDIT = ["ADMIN", "MANAGER", "STAFF"];
const roleOf = (actor: unknown): string => (actor as { role?: string } | null)?.role ?? "";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const actor = await getActor();
  if (!actor || !CAN_EDIT.includes(roleOf(actor))) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const id = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("id");
  if (id) {
    const row: any = await prisma.product.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!row) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not found" }, { status: 404 });
    const names: string[] = Array.isArray(row.colors) ? row.colors : [];
    const rich: any[] = Array.isArray(row.colorOptions)
      ? row.colorOptions
      : names.map((n) => ({ name: n, image: "" }));
    return NextResponse.json({
      product: {
        id: row.id,
        name: row.name,
        colors: names,
        colorOptions: rich,
        variants: Array.isArray(row.variants) ? row.variants : [],
        optionGroups: Array.isArray(row.optionGroups) ? row.optionGroups : [],
      },
    });
  }

  const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
    select: { id: true, name: true },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    take: 200,
  });
  return NextResponse.json({ products });
}

export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
  const actor = await getActor();
  if (!actor || !CAN_EDIT.includes(roleOf(actor))) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await req.json().catch(() => null);
  const id = (body as { id?: unknown } | null)?.id;
  if (typeof id !== "string" || !id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing product id" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const data = parseProductOptions(body);
  if (Object.keys(data).length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Nothing to update" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  await prisma.product.update({ where: { id }, data });
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, id });
}

import { parseProductOptions } from "@/lib/product-options";
import { sanitizePdpBlocks } from "@/lib/pdp-blocks";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { requireStaff, audit, can } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { productInputSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { discountPercent, jsonError, slugify } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { validationError, ok } from "@/lib/api-response";
import { seedRating, buildReviewPicks, REVIEW_TARGET } from "@/lib/rating-seed";
export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

async function uniqueSlug(tx: any, base: string, excludeId?: string) {
  let slug = slugify(base) || "product";
  let i = 2;
  while (true) {
    const exists = await tx.product.findUnique({ where: { slug }, select: { id: true } });
    if (!exists || exists.id === excludeId) return slug;
    slug = `${slugify(base)}-${i++}`;
  }
}

// Coerce an unknown array into clean {group,label,value} rows (max lengths mirror
// productInputSchema so a malformed admin payload can't blow past the column limits).
function specRows(raw: unknown) {
  if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
  return raw
    .map((r: any) => ({
      group: typeof r?.group === "string" ? r.group.trim().slice(0, 60) : "",
      label: typeof r?.label === "string" ? r.label.trim().slice(0, 80) : "",
      value: typeof r?.value === "string" ? r.value.trim().slice(0, 240) : "",
    }))
    .filter((r) => r.group && r.label && r.value);
}
function imageRows(raw: unknown) {
  if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
  return raw
    .map((r: any) => ({
      url: typeof r?.url === "string" ? r.url.trim().slice(0, 1000) : "",
      alt: typeof r?.alt === "string" ? r.alt.trim().slice(0, 500) : "",
    }))
    .filter((r) => r.url);
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);
  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    if (!can.manageCatalog(actor.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }
    const body: Record<string, unknown> = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));

    // Strip the keys that are NOT part of productInputSchema so the strict-ish
    // parse only sees the core contract. The extras are read from `body` below.
    const bodyForSchema: Record<string, unknown> = { ...body };
    delete bodyForSchema.colors;
    delete bodyForSchema.colorOptions;
    delete bodyForSchema.variants;
    delete bodyForSchema.optionGroups;
    delete bodyForSchema.groupId;
    delete bodyForSchema.description;
    delete bodyForSchema.warrantySpecifications;
    delete bodyForSchema.mfgSpecifications;
    delete bodyForSchema.showcaseImages;
    delete bodyForSchema.pdpBlocks;

    const parsed = productInputSchema.safeParse(bodyForSchema);
    if (!parsed.success) return validationError(parsed.error);
    const data = parsed.data;

    const rawGroupId = (body as { groupId?: unknown }).groupId;
    const groupId = typeof rawGroupId === "string" && rawGroupId.trim() ? rawGroupId.trim() : null;

    if (data.salePrice > data.mrp) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Sale price cannot exceed MRP" }, { status: 422 });
    }

    // ---- extra sections (the image-2 parity fields) ----
    const description =
      typeof body.description === "string" ? body.description.trim().slice(0, 20000) || null : null;
    const warranty = specRows(body.warrantySpecifications);
    const mfg = specRows(body.mfgSpecifications);
    const showcase = imageRows(body.showcaseImages);
    const pdpBlocks = sanitizePdpBlocks(body.pdpBlocks);

    const [category, brand] = await Promise.all([
      prisma.category.findUnique({ where: { id: data.categoryId }, select: { id: true } }),
      prisma.brand.findUnique({ where: { id: data.brandId }, select: { id: true } }),
    ]);
    if (!category || !brand) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid category or brand" }, { status: 422 });
    }

    const galleryCount = data.images.length;

    const product = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const slug = await uniqueSlug(tx, data.slug || data.name);
      return tx.product.create({
        data: {
          name: data.name,
          slug,
          shortDescription: data.shortDescription || null,
          description,                                   // <-- long-form copy
          pdpBlocks: pdpBlocks as any,                   // <-- PDP info blocks (Json)
          category: { connect: { id: data.categoryId } },
          brand: { connect: { id: data.brandId } },
          mrp: data.mrp,
          salePrice: data.salePrice,
          discountPercent: discountPercent(data.mrp, data.salePrice),
          stock: data.stock,
          lowStockAt: data.lowStockAt,
          subtype: data.subtype || null,
          ram: data.ram || null,
          storage: data.storage || null,
          screenSize: data.screenSize || null,
          processor: data.processor || null,
          color: data.color || null,
          warrantyMonths: data.warrantyMonths,
          codEligible: data.codEligible,
          emiEligible: data.emiEligible,
          exchangeEligible: data.exchangeEligible,
          featured: data.featured,
          active: data.active,
          hsnCode: data.hsnCode || null,
          tags: data.tags,
          ...seedRating(data.name),
          ...parseProductOptions(body),
          groupId,
          images: {
            create: [
              // GALLERY (primary first) — unchanged behaviour
              ...data.images.map((img, idx) => ({
                url: img.url,
                alt: img.alt || data.name,
                position: idx,
                isPrimary: idx === 0,
                kind: "GALLERY" as const,
              })),
              // SHOWCASE banners — stacked after the gallery, never primary
              ...showcase.map((img, i) => ({
                url: img.url,
                alt: img.alt || data.name,
                position: galleryCount + i,
                isPrimary: false,
                kind: "SHOWCASE" as const,
              })),
            ],
          },
          specifications: {
            create: [
              ...data.specifications.map((s) => ({
                group: s.group,
                label: s.label,
                value: s.value,
                kind: "SPEC" as const,
              })),
              ...warranty.map((s) => ({ ...s, kind: "WARRANTY" as const })),
              ...mfg.map((s) => ({ ...s, kind: "MFG" as const })),
            ],
          },
        },
      });
    });

    // best-effort visible review strip, POST-commit so it can never block creation.
    try {
      const authors = await prisma.user.findMany({
        where: { role: { not: "ADMIN" } },
        take: REVIEW_TARGET,
        select: { id: true },
      });
      if (authors.length) {
        await prisma.review.createMany({
          data: buildReviewPicks(product.id, authors.map((a) => a.id)),
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("review seed skipped for", product.id, e instanceof Error ? e.message : e);
    }

    await audit({
      actorId: actor.id,
      action: "PRODUCT_CREATE",
      entity: "Product",
      entityId: product.id,
      ip: clientIp(req),
      userAgent: req.headers.get("user-agent"),
      after: { name: product.name, salePrice: product.salePrice, stock: product.stock },
    });
    return ok({ product });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Product creation failed");
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { can, requireStaff } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { ok, validationError } from "@/lib/api-response";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// Dedicated, minimal schema for the long-form description column. Kept OUT of
// productInputSchema on purpose: the main [id] PATCH rebuilds specifications on
// every save, so routing description through it would risk clobbering specs. A
// bounded string here is the safe, isolated write path (empty -> null).
const payload = z.object({
  description: z.string().trim().max(20000).optional().or(z.literal("")),
});

export async function PATCH(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    if (!can.manageCatalog(actor.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const { id } = await ctx.params;
    const parsed = payload.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => null));
    if (!parsed.success) return validationError(parsed.error);

    const exists = await prisma.product.findUnique({ where: { id }, select: { id: true } });
    if (!exists) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });

    const description = (parsed.data.description ?? "").trim() || null;
    const updated = await prisma.product.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { description },
      select: { id: true, description: true },
    });

    return ok({ product: updated });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { ok: false, error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Description update failed" },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\admin\products\[id]\duplicate\route.ts
============================================================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/**
 * POST /api/admin/products/:id/duplicate
 *
 * Clone a product so a colour/variant sibling can be edited from a copy instead
 * of from scratch. Copies, in ONE atomic transaction:
 *   - the row (new slug/name, sales+views reset, rating carried WITH reviews, inactive)
 *   - ALL images (GALLERY + SHOWCASE, positions + isPrimary)
 *   - ALL specifications (SPEC / WARRANTY / MFG)
 *   - ALL reviews (photos, verified flag, helpful counts, original timestamps)
 *   - ALL question threads with their answers
 * Copies the SAVED server state; does not see unsaved form edits.
 */
export async function POST(
  _req: Request,
  ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  const actor = await getActor();

  // Same inline staff idiom as the order page; align with your other admin
  // write routes if you enforce a stricter role.
  if (!actor || !["ADMIN", "MANAGER", "STAFF"].includes(actor.role)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { id } = await ctx.params;

  const src = await prisma.product.findUnique({
    where: { id },
    include: {
      images: { orderBy: { position: "asc" } },
      specifications: true,
    },
  });

  if (!src) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { ok: false, error: "Product not found" },
      { status: 404 },
    );
  }

  // Unique slug without touching the create route's slugify: suffix until free.
  let slug = `${src.slug}-copy`;
  for (let n = 2; ; n++) {
    const taken = await prisma.product.findUnique({
      where: { slug },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    if (!taken) break;
    slug = `${src.slug}-copy-${n}`;
  }

  const copy = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const row = await tx.product.create({
      data: {
        // --- identity --------------------------------------------------------
        slug,
        name: `${src.name} (Copy)`,
        groupId: src.groupId,
        shortDescription: src.shortDescription,
        categoryId: src.categoryId,
        brandId: src.brandId,
        subtype: src.subtype,

        // --- pricing & stock -------------------------------------------------
        mrp: src.mrp,
        salePrice: src.salePrice,
        discountPercent: src.discountPercent,
        stock: src.stock,
        lowStockAt: src.lowStockAt,
        hsnCode: src.hsnCode,

        // --- physical / technical --------------------------------------------
        ram: src.ram,
        storage: src.storage,
        screenSize: src.screenSize,
        processor: src.processor,
        color: src.color,

        // --- service / eligibility -------------------------------------------
        warrantyMonths: src.warrantyMonths,
        returnableDays: src.returnableDays,
        codEligible: src.codEligible,
        emiEligible: src.emiEligible,
        exchangeEligible: src.exchangeEligible,

        // --- state -----------------------------------------------------------
        featured: src.featured,
        active: false, // copy starts inactive so a half-edited variant can't go live

        // --- collections -----------------------------------------------------
        tags: [...(src.tags ?? [])],
        colors: [...(src.colors ?? [])],
        variants: src.variants ?? undefined,
        optionGroups: src.optionGroups ?? undefined,
        colorOptions: src.colorOptions ?? undefined,
        showcaseImages: [...(src.showcaseImages ?? [])],

        // --- aggregates & history --------------------------------------------
        // Sales/traffic stay reset: a copy must not claim sales it never made
        // or sneak into bestseller carousels. The rating travels WITH the
        // reviews copied below, so the aggregate and the review list can never
        // disagree.
        sold: 0,
        views: 0,
        ratingAvg: src.ratingAvg,
        ratingCount: src.ratingCount,
      },
    });

    // --- images (both GALLERY and SHOWCASE, with original positions) ----------
    if (src.images.length) {
      await tx.productImage.createMany({
        data: src.images.map((im, i) => ({
          productId: row.id,
          url: im.url,
          alt: im.alt,
          kind: im.kind,
          position: im.position ?? i,
          isPrimary: im.isPrimary,
        })),
      });
    }

    // --- specifications (SPEC / WARRANTY / MFG) --------------------------------
    if (src.specifications.length) {
      await tx.productSpecification.createMany({
        data: src.specifications.map((s) => ({
          productId: row.id,
          kind: s.kind,
          group: s.group,
          label: s.label,
          value: s.value,
        })),
      });
    }

    // --- reviews ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // Colour/variant siblings share reviews on real marketplaces. The
    // @@unique([productId, userId]) constraint cannot collide: the pair
    // includes the NEW productId, so no user ends up with two reviews on the
    // same product.
    const reviews = await tx.review.findMany({ where: { productId: id } });
    if (reviews.length) {
      await tx.review.createMany({
        data: reviews.map((r) => ({
          productId: row.id,
          userId: r.userId,
          orderId: r.orderId,
          rating: r.rating,
          title: r.title,
          body: r.body,
          images: [...(r.images ?? [])],
          verified: r.verified,
          helpfulCount: r.helpfulCount,
          published: r.published,
          createdAt: r.createdAt,
        })),
      });
    }

    // --- question threads + answers, in thread order ---------------------------
    // Neither Question nor Answer has a unique constraint, so re-parenting
    // answers onto fresh question ids is collision-free.
    const questions = await tx.question.findMany({
      where: { productId: id },
      include: { answers: { orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" } } },
    });

    for (const q of questions) {
      const nq = await tx.question.create({
        data: {
          productId: row.id,
          userId: q.userId,
          body: q.body,
          answered: q.answered,
          createdAt: q.createdAt,
        },
      });

      if (q.answers.length) {
        await tx.answer.createMany({
          data: q.answers.map((a) => ({
            questionId: nq.id,
            userId: a.userId,
            body: a.body,
            isOfficial: a.isOfficial,
            createdAt: a.createdAt,
          })),
        });
      }
    }

    return row;
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, id: copy.id, slug: copy.slug });
}

    return tx.productImage.findMany({ where: { productId: id, kind }, orderBy: { position: "asc" } });
  });
  return NextResponse.json({ images: saved });

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { audit, can, requireStaff } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { productInputSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { discountPercent, jsonError, slugify } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { ok, validationError } from "@/lib/api-response";
import { parseProductOptions } from "@/lib/product-options";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const quickSchema = z.object({
  active: z.coerce.boolean().optional(),
  featured: z.coerce.boolean().optional(),
});

async function uniqueSlug(tx: any, base: string, excludeId?: string) {
  let slug = slugify(base) || "product";
  let i = 2;
  while (true) {
    const exists = await tx.product.findUnique({ where: { slug }, select: { id: true } });
    if (!exists || exists.id === excludeId) return slug;
    slug = `${slugify(base)}-${i++}`;
  }
}

export async function PATCH(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    if (!can.manageCatalog(actor.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const { id } = await ctx.params;
    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));

    // Option fields are persisted separately (below); keep them out of the zod
    // schema's view so a strict schema can't reject the whole save because of them.
    const bodyForSchema: Record<string, unknown> = { ...body };
    delete bodyForSchema.colors;
    delete bodyForSchema.colorOptions;
    delete bodyForSchema.variants;
    delete bodyForSchema.optionGroups;
    delete bodyForSchema.groupId;

    const existing = await prisma.product.findUnique({ where: { id },select: { id: true, name: true, stock: true, active: true } });
    if (!existing) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });

    if (("active" in body || "featured" in body) && !("name" in body)) {
      const quick = quickSchema.safeParse(body);
      if (!quick.success) return validationError(quick.error);
      const product = await prisma.product.update({ where: { id }, data: quick.data });
      await audit({
        actorId: actor.id,
        action: "PRODUCT_QUICK_UPDATE",
        entity: "Product",
        entityId: id,
        ip: clientIp(req),
        before: { active: existing.active },
        after: { active: product.active, featured: product.featured },
      });
      return ok({ product });
    }

    const parsed = productInputSchema.safeParse({ ...bodyForSchema, id: undefined });
    if (!parsed.success) return validationError(parsed.error);
    const data = parsed.data;

    const rawGroupId = (body as { groupId?: unknown }).groupId;
    const groupId = typeof rawGroupId === "string" && rawGroupId.trim() ? rawGroupId.trim() : null;

    if (data.salePrice > data.mrp) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Sale price cannotexceed MRP" }, { status: 422 });
    }

    const product = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const slug = await uniqueSlug(tx, data.slug || data.name, id);
      await tx.productImage.deleteMany({ where: { productId: id, kind: "GALLERY" } });
      await tx.productSpecification.deleteMany({ where: { productId: id, kind: "SPEC" } });

      return tx.product.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          name: data.name,
          slug,
          shortDescription: data.shortDescription || null,
          category: { connect: { id: data.categoryId } },
          brand: { connect: { id: data.brandId } },
          mrp: data.mrp,
          salePrice: data.salePrice,
          discountPercent: discountPercent(data.mrp, data.salePrice),
          stock: data.stock,
          lowStockAt: data.lowStockAt,
          subtype: data.subtype || null,
          ram: data.ram || null,
          storage: data.storage || null,
          screenSize: data.screenSize || null,
          processor: data.processor || null,
          color: data.color || null,
          warrantyMonths: data.warrantyMonths,
          codEligible: data.codEligible,
          emiEligible: data.emiEligible,
          exchangeEligible: data.exchangeEligible,
          featured: data.featured,
          active: data.active,
          hsnCode: data.hsnCode || null,
          tags: data.tags,
          // Colours / swatches / option groups / variants — sanitized; returns only
          // keys present in the payload, so callers that don't send them change nothing.
          ...parseProductOptions(body),
          groupId,
          images: {
            create: data.images.map((img, idx) => ({
              url: img.url,
              alt: img.alt || data.name,
              position: idx,
              isPrimary: idx === 0,
            })),
          },
          specifications: {
            create: data.specifications.map((s) => ({
              group: s.group,
              label: s.label,
              value: s.value,
            })),
          },
        },
      });
    });

    await audit({
      actorId: actor.id,
      action: "PRODUCT_UPDATE",
      entity: "Product",
      entityId: id,
      ip: clientIp(req),
      before: { name: existing.name, stock: existing.stock },
      after: { name: product.name, stock: product.stock, salePrice: product.salePrice },
    });

    return ok({ product });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Product update failed");
  }
}

export async function DELETE(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    if (!can.destroy(actor.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Admin only" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const { id } = await ctx.params;
    const existing = await prisma.product.findUnique({ where: { id },select: { id: true, name: true } });
    if (!existing) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });

    try {
      await prisma.product.delete({ where: { id } });
    } catch {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Cannot delete product with order history. Deactivate it instead." },
        { status: 409 },
      );
    }

    await audit({
      actorId: actor.id,
      action: "PRODUCT_DELETE",
      entity: "Product",
      entityId: id,
      ip: clientIp(req),
      before: { name: existing.name },
    });

    return ok();
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Product delete failed");
  }
}

const KINDS = ["SPEC", "WARRANTY", "MFG"] as const;
const row = z.object({ group: z.string().min(1), label: z.string().min(1), value: z.string().min(1) });
const payload = z.object({ kind: z.enum(KINDS).default("SPEC"), specs: z.array(row) });

async function guard() {
  const actor = await getActor();
  if (!actor || actor.role !== "ADMIN") return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  return null;
}

export async function GET(_req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const denied = await guard(); if (denied) return denied;
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const specs = await prisma.productSpecification.findMany({
    where: { productId: id }, orderBy: [{ kind: "asc" }, { group: "asc" }, { label: "asc" }] });
  return NextResponse.json({ specs });
}

export async function PUT(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const denied = await guard(); if (denied) return denied;
  const { id } = await ctx.params;
  const parsed = payload.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => null));
  if (!parsed.success) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Bad payload" }, { status: 400 });
  const { kind, specs } = parsed.data;

  const exists = await prisma.product.findUnique({ where: { id }, select: { id: true } });
  if (!exists) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not found" }, { status: 404 });

  const saved = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.productSpecification.deleteMany({ where: { productId: id, kind } });
    await tx.productSpecification.createMany({ data: specs.map((s) => ({ ...s, productId: id, kind })) });
    return tx.productSpecification.findMany({ where: { productId: id, kind }, orderBy: [{ group: "asc" }, { label: "asc" }] });
  });
  return NextResponse.json({ specs: saved });
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { audit, can, requireStaff } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { stockAdjustSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { jsonError } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { notifyStaff } from "@/lib/notifications";
import { ok, validationError } from "@/lib/api-response";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function PATCH(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    if (!can.manageCatalog(actor.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const { id } = await ctx.params;

    const parsed = stockAdjustSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) return validationError(parsed.error);

    const before = await prisma.product.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      select: { id: true, name: true, stock: true, lowStockAt: true },
    });

    if (!before) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });
    }

    const delta = parsed.data.delta;
    let updated;

    if (delta < 0) {
      const res = await prisma.product.updateMany({
        where: { id, stock: { gte: -delta } },
        data: { stock: { increment: delta } },
      });

      if (res.count !== 1) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { ok: false, error: "Insufficient stock for this adjustment" },
          { status: 409 },
        );
      }

      updated = await prisma.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
    } else {
      updated = await prisma.product.update({
        where: { id },
        data: { stock: { increment: delta } },
      });
    }

    await audit({
      actorId: actor.id,
      action: "PRODUCT_STOCK_ADJUST",
      entity: "Product",
      entityId: id,
      ip: clientIp(req),
      userAgent: req.headers.get("user-agent"),
      before: { stock: before.stock },
      after: { stock: updated.stock, reason: parsed.data.reason },
    });

    if (updated.stock === 0) {
      await notifyStaff({ template: "ADMIN_OUT_OF_STOCK", ctx: { product: updated.name } });
    } else if (updated.stock <= updated.lowStockAt) {
      await notifyStaff({
        template: "ADMIN_LOW_STOCK",
        ctx: {
          product: updated.name,
          stock: String(updated.stock),
          threshold: String(updated.lowStockAt),
        },
      });
    }

    return ok({ product: { id: updated.id, stock: updated.stock } });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Stock update failed");
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { audit, can, requireStaff } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { returnDecisionSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { addDays, jsonError, paise, sanitizeText } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { notify } from "@/lib/notifications";
import { createRefund, razorpayConfigured } from "@/lib/razorpay";
import { ok, validationError } from "@/lib/api-response";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function PATCH(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    const { id } = await ctx.params;

    const parsed = returnDecisionSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) return validationError(parsed.error);
    const { status, adminNote } = parsed.data;

    if (status === "REFUNDED" && !can.refund(actor.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Refunds require ADMIN role" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const ret = await prisma.returnRequest.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: {
        order: {
          include: {
            user: { select: { id: true, name: true, email: true, phone: true, whatsappOptIn: true } },
            payments: { where: { status: "PAID" }, orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }, take: 1 },
          },
        },
        orderItem: { include: { product: { select: { id: true, name: true, stock: true } } } },
      },
    });

    if (!ret) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Return not found" }, { status: 404 });

    if (status === "REPLACED") {
      const res = await prisma.product.updateMany({
        where: { id: ret.orderItem.productId, stock: { gte: 1 } },
        data: { stock: { decrement: 1 } },
      });
      if (res.count !== 1) {
        return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Replacement blocked: product out of stock" }, { status: 409 });
      }
    }

    let refundNote = "";
    if (status === "REFUNDED") {
      const payment = ret.order.payments[0];
      const amountPaise = Math.min(paise(ret.orderItem.lineTotal), Math.max(0, payment?.amountPaise ?? 0) - (payment?.refundedAmountPaise ?? 0));

      if (payment && razorpayConfigured && payment.razorpayPaymentId && amountPaise > 0) {
        try {
          const refund = await createRefund({
            paymentId: payment.razorpayPaymentId,
            amountPaise,
            note: `Return ${ret.id}`,
            speed: "optimum",
          });
          const newRefunded = (payment.refundedAmountPaise ?? 0) + amountPaise;
          await prisma.payment.update({
            where: { id: payment.id },
            data: {
              refundId: refund.id,
              refundedAmountPaise: newRefunded,
              status: newRefunded >= payment.amountPaise ? "REFUNDED" : "PARTIALLY_REFUNDED",
            },
          });
          if (newRefunded >= payment.amountPaise) {
            await prisma.order.update({ where: { id: ret.orderId }, data: { paymentStatus: "REFUNDED" } });
          } else {
            await prisma.order.update({ where: { id: ret.orderId }, data: { paymentStatus: "PARTIALLY_REFUNDED" } });
          }
          refundNote = `Refund ${refund.id} initiated.`;
        } catch (e) {
          refundNote = "Refund API failed; mark manually after gateway review.";
          console.error("[return:refund]", e);
        }
      } else {
        refundNote = "No capturable online payment found; refund marked operationally.";
      }
    }

    const updated = await prisma.returnRequest.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        status,
        adminNote: adminNote ? sanitizeText(adminNote, 600) : ret.adminNote,
        pickupEta: status === "APPROVED" ? addDays(new Date(), 5) : ret.pickupEta,
      },
    });

    const ctxNotify = {
      orderNumber: ret.order.orderNumber,
      status: status.replace(/_/g, " "),
      note: adminNote ?? refundNote ?? "",
      date: status === "APPROVED" ? "in 3–5 days" : "soon",
    };

    await notify({
      template:
        status === "APPROVED"
          ? "RETURN_APPROVED"
          : status === "REJECTED"
            ? "RETURN_REJECTED"
            : status === "REFUNDED"
              ? "REFUND_PROCESSED"
              : "RETURN_STATUS",
      userId: ret.userId,
      email: ret.order.user?.email,
      phone: ret.order.user?.phone,
      whatsappOptIn: ret.order.user?.whatsappOptIn,
      ctx: {
        ...ctxNotify,
        amount: status === "REFUNDED" ? `₹${ret.orderItem.lineTotal.toLocaleString("en-IN")}` : "",
      },
    });

    await audit({
      actorId: actor.id,
      action: "RETURN_DECISION",
      entity: "ReturnRequest",
      entityId: id,
      ip: clientIp(req),
      before: { status: ret.status },
      after: { status: updated.status, note: adminNote },
    });

    return ok({ return: { id: updated.id, status: updated.status } });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Return decision failed");
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { audit, can, requireStaff } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { jsonError } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { ok, validationError } from "@/lib/api-response";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const schema = z.object({ ids: z.array(z.string()).min(1).max(200) });

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);
  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    if (!can.manageContent(actor.role)) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });

      ),
    );

    await audit({ actorId: actor.id, action: "SLIDE_REORDER", entity: "HeroSlide", ip: clientIp(req), after: { count: parsed.data.ids.length } });
    return ok();
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Reorder failed");
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\admin\slides\route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { audit, can, requireStaff } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import type { GradientTheme } from "@prisma/client";
import { slideInputSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { jsonError } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { ok, validationError } from "@/lib/api-response";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    if (!can.manageContent(actor.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const parsed = slideInputSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) return validationError(parsed.error);

    const data = parsed.data;

    // Validate that every attached product exists and is active.
    if (data.productIds.length) {
      const count = await prisma.product.count({
        where: { id: { in: data.productIds }, active: true },
      });
      if (count !== data.productIds.length) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { ok: false, error: "One or more products are invalid" },
          { status: 422 },
        );
      }
    }

    const slide = await prisma.heroSlide.create({
      data: {
        kind: "CUSTOM",

        // --- content --------------------------------------------------------
        badge: data.badge,
        headline: data.headline,
        highlight: data.highlight || null,
        description: data.description || null,
        image: data.image || null,

        // --- calls to action ------------------------------------------------
        ctaLabel: data.ctaLabel,
        ctaHref: data.ctaHref || null,
        secondaryLabel: data.secondaryLabel || null,
        secondaryHref: data.secondaryHref || null,

        // --- appearance & schedule ------------------------------------------
        gradient: data.gradient as GradientTheme,
        active: data.active,
        sortOrder: data.sortOrder,
        startsAt: data.startsAt ? new Date(data.startsAt) : null,
        endsAt: data.endsAt ? new Date(data.endsAt) : null,
        createdBy: actor.id,

        // --- attached products + per-product slide artwork ------------------
        products: {
          create: data.productIds.map((productId, position) => ({
            productId,
            position,
            image: data.productImages?.[productId] || null,
          })),
        },
      },
      include: { products: true },
    });

    await audit({
      actorId: actor.id,
      action: "SLIDE_CREATE",
      entity: "HeroSlide",
      entityId: slide.id,
      ip: clientIp(req),
      after: { headline: slide.headline },
    });

    return ok({
      slide: {
        ...slide,
        productIds: slide.products.map((p) => p.productId),
        // Echo per-product artwork back so the manager's local state is correct
        // immediately after creation, without waiting for router.refresh().
        productImages: Object.fromEntries(
          slide.products.map((p) => [p.productId, p.image ?? ""]),
        ),
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Slide creation failed");
  }
}

const schema = z.object({ active: z.boolean() });

/**
 * PATCH /api/admin/slides/:id/active — flip a slide's active flag without
 * touching any other field (no re-validation of content, no join-row churn).
 */
export async function PATCH(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

      action: "SLIDE_UPDATE",

      entityId: id,

    });

    return jsonError(e, "Slide active toggle failed");

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { audit, can, requireStaff } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import type { GradientTheme } from "@prisma/client";
import { slideInputSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { jsonError } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { ok, validationError } from "@/lib/api-response";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function PATCH(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    if (!can.manageContent(actor.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const { id } = await ctx.params;

    const parsed = slideInputSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) return validationError(parsed.error);

    const data = parsed.data;

    // Replace the slide's attached products (and their per-product slide artwork)
    // in one transaction: wipe the join rows, then re-create from the payload.
    await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.heroSlideProduct.deleteMany({ where: { slideId: id } });

      await tx.heroSlide.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          // --- content ---------------------------------------------------------
          badge: data.badge,
          headline: data.headline,
          highlight: data.highlight || null,
          description: data.description || null,
          image: data.image || null,

          // --- calls to action --------------------------------------------------
          ctaLabel: data.ctaLabel,
          ctaHref: data.ctaHref || null,
          secondaryLabel: data.secondaryLabel || null,
          secondaryHref: data.secondaryHref || null,

          // --- appearance & schedule --------------------------------------------
          gradient: data.gradient as GradientTheme,
          active: data.active,
          sortOrder: data.sortOrder,
          startsAt: data.startsAt ? new Date(data.startsAt) : null,
          endsAt: data.endsAt ? new Date(data.endsAt) : null,

          // --- attached products + per-product slide artwork ---------------------
          products: {
            create: data.productIds.map((productId, position) => ({
              productId,
              position,
              image: data.productImages?.[productId] || null,
            })),
          },
        },
      });
    });

    await audit({
      actorId: actor.id,
      action: "SLIDE_UPDATE",
      entity: "HeroSlide",
      entityId: id,
      ip: clientIp(req),
    });

    const slide = await prisma.heroSlide.findUniqueOrThrow({
      where: { id },
      include: { products: true },
    });

    return ok({
      slide: {
        ...slide,
        productIds: slide.products.map((p) => p.productId),
        // Echo per-product artwork back so the manager's local state is correct
        // immediately, without waiting for router.refresh().
        productImages: Object.fromEntries(
          slide.products.map((p) => [p.productId, p.image ?? ""]),
        ),
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Slide update failed");
  }
}

export async function DELETE(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("adminMutation", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    if (!can.destroy(actor.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Admin only" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    await prisma.heroSlide.delete({ where: { id } });

    await audit({
      actorId: actor.id,
      action: "SLIDE_DELETE",
      entity: "HeroSlide",
      entityId: id,
      ip: clientIp(req),
    });

    return ok();
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Slide delete failed");
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\admin\upload\route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { mkdir, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { requireStaff, can } from "@/lib/auth/guards";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
const ALLOWED: Record<string, string> = {
  "image/png": ".png",
  "image/jpeg": ".jpg",
  "image/webp": ".webp",
  "image/gif": ".gif",
  "image/avif": ".avif",
};

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const actor = await requireStaff();
    if (!can.manageCatalog(actor.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const fd = await req.formData();
    const file = fd.get("file");
    if (!(file instanceof File)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "No file sent" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    const ext = ALLOWED[file.type];
    if (!ext) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Only PNG, JPEG, WEBP, GIF or AVIF images are allowed" }, { status: 415 });
    }
    if (file.size > MAX_BYTES) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Image must be 5 MB or smaller" }, { status: 413 });
    }

    const buf = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
    const name = `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}${ext}`;
    const dir = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "uploads");
    await mkdir(dir, { recursive: true });
    await writeFile(path.join(dir, name), buf);

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, url: `/uploads/${name}` });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Upload failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\auth\forgot-password\route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import crypto from "node:crypto";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { sendEmail } from "@/lib/notify";          // the export from Move 1
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit"; // verified symbols from your admin route

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const APP_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000";
const SECRET = process.env.RESET_SECRET;
const TTL_SECONDS = 30 * 60; // link valid 30 min

/** Stateless, signed reset token: userId.expiry.hmac — needs NO db column. */
function mintToken(userId: string): string {
  if (!SECRET) throw new Error("RESET_SECRET not set");
  const exp = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + TTL_SECONDS;
  const payload = `${userId}.${exp}`;
  const sig = crypto.createHmac("sha256", SECRET).update(payload).digest("hex");
  return Buffer.from(`${payload}.${sig}`).toString("base64url");
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("forgotPassword", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  let email: string | undefined;
  try {
    const body = (await req.json()) as { email?: unknown };
    if (typeof body.email === "string") email = body.email.trim().toLowerCase();
  } catch {
    /* fall through to the generic answer below */
  }

  // Build + send ONLY if the account exists — but the response is identical either way.
  if (email && /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email) && SECRET) {
    try {
      const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
        where: { email },
        select: { id: true, name: true },
      });
      if (user) {
        const link = `${APP_URL}/auth/reset-password?token=${encodeURIComponent(mintToken(user.id))}`;
        const hi = user.name ? `Hi ${user.name.split(" ")[0]},` : "Hi,";
        const text =
          `${hi}\n\nWe received a request to reset your Urban Vogue password.\n` +
          `Open this link within 30 minutes to choose a new one:\n${link}\n\n` +
          `If you didn't request this, ignore this message — your password stays unchanged.`;
        // Fire-and-forget semantics live inside sendEmail (try/catch + dry-run log).
        await sendEmail(email, "Reset your Urban Vogue password", text);
      }
    } catch {
      /* never leak which step failed; the safe message below is the only output */
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}

// src/app/api/auth/login/resend/route.ts
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import { OtpPurpose } from "@prisma/client";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { createAndSendOtp } from "@/lib/otp";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { jsonError } from "@/lib/utils";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const schema = z.object({
  email: z.string().trim().email("Enter a valid email").toLowerCase(),
});

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const ip = clientIp(req);
  const rl = await rateLimit("otpSend", ip);
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const parsed = schema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Invalid resend request" },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const { email } = parsed.data;

    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email },
      select: {
        id: true,
        phone: true,
        active: true,
        role: true,
      },
    });

    // Avoid account enumeration. Return success even if the account does not exist.
    if (!user || !user.active || !user.phone || user.role !== "CUSTOMER") {
      return NextResponse.json({
        ok: true,
        message: "If an account exists, a new code has been sent.",
      });
    }

    const send = await createAndSendOtp({
      purpose: OtpPurpose.LOGIN,
      phone: user.phone,
      userId: user.id,
      ip,
      userAgent: req.headers.get("user-agent"),
    });

    if (!send.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: send.error,
          code: send.code,
          resendAfter: send.resendAfter,
        },
        { status: send.code === "OTP_COOLDOWN" ? 429 : 422 },
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      requiresOtp: true,
      message: "A new OTP has been sent.",
      phoneMasked: send.phoneMasked,
      expiresAt: send.expiresAt,
      resendAfter: send.resendAfter,
      devCode: send.devCode,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Could not resend login OTP.");
  }
}

// src/app/api/auth/login/route.ts
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";
import { OtpPurpose } from "@prisma/client";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { loginSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { createSession, isStaffRole } from "@/lib/auth/session";

import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const ip = clientIp(req);
  const rl = await rateLimit("login", ip);
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const parsed = loginSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid credentials",
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const { email, password, admin } = parsed.data;

    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } });

    if (!user || !user.active) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Invalid email or password." },
        { status: 401 },
      );
    }

    if (user.lockedUntil && user.lockedUntil > new Date()) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: "Too many failed attempts. Please try again later.",
        },
        { status: 429 },
      );
    }

    const valid = await bcrypt.compare(password, user.passwordHash);

    if (!valid) {
      const failed = user.failedLoginCount + 1;

      await prisma.user.update({
        where: { id: user.id },
        data: {
          failedLoginCount: failed,
          lockedUntil:
            failed >= 5 ? new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000) : null,
        },
      });

      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Invalid email or password." },
        { status: 401 },
      );
    }

    if (admin && !isStaffRole(user.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Admin access restricted." },
        { status: 403 },
      );
    }

    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: {
        failedLoginCount: 0,
        lockedUntil: null,
        lastLoginAt: new Date(),
      },
    });

    // Customers require OTP verification after password success.
    // Staff/admin sign-in remains password-based to avoid locking yourself out.
    if (user.role === "CUSTOMER") {
      if (!user.phone) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            ok: false,
            code: "PHONE_REQUIRED",
            error:
              "Mobile verification is required for customer login. Please contact support to add a mobile number.",
          },
          { status: 422 },
        );
      }

      const send = await createAndSendOtp({
        purpose: OtpPurpose.LOGIN,
        phone: user.phone,
        userId: user.id,
        ip,
        userAgent: req.headers.get("user-agent"),
      });

      if (!send.ok) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            ok: false,
            error: send.error,
            code: send.code,
            resendAfter: send.resendAfter,
          },
          { status: send.code === "OTP_COOLDOWN" ? 429 : 422 },
        );
      }

      return NextResponse.json({
        ok: false,
        requiresOtp: true,
        message: "Enter the 6-digit OTP sent to your mobile number.",
        phoneMasked: send.phoneMasked,
        expiresAt: send.expiresAt,
        resendAfter: send.resendAfter,
        devCode: send.devCode,
      });
    }

    await createSession(user);

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      user: {
        id: user.id,
        name: user.name,
        email: user.email,
        phone: user.phone,
        role: user.role,
        whatsappOptIn: user.whatsappOptIn,
      },
      redirect: admin
        ? "/admin/dashboard"
        : isStaffRole(user.role)
          ? "/admin/dashboard"
          : "/account",
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Login failed.");
  }
}

// src/app/api/auth/login/verify/route.ts
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import { OtpPurpose } from "@prisma/client";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { createSession, isStaffRole } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { verifyOtp } from "@/lib/otp";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { jsonError } from "@/lib/utils";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const schema = z.object({
  email: z.string().trim().email("Enter a valid email").toLowerCase(),
  code: z.string().trim().regex(/^\d{6}$/, "Enter the 6-digit OTP"),
});

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const ip = clientIp(req);
  const rl = await rateLimit("otpVerify", ip);
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const parsed = schema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid OTP request",
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const { email, code } = parsed.data;

    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        email: true,
        phone: true,
        role: true,
        active: true,
        whatsappOptIn: true,
      },
    });

    if (!user || !user.active) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Invalid login request." },
        { status: 401 },
      );
    }

    if (!user.phone) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          code: "PHONE_REQUIRED",
          error: "No mobile number is registered for this account.",
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const verified = await verifyOtp({
      purpose: OtpPurpose.LOGIN,
      phone: user.phone,
      code,
      userId: user.id,
    });

    if (!verified.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: verified.error, code: verified.reason },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    await createSession(user);

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      user: {
        id: user.id,
        name: user.name,
        email: user.email,
        phone: user.phone,
        role: user.role,
        whatsappOptIn: user.whatsappOptIn,
      },
      redirect: isStaffRole(user.role) ? "/admin/dashboard" : "/account",
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "OTP login verification failed.");
  }
}

// src/app/api/auth/register/resend/route.ts
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import { OtpPurpose } from "@prisma/client";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { createAndSendOtp } from "@/lib/otp";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { jsonError, normalizeMobile } from "@/lib/utils";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const schema = z.object({
  email: z.string().trim().email("Enter a valid email").toLowerCase(),
  phone: z.string().trim().min(10, "Mobile number is required"),
});

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const ip = clientIp(req);
  const rl = await rateLimit("otpSend", ip);
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const parsed = schema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid resend request",
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const { email, phone } = parsed.data;

    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email },
      select: {
        id: true,
        phone: true,
        active: true,
      },
    });

    if (!user || user.active || !user.phone) {
      return NextResponse.json({
        ok: true,
        message: "If a pending verification exists, a new code has been sent.",
      });
    }

    const normalizedUserPhone = normalizeMobile(user.phone);
    const normalizedInputPhone = normalizeMobile(phone);

    if (!normalizedUserPhone || normalizedUserPhone !== normalizedInputPhone) {
      return NextResponse.json({
        ok: true,
        message: "If a pending verification exists, a new code has been sent.",
      });
    }

    const send = await createAndSendOtp({
      purpose: OtpPurpose.REGISTER,
      phone: normalizedInputPhone,
      userId: user.id,
      ip,
      userAgent: req.headers.get("user-agent"),
      meta: { email },
    });

    if (!send.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: send.error,
          code: send.code,
          resendAfter: send.resendAfter,
        },
        { status: send.code === "OTP_COOLDOWN" ? 429 : 422 },
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      pendingVerification: true,
      message: "A new OTP has been sent.",
      phoneMasked: send.phoneMasked,
      expiresAt: send.expiresAt,
      resendAfter: send.resendAfter,
      devCode: send.devCode,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Could not resend OTP.");
  }
}

// src/app/api/auth/register/route.ts
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";
import { OtpPurpose } from "@prisma/client";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { registerSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { createAndSendOtp } from "@/lib/otp";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { jsonError, sanitizeText } from "@/lib/utils";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const ip = clientIp(req);
  const rl = await rateLimit("register", ip);
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const parsed = registerSchema.safeParse(
      await req.json().catch(() => ({})),
    );

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid registration",
          fields: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors,
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const data = parsed.data;

    if (data.honeypot) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
    }

    const email = data.email;
    const phone = data.phone;

    const existing = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email },
      select: {
        id: true,
        active: true,
        phone: true,
      },
    });

    let userId: string;

    if (existing) {
      if (existing.active) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            ok: false,
            error: "An account with this email already exists.",
          },
          { status: 409 },
        );
      }

      const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(data.password, 12);

      const user = await prisma.user.update({
        where: { id: existing.id },
        data: {
          name: sanitizeText(data.name, 80),
          phone,
          passwordHash,
          whatsappOptIn: Boolean(data.whatsappOptIn),
          active: false,
        },
        select: { id: true },
      });

      userId = user.id;
    } else {
      const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(data.password, 12);

      const user = await prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          name: sanitizeText(data.name, 80),
          email,
          phone,
          passwordHash,
          role: "CUSTOMER",
          whatsappOptIn: Boolean(data.whatsappOptIn),
          marketingOptIn: true,
          active: false,
          cart: { create: {} },
          wishlist: { create: {} },
        },
        select: { id: true },
      });

      userId = user.id;
    }

    const send = await createAndSendOtp({
      purpose: OtpPurpose.REGISTER,
      phone,
      userId,
      ip,
      userAgent: req.headers.get("user-agent"),
      meta: { email },
    });

    if (!send.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: send.error,
          code: send.code,
          resendAfter: send.resendAfter,
        },
        { status: send.code === "OTP_COOLDOWN" ? 429 : 422 },
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      pendingVerification: true,
      message: "We sent a 6-digit OTP to your mobile number.",
      phoneMasked: send.phoneMasked,
      expiresAt: send.expiresAt,
      resendAfter: send.resendAfter,
      devCode: send.devCode,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Registration failed.");
  }
}
