// src/app/api/auth/register/verify/route.ts
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import { OtpPurpose } from "@prisma/client";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { createSession } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { notify } from "@/lib/notifications";
import { verifyOtp } from "@/lib/otp";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { jsonError, normalizeMobile } from "@/lib/utils";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const schema = z.object({
  email: z.string().trim().email("Enter a valid email").toLowerCase(),
  phone: z.string().trim().min(10, "Mobile number is required"),
  code: z.string().trim().regex(/^\d{6}$/, "Enter the 6-digit OTP"),
});

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const ip = clientIp(req);
  const rl = await rateLimit("otpVerify", ip);
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const parsed = schema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid verification request",
          fields: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors,
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const { email, phone, code } = parsed.data;

    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        email: true,
        phone: true,
        role: true,
        active: true,
      },
    });

    if (!user) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Invalid verification request." },
        { status: 401 },
      );
    }

    if (user.active) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Account is already verified. Please log in." },
        { status: 409 },
      );
    }

    const normalizedUserPhone = normalizeMobile(user.phone);
    const normalizedInputPhone = normalizeMobile(phone);

    if (!normalizedUserPhone || normalizedUserPhone !== normalizedInputPhone) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Mobile number does not match this account." },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const verified = await verifyOtp({
      purpose: OtpPurpose.REGISTER,
      phone: normalizedInputPhone,
      code,
      userId: user.id,
    });

    if (!verified.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: verified.error, code: verified.reason },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const activated = await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: {
        active: true,
        lastLoginAt: new Date(),
        failedLoginCount: 0,
        lockedUntil: null,
      },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        email: true,
        phone: true,
        role: true,
        whatsappOptIn: true,
      },
    });

    await createSession(activated);

    await notify({
      template: "WELCOME",
      userId: activated.id,
      email: activated.email,
      ctx: { name: activated.name.split(" ")[0] ?? "there" },
    }).catch((e) => console.error("[auth:welcome]", e));

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      user: activated,
      redirect: "/account",
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "OTP verification failed.");
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\auth\reset-password\route.ts

import crypto from "node:crypto";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { resetPasswordSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { jsonError } from "@/lib/utils";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function hashToken(token: string) {
  return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(token).digest("hex");
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const ip = clientIp(req);
  const rl = await rateLimit("reset", ip);
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const parsed = resetPasswordSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid reset request",
          fields: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors,
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const hashed = hashToken(parsed.data.token);

    const user = await prisma.user.findFirst({
      where: {
        resetTokenHash: hashed,
        resetTokenExp: { gt: new Date() },
        active: true,
      },
      select: { id: true },
    });

    if (!user) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "This reset link is invalid or has expired." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(parsed.data.password, 12);

    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: {
        passwordHash,
        resetTokenHash: null,
        resetTokenExp: null,
        failedLoginCount: 0,
        lockedUntil: null,
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Password reset failed.");
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\cart\route.ts
============================================================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { requireActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { jsonError } from "@/lib/utils";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const mergeSchema = z.object({
  merge: z
    .array(
      z.object({
        productId: z.string().min(1),
        quantity: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(10),
        savedForLater: z.coerce.boolean().optional(),
      }),
    )
    .max(20)
    .optional(),
});

const patchSchema = z.object({
  productId: z.string().min(1),
  quantity: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).max(10).optional(),
  delta: z.coerce.number().int().min(-9).max(9).optional(),
  savedForLater: z.coerce.boolean().optional(),
});

async function ensureCart(userId: string) {
  return prisma.cart.upsert({
    where: { userId },
    update: {},
    create: { userId },
  });
}

function shape(items: { productId: string; quantity: number; savedForLater: boolean }[]) {
  return items.map((i) => ({
    productId: i.productId,
    quantity: i.quantity,
    savedForLater: i.savedForLater,
  }));
}

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();
    const cart = await ensureCart(actor.id);

    const items = await prisma.cartItem.findMany({
      where: { cartId: cart.id },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, items: shape(items) });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e);
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();
    const parsed = mergeSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid cart merge payload." }, { status: 422 });
    }

    const cart = await ensureCart(actor.id);
    const merge = parsed.data.merge ?? [];

    for (const line of merge) {
      const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
        where: { id: line.productId },
        select: { id: true, active: true, stock: true },
      });

      if (!product || !product.active) continue;

      const quantity = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, line.quantity));

      await prisma.cartItem.upsert({
        where: {
          cartId_productId: {
            cartId: cart.id,
            productId: product.id,
          },
        },
        create: {
          cartId: cart.id,
          productId: product.id,
          quantity,
          savedForLater: line.savedForLater ?? false,
        },
        update: {
          quantity,
          savedForLater: line.savedForLater ?? false,
        },
      });
    }

    const items = await prisma.cartItem.findMany({
      where: { cartId: cart.id },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, items: shape(items) });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e);
  }
}

export async function PATCH(req: Request) {
  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();
    const parsed = patchSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid cart update." }, { status: 422 });
    }

    const cart = await ensureCart(actor.id);
    const { productId, quantity, delta, savedForLater } = parsed.data;

    const existing = await prisma.cartItem.findUnique({
      where: {
        cartId_productId: {
          cartId: cart.id,
          productId,
        },
      },
    });

    if (typeof quantity === "number") {
      if (quantity <= 0) {
        await prisma.cartItem.deleteMany({
          where: { cartId: cart.id, productId },
        });
      } else {
        const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
          where: { id: productId },
          select: { id: true, active: true },
        });

        if (!product || !product.active) {
          return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Product unavailable." }, { status: 409 });
        }

        await prisma.cartItem.upsert({
          where: {
            cartId_productId: {
              cartId: cart.id,
              productId,
            },
          },
          create: {
            cartId: cart.id,
            productId,
            quantity: Math.min(10, quantity),
            savedForLater: savedForLater ?? false,
          },
          update: {
            quantity: Math.min(10, quantity),
            ...(typeof savedForLater === "boolean" ? { savedForLater } : {}),
          },
        });
      }
    } else if (typeof delta === "number") {
      if (!existing) {
        if (delta <= 0) {
          return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, items: shape(await prisma.cartItem.findMany({ where: { cartId: cart.id } })) });
        }

        const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
          where: { id: productId },
          select: { id: true, active: true },
        });

        if (!product || !product.active) {
          return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Product unavailable." }, { status: 409 });
        }

        await prisma.cartItem.create({
          data: {
            cartId: cart.id,
            productId,
            quantity: Math.max(1, Math.min(10, delta)),
            savedForLater: savedForLater ?? false,
          },
        });
      } else {
        const nextQty = Math.max(0, Math.min(10, existing.quantity + delta));

        if (nextQty <= 0) {
          await prisma.cartItem.delete({ where: { id: existing.id } });
        } else {
          await prisma.cartItem.update({
            where: { id: existing.id },
            data: {
              quantity: nextQty,
              ...(typeof savedForLater === "boolean" ? { savedForLater } : {}),
            },
          });
        }
      }
    } else if (typeof savedForLater === "boolean" && existing) {
      await prisma.cartItem.update({
        where: { id: existing.id },
        data: { savedForLater },
      });
    }

    const items = await prisma.cartItem.findMany({
      where: { cartId: cart.id },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, items: shape(items) });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e);
  }
}

export async function DELETE() {
  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();
    const cart = await ensureCart(actor.id);

    await prisma.cartItem.deleteMany({ where: { cartId: cart.id } });

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, items: [] });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e);
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { contactSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { excerpt, jsonError, sanitizeText } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { notifyStaff } from "@/lib/notifications";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("form", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const parsed = contactSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid contact request",
          fields: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors,
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const data = parsed.data;

    if (data.honeypot) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
    }

    await prisma.contactMessage.create({
      data: {
        name: sanitizeText(data.name, 80),
        email: data.email,
        phone: data.phone ?? null,
        topic: data.topic,
        message: sanitizeText(data.message, 2000),
      },
    });

    await notifyStaff({
      template: "ADMIN_MESSAGE",
      ctx: {
        name: data.name,
        topic: data.topic,
        preview: excerpt(data.message, 120),
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Could not send message.");
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import { computeQuote } from "@/lib/quote";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { jsonError } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const schema = z.object({
  code: z.string().trim().min(3).max(24),
  items: z
    .array(
      z.object({
        productId: z.string().min(1),
        quantity: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(10),
      }),
    )
    .min(1)
    .max(50),
});

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("form", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const parsed = schema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Enter a valid coupon code." },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const actor = await getActor();
    const quote = await computeQuote({
      items: parsed.data.items,
      couponCode: parsed.data.code.toUpperCase(),
      userId: actor?.id ?? null,
    });

    if (!quote.coupon) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: quote.couponError ?? "Coupon is not valid for this cart.",
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      coupon: quote.coupon,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Coupon validation failed.");
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { inspectPincode } from "@/lib/delivery";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  let pincode: unknown;
  try {
    const body = (await req.json()) as { pincode?: unknown };
    pincode = body.pincode;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid request body." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (typeof pincode !== "string" || pincode.trim().length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "pincode is required." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const result = await inspectPincode(pincode); // <- now awaited
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, result });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { ok: false, error: "Could not check serviceability. Try again." },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\feed\cart-recommendations\route.ts
============================================================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { productSelect, toCards } from "@/lib/catalog";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/**
 * Hydrates the cart's bottom rails + the saved-for-later list. Two modes, both over
 * the REAL catalog: ?n&exclude -> random draw over EVERY active+in-stock product minus
 * excluded ids (whole-catalog dynamic, no gate/window, so a product you add later is
 * eligible next load); ?ids=a,b -> the CardVM for those ids (saved-for-later + the
 * view-history rails), dropping inactive ones. Returns CardVM[]; failures return [] so
 * a rail/list simply hides instead of crashing the cart.
 */
export async function GET(req: Request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
    const idsParam = searchParams.get("ids");

    if (idsParam) {
      const ids = idsParam.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 24);
      if (!ids.length) return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, products: [] });
      const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({ where: { id: { in: ids }, active: true }, select: productSelect });
      const byId = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r] as const));
      const ordered = ids.map((id) => byId.get(id)).filter((r): r is NonNullable<typeof r> => Boolean(r));
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, products: toCards(ordered) });
    }

    const n = Math.min(24, Math.max(1, Number(searchParams.get("n") ?? 12) || 12));
    const exclude = new Set((searchParams.get("exclude") ?? "").split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean));
    const cand = await prisma.product.findMany({ where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } }, select: { id: true } });
    const pool = cand.filter((c) => !exclude.has(c.id));
    if (!pool.length) return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, products: [] });
    const shuffled = [...pool];
    for (let i = shuffled.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      const a = shuffled[i]!; shuffled[i] = shuffled[j]!; shuffled[j] = a;
    }
    const picked = shuffled.slice(0, n).map((r) => r.id);
    const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({ where: { id: { in: picked } }, select: productSelect });
    const byId = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r] as const));
    const ordered = picked.map((id) => byId.get(id)).filter((r): r is NonNullable<typeof r> => Boolean(r));
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, products: toCards(ordered) });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, products: [] });
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\feed\order-recommendations\route.ts
============================================================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { discountPercent } from "@/lib/utils";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

type RecVM = {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  image: string;
  salePrice: number;
  mrp: number;
  discountPercent: number;
  ratingAvg: number;
  sold: number;
};

/**
 * "Products For You" pool for the order-details page. Mirrors /api/feed/random-ad's
 * dynamic guarantee: the candidate set is EVERY active, in-stock product (no featured/
 * discount gate, no bounded take() window), shuffled per request, so anything you add
 * later is eligible on the next load with no code change. `exclude` (csv of product ids)
 * keeps the just-purchased item out of its own recommendation rail.
 *
 * Scale note: loading the id set of the active catalog is cheap for realistic stores; if
 * it ever grows very large, switch to a random-skip / TABLESAMPLE pick instead.
 */
export async function GET(req: Request) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const n = Math.min(24, Math.max(1, Number(url.searchParams.get("n") ?? 10) || 10));
    const exclude = new Set(
      (url.searchParams.get("exclude") ?? "")
        .split(",")
        .map((s) => s.trim())
        .filter(Boolean),
    );

    const candidates = await prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } },
      select: { id: true },
    });

    const pool = candidates.filter((c) => !exclude.has(c.id));
    if (pool.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, products: [] as RecVM[] });

    // Fisher–Yates over the id list, then take n (same pattern the account page uses).
    const shuffled = [...pool];
    for (let i = shuffled.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      const a = shuffled[i]!;
      shuffled[i] = shuffled[j]!;
      shuffled[j] = a;
    }
    const pickedIds = shuffled.slice(0, n).map((r) => r.id);

    const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { id: { in: pickedIds } },
      select: {
        id: true,
        slug: true,
        name: true,
        salePrice: true,
        mrp: true,
        discountPercent: true,
        ratingAvg: true,
        sold: true,
        images: {
          select: { url: true, isPrimary: true, position: true },
          orderBy: { position: "asc" as const },
        },
      },
    });

    const byId = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r] as const));
    const products: RecVM[] = pickedIds
      .map((id) => byId.get(id))
      .filter((r): r is NonNullable<typeof r> => Boolean(r))
      .map((r) => {
        const salePrice = Number(r.salePrice ?? 0);
        const mrp = Number(r.mrp ?? salePrice);
        return {
          id: r.id,
          slug: r.slug,
          name: r.name,
          image: r.images.find((i) => i.isPrimary)?.url ?? r.images[0]?.url ?? "",
          salePrice,
          mrp,
          discountPercent: r.discountPercent || discountPercent(mrp, salePrice),
          ratingAvg: Number(r.ratingAvg ?? 0),
          sold: Number(r.sold ?? 0),
        };
      });

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, products });
  } catch {
    // A failed recommendation fetch must never break the order page: hand back an
    // empty list so the rail simply hides (the client returns null on empty).
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, products: [] as RecVM[] });
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\feed\random-ad\route.ts
============================================================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { productSelect, toCards } from "@/lib/catalog";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    // Pool = EVERY active, in-stock product. No featured/discount gate and no
    // bounded take() window: both of those made the slot effectively static — a
    // product added later (or one outside the first 50 heap rows) could never be
    // drawn. Sampling the full id set keeps the pick uniform, so anything you
    // publish tomorrow is eligible on the very next refresh with no code change.
    // (Scale note: id-only projection over the active set is cheap for realistic
    // catalogs; if it ever grows very large, switch to a random-skip or
    // TABLESAMPLE pick instead of loading every id.)
    const candidates = await prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } },
      select: { id: true },
    });

    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "No ads available" }, { status: 404 });
    }

    // Narrow the indexed element BEFORE reading .id (satisfies noUncheckedIndexedAccess).
    const picked = candidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidates.length)];
    if (!picked) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "No ads available" }, { status: 404 });
    }

    const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
      where: { id: picked.id },
      select: productSelect,
    });

    if (!product) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Ad lookup failed" }, { status: 404 });
    }

    // toCards returns an array; index [0] is also possibly-undefined under strict
    // mode, so pull it into a variable and guard it instead of returning
    // toCards([product])[0] inline.
    const [vm] = toCards([product]);
    if (!vm) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Ad mapping failed" }, { status: 500 });
    }

    // Brand for the featured card bottom-right stamp. Fetched with one extra
    // indexed lookup instead of widening the shared productSelect/CardVM in
    // lib/catalog.ts (consumed by the rails, hero and feed too) - keeps this a
    // route-local change and lights the stamp without a shared-contract edit.
    const brandRow = await prisma.product.findUnique({
      where: { id: picked.id },
      select: { brand: { select: { name: true } } },
    });
    const brandName = brandRow?.brand?.name ?? null;

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, product: { ...vm, brand: brandName } });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Random ad generation failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { productSelect, toCards } from "@/lib/catalog";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const page = parseInt(url.searchParams.get("page") || "1");
    const limit = Math.min(parseInt(url.searchParams.get("limit") || "12"), 24); // Cap at 24

    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

    const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } },
      select: productSelect,
      orderBy: [{ ratingAvg: "desc" }, { sold: "desc" }],

      take: limit,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      items: toCards(products),
      page,
      hasMore: products.length === limit,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Feed failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\feed\upsell\route.ts
============================================================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { productSelect, toCards } from "@/lib/catalog";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/**
 * Upsell candidates for the buy-now interstitial, drawn by a relevance fallback chain:
 *   tier 0  copurchase  REAL co-occurrence in non-cancelled Urban Vogue orders (the only
 *                       tier that earns the literal "Frequently bought together" title)
 *   tier 1  category    in-stock products sharing the seed's category
 *   tier 2  brand       in-stock products sharing the seed's brand
 *   tier 3  global      in-stock products from the whole catalog
 * All tiers are per-request randomized (no fixed window, so a product you add later is
 * eligible next load) and always exclude the seed. Co-purchase uses ONLY the Prisma
 * client (relation filter + groupBy, sorted in JS) — no $queryRaw, no table-name
 * guessing — so a custom @@map can't silently defeat it. Every tier that yields nothing
 * falls through; total failure returns [] so the sheet auto-skips. `scope`/`groupName`
 * let the client title the sheet HONESTLY for whichever tier actually fired.
 */
export async function GET(req: Request) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
    const id = (searchParams.get("id") ?? "").trim();
    const n = Math.min(8, Math.max(1, Number(searchParams.get("n") ?? 4) || 4));
    if (!id) return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, products: [], scope: "none" });

    const seed = await prisma.product.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      select: {
        id: true,
        categoryId: true,
        brandId: true,
        category: { select: { name: true } },
        brand: { select: { name: true } },
      },
    });
    if (!seed) return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, products: [], scope: "none" });

    // ---- tier 0: REAL co-purchase from non-cancelled orders ---------------------
    // Capped to the 300 most recent seed-containing orders to bound the IN-list;
    // frequency ranked client-side so we never depend on groupBy orderBy syntax.
    try {
      const seedOrders = await prisma.orderItem.findMany({
        where: { productId: id, order: { status: { not: "CANCELLED" } } },
        select: { orderId: true },
        orderBy: { order: { createdAt: "desc" } },
        take: 300,
      });
      const orderIds = Array.from(new Set(seedOrders.map((o) => o.orderId)));
      if (orderIds.length) {
        const groups = await prisma.orderItem.groupBy({
          by: ["productId"],
          where: { orderId: { in: orderIds }, productId: { not: id } },
          _count: { _all: true },
        });
        const coIds = groups
          .filter((g) => g.productId && g.productId !== id)
          .sort((a, b) => (b._count._all ?? 0) - (a._count._all ?? 0))
          .slice(0, n)
          .map((g) => g.productId);
        if (coIds.length) {
          const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({
            where: { id: { in: coIds }, active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } },
            select: productSelect,
          });
          const byId = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r] as const));
          const ordered = coIds.map((cid) => byId.get(cid)).filter((r): r is NonNullable<typeof r> => Boolean(r));
          if (ordered.length) {
            return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, products: toCards(ordered), scope: "copurchase", groupName: null });
          }
        }
      }
    } catch {
      /* co-purchase unavailable (no data / query error) -> fall through honestly */
    }

    // ---- fallback tiers: category -> brand -> global (unchanged from prior turn) --
    const picked: string[] = [];
    const seen = new Set<string>([id]);
    const take = (rows: { id: string }[], cap: number) => {
      for (const r of rows) { if (picked.length >= cap) break; if (seen.has(r.id)) continue; seen.add(r.id); picked.push(r.id); }
    };

    let scope: "category" | "brand" | "global" | "none" = "none";
    let groupName: string | null = null;

    if (seed.categoryId) {
      try {
        const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({
          where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 }, categoryId: seed.categoryId, id: { not: id } },
          select: { id: true },
        });
        for (let i = rows.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1)); const a = rows[i]!; rows[i] = rows[j]!; rows[j] = a; }
        take(rows, n);
        if (picked.length) { scope = "category"; groupName = seed.category?.name ?? null; }
      } catch { /* fall through to brand */ }
    }
    if (picked.length < n && seed.brandId) {
      try {
        const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({
          where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 }, brandId: seed.brandId, id: { notIn: picked.concat(id) } },
          select: { id: true },
        });
        for (let i = rows.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1)); const a = rows[i]!; rows[i] = rows[j]!; rows[j] = a; }
        take(rows, n);
        if (scope === "none" && picked.length) { scope = "brand"; groupName = seed.brand?.name ?? null; }
      } catch { /* fall through to global */ }
    }
    if (picked.length < n) {
      try {
        const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({
          where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 }, id: { notIn: picked.concat(id) } },
          select: { id: true },
        });
        for (let i = rows.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1)); const a = rows[i]!; rows[i] = rows[j]!; rows[j] = a; }
        take(rows, n);
        if (scope === "none" && picked.length) scope = "global";
      } catch { /* leave as-is */ }
    }

    if (!picked.length) return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, products: [], scope: "none" });
    const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({ where: { id: { in: picked } }, select: productSelect });
    const byId = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r] as const));
    const ordered = picked.map((pid) => byId.get(pid)).filter((r): r is NonNullable<typeof r> => Boolean(r));
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, products: toCards(ordered), scope, groupName });
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, products: [], scope: "none" });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";  
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(
  _: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ orderNumber: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const me = await getActor(); // Adjust based on your auth provider
    
    if (!me?.email) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Unauthorized." }, { status: 401 });
    }
    
    const { orderNumber } = await params;
    
    const order = await prisma.order.findFirst({
      where: {
        orderNumber,
        OR: [
  { userId: me.id },
  { guestEmail: me.email },
],
      },
      include: {
        items: { select: { name: true, quantity: true, unitPrice: true } },
      },
    });
    
    if (!order) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Order not found or doesn't belong to you." }, { status: 404 });
    }
    
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, order });
    
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("My-order lookup failed:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Server error." }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\nav\route.ts
============================================================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { MEN_GROUPS } from "@/lib/men-taxonomy";

// Force a fresh execution per request so the random pick below is re-rolled on
// every fetch (a cached/static GET would freeze one image forever).
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/** Decode the `q` term from a `...?q=<term>` href ("" if not a q-link). */
const termOf = (href: string): string => {
  const i = href.indexOf("q=");
  return i === -1 ? "" : decodeURIComponent(href.slice(i + 2));
};

/** Random element of a non-empty array, else null. Re-rolled each request. */
const pick = <T,>(arr: T[]): T | null =>
  arr.length ? arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)] ?? null : null;

/**
 * Serves the static MEN taxonomy with live, ROTATING catalog thumbnails.
 *  - group.image = a RANDOM matching active product that has ANY image (primary-
 *    first), ignoring `kind`, so a product whose photo was uploaded as a Showcase
 *    banner (kind != GALLERY) still lights the tile — this is what fixes Men's
 *    Grooming, whose images aren't tagged GALLERY.
 *  - item.image  = a RANDOM product matching the item's search term (preferring a
 *    GALLERY image, then any image), falling back to the group image so no tile is
 *    ever blank.
 * Because the pick is random per request, the rail + dropdown thumbnails change on
 * every page refresh / route navigation / login-redirect (the client re-fetches).
 */
export async function GET() {
  const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: { active: true },
    select: {
      name: true,
      subtype: true,
      // No hard kind gate; primary first so images[0] is the best available shot.
      images: {
        orderBy: [{ isPrimary: "desc" }, { position: "asc" }],
        take: 5,
        select: { url: true, kind: true, isPrimary: true },
      },
    },
  });

  const hay = (r: { name: string; subtype: string | null }) =>
    `${r.name} ${r.subtype ?? ""}`.toLowerCase();
  const anyImage = (r: { images: { url: string; kind?: string | null }[] }) =>
    r.images[0]?.url ?? null;
  const galleryImage = (r: { images: { url: string; kind?: string | null }[] }) =>
    r.images.find((i) => (i.kind ?? "GALLERY") === "GALLERY")?.url ?? null;

  const groups = MEN_GROUPS.map((g) => {
    const re = g.matcher ? new RegExp(g.matcher, "i") : null;
    const matched = re
      ? rows.filter((r) => re.test(hay(r)))
      : rows.filter((r) =>
          g.items.some((it) => {
            const t = termOf(it.href).toLowerCase();
            return t && hay(r).includes(t);
          }),
        );

    // Rail tile: random imaged product in the group (any kind).
    const imaged = matched.filter((r) => anyImage(r));
    const chosen = pick(imaged);
    const image = chosen ? anyImage(chosen) : null;

    const items = g.items.map((it) => {
      const term = termOf(it.href).toLowerCase() || null;
      const cand = term
        ? (matched.filter((r) => hay(r).includes(term)))
        : [];
      const cand2 = cand.length
        ? cand
        : term
          ? rows.filter((r) => hay(r).includes(term))
          : [];
      const imagedCand = cand2.filter((r) => anyImage(r));
      const hit = pick(imagedCand);
      // Prefer a clean GALLERY shot for the term, else any image, else the group image.
      const itemImage = (hit ? (galleryImage(hit) ?? anyImage(hit)) : null) ?? image;
      return { label: it.label, href: it.href, image: itemImage };
    });

    return {
      slug: g.slug,
      label: g.label,
      subtitle: g.subtitle,
      icon: g.icon,
      viewAll: g.viewAll,
      image,
      items,
    };
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ groups });
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { newsletterSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { jsonError, normalizeMobile } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("form", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const parsed = newsletterSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid subscription",
          fields: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors,
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const data = parsed.data;

    if (data.honeypot) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
    }

    const phone = normalizeMobile(data.phone ?? undefined);

    await prisma.subscriber.upsert({
      where: { email: data.email },
      update: {
        phone,
        whatsappOptIn: Boolean(data.whatsappOptIn),
        active: true,
      },
      create: {
        email: data.email,
        phone,
        whatsappOptIn: Boolean(data.whatsappOptIn),
        source: "FOOTER",
        active: true,
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Subscription failed.");
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\orders\route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import type { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { orderCreateSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { computeQuote } from "@/lib/quote";
import { createOrderTx } from "@/lib/orders";
import { jsonError, sanitizeText } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

async function snapshotAddress(
  userId: string | null,
  addressId?: string,
  address?: Record<string, unknown>,
): Promise<Prisma.JsonObject | null> {
  if (addressId && userId) {
    const a = await prisma.address.findFirst({
      where: { id: addressId, userId },
    });

    if (a) {
      const { id: _id, userId: _u, createdAt: _c, ...rest } = a;
      return rest as Prisma.JsonObject;
    }
  }

  if (address) {
    const { id: _id, userId: _u, createdAt: _c, ...rest } = address;
    return rest as Prisma.JsonObject;
  }

  return null;
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("order", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const parsed = orderCreateSchema.safeParse(
      await req.json().catch(() => ({})),
    );

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid order request",
          fields: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors,
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const body = parsed.data;
    const actor = await getActor();

    const guestEmail = body.guestEmail?.trim() || null;
    const guestPhone = body.guestPhone?.trim() || null;

    if (!actor && !guestEmail && !guestPhone) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Guest orders require an email or mobile number." },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    if (body.paymentMethod && body.paymentMethod !== "COD") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error:
            "Online payments must start from /api/razorpay/order. This endpoint is for COD.",
        },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const quote = await computeQuote({
      items: body.items,
      couponCode: body.couponCode,
      deliveryMode: body.deliveryMode,
      paymentMethod: "COD",
      userId: actor?.id ?? null,
      pincode: body.pincode,
    });

    if (quote.stockIssues.length > 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          code: "STOCK_CONFLICT",
          error: "Stock changed while placing your order.",
          conflicts: quote.stockIssues,
        },
        { status: 409 },
      );
    }

    const addressSnapshot = await snapshotAddress(
      actor?.id ?? null,
      body.addressId,
      body.address as Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
    );

    if (!addressSnapshot || typeof addressSnapshot.line1 !== "string") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "A valid delivery address is required." },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const order = await createOrderTx({
      userId: actor?.id ?? null,
      guestEmail: actor ? null : guestEmail,
      guestPhone: actor ? null : guestPhone,
      addressSnapshot,
      quote,
      paymentMethod: "COD",
      payment: null,
      ip: clientIp(req),
      note: body.note ? sanitizeText(body.note, 300) : null,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      order: {
        orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
        status: order.status,
        total: order.total,
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Could not place COD order.");
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\orders\[orderNumber]\cancel\route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { requireActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { advanceStatus } from "@/lib/orders";
import { jsonError, sanitizeText } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const schema = z.object({
  reason: z.string().trim().max(300).optional().or(z.literal("")),
});

export async function POST(
  req: Request,
  ctx: { params: Promise<{ orderNumber: string }> },
) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("order", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();
    const { orderNumber } = await ctx.params;

    const parsed = schema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid cancellation." }, { status: 422 });
    }

    const order = await prisma.order.findUnique({
      where: { orderNumber },
      select: { id: true, userId: true, status: true },
    });

    if (!order) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Order not found." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    const isOwner = actor.id === order.userId;
    const isStaff = ["ADMIN", "MANAGER", "STAFF"].includes(actor.role);

    if (!isOwner && !isStaff) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Not allowed." }, { status: 403 });
    }

    if (!["PENDING", "CONFIRMED"].includes(order.status)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "This order can no longer be cancelled online." },
        { status: 409 },
      );
    }

    const updated = await advanceStatus({
      orderId: order.id,
      status: "CANCELLED",
      actorId: actor.id,
      note: parsed.data.reason ? sanitizeText(parsed.data.reason, 300) : "Customer requested cancellation",
      location: "Urban Vogue",
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      order: {
        orderNumber: updated.orderNumber,
        status: updated.status,
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Could not cancel order.");
  }
}

import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// Seller identity. LEFT BLANK ON PURPOSE except the name: we never print a fabricated
// GSTIN / registered address on a financial document. Drop your real details here once
// and every invoice picks them up.
const SELLER = {
  name: "Urban Vogue",
  tagline: "India's premier destination for fashion",
  gstin: "",            // e.g. "27ABCDE1234F1Z5"
  addressLines: [] as string[], // e.g. ["42, MG Road", "Pune, MH 411001"],
  phone: "",            // support number printed in the footer
  email: "",            // billing/support email printed in the footer
};

// Escape every interpolated value: product names and the checkout address are
// arbitrary user/merchant text, and this document is hand-built HTML.
const esc = (s: unknown): string =>
  String(s ?? "")
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");

const money = (n: unknown): string => `₹${Math.round(Number(n ?? 0)).toLocaleString("en-IN")}`;

const fmtDate = (d: Date | string | null | undefined): string =>
  d ? new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric" }) : "—";

const fmtDateTime = (d: Date | string | null | undefined): string =>
  d ? new Date(d).toLocaleString("en-IN", { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" }) : "—";

const methodLabel = (m: string | null): string =>
  m === "COD" ? "Cash On Delivery"
  : m === "CARD" ? "Card"
  : m === "UPI" ? "UPI"
  : m === "NETBANKING" ? "Net Banking"
  : m === "WALLET" ? "Wallet"
  : (m ?? "—");

type AddressSnap = {
  name?: string; line1?: string; line2?: string;
  city?: string; state?: string; pincode?: string; phone?: string;
};

function shell(title: string, body: string): string {

<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
<title>${esc(title)}</title>
<style>

export async function GET(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ orderNumber: string }> }) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const asDownload = searchParams.get("download") === "1";

  const me = await getActor();
  if (!me?.email) {
    return new Response(
      shell("Invoice unavailable", `<div class="err"><p>This invoice requires sign‑in.</p>
        <p><a href="/auth/login?next=/account/orders">Sign in</a> or <a href="/account/orders">back to orders</a>.</p></div>`),
      { status: 401, headers: { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" } },
    );
  }

  const { orderNumber } = await ctx.params;
  const num = decodeURIComponent(orderNumber);

  const order = await prisma.order.findFirst({
    where: { orderNumber: num, OR: [{ userId: me.id }, { guestEmail: me.email }] },
    include: {
      items: {
        select: {
          name: true, brand: true, image: true, unitMrp: true, unitPrice: true,
          quantity: true, lineTotal: true, warrantyMonths: true,
        },
        orderBy: { id: "asc" },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!order) {
    return new Response(
      shell("Invoice not found", `<div class="err"><p>We couldn't find order <b>${esc(num)}</b> on this account.</p>
        <p><a href="/account/orders">Back to your orders</a></p></div>`),
      { status: 404, headers: { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" } },
    );
  }

  // addressSnapshot is read defensively (not in the confirmed scalar set), exactly like
  // the order-details page; the money/payment fields below ARE typed Order columns.
  const addr = (order as unknown as { addressSnapshot?: AddressSnap | null }).addressSnapshot ?? null;
  const buyerLines = [
    addr?.line1, addr?.line2,
    [addr?.city, addr?.state].filter(Boolean).join(", "),
    addr?.pincode,
  ].filter(Boolean).join("\n");
  const buyerPhone = addr?.phone ?? order.guestPhone ?? "";
  const buyerEmail = order.guestEmail ?? me.email ?? "";

  const rows = order.items.map((it, i) => {
    const mrp = Number(it.unitMrp);
    const price = Number(it.unitPrice);
    const discounted = mrp > price;
    return `<tr>
      <td class="num">${i + 1}</td>
      <td class="desc"><b>${esc(it.brand ? `${it.brand} ${it.name}` : it.name)}</b>
        // <small>Warranty: ${esc(it.warrantyMonths)} months</small></td>
      <td class="num">${discounted ? `<span class="strike">${money(mrp)}</span>` : "—"}</td>
      <td class="num">${money(price)}</td>
      <td class="num">${esc(it.quantity)}</td>
      <td class="num">${money(it.lineTotal)}</td>
    </tr>`;
  }).join("");

  // Totals list each STORED component with its own sign and end on the stored `total`
  // (the amount actually charged). We do not assert that the rows sum to the total —
  // the reconciliation isn't documented, and inventing a formula on an invoice is worse
  // than presenting the recorded figures.
  const totalRows: string[] = [
    `<tr><td>Listing price (MRP)</td><td class="num">${money(order.subtotalMrp)}</td></tr>`,
  ];
  if (order.itemDiscount > 0)
    totalRows.push(`<tr><td>Discount on items</td><td class="num">-${money(order.itemDiscount)}</td></tr>`);
  if (order.couponDiscount > 0)
    totalRows.push(`<tr><td>Coupon${order.couponCode ? ` (${esc(order.couponCode)})` : ""}</td><td class="num">-${money(order.couponDiscount)}</td></tr>`);
  totalRows.push(`<tr><td>Net taxable value</td><td class="num">${money(order.subtotal)}</td></tr>`);
  totalRows.push(`<tr><td>Delivery fee</td><td class="num">${money(order.deliveryFee)}</td></tr>`);
  if (order.codFee > 0)
    totalRows.push(`<tr><td>COD handling fee</td><td class="num">${money(order.codFee)}</td></tr>`);
  totalRows.push(`<tr><td>GST (incl., ${esc(order.gstRate)}%)</td><td class="num">${money(order.gstComponent)}</td></tr>`);
  totalRows.push(`<tr class="grand"><td>Total amount payable</td><td class="num">${money(order.total)}</td></tr>`);

  const sellerAddr = SELLER.addressLines.filter(Boolean).join("\n");
  const body = `
  <div class="bar">
    <button type="button" onclick="window.print()">🖨 Print / Save as PDF</button>
    <a class="ghost" href="?download=1">⬇ Download file</a>
    <a class="ghost" href="/account/orders/${encodeURIComponent(num)}">← Order details</a>
  </div>
  <div class="sheet">
    <div class="head">
      <div>
        <div class="logo">Volt<span>Kart</span></div>
        <div class="tag">${esc(SELLER.tagline)}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="inv">
        <h1>Tax Invoice</h1>
        <div class="no">#${esc(order.orderNumber)}</div>
        <div class="dt">Placed on ${esc(fmtDateTime(order.createdAt))}</div>
        <div class="dt">Status: ${esc(order.status.replace(/_/g, " "))}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="parties">
      <div>
        <div class="lbl">Billed &amp; shipped to</div>
        <div class="who">${esc(addr?.name ?? buyerEmail)}</div>
        <div class="addr">${esc(buyerLines || "Address on file")}</div>
        ${buyerPhone ? `<div class="addr">${esc(buyerPhone)}</div>` : ""}
        ${buyerEmail ? `<div class="addr">${esc(buyerEmail)}</div>` : ""}
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="lbl">Seller</div>
        <div class="who">${esc(SELLER.name)}</div>
        ${sellerAddr ? `<div class="addr">${esc(sellerAddr)}</div>` : ""}
        ${SELLER.gstin ? `<div class="addr">GSTIN: ${esc(SELLER.gstin)}</div>` : ""}
        <div class="addr">Payment: ${esc(methodLabel(order.paymentMethod))} · ${esc(order.paymentStatus)}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <table>
      <thead><tr>
        <th class="num">#</th><th>Description</th><th class="num">MRP</th>
        <th class="num">Unit price</th><th class="num">Qty</th><th class="num">Line total</th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="totals"><table><tbody>${totalRows.join("")}</tbody></table></div>

    <p class="note">Amounts and tax/fee components as recorded at checkout. The total reflects the
      amount charged to the customer. This is a computer‑generated invoice and does not require a signature.</p>

    <div class="foot">
      <span>${SELLER.phone ? `Support: ${esc(SELLER.phone)} · ` : ""}${SELLER.email ? esc(SELLER.email) : esc(SELLER.name)}</span>
      <span>Thank you for shopping with ${esc(SELLER.name)}.</span>
    </div>
  </div>`;

  const headers: Record<string, string> = { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" };
  if (asDownload) {
    const safe = order.orderNumber.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, "");
    headers["content-disposition"] = `attachment; filename="invoice-${safe || "order"}.html"`;
  }
  return new Response(shell(`Invoice ${order.orderNumber}`, body), { status: 200, headers });
}

FILE: src\app\api\products\[id]\questions\route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const schema = z.object({ body: z.string().trim().min(1).max(1000) });

export async function POST(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const actor = await getActor();
  if (!actor) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Sign in to ask a question." }, { status: 401 });
  const { id: productId } = await ctx.params;

  const parsed = schema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => null));
  if (!parsed.success) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Please type your question." }, { status: 400 });

  const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({ where: { id: productId }, select: { id: true } });
  if (!product) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });

  try {
    const row = await prisma.question.create({
      data: { productId, userId: actor.id, body: parsed.data.body },
      include: { user: { select: { name: true } } },
    });
    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      question: {
        id: row.id,
        body: row.body,
        askedAt: row.createdAt ? new Date(row.createdAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
        asker: row.user?.name ?? "Customer",
        answers: [],
      },
    });
  } catch (e: any) {
    // The ONE honest unknown: I have runtime proof of Review's shape (the seed), but the seed
    // never wrote a Question, so I can't be 100% sure Question keys its author via a userId
    // relation vs a stored column, or whether it has another required field. Rather than guess
    // silently, Prisma's exact message is returned to the form so ONE submit tells us what to
    // add/change. (On production, swap this for a generic message — it leaks a column name.)
    console.error("question create failed", e);
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: e?.message ? `Question endpoint: ${e.message}` : "Could not post your question." }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\products\[id]\reviews\route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const schema = z.object({
  rating: z.number().int().min(1).max(5),
  title: z.string().trim().max(120).optional(),
  body: z.string().trim().min(1).max(2000),
  // Customer photos for THIS review. Mirrors reviewSchema.images (validators.ts:155):
  // up to 5 URLs, each <=1000 chars. The route's z.object is non-strict, so before this
  // line an incoming `images` key was silently STRIPPED (not a 422) and never persisted.
  images: z.array(z.string().trim().max(1000)).max(5).optional(),
});

export async function POST(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const actor = await getActor();
  if (!actor) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Sign in to leave a review." }, { status: 401 });
  const { id: productId } = await ctx.params;

  const parsed = schema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => null));
  if (!parsed.success) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Please add a rating and some text." }, { status: 400 });

  const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({ where: { id: productId }, select: { id: true } });
  if (!product) return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });

  try {
    // productId/userId/rating/body required; title nullable. `images` is a real column
    // (String[] @default([])), so passing it is safe — the old "unknown key would throw"
    // note was wrong for images (it IS known). verified/helpfulCount still use defaults.
    const row = await prisma.review.create({
      data: {
        productId,
        userId: actor.id,
        rating: parsed.data.rating,
        title: parsed.data.title || null,
        body: parsed.data.body,
        images: parsed.data.images ?? [],
      },
      include: { user: { select: { name: true } } },
    });
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, review: toVM(row) });
  } catch (e: any) {
    if (e?.code === "P2002") return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "You've already reviewed this product." }, { status: 409 });
    console.error("review create failed", e);
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Could not save your review. Try again." }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

function toVM(r: any) {
  return {
    id: r.id,
    rating: r.rating,
    title: r.title ?? null,
    body: r.body,
    images: Array.isArray(r.images) ? r.images : [],
    author: r.user?.name ?? "Verified Buyer",
    // Honour the column if it exists; a signed-in post counts as verified.
    verified: typeof r.verified === "boolean" ? r.verified : true,
    at: r.createdAt ? new Date(r.createdAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
    helpful: r.helpfulCount ?? 0,
  };
}

FILE: src\app\api\razorpay\order\route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import type { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { orderCreateSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { computeQuote } from "@/lib/quote";
import {
  createRazorpayOrder,
  publicKeyId,
  razorpayConfigured,
} from "@/lib/razorpay";
import { jsonError, sanitizeText } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function intentOrderNumber(): string {
  return `UVINT${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase().slice(-8)}${Math.random()
    .toString(36)
    .slice(2, 6)
    .toUpperCase()}`;
}

async function snapshotAddress(
  userId: string | null,
  addressId?: string,
  address?: Record<string, unknown>,
): Promise<Prisma.JsonObject> {
  if (addressId && userId) {
    const a = await prisma.address.findFirst({
      where: { id: addressId, userId },
    });
    if (a) {
      const { id: _id, userId: _u, createdAt: _c, ...rest } = a;
      return rest as Prisma.JsonObject;
    }
  }

  if (address) {
    const { id: _id, userId: _u, createdAt: _c, ...rest } = address;
    return rest as Prisma.JsonObject;
  }

  return { note: "address provided at confirmation" } as Prisma.JsonObject;
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("order", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    if (!razorpayConfigured) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error:
            "Online payments are not configured. Please use Cash on Delivery or contact support.",
        },
        { status: 503 },
      );
    }

    const parsed = orderCreateSchema.safeParse(
      await req.json().catch(() => ({})),
    );
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid checkout request",
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const body = parsed.data;

    if (body.paymentMethod === "COD") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "COD does not require a payment gateway order." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const actor = await getActor();

    const quote = await computeQuote({
      items: body.items,
      couponCode: body.couponCode,
      deliveryMode: body.deliveryMode,
      paymentMethod: body.paymentMethod,
      userId: actor?.id ?? null,
      pincode: body.pincode,
    });

    if (quote.stockIssues.length > 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          code: "STOCK_CONFLICT",
          error: "Stock changed while starting payment.",
          conflicts: quote.stockIssues,
        },
        { status: 409 },
      );
    }

    if (quote.total <= 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Order total is invalid." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const addressSnapshot = await snapshotAddress(
      actor?.id ?? null,
      body.addressId,
      body.address as Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
    );

    const intent = await prisma.order.create({
      data: {
        orderNumber: intentOrderNumber(),
        userId: actor?.id ?? null,
        guestEmail: actor ? null : body.guestEmail || null,
        guestPhone: actor ? null : body.guestPhone || null,
        status: "PENDING",
        paymentMethod: body.paymentMethod ?? "UPI",
        paymentStatus: "PENDING",
        subtotalMrp: quote.subtotalMrp,
        subtotal: quote.subtotal,
        itemDiscount: quote.itemDiscount,
        couponDiscount: quote.coupon?.discount ?? 0,
        couponCode: quote.coupon?.code ?? null,
        deliveryFee: quote.deliveryFee,
        codFee: 0,
        total: quote.total,
        gstRate: 18,
        gstComponent: quote.gstComponent,
        deliveryMode: quote.deliveryMode,
        etaFrom: quote.etaFrom,
        etaTo: quote.etaTo,
        addressSnapshot,
        ip: clientIp(req),
        note: body.note ? sanitizeText(body.note, 300) : null,
        items: {
          create: quote.lines.map((l) => ({
            productId: l.productId,
            name: l.name,
            slug: l.slug,
            brand: l.brand,
            image: l.image,
            unitMrp: l.mrp,
            unitPrice: l.salePrice,
            quantity: l.quantity,
            lineTotal: l.lineTotal,
            warrantyMonths: 12,
          })),
        },
      },
    });

    try {
      const rzpOrder = await createRazorpayOrder({
        amountPaise: quote.total * 100,
        receipt: intent.orderNumber,
        notes: {
          intentId: intent.id,
          itemCount: String(quote.itemCount),
        },
      });

      await prisma.payment.create({
        data: {
          orderId: intent.id,
          method: body.paymentMethod ?? "UPI",
          status: "PENDING",
          amountPaise: quote.total * 100,
          gateway: "RAZORPAY",
          razorpayOrderId: rzpOrder.id,
        },
      });

      return NextResponse.json({
        ok: true,
        intentId: intent.id,
        rzp: {
          key: publicKeyId(),
          order_id: rzpOrder.id,
          amount: quote.total * 100,
          currency: "INR",
          name: "Urban Vogue",
          description: `${quote.itemCount} item(s) · ${intent.orderNumber}`,
          timeout: 300,
          notes: {
            intentId: intent.id,
          },
          prefill: {
            name: actor?.name ?? "",
            email: actor?.email ?? body.guestEmail ?? "",
            contact: actor?.phone ?? body.guestPhone ?? "",
          },
          theme: {
            color: "#c9a96e",
          },
        },
      });
    } catch (e) {
      await prisma.order.delete({ where: { id: intent.id } }).catch(() => undefined);
      throw e;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Could not start payment.");
  }
}

FILE: src\app\api\razorpay\status\route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const id = new URL(req.url).searchParams.get("rzpOrderId");
  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, status: "UNKNOWN" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const payment = await prisma.payment.findUnique({
    where: { razorpayOrderId: id },
    include: {
      order: {
        select: {
          orderNumber: true,
          status: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!payment) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, status: "UNKNOWN" });
  }

  if (payment.status === "FAILED") {
    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: false,
      status: "FAILED",
      error: payment.failureReason ?? "Payment failed.",
    });
  }

  const isConverted =
    payment.order &&
    !payment.order.orderNumber.startsWith("UVINT") &&
    payment.order.status !== "PENDING";

  if (payment.status === "PAID" && isConverted) {
    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      status: "PAID",
      orderNumber: payment.order.orderNumber,
    });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, status: payment.status });
}

FILE: src\app\api\razorpay\verify\route.ts
============================================================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { AppError, jsonError, orderNumber as makeOrderNumber } from "@/lib/utils";
import {
  createRefund,
  razorpayConfigured,
  verifyPaymentSignature,
} from "@/lib/razorpay";
import { notify, notifyStaff } from "@/lib/notifications";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const schema = z.object({
  razorpay_order_id: z.string().min(10),
  razorpay_payment_id: z.string().min(10),
  razorpay_signature: z.string().min(10),
});

async function refundCapturedPayment(opts: {
  paymentId: string;
  amountPaise: number;
  reason: string;
  orderNumber?: string;
}) {
  if (!razorpayConfigured) return null;

  try {
    const refund = await createRefund({
      paymentId: opts.paymentId,
      amountPaise: opts.amountPaise,
      note: opts.reason,
      speed: "optimum",
    });

    await notifyStaff({
      template: "ADMIN_PAYMENT",
      ctx: {
        orderNumber: opts.orderNumber ?? opts.paymentId,
        total: `₹${(opts.amountPaise / 100).toLocaleString("en-IN")}`,
        method: "AUTO_REFUND",
        paymentId: refund.id,
      },
    });

    return refund;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("[razorpay:verify:refund]", e);

    await notifyStaff({
      template: "ADMIN_PAYMENT",
      ctx: {
        orderNumber: opts.orderNumber ?? opts.paymentId,
        total: `₹${(opts.amountPaise / 100).toLocaleString("en-IN")}`,
        method: "REFUND_FAILED",
        paymentId: opts.paymentId,
      },
    });

    return null;
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const parsed = schema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Invalid payment verification payload." },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const {
      razorpay_order_id,
      razorpay_payment_id,
      razorpay_signature,
    } = parsed.data;

    const valid = verifyPaymentSignature({
      razorpay_order_id,
      razorpay_payment_id,
      razorpay_signature,
    });

    if (!valid) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Payment signature verification failed." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const payment = await prisma.payment.findUnique({
      where: { razorpayOrderId: razorpay_order_id },
      include: {
        order: {
          include: {
            items: true,
            user: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                name: true,
                email: true,
                phone: true,
                whatsappOptIn: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!payment || !payment.order) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Payment intent not found." },
        { status: 404 },
      );
    }

    const order = payment.order;

    if (
      payment.status === "PAID" &&
      !order.orderNumber.startsWith("UVINT")
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json({
        ok: true,
        orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
        alreadyVerified: true,
      });
    }

    if (payment.amountPaise !== order.total * 100) {
      await notifyStaff({
        template: "ADMIN_PAYMENT",
        ctx: {
          orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
          total: `Expected ₹${order.total}, got ₹${payment.amountPaise / 100}`,
          method: payment.method,
          paymentId: razorpay_payment_id,
        },
      });

      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Payment amount mismatch." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const conflicts: { productId: string; name: string; available: number }[] = [];

    for (const item of order.items) {
      const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
        where: { id: item.productId },
        select: { id: true, name: true, stock: true, active: true },
      });

      if (!product || !product.active || product.stock < item.quantity) {
        conflicts.push({
          productId: item.productId,
          name: product?.name ?? item.name,
          available: product?.stock ?? 0,
        });
      }
    }

    if (conflicts.length > 0) {
      const refund = await refundCapturedPayment({
        paymentId: razorpay_payment_id,
        amountPaise: payment.amountPaise,
        reason: `Stock conflict for order ${order.orderNumber}`,
        orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
      });

      await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        await tx.payment.update({
          where: { id: payment.id },
          data: {
            status: refund ? "REFUNDED" : "FAILED",
            razorpayPaymentId: razorpay_payment_id,
            razorpaySignature: razorpay_signature,
            failureReason: "Stock conflict after payment capture",
            refundId: refund?.id ?? null,
            refundedAmountPaise: refund ? payment.amountPaise : 0,
          },
        });

        await tx.order.update({
          where: { id: order.id },
          data: {
            status: "CANCELLED",
            paymentStatus: refund ? "REFUNDED" : "FAILED",
            cancelledAt: new Date(),
            cancelReason: "Stock conflict after payment capture",
          },
        });

        await tx.trackingEvent.create({
          data: {
            orderId: order.id,
            status: "CANCELLED",
            title: "Order cancelled",
            description: refund
              ? "Stock became unavailable after payment. Refund initiated."
              : "Stock became unavailable after payment. Manual refund required.",
            location: "Urban Vogue",
          },
        });
      });

      await notify({
        template: "CANCELLED",
        userId: order.userId,
        email: order.user?.email ?? order.guestEmail ?? undefined,
        phone: order.user?.phone ?? order.guestPhone ?? undefined,
        whatsappOptIn: order.user?.whatsappOptIn,
        ctx: {
          name: order.user?.name?.split(" ")[0] ?? "there",
          orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
          total: `₹${order.total.toLocaleString("en-IN")}`,
          reason: "Stock conflict after payment",
        },
      });

      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          code: refund ? "STOCK_REFUNDED" : "STOCK_CONFLICT_MANUAL_REFUND",
          error: refund
            ? "Stock became unavailable. Payment has been refunded."
            : "Stock became unavailable. Our team will process refund manually.",
          conflicts,
        },
        { status: 409 },
      );
    }

    const realOrderNumber = makeOrderNumber();

    try {
      await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        for (const item of order.items) {
          const res = await tx.product.updateMany({
            where: {
              id: item.productId,
              stock: { gte: item.quantity },
              active: true,
            },
            data: {
              stock: { decrement: item.quantity },
              sold: { increment: item.quantity },
            },
          });

          if (res.count !== 1) {
            throw new AppError(409, "Stock conflict", "STOCK_CONFLICT");
          }
        }

        await tx.payment.update({
          where: { id: payment.id },
          data: {
            status: "PAID",
            razorpayPaymentId: razorpay_payment_id,
            razorpaySignature: razorpay_signature,
            capturedAt: new Date(),
          },
        });

        await tx.order.update({
          where: { id: order.id },
          data: {
            orderNumber: realOrderNumber,
            status: "CONFIRMED",
            paymentStatus: "PAID",
          },
        });

        await tx.trackingEvent.create({
          data: {
            orderId: order.id,
            status: "CONFIRMED",
            title: "Payment received",
            description: "Online payment verified. Order confirmed.",
            location: "Urban Vogue",
          },
        });

        if (order.couponCode) {
          const coupon = await tx.coupon.findUnique({
            where: { code: order.couponCode },
            select: { id: true, usedCount: true, usageLimit: true },
          });

          if (coupon && (!coupon.usageLimit || coupon.usedCount < coupon.usageLimit)) {
            await tx.coupon.update({
              where: { id: coupon.id },
              data: { usedCount: { increment: 1 } },
            });

            await tx.couponRedemption.create({
              data: {
                couponId: coupon.id,
                userId: order.userId,
                orderId: order.id,
                discount: order.couponDiscount,
              },
            });
          }
        }

        if (order.userId) {
          const cart = await tx.cart.findUnique({
            where: { userId: order.userId },
            select: { id: true },
          });

          if (cart) {
            await tx.cartItem.deleteMany({
              where: {
                cartId: cart.id,
                productId: { in: order.items.map((i) => i.productId) },
              },
            });
          }
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof AppError && e.code === "STOCK_CONFLICT") {
        const refund = await refundCapturedPayment({
          paymentId: razorpay_payment_id,
          amountPaise: payment.amountPaise,
          reason: `Stock conflict for order ${order.orderNumber}`,
          orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
        });

        await prisma.payment.update({
          where: { id: payment.id },
          data: {
            status: refund ? "REFUNDED" : "FAILED",
            razorpayPaymentId: razorpay_payment_id,
            razorpaySignature: razorpay_signature,
            failureReason: "Stock conflict during order confirmation",
            refundId: refund?.id ?? null,
            refundedAmountPaise: refund ? payment.amountPaise : 0,
          },
        });

        await prisma.order.update({
          where: { id: order.id },
          data: {
            status: "CANCELLED",
            paymentStatus: refund ? "REFUNDED" : "FAILED",
            cancelledAt: new Date(),
            cancelReason: "Stock conflict during order confirmation",
          },
        });

        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            ok: false,
            code: refund ? "STOCK_REFUNDED" : "STOCK_CONFLICT_MANUAL_REFUND",
            error: refund
              ? "Stock became unavailable. Payment has been refunded."
              : "Stock became unavailable. Our team will process refund manually.",
          },
          { status: 409 },
        );
      }

      throw e;
    }

    await notify({
      template: "ORDER_PLACED",
      userId: order.userId,
      email: order.user?.email ?? order.guestEmail ?? undefined,
      phone: order.user?.phone ?? order.guestPhone ?? undefined,
      whatsappOptIn: order.user?.whatsappOptIn,
      ctx: {
        name: order.user?.name?.split(" ")[0] ?? "there",
        orderNumber: realOrderNumber,
        total: `₹${order.total.toLocaleString("en-IN")}`,
      },
    });

    await notify({
      template: "PAYMENT_SUCCESS",
      userId: order.userId,
      email: order.user?.email ?? order.guestEmail ?? undefined,
      phone: order.user?.phone ?? order.guestPhone ?? undefined,
      whatsappOptIn: order.user?.whatsappOptIn,
      ctx: {
        orderNumber: realOrderNumber,
        total: `₹${order.total.toLocaleString("en-IN")}`,
        paymentId: razorpay_payment_id,
      },
    });

    await notifyStaff({
      template: "ADMIN_NEW_ORDER",
      ctx: {
        orderNumber: realOrderNumber,
        total: `₹${order.total.toLocaleString("en-IN")}`,
        items: String(order.items.length),
        customer: order.user?.email ?? order.guestEmail ?? "Guest",
        method: payment.method,
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      orderNumber: realOrderNumber,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Payment verification failed.");
  }
}
