FILE: src\app\api\returns\route.ts
============================================================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { ReturnReason, ReturnStatus } from "@prisma/client";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { requireActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { returnSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { jsonError, sanitizeText } from "@/lib/utils";
import { notify, notifyStaff } from "@/lib/notifications";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();

    const parsed = returnSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid return request",
          fields: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors,
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const data = parsed.data;

    const item = await prisma.orderItem.findUnique({
      where: { id: data.orderItemId },
      include: {
        order: {
          include: {
            user: { select: { id: true, name: true, email: true, phone: true, whatsappOptIn: true } },
          },
        },
        product: { select: { id: true, name: true, returnableDays: true } },
      },
    });

    if (!item) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Order item not found." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    if (item.order.userId !== actor.id) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Not allowed." }, { status: 403 });
    }

    if (item.order.status !== "DELIVERED" || !item.order.deliveredAt) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Returns are allowed only after delivery." },
        { status: 409 },
      );
    }

    const daysSinceDelivery =
      (Date.now() - new Date(item.order.deliveredAt).getTime()) / 86400000;

    const window = item.product?.returnableDays ?? 7;

    if (daysSinceDelivery > window) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: `Return window of ${window} days has passed.` },
        { status: 409 },
      );
    }

    const existing = await prisma.returnRequest.findUnique({
      where: { orderItemId: item.id },
      select: { id: true, status: true },
    });

    if (existing) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "A return request already exists for this item." },
        { status: 409 },
      );
    }

    const ret = await prisma.returnRequest.create({
      data: {
        orderItemId: item.id,
        orderId: item.orderId,
        userId: actor.id,
        reason: data.reason as ReturnReason,
        details: data.details ? sanitizeText(data.details, 1000) : null,
        status: ReturnStatus.REQUESTED,
        resolution: data.resolution,
      },
    });

    await notify({
      template: "RETURN_STATUS",
      userId: actor.id,
      email: item.order.user?.email ?? undefined,
      phone: item.order.user?.phone ?? undefined,
      whatsappOptIn: item.order.user?.whatsappOptIn,
      ctx: {
        orderNumber: item.order.orderNumber,
        status: "REQUESTED",
        note: "Our team will review your return request shortly.",
      },
    });

    await notifyStaff({
      template: "ADMIN_RETURN",
      ctx: {
        orderNumber: item.order.orderNumber,
        product: item.product?.name ?? item.name,
        reason: data.reason,
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      return: {
        id: ret.id,
        status: ret.status,
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Could not create return request.");
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { requireActor, isStaffRole } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { jsonError, sanitizeText } from "@/lib/utils";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const schema = z.object({
  body: z.string().trim().min(4).max(1500),
});

export async function POST(
  req: Request,
  ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
) {
  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();
    const { id } = await ctx.params;

    const parsed = schema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid answer" },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const question = await prisma.question.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      select: { id: true },
    });

    if (!question) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Question not found." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    const answer = await prisma.answer.create({
      data: {
        questionId: question.id,
        userId: actor.id,
        body: sanitizeText(parsed.data.body, 1500),
        isOfficial: isStaffRole(actor.role),
      },
      include: {
        user: { select: { name: true, role: true } },
      },
    });

    await prisma.question.update({
      where: { id: question.id },
      data: { answered: true },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      answer: {
        id: answer.id,
        body: answer.body,
        author: isStaffRole(answer.user.role) ? "Urban Vogue" : answer.user.name,
        official: answer.isOfficial || isStaffRole(answer.user.role),
        at: answer.createdAt.toISOString(),
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Could post answer.");
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { requireActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { reviewSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { jsonError, sanitizeText } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { notifyStaff } from "@/lib/notifications";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("form", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();

    const parsed = reviewSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid review",
          fields: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors,
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const data = parsed.data;

    const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
      where: { id: data.productId },
      select: { id: true, name: true, active: true },
    });

    if (!product || !product.active) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Product not found." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    const purchased = await prisma.orderItem.findFirst({
      where: {
        productId: product.id,
        order: {
          userId: actor.id,
          status: "DELIVERED",
        },
      },
      select: { id: true },
    });

    if (!purchased) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Only verified buyers can publish reviews." },
        { status: 403 },
      );
    }

    await prisma.review.upsert({
      where: {
        productId_userId: {
          productId: product.id,
          userId: actor.id,
        },
      },
      update: {
        rating: data.rating,
        title: data.title ? sanitizeText(data.title, 120) : null,
        body: sanitizeText(data.body, 2000),
        images: data.images ?? [],
        published: true,
      },
      create: {
        productId: product.id,
        userId: actor.id,
        rating: data.rating,
        title: data.title ? sanitizeText(data.title, 120) : null,
        body: sanitizeText(data.body, 2000),
        images: data.images ?? [],
        verified: true,
        published: true,
        helpfulCount: 0,
      },
    });

    const agg = await prisma.review.aggregate({
      where: {
        productId: product.id,
        published: true,
      },
      _avg: {
        rating: true,
      },
      _count: true,
    });

    await prisma.product.update({
      where: { id: product.id },
      data: {
        ratingAvg: agg._avg.rating ?? 0,
        ratingCount: agg._count,
      },
    });

    await notifyStaff({
      template: "ADMIN_REVIEW",
      ctx: {
        customer: actor.name,
        product: product.name,
        rating: String(data.rating),
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Review submission failed.");
  }
}

export async function PATCH(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("form", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const id = new URL(req.url).searchParams.get("id");

    if (!id) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Review id required." }, { status: 422 });
    }

    await prisma.review.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        helpfulCount: { increment: 1 },
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Could mark review helpful.");
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { productSelect, searchProducts, toCards } from "@/lib/catalog";
import { searchQuerySchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { jsonError } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("search", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const entries = Object.fromEntries(url.searchParams.entries());

    const parsed = searchQuerySchema.safeParse(entries);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid search" },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const input = parsed.data;
    const result = await searchProducts(input, input.category === "all" ? null : input.category);

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      items: result.items,
      total: result.total,
      page: result.page,
      perPage: result.perPage,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Search failed.");
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  return GET(req);
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { requireActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { supportTicketSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { jsonError, reference, sanitizeText } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { notify, notifyStaff } from "@/lib/notifications";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("form", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();

    const parsed = supportTicketSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          ok: false,
          error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid ticket",
          fields: parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors,
        },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const data = parsed.data;

    if (data.orderId) {
      const order = await prisma.order.findFirst({
        where: { id: data.orderId, userId: actor.id },
        select: { id: true },
      });

      if (!order) {
        return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Related order not found." }, { status: 404 });
      }
    }

    const ticket = await prisma.supportTicket.create({
      data: {
        reference: reference("UVSUP"),
        userId: actor.id,
        email: actor.email,
        subject: sanitizeText(data.subject, 120),
        category: data.category,
        status: "OPEN",
        orderId: data.orderId || null,
        messages: {
          create: {
            userId: actor.id,
            body: sanitizeText(data.message, 2000),
            fromStaff: false,
          },
        },
      },
      include: {
        messages: true,
      },
    });

    await notify({
      template: "TICKET_CREATED",
      userId: actor.id,
      email: actor.email,
      ctx: {
        reference: ticket.reference,
      },
    });

    await notifyStaff({
      template: "ADMIN_TICKET",
      ctx: {
        reference: ticket.reference,
        customer: actor.name,
        subject: ticket.subject,
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      ticket: {
        id: ticket.id,
        reference: ticket.reference,
        subject: ticket.subject,
        category: ticket.category,
        status: ticket.status,
        createdAt: ticket.createdAt.toISOString(),
        updatedAt: ticket.updatedAt.toISOString(),
        messages: ticket.messages.map((m) => ({
          id: m.id,
          body: m.body,
          fromStaff: m.fromStaff,
          createdAt: m.createdAt.toISOString(),
        })),
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Could create support ticket.");
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { requireActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { jsonError, sanitizeText } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { notifyStaff } from "@/lib/notifications";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const schema = z.object({
  body: z.string().trim().min(2, "Reply is too short").max(2000),
});

export async function POST(req: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("form", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();
    const { id } = await ctx.params;

    const parsed = schema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid reply" },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const ticket = await prisma.supportTicket.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      select: { id: true, userId: true, reference: true, subject: true, status: true },
    });

    if (!ticket) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Ticket not found." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    if (ticket.userId !== actor.id) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Not allowed." }, { status: 403 });

      data: {
        ticketId: ticket.id,
        userId: actor.id,
        body: sanitizeText(parsed.data.body, 2000),
        fromStaff: false,
      },
    });

    await prisma.supportTicket.update({
      where: { id: ticket.id },
      data: {
        status: ticket.status === "RESOLVED" || ticket.status === "CLOSED" ? "OPEN" : ticket.status,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });

    await notifyStaff({
      template: "ADMIN_TICKET",
      ctx: {
        reference: ticket.reference,
        customer: actor.name,
        subject: ticket.subject,
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Reply failed.");
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { trackLookupSchema } from "@/lib/validators";
import { normalizeMobile } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import {createGuestTrackToken } from "@/lib/track-token";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("track", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  const parsed = trackLookupSchema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { ok: false, error: "We couldn’t find an order with those details." },
      { status: 404 },
    );
  }

  const { orderNumber, identifier } = parsed.data;
  const isEmail = identifier.includes("@");
  const mobile = isEmail ? null : normalizeMobile(identifier);

  if (!isEmail && !mobile) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { ok: false, error: "We couldn’t find an order with those details." },
      { status: 404 },
    );
  }

  const order = await prisma.order.findFirst({
    where: {
      orderNumber: orderNumber.toUpperCase(),
      OR: isEmail
        ? [
            { guestEmail: identifier.toLowerCase() },
            { user: { email: identifier.toLowerCase() } },
          ]
        : [
            { guestPhone: mobile! },
            { user: { phone: mobile! } },
          ],
    },
    include: {
      items: {
        select: {
          name: true,
          quantity: true,
          image: true,
        },
      },
      trackingEvents: {
        orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!order) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { ok: false, error: "We couldn’t find an order with those details." },
      { status: 404 },
    );
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    ok: true,
    result: {
      orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
      status: order.status,
      total: order.total,
      paymentMethod: order.paymentMethod,
      paymentStatus: order.paymentStatus,
      etaFrom: order.etaFrom?.toISOString() ?? null,
      etaTo: order.etaTo?.toISOString() ?? null,
      carrier: order.carrier,
      trackingNumber: order.trackingNumber,
      token: createGuestTrackToken(order.orderNumber),
      items: order.items,
      events: order.trackingEvents.map((e) => ({
        id: e.id,
        status: e.status,
        title: e.title,
        description: e.description,
        location: e.location,
        createdAt: e.createdAt.toISOString(),
      })),
    },
  });
}

FILE: src\app\api\tracking\route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { jsonError, normalizeMobile } from "@/lib/utils";
import { clientIp, rateLimit, tooMany } from "@/lib/rate-limit";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const schema = z.object({
  orderNumber: z.string().trim().min(5).max(40),
  identifier: z.string().trim().min(5).max(120),
});

function authorized(
  order: {
    userId: string | null;
    guestEmail?: string | null;
    guestPhone?: string | null;
    user?: { email?: string | null; phone?: string | null } | null;
  },
  identifier: string,
  actorId?: string | null,
  role?: string | null,
) {
  if (actorId && order.userId === actorId) return true;
  if (role && ["ADMIN", "MANAGER", "STAFF"].includes(role)) return true;

  const id = identifier.trim().toLowerCase();
  const mobile = normalizeMobile(id) ?? id;

  return (
    order.user?.email?.toLowerCase() === mobile ||
    order.guestEmail?.toLowerCase() === mobile ||
    order.user?.phone === mobile ||
    order.guestPhone === mobile
  );
}

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const rl = await rateLimit("track", clientIp(req));
  if (!rl.success) return tooMany(rl);

  try {
    const url = new URL(req.url);
    const parsed = schema.safeParse({
      orderNumber: url.searchParams.get("orderNumber") ?? url.searchParams.get("order"),
      identifier: url.searchParams.get("identifier") ?? url.searchParams.get("id"),
    });

    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Order number and email/mobile are required." },
        { status: 422 },
      );
    }

    const actor = await getActor();

    const order = await prisma.order.findUnique({
      where: { orderNumber: parsed.data.orderNumber.toUpperCase() },
      include: {
        user: { select: { email: true, phone: true } },
        trackingEvents: { orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" } },
      },
    });

    if (!order) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Order not found." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    if (!authorized(order, parsed.data.identifier, actor?.id, actor?.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, error: "Email/mobile does not match this order." },
        { status: 403 },
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      order: {
        orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
        status: order.status,
        paymentStatus: order.paymentStatus,
        total: order.total,
        carrier: order.carrier,
        trackingNumber: order.trackingNumber,
        etaFrom: order.etaFrom?.toISOString() ?? null,
        etaTo: order.etaTo?.toISOString() ?? null,
        events: order.trackingEvents.map((e) => ({
          id: e.id,
          status: e.status,
          title: e.title,
          description: e.description,
          location: e.location,
          createdAt: e.createdAt.toISOString(),
        })),
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e, "Tracking lookup failed.");
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  return GET(req);
}

FILE: src\app\api\webhooks\razorpay\route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { verifyWebhookSignature } from "@/lib/razorpay";
import { notifyStaff } from "@/lib/notifications";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const raw = await req.text();
    const signature = req.headers.get("x-razorpay-signature");

    if (!verifyWebhookSignature(raw, signature)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid webhook signature." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const event = JSON.parse(raw) as {
      event?: string;
      payload?: {
        payment?: { entity?: { id?: string; order_id?: string; status?: string; amount?: number } };
        refund?: { entity?: { id?: string; payment_id?: string; status?: string; amount?: number } };
      };
    };

    if (event.event === "payment.captured" && event.payload?.payment?.entity?.order_id) {
      const payment = await prisma.payment.findUnique({
        where: { razorpayOrderId: event.payload.payment.entity.order_id },
        include: { order: { select: { orderNumber: true, status: true } } },
      });

      if (payment && payment.status !== "PAID") {
        await notifyStaff({
          template: "ADMIN_PAYMENT",
          ctx: {
            orderNumber: payment.order?.orderNumber ?? payment.razorpayOrderId ?? "-",
            total: `₹${((event.payload.payment.entity.amount ?? payment.amountPaise) / 100).toLocaleString("en-IN")}`,
            method: payment.method,
            paymentId: event.payload.payment.entity.id ?? "-",
          },
        });
      }
    }

    if (event.event === "refund.processed" && event.payload?.refund?.entity?.payment_id) {
      await prisma.payment.updateMany({
        where: { razorpayPaymentId: event.payload.refund.entity.payment_id },
        data: {
          status: "REFUNDED",
          refundId: event.payload.refund.entity.id ?? null,
          refundedAmountPaise: event.payload.refund.entity.amount ?? undefined,
        },
      });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("[razorpay:webhook]", e);
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false }, { status: 200 });
  }
}

============================================================
FILE: src\app\api\wishlist\route.ts
============================================================

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { requireActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { jsonError } from "@/lib/utils";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const schema = z.object({
  productId: z.string().min(1),
});

async function ensureWishlist(userId: string) {
  return prisma.wishlist.upsert({
    where: { userId },
    update: {},
    create: { userId },
  });
}

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();
    const wishlist = await prisma.wishlist.findUnique({
      where: { userId: actor.id },
      include: { items: { select: { productId: true } } },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      ids: wishlist?.items.map((i) => i.productId) ?? [],
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e);
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const actor = await requireActor();

    const parsed = schema.safeParse(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Invalid wishlist request." }, { status: 422 });
    }

    const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
      where: { id: parsed.data.productId },
      select: { id: true },
    });

    if (!product) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: "Product not found." }, { status: 404 });
    }

    const wishlist = await ensureWishlist(actor.id);

    const existing = await prisma.wishlistItem.findUnique({
      where: {
        wishlistId_productId: {
          wishlistId: wishlist.id,
          productId: product.id,
        },
      },
    });

    if (existing) {
      await prisma.wishlistItem.delete({ where: { id: existing.id } });
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, added: false });
    }

    await prisma.wishlistItem.create({
      data: {
        wishlistId: wishlist.id,
        productId: product.id,
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, added: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return jsonError(e);
  }
}

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";

import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { QuantityStepper } from "@/components/ui/Stepper";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/Skeleton";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import { useCart } from "@/context/CartContext";
import { inr } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { CardVM } from "@/lib/catalog";

const RECENT_KEY = "uv:recent:v1";   // same history the PDP / account rail write
const LS_ADDR = "uv_addr_sel_v1";    // selected delivery address id (local, reload-stable)

// Real Address columns (schema-confirmed): fullName / label / isDefault / pincode /
// line1 / line2(nullable) / city / state / phone / altPhone(nullable).
type Addr = {
  id: string;
  fullName: string;
  label: string;
  pincode: string;
  line1: string;
  line2?: string | null;
  city: string;
  state: string;
  phone: string;
  altPhone?: string | null;
  isDefault: boolean;
};

const addrStreet = (a: Addr) => [a.line1, a.line2, a.city, a.state].filter(Boolean).join(", ");

function useAddresses() {
  const [list, setList] = useState<Addr[] | null>(null);
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);
  const refresh = useCallback(() => setTick((t) => t + 1), []);
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    fetch("/api/account/addresses", { cache: "no-store" })
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((j) => {
        if (!alive) return;
        const arr = (j?.addresses ?? []) as Addr[];
        setList(Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : []);
      })
      .catch(() => alive && setList([])); // guest / 401 -> empty list, never a crash
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [tick]);
  return { list, refresh };
}

export default function CartPage() {

  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"cart" | "wishlist">("cart");
  const [sheetOpen, setSheetOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selecting, setSelecting] = useState(false);

  // Address selection lives HERE (local), not in context, so this single file works

  // the server render never touches localStorage.
  const [selectedId, setSelectedIdState] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    try { const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(LS_ADDR); if (raw) setSelectedIdState(JSON.parse(raw) as string); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }, []);
  const setSelectedId = useCallback((id: string | null) => {
    setSelectedIdState(id);
    try { if (id) window.localStorage.setItem(LS_ADDR, id); else window.localStorage.removeItem(LS_ADDR); } catch { /* ignore */ }

          </div>
          <Button href="/checkout" size="lg" className="shrink-0 bg-yellow-400 text-ink-900 hover:bg-yellow-300">Place Order</Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {sheetOpen && (

          onClose={() => setSheetOpen(false)}
          onAddNew={() => { setSheetOpen(false); router.push("/account/addresses?new=1"); }}
          onEdit={(id) => { setSheetOpen(false); router.push(`/account/addresses?edit=${id}`); }}
          onDelete={async (id) => {
            if (!window.confirm("Delete this address?")) return;
            try {
              const res = await fetch(`/api/account/addresses/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
              if (res.ok) { if (selectedId === id) setSelectedId(null); refreshAddresses(); toast.push({ title: "Address deleted" }); }
              else { toast.push({ tone: "error", title: "Couldn't delete here", body: "Manage it on the addresses page." }); setSheetOpen(false); router.push("/account/addresses"); }
            } catch { toast.push({ tone: "error", title: "Couldn't delete here", body: "Manage it on the addresses page." }); setSheetOpen(false); router.push("/account/addresses"); }
          }}
        />
      )}

      {selecting && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] grid place-items-center bg-white/40 backdrop-blur-[1px]">
          <Loader2 className="size-8 animate-spin text-electric-600" />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------- local, self-contained pieces ---------------- */

function HeaderTabs({ tab, setTab, cartQty, wlCount, onCheckout }: { tab: "cart" | "wishlist"; setTab: (t: "cart" | "wishlist") => void; cartQty: number; wlCount: number; onCheckout: () => void }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const active = "-mb-px inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b-2 border-electric-600 pb-2.5 text-[14px] font-bold text-electric-700";
  const idle = "-mb-px inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 pb-2.5 text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink-400 hover:text-ink-900";
  return (
    <>
      {/* "My Cart" nudged up (page pt-3); Checkout kept top-right so no existing control is lost */}
      <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => router.back()} aria-label="Back" className="grid size-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg text-ink-700 hover:bg-canvas">
            <ArrowLeft className="size-5" />
          </button>
          <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-bold text-ink-900">My Cart</h1>
        </div>
        {/* <Button size="sm" onClick={onCheckout} className="shrink-0">Checkout <ArrowRight className="size-4" /></Button> */}
      </div>
      {/* tabs spread opposite each other: Urban Vogue left, Wishlist right */}
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-hairline">
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setTab("cart")} className={tab === "cart" ? active : idle}>Urban Vogue ({cartQty})</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setTab("wishlist")} className={tab === "wishlist" ? active : idle}>Wishlist ({wlCount})</button>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

function DeliverToBar({ selected, onChange }: { selected: Addr | null; onChange: () => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="mb-5 flex items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-hairline bg-white px-4 py-3">
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-1.5 gap-y-0.5 text-[13px] text-ink-700">
          Deliver to:
          <span className="font-bold text-ink-900">{selected ? `${selected.fullName}, ${selected.pincode}` : "Add your address"}</span>
          {selected && <span className="rounded bg-gray-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-500">{selected.label}</span>}
        </p>
        {selected && <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[12px] text-ink-400">{addrStreet(selected)}</p>}
      </div>
      <button type="button" onClick={onChange} className="shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-electric-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-[12.5px] font-bold text-electric-700 hover:bg-electric-50">Change</button>
    </div>
  );
}

function AddressSheet({ addresses, loading, selectedId, onSelect, onClose, onAddNew, onEdit, onDelete }: {
  addresses: Addr[]; loading: boolean; selectedId: string | null;
  onSelect: (a: Addr) => void; onClose: () => void; onAddNew: () => void;
  onEdit: (id: string) => void; onDelete: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const [menuId, setMenuId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex flex-col justify-end">
      <button type="button" aria-label="Close" onClick={onClose} className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/40" />
      <div className="relative max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto rounded-t-2xl bg-white shadow-2xl">
        <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-dashed border-hairline bg-white px-4 py-3.5">
          <h2 className="font-display text-[16px] font-bold text-ink-900">Select delivery address</h2>
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close" className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-lg text-ink-500 hover:bg-canvas"><X className="size-5" /></button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3">
          <p className="text-[13px] font-bold text-ink-900">Saved addresses</p>
          <button type="button" onClick={onAddNew} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[13px] font-bold text-electric-600 hover:underline"><Plus className="size-4" /> Add New</button>
        </div>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="space-y-2 px-4 pb-4">{[0, 1].map((i) => <Skeleton key={i} className="h-16 w-full rounded-xl" />)}</div>
        ) : addresses.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="px-4 pb-6 text-[13px] text-ink-400">No saved addresses yet. Tap “Add New” to create one.</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-hairline pb-6">
            {addresses.map((a) => {
              const isSel = a.id === selectedId;
              const Icon = /work|office/i.test(a.label) ? Building2 : HomeIcon;
              return (
                <li key={a.id} className="relative">
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => onSelect(a)} className="flex w-full items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3.5 text-left hover:bg-canvas/60">
                    <Icon className="mt-0.5 size-5 shrink-0 text-ink-500" />
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="text-[14px] font-bold text-ink-900">{a.fullName}</span>
                        {isSel && <span className="rounded bg-electric-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] font-bold text-electric-700">Selected</span>}
                      </span>
                      <span className="mt-0.5 block truncate text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">{[addrStreet(a), a.pincode].filter(Boolean).join(", ")}</span>
                    </span>
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setMenuId(menuId === a.id ? null : a.id)} aria-label="Address options" className="absolute right-2 top-3 grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-lg text-ink-400 hover:bg-canvas">
                    <MoreHorizontal className="size-5" />
                  </button>
                  {menuId === a.id && (
                    <>
                      <button type="button" aria-label="Close menu" onClick={() => setMenuId(null)} className="fixed inset-0 z-10 cursor-default" />
                      <div className="absolute right-3 top-11 z-20 w-32 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-hairline bg-white py-1 shadow-lg">
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => { setMenuId(null); onEdit(a.id); }} className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink-700 hover:bg-canvas"><PenIcon /> Edit</button>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => { setMenuId(null); void onDelete(a.id); }} className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-flame-600 hover:bg-canvas"><Trash2 className="size-4" /> Delete</button>
                      </div>
                    </>
                  )}
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// inline pencil so we don't churn the lucide import list
function PenIcon() { return <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" className="size-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden><path d="M12 20h9" /><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.12 2.12 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4Z" /></svg>; }

function Thumb({ src, name, pad = "p-1.5" }: { src: string; name: string; pad?: string }) {
  const [err, setErr] = useState(false);
  if (!src || err) return <span aria-hidden className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center bg-canvas text-[11px] font-bold text-ink-300">{(name || "V").slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}</span>;
  return (
    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
    <img src={src} alt={name} loading="lazy" onError={() => setErr(true)} className={`absolute inset-0 size-full object-contain ${pad}`} />
  );
}

function Rail({ title, subtitle, source, exclude = [], count = 12 }: { title: string; subtitle?: string; source: "random" | "recent"; exclude?: string[]; count?: number }) {
  const { add } = useCart();
  const [items, setItems] = useState<CardVM[] | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    (async () => {
      let url = "";
      if (source === "random") {
        const qs = new URLSearchParams({ n: String(count) });
        if (exclude.length) qs.set("exclude", exclude.join(","));
        url = `/api/feed/cart-recommendations?${qs}`;
      } else {
        let ids: string[] = [];
        try { const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(RECENT_KEY); const list = raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as Array<{ id?: string }>) : []; ids = (Array.isArray(list) ? list : []).map((r) => r.id ?? "").filter(Boolean); } catch { ids = []; }
        const ex = new Set(exclude);
        const final = (exclude.length ? ids.filter((id) => !ex.has(id)) : ids).slice(0, count);
        if (!final.length) { if (alive) setItems([]); return; }
        url = `/api/feed/cart-recommendations?ids=${final.join(",")}`;
      }
      try { const res = await fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" }); const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; products?: CardVM[] }; if (alive) setItems(json.ok && Array.isArray(json.products) ? json.products : []); } catch { if (alive) setItems([]); }
    })();
    return () => { alive = false; };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [source, exclude.join(","), count]);
  if (!items || items.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <section className="card p-4">
      <div className="mb-3"><h2 className="font-display text-[14px] font-bold text-ink-900">{title}</h2>{subtitle && <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12px] text-ink-400">{subtitle}</p>}</div>
      <div className="no-scrollbar -mx-1 flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto px-1 pb-1">
        {items.map((p) => (
          <div key={p.id} className="flex w-36 shrink-0 flex-col">
            <Link href={`/product/${p.slug}`} className="relative block aspect-square overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-canvas"><Thumb src={p.image} name={p.name} /></Link>
            <Link href={`/product/${p.slug}`} className="mt-2 line-clamp-2 min-h-[2.1rem] text-[12px] font-semibold leading-snug text-ink-900 hover:text-electric-600">{p.name}</Link>
            <p className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-1"><span className="text-[12.5px] font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">{inr(p.salePrice)}</span>{p.mrp > p.salePrice && <span className="text-[11px] text-ink-300 line-through tabular-nums">{inr(p.mrp)}</span>}</p>
            {p.discountPercent > 0 && <span className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-600">{p.discountPercent}% off</span>}
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="mt-2 w-full" onClick={() => void add(p.id)}>Add to cart</Button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function useHydrate(ids: string[]): CardVM[] | null {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<CardVM[] | null>(null);
  const key = ids.join(",");
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!key) { setRows([]); return; }
    let alive = true;
    fetch(`/api/feed/cart-recommendations?ids=${key}`, { cache: "no-store" })
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((j) => { if (alive) setRows((j?.products as CardVM[] | undefined) ?? []); })
      .catch(() => { if (alive) setRows([]); });
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [key]);
  return rows;
}

function SavedList({ ids, onMove, onRemove }: { ids: string[]; onMove: (id: string) => void; onRemove: (id: string) => void }) {
  const rows = useHydrate(ids);
  if (!ids.length || !rows || rows.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <section className="card p-4">
      <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-[14px] font-bold text-ink-900">Saved for later ({ids.length})</h2>
      <ul className="space-y-3">
        {rows.map((p) => (
          <li key={p.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Link href={`/product/${p.slug}`} className="relative size-14 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-canvas"><Thumb src={p.image} name={p.name} pad="p-1" /></Link>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1"><Link href={`/product/${p.slug}`} className="block truncate text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink-900 hover:text-electric-600">{p.name}</Link><p className="text-[12.5px] font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-400">{inr(p.salePrice)}</p></div>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => onMove(p.id)}>Move to cart</Button>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => onRemove(p.id)} aria-label="Remove" className="p-1.5 text-ink-300 hover:text-flame-600"><Trash2 className="size-4" /></button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}

function WishlistPanel() {
  const { wishlist, add, toggleWishlist } = useCart();
  const rows = useHydrate(wishlist);
  if (!wishlist.length) return (
    <div className="card p-8 text-center"><Heart className="mx-auto size-7 text-ink-300" /><p className="mt-2 text-[14px] font-bold text-ink-900">Your wishlist is empty</p><p className="mt-1 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">Tap the heart on any product to save it here.</p><Button href="/products/all" className="mt-4">Browse products</Button></div>
  );
  if (!rows) return <div className="card space-y-3 p-4">{[0, 1, 2].map((i) => <Skeleton key={i} className="h-16 w-full rounded-xl" />)}</div>;
  if (rows.length === 0) return <div className="card p-6 text-center text-[13px] text-ink-400">Your saved items are no longer available.</div>;
  return (
    <section className="card p-4">
      <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-[14px] font-bold text-ink-900">Wishlist ({wishlist.length})</h2>
      <ul className="space-y-3">
        {rows.map((p) => (
          <li key={p.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Link href={`/product/${p.slug}`} className="relative size-16 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-canvas"><Thumb src={p.image} name={p.name} pad="p-1" /></Link>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="text-[10.5px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">{p.brand}</p>
              <Link href={`/product/${p.slug}`} className="block truncate text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink-900 hover:text-electric-600">{p.name}</Link>
              <p className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-1.5"><span className="text-[13px] font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">{inr(p.salePrice)}</span>{p.mrp > p.salePrice && <span className="text-[11px] text-ink-300 line-through tabular-nums">{inr(p.mrp)}</span>}{p.discountPercent > 0 && <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-600">↓{p.discountPercent}%</span>}</p>
            </div>
            <Button size="sm" onClick={() => { void add(p.id); void toggleWishlist(p.id); }}>Move to cart</Button>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => void toggleWishlist(p.id)} aria-label="Remove from wishlist" className="p-1.5 text-ink-300 hover:text-flame-600"><Trash2 className="size-4" /></button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}

function Row({ k, v, good }: { k: string; v: string; good?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
      <dt className="text-ink-400">{k}</dt>
      <dd className={`font-semibold tabular-nums ${good ? "text-emerald-600" : "text-ink-900"}`}>{v}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Script from "next/script";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { CheckoutWizard } from "@/components/checkout/CheckoutWizard";
import { publicKeyId, razorpayConfigured } from "@/lib/razorpay";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Secure Checkout",
  robots: { index: false, follow: false },
};

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function CheckoutPage() {
  const actor = await getActor();

  let addresses: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof prisma.address.findMany>> = [];
  let pin: string | undefined;

  if (actor) {
    const rows = await prisma.address.findMany({
      where: { userId: actor.id },
      orderBy: [{ isDefault: "desc" }, { createdAt: "desc" }],
    });
    addresses = rows;
    pin = rows.find((r) => r.isDefault)?.pincode ?? rows[0]?.pincode;
  }

  const rzpKey = publicKeyId();

  return (
    <div className="container-x py-6">
      {rzpKey && (
        <Script
          src="https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js"
          strategy="afterInteractive"
        />
      )}

        <div className="sr-only">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-ink-900">Checkout</h1>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-[13px] text-ink-400">
            Prices, coupons and stock are re-validated on our server at every step.
          </p>
        </div>
        <span className="rounded-full bg-mint-500/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11.5px] font-bold text-emerald-700">
          🔒 Secured session · {razorpayConfigured ? "Razorpay live" : "Sandbox mode"}
        </span>
      </div>

      <CheckoutWizard
        addresses={addresses.map((a) => ({
          id: a.id,
          label: a.label,
          fullName: a.fullName,
          phone: a.phone,
          altPhone: a.altPhone,
          pincode: a.pincode,
          line1: a.line1,
          line2: a.line2,
          city: a.city,
          state: a.state,
          isDefault: a.isDefault,
        }))}
        defaultPincode={pin}
        razorpayKey={rzpKey}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { CreditCard, Gift, RefreshCcw, Tags, Zap } from "lucide-react";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { SectionHeading } from "@/components/ui/SectionHeading";
import { CopyCode } from "@/components/offers/CopyCode";
import { formatDate, inr, siteUrl } from "@/lib/utils";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Offers & Coupons",
  description: "Live bank offers, no-cost EMI, exchange bonuses and Urban Vogue coupon codes.",
  alternates: { canonical: siteUrl("/offers") },
};

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const TYPE_META: Record<string, { label: string; icon: React.ReactNode; tone: "info" | "save" | "warn" | "violet" | "deal" }> = {
  BANK: { label: "Bank Offer", icon: <CreditCard className="size-4" />, tone: "info" },
  EMI: { label: "No-Cost EMI", icon: <Zap className="size-4" />, tone: "save" },
  EXCHANGE: { label: "Exchange Bonus", icon: <RefreshCcw className="size-4" />, tone: "violet" },
  COMBO: { label: "Combo Savings", icon: <Gift className="size-4" />, tone: "warn" },
  FESTIVAL: { label: "Festival Sale", icon: <Zap className="size-4" />, tone: "deal" },
  DEAL: { label: "Deal", icon: <Tags className="size-4" />, tone: "warn" },
};

type OfferMeta = (typeof TYPE_META)[string];

const FALLBACK_META: OfferMeta = {
  label: "Deal",
  icon: <Tags className="size-4" />,
  tone: "warn",
};

export default async function OffersPage() {
  const now = new Date();

  const [offers, coupons] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.offer.findMany({
      where: {
        active: true,
        startsAt: { lte: now },
        OR: [{ endsAt: null }, { endsAt: { gte: now } }],
      },
      orderBy: { priority: "desc" },
      include: {
        category: { select: { name: true, slug: true } },
        brand: { select: { name: true, slug: true } },
        product: { select: { name: true, slug: true } },
      },
    }),
    prisma.coupon.findMany({
      where: {
        active: true,
        startsAt: { lte: now },
        OR: [{ endsAt: null }, { endsAt: { gte: now } }],
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      include: {
        category: { select: { name: true, slug: true } },
        brand: { select: { name: true, slug: true } },
      },
    }),
  ]);

  return (
    <div className="container-x py-8">
      <SectionHeading
        eyebrow="Save more"
        title="Live offers & coupons"
        subtitle="Bank discounts, exchange bonuses, no-cost EMI and coupon codes applicable at checkout."
      />

      <section className="mt-6">
        <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-lg font-bold text-ink-900">Coupon codes</h2>
        {coupons.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="card p-5 text-[13.5px] text-ink-400">No active coupons right now. Check back during sale events.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {coupons.map((c) => (
              <article key={c.id} className="card p-4">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <p className="font-display text-lg font-bold tracking-wider text-ink-900">{c.code}</p>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-ink-400">{c.description ?? "Storewide savings"}</p>
                  </div>
                  <Badge tone="save">
                    {c.type === "PERCENT" ? `${c.value}%` : inr(c.value)}
                  </Badge>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">
                  <Badge tone="neutral">
                    {c.scope === "ALL" ? "All products" : c.scope === "CATEGORY" ? c.category?.name ?? "Category" : c.brand?.name ?? "Brand"}
                  </Badge>
                  {c.minOrderValue > 0 && <Badge tone="info">Min {inr(c.minOrderValue)}</Badge>}
                  {c.maxDiscount ? <Badge tone="warn">Max {inr(c.maxDiscount)}</Badge> : null}
                </div>

                <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-hairline pt-3">
                  <p className="text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">
                    {c.endsAt ? `Valid till ${formatDate(c.endsAt)}` : "Open offer"}
                  </p>
                  <CopyCode code={c.code} />
                </div>
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      <section className="mt-8">
        <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-lg font-bold text-ink-900">Bank, EMI & exchange offers</h2>
        {offers.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="card p-5 text-[13.5px] text-ink-400">No active offers right now.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {offers.map((o) => {
          const meta = TYPE_META[o.type] ?? FALLBACK_META;
              return (
                <article key={o.id} className="card p-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-electric-50 text-electric-600">
                      {meta.icon}
                    </span>
                    <Badge tone={meta.tone}>{meta.label}</Badge>
                  </div>

                  <h3 className="mt-3 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">{o.title}</h3>
                  <p className="mt-1.5 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-ink-400">{o.description}</p>

                  <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                    {o.bankName && <Badge tone="info">{o.bankName}</Badge>}
                    {o.category && (
                      <Link href={`/products/${o.category.slug}`} className="text-[11.5px] font-bold text-electric-600 hover:underline">
                        {o.category.name}
                      </Link>
                    )}
                    {o.brand && (
                      <Link href={`/products/all?brands=${o.brand.slug}`} className="text-[11.5px] font-bold text-electric-600 hover:underline">
                        {o.brand.name}
                      </Link>
                    )}
                    {o.product && (
                      <Link href={`/product/${o.product.slug}`} className="text-[11.5px] font-bold text-electric-600 hover:underline">
                        {o.product.name}
                      </Link>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {o.endsAt && (
                    <p className="mt-3 border-t border-hairline pt-2.5 text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">
                      Ends {formatDate(o.endsAt)}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </article>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      <section className="card mt-8 p-5">
       <h2 className="font-display text-lg font-bold text-ink-900">How to use coupons</h2>
<ol className="mt-3 list-decimal space-y-1.5 pl-5 text-[13.5px] text-ink-700">
  <li>Add eligible styles to your cart.</li>
  <li>Open cart and enter the coupon code in the coupon box.</li>
  <li>Discount is validated on the server and reflected in the final payable amount.</li>
  <li>Proceed to checkout. Coupon is re-validated before order creation.</li>
</ol>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

============================================================
FILE: src\app\order\[orderNumber]\page.tsx
============================================================

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ChevronRight, LifeBuoy, RotateCcw, ShieldCheck, Star, Truck } from "lucide-react";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { TrackingTimeline } from "@/components/tracking/TrackingTimeline";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { formatDateTime, inr } from "@/lib/utils";
import { CancelOrderButton } from "@/components/order/CancelOrderButton";
import { ReturnRequestButton } from "@/components/order/ReturnRequestButton";
import { ReviewLinks } from "@/components/order/ReviewLinks";
import { PrintButton } from "@/components/order/PrintButton";
import { verifyGuestTrackToken } from "@/lib/track-token";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Order details",
  robots: { index: false, follow: false },
};

const STATUS_TONE: Record<
  string,
  "info" | "save" | "warn" | "deal" | "neutral" | "violet"
> = {
  PENDING: "warn",
  CONFIRMED: "info",
  PROCESSING: "info",
  SHIPPED: "violet",
  OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: "warn",
  DELIVERED: "save",
  CANCELLED: "deal",
};

const PAYMENT_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  UPI: "UPI",
  CARD: "Credit / Debit Card",
  NETBANKING: "Net Banking",
  WALLET: "Wallet",
  COD: "Cash / UPI on Delivery",
};

type AddressSnapshot = {
  fullName?: string;
  phone?: string;
  line1?: string;
  line2?: string;
  city?: string;
  state?: string;
  pincode?: string;
};

export default async function OrderPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ orderNumber: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const { orderNumber } = await params;
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const actor = await getActor();

  const order = await prisma.order.findUnique({
    where: { orderNumber },
    include: {
      user: {
        select: { id: true, name: true, email: true, phone: true },
      },
      items: {
        include: {
          product: {
            select: { slug: true, name: true, returnableDays: true },
          },
        },
      },
      payments: {
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        take: 1,
      },
      trackingEvents: {
        orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
      },
      returnRequests: {
        select: { orderItemId: true, status: true },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!order) notFound();

  const isOwner = actor?.id === order.userId;
  const isStaff =
    !!actor && ["ADMIN", "MANAGER", "STAFF"].includes(actor.role);
  const guestToken = typeof sp.tok === "string" ? sp.tok : undefined;
  const isGuest = !order.userId && verifyGuestTrackToken(orderNumber, guestToken);

  if (!isOwner && !isStaff && !isGuest) {
    redirect(`/track?order=${encodeURIComponent(orderNumber)}`);
  }

  const simulated = sp.simulated === "1";
  const addr = (order.addressSnapshot ?? {}) as AddressSnapshot;
  const payment = order.payments[0];
  const canCancel =
    (isOwner || isStaff) && ["PENDING", "CONFIRMED"].includes(order.status);

  const activeReturnStatuses = new Set([
    "REQUESTED",
    "APPROVED",
    "PICKED_UP",
  ]);

  const returnedItemIds = new Set(
    order.returnRequests
      .filter((r) => activeReturnStatuses.has(r.status))
      .map((r) => r.orderItemId),
  );

  const daysSinceDelivery = order.deliveredAt
    ? (Date.now() - new Date(order.deliveredAt).getTime()) / 86400000
    : null;

  const eligibleReturnItems =
    order.status === "DELIVERED" && daysSinceDelivery !== null
      ? order.items
          .filter((item) => {
            const window = item.product?.returnableDays ?? 7;
            return daysSinceDelivery <= window && !returnedItemIds.has(item.id);
          })
          .map((item) => ({
            id: item.id,
            name: item.name,
            slug: item.product?.slug ?? item.slug,
          }))
      : [];

  const events = order.trackingEvents.map((e) => ({
    id: e.id,
    status: e.status,
    title: e.title,
    description: e.description,
    location: e.location,
    createdAt: e.createdAt.toISOString(),
  }));

  return (
    <div className="container-x py-8">
      {simulated && (
        <p className="mb-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-offer/10 px-4 py-3 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-amber-700">
          Development mode: Razorpay keys are not configured, so this order was
          created as a COD-shaped fallback. Set{" "}
          <code>RAZORPAY_KEY_ID</code> and <code>RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET</code> to
          enable live payments.
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_22rem]">
        <div className="min-w-0 space-y-6">
          <section className="card overflow-hidden print:break-inside-avoid">
            <div className="relative bg-ink-900 px-5 py-6 text-white sm:px-7">
              <span className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-10 -top-14 size-56 rounded-full bg-mint-500/20 blur-3xl" />

              <div className="relative flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-mint-500">
                    <ShieldCheck className="size-4" />
                    {order.status === "DELIVERED"
                      ? "Delivered"
                      : order.status === "CANCELLED"
                        ? "Cancelled"
                        : "Order confirmed"}
                  </p>

                  <h1 className="mt-2 font-display text-2xl font-bold">
                    Order {order.orderNumber}
                  </h1>

                  <p className="mt-1.5 text-[13.5px] text-white/60">
                    Placed {formatDateTime(order.createdAt)} · Invoice{" "}
                    {order.orderNumber}/INV
                  </p>

                  <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <Badge
                      tone={STATUS_TONE[order.status] ?? "neutral"}
                      className="bg-white/12 text-white ring-white/20"
                    >
                      {order.status.replace(/_/g, " ")}
                    </Badge>

                    <Badge
                      tone="neutral"
                      className="bg-white/12 text-white/80 ring-white/20"
                    >
                      {PAYMENT_LABEL[order.paymentMethod] ?? order.paymentMethod}{" "}
                      · {order.paymentStatus}
                    </Badge>

                    {order.couponCode && (
                      <Badge
                        tone="save"
                        className="bg-white/12 text-mint-500 ring-white/20"
                      >
                        {order.couponCode} saved {inr(order.couponDiscount)}
                      </Badge>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 print:hidden">
                  <PrintButton />
                  {canCancel && (
                    <CancelOrderButton
                      orderNumber={order.orderNumber}
                      status={order.status}
                    />
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid gap-5 p-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <div>
                <h2 className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">
                  <Truck className="size-3.5" /> Delivery address
                </h2>

                <p className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink-900">
                  {addr.fullName ?? order.user?.name ?? "Customer"}
                </p>

                <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-ink-400">
                  {addr.line1 ?? "Address will be confirmed"}
                  {addr.line2 ? `, ${addr.line2}` : ""}
                  {addr.city ? `, ${addr.city}` : ""}
                  {addr.state ? `, ${addr.state}` : ""}
                  {addr.pincode ? ` — ${addr.pincode}` : ""}
                </p>

                {addr.phone && (
                  <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink-700">
                    ☎ {addr.phone}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <h2 className="mb-2 text-[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">
                  Payment
                </h2>

                <p className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink-900">
                  {PAYMENT_LABEL[order.paymentMethod] ?? order.paymentMethod}
                </p>

                <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-ink-400">
                  Status:{" "}
                  <span
                    className={
                      order.paymentStatus === "PAID"
                        ? "font-bold text-emerald-600"
                        : order.paymentStatus === "FAILED"
                          ? "font-bold text-flame-600"
                          : "font-bold text-amber-600"
                    }
                  >
                    {order.paymentStatus}
                  </span>
                </p>

                {payment?.razorpayPaymentId && (
                  <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-[11.5px] text-ink-300">
                    Ref: {payment.razorpayPaymentId}
                  </p>
                )}

                {order.paymentMethod === "COD" && (
                  <p className="mt-2 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">
                    Keep exact change or UPI ready at delivery.
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>

          <section className="card p-5">
            <h2 className="mb-4 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
              Live tracking
            </h2>

            <TrackingTimeline
              status={order.status}
              events={events}
              eta={
                order.etaFrom && order.etaTo
                  ? {
                      from: order.etaFrom.toISOString(),
                      to: order.etaTo.toISOString(),
                    }
                  : null
              }
              carrier={order.carrier}
              trackingNumber={order.trackingNumber}
            />
          </section>

          <section className="card overflow-hidden">
            <header className="border-b border-hairline px-5 py-3.5">
              <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
                Items in this order
              </h2>
            </header>

            <ul className="divide-y divide-hairline">
              {order.items.map((item) => (
                <li key={item.id}>
                  <Link
                    href={`/product/${item.product?.slug ?? item.slug}`}
                    className="group flex gap-3.5 p-4 transition-colors hover:bg-gray-50/60 active:bg-gray-100"
                  >
                    <span className="relative size-20 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-canvas">
                      {item.image ? (
                        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                        <img
                          src={item.image}
                          alt={item.name}
                          className="size-full object-contain p-1"
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <span className="grid size-full place-items-center text-[11px] text-ink-300">
                          No image
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </span>

                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">
                        {item.brand}
                      </p>

                      <p className="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink-900">
                        {item.name}
                      </p>

                      <p className="mt-1 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">
                        Qty {item.quantity} · {item.warrantyMonths}-month warranty
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="shrink-0 text-right">
                      <p className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">
                        {inr(item.lineTotal)}
                      </p>

                      {item.unitMrp > item.unitPrice && (
                        <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12px] text-ink-300 line-through tabular-nums">
                          {inr(item.unitMrp * item.quantity)}
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <ChevronRight className="size-4 shrink-0 self-center text-ink-300 transition-colors group-hover:text-ink-500" />
                  </Link>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </section>

          <section className="card p-5 print:hidden">
            <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
              Need something else?
            </h2>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              {eligibleReturnItems.length > 0 && (
                <ReturnRequestButton items={eligibleReturnItems} />
              )}

              {order.status === "DELIVERED" && (
                <ReviewLinks
                  items={order.items.map((i) => ({
                    slug: i.product?.slug ?? i.slug,
                    name: i.name,
                  }))}
                />
              )}

              <Button
                href="/contact"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                className="inline-flex"
              >
                <LifeBuoy className="size-3.5" /> Contact support
              </Button>

              <Button
                href="/track"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                className="inline-flex"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="size-3.5" /> Track another order
              </Button>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>

        <aside className="lg:sticky lg:top-[92px] lg:h-fit">
          <div className="card overflow-hidden">
            <header className="border-b border-hairline px-4 py-3.5">
              <h2 className="font-display text-[13px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-400">
                Invoice summary
              </h2>
            </header>

            <div className="space-y-2.5 p-4 text-[13px]">
              <Row label="Total MRP" value={inr(order.subtotalMrp)} />

              <Row
                label="Item discount"
                value={`− ${inr(order.itemDiscount)}`}
                tone="good"
              />

              {order.couponDiscount > 0 && (
                <Row
                  label={`Coupon (${order.couponCode ?? ""})`}
                  value={`− ${inr(order.couponDiscount)}`}
                  tone="good"
                />
              )}

              <Row
                label="Delivery"
                value={order.deliveryFee === 0 ? "FREE" : inr(order.deliveryFee)}
                tone={order.deliveryFee === 0 ? "good" : undefined}
              />

              {order.codFee > 0 && (
                <Row label="COD handling" value={inr(order.codFee)} />
              )}

              <div className="my-1 border-t border-dashed border-hairline" />

              <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between">
                <span className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
                  Total payable
                </span>

                <span className="font-display text-xl font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">
                  {inr(order.total)}
                </span>
              </div>

              <p className="text-[11px] text-ink-400">
                Includes {inr(order.gstComponent)} GST.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="card mt-4 p-4">
            <h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-[13px] font-bold text-ink-900">
              <Star className="size-4 text-amber-offer" /> After delivery
            </h3>

            <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1.5 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">
              <li>• Rate your product to help future buyers.</li>
              <li>• Raise a return only for damaged/wrong/non-working units.</li>
              <li>• Keep packaging and invoice for faster support.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Row({
  label,
  value,
  tone,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  tone?: "good";
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
      <span className="text-ink-400">{label}</span>
      <span
        className={
          tone === "good"
            ? "font-semibold tabular-nums text-emerald-600"
            : "font-semibold tabular-nums text-ink-900"
        }
      >
        {value}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

function etaLabel(from: Date | null, to: Date | null): string | null {
  const d = to ?? from;
  if (!d) return null;
  const dt = new Date(d);
  return `${dt.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" })} ’${String(dt.getFullYear()).slice(2)}`;
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { productSelect, toCards } from "@/lib/catalog";
import type { CardVM } from "@/lib/catalog";
import { FEATURE_KEYS, type FeatureKey } from "@/lib/home-features";
import { buildHeroSlides } from "@/lib/home-slides";
import { HeroCarousel } from "@/components/home/HeroCarousel";
import { FlipkartGrid } from "@/components/home/FlipkartGrid";
import { DynamicRails } from "@/components/home/DynamicRails";
import { InfiniteProductFeed } from "@/components/home/InfiniteProductFeed";
import { getSuggested, getCategoryCollections, getDealTiles, getBrandSpotlight } from "@/lib/home-discovery";
import { CollectionGrid } from "@/components/home/CollectionGrid";
import { CategoryDealRow } from "@/components/home/CategoryDealRow";
import { BrandSpotlight } from "@/components/home/BrandSpotlight";
import { ProductGrid } from "@/components/home/ProductGrid";
import { ServiceIconRow } from "@/components/home/ServiceIconRow";

export const revalidate = 5;

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Shop Online",
  description: "India's premier destination for fashion.",
};

export default async function HomePage() {
  // Hero / sponsored slides
  const rawSlides = await buildHeroSlides(20);
  const slides = rawSlides.map((s: any) => ({
    id: s.id ?? "",
    imageUrl: s.image || s.imageUrl || "/placeholder-banner-bg.jpg",
    art: Boolean(s.image),
    headline: s.headline || s.title || "Mega Tech Sale",
    highlight: s.highlight || s.subtitle || "",
    description:
      s.description ||
      s.body ||
      "Limited-time discounts across Shirts & T-Shirts, Pants & Trousers, appliances and accessories.",
    badge: s.badge || null,
    ctaLabel: s.ctaLabel || s.buttonText || "Shop Now",
    ctaHref: s.ctaHref || s.link || "/products/all?sort=discount",
    products: s.products ?? [],
  }));

  // Initial SSR batch for the infinite "Suggested For You" feed
  const initialFeed = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } },
    select: productSelect,
    orderBy: [{ ratingAvg: "desc" }, { sold: "desc" }],
    take: 12,
  });

  // Mixed pool feeding the Wishlist + Suggested rails inside DynamicRails
  const mixedPool = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } },
    select: productSelect,
    take: 24,
  });

  // Deals / New / Best rails (fallback pools when curation is empty)
  const [deals, newArrivals, bestSellers] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true, discountPercent: { gte: 20 } },
      select: productSelect,
      take: 10,
    }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
      select: productSelect,
      take: 10,
    }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true },
      orderBy: { sold: "desc" },
      select: productSelect,
      take: 10,
    }),
  ]);

  // Discovery datasets
  const [suggested, catCollections, dealTiles, brandSpot] = await Promise.all([
    getSuggested(12),
    getCategoryCollections(4),
    getDealTiles(6),
    getBrandSpotlight(4),
  ]);

  // Curated rails: per-section product lists saved from /admin/features.
  // DynamicRails prefers these (order preserved) over the shuffled pool fallback.
  const curation = await prisma.productFeature.findMany({
    include: { product: { select: productSelect } },
    orderBy: [{ section: "asc" }, { position: "asc" }],
  });

  const curatedBySection = curation.reduce<Partial<Record<FeatureKey, CardVM[]>>>(
    (acc, row) => {
      if (!FEATURE_KEYS.includes(row.section as FeatureKey)) return acc;
      const card = toCards([row.product])[0];
      if (!card) return acc;
      const key = row.section as FeatureKey;
      (acc[key] ??= []).push(card);
      return acc;
    },
    {},
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#faf8f5] pb-20 md:pb-0">
      {/* A. HERO CAROUSEL (sponsored/AD slides — first, unmodified) */}
      <section className="container-x mt-8 mb-10">
        <HeroCarousel slides={slides} />
      </section>

      {/* B. CATEGORY-DEAL TILES (horizontal "jump in" strip) */}
      <section className="container-x mb-6">
        <CategoryDealRow title="Today's deals ⚡" items={dealTiles} />
      </section>

      {/* C. DYNAMIC RAILS (curated-first, shuffled fallback) */}
      <DynamicRails
        deals={toCards(deals)}
        newArrivals={toCards(newArrivals)}
        bestSellers={toCards(bestSellers)}
        allProducts={toCards(mixedPool)}
        curated={curatedBySection}
      />

      {/* D. POPULAR PICKS (tinted collection grid) */}
      <section className="container-x mt-6">
        <CollectionGrid title="Popular picks" tiles={catCollections} tone="green" columns={2} />
      </section>

      {/* E. SERVICE ICON ROW */}
      <section className="container-x mt-6">
        <ServiceIconRow />
      </section>

      {/* F. CATEGORY GRID */}
      <FlipkartGrid />

      {/* G. MORE PRODUCTS FOR YOU (3-col grid, distinct from infinite feed heading) */}
      <section className="container-x mt-6">
        <ProductGrid title="More products for you" items={suggested} />
      </section>

      {/* H. BRANDS IN SPOTLIGHT */}
      <section className="container-x mt-6">
        <BrandSpotlight title="Brands in Spotlight" items={brandSpot} />
      </section>

      {/* I. LOWEST PRICES (second tinted collection grid) */}
      <section className="container-x mt-6">
        <CollectionGrid
          title="Lowest Prices in the year"
          tiles={catCollections}
          tone="peach"
          columns={2}
        />
      </section>

      {/* J. INFINITE SCROLL FEED ("Suggested For You") */}
      <InfiniteProductFeed initialProducts={toCards(initialFeed)} />
    </div>
  );
}
