export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function generateMetadata({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
}): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params;

  const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
    where: { slug },
    select: {
      slug: true,
      name: true,
      shortDescription: true,
      description: true,
      active: true,
      category: { select: { name: true } },
      brand: { select: { name: true } },
      images: { select: { url: true }, take: 1 },
    },
  });

  if (!product || !product.active) {
    return { title: "Product not found" };
  }

    const description = excerpt(product.description ?? product.shortDescription ?? product.name, 180);

  return {
    title: product.name,
    description,
    alternates: { canonical: siteUrl(`/product/${product.slug ?? slug}`) },
    openGraph: {
      title: product.name,
      description,
      images: product.images[0]?.url ? [{ url: product.images[0].url }] : undefined,
    },
  };
}

export default async function ProductPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
}) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const actor = await getActor();

  const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
    where: { slug },
    include: {
      category: true,
      brand: true,
      images: { orderBy: { position: "asc" } },
      specifications: { orderBy: [{ group: "asc" }, { label: "asc" }] },
      reviews: {
        where: { published: true },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        take: 20,
        include: { user: { select: { name: true } } },
      },
      questions: {
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        take: 20,
        include: {
          user: { select: { name: true } },
          answers: {
            orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
            include: { user: { select: { name: true, role: true } } },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!product || !product.active) notFound();

  // Sibling SKUs (same family group) drive the navigating colour/variant picker.
  const siblings = product.groupId
    ? await prisma.product.findMany({
        where: { groupId: product.groupId, active: true },
        orderBy: [{ color: "asc" }, { storage: "asc" }, { ram: "asc" }],
        include: { images: { where: { kind: "GALLERY" }, orderBy: { position: "asc" }, take: 1 } },
      })
    : [];
    const siblingItems = siblings.map((s) => ({
    id: s.id, slug: s.slug, name: s.name, color: s.color, storage: s.storage, ram: s.ram,
    salePrice: s.salePrice, mrp: s.mrp, stock: s.stock, lowStockAt: s.lowStockAt,
    image: s.images[0]?.url ?? null,
    variants: (s as any).variants ?? [],
  }));

  // Sponsored tile candidates: best-selling other products in the same category.
  const adCandidates = (
    await prisma.product.findMany({
      where: {
        active: true,
        id: { not: product.id },
        ...(product.categoryId ? { categoryId: product.categoryId } : {}),
      },
      orderBy: { sold: "desc" },
      take: 8,
      select: {
        id: true, slug: true, name: true, mrp: true, salePrice: true,
        images: { where: { kind: "GALLERY" }, orderBy: { position: "asc" }, take: 1, select: { url: true } },
      },
    })
  ).map((p) => ({
    id: p.id, slug: p.slug, name: p.name, mrp: p.mrp, salePrice: p.salePrice,
    image: p.images[0]?.url ?? null,
  }));

  const carouselSelect = {
    id: true, slug: true, name: true, salePrice: true, mrp: true,
    ratingAvg: true, ratingCount: true, featured: true, sold: true,
    brand: { select: { name: true } },
    images: { select: { url: true, isPrimary: true, kind: true } },
  } as const;

   // Flat shape RelatedTicker reads (it.image / it.price / it.discountPercent). The old bare
  // findMany never loaded the images relation, so every tile hit the first-letter fallback —
  // which for "OnePlus 13" renders a capital "O" that reads as the grey circle in the shot.
  // Inline the primary-image pick: do NOT use prim/toCarousel here — they're defined after the
  // Promise.all below, so referencing them at this point is a TDZ ReferenceError.
  const related = (await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: {
      categoryId: product.categoryId,
      id: { not: product.id },
      active: true,
      stock: { gt: 0 },
    },
    take: 10,
    select: {
      id: true, slug: true, name: true, salePrice: true, mrp: true, discountPercent: true,
      images: { select: { url: true, isPrimary: true } },
    },
  })).map((p) => ({
    id: p.id,
    slug: p.slug,
    name: p.name,
    image: p.images.find((i) => i.isPrimary)?.url ?? p.images[0]?.url ?? undefined,
    price: p.salePrice,
    mrp: p.mrp,
    discountPercent: p.discountPercent,
  }));

  const pAny = product as any;
  const basePrice = Number(pAny.salePrice ?? pAny.price ?? 0);
  const baseMrp = Number(pAny.mrp ?? basePrice);
  const colors: string[] = Array.isArray(pAny.colors) ? pAny.colors : [];
  const variants: { label: string; add: number }[] = Array.isArray(pAny.variants)
    ? (pAny.variants as { label: string; add: number }[])
    : [];
  const optionGroups: any[] = Array.isArray(pAny.optionGroups) ? pAny.optionGroups : [];
  const colorOptions: any[] = Array.isArray(pAny.colorOptions) ? pAny.colorOptions : [];

  await prisma.product.update({
    where: { id: product.id },
    data: { views: { increment: 1 } },
  });

  if (actor) {
    await prisma.recentlyViewed.upsert({
      where: {
        userId_productId: {
          userId: actor.id,
          productId: product.id,
        },
      },
      create: { userId: actor.id, productId: product.id },
      update: { viewedAt: new Date() },
    });
  }

  const [
    distRows, fbtRows, peerRows,
    priceRows, brandRows, ramRows, storageRows, likeRows,
    catPoolRows, brandPoolRows,
  ] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.review.groupBy({
      by: ["rating"],
      where: { productId: product.id, published: true },
      _count: true,
    }),
    prisma.frequentlyBoughtPair.findMany({
      where: { primaryId: product.id },
      include: { addOn: { select: productSelect } },
    }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 }, categoryId: product.categoryId, id: { not: product.id } },
      select: { ...productSelect, slug: true },
      orderBy: [{ sold: "desc" }, { ratingAvg: "desc" }],
      take: 3,
    }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: {
        active: true, stock: { gt: 0 }, id: { not: product.id }, categoryId: product.categoryId,
        salePrice: { gte: Math.round(Number(product.salePrice) * 0.8), lte: Math.round(Number(product.salePrice) * 1.25) },
      },
      select: carouselSelect, orderBy: [{ sold: "desc" }, { ratingAvg: "desc" }], take: 8,
    }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 }, id: { not: product.id }, brandId: product.brandId },
      select: carouselSelect, orderBy: [{ sold: "desc" }, { ratingAvg: "desc" }], take: 8,
    }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 }, id: { not: product.id }, categoryId: product.categoryId, ...(product.ram ? { ram: product.ram } : {}) },
      select: carouselSelect, orderBy: [{ sold: "desc" }], take: 8,
    }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 }, id: { not: product.id }, categoryId: product.categoryId, ...(product.storage ? { storage: product.storage } : {}) },
      select: carouselSelect, orderBy: [{ sold: "desc" }], take: 8,
    }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 }, id: { not: product.id }, OR: [{ featured: true }, { categoryId: product.categoryId }] },
      select: carouselSelect, orderBy: [{ sold: "desc" }, { ratingAvg: "desc" }], take: 8,
    }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 }, category: { id: { not: product.categoryId } } },
      select: { id: true, salePrice: true, mrp: true, sold: true, images: { select: { url: true, isPrimary: true } }, category: { select: { slug: true, name: true } } },
      orderBy: [{ sold: "desc" }], take: 40,
    }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } },
      select: { id: true, salePrice: true, mrp: true, ratingAvg: true, sold: true, images: { select: { url: true, isPrimary: true } }, brand: { select: { name: true } } },
      orderBy: [{ sold: "desc" }], take: 60,
    }),
  ]);

  const reviewVMs = product.reviews.map((r) => ({
    id: r.id,
    rating: r.rating,
    title: r.title,
    body: r.body,
    images: r.images,
    author: r.user?.name ?? "Verified Buyer",
    verified: r.verified,
    at: r.createdAt.toISOString(),
    helpful: r.helpfulCount,
  }));

  const questionVMs = product.questions.map((q) => ({
    id: q.id,
    body: q.body,
    askedAt: q.createdAt.toISOString(),
    asker: q.user?.name ?? "Anonymous",
    answers: q.answers.map((a) => ({
      id: a.id,
      body: a.body,
      author:
        a.user?.role === "ADMIN" || a.user?.role === "MANAGER" || a.user?.role === "STAFF"
          ? "Urban Vogue"
          : a.user?.name ?? "Customer",
      official: a.isOfficial || a.user?.role !== "CUSTOMER",
      at: a.createdAt.toISOString(),
    })),
  }));

  const addOns = toCards(fbtRows.map((p) => p.addOn));
  const peers = toCards(peerRows);

  const galleryImgs = product.images.filter((i) => (i.kind ?? "GALLERY") === "GALLERY");
  const primaryImage = galleryImgs.find((i) => i.isPrimary)?.url ?? galleryImgs[0]?.url ?? "";

   const prim = (r: { images?: { url: string; isPrimary: boolean; kind?: string }[] }) => {
    const g = (r.images ?? []).filter((i) => (i.kind ?? "GALLERY") === "GALLERY");
    return g.find((i) => i.isPrimary)?.url ?? g[0]?.url ?? null;
  };
  const toCarousel = (r: any, _i: number, all: any[]): CarouselItem => ({
    id: r.id, slug: r.slug, name: r.name, brand: r.brand?.name ?? null, image: prim(r),
    price: r.salePrice, mrp: r.mrp, rating: r.ratingAvg, ratingCount: r.ratingCount,
    badge: r.featured ? "trending" : (all.indexOf(r) === 0 && (r.sold ?? 0) > 0 ? "bestseller" : null),
  });
  const priceItems = priceRows.map((r, i) => toCarousel(r, i, priceRows));
  const brandItems = brandRows.map((r, i) => toCarousel(r, i, brandRows));
  const ramItems = ramRows.map((r, i) => toCarousel(r, i, ramRows));
  const storageItems = storageRows.map((r, i) => toCarousel(r, i, storageRows));
  const likeItems = likeRows.map((r, i) => toCarousel(r, i, likeRows));

  // Recently Viewed (login-gated): built from productId + a second product query so it
  // never depends on relation names and can't 500. Placed after toCarousel (no TDZ).
  let recentItems: CarouselItem[] = [];
  if (actor) {
    try {
      const rows = await prisma.recentlyViewed.findMany({
        where: { userId: actor.id },
        orderBy: { viewedAt: "desc" },
        take: 8,
        select: { productId: true },
      });
      const ids = rows.map((r) => r.productId);
      if (ids.length > 0) {
        const prods = await prisma.product.findMany({
          where: { id: { in: ids } },
          select: carouselSelect,
        });
        const byId = new Map(prods.map((p) => [p.id, p]));
        const ordered = ids
          .map((id) => byId.get(id))
          .filter((p): p is NonNullable<typeof p> => Boolean(p));
        recentItems = ordered.map((r, i) => toCarousel(r, i, ordered));
      }
    } catch {
      recentItems = [];
    }
  }

  const currentCard: CarouselItem = toCarousel(product as any, 0, []);

  const comboPairs: ComboPair[] = fbtRows.map((row: any) => ({
    primary: { name: product.name, image: primaryImage, price: Number(product.salePrice), slug: product.slug },
    addOn: { name: row.addOn?.name, image: prim(row.addOn ?? { images: [] }), price: row.addOn?.salePrice, slug: row.addOn?.slug },
  }));

  const groupBest = (rows: any[], key: (r: any) => string | null) => {
    const m = new Map<string, any[]>();
    for (const r of rows) { const k = key(r); if (!k) continue; (m.get(k) ?? m.set(k, []).get(k)!).push(r); }
    return m;
  };
  const disc = (r: any) => (r.mrp && r.salePrice && r.mrp > r.salePrice ? Math.round(((r.mrp - r.salePrice) / r.mrp) * 100) : 0);
  const interestTiles: Tile[] = [...groupBest(catPoolRows, (r) => r.category?.slug ?? null).entries()]
    .filter(([s]) => s !== product.category?.slug)
    .map(([s, rs]) => {
      const best = rs.slice().sort((a, b) => disc(b) - disc(a))[0]!;
      const maxOff = Math.max(...rs.map(disc));
      return { title: best.category?.name ?? s, subtitle: maxOff > 0 ? `Up to ${maxOff}% Off` : "Explore", image: prim(best), href: `/products/${s}` };
    })
    .slice(0, 4);
  const tryTiles: Tile[] = [...groupBest(brandPoolRows, (r) => r.brand?.name ?? null).entries()]
    .map(([name, rs]) => {
      const best = rs.slice().sort((a, b) => (b.sold ?? 0) - (a.sold ?? 0))[0]!;
      const topRated = Math.max(0, ...rs.map((x) => x.ratingAvg ?? 0));
      const sub = topRated >= 4.5 ? "Top rated" : (best.sold ?? 0) > 0 ? "Best sellers" : "Explore";
      return { title: name, subtitle: sub, image: prim(best), href: `/products/all?q=${encodeURIComponent(name)}` };
    })
    .slice(0, 4);

  // Delivery ETA (same 3–5 day horizon DeliveryDetails promises).
  const etaDate = new Date(Date.now() + 4 * 864e5);
  const etaShort = etaDate.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { day: "numeric", month: "short" });
  const etaLong = etaDate.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "short" });

    // Per-product PDP info-block overrides (admin "PDP info blocks" card).
  // Absent/empty override => live defaults, so untouched products render exactly
  // as today. Inert until the pdpBlocks column exists (pre-push => undefined => {}).
  const pdp = sanitizePdpBlocks((product as any).pdpBlocks);
  const info = resolvePdpBlocks(pdp);

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1280px] px-3 py-6 pb-32 sm:px-4 lg:px-5 md:pb-24">
      <ProductJsonLd product={product} reviews={reviewVMs} />

      {/* MOBILE — sponsored tile comes first, above the image (Flipkart mobile order) */}
      <div className="mb-4 md:hidden">
        <SponsoredAdCard seed={product.id} products={adCandidates} />
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 rounded-xl bg-white p-4 shadow-sm md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,32rem)_1fr] md:p-6 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,34rem)_1fr]">
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <ProductGallery
            images={product.images.filter((im) => (im.kind ?? "GALLERY") === "GALLERY")}
            name={product.name}
            productId={product.id}
            ratingAvg={product.ratingAvg}
            ratingCount={product.ratingCount}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="min-w-0 space-y-5">
          {/* DESKTOP — sponsored tile at the top of the right column; hidden on mobile (shown above) */}
          <div className="hidden md:block">
            <SponsoredAdCard seed={product.id} products={adCandidates} />
          </div>

          {/* Colour + variant sit directly under the image on mobile, under the ad on desktop */}
                    {siblingItems.length > 1 ? (
            <VariantNavigator siblings={siblingItems} currentId={product.id} />
          ) : (
            <VariantPicker
              colors={colors}
              variants={variants}
              optionGroups={optionGroups}
              colorOptions={colorOptions}
              basePrice={basePrice}
              baseMrp={baseMrp}
              name={product.name}
              brand={product.brand.name}
              storage={product.storage}
              ram={product.ram}
            />
          )}

          {/* Size Chart trigger — rendered for BOTH the sibling navigator and the
              single-SKU picker, so family-linked products (blue/beige denim jacket)
              get the same Size Chart link as standalone products. */}
          <SizeChart
            subtype={product.subtype}
            productName={product.name}
            images={galleryImgs.map((g) => g.url)}
          />

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <h1 className="font-display text-[17px] font-bold leading-snug text-gray-900 md:text-[19px]">
              {product.name}
            </h1>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-gray-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[12.5px] font-bold text-gray-800">
                {Number(product.ratingAvg).toFixed(1)} <Star className="size-3 fill-current text-emerald-600" />
              </span>
              <span className="text-[12.5px] text-gray-500">| {Number(product.ratingCount).toLocaleString("en-IN")}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="text-[16px] font-bold text-emerald-600">↓{product.discountPercent}%</span>
              <span className="text-[15px] text-gray-400 line-through">₹{Number(product.mrp).toLocaleString("en-IN")}</span>
              <span className="font-display text-[24px] font-bold text-gray-900">₹{Number(product.salePrice).toLocaleString("en-IN")}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <ProductPurchasePanel
            id={product.id}
            slug={product.slug}
            name={product.name}
            brand={product.brand.name}
            category={product.category.name}
            subtype={product.subtype}
            mrp={product.mrp}
            salePrice={product.salePrice}
            discountPercent={product.discountPercent}
            hidePrice
            stock={product.stock}
            lowStockAt={product.lowStockAt}
            ratingAvg={product.ratingAvg}
            ratingCount={product.ratingCount}
            warrantyMonths={product.warrantyMonths}
            returnableDays={product.returnableDays}
            emiEligible={product.emiEligible}
            codEligible={product.codEligible}
            exchangeEligible={product.exchangeEligible}
            ram={product.ram}
            storage={product.storage}
            screenSize={product.screenSize}
            processor={product.processor}
            color={product.color}
            shortDescription={(product.description ?? product.shortDescription ?? product.name ?? "").slice(0, 160)}
          />

          <DeliveryDetails returnableDays={product.returnableDays} items={pdp.deliveryDetails ?? null} />

          <DeliveryMeta etaLong={etaLong} deliveryBy={pdp.deliveryBy ?? null} soldBy={pdp.soldBy ?? null} />
             
             <PeaceOfMind
            brandName={product.brand.name}
            warrantyMonths={product.warrantyMonths}
            returnableDays={product.returnableDays}
            codEligible={product.codEligible}
            items={pdp.peaceOfMind ?? null}
          />

            <ProductHighlights
            ram={product.ram}
            storage={product.storage}
            processor={product.processor}
            screenSize={product.screenSize}
            color={product.color}
            warrantyMonths={product.warrantyMonths}
            returnableDays={product.returnableDays}
            items={pdp.highlights ?? null}
          />
          
          <ProductDetails
            name={product.name}
            brandName={product.brand.name}
            categoryName={product.category.name}
            subtype={product.subtype}
            color={product.color}
            ram={product.ram}
            storage={product.storage}
            screenSize={product.screenSize}
            processor={product.processor}
            warrantyMonths={product.warrantyMonths}
            returnableDays={product.returnableDays}
            images={product.images}
            specifications={product.specifications}
            description={product.description}
          />

          <ProductBuyBar
            id={product.id}
            name={product.name}
            salePrice={product.salePrice}
            stock={product.stock}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* MOBILE — related strip moved BELOW the product card (was above the ad) */}
      {related.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-6 md:hidden">
        <RelatedTicker items={related} />
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="mt-6 space-y-6">
        <RecentlyViewedRail current={currentCard} serverItems={recentItems} eta={etaShort} />

        {/* <ReviewPhotoMosaic reviews={reviewVMs} /> */}

        <ReviewsSection
          productId={product.id}
          ratingAvg={product.ratingAvg}
          ratingCount={product.ratingCount}
          reviews={reviewVMs}
        />

        <QASection productId={product.id} questions={questionVMs} />

        <SaveCombos pairs={comboPairs} />

        {addOns.length > 0 && (
          <FrequentlyBought
            primary={{
              id: product.id,
              slug: product.slug,
              name: product.name,
              image: primaryImage,
              salePrice: product.salePrice,
            }}
            addOns={addOns}
          />
        )}

        {peers.length > 0 && (
          <CompareBlock
            base={{
              slug: product.slug,
              name: product.name,
              price: product.salePrice,
              rating: product.ratingAvg,
              ram: product.ram,
              storage: product.storage,
              screen: product.screenSize,
              processor: product.processor,
              warranty: product.warrantyMonths,
              image: primaryImage,
            }}
            peers={peers.map((p) => ({
              slug: p.slug,
              name: p.name,
              price: p.salePrice,
              rating: p.ratingAvg,
              ram: p.ram,
              storage: p.storage,
              screen: p.screenSize,
              processor: p.processor,
              warranty: p.warrantyMonths,
              image: p.image,
            }))}
          />
        )}

        <ProductCarousel title={`Similar from ${product.brand?.name ?? "this brand"}`} items={brandItems} eta={etaShort} />
        {product.ram ? <ProductCarousel title={`Similar in Size ${product.ram}`} items={ramItems} eta={etaShort} /> : null}
        {product.storage ? <ProductCarousel title={`Similar with ${product.storage}`} items={storageItems} eta={etaShort} /> : null}
        <ProductCarousel title="You may also like" items={likeItems} eta={etaShort} />
        <BrowseTiles title="You can also try" tiles={tryTiles} />
        <BrowseTiles title="You might be interested in" tiles={interestTiles} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Example for [category]/page.tsx
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import {Prisma} from "@prisma/client";
import { productSelect, toCards } from "@/lib/catalog";
import { ProductListClient } from "@/components/product/ProductListClient"; // Import the new client component

// export default async function CategoryPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ category: string }> }) {
//   const { category } = await params;
  
//   // Fetch data ON SERVER SIDE (Safe)
//   const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
//     where: { active: true, category: { slug: category } },
//     select: productSelect,
//     take: 50,
//   });

//   // Pass DATA ONLY to Client Component (Functions stay inside Client Comp)
//   return (
//     <ProductListClient 
//       initialProducts={toCards(products)} 
//       total={products.length}
//       categorySlug={category}
//     />
//   );
// }

export default async function AllProductsPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<{ q?: string; brands?: string }> }) {
  const { q, brands } = await searchParams;
  
  const whereClause: Prisma.ProductWhereInput = q 
    ? { 
        active: true, 
        OR: [
          { name: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
          { brand: { name: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } } }
        ] 
      } 
    : { active: true };

  const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: {
      AND: [
        whereClause,
        ...(brands
          ? [
              {
                brand: {
                  slug: {
                    in: brands.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean),
                  },
                },
              },
            ]
          : []),
      ],
    },
    select: productSelect,
    take: 50,
  });

  return (
    <ProductListClient 
      initialProducts={toCards(products)} 
      total={products.length}
      categorySlug="all"
    />
  );
}

FILE: src\app\products\[category]\page.tsx

import Link from "next/link";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { productSelect, toCards } from "@/lib/catalog";
import { ProductListClient } from "@/components/product/ProductListClient";
import { ProductCard } from "@/components/product/ProductCard";
import { HeroCarousel } from "@/components/home/HeroCarousel";
import { CollectionGrid } from "@/components/home/CollectionGrid";
import { buildHeroSlides } from "@/lib/home-slides";
import { getCategoryExplorer } from "@/lib/category-explorer";
import type { ExplorerItem, ExplorerBrand } from "@/lib/category-explorer";
import type { Tile } from "@/lib/home-discovery";

// Reading `searchParams` makes this route dynamic in Next 15, so `revalidate`
// is ignored for filtered URLs (filters stay live). It still applies to the
// bare /products/<slug> view if Next ever statically caches it.
export const revalidate = 5;

const RUPEE = "\u20B9";
const inr = (n?: number | null) =>
  typeof n === "number" && Number.isFinite(n) ? `${RUPEE}${n.toLocaleString("en-IN")}` : "";

// --- URL-param helpers -------------------------------------------------------
type SP = Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>;
const first = (v: string | string[] | undefined) => (Array.isArray(v) ? v[0] : v);
const csv = (v: string | string[] | undefined): string[] =>
  (first(v) ?? "").split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
const posNum = (v: string | string[] | undefined): number | undefined => {
  const n = Number(first(v));
  return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : undefined;
};

// Any of these present & non-empty => the visitor drilled into a filter
// (brand tile, sidebar facet, or header search). In that case we render a
// server-filtered grid ourselves and SKIP the category-level hero/deals/
// ProductListClient, which would otherwise show other brands' content.
const FACET_KEYS = [
  "brands", "subtypes", "ram", "storage", "screenSize", "processor",
  "color", "minRating", "minDiscount", "warranty", "inStock", "q",
] as const;
const hasFacets = (sp: SP) =>
  FACET_KEYS.some((k) => {
    const v = sp[k];
    if (v == null) return false;
    const s = Array.isArray(v) ? v.join(",") : v;
    return s.trim().length > 0;
  });

/** Build the Prisma `where` from active query params. The `brands` param holds
 *  brand SLUGS — identical to the contract in src/app/products/all/page.tsx
 *  (`brand: { slug: { in: brands } }`). No params => base category filter only,
 *  so the plain /products/<slug> view is byte-for-byte unchanged. */
function buildWhere(category: string, sp: SP) {
  const where: Record<string, unknown> = { active: true, category: { slug: category } };

  const brands = csv(sp.brands);
  if (brands.length) where.brand = { slug: { in: brands } };   // ← SLUG

  const subtypes = csv(sp.subtypes);
  if (subtypes.length) where.subtype = { in: subtypes };

  const ram = csv(sp.ram);
  if (ram.length) where.ram = { in: ram };

  const storage = csv(sp.storage);
  if (storage.length) where.storage = { in: storage };

  const screenSize = csv(sp.screenSize);
  if (screenSize.length) where.screenSize = { in: screenSize };

  const processor = csv(sp.processor);
  if (processor.length) where.processor = { in: processor };

  const color = csv(sp.color);
  if (color.length) where.color = { in: color };

  const minRating = posNum(sp.minRating);
  if (minRating) where.ratingAvg = { gte: minRating };

  const minDiscount = posNum(sp.minDiscount);
  if (minDiscount) where.discountPercent = { gte: minDiscount };

  const warranty = posNum(sp.warranty);
  if (warranty) where.warrantyMonths = { gte: warranty };

  if (first(sp.inStock)) where.stock = { gt: 0 };

  const q = first(sp.q)?.trim();
  if (q) {
    where.OR = [
      { name: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
      { shortDescription: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
      { brand: { name: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } } },
    ];
  }

  return where;
}

function Pill({ item }: { item: ExplorerItem }) {
  if (item.off > 0)
    return <span className="rounded bg-emerald-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700">{item.off}% OFF</span>;
  if (item.isNew)
    return <span className="rounded bg-[#1a1a2e]/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-[#1a1a2e]">New</span>;
  return null;
}

function DealCard({ p }: { p: ExplorerItem }) {
  return (
    <Link href={`/product/${p.slug}`} className="flex w-[120px] shrink-0 flex-col sm:w-auto">
      <div className="relative mb-1.5 aspect-square overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50">
        {p.image ? (
          // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
          <img src={p.image} alt={p.name} loading="lazy" className="size-full object-contain" />
        ) : null}
        <span className="absolute left-1 top-1"><Pill item={p} /></span>
      </div>
      <p className="line-clamp-2 min-h-[2rem] text-[11.5px] leading-snug text-gray-800">{p.name}</p>
      <div className="mt-0.5 flex items-baseline gap-1">
        <span className="text-[12.5px] font-bold text-gray-900">{inr(p.price)}</span>
        {p.off > 0 && p.mrp ? <span className="text-[10.5px] text-gray-400 line-through">{inr(p.mrp)}</span> : null}
      </div>
    </Link>
  );
}

function DealsRail({ title, items }: { title: string; items: ExplorerItem[] }) {
  if (!items.length) return null;
  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-3">
      <h3 className="mb-2 font-display text-[13.5px] font-bold text-gray-900">{title}</h3>
      <div className="flex gap-2.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden sm:grid sm:grid-cols-4 sm:overflow-visible">
        {items.map((p) => <DealCard key={p.id} p={p} />)}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export default async function CategoryPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ category: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<SP>;
}) {
  const [{ category }, sp] = await Promise.all([params, searchParams]);
  const filtered = hasFacets(sp);
  const where = buildWhere(category, sp);

  // brandRows = name<->slug dictionaries so the tile (which only carries a name
  // via the explorer) emits the SLUG the server filter expects, and the chip can
  // show the pretty NAME instead of the raw slug.
  const [products, cat, explorer, rawSlides, brandRows] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.product.findMany({ where: where as any, select: productSelect, take: 50 }),
    prisma.category.findUnique({ where: { slug: category }, select: { name: true } }),
    getCategoryExplorer(),
    buildHeroSlides(6, { categorySlug: category }),
    prisma.brand.findMany({ select: { slug: true, name: true } }),
  ]);

  const catName = cat?.name ?? category;
  const bucket = explorer.byCategory[category];
  const brandSlugByName = new Map(brandRows.map((b) => [b.name, b.slug] as const));
  const brandNameBySlug = new Map(brandRows.map((b) => [b.slug, b.name] as const));

  const cards = toCards(products);

  // ---- FILTERED VIEW: brand's own products only, nothing category-level ----
  if (filtered) {
    const activeBrands = csv(sp.brands);
    const brandLabels = activeBrands.map((s) => brandNameBySlug.get(s) ?? s);
    const q = first(sp.q)?.trim();

    // "Clear brand" link: same URL minus the brands param (keeps size/colour/etc).
    const cleared = new URLSearchParams();
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(sp)) {
      if (k === "brands" || v == null) continue;
      (Array.isArray(v) ? v : [v]).forEach((x) => x && cleared.append(k, x));
    }
    const clearedHref = `/products/${category}${cleared.toString() ? `?${cleared}` : ""}`;

    const heading = brandLabels.length
      ? `${brandLabels.join(", ")} in ${catName}`
      : q
        ? `Results for “${q}” in ${catName}`
        : `Filtered styles in ${catName}`;

    return (
      <div className="container-x space-y-5 py-6">
        {/* Active-filter chip with a human-readable brand name + count. */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[#c9a96e]/40 bg-[#faf5eb] px-3 py-2 text-[13px]">
          <span className="font-semibold text-ink-700">Showing</span>
          {brandLabels.map((b) => (
            <span key={b} className="rounded-full bg-[#1a1a2e] px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[12px] font-bold text-white">{b}</span>
          ))}
          {q && !brandLabels.length && (
            <span className="rounded-full bg-[#1a1a2e] px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[12px] font-bold text-white">“{q}”</span>
          )}
          <span className="text-ink-400">· {cards.length} {cards.length === 1 ? "style" : "styles"} in {catName}</span>
          {brandLabels.length > 0 && (
            <Link href={clearedHref} className="ml-auto inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-bold text-[#8b6914] hover:underline">
              Clear brand ✕
            </Link>
          )}
        </div>

        <h1 className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-ink-900">{heading}</h1>

        {cards.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-300 bg-white py-12 text-center">
            <p className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink-700">No styles match this filter yet.</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">Try clearing the brand or browsing the full {catName} range.</p>
            <div className="mt-4 flex justify-center gap-2">
              <Link href={clearedHref} className="inline-flex h-9 items-center rounded-lg bg-[#1a1a2e] px-4 text-[12.5px] font-bold text-white hover:bg-[#2c3e50]">
                Clear filters
              </Link>
              <Link href={`/products/${category}`} className="inline-flex h-9 items-center rounded-lg border border-hairline px-4 text-[12.5px] font-bold text-ink-700 hover:bg-canvas">
                Browse all {catName}
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
            {cards.map((c) => (
              <ProductCard key={c.id} product={c} />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ---- UNFILTERED VIEW: original category experience (hero + picker + deals) ----
  const brandTiles: Tile[] = (bucket?.brands ?? []).map((b: ExplorerBrand) => ({
    label: b.name,
    pill: b.pill,
    image: b.image,
    href: `/products/${category}?brands=${encodeURIComponent(brandSlugByName.get(b.name) ?? b.name)}`,
  }));
  const deals = bucket?.deals ?? [];

  const slides = rawSlides.map((s: any) => ({
    id: s.id,
    imageUrl: s.image || "/placeholder-banner-bg.jpg",
    art: Boolean(s.image),
    headline: s.headline,
    highlight: s.highlight ?? "",
    description: s.description ?? `Discover top picks in ${catName}.`,
    badge: s.badge,
    ctaLabel: s.ctaLabel,
    ctaHref: s.ctaHref || `/products/${category}`,
    products: s.products,
  }));

  return (
    <div className="container-x space-y-6 py-6">
        {brandTiles.length > 0 && (
        <CollectionGrid title={`Top Brands in ${catName}`} tiles={brandTiles} tone="plain" columns={4} />
      )}
      <DealsRail title={`Top Deals in ${catName}`} items={deals} />
      <ProductListClient
        initialProducts={cards}
        total={cards.length}
        categorySlug={category}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

export default async function SearchRedirect({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const q = Array.isArray(sp.q) ? sp.q[0] : sp.q;
  redirect(`/products/all${q ? `?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}` : ""}`);
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { productSelect, toCards } from "@/lib/catalog";
import { MEN_GROUPS } from "@/lib/men-taxonomy";
import { SponsoredAdCard } from "@/components/product/SponsoredAdCard";
import { ProductCard } from "@/components/product/ProductCard";
import { HeroCarousel } from "@/components/home/HeroCarousel";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

type SP = Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>;
const first = (v: string | string[] | undefined) => (Array.isArray(v) ? v[0] : v);
const termOf = (href: string) => {
  const i = href.indexOf("q=");
  return i === -1 ? "" : decodeURIComponent(href.slice(i + 2));
};

/**
 * Dedicated storefront page per header group (Footwear, Top wear, Winter Wear…).
 * Same anatomy as Home: hero banner -> dynamic ad slot -> sub-category tiles ->
 * deals rail -> product grid. Membership comes from the group's `matcher`
 * (name/subtype regex); groups without a matcher (Featured) fall back to their
 * item search terms. `?q=<term>` narrows within the group (dropdown sub-items).
 */
export default async function ShopGroupPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ group: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<SP>;
}) {
  const [{ group: slug }, sp] = await Promise.all([params, searchParams]);
  const group = MEN_GROUPS.find((g) => g.slug === slug);
  if (!group) notFound();

  const rawQ = (first(sp.q) ?? "").trim();
  const q = rawQ.toLowerCase();

  const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: { active: true },
    select: productSelect,
    take: 300,
  });

  const re = group.matcher ? new RegExp(group.matcher, "i") : null;
  let matched = re
    ? rows.filter((r: any) => re.test(`${r.name} ${r.subtype ?? ""}`))
    : rows.filter((r: any) =>
        group.items.some((it) => {
          const t = termOf(it.href).toLowerCase();
          return t ? `${r.name} ${r.brand?.name ?? ""}`.toLowerCase().includes(t) : false;
        }),
      );
  if (q) {
    matched = matched.filter((r: any) =>
      `${r.name} ${r.shortDescription ?? ""} ${r.brand?.name ?? ""}`.toLowerCase().includes(q),
    );
  }

    const cards = toCards(matched);

   // Dynamic hero slides. Prefers the group's OWN best-sellers; when the group has
  // no stock yet (e.g. Men's Grooming today), falls back to site-wide best-sellers
  // so the carousel is never a dead static banner. The moment products are added
  // to the group, `matched` becomes non-empty and they take over the hero
  // automatically — no code change, fully data-driven.
  const heroSource = matched.length > 0 ? matched : rows;
  const heroSlides = heroSource
    .slice()
    .sort((a: any, b: any) => (b.sold ?? 0) - (a.sold ?? 0))
    .slice(0, 6)
    .map((p: any) => ({
      id: `group-${group.slug}-${p.id}`,
      imageUrl:
        p.images?.find((i: any) => i.isPrimary)?.url ??
        p.images?.[0]?.url ??
        "/placeholder-banner-bg.jpg",
      art: false,
      headline: p.name,
      highlight: group.label,
      description:
        matched.length > 0
          ? `${group.subtitle} · ${p.brand?.name ?? "Urban Vogue"}`
          : `Coming soon to ${group.label} · Meanwhile: ${p.brand?.name ?? "Urban Vogue"}`,
      badge: (p.discountPercent ?? 0) > 0 ? `${p.discountPercent}% OFF` : null,
      ctaLabel: "Shop Now",
      ctaHref: `/product/${p.slug}`,
      products: toCards([p]),
    }));

  const adCandidates = matched
    .slice()
    .sort((a: any, b: any) => (b.sold ?? 0) - (a.sold ?? 0))
    .slice(0, 8)
    .map((p: any) => ({
      id: p.id, slug: p.slug, name: p.name, mrp: p.mrp, salePrice: p.salePrice,
      image: p.images?.find((i: any) => i.isPrimary)?.url ?? p.images?.[0]?.url ?? null,
    }));

  const deals = cards.filter((c: any) => (c.discountPercent ?? 0) > 0).slice(0, 4);

  const itemTiles = group.items.map((it) => {
    const term = termOf(it.href);
    const hit = rows.find((r: any) =>
      term ? `${r.name} ${r.subtype ?? ""}`.toLowerCase().includes(term.toLowerCase()) : false,
    );
    return {
      label: it.label,
      term,
      image: hit?.images?.find((i: any) => i.isPrimary)?.url ?? hit?.images?.[0]?.url ?? null,
    };
  });

  return (
    <div className="container-x space-y-6 py-6">
            {/* ── group identity row ── */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display text-xl font-black text-ink-900 sm:text-2xl">{group.label}</h1>
          <p className="text-[12px] text-ink-400">{group.subtitle} · {cards.length} styles</p>
        </div>
        {q && (
          <p className="text-[12px] text-ink-400">
            Narrowed to “{rawQ}” ·{" "}
            <Link href={`/shop/${group.slug}`} className="text-[#8b6914] underline underline-offset-2">
              clear
            </Link>
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ── dynamic hero carousel (same component + slide shape as Home) ── */}
      {heroSlides.length > 0 ? (
        <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl">
          <HeroCarousel slides={heroSlides} />
        </section>
      ) : (
        <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-[linear-gradient(120deg,#1a1a2e_0%,#2c3e50_55%,#8b6914_130%)] px-6 py-8 text-white sm:px-10">
          <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#e0cfa8]">Urban Vogue · Men's Store</p>
          <h2 className="mt-2 font-display text-2xl font-black sm:text-3xl">{group.label}</h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-white/70">{group.subtitle} · stocking soon</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── dynamic ad slot (same component Home/product pages use) ── */}
      {adCandidates.length > 0 && (
                <SponsoredAdCard seed={group.slug} products={adCandidates} />
      )}

      {/* ── sub-category tiles (the dropdo
      wn items, as a page section) ── */}
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-hairline bg-white p-4">
        <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-[14px] font-bold text-ink-900">Shop by style</h2>
        <div className="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-1 [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden">
          {itemTiles.map((t) => (
            <Link
              key={t.label}
              href={`/shop/${group.slug}?q=${encodeURIComponent(t.term)}`}
              className="flex w-[104px] shrink-0 flex-col items-center"
            >
              <span className="relative aspect-square w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-hairline bg-canvas">
                {t.image ? (
                  // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                  <img src={t.image} alt={t.label} className="size-full object-cover" />
                ) : null}
                <span className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-1.5 bg-[linear-gradient(90deg,#b8963f,#e0cfa8,#b8963f)]" />
              </span>
              <span className="mt-1.5 w-full truncate text-center text-[11px] font-semibold text-ink-700">
                {t.label}
              </span>
            </Link>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* ── deals rail ── */}
      {deals.length > 0 && (
        <section className="rounded-xl border border-hairline bg-white p-4">
          <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-[14px] font-bold text-ink-900">Top deals in {group.label}</h2>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
            {deals.map((c: any) => (
              <ProductCard key={c.id} product={c} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {/* ── main grid ── */}
      <section>
        <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
          {q ? `Results for “${rawQ}” in ${group.label}` : `All ${group.label}`}
        </h2>
        {cards.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-300 bg-white py-12 text-center">
            <p className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink-700">No styles in this section yet.</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">New {group.label.toLowerCase()} drops land here first.</p>
            <Link
              href="/products/all"
              className="mt-4 inline-flex h-9 items-center rounded-lg bg-[#1a1a2e] px-4 text-[12.5px] font-bold text-white hover:bg-[#2c3e50]"
            >
              Browse everything
            </Link>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
            {cards.map((c: any) => (
              <ProductCard key={c.id} product={c} />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src\app\sitemap.ts

import type { MetadataRoute } from "next";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { siteUrl } from "@/lib/utils";

// Generate on demand, never at build time. This is the entire point: a DB-backed
// sitemap must not be prerendered during `next build`, because the build machine has
// no DATABASE_URL (and Neon may be asleep) — which is exactly what killed the last
// deploy ("Environment variable not found: DATABASE_URL" while generating static
// pages). force-dynamic excludes this route from static generation, so the build is
// immune; at runtime Vercel injects the env and the query runs against the live pooler.
// We DROP `revalidate = 3600` on purpose: ISR would still seed this route at build
// time — the very behavior being removed. A sitemap is crawled rarely, so per-request
// generation is cheap; if you later want caching, add a short-TTL Upstash read here,
// not ISR.
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function sitemap(): Promise<MetadataRoute.Sitemap> {
  const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: { active: true },
    select: { slug: true, updatedAt: true },
    take: 5000,
  });

  const categories = await prisma.category.findMany({
    where: { active: true },
    select: { slug: true },
  });

  const staticRoutes: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = [
    { url: siteUrl("/"), changeFrequency: "daily", priority: 1 },
    { url: siteUrl("/products/all"), changeFrequency: "daily", priority: 0.9 },
    { url: siteUrl("/offers"), changeFrequency: "daily", priority: 0.8 },
    { url: siteUrl("/track"), changeFrequency: "monthly", priority: 0.5 },
    { url: siteUrl("/contact"), changeFrequency: "monthly", priority: 0.5 },
  ];

  const categoryRoutes: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = categories.map((c) => ({
    url: siteUrl(`/products/${c.slug}`),
    changeFrequency: "daily",
    priority: 0.8,
  }));

  const productRoutes: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = products.map((p) => ({
    url: siteUrl(`/product/${p.slug}`),
    lastModified: p.updatedAt,
    changeFrequency: "weekly",
    priority: 0.7,
  }));

  return [...staticRoutes, ...categoryRoutes, ...productRoutes];
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { getActor } from "@/lib/auth/guards";
import { TrackingTimeline } from "@/components/tracking/TrackingTimeline";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { formatDateTime, inr, normalizeMobile } from "@/lib/utils";
import { createGuestTrackToken } from "@/lib/track-token";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "Track order",
  description: "Track your Urban Vogue order using order number and email/mobile.",
};

const STATUS_TONE: Record<
  string,
  "info" | "save" | "warn" | "deal" | "neutral" | "violet"
> = {
  PENDING: "warn",
  CONFIRMED: "info",
  PROCESSING: "info",
  SHIPPED: "violet",
  OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: "warn",
  DELIVERED: "save",
  CANCELLED: "deal",
};

export default async function TrackPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const actor = await getActor();

  const orderNumber =
    typeof sp.order === "string" ? sp.order.trim().toUpperCase() : "";
  const identifier =
    typeof sp.id === "string"
      ? sp.id.trim().toLowerCase()
      : typeof sp.email === "string"
        ? sp.email.trim().toLowerCase()
        : typeof sp.phone === "string"
          ? sp.phone.trim()
          : "";

  let order = null;
  let error: string | null = null;

  if (orderNumber) {
    order = await prisma.order.findUnique({
      where: { orderNumber },
      include: {
        user: { select: { id: true, email: true, phone: true } },
        items: { select: { name: true, quantity: true }, take: 3 },
        trackingEvents: { orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" } },
      },
    });

    if (!order) {
      error = "Order not found. Check the order number.";
    } else {
      const isOwner = actor?.id === order.userId;
      const isStaff =
        !!actor && ["ADMIN", "MANAGER", "STAFF"].includes(actor.role);

      const normalizedIdentifier = normalizeMobile(identifier) ?? identifier;

      const matches =
        order.user?.email?.toLowerCase() === normalizedIdentifier ||
        order.guestEmail?.toLowerCase() === normalizedIdentifier ||
        order.user?.phone === normalizedIdentifier ||
        order.guestPhone === normalizedIdentifier;

      if (!isOwner && !isStaff && !matches) {
        error =
          "For privacy, enter the email or mobile number used while placing the order.";
        order = null;
      }
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="container-x py-10">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl">
        <header className="mb-6 text-center">
          <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-electric-600">
            Order tracking
          </p>
          <h1 className="mt-1 font-display text-3xl font-bold text-ink-900">
            Track your Urban Vogue order
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-[13.5px] text-ink-400">
            Enter your order number and the email or mobile used at checkout.
          </p>
        </header>

        <form method="get" action="/track" className="card grid gap-3 p-5 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_auto] sm:items-end">
          <Input
            label="Order number"
            name="order"
            defaultValue={orderNumber}
            placeholder="UVXXXXXXXX"
            required
          />

          <Input
            label="Email or mobile"
            name="id"
            defaultValue={identifier}
            placeholder="you@email.com or 9876543210"
            required
          />

          <Button type="submit" size="lg" className="h-12">
            Track
          </Button>
        </form>

        {error && (
          <p role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-4 py-3 text-[13px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}

        {order && (
          <section className="card mt-6 overflow-hidden">
            <header className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-hairline bg-canvas/60 px-5 py-4">
              <div>
                <p className="font-display text-lg font-bold text-ink-900">
                  {order.orderNumber}
                </p>
                <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">
                  Placed {formatDateTime(order.createdAt)} · {inr(order.total)}
                </p>
              </div>

              <Badge tone={STATUS_TONE[order.status] ?? "neutral"}>
                {order.status.replace(/_/g, " ")}
              </Badge>
            </header>

            <div className="p-5">
              <TrackingTimeline
                status={order.status}
                events={order.trackingEvents.map((e) => ({
                  id: e.id,
                  status: e.status,
                  title: e.title,
                  description: e.description,
                  location: e.location,
                  createdAt: e.createdAt.toISOString(),
                }))}
                eta={
                  order.etaFrom && order.etaTo
                    ? {
                        from: order.etaFrom.toISOString(),
                        to: order.etaTo.toISOString(),
                      }
                    : null
                }
                carrier={order.carrier}
                trackingNumber={order.trackingNumber}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="border-t border-hairline p-5">
              <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
                Items
              </h2>

              <ul className="space-y-2 text-[13px] text-ink-700">
                {order.items.map((item, idx) => (
                  <li key={idx} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{item.name}</span>
                    <span className="shrink-0 font-bold tabular-nums">
                      Qty {item.quantity}
                    </span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>

              <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <Button
  href={`/order/${order.orderNumber}?tok=${createGuestTrackToken(order.orderNumber)}`}
  size="sm"
>
  View full invoice
</Button>

                <Button href="/contact" variant="outline" size="sm">
                  Need help?
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>
        )}

        <p className="mt-6 text-center text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">
          Registered customer?{" "}
          <Link href="/account/orders" className="font-bold text-electric-600 hover:underline">
            View all orders
          </Link>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";

type Raw = { name?: string; image?: string; slug?: string; id?: string };
type Tile = { name: string; image: string; slug?: string; id?: string };

// Same device-local history the PDP writes on every product view, so the strip is
// genuinely per-shopper/per-visit with no new storage and no server round-trip.
const RECENT_KEY = "uv:recent:v1";

export function AccountRecentlyViewed({ title = "Recently Viewed Stores" }: { title?: string }) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Tile[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(RECENT_KEY);
      if (!raw) return;
      const list = JSON.parse(raw) as Raw[];
      if (!Array.isArray(list)) return;
      setItems(list.filter((r): r is Tile => Boolean(r && r.image && r.name)).slice(0, 12));
    } catch {
      /* private mode / corrupt storage: the strip simply stays hidden */
    }
  }, []);

  // Flipkart hides the section entirely when there's no history — match that.
  if (items.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <section className="mt-6" aria-label={title}>
      <h2 className="px-4 font-display text-[16px] font-bold text-gray-900">{title}</h2>
      <div className="no-scrollbar mt-2 flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto px-4 pb-1">
        {items.map((it, i) => {
          const href = it.slug ? `/product/${it.slug}` : it.id ? `/product/${it.id}` : null;
          const tile = (
            <div className="flex w-[112px] shrink-0 flex-col">
              <div className="relative aspect-square w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-100 bg-white">
                {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                <img
                  src={it.image}
                  alt={it.name}
                  loading="lazy"
                  className="size-full object-contain p-2 transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-105"
                />
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1.5 line-clamp-2 text-center text-[11.5px] font-medium leading-tight text-gray-700">
                {it.name}
              </p>
            </div>
          );
          return href ? (
            <Link key={`${it.slug ?? it.id}-${i}`} href={href} className="group block">
              {tile}
            </Link>
          ) : (
            <div key={`${it.name}-${i}`} className="group block">
              {tile}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\account\AccountSponsoredCard.tsx
============================================================

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";

export type SponsoredItem = {
  key: string;
  href: string;
  image: string;
  name: string;
  price: number;
  off: number;
};

/**
 * The account page's Sponsored slot as ONE feature card that slides right-to-left
 * every 4s through the server-supplied random pool. No dots, no arrows, no "View
 * all" — the motion itself is the pagination. The pool is re-randomized per request
 * over ALL active+in-stock products, so this is a dynamic ad: anything you publish
 * later can appear on the next page load with no code change.
 */
export function AccountSponsoredCard({ items }: { items: SponsoredItem[] }) {
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0);
  const count = items.length;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (count <= 1) return; // nothing to rotate
    // Auto-advancing content with no controls should yield to reduced-motion; the
    // first card still shows. Drop this guard if you want it to move regardless.
    if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;
    const t = window.setInterval(() => setIndex((i) => (i + 1) % count), 4000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(t);
  }, [count]);

  if (count === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl shadow-sm">
      {/* No gap on the track: each child is exactly w-full, so -index*100% slides
          precisely one card per step (right-to-left as index grows). */}
      <div
        className="flex transition-transform duration-700 ease-out"
        style={{ transform: `translateX(-${index * 100}%)` }}
      >
        {items.map((it) => (
          <Link
            key={it.key}
            href={it.href}
            className="relative flex w-full shrink-0 items-center gap-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#101c30] to-[#1a1a2e] p-4 text-white"
          >
            <span className="absolute right-2 top-2 rounded bg-white/15 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest">
              Sponsored
            </span>
            {it.image ? (
              // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
              <img src={it.image} alt="" className="size-20 shrink-0 rounded-lg object-cover" />
            ) : (
              <span className="grid size-20 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-white/10 text-2xl font-black">
                {it.name.charAt(0) || "V"}
              </span>
            )}
            <span className="min-w-0">
              <span className="block truncate text-sm font-bold">{it.name}</span>
              <span className="mt-1 block text-lg font-black">
                ₹{it.price.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
              </span>
              {it.off > 0 && (
                <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] font-semibold text-yellow-300">
                  {it.off}% off · Deal of the day
                </span>
              )}
            </span>
          </Link>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\account\AddressesClient.tsx

"use client";

import { Check, MapPin, Pencil, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Checkbox, Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import type { AddressVM } from "@/lib/address-types";

const blank = {
  label: "Home",
  fullName: "",
  phone: "",
  altPhone: "",
  pincode: "",
  line1: "",
  line2: "",
  city: "",
  state: "",
  isDefault: false,
};

export function AddressesClient({ initial }: { initial: AddressVM[] }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [items, setItems] = useState(initial);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ ...blank });
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  function startEdit(a: AddressVM) {
    setEditingId(a.id);
    setForm({
      label: a.label,
      fullName: a.fullName,
      phone: a.phone,
      altPhone: a.altPhone ?? "",
      pincode: a.pincode,
      line1: a.line1,
      line2: a.line2 ?? "",
      city: a.city,
      state: a.state,
      isDefault: a.isDefault,
    });
  }

  function cancelEdit() {
    setEditingId(null);
    setForm({ ...blank });
    setError(null);
  }

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(editingId ? `/api/account/addresses/${editingId}` : "/api/account/addresses", {
        method: editingId ? "PATCH" : "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(form),
      });

      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Could save address.");

      toast.push({ title: editingId ? "Address updated" : "Address added" });
      cancelEdit();
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could save address.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function makeDefault(id: string) {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/account/addresses/${id}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ isDefault: true }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Could update default address.");
      setItems((prev) => prev.map((a) => ({ ...a, isDefault: a.id === id })));
      toast.push({ title: "Default address updated" });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.push({
        tone: "error",
        title: "Update failed",
        body: err instanceof Error ? err.message : undefined,
      });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function remove(id: string) {
    if (!window.confirm("Delete this address?")) return;

    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/account/addresses/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Could delete address.");
      setItems((prev) => prev.filter((a) => a.id !== id));
      if (editingId === id) cancelEdit();
      toast.push({ title: "Address deleted" });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.push({
        tone: "error",
        title: "Delete failed",
        body: err instanceof Error ? err.message : undefined,
      });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <header className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h1 className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-ink-900">Saved addresses</h1>
        <Button size="sm" onClick={() => { cancelEdit(); }}>
          <Plus className="size-3.5" />
          Add address
        </Button>
      </header>

      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="card p-5 text-[13.5px] text-ink-400">No saved addresses yet.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="space-y-3">
          {items.map((a) => (
            <li key={a.id} className="card p-4">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <p className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">{a.fullName}</p>
                    <Badge tone="neutral">{a.label}</Badge>
                    {a.isDefault && <Badge tone="info">Default</Badge>}
                  </div>

                  <p className="mt-1.5 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-ink-400">
                    {a.line1}
                    {a.line2 ? `, ${a.line2}` : ""}, {a.city}, {a.state} — {a.pincode}
                  </p>

                  <p className="mt-1 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-ink-700">
                    ☎ {a.phone}
                    {a.altPhone ? ` · Alt ${a.altPhone}` : ""}
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => startEdit(a)}>
                    <Pencil className="size-3.5" />
                    Edit
                  </Button>

                  {!a.isDefault && (
                    <Button size="sm" variant="outline" loading={busy} onClick={() => void makeDefault(a.id)}>
                      <Check className="size-3.5" />
                      Set default
                    </Button>
                  )}

                  <Button size="sm" variant="danger" loading={busy} onClick={() => void remove(a.id)}>
                    <Trash2 className="size-3.5" />
                    Delete
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      <form onSubmit={submit} className="card space-y-4 p-5">
        <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
          <MapPin className="size-4 text-electric-600" />
          {editingId ? "Edit address" : "Add new address"}
        </h2>

        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Input label="Label" value={form.label} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, label: e.target.value })} placeholder="Home / Office" />
          <Input label="Full name" value={form.fullName} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, fullName: e.target.value })} required />
          <Input label="Mobile" value={form.phone} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, phone: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 10) })} inputMode="numeric" required />
          <Input label="Alternate mobile" value={form.altPhone} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, altPhone: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 10) })} inputMode="numeric" />
          <Input label="PIN code" value={form.pincode} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, pincode: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 6) })} inputMode="numeric" required />
          <Input label="City" value={form.city} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, city: e.target.value })} required />
          <Input containerClassName="sm:col-span-2" label="Flat, house no., building, street" value={form.line1} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, line1: e.target.value })} required />
          <Input containerClassName="sm:col-span-2" label="Area, landmark" value={form.line2} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, line2: e.target.value })} />
          <Input label="State" value={form.state} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, state: e.target.value })} required />
        </div>

        <Checkbox
          checked={form.isDefault}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, isDefault: e.target.checked })}
          label="Make this my default delivery address"
        />

        {error && (
          <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}

        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button type="submit" loading={busy}>
            {editingId ? "Update address" : "Save address"}
          </Button>
          {editingId && (
            <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={cancelEdit}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

============================================================
FILE: src\components\account\AddressesManager.tsx
============================================================

"use client";

import { Check, Loader2, MapPin, Pencil, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Checkbox, Input, Select } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import type { AddressVM } from "@/lib/address-types";

const emptyForm = {
  label: "Home",
  fullName: "",
  phone: "",
  altPhone: "",
  pincode: "",
  line1: "",
  line2: "",
  city: "",
  state: "",
  isDefault: false,
};

export function AddressesManager({ initial }: { initial: AddressVM[] }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [addresses, setAddresses] = useState(initial);
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(initial.length === 0);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyForm);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  function startAdd() {
    setEditingId(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setShowForm(true);
    setError(null);
  }

  function startEdit(a: AddressVM) {
    setEditingId(a.id);
    setForm({
      label: a.label,
      fullName: a.fullName,
      phone: a.phone,
      altPhone: a.altPhone ?? "",
      pincode: a.pincode,
      line1: a.line1,
      line2: a.line2 ?? "",
      city: a.city,
      state: a.state,
      isDefault: a.isDefault,
    });
    setShowForm(true);
    setError(null);
  }

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const url = editingId ? `/api/account/addresses/${editingId}` : "/api/account/addresses";
      const method = editingId ? "PATCH" : "POST";

      const res = await fetch(url, {
        method,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(form),
      });

      const json = (await res.json()) as {
        ok: boolean;
        error?: string;
        fields?: Record<string, string[]>;
        address?: AddressVM;
      };

      if (!json.ok || !json.address) {
        const first = json.fields ? Object.values(json.fields).flat()[0] : json.error;
        throw new Error(first ?? "Could not save address.");
      }

      setAddresses((prev) => {
        if (editingId) return prev.map((a) => (a.id === editingId ? json.address! : a));
        return [json.address!, ...prev];
      });

      setShowForm(false);
      setEditingId(null);
      setForm(emptyForm);
      toast.push({ title: editingId ? "Address updated" : "Address added" });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not save address.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function setDefault(id: string) {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/account/addresses/${id}`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ isDefault: true }),
    });
    const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
    if (!json.ok) {
      toast.push({ tone: "error", title: "Could not set default", body: json.error });
      return;
    }
    setAddresses((prev) => prev.map((a) => ({ ...a, isDefault: a.id === id })));
    toast.push({ title: "Default address updated" });
    router.refresh();
  }

  async function remove(id: string) {
    if (!window.confirm("Delete this address?")) return;
    const res = await fetch(`/api/account/addresses/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
    const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
    if (!json.ok) {
      toast.push({ tone: "error", title: "Delete failed", body: json.error });
      return;
    }
    setAddresses((prev) => prev.filter((a) => a.id !== id));
    toast.push({ tone: "info", title: "Address deleted" });
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">Saved addresses</h2>
        <Button size="sm" onClick={startAdd}>
          <Plus className="size-3.5" /> Add address
        </Button>
      </div>

      {showForm && (
        <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="card grid gap-3 p-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Select
            containerClassName="sm:col-span-2"
            label="Label"
            value={form.label}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, label: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option>Home</option>
            <option>Work</option>
            <option>Other</option>
          </Select>

          <Input containerClassName="sm:col-span-2" label="Full name" value={form.fullName} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, fullName: e.target.value })} required />
          <Input label="Mobile" value={form.phone} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, phone: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 10) })} required inputMode="numeric" />
          <Input label="Alternate mobile" value={form.altPhone} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, altPhone: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 10) })} inputMode="numeric" />
          <Input label="PIN code" value={form.pincode} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, pincode: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 6) })} required inputMode="numeric" />
          <Input label="City" value={form.city} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, city: e.target.value })} required />
          <Input containerClassName="sm:col-span-2" label="Flat, house no., building, street" value={form.line1} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, line1: e.target.value })} required />
          <Input containerClassName="sm:col-span-2" label="Area, landmark" value={form.line2} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, line2: e.target.value })} />
          <Input label="State" value={form.state} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, state: e.target.value })} required />

          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <Checkbox checked={form.isDefault} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, isDefault: e.target.checked })} label="Set as default address" />
          </div>

          {error && (
            <p role="alert" className="sm:col-span-2 rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}

          <div className="flex gap-2 sm:col-span-2">
            <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setShowForm(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" size="sm" loading={busy} className="flex-1">
              {editingId ? "Update address" : "Save address"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}

      {addresses.length === 0 && !showForm && (
        <p className="card p-5 text-center text-[13.5px] text-ink-400">
          No saved addresses yet. Add one to speed up checkout.
        </p>
      )}

      <ul className="space-y-3">
        {addresses.map((a) => (
          <li key={a.id} className="card p-4">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <p className="text-[14px] font-bold text-ink-900">{a.fullName}</p>
                  <Badge tone="neutral">{a.label}</Badge>
                  {a.isDefault && (
                    <Badge tone="info">
                      <Check className="size-3" /> Default
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-ink-400">
                  {a.line1}
                  {a.line2 ? `, ${a.line2}` : ""}, {a.city}, {a.state} — {a.pincode}
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-ink-700">
                  ☎ {a.phone}
                  {a.altPhone ? ` · ${a.altPhone}` : ""}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col gap-1.5">
                <button onClick={() => startEdit(a)} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[12px] font-bold text-ink-400 hover:bg-canvas hover:text-ink-900">
                  <Pencil className="size-3.5" /> Edit
                </button>
                {!a.isDefault && (
                  <button onClick={() => void setDefault(a.id)} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[12px] font-bold text-electric-600 hover:bg-electric-50">
                    <MapPin className="size-3.5" /> Set default
                  </button>
                )}
                <button onClick={() => void remove(a.id)} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[12px] font-bold text-flame-600 hover:bg-flame-500/10">
                  <Trash2 className="size-3.5" /> Delete
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { CheckCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";

export function MarkNotificationsRead({ count }: { count: number }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  if (count <= 0) return null;

  async function markRead() {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/account/notifications/read", { method: "POST" });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Could not mark read.");

      toast.push({ title: "Notifications marked read" });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.push({
        tone: "error",
        title: "Update failed",
        body: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined,
      });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Button size="sm" variant="outline" loading={busy} onClick={markRead}>
      {!busy && <CheckCheck className="size-3.5" />}
      Mark all read
    </Button>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\account\NotificationsClient.tsx
