"use client";

import { Bell, CheckCheck, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/EmptyState";
import { relativeTime } from "@/lib/utils";

export type NotificationVM = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  body: string;
  href: string | null;
  read: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  channel: string;
};

export function NotificationsClient({ initial }: { initial: NotificationVM[] }) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState(initial);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const unread = items.filter((i) => !i.read).length;

  async function markOne(id: string) {
    setItems((prev) => prev.map((n) => (n.id === id ? { ...n, read: true } : n)));
    await fetch("/api/account/notifications", {
      method: "PATCH",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ id }),
    }).catch(() => undefined);
  }

  async function markAll() {
    setBusy(true);
    setItems((prev) => prev.map((n) => ({ ...n, read: true })));
    await fetch("/api/account/notifications", {
      method: "PATCH",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ all: true }),
    }).catch(() => undefined);
    setBusy(false);
  }

  if (!items.length) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        icon={<Bell className="size-6" />}
        title="No notifications yet"
        body="Order updates, support replies and offer alerts will appear here."
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
          Notifications {unread > 0 && <span className="text-electric-600">({unread} unread)</span>}
        </h2>
        {unread > 0 && (
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={markAll} loading={busy}>
            {!busy && <CheckCheck className="size-3.5" />} Mark all read
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>

      <ul className="card divide-y divide-hairline">
        {items.map((n) => (
          <li key={n.id} className={`p-4 ${n.read ? "" : "bg-electric-50/40"}`}>
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <span className={`mt-1 size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${n.read ? "bg-ink-300/30" : "bg-electric-500"}`} />
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <p className="text-[13.5px] font-bold text-ink-900">{n.title}</p>
                  <Badge tone="neutral">{n.channel.replace(/_/g, " ")}</Badge>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-ink-400">{n.body}</p>
                <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[11.5px] text-ink-300">{relativeTime(n.createdAt)}</span>
                  {n.href && (
                    <Link href={n.href} onClick={() => void markOne(n.id)} className="text-[12px] font-bold text-electric-600 hover:underline">
                      Open
                    </Link>
                  )}
                  {!n.read && (
                    <button onClick={() => void markOne(n.id)} className="text-[12px] font-bold text-ink-400 hover:text-ink-900">
                      Mark read
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Save, UserCog } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

import { Checkbox, Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";

type Initial = {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  phone: string | null;
  whatsappOptIn: boolean;
  marketingOptIn: boolean;
};

export function ProfileClient({ initial }: { initial: Initial }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: initial.name,
    phone: initial.phone ?? "",
    whatsappOptIn: initial.whatsappOptIn,
    marketingOptIn: initial.marketingOptIn,
  });
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/account/profile", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          name: form.name,
          phone: form.phone.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 10),
          whatsappOptIn: form.whatsappOptIn,

      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could update profile.");

      setBusy(false);

      <header className="card p-5">

        <Input
          label="Full name"
          value={form.name}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })}
          required
          minLength={2}
        />

        <Input
          label="Email"
          value={initial.email}
          disabled
          hint="Email is used for login and cannot be changed from this page."
        />

        <Input
          label="Mobile number"
          value={form.phone}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, phone: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 10) })}
          inputMode="numeric"
          placeholder="9876543210"
        />

        {/* <Checkbox
          checked={form.whatsappOptIn}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, whatsappOptIn: e.target.checked })}
          label="Send order updates and offer alerts on WhatsApp"
        />

        <Checkbox
          checked={form.marketingOptIn}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, marketingOptIn: e.target.checked })}

        {error && (

FILE: src\components\account\ProfileForm.tsx

"use client";

import { Loader2, Save } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Checkbox, Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { useCart } from "@/context/CartContext";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";

type Initial = {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  phone: string | null;
  whatsappOptIn: boolean;
  role: string;
};

export function ProfileForm({ initial }: { initial: Initial }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { setUser } = useCart();
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: initial.name,
    phone: initial.phone ?? "",
    whatsappOptIn: initial.whatsappOptIn,
  });
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/account/profile", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(form),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as {
        ok: boolean;
        error?: string;
        fields?: Record<string, string[]>;
        user?: { id: string; name: string; email: string; role: string };
      };

      if (!json.ok || !json.user) {
        const first = json.fields ? Object.values(json.fields).flat()[0] : json.error;
        throw new Error(first ?? "Could not update profile.");
      }

      setUser(json.user);
      toast.push({ title: "Profile updated" });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not update profile.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="card space-y-4 p-5">
      <div>
        <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">Personal information</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">
          Email is locked for security. Contact support to change it.
        </p>
      </div>

      <Input label="Full name" value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })} required />
      <Input label="Email" value={initial.email} disabled />
      <Input
        label="Mobile number"
        value={form.phone}
        onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, phone: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 10) })}
        inputMode="numeric"
        placeholder="9876543210"
      />

      <Checkbox
        checked={form.whatsappOptIn}
        onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, whatsappOptIn: e.target.checked })}
        label="Enable WhatsApp order updates and offer alerts"
      />

      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      <Button type="submit" loading={busy}>
        {!busy && <Save className="size-4" />}
        Save changes
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\account\SupportCenter.tsx
============================================================

"use client";

import { LifeBuoy, Plus, Send } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input, Select, Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import { formatDateTime, relativeTime } from "@/lib/utils";

type Message = {
  id: string;
  body: string;
  fromStaff: boolean;
  author: string;
  createdAt: string;
};

type Ticket = {
  id: string;
  reference: string;
  subject: string;
  category: string;
  status: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  messages: Message[];
};

const STATUS_TONE: Record<string, "info" | "save" | "warn" | "deal" | "neutral"> = {
  OPEN: "warn",
  UNDER_REVIEW: "info",
  RESOLVED: "save",
  CLOSED: "neutral",
};

export function SupportCenter({ tickets }: { tickets: Ticket[] }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState<string | null>(tickets[0]?.id ?? null);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    subject: "",
    category: "GENERAL",
    message: "",
  });

  const [replies, setReplies] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [replyBusy, setReplyBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function createTicket(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setCreating(true);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/support", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(form),
      });

      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Could not create ticket.");

      toast.push({ title: "Support ticket created" });
      setForm({ subject: "", category: "GENERAL", message: "" });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.push({
        tone: "error",
        title: "Ticket failed",
        body: err instanceof Error ? err.message : undefined,
      });
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  }

  async function reply(ticketId: string) {
    const body = replies[ticketId]?.trim();
    if (!body) return;

    setReplyBusy(ticketId);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/support/${ticketId}/messages`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ body }),
      });

      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Reply failed.");

      setReplies((prev) => ({ ...prev, [ticketId]: "" }));
      toast.push({ title: "Reply sent" });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.push({
        tone: "error",
        title: "Reply failed",
        body: err instanceof Error ? err.message : undefined,
      });
    } finally {
      setReplyBusy(null);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <section className="card p-5">
        <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
          <Plus className="size-4 text-electric-600" />
          Open a new ticket
        </h2>

        <form onSubmit={createTicket} className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Input
            containerClassName="sm:col-span-2"
            label="Subject"
            value={form.subject}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, subject: e.target.value })}
            required
            minLength={4}
            maxLength={120}
          />

          <Select
            label="Category"
            value={form.category}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, category: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="ORDER">Order</option>
            <option value="PAYMENT">Payment</option>
            <option value="PRODUCT">Product</option>
            <option value="RETURN">Return</option>
            <option value="ACCOUNT">Account</option>
            <option value="GENERAL">General</option>
          </Select>

          <Textarea
            containerClassName="sm:col-span-2"
            label="Message"
            value={form.message}
            onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, message: e.target.value })}
            rows={5}
            required
            minLength={10}
            placeholder="Describe the issue. Include order number if relevant."
          />

          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <Button type="submit" loading={creating}>
              {!creating && <LifeBuoy className="size-4" />}
              Create ticket
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </section>

      <section className="card overflow-hidden">
        <header className="border-b border-hairline px-4 py-3">
          <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">Your tickets</h2>
        </header>

        {tickets.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="p-5 text-[13.5px] text-ink-400">No support tickets yet.</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-hairline">
            {tickets.map((t) => {
              const open = openId === t.id;

              return (
                <li key={t.id}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setOpenId(open ? null : t.id)}
                    className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 p-4 text-left hover:bg-canvas/50"
                  >
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                        <p className="font-bold text-ink-900">{t.subject}</p>
                        <Badge tone={STATUS_TONE[t.status] ?? "neutral"}>
                          {t.status.replace(/_/g, " ")}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-[12px] text-ink-400">
                        {t.reference} · {relativeTime(t.updatedAt)}
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <span className="shrink-0 text-[12px] font-bold text-electric-600">
                      {open ? "Hide" : "Open"}
                    </span>
                  </button>

                  {open && (
                    <div className="border-t border-hairline bg-canvas/30 p-4">
                      <ul className="space-y-3">
                        {t.messages.map((m) => (
                          <li key={m.id} className={`flex ${m.fromStaff ? "justify-end" : "justify-start"}`}>
                            <div
                              className={`max-w-[85%] rounded-2xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[13px] leading-relaxed ${
                                m.fromStaff ? "bg-ink-900 text-white" : "bg-white text-ink-900 ring-1 ring-hairline"
                              }`}
                            >
                              <p>{m.body}</p>
                              <p className={`mt-1 text-[10.5px] ${m.fromStaff ? "text-white/50" : "text-ink-400"}`}>
                                {m.author} · {formatDateTime(m.createdAt)}
                              </p>
                            </div>
                          </li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>

                      <div className="mt-4">
                        <Textarea
                          rows={3}
                          placeholder="Write a reply…"
                          value={replies[t.id] ?? ""}
                          onChange={(e) => setReplies((prev) => ({ ...prev, [t.id]: e.target.value }))}
                        />

                        <Button
                          className="mt-2"
                          size="sm"
                          loading={replyBusy === t.id}
                          onClick={() => void reply(t.id)}
                        >
                          {!replyBusy && <Send className="size-3.5" />}
                          Send reply
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Plus, Trash2, Save } from "lucide-react";
import { AdminPageHeader } from "@/components/admin/AdminPageHeader";
import { ProductOptionsEditor, type OptionsPayload } from "@/components/admin/ProductOptionsEditor";
import { ImageUploadButton } from "@/components/admin/ImageUploadButton";
import { Input, Select, Textarea, Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import {
  DEFAULT_DELIVERY_DETAILS, DEFAULT_PEACE_OF_MIND, defaultDeliveryBy, defaultSoldBy, defaultHighlightsFromProduct,
} from "@/lib/pdp-blocks";

type Cat = { id: string; name: string };
type Brand = { id: string; name: string; categories?: string[] };
type ImgRow = { url: string; alt: string };
type SpecRow = { group: string; label: string; value: string };
type ColorRich = { name: string; image: string };

const emptyImg = (): ImgRow => ({ url: "", alt: "" });
const emptySpec = (): SpecRow => ({ group: "General", label: "", value: "" });
const lines = (s: string) => s.split("\n").map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean);

const LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  images: "Images", specifications: "Specifications", warrantySpecifications: "Return & Exchange",
  mfgSpecifications: "Manufacturer Info", showcaseImages: "Showcase banners",
  colors: "Colours & variants", variants: "Colours & variants", optionGroups: "Colours & variants",
  shortDescription: "Short description", pdpBlocks: "PDP info blocks", _: "Product",
};
const KNOWN = new Set([
  "name", "slug", "shortDescription", "categoryId", "brandId", "subtype", "groupId",
  "mrp", "salePrice", "stock", "lowStockAt", "hsnCode", "ram", "storage", "screenSize", "processor", "color", "tags",
  "description", "deliveryDetails", "deliveryBy", "soldBy", "peaceOfMind", "highlights",
  "active", "featured", "codEligible", "emiEligible", "exchangeEligible",
]);

function Section({ title, hint, children }: { title: string; hint?: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section className="card space-y-3 p-4 md:p-5">
      <div>
        <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">{title}</h2>
        {hint && <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12px] text-ink-400">{hint}</p>}
      </div>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

export function AddProductFullForm({ categories, brands }: { categories: Cat[]; brands: Brand[] }) {
  const router = useRouter();

  const [name, setName] = useState(""); const [slug, setSlug] = useState(""); const [shortDescription, setShortDescription] = useState("");
  const [categoryId, setCategoryId] = useState(""); const [brandId, setBrandId] = useState(""); const [subtype, setSubtype] = useState(""); const [groupId, setGroupId] = useState("");
  const [mrp, setMrp] = useState("0"); const [salePrice, setSalePrice] = useState("0"); const [stock, setStock] = useState("0"); const [lowStockAt, setLowStockAt] = useState("5"); const [hsnCode, setHsnCode] = useState("");
  const [ram, setRam] = useState(""); const [storage, setStorage] = useState(""); const [screenSize, setScreenSize] = useState(""); const [processor, setProcessor] = useState(""); const [color, setColor] = useState(""); const [tags, setTags] = useState("");
  const [images, setImages] = useState<ImgRow[]>([emptyImg()]); const [specs, setSpecs] = useState<SpecRow[]>([]);
  const [warranty, setWarranty] = useState<SpecRow[]>([]); const [mfg, setMfg] = useState<SpecRow[]>([]); const [showcase, setShowcase] = useState<ImgRow[]>([]); const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [options, setOptions] = useState<OptionsPayload>({ colors: [], variants: [], optionGroups: [] });
  const [active, setActive] = useState(true); const [featured, setFeatured] = useState(false); const [codEligible, setCodEligible] = useState(true); const [emiEligible, setEmiEligible] = useState(true); const [exchangeEligible, setExchangeEligible] = useState(true);
  const [deliveryDetails, setDeliveryDetails] = useState(""); const [deliveryBy, setDeliveryBy] = useState(""); const [soldBy, setSoldBy] = useState(""); const [peaceOfMind, setPeaceOfMind] = useState(""); const [highlights, setHighlights] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false); const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [fieldErrs, setFieldErrs] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({});
  const fe = (k: string) => fieldErrs[k]?.[0];
  const unmapped = Object.entries(fieldErrs).filter(([k]) => !KNOWN.has(k));

  const highlightHint = useMemo(() => {
    const pseudo = { ram, storage, screenSize, processor, color, returnDays: null, returnWindowDays: null, returnPolicyDays: null, easyReturnDays: null, exchangeEligible };
    return defaultHighlightsFromProduct(pseudo).join(" · ") || "—";
  }, [ram, storage, screenSize, processor, color, exchangeEligible]);

  const setRow = <T,>(list: T[], i: number, patch: Partial<T>, setter: (v: T[]) => void) => setter(list.map((r, idx) => (idx === i ? { ...r, ...patch } : r)));
  const dropRow = <T,>(list: T[], i: number, setter: (v: T[]) => void) => setter(list.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i));
  const galleryUrls = images.filter((r) => r.url.trim());

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault(); setError(null); setFieldErrs({});
    if (name.trim().length < 3) return setError("Product name must be at least 3 characters.");
    if (!categoryId) return setError("Select a category.");
    if (!brandId) return setError("Select a brand.");
    const mrpN = Number(mrp), saleN = Number(salePrice), stockN = Number(stock), lowN = Number(lowStockAt);
    if (!Number.isFinite(mrpN) || mrpN <= 0) return setError("MRP must be a positive number.");
    if (!Number.isFinite(saleN) || saleN <= 0) return setError("Sale price must be a positive number.");
    if (saleN > mrpN) return setError("Sale price cannot exceed MRP.");
    if (!Number.isFinite(stockN) || stockN < 0) return setError("Stock cannot be negative.");
    if (!galleryUrls.length) return setError("Add at least one product image (upload or paste a URL).");
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/products", {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          name: name.trim(), slug: slug.trim() || undefined, shortDescription: shortDescription.trim() || undefined,
          categoryId, brandId, subtype: subtype.trim() || undefined, mrp: mrpN, salePrice: saleN, stock: stockN,
          lowStockAt: Number.isFinite(lowN) ? lowN : 5, ram: ram.trim() || undefined, storage: storage.trim() || undefined,
          screenSize: screenSize.trim() || undefined, processor: processor.trim() || undefined, color: color.trim() || undefined,
          warrantyMonths: 12, codEligible, emiEligible, exchangeEligible, featured, active, hsnCode: hsnCode.trim() || undefined,
          tags: tags.split(",").map((t) => t.trim()).filter(Boolean), groupId: groupId.trim() || undefined,
          images: galleryUrls.map((r) => ({ url: r.url.trim(), alt: r.alt.trim() })),
          specifications: specs.filter((s) => s.group.trim() && s.label.trim() && s.value.trim()).map((s) => ({ group: s.group.trim(), label: s.label.trim(), value: s.value.trim() })),
          description: description.trim(),
          warrantySpecifications: warranty.filter((s) => s.group.trim() && s.label.trim() && s.value.trim()).map((s) => ({ group: s.group.trim(), label: s.label.trim(), value: s.value.trim() })),
          mfgSpecifications: mfg.filter((s) => s.group.trim() && s.label.trim() && s.value.trim()).map((s) => ({ group: s.group.trim(), label: s.label.trim(), value: s.value.trim() })),
          showcaseImages: showcase.filter((r) => r.url.trim()).map((r) => ({ url: r.url.trim(), alt: r.alt.trim() })),
          pdpBlocks: { deliveryDetails: lines(deliveryDetails), deliveryBy: deliveryBy.trim(), soldBy: soldBy.trim(), peaceOfMind: lines(peaceOfMind), highlights: lines(highlights) },
          colors: (options.colors as ColorRich[]).map((c) => ({ name: c.name, image: c.image ?? "" })), variants: options.variants, optionGroups: options.optionGroups,
        }),
      });
      const json = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || !json.ok) {
        setFieldErrs(json.fields ?? {});
        if (!json.fields || Object.keys(json.fields).length === 0) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Creation failed.");
        setBusy(false); return;
      }
      router.push(`/admin/products/${json.product.id}/edit`);
    } catch (err) { setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not create product."); setBusy(false); }
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4">
      <AdminPageHeader title="Add product" subtitle="Create a new SKU with pricing, inventory, specs, media and full PDP content." />

      <Section title="Basics">
        <Input label="Product name" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} error={fe("name")} required />
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Input label="Slug (optional)" value={slug} onChange={(e) => setSlug(e.target.value)} placeholder="auto-generated" error={fe("slug")} />
          <Select label="Brand" value={brandId} onChange={(e) => setBrandId(e.target.value)} error={fe("brandId")} required>
            <option value="">Select brand</option>{brands.map((b) => <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>{b.name}</option>)}
          </Select>
          <Select label="Category" value={categoryId} onChange={(e) => setCategoryId(e.target.value)} error={fe("categoryId")} required>
            <option value="">Select category</option>{categories.map((c) => <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}</option>)}
          </Select>
          <Input label="Style Type" value={subtype} onChange={(e) => setSubtype(e.target.value)} placeholder="Shirt / Trouser / Blazer / Shoes" error={fe("subtype")} />
        </div>
        <Input label="Family group (same value links colour/variant siblings)" value={groupId} onChange={(e) => setGroupId(e.target.value)} error={fe("groupId")} />
      </Section>

      <Section title="Pricing & inventory">
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <Input label="MRP (₹)" type="number" value={mrp} onChange={(e) => setMrp(e.target.value)} error={fe("mrp")} />
          <Input label="Sale price (₹)" type="number" value={salePrice} onChange={(e) => setSalePrice(e.target.value)} error={fe("salePrice")} />
          <Input label="Stock" type="number" value={stock} onChange={(e) => setStock(e.target.value)} error={fe("stock")} />
          <Input label="Low stock alert at" type="number" value={lowStockAt} onChange={(e) => setLowStockAt(e.target.value)} error={fe("lowStockAt")} />
          <Input label="HSN code" value={hsnCode} onChange={(e) => setHsnCode(e.target.value)} error={fe("hsnCode")} />
        </div>
      </Section>

      <Section title="Attributes">
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <Input label="Size" value={ram} onChange={(e) => setRam(e.target.value)} placeholder="S / M / L / XL" error={fe("ram")} />
          <Input label="Fabric" value={storage} onChange={(e) => setStorage(e.target.value)} placeholder="Cotton / Linen / Polyester" error={fe("storage")} />
          <Input label="Fit" value={screenSize} onChange={(e) => setScreenSize(e.target.value)} placeholder="Slim / Regular / Loose" error={fe("screenSize")} />
          <Input label="Occasion" value={processor} onChange={(e) => setProcessor(e.target.value)} placeholder="Formal / Casual / Sports" error={fe("processor")} />
          <Input label="Color" value={color} onChange={(e) => setColor(e.target.value)} error={fe("color")} />
        </div>
        <Input label="Tags (comma separated)" value={tags} onChange={(e) => setTags(e.target.value)} placeholder="formal, cotton, office" error={fe("tags")} />
      </Section>

      <Section title="Images" hint="Gallery shots. The first URL becomes the primary image.">
        {fieldErrs.images && <p className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-flame-600">Images — {fieldErrs.images.join("; ")}</p>}
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setImages((a) => [...a, emptyImg()])} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[13px] font-bold text-ink-700 hover:text-electric-600"><Plus className="size-4" />Add image</button>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {images.map((r, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="grid size-12 shrink-0 place-items-center overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-hairline bg-canvas">{r.url ? <img src={r.url} alt="" className="size-full object-contain" /> : null}</span>
              <ImageUploadButton onUploaded={(url) => setRow(images, i, { url }, setImages)} />
              <Input containerClassName="flex-1" value={r.url} onChange={(e) => setRow(images, i, { url: e.target.value }, setImages)} placeholder="…or paste a URL" />
              <Input containerClassName="flex-1" value={r.alt} onChange={(e) => setRow(images, i, { alt: e.target.value }, setImages)} placeholder="Alt text" />
              <button type="button" onClick={() => dropRow(images, i, setImages)} aria-label="Remove image" className="grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg border border-hairline text-flame-600 hover:bg-flame-500/10"><Trash2 className="size-4" /></button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </Section>

      <Section title="Specifications">
        {fieldErrs.specifications && <p className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-flame-600">Specifications — {fieldErrs.specifications.join("; ")}</p>}
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setSpecs((a) => [...a, emptySpec()])} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[13px] font-bold text-ink-700 hover:text-electric-600"><Plus className="size-4" />Add specification</button>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {specs.map((s, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_2fr_auto]">
              <Input value={s.group} onChange={(e) => setRow(specs, i, { group: e.target.value }, setSpecs)} placeholder="Group" />
              <Input value={s.label} onChange={(e) => setRow(specs, i, { label: e.target.value }, setSpecs)} placeholder="Label" />
              <Input value={s.value} onChange={(e) => setRow(specs, i, { value: e.target.value }, setSpecs)} placeholder="Value" />
              <button type="button" onClick={() => dropRow(specs, i, setSpecs)} aria-label="Remove spec" className="grid size-12 place-items-center rounded-lg border border-hairline text-flame-600 hover:bg-flame-500/10"><Trash2 className="size-4" /></button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </Section>

      <Section title="Colours, groups & variants" hint="Swatches (with optional image URL), pill option groups (e.g. Size) and price sizes. Size price = sale price + group add + size add.">
        {(fieldErrs.colors || fieldErrs.variants || fieldErrs.optionGroups) && (
          <p className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-flame-600">Colours & variants — {[...(fieldErrs.colors ?? []), ...(fieldErrs.variants ?? []), ...(fieldErrs.optionGroups ?? [])].join("; ")}</p>
        )}
        <ProductOptionsEditor value={options} onChange={setOptions} />
      </Section>

      <Section title="Visibility & eligibility">
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5">
          <Checkbox label="Active" checked={active} onChange={(e) => setActive(e.target.checked)} error={fe("active")} />
          <Checkbox label="Featured" checked={featured} onChange={(e) => setFeatured(e.target.checked)} error={fe("featured")} />
          <Checkbox label="COD eligible" checked={codEligible} onChange={(e) => setCodEligible(e.target.checked)} error={fe("codEligible")} />
          <Checkbox label="EMI eligible" checked={emiEligible} onChange={(e) => setEmiEligible(e.target.checked)} error={fe("emiEligible")} />
          <Checkbox label="Exchange eligible" checked={exchangeEligible} onChange={(e) => setExchangeEligible(e.target.checked)} error={fe("exchangeEligible")} />
        </div>
      </Section>

      <Section title="Description" hint="Long-form product description shown on the product page's Description tab. Markdown/plain text; line breaks preserved.">
        <Textarea rows={6} value={description} onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)} placeholder="Write the full product story, materials, care and what's in the box…" error={fe("description")} />

        <button type="button" onClick={() => setWarranty((a) => [...a, emptySpec()])} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[13px] font-bold text-ink-700 hover:text-electric-600"><Plus className="size-4" />Add row</button>
        {warranty.length === 0 && <p className="text-[12px] text-ink-400">No rows yet — add one above.</p>}

              <Input value={s.label} onChange={(e) => setRow(warranty, i, { label: e.target.value }, setWarranty)} placeholder="Label" />
              <Input value={s.value} onChange={(e) => setRow(warranty, i, { value: e.target.value }, setWarranty)} placeholder="Value" />
              <button type="button" onClick={() => dropRow(warranty, i, setWarranty)} aria-label="Remove row" className="grid size-12 place-items-center rounded-lg border border-hairline text-flame-600 hover:bg-flame-500/10"><Trash2 className="size-4" /></button>
            </div>
          ))}

      <Section title="Manufacturer Info" hint="Rows rendered under the product page's Manufacturer Info tab.">
        {fieldErrs.mfgSpecifications && <p className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-flame-600">Manufacturer Info — {fieldErrs.mfgSpecifications.join("; ")}</p>}
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setMfg((a) => [...a, emptySpec()])} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[13px] font-bold text-ink-700 hover:text-electric-600"><Plus className="size-4" />Add row</button>
        {mfg.length === 0 && <p className="text-[12px] text-ink-400">No rows yet — add one above.</p>}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {mfg.map((s, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_2fr_auto]">
              <Input value={s.group} onChange={(e) => setRow(mfg, i, { group: e.target.value }, setMfg)} placeholder="Group" />
              <Input value={s.label} onChange={(e) => setRow(mfg, i, { label: e.target.value }, setMfg)} placeholder="Label" />
              <Input value={s.value} onChange={(e) => setRow(mfg, i, { value: e.target.value }, setMfg)} placeholder="Value" />
              <button type="button" onClick={() => dropRow(mfg, i, setMfg)} aria-label="Remove row" className="grid size-12 place-items-center rounded-lg border border-hairline text-flame-600 hover:bg-flame-500/10"><Trash2 className="size-4" /></button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </Section>

      <Section title="Showcase banners" hint="Tall full-width images (e.g. 1080×1350). They stack vertically in the Showcase tab. Click a thumbnail to preview it full size.">
        {fieldErrs.showcaseImages && <p className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-flame-600">Showcase banners — {fieldErrs.showcaseImages.join("; ")}</p>}
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowcase((a) => [...a, emptyImg()])} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[13px] font-bold text-ink-700 hover:text-electric-600"><Plus className="size-4" />Add banner</button>
        {showcase.length === 0 && <p className="text-[12px] text-ink-400">No banners yet — add one above.</p>}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {showcase.map((r, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="grid size-12 shrink-0 place-items-center overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-hairline bg-canvas">{r.url ? <img src={r.url} alt="" className="size-full object-cover" /> : null}</span>
              <ImageUploadButton onUploaded={(url) => setRow(showcase, i, { url }, setShowcase)} />
              <Input containerClassName="flex-1" value={r.url} onChange={(e) => setRow(showcase, i, { url: e.target.value }, setShowcase)} placeholder="Banner URL" />
              <button type="button" onClick={() => dropRow(showcase, i, setShowcase)} aria-label="Remove banner" className="grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg border border-hairline text-flame-600 hover:bg-flame-500/10"><Trash2 className="size-4" /></button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </Section>

      <Section title="PDP info blocks" hint="Leave a field empty to use the live default (shown as its placeholder). Typing a value overrides just that section for this product; clearing it restores the default.">
        {(() => {
          const hlDefault = defaultHighlightsFromProduct({ ram, storage, screenSize, processor, color, returnDays: null, returnWindowDays: null, returnPolicyDays: null, easyReturnDays: null, exchangeEligible });
          return (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <p className="mb-1 block text-[12.5px] font-bold text-ink-900">Delivery details (one per line)</p>
                <Textarea rows={3} value={deliveryDetails} onChange={(e) => setDeliveryDetails(e.target.value)} placeholder={DEFAULT_DELIVERY_DETAILS.join("\n")} error={fe("deliveryDetails")} />
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">Default: {DEFAULT_DELIVERY_DETAILS.join(" · ")}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                <div>
                  <p className="mb-1 block text-[12.5px] font-bold text-ink-900">Delivery by</p>
                  <Input value={deliveryBy} onChange={(e) => setDeliveryBy(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") e.preventDefault(); }} placeholder={defaultDeliveryBy()} error={fe("deliveryBy")} />
                  <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">Default updates daily: {defaultDeliveryBy()}</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="mb-1 block text-[12.5px] font-bold text-ink-900">Sold by</p>
                  <Input value={soldBy} onChange={(e) => setSoldBy(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") e.preventDefault(); }} placeholder={defaultSoldBy()} error={fe("soldBy")} />
                  <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">Default: {defaultSoldBy()}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="mb-1 block text-[12.5px] font-bold text-ink-900">Shop with peace of mind (one per line)</p>
                <Textarea rows={3} value={peaceOfMind} onChange={(e) => setPeaceOfMind(e.target.value)} placeholder={DEFAULT_PEACE_OF_MIND.join("\n")} error={fe("peaceOfMind")} />
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">Default: {DEFAULT_PEACE_OF_MIND.join(" · ")}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="mb-1 block text-[12.5px] font-bold text-ink-900">Product highlights (one per line)</p>
                <Textarea rows={4} value={highlights} onChange={(e) => setHighlights(e.target.value)} placeholder={hlDefault.join("\n")} error={fe("highlights")} />
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">Default derived from this product: {highlightHint}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })()}
      </Section>

      {(error || unmapped.length > 0) && (
        <div role="alert" className="space-y-1 rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-4 py-3 text-[13px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
          {error && <p>{error}</p>}
          {unmapped.map(([k, v]) => (<p key={k}>{LABEL[k] ?? k} — {v.join("; ")}</p>))}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-1">
        <button type="submit" disabled={busy} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-ink-900 px-5 py-2.5 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-electric-600 disabled:opacity-50"><Save className="size-4" />{busy ? "Creating…" : "Create product"}</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => router.push("/admin/products")} className="rounded-xl border border-hairline bg-white px-5 py-2.5 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-ink-700 hover:border-electric-300">Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </form>

}

"use client";

import { Lock, LogIn } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input, PasswordInput } from "@/components/ui/Input";

export function AdminLoginForm() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const next = params.get("next");

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/auth/login", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email, password, admin: true }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Invalid admin credentials.");

      router.push(next && next.startsWith("/admin") ? next : "/admin/dashboard");
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unable to sign in.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="container-x flex min-h-dvh items-center justify-center py-10">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md">
        <div className="mb-6 text-center">
          <span className="mx-auto grid size-12 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-ink-900 text-white">
            <Lock className="size-5" />
          </span>
          <h1 className="mt-4 font-display text-2xl font-bold text-ink-900">
            Admin Console
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[13.5px] text-ink-400">
            Restricted access. Authorized staff only.
          </p>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="card space-y-4 p-6">
          <Input
            label="Email"
            type="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="admin@urbanvogue.in"
            autoComplete="username"
            required
          />

          <PasswordInput
            label="Password"
            value={password}
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="••••••••"
            autoComplete="current-password"
            required
          />

          {error && (
            <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}

          <Button block size="lg" type="submit" loading={busy}>
            {!busy && <LogIn className="size-4" />}
            Sign in
          </Button>

          <p className="text-center text-[12px] text-ink-400">
            No public admin signup. First admin is created only via{" "}
            <code>npm run seed:admin</code>.
          </p>
        </form>

        <p className="mt-4 text-center text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">
          <Link href="/" className="font-semibold text-electric-600 hover:underline">
            Back to storefront
          </Link>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Loader2, Send } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input, Select, Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";

const NEXT: Record<string, string[]> = {
  PENDING: ["CONFIRMED", "CANCELLED"],
  CONFIRMED: ["PROCESSING", "CANCELLED"],
  PROCESSING: ["SHIPPED", "CANCELLED"],
  SHIPPED: ["OUT_FOR_DELIVERY"],
  OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: ["DELIVERED"],
  DELIVERED: [],
  CANCELLED: [],
};

export function AdminOrderActions({
  orderNumber,
  status,
  carrier,
  trackingNumber,
}: {
  orderNumber: string;
  status: string;
  carrier: string;
  trackingNumber: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const options = NEXT[status] ?? [];
  const [next, setNext] = useState(options[0] ?? "");
  const [_carrier, setCarrier] = useState(carrier || "Delhivery Partner Network");
  const [_tracking, setTracking] = useState(trackingNumber);
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const [location, setLocation] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  if (!options.length) {
    return (
      <section className="card p-4">
        <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">Status</h2>
        <p className="mt-2 text-[13px] text-ink-400">This order is in a terminal state.</p>
      </section>
    );
  }

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/orders/${orderNumber}/status`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status: next, carrier: _carrier, trackingNumber: _tracking, note, location }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Status update failed");
      toast.push({ title: "Order status updated" });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.push({ tone: "error", title: "Update failed", body: err instanceof Error ? err.message : undefined });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="card space-y-3 p-4">
      <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">Advance status</h2>

      <Select label="Next status" value={next} onChange={(e) => setNext(e.target.value)}>
        {options.map((o) => (
          <option key={o} value={o}>{o.replace(/_/g, " ")}</option>
        ))}
      </Select>

      {next === "SHIPPED" && (
        <>
          <Input label="Carrier" value={_carrier} onChange={(e) => setCarrier(e.target.value)} />
          <Input label="Tracking number (optional)" value={_tracking} onChange={(e) => setTracking(e.target.value)} placeholder="auto-generated if blank" />
        </>
      )}

      <Input label="Location" value={location} onChange={(e) => setLocation(e.target.value)} placeholder="Bengaluru HDC" />
      <Textarea label="Internal note / customer message" value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} rows={3} />

      <Button type="submit" loading={busy} block>
        {!busy && <Send className="size-4" />}
        Update status
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

  children: React.ReactNode;

    if (!isLogin && !user) {

function AdminNav({ vertical }: { vertical?: boolean }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();

"use client";

import { LifeBuoy, Send } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Select, Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/admin/StatusBadge";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import { formatDateTime } from "@/lib/utils";

type Ticket = {
  id: string;
  reference: string;
  status: string;
  customer: { name: string; email: string; phone: string | null };
  messages: { id: string; body: string; fromStaff: boolean; author: string; createdAt: string }[];
};

export function AdminTicketThread({ ticket }: { ticket: Ticket }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [body, setBody] = useState("");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState(ticket.status);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function reply() {
    if (body.trim().length < 2) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/support/${ticket.id}/messages`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ body, status }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Reply failed");
      setBody("");
      toast.push({ title: "Reply sent" });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.push({ tone: "error", title: "Reply failed", body: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_18rem]">
      <section className="card p-4">
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
            <LifeBuoy className="size-4 text-electric-600" /> Conversation
          </h2>
          <StatusBadge status={ticket.status} />
        </div>

        <ul className="space-y-3">
          {ticket.messages.map((m) => (
            <li key={m.id} className={`flex ${m.fromStaff ? "justify-end" : "justify-start"}`}>
              <div className={`max-w-[85%] rounded-2xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[13px] leading-relaxed ${m.fromStaff ? "bg-ink-900 text-white" : "bg-canvas text-ink-900"}`}>
                <p>{m.body}</p>
                <p className={`mt-1 text-[10.5px] ${m.fromStaff ? "text-white/50" : "text-ink-400"}`}>
                  {m.author} · {formatDateTime(m.createdAt)}
                </p>
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>

        <div className="mt-4 border-t border-hairline pt-4">
          <Textarea label="Staff reply" value={body} onChange={(e) => setBody(e.target.value)} rows={4} placeholder="Write a clear, helpful reply…" />
          <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2">
            <Button onClick={reply} loading={busy}>
              {!busy && <Send className="size-4" />} Send reply
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <aside className="card h-fit p-4">
        <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">Ticket controls</h2>
        <Select label="Status" value={status} onChange={(e) => setStatus(e.target.value)}>
          <option value="OPEN">Open</option>
          <option value="UNDER_REVIEW">Under review</option>
          <option value="RESOLVED">Resolved</option>
          <option value="CLOSED">Closed</option>
        </Select>
        <div className="mt-4 space-y-1 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">
          <p><strong className="text-ink-900">Reference:</strong> {ticket.reference}</p>
          <p><strong className="text-ink-900">Customer:</strong> {ticket.customer.name}</p>
          <p><strong className="text-ink-900">Email:</strong> {ticket.customer.email}</p>
          {ticket.customer.phone && <p><strong className="text-ink-900">Phone:</strong> {ticket.customer.phone}</p>}
        </div>
      </aside>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\admin\BannerManager.tsx

"use client";

import { ImageIcon, Save } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Checkbox, Input, Select, Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { ConfirmButton } from "@/components/admin/ConfirmButton";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";

type Banner = {
  id: string;
  slot: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string | null;
  ctaLabel: string | null;
  ctaHref: string | null;
  imageUrl: string | null;
  active: boolean;
  sortOrder: number;
};

const blank = {
  slot: "PROMO_STRIP",
  title: "",
  subtitle: "",
  ctaLabel: "",
  ctaHref: "",
  imageUrl: "",
  active: true,
  sortOrder: 0,
};

export function BannerManager({ initial, canDelete }: { initial: Banner[]; canDelete: boolean }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [items, setItems] = useState(initial);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<any>(blank);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(editingId ? `/api/admin/banners/${editingId}` : "/api/admin/banners", {
        method: editingId ? "PATCH" : "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(form),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; banner?: Banner; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok || !json.banner) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Save failed");
      setItems((prev) => editingId ? prev.map((b) => (b.id === editingId ? json.banner! : b)) : [json.banner!, ...prev]);
      setEditingId(null);
      setForm(blank);
      toast.push({ title: editingId ? "Banner updated" : "Banner created" });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Save failed");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_24rem]">
      <section className="card overflow-hidden">
        <header className="border-b border-hairline px-4 py-3">
          <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">Banners</h2>
        </header>
        <ul className="divide-y divide-hairline">
          {items.map((b) => (
            <li key={b.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 p-4">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Badge tone="info">{b.slot}</Badge>
                  {!b.active && <Badge tone="neutral">Inactive</Badge>}
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1.5 font-bold text-ink-900">{b.title}</p>
                {b.subtitle && <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">{b.subtitle}</p>}
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setEditingId(b.id);
                    setForm({
                      slot: b.slot,
                      title: b.title,
                      subtitle: b.subtitle ?? "",
                      ctaLabel: b.ctaLabel ?? "",
                      ctaHref: b.ctaHref ?? "",
                      imageUrl: b.imageUrl ?? "",
                      active: b.active,
                      sortOrder: b.sortOrder,
                    });
                  }}
                  className="rounded-lg border border-hairline px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-bold hover:border-electric-300"
                >
                  Edit
                </button>
                {canDelete && (
                  <ConfirmButton url={`/api/admin/banners/${b.id}`} confirmText="Delete banner?" successText="Banner deleted" variant="danger" size="sm">
                    Delete
                  </ConfirmButton>
                )}
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </section>

      <form onSubmit={submit} className="card h-fit space-y-3 p-4">
        <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
          <ImageIcon className="size-4 text-electric-600" />
          {editingId ? "Edit banner" : "Create banner"}
        </h2>
        <Select label="Slot" value={form.slot} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, slot: e.target.value })}>
          <option value="HERO_TEXT">Hero text</option>
          <option value="PROMO_STRIP">Promo strip</option>
          <option value="CATEGORY">Category</option>
          <option value="SALE">Sale</option>
          <option value="FOOTER">Footer</option>
        </Select>
        <Input label="Title" value={form.title} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })} required />
        <Textarea label="Subtitle" value={form.subtitle} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, subtitle: e.target.value })} rows={2} />
        <Input label="CTA label" value={form.ctaLabel} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, ctaLabel: e.target.value })} />
        <Input label="CTA href" value={form.ctaHref} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, ctaHref: e.target.value })} placeholder="/offers" />
        <Input label="Image URL" value={form.imageUrl} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, imageUrl: e.target.value })} />
        <Input label="Sort order" type="number" value={form.sortOrder} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, sortOrder: Number(e.target.value) })} />
        <Checkbox checked={form.active} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, active: e.target.checked })} label="Active" />
        {error && <p role="alert" className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">{error}</p>}
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button type="submit" loading={busy} className="flex-1">{!busy && <Save className="size-4" />}{editingId ? "Update" : "Create"}</Button>
          {editingId && <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => { setEditingId(null); setForm(blank); }}>Cancel</Button>}
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, ChevronLeft, Search } from "lucide-react";

export type BrandOption = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  slug?: string;
  categories?: string[];
};

const UNC = "Uncategorized";

export function BrandPicker({
  brands,
  categories,
  preferred,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  brands: BrandOption[];
  categories: string[];
  preferred?: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [cat, setCat] = useState<string | null>(null); // null = category list view
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");

  // Brands created inline during this session, merged so the trigger label and
  // search both see them without a refetch.
  const [created, setCreated] = useState<BrandOption[]>([]);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [createErr, setCreateErr] = useState<string | null>(null);

    // Dedupe by id: a brand can arrive in BOTH `brands` (parent refetches after a
  // save) and `created` (added inline this session). Without this, the same id
  // yields two list rows sharing one React key. First occurrence wins, and it
  // also keeps `countFor` / `uncItems` from double-counting the duplicate.
  const allBrands = useMemo(() => {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    const out: BrandOption[] = [];
    for (const b of [...brands, ...created]) {
      if (b.id && !seen.has(b.id)) {
        seen.add(b.id);
        out.push(b);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }, [brands, created]);

  const selected = allBrands.find((b) => b.id === value);

  const cats = useMemo(
    () =>
      [...categories].sort((a, b) =>
        a === preferred ? -1 : b === preferred ? 1 : a.localeCompare(b),
      ),
    [categories, preferred],
  );

  const countFor = (c: string) =>
    allBrands.filter((b) => (b.categories ?? []).includes(c)).length;

  const uncItems = useMemo(
    () => allBrands.filter((b) => (b.categories ?? []).length === 0),
    [allBrands],
  );

  const needle = q.trim().toLowerCase();
  const trimmed = q.trim();

  // KEY FIX: when a search query is present, match across ALL brands (any
  // category) — the brand is no longer gated by the category you drilled into.
  // With no query, keep the curated per-category browse.
  const items = useMemo(() => {
    if (!cat) return [];
    if (needle) return allBrands.filter((b) => b.name.toLowerCase().includes(needle));
    const base =
      cat === UNC ? uncItems : allBrands.filter((b) => (b.categories ?? []).includes(cat));
    return base;
  }, [cat, needle, allBrands, uncItems]);

  // Offer inline creation only when the typed name isn't already an exact brand.
  const exactExists =
    trimmed.length > 0 && allBrands.some((b) => b.name.toLowerCase() === trimmed.toLowerCase());
  const showCreate = Boolean(cat) && trimmed.length >= 2 && !exactExists && !creating;

  function close() {
    setOpen(false);
    setCat(null);
    setQ("");
    setCreateErr(null);
  }

  async function createBrand() {
    const name = trimmed;
    if (name.length < 2 || creating) return;
    setCreating(true);
    setCreateErr(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/brands", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name }),
      });
      const json = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!res.ok || !json?.ok || !json?.brand?.id) {
        throw new Error(json?.error || "Could not create brand");
      }
      const nb: BrandOption = {
        id: json.brand.id,
        name: json.brand.name,
        slug: json.brand.slug,
        categories: json.brand.categories ?? [],
      };
      setCreated((p) => (p.some((x) => x.id === nb.id) ? p : [...p, nb]));
      onChange(nb.id);
      close();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setCreateErr(e?.message || "Could not create brand");
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <span className="mb-1 block text-[12px] font-bold text-gray-700">Brand</span>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}
        className="flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 text-[13px] focus:border-[#1a1a2e]"
      >
        <span className={selected ? "text-gray-900" : "text-gray-400"}>
          {selected?.name ?? "Select brand"}
        </span>
        <ChevronDown className="size-4 text-gray-400" />
      </button>

      {open && (
        <>
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-30" onClick={close} />
          <div className="absolute z-40 mt-1 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-xl">
            {cat === null ? (
              /* LEVEL 1 — categories only */
              <div className="p-1">
                <p className="px-2 pb-1 pt-2 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400">
                  Choose a category
                </p>
                {cats.map((c) => (
                  <button
                    key={c}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setCat(c);
                      setQ("");
                    }}
                    className="flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-[13px] hover:bg-gray-50"
                  >
                    <span className="text-gray-800">{c}</span>
                    <span className="rounded-full bg-gray-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-500">
                      {countFor(c)}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                ))}
                {uncItems.length > 0 && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setCat(UNC);
                      setQ("");
                    }}
                    className="flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-lg px-2 py-2 text-left text-[13px] font-semibold text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-50"
                  >
                    {UNC}
                    <span className="rounded-full bg-gray-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-500">
                      {uncItems.length}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            ) : (
              /* LEVEL 2 — brands, search is GLOBAL across all categories */
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 border-b border-gray-100 p-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setCat(null);
                      setQ("");
                    }}
                    aria-label="Back to categories"
                    className="grid size-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50"
                  >
                    <ChevronLeft className="size-4 text-gray-500" />
                  </button>
                  <p className="text-[12.5px] font-bold text-gray-900">{cat}</p>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-gray-100 px-2 py-1.5">
                  <Search className="size-4 shrink-0 text-gray-400" />
                  <input
                    autoFocus
                    value={q}
                    onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={`Search all brands (any category)…`}
                    className="h-9 w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-300 pl-1 pr-2 text-[13px] outline-none focus:border-[#1a1a2e]"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto p-1">
                  {showCreate && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={createBrand}
                      disabled={creating}
                      className="mb-1 flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-[#c9a96e]/60 bg-[#faf5eb] px-2 py-2 text-left text-[13px] font-semibold text-[#8b6914] hover:bg-[#f0e6d0] disabled:opacity-60"
                    >
                      <span className="grid size-5 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full bg-[#c9a96e] text-white">
                        +
                      </span>
                      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">
                        Create brand “{trimmed}” and use it here
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {createErr && (
                    <p className="px-2 py-1 text-[11.5px] font-semibold text-[#a93226]">
                      {createErr}
                    </p>
                  )}

                  {items.map((b) => (
                    <button
                      key={b.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        onChange(b.id);
                        close();
                      }}
                      className={`flex w-full flex-col rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-[13px] hover:bg-gray-50 ${
                        b.id === value ? "font-bold text-[#1a1a2e]" : "text-gray-800"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className="text-gray-900">{b.name}</span>
                      {(b.categories ?? []).length > 0 && (
                        <span className="mt-0.5 block truncate text-[10.5px] text-gray-400">
                          {(b.categories ?? []).join(" · ")}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  ))}

                  {items.length === 0 && !showCreate && !createErr && (
                    <p className="p-3 text-[12.5px] text-gray-400">
                      {needle
                        ? `No brand matches “${trimmed}”. Use the “Create brand” button above to add it.`
                        : `No brands tagged under ${cat} yet — tag them at /admin/brands.`}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default BrandPicker;

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, Search, Check, Plus, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

export type BrandOptionLite = { id: string; name: string };

type Props = {
  brands: BrandOptionLite[];
  value: string | null | undefined;
  onChange: (id: string) => void;
  label?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  /** Creates a brand row and resolves to its new id. Omit => search-only picker. */
  onCreateBrand?: (name: string) => Promise<string>;
  // Accepted for call-site compatibility with the old BrandPicker; unused here.
  categories?: string[];
  preferred?: string;
  className?: string;
};

export function BrandSelect({
  brands,
  value,
  onChange,
  label,
  placeholder = "Select brand",
  onCreateBrand,
  className = "",
}: Props) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [hint, setHint] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [created, setCreated] = useState<BrandOptionLite[]>([]);

  const wrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLUListElement>(null);

  // Merge server brands + locally-created ones so a just-added brand is selectable/visible.
    // Merge server brands + locally-created ones, de-duplicated by id so a refreshed
  // `brands` prop (router.refresh on save / hot reload) can never double-count an
  // optimistically-added brand. Authoritative = `brands`; `created` only fills gaps.
  const all = useMemo(() => {
   const seen = new Set(brands.map((b) => b.id));
    const extra = created.filter((b) => !seen.has(b.id));
    return [...brands, ...extra];
  }, [brands, created]);
  const selected = useMemo(() => all.find((b) => b.id === value) ?? null, [all, value]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return all;
    return all.filter((b) => b.name.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  }, [all, query]);

  const showCreate = !!onCreateBrand && query.trim().length > 0 && filtered.length === 0;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    setQuery("");
    setHint(null);
    const idx = filtered.findIndex((b) => b.id === value);
    setActive(idx === -1 ? 0 : idx);
    const t = setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 0);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [open]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !listRef.current) return;
    (listRef.current.children[active] as HTMLElement | undefined)?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
  }, [active, open]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (wrapRef.current && !wrapRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
  }, [open]);

  const commit = (id: string) => { onChange(id); setOpen(false); };

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!onCreateBrand || !query.trim() || creating) return;
    const name = query.trim();
    setCreating(true);
    setHint(null);
    try {
      const id = await onCreateBrand(name);
      setCreated((c) => (c.some((x) => x.id === id) ? c : [...c, { id, name }]));
      onChange(id);
      setOpen(false);
    } catch (e) {
      setHint(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not create this brand.");
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") { e.preventDefault(); setActive((i) => Math.min(i + 1, filtered.length - 1)); }
    else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") { e.preventDefault(); setActive((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0)); }
    else if (e.key === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (showCreate) { void handleCreate(); return; }
      const b = filtered[active];
      if (b) commit(b.id);
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); setOpen(false); }
    else if (e.key === "Tab") { setOpen(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div ref={wrapRef} className={`relative ${className}`}>
      {label && <span className="mb-1 block text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-ink-900">{label}</span>}

      <button
        type="button"
        role="combobox"
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-expanded={open}
        onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
        className="flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 text-left text-sm text-gray-900 transition-colors hover:border-gray-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#c9a96e]"
      >
        <span className={selected ? "truncate" : "truncate text-gray-400"}>
          {selected ? selected.name : placeholder}
        </span>
        <ChevronDown className={`size-4 shrink-0 text-gray-400 transition-transform ${open ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full z-50 mt-1 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-lg ring-1 ring-black/5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-gray-100 px-3">
            <Search className="size-4 shrink-0 text-gray-400" />
            <input
              ref={inputRef}
              value={query}
              onChange={(e) => { setQuery(e.target.value); setActive(0); setHint(null); }}
              onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
              placeholder="Type to search or add a brand…"
              className="h-10 w-full bg-transparent text-sm text-gray-900 placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          {hint && (
            <p className="border-b border-gray-100 bg-flame-500/5 px-3 py-2 text-[11.5px] font-medium text-flame-600">{hint}</p>
          )}

          <ul ref={listRef} role="listbox" className="max-h-60 overflow-auto py-1">
            {filtered.length === 0 && !showCreate && (
              <li className="px-3 py-6 text-center text-[12.5px] text-gray-400">No brands match</li>
            )}
            {filtered.map((b, i) => {
              const isSel = b.id === value;
              const isActive = i === active;
              return (
                <li key={b.id} role="none">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    role="option"
                    aria-selected={isSel}
                    onMouseEnter={() => setActive(i)}
                    onClick={() => commit(b.id)}
                    className={`flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm transition-colors ${isActive ? "bg-gray-100" : "bg-white"}`}
                  >
                    <span className="truncate font-medium text-gray-900">{b.name}</span>
                    {isSel && <Check className="size-4 shrink-0 text-[#8b6914]" />}
                  </button>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>

          {showCreate && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => void handleCreate()}
              disabled={creating}
              className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 border-t border-gray-100 px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-[13px] font-semibold text-[#1a1a2e] hover:bg-gray-50 disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {creating ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : <Plus className="size-4" />}
              Create “{query.trim()}”
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default BrandSelect;
