"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, Search, Check } from "lucide-react";

export type CategoryOption = { value: string; label: string; hint?: string };

type Props = {
  options: CategoryOption[];
  value: string | null | undefined;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  emptyText?: string;
  className?: string;
  /** Bold heading rendered above the trigger, matching the admin Input/Select labels. */
  label?: string;
};

/**
 * Accessible searchable category picker for the admin product form.
 * Replaces a native <select> (which cannot be filtered by typing).
 * Controlled: parent owns `value`; we only emit onChange(value) + close.
 */
export function CategorySelect({
  options,
  value,
  onChange,
  placeholder = "Select category",
  emptyText = "No categories match",
  className = "",
  label,
}: Props) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);

  const wrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLUListElement>(null);

  const selected = useMemo(
    () => options.find((o) => o.value === value) ?? null,
    [options, value],
  );

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return options;
    return options.filter((o) =>
      `${o.label} ${o.hint ?? ""}`.toLowerCase().includes(q),
    );
  }, [options, query]);

  // open => focus search, reset filter, point active at the current selection
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    setQuery("");
    const idx = filtered.findIndex((o) => o.value === value);
    setActive(idx === -1 ? 0 : idx);
    const t = setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 0);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [open]);

  // keep active row scrolled into view
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !listRef.current) return;
    const el = listRef.current.children[active] as HTMLElement | undefined;
    el?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
  }, [active, open]);

  // click-away closes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (wrapRef.current && !wrapRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
  }, [open]);

  const commit = (o: CategoryOption) => {
    onChange(o.value);
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault();
      setActive((i) => Math.min(i + 1, filtered.length - 1));
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      setActive((i) => Math.max(i - 1, 0));
    } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      const o = filtered[active];
      if (o) commit(o);
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
      e.preventDefault();
      setOpen(false);
    } else if (e.key === "Tab") {
      setOpen(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div ref={wrapRef} className={`relative ${className}`}>
        {label && (
        <span className="mb-1 block text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-ink-900">{label}</span>
      )}
      {/* trigger */}
      <button
        type="button"
        role="combobox"
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-expanded={open}
        onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
        className="flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 text-left text-sm text-gray-900 transition-colors hover:border-gray-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#c9a96e]"
      >
        <span className={selected ? "truncate" : "truncate text-gray-400"}>
          {selected ? selected.label : placeholder}
        </span>
        <ChevronDown className={`size-4 shrink-0 text-gray-400 transition-transform ${open ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
      </button>

      {/* panel */}
      {open && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full z-50 mt-1 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-lg ring-1 ring-black/5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-gray-100 px-3">
            <Search className="size-4 shrink-0 text-gray-400" />
            <input
              ref={inputRef}
              value={query}
              onChange={(e) => { setQuery(e.target.value); setActive(0); }}
              onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
              placeholder="Type to search…"
              className="h-10 w-full bg-transparent text-sm text-gray-900 placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <ul ref={listRef} role="listbox" className="max-h-60 overflow-auto py-1">
            {filtered.length === 0 && (
              <li className="px-3 py-6 text-center text-[12.5px] text-gray-400">{emptyText}</li>
            )}
            {filtered.map((o, i) => {
              const isSel = o.value === value;
              const isActive = i === active;
              return (
                <li key={o.value} role="none">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    role="option"
                    aria-selected={isSel}
                    onMouseEnter={() => setActive(i)}
                    onClick={() => commit(o)}
                    className={`flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm transition-colors ${
                      isActive ? "bg-gray-100" : "bg-white"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className="min-w-0">
                      <span className="block truncate font-medium text-gray-900">{o.label}</span>
                      {o.hint && <span className="block truncate text-[11px] text-gray-400">{o.hint}</span>}
                    </span>
                    {isSel && <Check className="size-4 shrink-0 text-[#8b6914]" />}
                  </button>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default CategorySelect;

FILE: src\components\admin\ConfirmButton.tsx
============================================================

"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, type ButtonProps } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";

export function ConfirmButton({
  url,
  method = "DELETE",
  body,
  confirmText,
  successText,
  children,
  ...rest
}: ButtonProps & {
  url: string;
  method?: string;
  body?: unknown;
  confirmText: string;
  successText?: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function run() {
    if (!window.confirm(confirmText)) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, {
        method,
        headers: body ? { "Content-Type": "application/json" } : undefined,
        body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Action failed");
      if (successText) toast.push({ title: successText });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.push({
        tone: "error",
        title: "Action failed",
        body: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined,
      });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Button {...rest} loading={busy} onClick={run} type="button">
      {children}
    </Button>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Gift, Plus, Save, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Checkbox, Input, Select, Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { ConfirmButton } from "@/components/admin/ConfirmButton";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import { formatDate, inr } from "@/lib/utils";

type Option = { id: string; name: string };
type Coupon = {
  id: string;
  code: string;
  description: string | null;
  type: "PERCENT" | "FIXED";
  value: number;
  scope: "ALL" | "CATEGORY" | "BRAND";
  categoryId: string | null;
  brandId: string | null;
  categoryName: string | null;
  brandName: string | null;
  minOrderValue: number;
  maxDiscount: number | null;
  usageLimit: number | null;
  usedCount: number;
  perUserLimit: number;
  active: boolean;
  startsAt: string;
  endsAt: string | null;
};

const blank = {
  code: "",
  description: "",
  type: "PERCENT" as const,
  value: 10,
  scope: "ALL" as const,
  categoryId: "",
  brandId: "",
  minOrderValue: 0,
  maxDiscount: 0,
  usageLimit: 0,
  perUserLimit: 1,
  active: true,
  startsAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 16),
  endsAt: "",
  broadcast: false,
};

export function CouponManager({
  initial,
  categories,
  brands,
  canDelete,
}: {
  initial: Coupon[];
  categories: Option[];
  brands: Option[];
  canDelete: boolean;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [items, setItems] = useState(initial);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<any>(blank);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  function startEdit(c: Coupon) {
    setEditingId(c.id);
    setForm({
      code: c.code,
      description: c.description ?? "",
      type: c.type,
      value: c.value,
      scope: c.scope,
      categoryId: c.categoryId ?? "",
      brandId: c.brandId ?? "",
      minOrderValue: c.minOrderValue,
      maxDiscount: c.maxDiscount ?? 0,
      usageLimit: c.usageLimit ?? 0,
      perUserLimit: c.perUserLimit,
      active: c.active,
      startsAt: c.startsAt.slice(0, 16),
      endsAt: c.endsAt?.slice(0, 16) ?? "",
      broadcast: false,
    });
  }

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const payload = {
        ...form,
        maxDiscount: form.maxDiscount ? Number(form.maxDiscount) : undefined,
        usageLimit: form.usageLimit ? Number(form.usageLimit) : undefined,
        startsAt: form.startsAt ? new Date(form.startsAt).toISOString() : undefined,
        endsAt: form.endsAt ? new Date(form.endsAt).toISOString() : undefined,
        categoryId: form.scope === "CATEGORY" ? form.categoryId : undefined,
        brandId: form.scope === "BRAND" ? form.brandId : undefined,
      };

      const res = await fetch(editingId ? `/api/admin/coupons/${editingId}` : "/api/admin/coupons", {
        method: editingId ? "PATCH" : "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string; coupon?: Coupon };
      if (!json.ok || !json.coupon) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Save failed");

      setItems((prev) =>
        editingId ? prev.map((c) => (c.id === editingId ? json.coupon! : c)) : [json.coupon!, ...prev],
      );
      setEditingId(null);
      setForm(blank);
      toast.push({ title: editingId ? "Coupon updated" : "Coupon created" });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Save failed");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_24rem]">
      <section className="card overflow-hidden">
        <header className="border-b border-hairline px-4 py-3">
          <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">Live & scheduled coupons</h2>
        </header>
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full min-w-[52rem] text-[13px]">
            <thead className="bg-canvas text-left text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Code</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Value</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Scope</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Usage</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Validity</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-hairline">
              {items.map((c) => (
                <tr key={c.id} className="hover:bg-canvas/50">
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <p className="font-display font-bold tracking-wider text-ink-900">{c.code}</p>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">{c.description ?? "—"}</p>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 font-bold tabular-nums">
                    {c.type === "PERCENT" ? `${c.value}%` : inr(c.value)}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <Badge tone="neutral">{c.scope}</Badge>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">
                      {c.categoryName ?? c.brandName ?? "Storewide"}
                    </p>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 tabular-nums">
                    {c.usedCount}
                    {c.usageLimit ? ` / ${c.usageLimit}` : ""}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-[12px] text-ink-400">
                    {formatDate(c.startsAt)}
                    {c.endsAt ? ` → ${formatDate(c.endsAt)}` : " → open"}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
                      <button onClick={() => startEdit(c)} className="rounded-lg border border-hairline px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-bold hover:border-electric-300">
                        Edit
                      </button>
                      {canDelete && (
                        <ConfirmButton
                          url={`/api/admin/coupons/${c.id}`}
                          confirmText="Delete this coupon?"
                          successText="Coupon deleted"
                          variant="danger"
                          size="sm"
                        >
                          Delete
                        </ConfirmButton>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>

      <form onSubmit={submit} className="card h-fit space-y-3 p-4">
        <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
          <Gift className="size-4 text-electric-600" />
          {editingId ? "Edit coupon" : "Create coupon"}
        </h2>

        <Input label="Code" value={form.code} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, code: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} required minLength={3} maxLength={24} />
        <Textarea label="Description" value={form.description} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })} rows={2} />
        <Select label="Type" value={form.type} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, type: e.target.value })}>
          <option value="PERCENT">Percentage</option>
          <option value="FIXED">Fixed ₹</option>
        </Select>
        <Input label="Value" type="number" value={form.value} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, value: Number(e.target.value) })} required min={1} max={form.type === "PERCENT" ? 90 : 200000} />
        <Select label="Scope" value={form.scope} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, scope: e.target.value })}>
          <option value="ALL">All products</option>
          <option value="CATEGORY">Category</option>
          <option value="BRAND">Brand</option>
        </Select>
        {form.scope === "CATEGORY" && (
          <Select label="Category" value={form.categoryId} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, categoryId: e.target.value })} required>
            <option value="">Select</option>
            {categories.map((c) => <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}</option>)}
          </Select>
        )}
        {form.scope === "BRAND" && (
          <Select label="Brand" value={form.brandId} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, brandId: e.target.value })} required>
            <option value="">Select</option>
            {brands.map((b) => <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>{b.name}</option>)}
          </Select>
        )}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <Input label="Min order" type="number" value={form.minOrderValue} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, minOrderValue: Number(e.target.value) })} />
          <Input label="Max discount" type="number" value={form.maxDiscount} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, maxDiscount: Number(e.target.value) })} />
          <Input label="Usage limit" type="number" value={form.usageLimit} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, usageLimit: Number(e.target.value) })} />
          <Input label="Per user" type="number" value={form.perUserLimit} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, perUserLimit: Number(e.target.value) })} />
        </div>
        <Input label="Starts" type="datetime-local" value={form.startsAt} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, startsAt: e.target.value })} />
        <Input label="Ends" type="datetime-local" value={form.endsAt} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, endsAt: e.target.value })} />
        <Checkbox checked={form.active} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, active: e.target.checked })} label="Active" />
        {!editingId && (
          <Checkbox checked={form.broadcast} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, broadcast: e.target.checked })} label="Broadcast to subscribers on creation" />
        )}

        {error && <p role="alert" className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">{error}</p>}

        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button type="submit" loading={busy} className="flex-1">
            {!busy && <Save className="size-4" />}
            {editingId ? "Update" : "Create"}
          </Button>
          {editingId && (
            <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => { setEditingId(null); setForm(blank); }}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Eye, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { Drawer } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/admin/StatusBadge";
import { formatDate, inr, relativeTime } from "@/lib/utils";

type Row = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  phone: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  active: boolean;
  whatsappOptIn: boolean;
  orderCount: number;
  totalSpent: number;
  lastOrderAt: string | null;
  lastOrderNumber: string | null;
};

type Detail = {
  user: Row & { role: string };
  orders: {
    id: string;
    orderNumber: string;
    status: string;
    paymentStatus: string;
    total: number;
    itemCount: number;
    createdAt: string;
  }[];
  reviews: { id: string; rating: number; body: string; createdAt: string }[];
  tickets: { id: string; reference: string; subject: string; status: string; createdAt: string }[];
  feedback: { id: string; overall: number | null; comment: string; createdAt: string }[];
};

export function CustomersTable({ initial }: { initial: Row[] }) {
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<Detail | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function view(id: string) {
    setOpenId(id);
    setBusy(true);
    setDetail(null);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/customers/${id}`, { cache: "no-store" });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; detail?: Detail; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok || !json.detail) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Failed to load customer.");
      setDetail(json.detail);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to load customer.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <section className="card overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full min-w-[58rem] text-[13px]">

              <tr>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Customer</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Contact</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Orders</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Spent</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Last order</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>

            <tbody className="divide-y divide-hairline">
              {initial.map((c) => (
                <tr key={c.id} className="hover:bg-canvas/50">
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <p className="font-bold text-ink-900">{c.name}</p>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">Joined {formatDate(c.createdAt)}</p>
                  </td>

                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-ink-900">{c.email}</p>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">{c.phone ?? "—"}</p>
                  </td>

                  <td className="px-4 py-3 tabular-nums">{c.orderCount}</td>

                  <td className="px-4 py-3 font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">{inr(c.totalSpent)}</td>

                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    {c.lastOrderNumber ? (
                      <>
                        <Link href={`/admin/orders/${c.lastOrderNumber}`} className="font-bold text-electric-600 hover:underline">
                          {c.lastOrderNumber}
                        </Link>
                        <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">{relativeTime(c.lastOrderAt)}</p>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-ink-300">No orders</span>
                    )}
                  </td>

                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => void view(c.id)}
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-hairline px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-bold text-ink-700 hover:border-electric-300"
                    >
                      <Eye className="size-3.5" />
                      View
                    </button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>

      <Drawer open={Boolean(openId)} onClose={() => setOpenId(null)} title="Customer detail" side="right">
        {busy && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px] text-ink-400">
            <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" />
            Loading customer…
          </div>
        )}

        {error && <p className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-flame-600">{error}</p>}

        {detail && (
          <div className="space-y-5">
            <section>
              <h3 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">{detail.user.name}</h3>
              <p className="mt-1 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">{detail.user.email}</p>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">{detail.user.phone ?? "No phone"}</p>

              <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                <Badge tone={detail.user.active ? "save" : "neutral"}>
                  {detail.user.active ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                </Badge>
                <Badge tone="info">{detail.user.role}</Badge>
                {detail.user.whatsappOptIn && <Badge tone="violet">WhatsApp opt-in</Badge>}
              </div>

              <dl className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-[12.5px]">
                <Stat k="Orders" v={String(detail.user.orderCount)} />
                <Stat k="Spent" v={inr(detail.user.totalSpent)} />
                <Stat k="Joined" v={formatDate(detail.user.createdAt)} />
                <Stat k="Last order" v={detail.user.lastOrderAt ? relativeTime(detail.user.lastOrderAt) : "—"} />
              </dl>
            </section>

            <Section title="Recent orders">
              {detail.orders.length === 0 ? (
                <Empty text="No orders yet." />
              ) : (
                <ul className="space-y-2">
                  {detail.orders.map((o) => (
                    <li key={o.id} className="rounded-xl border border-hairline p-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                        <Link href={`/admin/orders/${o.orderNumber}`} className="font-bold text-ink-900 hover:text-electric-600">
                          {o.orderNumber}
                        </Link>
                        <span className="font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">{inr(o.total)}</span>
                      </div>

                      <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                        <StatusBadge status={o.status} />
                        <StatusBadge status={o.paymentStatus} />
                        <span className="text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">{o.itemCount} item(s)</span>
                      </div>

                      <p className="mt-1 text-[11.5px] text-ink-300">{relativeTime(o.createdAt)}</p>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
            </Section>

            <Section title="Reviews">
              {detail.reviews.length === 0 ? (
                <Empty text="No reviews yet." />
              ) : (
                <ul className="space-y-2">
                  {detail.reviews.map((r) => (
                    <li key={r.id} className="rounded-xl border border-hairline p-3">
                      <p className="text-[12.5px] font-bold text-ink-900">{r.rating}★</p>
                      <p className="mt-1 line-clamp-3 text-[12.5px] text-ink-700">{r.body}</p>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-ink-300">{relativeTime(r.createdAt)}</p>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
            </Section>

            <Section title="Support tickets">
              {detail.tickets.length === 0 ? (
                <Empty text="No tickets yet." />
              ) : (
                <ul className="space-y-2">
                  {detail.tickets.map((t) => (
                    <li key={t.id} className="rounded-xl border border-hairline p-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                        <Link href={`/admin/support/${t.id}`} className="font-bold text-ink-900 hover:text-electric-600">
                          {t.reference}
                        </Link>
                        <StatusBadge status={t.status} />
                      </div>
                      <p className="mt-1 truncate text-[12.5px] text-ink-700">{t.subject}</p>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-ink-300">{relativeTime(t.createdAt)}</p>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
            </Section>

            <Section title="Feedback">
              {detail.feedback.length === 0 ? (
                <Empty text="No feedback yet." />
              ) : (
                <ul className="space-y-2">
                  {detail.feedback.map((f) => (
                    <li key={f.id} className="rounded-xl border border-hairline p-3">
                      <p className="text-[12.5px] font-bold text-ink-900">
                        {f.overall ? `${f.overall}/5 overall` : "Feedback"}
                      </p>
                      <p className="mt-1 line-clamp-3 text-[12.5px] text-ink-700">{f.comment || "No comment"}</p>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-ink-300">{relativeTime(f.createdAt)}</p>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
            </Section>
          </div>
        )}
      </Drawer>
    </>
  );
}

function Section({ title, children }: { title: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section>
      <h4 className="mb-2 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">{title}</h4>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

function Stat({ k, v }: { k: string; v: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl bg-canvas p-2.5">
      <dt className="text-[10.5px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">{k}</dt>
      <dd className="mt-1 text-[13px] font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">{v}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

function Empty({ text }: { text: string }) {
  return <p className="rounded-xl bg-canvas p-3 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">{text}</p>;
}

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from "react";

// Standalone editor for the Product.description long-form column.
// Auto-saves 800ms after typing stops, or instantly on blur (so clicking
// "Update product" or navigating away never loses unsaved text).
export function DescriptionEditor({
  productId,
  initial = "",
}: {
  productId: string;
  initial?: string;
}) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(initial);
  const [state, setState] = useState<"idle" | "unsaved" | "saving" | "saved" | "error">("idle");
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState("");
  
  const lastSavedRef = useRef(initial);
  const valueRef = useRef(initial);
  
  // Keep valueRef in sync so the save function always reads the latest text
  useEffect(() => {
    valueRef.current = value;
  }, [value]);

  const save = useCallback(async () => {
    const currentValue = valueRef.current;
    if (currentValue === lastSavedRef.current) {
      setState((s) => (s === "unsaved" || s === "saving" ? "idle" : s));
      return;
    }
    setState("saving");
    setMsg("");
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/products/${productId}/description`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ description: currentValue }),
      });
      const json = await res.json().catch(() => null);
      if (!res.ok || json?.ok === false) {
        setState("error");
        setMsg(json?.error ?? `Save failed (${res.status})`);
        return;
      }
      lastSavedRef.current = currentValue;
      setState("saved");
      setMsg("Saved.");
    } catch {
      setState("error");
      setMsg("Network error - not saved.");
    }
  }, [productId]);

  // Debounced auto-save: waits 800ms after the user stops typing
  useEffect(() => {
    if (value === lastSavedRef.current) {
      setState((s) => (s === "unsaved" ? "idle" : s));
      return;
    }
    setState("unsaved");
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      save();
    }, 800);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [value, save]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <textarea
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
        onBlur={() => { if (value !== lastSavedRef.current) save(); }}
        rows={10}
        placeholder="Long-form product description shown on the product page's Description tab. Markdown/plain text; line breaks preserved."
        className="w-full resize-y rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white p-3 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-gray-900 outline-none focus:border-[#1a1a2e] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1a1a2e]/20"
      />
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-h-[20px]" aria-live="polite">
        {state === "unsaved" && (
          <span className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-gray-500">Unsaved changes...</span>
        )}
        {state === "saving" && (
          <span className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-gray-500">Saving...</span>
        )}
        {state === "saved" && (
          <span className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-emerald-600">Saved ✓</span>
        )}
        {state === "error" && (
          <span className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-rose-600">{msg || "Couldn't save"}</span>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Settings2, Search as SearchIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import { HOME_FEATURES } from "@/lib/home-features";

type Product = { id: string; name: string };
type Sections = Record<string, Product[]>;

// Any-word substring match: split query on whitespace, succeed if SOME token is
// contained in the lowercased product name. "rog" finds ASUS ROG, "bespoke" finds
// Samsung Bespoke AC — no need to type the full 120-character name.
function matchesAnyWord(haystack: string, query: string): boolean {
  const h = haystack.toLowerCase();
  const tokens = query.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (!tokens.length) return true;
  return tokens.some((t) => h.includes(t));
}

export function FeatureManager({ products, initial }: { products: Product[]; initial: Sections }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [state, setState] = useState<Sections>(initial);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // LIVE search: the checkbox list filters on every keystroke from this state.
  // The Search button / Enter only normalize (trim) the query — matching never
  // waits for a click. (The old `applied` state that gated filtering is gone.)
  const [queries, setQueries] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  async function save(section: string) {
    setBusy(section);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/features", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ section, productIds: state[section]?.map((p) => p.id) ?? [] }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Save failed");
      const title = HOME_FEATURES.find((f) => f.key === section)?.title ?? section;
      toast.push({ title: `${title} updated` });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.push({ tone: "error", title: "Save failed", body: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined });
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  function toggle(section: string, product: Product) {
    setState((prev) => {
      const list = prev[section] ?? [];
      const exists = list.some((p) => p.id === product.id);
      const next = exists
        ? list.filter((p) => p.id !== product.id)
        : [...list, product].slice(0, 24);
      return { ...prev, [section]: next };
    });
  }

  function normalize(section: string) {
    setQueries((prev) => ({ ...prev, [section]: (prev[section] ?? "").trim() }));
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
      {HOME_FEATURES.map((def) => {
        const list = state[def.key] ?? [];
        const q = (queries[def.key] ?? "").trim();
        const visibleProducts = q
          ? products.filter((p) => matchesAnyWord(p.name, q))
          : products;

        return (
          <section key={def.key} className="card p-4">
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
                <Settings2 className="size-4 text-electric-600" /> {def.title}
              </h2>
              <Button size="sm" loading={busy === def.key} onClick={() => void save(def.key)}>
                Save
              </Button>
            </div>

            <p className="mb-3 text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">{def.help}</p>

            <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              {list.length === 0 && <p className="text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">No curated products yet.</p>}
              {list.map((p) => (
                <span key={p.id} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-electric-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11.5px] font-bold text-electric-700">
                  {p.name}
                  <button onClick={() => toggle(def.key, p)} aria-label="Remove" className="text-electric-500 hover:text-flame-600">×</button>
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="mb-2 flex gap-2">
              <input
                value={queries[def.key] ?? ""}
                onChange={(e) => setQueries((prev) => ({ ...prev, [def.key]: e.target.value }))}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); normalize(def.key); }
                }}
                placeholder="Search products (any word matches, e.g. rog, bespoke)"
                className="h-9 flex-1 rounded-lg border border-hairline px-2.5 text-[12.5px] outline-none focus:border-electric-400"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => normalize(def.key)}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-electric-600 px-3 text-[12px] font-bold text-white hover:bg-electric-700"
              >
                <SearchIcon className="size-3.5" /> Search
              </button>
              {q && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setQueries((prev) => ({ ...prev, [def.key]: "" }))}
                  className="rounded-lg border border-hairline px-3 text-[12px] font-semibold text-ink-600 hover:bg-ink-50"
                >
                  Clear
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            {q && (
              <p className="mb-1 text-[11px] text-ink-400">
                Showing {visibleProducts.length} of {products.length} matching “{q}”
              </p>
            )}

            <div className="max-h-56 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto rounded-xl border border-hairline p-2">
              {visibleProducts.length === 0 && (
                <p className="p-2 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">No products match your search.</p>
              )}
              {visibleProducts.map((p) => {
                const checked = list.some((x) => x.id === p.id);
                return (
                  <label key={p.id} className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-[12.5px]">
                    <input type="checkbox" checked={checked} onChange={() => toggle(def.key, p)} className="size-3.5 
accent-[#c9a96e]" />
                    <span className="truncate">{p.name}</span>
                  </label>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </section>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Plus, Trash2, ZoomIn } from "lucide-react";
import { ImageUploadButton } from "@/components/admin/ImageUploadButton";
import { ImagePreviewModal } from "@/components/admin/ImagePreviewModal";

type Row = { url: string; alt: string | null };

export function ImageListEditor({ productId, initial }: { productId: string; initial: Row[] }) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<Row[]>(initial);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<"idle" | "saving" | "saved" | "error">("idle");
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const rowsRef = useRef(rows); rowsRef.current = rows;
  const dirty = useRef(false);
  const mounted = useRef(true);
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const chain = useRef<Promise<void>>(Promise.resolve());

  useEffect(() => () => { mounted.current = false; }, []);

  async function doSave() {
    const snap = JSON.stringify(rowsRef.current);
    const clean = rowsRef.current
      .filter((r) => r.url.trim())
      .map((r, i) => ({ url: r.url.trim(), alt: (r.alt ?? "").trim(), position: i }));
    setStatus("saving");
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/products/${productId}/images`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ kind: "SHOWCASE", images: clean }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error();
    } catch { if (mounted.current) setStatus("error"); return; }
    if (!mounted.current) return;
    if (JSON.stringify(rowsRef.current) === snap) { dirty.current = false; setStatus("saved"); }
    else setStatus("saving");
  }

  function queueSave() { chain.current = chain.current.then(doSave).catch(() => {}); }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dirty.current) return;
    if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);
    timer.current = setTimeout(queueSave, 700);
    return () => { if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current); };
  }, [rows]);

  useEffect(() => () => { if (dirty.current) { if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current); void queueSave(); } }, []);

  const update = (i: number, patch: Partial<Row>) => { dirty.current = true; setRows((rs) => rs.map((r, j) => (j === i ? { ...r, ...patch } : r))); };
  const remove = (i: number) => { dirty.current = true; setRows((rs) => rs.filter((_, j) => j !== i)); };
  const add = () => { dirty.current = true; setRows((rs) => [...rs, { url: "", alt: "" }]); };

  const statusText = status === "saving" ? "Saving…" : status === "saved" ? "Saved" : status === "error" ? "Save failed — retries on next edit" : "";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <button type="button" onClick={add} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[12px] font-semibold text-[#1a1a2e] hover:underline">
          <Plus className="size-3.5" /> Add banner
        </button>
        {statusText ? <span className={`text-[11px] font-medium ${status === "error" ? "text-flame-600" : "text-gray-400"}`}>{statusText}</span> : null}
      </div>
      <p className="text-[11.5px] text-gray-400">Tall full‑width images (e.g. 1080×1350). They stack vertically in the Showcase tab. Click a thumbnail to preview it full‑size.</p>
      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="py-2 text-[12.5px] text-gray-400">No banners yet — add one above.</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {rows.map((r, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-[auto_auto_1fr_1fr_auto] items-center">
              {r.url ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setPreview(r.url)}
                  title="Click to preview full image"
                  className="group/thumb relative block size-12 shrink-0 cursor-zoom-in overflow-hidden rounded border border-gray-200 bg-white"
                >
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                  <img src={r.url} alt="" className="size-full object-cover" />
                  <span className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center text-white opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover/thumb:bg-black/30 group-hover/thumb:opacity-100">
                    <ZoomIn className="size-4" />
                  </span>
                </button>
              ) : (
                <div className="size-12 shrink-0 rounded border border-dashed border-gray-300" />
              )}
              <ImageUploadButton onUploaded={(url) => update(i, { url })} />
              <input value={r.url} placeholder="…or paste a URL" onChange={(e) => update(i, { url: e.target.value })} className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 px-2 text-[13px] outline-none focus:border-gray-400" />
              <input value={r.alt ?? ""} placeholder="alt text" onChange={(e) => update(i, { alt: e.target.value })} className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 px-2 text-[13px] outline-none focus:border-gray-400" />
              <button type="button" onClick={() => remove(i)} aria-label="Remove banner" className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-lg text-gray-400 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-600"><Trash2 className="size-4" /></button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {preview && <ImagePreviewModal url={preview} onClose={() => setPreview(null)} />}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { X } from "lucide-react";

/**
 * Full-size image preview for admin editors. Click a thumbnail in the Images /
 * Showcase rows to confirm WHICH image is stored — the small object-cover crop in
 * the row can't show a tall banner in full; this can (object-contain, max-h 82vh).
 *
 * Same interaction model as the app's other overlays (FullImageView / ShowCaseDrawer):
 * Esc closes, backdrop click closes, body scroll locked while open, fade + zoom in.
 * Portal-less fixed overlay (z-[100]) like the rest of the codebase's modals.
 *
 * Every <button> here is type="button" ON PURPOSE: this renders inside the product
 * <form> (via ProductForm's gallery rows), so an untyped button would submit the form.
 */
export function ImagePreviewModal({ url, onClose }: { url: string; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const r = requestAnimationFrame(() => setShown(true));
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === "Escape") onClose(); };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    const prev = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(r);
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      document.body.style.overflow = prev;
    };
  }, [onClose]);

  if (!url) return null;

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Image preview"
      onClick={onClose}
      className={`fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 p-4 transition-opacity duration-200 ${
        shown ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0"
      }`}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onClose}
        aria-label="Close preview"
        className="absolute right-3 top-3 grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full bg-white/10 text-white transition-colors hover:bg-white/25"
      >
        <X className="size-5" />
      </button>

      <figure
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        className={`flex max-h-full max-w-full flex-col items-center gap-3 transition-transform duration-200 ${
          shown ? "scale-100" : "scale-95"
        }`}
      >
        <img
          src={url}
          alt="Preview"
          // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
          className="max-h-[82vh] max-w-[92vw] rounded-lg object-contain shadow-2xl"
          draggable={false}
        />
        <figcaption
          className="max-w-[92vw] truncate font-mono text-[11.5px] text-white/70"
          title={url}
        >
          {url}
        </figcaption>
      </figure>
    </div>
  );
}

export default ImagePreviewModal;

"use client";

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ImagePlus, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";

export function ImageUploadButton({ onUploaded, label = "Upload image", className = "" }: {
  onUploaded: (url: string) => void;
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const toast = useToast();

  async function pick(f: File) {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append("file", f);
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/upload", { method: "POST", body: fd });
      const json = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { ok?: boolean; url?: string; error?: string };
      if (!res.ok || !json.url) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Upload failed");
      onUploaded(json.url);
      toast.push({ title: "Image uploaded" });
    } catch (e) {
      toast.push({ title: "Upload failed", body: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.value = "";
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <input
        ref={inputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif,image/avif"
        className="hidden"
        onChange={(e) => { const f = e.target.files?.[0]; if (f) void pick(f); }}
      />
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}
        disabled={busy}
        className={`inline-flex h-9 shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-gray-700 transition-colors hover:border-[#1a1a2e] hover:text-[#1a1a2e] disabled:opacity-50 ${className}`}
      >
        {busy ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : <ImagePlus className="size-4" />}
        {busy ? "Uploading…" : label}
      </button>
    </>
  );
}

export default ImageUploadButton;

export function PdpBlocksEditor({ productId, initial, defaults }: { productId: string; initial?: Override | null; defaults: Defaults }) {

  const fe = (k: string) => fieldErrs[k]?.[0];

    setDeliveryBy(initial?.deliveryBy ?? "");
    setSoldBy(initial?.soldBy ?? "");
    setPeaceOfMind(nl(initial?.peaceOfMind));
    setHighlights(nl(initial?.highlights));
    setSaved(false); setError(null); setFieldErrs({});
  }, [productId, initial]);

  async function save() {
    setSaving(true); setSaved(false); setError(null); setFieldErrs({});
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/products/${encodeURIComponent(productId)}/pdp-blocks`, {
        method: "PATCH", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          blocks: {
            deliveryDetails: toList(deliveryDetails), deliveryBy: strOrUndef(deliveryBy), soldBy: strOrUndef(soldBy),
            peaceOfMind: toList(peaceOfMind), highlights: toList(highlights),
          },
        }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { ok?: boolean; error?: string; fields?: Record<string, string[]> };
      if (!res.ok || json.ok === false) {
        setFieldErrs(json.fields ?? {});
        if (!json.fields || Object.keys(json.fields).length === 0) setError(json.error ?? "Save failed");
        return;
      }
      setSaved(true); toast.push({ tone: "success", title: "PDP info blocks saved" });
    } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not save PDP blocks"); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  }

  const guardEnter = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === "Enter") e.preventDefault(); };
  const d = defaults ?? { deliveryDetails: [], deliveryBy: "", soldBy: "", peaceOfMind: [], highlights: [] };

  return (
    <section className="card p-4">
      <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">PDP info blocks</h2>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-400">Leave a field empty to use the live default (shown as its placeholder). Typing a value overrides just that section for this product; clearing it restores the default.</p>

      <div className="mt-4 space-y-4">
        <div>
          <p className={title}>Delivery details (one per line)</p>
          <textarea rows={3} value={deliveryDetails} onChange={(e) => { setDeliveryDetails(e.target.value); setSaved(false); }} placeholder={nl(d.deliveryDetails)} className={area} />
          {fe("deliveryDetails") && <p className="mt-1 text-[11.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">{fe("deliveryDetails")}</p>}
          <p className={cap}>Default: {dot(d.deliveryDetails)}</p>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div>
            <p className={title}>Delivery by</p>
            <input value={deliveryBy} onChange={(e) => { setDeliveryBy(e.target.value); setSaved(false); }} onKeyDown={guardEnter} placeholder={d.deliveryBy} className={box} />
            {fe("deliveryBy") && <p className="mt-1 text-[11.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">{fe("deliveryBy")}</p>}
            <p className={cap}>Default updates daily: {d.deliveryBy}</p>
          </div>
          <div>
            <p className={title}>Sold by</p>
            <input value={soldBy} onChange={(e) => { setSoldBy(e.target.value); setSaved(false); }} onKeyDown={guardEnter} placeholder={d.soldBy} className={box} />
            {fe("soldBy") && <p className="mt-1 text-[11.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">{fe("soldBy")}</p>}
            <p className={cap}>Default: {d.soldBy}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <p className={title}>Shop with peace of mind (one per line)</p>
          <textarea rows={3} value={peaceOfMind} onChange={(e) => { setPeaceOfMind(e.target.value); setSaved(false); }} placeholder={nl(d.peaceOfMind)} className={area} />
          {fe("peaceOfMind") && <p className="mt-1 text-[11.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">{fe("peaceOfMind")}</p>}
          <p className={cap}>Default: {dot(d.peaceOfMind)}</p>
        </div>

        <div>
          <p className={title}>Product highlights (one per line)</p>
          <textarea rows={4} value={highlights} onChange={(e) => { setHighlights(e.target.value); setSaved(false); }} placeholder={nl(d.highlights)} className={area} />
          {fe("highlights") && <p className="mt-1 text-[11.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">{fe("highlights")}</p>}
          {d.highlights.length > 0 && <p className={cap}>Default derived from this product: {dot(d.highlights)}</p>}
        </div>
      </div>

      {(error || unmapped.length > 0) && (
        <div role="alert" className="mt-3 space-y-1 rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-4 py-3 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
          {error && <p>{error}</p>}
          {unmapped.map(([k, v]) => (<p key={k}>{k} — {v.join("; ")}</p>))}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-end gap-3">
        {saved && !saving && <span className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-emerald-600">Saved</span>}
        <button type="button" onClick={save} disabled={!productId || saving} className="rounded-xl bg-ink-900 px-5 py-2.5 text-[13px] font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-electric-600 disabled:opacity-50">{saving ? "Saving…" : "Save PDP blocks"}</button>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export default PdpBlocksEditor;

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";
import { List } from "lucide-react";
import { SpecEditor } from "@/components/admin/SpecEditor";
import { ImageListEditor } from "@/components/admin/ImageListEditor";
import { DescriptionEditor } from "@/components/admin/DescriptionEditor";

type SpecRow = { group: string; label: string; value: string };
type ImgRow = { url: string; alt: string | null; position?: number };

// The /edit footer. Warranty / Manufacturer Info / Showcase self-source from the
// specs+images GETs; Description is seeded from the server-fetched product column
// (passed as a prop by the edit page) and saves through its own /description route,
// independent of the main Update button - same own-save contract as SpecEditor.
export function ProductDetailEditors({ description = "" }: { description?: string } = {}) {
  const p = useParams();
  const id = Array.isArray(p.id) ? p.id[0] : p.id;

  const [warranty, setWarranty] = useState<SpecRow[]>([]);
  const [mfg, setMfg] = useState<SpecRow[]>([]);
  const [banners, setBanners] = useState<ImgRow[]>([]);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return;
    let alive = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const [s, im] = await Promise.all([
          fetch(`/api/admin/products/${id}/specs`).then((r) => r.json()),
          fetch(`/api/admin/products/${id}/images`).then((r) => r.json()),
        ]);
        if (!alive) return;
        const specs: (SpecRow & { kind?: string })[] = Array.isArray(s.specs) ? s.specs : [];
        const imgs: ImgRow[] = Array.isArray(im.images) ? im.images : [];
        setWarranty(specs.filter((x) => x.kind === "WARRANTY"));
        setMfg(specs.filter((x) => x.kind === "MFG"));
        setBanners(imgs.filter((x) => (x as { kind?: string }).kind === "SHOWCASE"));
        setLoaded(true);
      } catch {
        if (alive) setLoaded(true);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [id]);

  if (!id) return null;
  if (!loaded) return <p className="text-[13px] text-gray-400">Loading detail editors...</p>;

  const Head = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => (
    <h3 className="mb-3 inline-flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-gray-900">
      <List className="size-4 text-gray-400" /> {children}
    </h3>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4">
        <Head>Description</Head>
        <DescriptionEditor productId={id} initial={description} />
      </section>
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4">
        <Head>Return & Exchange</Head>
        <SpecEditor productId={id} kind="WARRANTY" initial={warranty} />
      </section>
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4">
        <Head>Manufacturer Info</Head>
        <SpecEditor productId={id} kind="MFG" initial={mfg} />
      </section>
      <section className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4">
        <Head>Showcase banners</Head>
        <ImageListEditor productId={id} initial={banners} />
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, type FormEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import {
  Copy,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  List,
  Palette,
  Plus,
  Save,
  Trash2,
  ZoomIn,
} from "lucide-react";

import { type BrandOption } from "@/components/admin/BrandPicker";
import { BrandSelect } from "@/components/admin/BrandSelect";
import { CategorySelect } from "@/components/admin/CategorySelect";
import { ConfirmButton } from "@/components/admin/ConfirmButton";
import { ImagePreviewModal } from "@/components/admin/ImagePreviewModal";
import { ImageUploadButton } from "@/components/admin/ImageUploadButton";
import {
  ProductOptionsEditor,
  type OptionsPayload,
} from "@/components/admin/ProductOptionsEditor";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Checkbox, Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import { parseProductOptions } from "@/lib/product-options";

type Option = { id: string; name: string };
type FormImage = { url: string; alt: string };
type FormSpec = { group: string; label: string; value: string };

type Initial = {
  name: string; slug: string; shortDescription: string; categoryId: string; brandId: string;
  mrp: number; salePrice: number; stock: number; lowStockAt: number; subtype: string; groupId: string;
  ram: string; storage: string; screenSize: string; processor: string; color: string; warrantyMonths: number;
  codEligible: boolean; emiEligible: boolean; exchangeEligible: boolean; featured: boolean; active: boolean;
  hsnCode: string; tags: string; images: FormImage[]; specifications: FormSpec[];
  colors: any[]; variants: any[]; optionGroups: any[];
};

const blank: Initial = {
  name: "", slug: "", shortDescription: "", categoryId: "", brandId: "", mrp: 0, salePrice: 0, stock: 0,
  lowStockAt: 5, subtype: "", groupId: "", ram: "", storage: "", screenSize: "", processor: "", color: "",
  warrantyMonths: 12, codEligible: true, emiEligible: true, exchangeEligible: true, featured: false, active: true,
  hsnCode: "", tags: "", images: [{ url: "", alt: "" }], specifications: [], colors: [], variants: [], optionGroups: [],
};

type NumericKey = "mrp" | "salePrice" | "stock" | "lowStockAt";
type RawState = Record<NumericKey, string> & { hsnCode: string };
type SaveResponse = {
  ok: boolean; id?: string; product?: { id?: string }; error?: string; fields?: Record<string, string[]>;
};

function createRawState(form: Initial): RawState {
  return {
    mrp: String(form.mrp), salePrice: String(form.salePrice), stock: String(form.stock),
    lowStockAt: String(form.lowStockAt), hsnCode: form.hsnCode,
  };
}
function splitTags(tags: string): string[] {
  return tags.split(",").map((t) => t.trim()).filter(Boolean);
}
function normalizeImages(images: FormImage[], fallbackAlt: string) {
  return images.filter((i) => i.url.trim() !== "").map((i) => ({ url: i.url.trim(), alt: i.alt.trim() || fallbackAlt }));
}
function normalizeSpecifications(specs: FormSpec[]) {
  return specs.filter((s) => s.label.trim() !== "" && s.value.trim() !== "").map((s) => ({
    group: s.group.trim() || "General", label: s.label.trim(), value: s.value.trim(),
  }));
}

// Friendly labels for keys a control can't red-line itself (custom selects, opaque
// option editor, array rows). Anything not in KNOWN surfaces here, so no error is lost.
const LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  brandId: "Brand", categoryId: "Category", images: "Images", specifications: "Specifications",
  colors: "Colours & variants", variants: "Colours & variants", optionGroups: "Colours & variants",
  shortDescription: "Short description", _: "Product",
};
// Scalar controls that DO accept `error` and render red + message themselves.
const KNOWN = new Set([
  "name", "slug", "subtype", "groupId", "hsnCode", "ram", "storage", "screenSize", "processor", "color", "tags",
  "mrp", "salePrice", "stock", "lowStockAt", "active", "featured", "codEligible", "emiEligible", "exchangeEligible",
]);

export function ProductForm({
  categories, brands, initial, productId, canDelete, footer,
}: {
  categories: Option[]; brands: BrandOption[]; initial?: Initial; productId?: string; canDelete?: boolean; footer?: ReactNode;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const isEdit = Boolean(productId);

  const [form, setForm] = useState<Initial>(initial ?? blank);
  const [raw, setRaw] = useState<RawState>(() => createRawState(form));
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [copyBusy, setCopyBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [fieldErrs, setFieldErrs] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({});
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const fe = (k: string) => fieldErrs[k]?.[0];
  const unmapped = Object.entries(fieldErrs).filter(([k]) => !KNOWN.has(k));

  function set<K extends keyof Initial>(key: K, value: Initial[K]) {
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [key]: value }) as Initial);
  }
  function setNumeric(key: NumericKey, value: string) {
    setRaw((r) => ({ ...r, [key]: value }));
    const n = Number(value);
    set(key, value === "" || !Number.isFinite(n) ? 0 : n);
  }
  function setHsnCode(value: string) {
    setRaw((r) => ({ ...r, hsnCode: value }));
    set("hsnCode", value);
  }
  function patchImage(i: number, p: Partial<FormImage>) {
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, images: f.images.map((im, idx) => (idx === i ? { ...im, ...p } : im)) }));
  }
  function removeImage(i: number) { setForm((f) => ({ ...f, images: f.images.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i) })); }
  function addImage() { setForm((f) => ({ ...f, images: [...f.images, { url: "", alt: "" }] })); }
  function patchSpec(i: number, p: Partial<FormSpec>) {
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, specifications: f.specifications.map((s, idx) => (idx === i ? { ...s, ...p } : s)) }));
  }
  function removeSpec(i: number) { setForm((f) => ({ ...f, specifications: f.specifications.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i) })); }
  function addSpec() { setForm((f) => ({ ...f, specifications: [...f.specifications, { group: "General", label: "", value: "" }] })); }

  async function duplicate() {
    if (!productId) return;
    setCopyBusy(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/products/${productId}/duplicate`, { method: "POST" });
      const json = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { ok?: boolean; id?: string; error?: string };
      if (!res.ok || !json.ok || !json.id) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Could not copy the product");
      toast.push({ title: "Product copied", body: "Opened the copy for editing." });
      router.push(`/admin/products/${json.id}/edit`); router.refresh();
    } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Copy failed"); } finally { setCopyBusy(false); }
  }

  async function onSubmit(e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault(); setBusy(true); setError(null); setFieldErrs({});
    try {
      const options = parseProductOptions({ colors: form.colors, variants: form.variants, optionGroups: form.optionGroups });
      const payload = {
        ...form,
        tags: splitTags(form.tags),
        images: normalizeImages(form.images, form.name),
        specifications: normalizeSpecifications(form.specifications),
        ...options,
      };
      const res = await fetch(productId ? `/api/admin/products/${productId}` : "/api/admin/products", {
        method: productId ? "PATCH" : "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      const json = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as SaveResponse;
      if (!res.ok || !json.ok) {
        // Keep the per-field map; only fall back to the flat string when there is none.
        setFieldErrs(json.fields ?? {});
        if (!json.fields || Object.keys(json.fields).length === 0) {
          throw new Error(json.error ?? "Save failed");
        }
        return; // field errors are now shown on the controls; don't also throw a banner
      }
      const createdId = json.product?.id ?? json.id;
      toast.push({
        title: isEdit ? "Product updated" : "Product created",
        body: isEdit ? undefined : "Next: add description, specs & PDP details.",
      });
      router.push(!isEdit && createdId ? `/admin/products/${createdId}/edit` : "/admin/products");
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Save failed");
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
      <section className="card grid gap-3 p-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <Input containerClassName="sm:col-span-2" label="Product name" value={form.name} onChange={(e) => set("name", e.target.value)} error={fe("name")} required />
        <Input label="Slug (optional)" value={form.slug} onChange={(e) => set("slug", e.target.value)} placeholder="auto-generated" error={fe("slug")} />
        <BrandSelect
          label="Brand" brands={brands} categories={categories.map((c) => c.name)}
          preferred={categories.find((c) => c.id === form.categoryId)?.name}
          value={form.brandId} onChange={(id) => set("brandId", id)} 
          onCreateBrand={async (name) => {
            const res = await fetch("/api/admin/brands", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ name }) });
            const j = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { ok?: boolean; id?: string; error?: string };
            if (!res.ok || !j?.ok || !j?.id) throw new Error(j?.error ?? "Could not create this brand.");
            return j.id;
          }}
        />
        <CategorySelect label="Category" options={categories.map((c) => ({ value: c.id, label: c.name }))} value={form.categoryId} onChange={(id) => set("categoryId", id)}/>
        <Input label="Style Type" value={form.subtype} onChange={(e) => set("subtype", e.target.value)} placeholder="Shirt / Trouser / Blazer / Shoes" error={fe("subtype")} />
        <Input label="Family group (same value links colour/variant siblings)" value={form.groupId} onChange={(e) => set("groupId", e.target.value)} error={fe("groupId")} />
      </section>

      <section className="card grid gap-3 p-5 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <Input label="MRP (₹)" type="number" value={raw.mrp} onChange={(e) => setNumeric("mrp", e.target.value)} error={fe("mrp")} required min={1} />
        <Input label="Sale price (₹)" type="number" value={raw.salePrice} onChange={(e) => setNumeric("salePrice", e.target.value)} error={fe("salePrice")} required min={1} />
        <Input label="Stock" type="number" value={raw.stock} onChange={(e) => setNumeric("stock", e.target.value)} error={fe("stock")} required min={0} />
        <Input label="Low stock alert at" type="number" value={raw.lowStockAt} onChange={(e) => setNumeric("lowStockAt", e.target.value)} error={fe("lowStockAt")} min={0} />
        <Input label="HSN code" value={raw.hsnCode} onChange={(e) => setHsnCode(e.target.value)} error={fe("hsnCode")} />
      </section>

      <section className="card grid gap-3 p-5 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <Input label="Size" value={form.ram} onChange={(e) => set("ram", e.target.value)} placeholder="S / M / L / XL" error={fe("ram")} />
        <Input label="Fabric" value={form.storage} onChange={(e) => set("storage", e.target.value)} placeholder="Cotton / Linen / Polyester" error={fe("storage")} />
        <Input label="Fit" value={form.screenSize} onChange={(e) => set("screenSize", e.target.value)} placeholder="Slim / Regular / Loose" error={fe("screenSize")} />
        <Input label="Occasion" value={form.processor} onChange={(e) => set("processor", e.target.value)} placeholder="Formal / Casual / Sports" error={fe("processor")} />
        <Input label="Color" value={form.color} onChange={(e) => set("color", e.target.value)} error={fe("color")} />
        <Input containerClassName="sm:col-span-3" label="Tags (comma separated)" value={form.tags} onChange={(e) => set("tags", e.target.value)} placeholder="formal, cotton, office, shirt" error={fe("tags")} />
      </section>

      <section className="card p-5">
        <h2 className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900"><ImageIcon className="size-4 text-electric-600" />Images</h2>
        {fieldErrs.images && <p className="mb-2 text-[12px] font-semibold text-flame-600">Images — {fieldErrs.images.join("; ")}</p>}
        <div className="mb-2">
          <button type="button" onClick={addImage} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[12px] font-semibold text-[#1a1a2e] hover:underline"><Plus className="size-3.5" />Add image</button>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {form.images.map((img, idx) => (
            <div key={idx} className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-[auto_auto_1fr_1fr_auto]">
              {img.url ? (
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setPreview(img.url)} title="Click to preview full image" className="group/thumb relative block size-12 shrink-0 cursor-zoom-in overflow-hidden rounded border border-gray-200 bg-white">
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                  <img src={img.url} alt="" className="size-full object-cover" />
                  <span className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center text-white opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover/thumb:bg-black/30 group-hover/thumb:opacity-100"><ZoomIn className="size-4" /></span>
                </button>
              ) : (<div className="size-12 shrink-0 rounded border border-dashed border-gray-300" />)}
              <ImageUploadButton onUploaded={(url) => patchImage(idx, { url })} />
              <Input placeholder="…or paste a URL" value={img.url} onChange={(e) => patchImage(idx, { url: e.target.value })} required={idx === 0} />
              <Input placeholder="Alt text" value={img.alt} onChange={(e) => patchImage(idx, { alt: e.target.value })} />
              <button type="button" onClick={() => removeImage(idx)} className="grid size-12 place-items-center rounded-xl border border-hairline text-flame-600 hover:bg-flame-500/10" aria-label="Remove image"><Trash2 className="size-4" /></button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="card p-5">
        <h2 className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900"><List className="size-4 text-electric-600" />Specifications</h2>
        {fieldErrs.specifications && <p className="mb-2 text-[12px] font-semibold text-flame-600">Specifications — {fieldErrs.specifications.join("; ")}</p>}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {form.specifications.map((spec, idx) => (
            <div key={idx} className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-[10rem_1fr_1fr_auto]">
              <Input placeholder="Group" value={spec.group} onChange={(e) => patchSpec(idx, { group: e.target.value })} />
              <Input placeholder="Label" value={spec.label} onChange={(e) => patchSpec(idx, { label: e.target.value })} />
              <Input placeholder="Value" value={spec.value} onChange={(e) => patchSpec(idx, { value: e.target.value })} />
              <button type="button" onClick={() => removeSpec(idx)} className="grid size-12 place-items-center rounded-xl border border-hairline text-flame-600 hover:bg-flame-500/10" aria-label="Remove spec"><Trash2 className="size-4" /></button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <Button type="button" size="sm" variant="outline" className="mt-3" onClick={addSpec}><Plus className="size-3.5" />Add specification</Button>
      </section>

      <section className="card p-5">
        <h2 className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900"><Palette className="size-4 text-electric-600" />Colours, groups &amp; variants</h2>
        {(fieldErrs.colors || fieldErrs.variants || fieldErrs.optionGroups) && (
          <p className="mb-2 text-[12px] font-semibold text-flame-600">Colours & variants — {[...(fieldErrs.colors ?? []), ...(fieldErrs.variants ?? []), ...(fieldErrs.optionGroups ?? [])].join("; ")}</p>
        )}
        <p className="mb-4 text-[12.5px] text-gray-500">Swatches with optional image URL, option groups such as Size, and price variants. Final size price = sale price + group add + size add.</p>
        <ProductOptionsEditor
          value={{ colors: form.colors, variants: form.variants, optionGroups: form.optionGroups }}
          onChange={(v: OptionsPayload) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, colors: v.colors ?? f.colors, variants: v.variants ?? f.variants, optionGroups: v.optionGroups ?? f.optionGroups }))}
        />
      </section>

      <section className="card grid gap-3 p-5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <Checkbox checked={form.active} onChange={(e) => set("active", e.target.checked)} label="Active" error={fe("active")} />
        <Checkbox checked={form.featured} onChange={(e) => set("featured", e.target.checked)} label="Featured" error={fe("featured")} />
        <Checkbox checked={form.codEligible} onChange={(e) => set("codEligible", e.target.checked)} label="COD eligible" error={fe("codEligible")} />
        <Checkbox checked={form.emiEligible} onChange={(e) => set("emiEligible", e.target.checked)} label="EMI eligible" error={fe("emiEligible")} />
        <Checkbox checked={form.exchangeEligible} onChange={(e) => set("exchangeEligible", e.target.checked)} label="Exchange eligible" error={fe("exchangeEligible")} />
      </section>

      {footer}

      {(error || unmapped.length > 0) && (
        <div role="alert" className="space-y-1 rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-4 py-3 text-[13px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
          {error && <p>{error}</p>}
          {unmapped.map(([k, v]) => (<p key={k}>{LABEL[k] ?? k} — {v.join("; ")}</p>))}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <Button type="submit" loading={busy}>{!busy && <Save className="size-4" />}{isEdit ? "Update product" : "Create product"}</Button>
        {productId && (<Button type="button" variant="outline" loading={copyBusy} onClick={() => void duplicate()}>{!copyBusy && <Copy className="size-4" />}Copy product</Button>)}
        <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => router.push("/admin/products")}>Cancel</Button>
        {productId && canDelete && (
          <ConfirmButton url={`/api/admin/products/${productId}`} confirmText="Delete this product? Only allowed if no order history exists." successText="Product deleted" variant="danger">Delete product</ConfirmButton>
        )}
      </div>
      {preview && <ImagePreviewModal url={preview} onClose={() => setPreview(null)} />}
    </form>
  );
}
