"use client";

import { Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { ImageUploadButton } from "@/components/admin/ImageUploadButton";

export type OptionsPayload = { colors: any[]; variants: any[]; optionGroups: any[] };

const normColor = (c: any) => (typeof c === "string" ? { name: c, image: "" } : { name: c?.name ?? "", image: c?.image ?? "" });

export function ProductOptionsEditor({ value, onChange }: {
  value: OptionsPayload;
  onChange: (v: OptionsPayload) => void;
}) {
  const colors = (value.colors ?? []).map(normColor);
  const variants = value.variants ?? [];
  const groups = value.optionGroups ?? [];

  const set = (patch: Partial<OptionsPayload>) => onChange({ colors, variants, optionGroups: groups, ...patch });
  const patchAt = <T,>(arr: T[], i: number, p: Partial<T>): T[] => arr.map((x, k) => (k === i ? { ...x, ...p } : x));

  const input = "h-9 w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-300 px-2 text-[13px] outline-none focus:border-[#1a1a2e]";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4">
      {/* COLORS — name + uploaded swatch */}
      <section>
        <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 className="text-[13.5px] font-bold text-gray-900">Colours</h3>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => set({ colors: [...colors, { name: "", image: "" }] })}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[12px] font-semibold text-[#1a1a2e]"><Plus className="size-3.5" /> Add colour</button>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {colors.map((c, i) => (
                        <div key={i} className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto_auto_1fr_auto] items-center gap-2">
              <input className={input} placeholder="Name (e.g. Sky Blue)" value={c.name ?? ""}
                onChange={(e) => set({ colors: patchAt(colors, i, { name: e.target.value }) })} />
              {c.image
                // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                ? <img src={c.image} alt="" className="size-9 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white object-contain" />
                : <span className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-gray-100 text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400">{(c.name || "?").slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}</span>}
              <ImageUploadButton label="Swatch" onUploaded={(url) => set({ colors: patchAt(colors, i, { image: url }) })} />
              <input className={input} placeholder="…or paste a URL" value={c.image ?? ""}
                onChange={(e) => set({ colors: patchAt(colors, i, { image: e.target.value }) })} />
              <button type="button" aria-label="Remove colour" onClick={() => set({ colors: colors.filter((_, k) => k !== i) })}
                className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 text-red-500"><Trash2 className="size-4" /></button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* OPTION GROUPS */}
      <section>
        <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 className="text-[13.5px] font-bold text-gray-900">Option groups (e.g. Size)</h3>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => set({ optionGroups: [...groups, { name: "", values: [{ label: "", add: 0 }] }] })}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[12px] font-semibold text-[#1a1a2e]"><Plus className="size-3.5" /> Add group</button>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {groups.map((g, gi) => (
            <div key={gi} className="rounded-lg border border-gray-200 p-2.5">
              <div className="mb-2 flex gap-2">
                <input className={input} placeholder="Group name (e.g. System Memory)" value={g.name ?? ""}
                  onChange={(e) => set({ optionGroups: patchAt(groups, gi, { name: e.target.value }) })} />
                <button type="button" aria-label="Remove group" onClick={() => set({ optionGroups: groups.filter((_, k) => k !== gi) })}
                  className="grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 text-red-500"><Trash2 className="size-4" /></button>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {(g.values ?? []).map((v: any, vi: number) => (
                  <div key={vi} className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_110px_auto] gap-2">
                    <input className={input} placeholder="Value (e.g. S / M / L / XL)" value={v.label ?? ""}
                      onChange={(e) => set({ optionGroups: patchAt(groups, gi, { values: patchAt(g.values, vi, { label: e.target.value }) }) })} />
                    <input className={input} type="number" placeholder="Price add ₹" value={v.add ?? 0}
                      onChange={(e) => set({ optionGroups: patchAt(groups, gi, { values: patchAt(g.values, vi, { add: Number(e.target.value) }) }) })} />
                    <button type="button" aria-label="Remove value"
                      onClick={() => set({ optionGroups: patchAt(groups, gi, { values: g.values.filter((_: any, k: number) => k !== vi) }) })}
                      className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 text-red-500"><Trash2 className="size-4" /></button>
                  </div>
                ))}
                <button type="button" onClick={() => set({ optionGroups: patchAt(groups, gi, { values: [...(g.values ?? []), { label: "", add: 0 }] }) })}
                  className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-[#1a1a2e]">+ Add value</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* VARIANTS */}
      <section>
        <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 className="text-[13.5px] font-bold text-gray-900">Sizes (price = base + group add + size add)</h3>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => set({ variants: [...variants, { label: "", add: 0, available: true }] })}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[12px] font-semibold text-[#1a1a2e]"><Plus className="size-3.5" /> Add size</button>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {variants.map((v, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="rounded-lg border border-gray-200 p-2.5">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-[1.4fr_100px_100px_auto] gap-2">
                <input className={input} placeholder="Label (e.g. L / Navy + L)" value={v.label ?? ""}
                  onChange={(e) => set({ variants: patchAt(variants, i, { label: e.target.value }) })} />
                <input className={input} type="number" placeholder="Add ₹" value={v.add ?? 0}
                  onChange={(e) => set({ variants: patchAt(variants, i, { add: Number(e.target.value) }) })} />
                <input className={input} type="number" placeholder="MRP add ₹" value={v.mrpAdd ?? v.add ?? 0}
                  onChange={(e) => set({ variants: patchAt(variants, i, { mrpAdd: Number(e.target.value) }) })} />
                <button type="button" aria-label="Remove variant" onClick={() => set({ variants: variants.filter((_, k) => k !== i) })}
                  className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 text-red-500"><Trash2 className="size-4" /></button>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] items-center gap-2">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12px] font-semibold text-gray-700">
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={v.available !== false}
                    onChange={(e) => set({ variants: patchAt(variants, i, { available: e.target.checked }) })} />
                  Available
                </label>
                <input className={input} placeholder="Note when unavailable (e.g. Available in other colours)" value={v.note ?? ""}
                  onChange={(e) => set({ variants: patchAt(variants, i, { note: e.target.value }) })} />
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

export default ProductOptionsEditor;

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { ConfirmButton } from "@/components/admin/ConfirmButton";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";

export function ProductRowActions({
  productId,
  active,
  canDelete,
}: {
  productId: string;
  active: boolean;
  canDelete: boolean;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function toggle() {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/products/${productId}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ active: !active }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Update failed");
      toast.push({ title: active ? "Product deactivated" : "Product activated" });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.push({ tone: "error", title: "Update failed", body: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
      <Link
        href={`/admin/products/${productId}/edit`}
        className="rounded-lg border border-hairline px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-bold text-ink-700 hover:border-electric-300"
      >
        Edit
      </Link>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={toggle}
        disabled={busy}
        className="rounded-lg border border-hairline px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-bold text-ink-700 hover:border-electric-300 disabled:opacity-50"
      >
        {busy ? "…" : active ? "Deactivate" : "Activate"}
      </button>
      {canDelete && (
        <ConfirmButton
          url={`/api/admin/products/${productId}`}
          confirmText="Delete this product? This is only possible if it has no order history."
          successText="Product deleted"
          variant="danger"
          size="sm"
        >
          Delete
        </ConfirmButton>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { RotateCcw, Save } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Select, Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/admin/StatusBadge";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import { inr, relativeTime } from "@/lib/utils";

type Return = {
  id: string;
  status: string;
  reason: string;
  details: string | null;
  resolution: string | null;
  adminNote: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  orderNumber: string;
  orderTotal: number;
  paymentStatus: string;
  customer: string;
  email: string;
  itemName: string;
  itemTotal: number;
  productId: string | null;
  stock: number | null;
};

const OPTIONS = ["APPROVED", "REJECTED", "PICKED_UP", "REPLACED", "REFUNDED", "CLOSED"];

export function ReturnsManager({ initial, canRefund }: { initial: Return[]; canRefund: boolean }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [items, setItems] = useState(initial);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [statuses, setStatuses] = useState<Record<string, string>>(
    Object.fromEntries(initial.map((r) => [r.id, r.status === "REQUESTED" ? "APPROVED" : r.status])),
  );

  async function decide(id: string) {
    const status = statuses[id] ?? "APPROVED";
    if (status === "REFUNDED" && !canRefund) {
      toast.push({ tone: "error", title: "Admin only", body: "Refunds require ADMIN role." });
      return;
    }

    setBusy(id);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/returns/${id}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status, adminNote: notes[id] ?? "" }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string; return?: { id: string; status: string } };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Decision failed");
      setItems((prev) => prev.map((r) => (r.id === id ? { ...r, status: json.return!.status } : r)));
      toast.push({ title: "Return updated" });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.push({ tone: "error", title: "Update failed", body: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined });
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="card overflow-hidden">
      <header className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-hairline px-4 py-3">
        <RotateCcw className="size-4 text-electric-600" />
        <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">Return requests</h2>
      </header>

      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full min-w-[70rem] text-[13px]">
          <thead className="bg-canvas text-left text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">
            <tr>
              <th className="px-4 py-3">Request</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3">Customer</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3">Item</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3">Reason</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3">Status</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3">Decision</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-hairline">
            {items.map((r) => (
              <tr key={r.id} className="align-top hover:bg-canvas/50">
                <td className="px-4 py-3">
                  <p className="font-bold text-ink-900">{r.orderNumber}</p>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">{relativeTime(r.createdAt)}</p>
                </td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3">
                  <p className="font-semibold text-ink-900">{r.customer}</p>
                  <p className="text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">{r.email}</p>
                </td>
                <td className="max-w-64 px-4 py-3">
                  <p className="truncate font-semibold text-ink-900">{r.itemName}</p>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">{inr(r.itemTotal)} · stock {r.stock ?? "—"}</p>
                </td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3">
                  <p className="font-semibold text-ink-900">{r.reason.replace(/_/g, " ")}</p>
                  {r.details && <p className="mt-1 line-clamp-3 text-[12px] text-ink-400">{r.details}</p>}
                </td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3"><StatusBadge status={r.status} /></td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3">
                  <div className="w-64 space-y-2">
                    <Select value={statuses[r.id] ?? "APPROVED"} onChange={(e) => setStatuses((s) => ({ ...s, [r.id]: e.target.value }))}>
                      {OPTIONS.filter((o) => o !== "REFUNDED" || canRefund).map((o) => (
                        <option key={o} value={o}>{o.replace(/_/g, " ")}</option>
                      ))}
                    </Select>
                    <Textarea
                      rows={2}
                      placeholder="Internal note / customer message"
                      value={notes[r.id] ?? ""}
                      onChange={(e) => setNotes((n) => ({ ...n, [r.id]: e.target.value }))}
                    />
                    <Button size="sm" loading={busy === r.id} onClick={() => void decide(r.id)} block>
                      {!busy && <Save className="size-3.5" />} Save decision
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\admin\SlideManager.tsx
============================================================

"use client";

import { ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Save, Search, SlidersHorizontal } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Checkbox, Input, Select, Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { ConfirmButton } from "@/components/admin/ConfirmButton";
import { ImageUploadButton } from "@/components/admin/ImageUploadButton";
import { ImagePreviewModal } from "@/components/admin/ImagePreviewModal";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import { SLIDE_GRADIENTS } from "@/lib/slide-gradients";

type Slide = {
  id: string;
  badge: string;
  headline: string;
  highlight: string | null;
  description: string | null;
  ctaLabel: string;
  ctaHref: string | null;
  secondaryLabel: string | null;
  secondaryHref: string | null;
  image: string | null;
  gradient: string;
  active: boolean;
  sortOrder: number;
   startsAt: string | null;
  endsAt: string | null;
  productIds: string[];
  productImages: Record<string, string>;
};

const blank = {
  badge: "MEGA OFFER",
  headline: "",
  highlight: "",
  description: "",
  ctaLabel: "Shop Now",
  ctaHref: "",
  secondaryLabel: "",
  secondaryHref: "",
  image: "",
  gradient: "MIDNIGHT",
  active: true,
  sortOrder: 0,
  startsAt: "",
  endsAt: "",
  productIds: [] as string[],
  productImages: {} as Record<string, string>,
};

export function SlideManager({ initial, products, canDelete }: { initial: Slide[]; products: { id: string; name: string }[]; canDelete: boolean }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [items, setItems] = useState(initial);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<any>(blank);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pq, setPq] = useState("");
  const [toggling, setToggling] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
            // Coerce edit-load nulls to "" so the payload is always strings (belt to the
      // schema's nullish() braces), and attach the per-product slide artwork map.
      const payload = {
        ...form,
        highlight: form.highlight ?? "",
        description: form.description ?? "",
        image: form.image ?? "",
        ctaHref: form.ctaHref ?? "",
        secondaryLabel: form.secondaryLabel ?? "",
        secondaryHref: form.secondaryHref ?? "",
        productImages: Object.fromEntries(
          (form.productIds as string[]).map((id: string) => [id, form.productImages?.[id] ?? ""]),
        ),
        startsAt: form.startsAt ? new Date(form.startsAt).toISOString() : undefined,
        endsAt: form.endsAt ? new Date(form.endsAt).toISOString() : undefined,
      };
      const res = await fetch(editingId ? `/api/admin/slides/${editingId}` : "/api/admin/slides", {
        method: editingId ? "PATCH" : "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; slide?: Slide; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok || !json.slide) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Save failed");
      setItems((prev) => editingId ? prev.map((s) => (s.id === editingId ? json.slide! : s)) : [...prev, json.slide!]);
      setEditingId(null);
      setForm(blank);
      toast.push({ title: editingId ? "Slide updated" : "Slide created" });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Save failed");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function move(id: string, dir: -1 | 1) {
    const idx = items.findIndex((s) => s.id === id);
    const swap = items[idx + dir];
    if (!swap) return;
    const next = [...items];
    next[idx] = swap;
    next[idx + dir] = items[idx]!;
    setItems(next);
    await fetch("/api/admin/slides/reorder", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ ids: next.map((s) => s.id) }),
    }).catch(() => router.refresh());
    router.refresh();
  }

    async function toggleActive(id: string) {
    const target = items.find((s) => s.id === id);
    if (!target) return;
    const next = !target.active;
    setToggling(id);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/slides/${id}/active`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ active: next }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Toggle failed");
      setItems((prev) => prev.map((s) => (s.id === id ? { ...s, active: next } : s)));
      toast.push({ title: next ? "Slide activated" : "Slide deactivated" });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.push({ tone: "error", title: "Toggle failed", body: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined });
    } finally {
      setToggling(null);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_26rem]">
      <section className="card overflow-hidden">
        <header className="border-b border-hairline px-4 py-3">

                   Edit

                    onClick={() => void toggleActive(s.id)}
                    disabled={toggling === s.id}

          <p className="mb-1.5 text-[12.5px] font-bold text-ink-700">Banner image (optional — full-bleed artwork)</p>

              <div className="size-12 rounded border border-dashed border-hairline" />
            )}
            <ImageUploadButton onUploaded={(url) => setForm({ ...form, image: url })} />

          </div>

          {Object.values(SLIDE_GRADIENTS).map((g) => (
            <option key={g.id} value={g.id}>{g.label}</option>
          ))}
        </Select>
        <Input label="Starts" type="datetime-local" value={form.startsAt ?? ""} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, startsAt: e.target.value })} />
        <Input label="Ends" type="datetime-local" value={form.endsAt ?? ""} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, endsAt: e.target.value })} />
        <Checkbox checked={form.active} onChange={(e: any) => setForm({ ...form, active: e.target.checked })} label="Active" />

                <div>
          <p className="mb-1.5 text-[12.5px] font-bold text-ink-700">Attach up to 3 products</p>
          <div className="mb-2 flex gap-2">
            <input
              value={pq}
              onChange={(e) => setPq(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search products (any word, e.g. rog, dell)"
              className="h-9 flex-1 rounded-lg border border-hairline px-2.5 text-[12.5px] outline-none focus:border-electric-400"
            />
            {pq.trim() && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPq("")}
                className="rounded-lg border border-hairline px-3 text-[12px] font-semibold text-ink-600 hover:bg-ink-50"
              >
                Clear
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          {pq.trim() && (
            <p className="mb-1 text-[11px] text-ink-400">
              Filtering as you type — selected products always stay visible so you can uncheck them.
            </p>
          )}
          <div className="max-h-48 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto rounded-xl border border-hairline p-2">
            {(() => {
              const q = pq.trim().toLowerCase();
              const tokens = q ? q.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean) : [];
              // Live any-word filter. Selected rows are NEVER hidden, so the
              // per-product "Slide image" input stays reachable and uncheckable
              // even when it doesn't match the current query.
              const visible = products.filter((p) => {
                if (form.productIds.includes(p.id)) return true;
                if (!tokens.length) return true;
                const h = p.name.toLowerCase();
                return tokens.some((t) => h.includes(t));
              });
              if (!visible.length) {
                return <p className="p-2 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">No products match “{pq.trim()}”.</p>;
              }
              return visible.map((p) => {
              const checked = form.productIds.includes(p.id);
              return (
                  <div key={p.id} className="rounded-lg px-1 py-0.5">
                  <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-[12.5px]">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={checked}
                      disabled={!checked && form.productIds.length >= 3}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        setForm((f: any) => ({
                          ...f,
                          productIds: e.target.checked ? [...f.productIds, p.id].slice(0, 3) : f.productIds.filter((id: string) => id !== p.id),
                        }));
                      }}
                      className="size-3.5 
accent-[#c9a96e]"
                    />
                    <span className="truncate">{p.name}</span>
                  </label>
                  {checked && (
                    <div className="ml-5 mt-1 grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] items-center gap-1.5">
                      <ImageUploadButton
                        label="Slide image"
                        onUploaded={(url) => setForm((f: any) => ({ ...f, productImages: { ...f.productImages, [p.id]: url } }))}
                      />
                      <Input
                        value={form.productImages?.[p.id] ?? ""}
                        onChange={(e: any) => setForm((f: any) => ({ ...f, productImages: { ...f.productImages, [p.id]: e.target.value } }))}
                        placeholder="…or paste a URL (slide-specific)"
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}
                 </div>
              );
              });
            })()}
          </div>
        </div>

        {error && <p role="alert" className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">{error}</p>}
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button type="submit" loading={busy} className="flex-1">{!busy && <Save className="size-4" />}{editingId ? "Update" : "Create"}</Button>
          {editingId && <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => { setEditingId(null); setForm(blank); }}>Cancel</Button>}
        </div>
      </form>

      {preview && <ImagePreviewModal url={preview} onClose={() => setPreview(null)} />}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\admin\SpecEditor.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";

type Row = { group: string; label: string; value: string };
type Kind = "SPEC" | "WARRANTY" | "MFG";

export function SpecEditor({ productId, kind, initial }: { productId: string; kind: Kind; initial: Row[] }) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<Row[]>(initial);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<"idle" | "saving" | "saved" | "error">("idle");

  const rowsRef = useRef(rows); rowsRef.current = rows;
  const dirty = useRef(false);
  const mounted = useRef(true);
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const chain = useRef<Promise<void>>(Promise.resolve());

  useEffect(() => () => { mounted.current = false; }, []);

  async function doSave() {
    const snap = JSON.stringify(rowsRef.current);
    const clean = rowsRef.current
      .filter((r) => r.label.trim() && r.value.trim())
      .map((r) => ({ group: r.group.trim() || "General", label: r.label.trim(), value: r.value.trim() }));
    setStatus("saving");
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/products/${productId}/specs`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ kind, specs: clean }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error();
    } catch { if (mounted.current) setStatus("error"); return; }
    if (!mounted.current) return;
    if (JSON.stringify(rowsRef.current) === snap) { dirty.current = false; setStatus("saved"); }
    else setStatus("saving"); // a fresher save is already queued behind us
  }

  function queueSave() { chain.current = chain.current.then(doSave).catch(() => {}); }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dirty.current) return;
    if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);
    timer.current = setTimeout(queueSave, 700);
    return () => { if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current); };
  }, [rows]);

  // flush a pending edit if the admin navigates/commits before the debounce fires
  useEffect(() => () => { if (dirty.current) { if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current); void queueSave(); } }, []);

  const update = (i: number, patch: Partial<Row>) => { dirty.current = true; setRows((rs) => rs.map((r, j) => (j === i ? { ...r, ...patch } : r))); };
  const remove = (i: number) => { dirty.current = true; setRows((rs) => rs.filter((_, j) => j !== i)); };
  const add = () => { dirty.current = true; setRows((rs) => [...rs, { group: "General", label: "", value: "" }]); };

  const statusText = status === "saving" ? "Saving…" : status === "saved" ? "Saved" : status === "error" ? "Save failed — retries on next edit" : "";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <button type="button" onClick={add} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[12px] font-semibold text-[#1a1a2e] hover:underline">
          <Plus className="size-3.5" /> Add row
        </button>
        {statusText ? <span className={`text-[11px] font-medium ${status === "error" ? "text-flame-600" : "text-gray-400"}`}>{statusText}</span> : null}
      </div>
      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="py-2 text-[12.5px] text-gray-400">No rows yet — add one above.</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {rows.map((r, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_1.2fr_1.2fr_auto] items-center gap-2">
              <input value={r.group} placeholder="Group" onChange={(e) => update(i, { group: e.target.value })} className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 px-2 text-[13px] outline-none focus:border-gray-400" />
              <input value={r.label} placeholder="Label" onChange={(e) => update(i, { label: e.target.value })} className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 px-2 text-[13px] outline-none focus:border-gray-400" />
              <input value={r.value} placeholder="Value" onChange={(e) => update(i, { value: e.target.value })} className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 px-2 text-[13px] outline-none focus:border-gray-400" />
              <button type="button" onClick={() => remove(i)} aria-label="Remove row" className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-lg text-gray-400 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-600"><Trash2 className="size-4" /></button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function StatCard({
  label,
  value,
  hint,
  href,
  tone = "default",
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  hint?: string;
  href?: string;
  tone?: "default" | "good" | "warn" | "bad";
}) {
  const cls = cn(
    "card p-4",
    href && "transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-lift",
  );

  const valueCls = cn(
    "mt-2 font-display text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums",
    tone === "good" && "text-emerald-600",
    tone === "warn" && "text-amber-600",
    tone === "bad" && "text-flame-600",
    tone === "default" && "text-ink-900",
  );

  const body = (
    <>
      <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">
        {label}
      </p>
      <p className={valueCls}>{value}</p>
      {hint && <p className="mt-1 text-[12px] text-ink-400">{hint}</p>}
    </>
  );

  return href ? (
    <Link href={href} className={cls}>
      {body}
    </Link>
  ) : (
    <div className={cls}>{body}</div>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\admin\StockEditor.tsx

"use client";

import { Check, Loader2, Minus, Plus } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function StockEditor({
  productId,
  stock,
  lowStockAt,
}: {
  productId: string;
  stock: number;
  lowStockAt: number;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [value, setValue] = useState(stock);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const dirty = value !== stock;
  const tone =
    value === 0 ? "text-flame-600" : value <= lowStockAt ? "text-amber-600" : "text-emerald-600";

  async function save() {
    const delta = value - stock;
    if (delta === 0) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/products/${productId}/stock`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ delta, reason: "Admin inline update" }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Stock update failed");
      toast.push({ title: "Stock updated" });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      setValue(stock);
      toast.push({
        tone: "error",
        title: "Stock update failed",
        body: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined,
      });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setValue((v) => Math.max(0, v - 1))}
        className="grid size-7 place-items-center rounded-lg border border-hairline text-ink-400 hover:border-electric-300"
        aria-label="Decrease stock"
      >
        <Minus className="size-3" />
      </button>
      <input
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => setValue(Math.max(0, Number(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "")) || 0))}
        onBlur={save}
        className={cn(
          "h-8 w-16 rounded-lg border border-hairline bg-white text-center text-[13px] font-bold tabular-nums outline-none focus:border-electric-400",
          tone,
        )}
        inputMode="numeric"
        aria-label="Stock quantity"
      />
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setValue((v) => v + 1)}
        className="grid size-7 place-items-center rounded-lg border border-hairline text-ink-400 hover:border-electric-300"
        aria-label="Increase stock"
      >
        <Plus className="size-3" />
      </button>
      {dirty && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={save}
          disabled={busy}
          className="grid size-7 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-electric-500 text-white disabled:opacity-60"
          aria-label="Save stock"
        >
          {busy ? <Loader2 className="size-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Check className="size-3.5" />}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { KeyRound, Loader2, LogIn, Mail, UserPlus } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Checkbox, Input, PasswordInput } from "@/components/ui/Input";

function AuthShell({
  title,
  subtitle,
  icon,
  children,
}: {
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="container-x flex min-h-[calc(100dvh-8rem)] items-center justify-center py-10">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md">
        <div className="mb-6 text-center">
          <span className="mx-auto grid size-12 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-ink-900 text-white">

          <h1 className="mt-4 font-display text-2xl font-bold text-ink-900">{title}</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[13.5px] text-ink-400">{subtitle}</p>
        </div>

            Back to storefront
          </Link>
        </p>

    </div>

function safeNext(next: string | null) {
  if (!next) return null;
  if (!next.startsWith("/") || next.startsWith("//")) return null;
  return next;
}

export function LoginForm() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const next = safeNext(params.get("next"));

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/auth/login", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email, password, admin: false }),
      });

      const json = (await res.json()) as {
        ok: boolean;
        error?: string;
        redirect?: string;
      };

      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Invalid credentials.");

      router.push(next ?? json.redirect ?? "/account");
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unable to sign in.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <AuthShell title="Sign in" subtitle="Access orders, wishlist and support." icon={<LogIn className="size-5" />}>
      <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
        <Input
          label="Email"
          type="email"
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="you@email.com"
          autoComplete="username"
          required
        />

        <PasswordInput
          label="Password"
          value={password}
          onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="••••••••"
          autoComplete="current-password"
          required
        />

        {error && (
          <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}

        <Button block size="lg" type="submit" loading={busy}>
          {!busy && <LogIn className="size-4" />}
          Sign in
        </Button>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[12.5px]">
          <Link href="/auth/forgot-password" className="font-semibold text-electric-600 hover:underline">
            Forgot password?
          </Link>
          <Link href="/auth/register" className="font-semibold text-ink-700 hover:underline">
            Create account
          </Link>
        </div>

        {/* <p className="text-center text-[12px] text-ink-400">
          Staff?{" "}
          <Link href="/admin/login" className="font-semibold text-violet-accent hover:underline">
            Admin login
          </Link>
        </p> */}
      </form>
    </AuthShell>
  );
}

export function RegisterForm() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const next = safeNext(params.get("next"));

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: "",
    email: "",
    phone: "",
    password: "",
    whatsappOptIn: false,
    honeypot: "",
  });
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/auth/register", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          ...form,
          phone: form.phone.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 10),
        }),
      });

      const json = (await res.json()) as {
        ok: boolean;
        error?: string;
        fields?: Record<string, string[]>;
        redirect?: string;
      };

      if (!json.ok) {
        const first = json.fields ? Object.values(json.fields).flat()[0] : json.error;
        throw new Error(first ?? "Registration failed.");
      }

      router.push(next ?? json.redirect ?? "/account");
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Registration failed.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <AuthShell title="Create account" subtitle="Faster checkout, order history and wishlist." icon={<UserPlus className="size-5" />}>
      <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
        <Input
          label="Full name"
          value={form.name}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })}
          required
          minLength={2}
        />

        <Input
          label="Email"
          type="email"
          value={form.email}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, email: e.target.value })}
          required
        />

                  <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <label className="text-[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500">
            Mobile number <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
          </label>

          <div className="flex">
            <span className="flex h-11 shrink-0 items-center rounded-l-lg border border-r-0 border-gray-300 bg-gray-100 px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-600">
              +91
            </span>
            <input
              type="tel"
              inputMode="numeric"
              maxLength={10}
              required
              value={form.phone}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setForm({
                  ...form,
                  phone: e.target.value
                    .replace(/\D/g, "")
                    .replace(/^0+(?=\d)/, "")
                    .slice(0, 10),
                })
              }
              placeholder="9876543210"
              className="h-11 w-full rounded-r-lg border border-gray-300 px-3 text-sm text-gray-900 placeholder:text-gray-400 outline-none transition-all focus:border-[#1a1a2e] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100"
            />
          </div>

          {form.phone.length > 0 && form.phone.length < 10 && (
            <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-orange-500">
              Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        <PasswordInput
          label="Password"
          value={form.password}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, password: e.target.value })}
          required
          hint="Min 10 chars, upper, lower, number and special character."
        />

        {/* <Checkbox
          checked={form.whatsappOptIn}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, whatsappOptIn: e.target.checked })}
          label="Send order updates on WhatsApp"
        /> */}

        <input
          type="text"
          value={form.honeypot}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, honeypot: e.target.value })}
          tabIndex={-1}
          autoComplete="off"
          aria-hidden="true"
          className="absolute left-[-9999px] h-0 w-0 opacity-0"
        />

        {error && (
          <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}

        <Button block size="lg" type="submit" loading={busy}>
          {!busy && <UserPlus className="size-4" />}
          Create account
        </Button>

        <p className="text-center text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">
          Already have an account?{" "}
          <Link href="/auth/login" className="font-semibold text-electric-600 hover:underline">
            Sign in
          </Link>
        </p>
      </form>
    </AuthShell>
  );
}

export function ForgotPasswordForm() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/auth/forgot-password", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email }),
      });

      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Could not send reset link.");

      setSent(true);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not send reset link.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <AuthShell title="Reset password" subtitle="We’ll email you a secure reset link." icon={<KeyRound className="size-5" />}>
      {sent ? (
        <div className="space-y-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-[13.5px] text-ink-700">
            If that email matches an account, a reset link is on its way.
          </p>
          <Button href="/auth/login" block>
            Back to sign in
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Email"
            type="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            required
          />

          {error && (
            <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}

          <Button block size="lg" type="submit" loading={busy}>
            {!busy && <Mail className="size-4" />}
            Send reset link
          </Button>

          <p className="text-center text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">
            Remembered it?{" "}
            <Link href="/auth/login" className="font-semibold text-electric-600 hover:underline">
              Sign in
            </Link>
          </p>
        </form>
      )}
    </AuthShell>
  );
}

export function ResetPasswordForm() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const token = params.get("token") ?? "";

  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!token) {
      setError("Reset token is missing. Request a new link.");
      return;
    }

    if (password !== confirm) {
      setError("Passwords do not match.");
      return;
    }

    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/auth/reset-password", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ token, password }),
      });

      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Password reset failed.");

      router.push("/auth/login");
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Password reset failed.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <AuthShell title="Set new password" subtitle="Choose a strong new password." icon={<KeyRound className="size-5" />}>
      <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
        <PasswordInput
          label="New password"
          value={password}
          onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          required
        />

        <PasswordInput
          label="Confirm password"
          value={confirm}
          onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)}
          required
        />

        {error && (
          <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}

        <Button block size="lg" type="submit" loading={busy}>
          {!busy && <KeyRound className="size-4" />}
          Update password
        </Button>

        <p className="text-center text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">
          <Link href="/auth/forgot-password" className="font-semibold text-electric-600 hover:underline">
            Request a new link
          </Link>
        </p>
      </form>
    </AuthShell>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Loader2, LogIn } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input, PasswordInput } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { useCart } from "@/context/CartContext";

export function LoginForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { setUser } = useCart();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/auth/login", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email, password, admin: false }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as {
        ok: boolean;
        error?: string;
        user?: { id: string; name: string; email: string; role: string };
        redirect?: string;
      };

      if (!json.ok || !json.user) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Unable to sign in.");

      setUser(json.user);
      const dest =
        next && next.startsWith("/") && !next.startsWith("/admin")
          ? next
          : json.redirect ?? "/account";

      router.push(dest);
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unable to sign in.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
      <Input
        label="Email"
        type="email"
        autoComplete="email"
        value={email}
        onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
        placeholder="you@email.com"
        required
      />

      <PasswordInput
        label="Password"
        autoComplete="current-password"
        value={password}
        onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
        placeholder="••••••••"
        required
      />

      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Link href="/auth/forgot-password" className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-electric-600 hover:underline">
          Forgot password?
        </Link>
        <Link href="/auth/register" className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-ink-400 hover:text-ink-900">
          Create account
        </Link>
      </div>

      <Button block size="lg" type="submit" loading={busy}>
        {!busy && <LogIn className="size-4" />}
        Sign in
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { ArrowRight, Lock, Mail, Phone, User } from "lucide-react";

import { BrandLogo } from "@/components/layout/BrandLogo";
import { OtpStep, type OtpStage } from "@/components/auth/OtpStep";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Checkbox, Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";

/**
 * Self-contained OTP-aware auth forms for /auth/login and /auth/register.
 * RECONSTRUCTED shell (the original AuthForms.tsx was never visible in any
 * dump), built from the app's confirmed design tokens + the real BrandLogo so
 * it matches the live site. Exports ONLY LoginForm/RegisterForm (the two the
 * pages import, prop-less). Forgot/Reset stay in the untouched AuthForms.tsx.
 */

// Open-redirect guard: only same-origin paths, never protocol-relative "//".
function redirectAfter(fallback: string) {
  const next = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("next");
  window.location.href =
    next && next.startsWith("/") && !next.startsWith("//") ? next : fallback;
}

function AuthShell({
  title,
  subtitle,
  children,
}: {
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-md px-4 py-12">
      <div className="mb-6 flex justify-center">
        <BrandLogo />
      </div>
      <div className="card p-6">
        <h1 className="font-display text-[20px] font-bold text-ink-900">{title}</h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-ink-400">{subtitle}</p>
        <div className="mt-5">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function FieldError({ msg }: { msg: string | null }) {
  if (!msg) return null;
  return (
    <p role="alert" className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
      {msg}
    </p>
  );
}

/* ────────────────────────────── LOGIN ────────────────────────────── */

export function LoginForm() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [otp, setOtp] = useState<OtpStage | null>(null);
  const [otpBusy, setOtpBusy] = useState(false);
  const [otpError, setOtpError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/auth/login", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email, password }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        ok: boolean;
        requiresOtp?: boolean;
        error?: string;
        phoneMasked?: string;
        expiresAt?: string;
        resendAfter?: string;
        devCode?: string;
        redirect?: string;
      };

      // Password ok, server now wants the 6-digit code (CUSTOMER path).
      if (json.requiresOtp) {
        setOtp({
          email,
          phoneMasked: json.phoneMasked ?? "",
          expiresAt: json.expiresAt ?? "",
          resendAfter: json.resendAfter ?? "",
          devCode: json.devCode,
        });
        return; // do NOT redirect — no session exists yet
      }

      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Invalid email or password.");

      // Staff/admin path: session already set server-side.
      redirectAfter(json.redirect ?? "/account");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Sign-in failed.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function verifyOtp(code: string) {
    setOtpBusy(true);
    setOtpError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/auth/login/verify", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: otp!.email, code }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        ok: boolean;
        error?: string;
        redirect?: string;
      };
      if (!json.ok) {
        setOtpError(json.error ?? "Incorrect OTP.");
        return;
      }
      toast.push({ tone: "success", title: "Signed in" });
      redirectAfter(json.redirect ?? "/account");
    } catch {
      setOtpError("Could not verify. Try again.");
    } finally {
      setOtpBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function resendOtp() {
    setOtpBusy(true);
    setOtpError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/auth/login/resend", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: otp!.email }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        ok: boolean;
        error?: string;
        phoneMasked?: string;
        expiresAt?: string;
        resendAfter?: string;
        devCode?: string;
      };
      if (json.ok) {
        setOtp((s) =>
          s && {
            ...s,
            phoneMasked: json.phoneMasked ?? s.phoneMasked,
            expiresAt: json.expiresAt ?? s.expiresAt,
            resendAfter: json.resendAfter ?? s.resendAfter,
            devCode: json.devCode,
          },
        );
      } else {
        setOtpError(json.error ?? "Could not resend.");
      }
    } catch {
      setOtpError("Could not resend.");
    } finally {
      setOtpBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <AuthShell title="Sign in" subtitle="Access orders, wishlist and support.">
      {otp ? (
        <OtpStep
          stage={otp}
          busy={otpBusy}
          error={otpError}
          onSubmit={verifyOtp}
          onResend={resendOtp}
          onCancel={() => {
            setOtp(null);
            setOtpError(null);
          }}
        />
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Email"
            type="email"
            autoComplete="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            required
          />
          <Input
            label="Password"
            type="password"
            autoComplete="current-password"
            value={password}
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
            required
          />
          <FieldError msg={error} />
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <a href="/auth/forgot" className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-ink-400 hover:text-electric-600">
              Forgot password?
            </a>
            <span className="text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">
              New here?{" "}
              <a href="/auth/register" className="font-semibold text-electric-600 hover:underline">
                Create account
              </a>
            </span>
          </div>
          <Button type="submit" loading={busy} className="w-full">
            {!busy && <ArrowRight className="size-4" />}
            {busy ? "Signing in…" : "Sign in"}
          </Button>
        </form>
      )}
    </AuthShell>
  );
}

/* ──────────────────────────── REGISTER ──────────────────────────── */

export function RegisterForm() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [whatsappOptIn, setWhatsappOptIn] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [otp, setOtp] = useState<OtpStage | null>(null);
  const [otpBusy, setOtpBusy] = useState(false);
  const [otpError, setOtpError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/auth/register", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name, email, phone, password, whatsappOptIn }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        ok: boolean;
        pendingVerification?: boolean;
        error?: string;
        fields?: Record<string, string[]>;
        phoneMasked?: string;
        expiresAt?: string;
        resendAfter?: string;
        devCode?: string;
      };

      if (!json.ok) {
        const first = json.fields ? Object.values(json.fields).flat()[0] : json.error;
        throw new Error(first ?? "Registration failed.");
      }

      // Account created inactive; a REGISTER OTP was sent. No session yet.
      if (json.pendingVerification) {
        setOtp({
          email,
          phone, // register verify/resend validate the phone matches the account
          phoneMasked: json.phoneMasked ?? "",
          expiresAt: json.expiresAt ?? "",
          resendAfter: json.resendAfter ?? "",
          devCode: json.devCode,
        });
        return;
      }

      // Should not happen with the OTP route, but stay safe.
      redirectAfter("/account");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Registration failed.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function verifyOtp(code: string) {
    setOtpBusy(true);
    setOtpError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/auth/register/verify", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: otp!.email, phone: otp!.phone, code }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        ok: boolean;
        error?: string;
        redirect?: string;
      };
      if (!json.ok) {
        setOtpError(json.error ?? "Incorrect OTP.");
        return;
      }
      toast.push({ tone: "success", title: "Account verified", body: "Welcome to Urban Vogue." });
      redirectAfter(json.redirect ?? "/account");
    } catch {
      setOtpError("Could not verify. Try again.");
    } finally {
      setOtpBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function resendOtp() {
    setOtpBusy(true);
    setOtpError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/auth/register/resend", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: otp!.email, phone: otp!.phone }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        ok: boolean;
        error?: string;
        phoneMasked?: string;
        expiresAt?: string;
        resendAfter?: string;
        devCode?: string;
      };
      if (json.ok) {
        setOtp((s) =>
          s && {
            ...s,
            phoneMasked: json.phoneMasked ?? s.phoneMasked,
            expiresAt: json.expiresAt ?? s.expiresAt,
            resendAfter: json.resendAfter ?? s.resendAfter,
            devCode: json.devCode,
          },
        );
      } else {
        setOtpError(json.error ?? "Could not resend.");
      }
    } catch {
      setOtpError("Could not resend.");
    } finally {
      setOtpBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <AuthShell title="Create account" subtitle="Shop faster, track orders, save favourites.">
      {otp ? (
        <OtpStep
          stage={otp}
          title="Confirm your mobile"
          submitLabel="Verify & continue"
          busy={otpBusy}
          error={otpError}
          onSubmit={verifyOtp}
          onResend={resendOtp}
          onCancel={() => {
            setOtp(null);
            setOtpError(null);
          }}
        />
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <Input
            label="Full name"
            autoComplete="name"
            value={name}
            onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
            required
          />
          <Input
            label="Email"
            type="email"
            autoComplete="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            required
          />
          <Input
            label="Mobile number"
            type="tel"
            inputMode="numeric"
            maxLength={10}
            placeholder="10-digit mobile"
            autoComplete="tel"
            value={phone}
            onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 10))}
            required
          />
          <Input
            label="Password"
            type="password"
            autoComplete="new-password"
            value={password}
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
            required
          />
          <Checkbox
            checked={whatsappOptIn}
            onChange={(e) => setWhatsappOptIn(e.target.checked)}
            label="Send me offers & order updates on WhatsApp"
          />
          <FieldError msg={error} />
          <p className="text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">
            Already have an account?{" "}
            <a href="/auth/login" className="font-semibold text-electric-600 hover:underline">
              Sign in
            </a>
          </p>
          <Button type="submit" loading={busy} className="w-full">
            {!busy && <ArrowRight className="size-4" />}
            {busy ? "Creating…" : "Create account"}
          </Button>
          <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-ink-300">
            A 6‑digit OTP will be sent to your mobile to activate the account.
          </p>
        </form>
      )}
    </AuthShell>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\auth\OtpStep.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";

export type OtpStage = {
  email: string;
  phone?: string;            // register verify/resend need it; login does not
  phoneMasked: string;
  expiresAt: string;         // ISO
  resendAfter: string;       // ISO
  devCode?: string;          // present only in non-prod when SMS didn't send
};

function secsLeft(iso: string): number {
  const t = new Date(iso).getTime() - Date.now();
  return t > 0 ? Math.ceil(t / 1000) : 0;
}

export function OtpStep({
  stage,
  title = "Verify your mobile",
  submitLabel = "Verify",
  busy,
  error,
  onSubmit,
  onResend,
  onCancel,
}: {
  stage: OtpStage;
  title?: string;
  submitLabel?: string;
  busy?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
  onSubmit: (code: string) => void;
  onResend: () => void;
  onCancel?: () => void;
}) {
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [cooldown, setCooldown] = useState(() => secsLeft(stage.resendAfter));

  useEffect(() => {
    if (cooldown <= 0) return;
    const t = setInterval(() => setCooldown((c) => (c > 0 ? c - 1 : 0)), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [cooldown]);

  // reset the box when a fresh code is sent (new timers/devCode arrive)
  useEffect(() => { setCode(""); setCooldown(secsLeft(stage.resendAfter)); },
    [stage.expiresAt, stage.resendAfter, stage.devCode]);

  const valid = /^\d{6}$/.test(code);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div>
        <h3 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">{title}</h3>
        <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">
          We sent a 6‑digit code to <span className="font-semibold text-ink-700">{stage.phoneMasked}</span>.
          It expires in {Math.max(0, Math.ceil((new Date(stage.expiresAt).getTime() - Date.now()) / 60000))} min.
        </p>
      </div>

      {stage.devCode && (
        <p className="rounded-lg bg-amber-500/10 px-3 py-2 text-[12px] font-semibold text-amber-700">
          Dev code (SMS not configured locally): <span className="tracking-widest">{stage.devCode}</span>
        </p>
      )}

      <Input
        autoFocus
        inputMode="numeric"
        autoComplete="one-time-code"
        maxLength={6}
        placeholder="••••••"
        value={code}
        onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 6))}
        onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Enter" && valid && !busy) onSubmit(code); }}
        aria-label="6-digit OTP"
      />

      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">{error}</p>
      )}

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Button type="button" loading={busy} disabled={!valid} onClick={() => onSubmit(code)}>
          {submitLabel}
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="outline"
          disabled={cooldown > 0 || busy}
          onClick={onResend}
        >
          {cooldown > 0 ? `Resend in ${cooldown}s` : "Resend code"}
        </Button>
        {onCancel && (
          <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-ink-400 hover:underline">
            Change number
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default OtpStep;

export function PasswordChecklist({ value }: { value: string }) {

            className={cn(

              ok ? "text-emerald-600" : "text-ink-300",
            )}
          >

            {rule.label}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Loader2, UserPlus } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";

import { useCart } from "@/context/CartContext";
import { PASSWORD_RULES } from "@/lib/validators";

export function RegisterForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { setUser } = useCart();
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: "",
    email: "",
    phone: "",
    password: "",
    whatsappOptIn: false,
    honeypot: "",
  });
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const allRulesPass = PASSWORD_RULES.every((r) => r.test(form.password));

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!allRulesPass) {
      setError("Please meet all password requirements.");
      return;
    }

    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/auth/register", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(form),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as {
        ok: boolean;
        error?: string;
        user?: { id: string; name: string; email: string; role: string };
      };

      if (!json.ok || !json.user) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Could not create account.");

      setUser(json.user);
      router.push(next && next.startsWith("/") ? next : "/account");
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not create account.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
      <Input
        label="Full name"
        value={form.name}
        onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })}
        placeholder="Rahul Sharma"
        autoComplete="name"
        required
        minLength={2}
      />

      <Input
        label="Email"
        type="email"
        value={form.email}
        onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, email: e.target.value })}
        placeholder="you@email.com"
        autoComplete="email"
        required
      />

      <Input
        label="Mobile number"
        value={form.phone}
        onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, phone: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 10) })}
        placeholder="9876543210"
        inputMode="numeric"
        autoComplete="tel"
      />

      <div>
        <PasswordInput
          label="Password"
          value={form.password}
          onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, password: e.target.value })}
          placeholder="Create a strong password"
          autoComplete="new-password"
          required
        />
        <div className="mt-2.5">
          <PasswordChecklist value={form.password} />
        </div>
      </div>

      <Checkbox
        checked={form.whatsappOptIn}
        onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, whatsappOptIn: e.target.checked })}
        label="Send me order updates and offer alerts on WhatsApp"
      />

      {/* honeypot */}
      <input
        type="text"
        name="company_website"
        value={form.honeypot}
        onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, honeypot: e.target.value })}
        className="absolute left-[-9999px] h-0 w-0 opacity-0"
        tabIndex={-1}
        autoComplete="off"
        aria-hidden="true"
      />

      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Link href="/auth/login" className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-electric-600 hover:underline">
          Already have an account?
        </Link>

"use client";

import { Loader2, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { PasswordInput } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { PasswordChecklist } from "@/components/auth/PasswordChecklist";
import { PASSWORD_RULES } from "@/lib/validators";

export function ResetPasswordForm({ token }: { token: string }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const allRulesPass = PASSWORD_RULES.every((r) => r.test(password));

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

    if (!allRulesPass) {
      setError("Please meet all password requirements.");
      return;
    }
    if (password !== confirm) {
      setError("Passwords do not match.");
      return;
    }

    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/auth/reset-password", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ token, password }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Could not reset password.");

      router.push("/auth/login");
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not reset password.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
      <div>
        <PasswordInput
          label="New password"
          value={password}
          onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          autoComplete="new-password"
          required
        />
        <div className="mt-2.5">
          <PasswordChecklist value={password} />
        </div>
      </div>

      <PasswordInput
        label="Confirm password"
        value={confirm}
        onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)}
        autoComplete="new-password"
        required
      />

      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      <Button block size="lg" type="submit" loading={busy}>
        {!busy && <ShieldCheck className="size-4" />}
        Reset password
      </Button>

      <p className="text-center text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">
        <Link href="/auth/login" className="font-semibold text-electric-600 hover:underline">
          Back to login
        </Link>
      </p>
    </form>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\cart\CartRecommendRail.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { ProductThumb } from "@/components/cart/ProductThumb";
import { useCart } from "@/context/CartContext";
import { inr } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { CardVM } from "@/lib/catalog";

const RECENT_KEY = "uv:recent:v1"; // same history the PDP / account rail write

export function CartRecommendRail({
  title,
  subtitle,
  source,
  exclude = [],
  count = 12,
}: {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  source: "random" | "recent";
  exclude?: string[];
  count?: number;
}) {
  const { add } = useCart();
  const [items, setItems] = useState<CardVM[] | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    const run = async () => {
      let url = "";
      if (source === "random") {
        const qs = new URLSearchParams({ n: String(count) });
        if (exclude.length) qs.set("exclude", exclude.join(","));
        url = `/api/feed/cart-recommendations?${qs}`;
      } else {
        let ids: string[] = [];
        try {
          const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(RECENT_KEY);
          const list = raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as Array<{ id?: string }>) : [];
          ids = (Array.isArray(list) ? list : []).map((r) => r.id ?? "").filter(Boolean);
        } catch { ids = []; }
        const ex = new Set(exclude);
        const final = (exclude.length ? ids.filter((id) => !ex.has(id)) : ids).slice(0, count);
        if (!final.length) { if (alive) setItems([]); return; }
        url = `/api/feed/cart-recommendations?ids=${final.join(",")}`;
      }
      try {
        const res = await fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" });
        const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; products?: CardVM[] };
        if (alive) setItems(json.ok && Array.isArray(json.products) ? json.products : []);
      } catch { if (alive) setItems([]); }
    };
    void run();
    return () => { alive = false; };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [source, exclude.join(","), count]);

  if (!items || items.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <section className="card p-4">
      <div className="mb-3">
        <h2 className="font-display text-[14px] font-bold text-ink-900">{title}</h2>
        {subtitle && <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12px] text-ink-400">{subtitle}</p>}
      </div>
      <div className="no-scrollbar -mx-1 flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto px-1 pb-1">
        {items.map((p) => (
          <div key={p.id} className="flex w-36 shrink-0 flex-col">
            <Link href={`/product/${p.slug}`} className="relative block aspect-square overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-canvas">
              <ProductThumb src={p.image} name={p.name} />
            </Link>
            <Link href={`/product/${p.slug}`} className="mt-2 line-clamp-2 min-h-[2.1rem] text-[12px] font-semibold leading-snug text-ink-900 hover:text-electric-600">
              {p.name}
            </Link>
            <p className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-1">
              <span className="text-[12.5px] font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">{inr(p.salePrice)}</span>
              {p.mrp > p.salePrice && <span className="text-[11px] text-ink-300 line-through tabular-nums">{inr(p.mrp)}</span>}
            </p>
            {p.discountPercent > 0 && <span className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-600">{p.discountPercent}% off</span>}
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="mt-2 w-full" onClick={() => void add(p.id)}>
              Add to cart
            </Button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
