"use client";

import { CheckCircle, Loader2, MapPin, XCircle } from "lucide-react";

type Props = {
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  status: "idle" | "loading" | "success" | "error";
  msg: string;
};

// Holds NO state and NO hooks. The PIN lives in the parent's addressForm, so a
// re-render or an accidental remount can never erase the digits you typed.
export function PincodeChecker({ value, onChange, status, msg }: Props) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500">
        <MapPin className="size-3" /> PIN Code
      </label>

      <div className="relative">
        <input
          type="text"
          inputMode="numeric"
          maxLength={6}
          value={value}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ""))}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter") {
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopPropagation();
            }
          }}
          className={`w-full h-11 rounded-lg border px-3 text-sm text-gray-900 placeholder:text-gray-400 outline-none transition-all ${
            status === "loading"
              ? "border-blue-400 bg-amber-50/50 ring-2 ring-blue-100"
              : status === "success"
                ? "border-green-500 bg-green-50/50 ring-2 ring-green-100"
                : status === "error"
                  ? "border-red-500 bg-red-50/50 ring-2 ring-red-100"
                  : "border-gray-300 focus:border-[#1a1a2e] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100"
          }`}
          placeholder="e.g. 560001"
        />
        <div className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2">
          {status === "loading" && <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-amber-500" />}
          {status === "success" && <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />}
          {status === "error" && <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-red-500" />}
        </div>
      </div>

      {msg && (
        <p
          className={`text-[11px] font-semibold ${
            status === "error" ? "text-red-500" : "text-green-600"
          }`}
        >
          {msg}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Pencil, Phone, Plus } from "lucide-react";
import type { AddressVM } from "@/lib/address-types";

/**
 * Flipkart-style saved address: a read-only "Deliver to:" card by default,
 * with a Change button that swaps it for the picker list. Owns only its own
 * open/closed state — selection lives in the checkout wizard.
 */
export function SavedAddressCard({ addresses, selectedId, onSelect, onAddNew }: {
  addresses: AddressVM[];
  selectedId: string;
  onSelect: (id: string) => void;
  onAddNew: () => void;
}) {
  const [changing, setChanging] = useState(false);
  const current = addresses.find((a) => a.id === selectedId) ?? addresses[0] ?? null;
  if (!current) return null;

  if (!changing) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-hairline bg-white p-4">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="min-w-0">

              {current.fullName}
              <span className="rounded bg-gray-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-600">
                {current.label}
              </span>
              {current.isDefault && (
                <span className="rounded bg-amber-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-amber-800">
                  Default
                </span>
              )}
            </p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-400">
              {current.line1}
              {current.line2 ? `, ${current.line2}` : ""}, {current.city}, {current.state} — {current.pincode}
            </p>
            <p className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-ink-700">
              <Phone className="size-3" /> {current.phone}
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"

          >
            <Pencil className="size-3.5" /> Change
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-hairline bg-white p-4">
      <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400">Choose delivery address</p>
      <ul className="space-y-2">
        {addresses.map((a) => (
          <li key={a.id}>
            <label

                selectedId === a.id ? "border-[#1a1a2e] bg-amber-50/50" : "border-gray-200 hover:border-[#93c5fd]"
              }`}

              <input
                type="radio"

                    {a.label}
                  </span>
                  {a.isDefault && (

FILE: src\components\contact\ContactForm.tsx
============================================================

"use client";

import { Loader2, Send } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Input, Select, Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";

export function ContactForm() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: "",
    email: "",
    phone: "",
    topic: "SUPPORT",
    message: "",
    honeypot: "",
  });
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/contact", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(form),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Could not send message.");
      setSent(true);
      toast.push({ title: "Message sent", body: "Our team will reply soon." });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not send message.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  if (sent) {
    return (
      <div className="card p-6 text-center">
        <h2 className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-ink-900">Thanks for reaching out</h2>
        <p className="mt-2 text-[13.5px] text-ink-400">
          Your message has been received. Our support team typically replies within 24 working hours.
        </p>
        <Button className="mt-5" variant="outline" onClick={() => setSent(false)}>
          Send another message
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="card space-y-4 p-5 sm:p-6">
      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <Input label="Full name" value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })} required minLength={2} />
        <Input label="Email" type="email" value={form.email} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, email: e.target.value })} required />
        <Input label="Mobile (optional)" value={form.phone} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, phone: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 10) })} inputMode="numeric" />
        <Select label="Topic" value={form.topic} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, topic: e.target.value })}>
          <option value="SALES">Sales / product advice</option>
          <option value="SUPPORT">Order support</option>
          <option value="PARTNERSHIP">Partnership</option>
          <option value="PRESS">Press</option>
          <option value="OTHER">Other</option>
        </Select>
      </div>

      <Textarea
        label="Message"
        value={form.message}
        onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, message: e.target.value })}
        rows={6}
        required
        minLength={10}
        placeholder="Tell us what you need help with. Include order number if relevant."
      />

      <input
        type="text"
        value={form.honeypot}
        onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, honeypot: e.target.value })}
        tabIndex={-1}
        autoComplete="off"
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="absolute left-[-9999px] h-0 w-0 opacity-0"
      />

      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      <Button type="submit" size="lg" loading={busy}>
        {!busy && <Send className="size-4" />}
        Send message
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\HideOnProduct.tsx

"use client";

import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";

// Renders its children everywhere EXCEPT the storefront product detail page
// (/product/<slug>). Note the regex: "/product/" (singular) matches the PDP,
// while "/products/..." (plural, your category routes) is NOT matched — so
// category/cart/account pages keep their bottom nav.
export function HideOnProduct({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  if (/^\/product(\/|$)/.test(pathname)) return null;
  return <>{children}</>;
}

"use client";

import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { Zap } from "lucide-react";
import Image from "next/image";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { RatingPill } from "@/components/ui/Rating";
import { useCart } from "@/context/CartContext";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import type { CardVM } from "@/lib/catalog";
import { inr, savings } from "@/lib/utils";

function msToMidnight(): number {
  const now = new Date();
  const end = new Date(now);
  end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
  return Math.max(0, end.getTime() - now.getTime());
}

export function DealOfTheDay({
  deal,
  runners,
}: {
  deal: CardVM;
  runners: CardVM[];
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { add } = useCart();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [remaining, setRemaining] = useState(msToMidnight());
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<"cart" | "grab" | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => setRemaining(msToMidnight()), 1000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  const totalSeconds = Math.floor(remaining / 1000);
  const h = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
  const s = totalSeconds % 60;

  const claimedBase = Math.max(1, deal.sold + deal.stock);
  const pct = Math.min(94, Math.round((deal.sold / claimedBase) * 100));

  async function addToCart() {
    setBusy("cart");
    await add(deal.id, 1);
    setBusy(null);
  }

  async function grabDeal() {
    setBusy("grab");
    await add(deal.id, 1);
    toast.push({ title: "Deal grabbed", body: "Taking you to checkout…" });
    router.push("/checkout");
  }

  return (
    <section className="card overflow-hidden">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-hairline bg-gradient-to-r from-flame-500/8 px-4 py-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-flame-500 text-white">
            ⚡
          </span>
          <div>
            <h2 className="font-display text-base font-bold text-ink-900">
              Deal of the Day
            </h2>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-ink-400">
              One flagship price, until midnight
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5"
          aria-label={`${h} hours ${m} minutes remaining`} suppressHydrationWarning
        >
          {[h, m, s].map((v, i) => (
            <span key={i} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span suppressHydrationWarning className="grid h-8 min-w-8 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-ink-900 text-[13px] font-bold tabular-nums text-white">
                {String(v).padStart(2, "0")}
              </span>
              {i < 2 && <span className="text-ink-300">:</span>}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-5 p-4 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,15rem)_1fr] sm:p-5">
        <Link
          href={`/product/${deal.slug}`}
          className="group relative block aspect-square overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-canvas"
        >
          <Image
            src={deal.image}
            alt={deal.name}
            fill
            sizes="240px"
            className="object-contain p-3 transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105"
          />
          <Badge
            tone="deal"
            className="absolute left-2 top-2 bg-flame-500 text-white ring-0"
          >
            {deal.discountPercent}% OFF
          </Badge>
        </Link>

        <div className="flex flex-col">
          <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">
            {deal.brand}
          </p>

          <Link
            href={`/product/${deal.slug}`}
            className="mt-1 font-display text-lg font-bold leading-snug text-ink-900 hover:text-electric-600 sm:text-xl"
          >
            {deal.name}
          </Link>

          <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-3">
            <RatingPill value={deal.ratingAvg} count={deal.ratingCount} />
            <span className="text-[12px] text-ink-400">
              {deal.sold.toLocaleString("en-IN")} sold
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-2">
            <span className="font-display text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">
              {inr(deal.salePrice)}
            </span>
            <span className="text-sm text-ink-300 line-through tabular-nums">
              {inr(deal.mrp)}
            </span>
            <Badge tone="save">
              You save {inr(savings(deal.mrp, deal.salePrice))}
            </Badge>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 max-w-sm">
            <div className="mb-1 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-semibold">
              <span className="text-ink-400">Stock claimed</span>
              <span className="text-flame-600">{pct}%</span>
            </div>

            <div className="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-ink-900/8">
              <motion.div
                initial={{ width: 0 }}
                animate={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
                transition={{ duration: 0.9, ease: "easeOut" }}
                className="h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-flame-500 to-orange-deal"
              />
            </div>

            <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">
              {deal.stock <= deal.lowStockAt
                ? `Hurry — only ${deal.stock} left`
                : `${deal.stock} units available`}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={addToCart}
              disabled={busy !== null || deal.stock <= 0}
              className="h-11 rounded-xl bg-ink-900 px-6 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-electric-600 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {busy === "cart" ? "Adding…" : "Add to Cart"}
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={grabDeal}
              disabled={busy !== null || deal.stock <= 0}
              className="inline-flex h-11 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-offer px-6 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-white transition-transform active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <Zap className="size-4" />
              {busy === "grab" ? "Working…" : "Grab Deal"}
            </button>

            <Link
              href={`/product/${deal.slug}`}
              className="inline-flex h-11 items-center rounded-xl border border-hairline px-5 text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-ink-700 hover:border-electric-300"
            >
              View details
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {runners.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid gap-3 border-t border-hairline p-4 sm:grid-cols-3 sm:p-5">
          {runners.slice(0, 3).map((p) => (
            <Link
              key={p.id}
              href={`/product/${p.slug}`}
              className="group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-hairline p-2.5 transition-colors hover:border-electric-300"
            >
              <span className="relative size-16 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-canvas">
                <Image
                  src={p.image}
                  alt={p.name}
                  fill
                  sizes="64px"
                  className="object-contain p-1"
                />
              </span>

              <span className="min-w-0">
                <span className="block truncate text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-ink-900">
                  {p.name}
                </span>
                <span className="mt-0.5 flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
                  <span className="text-[13px] font-bold tabular-nums">
                    {inr(p.salePrice)}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-mint-500">
                    {p.discountPercent}% off
                  </span>
                </span>
              </span>
            </Link>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";

// ASCII-only source: \u escapes decode to real glyphs at runtime but are plain bytes
// in the file, so the CP1252 mojibake that keeps re-infecting pasted files can never
// return. Never hardcode a literal rupee / down-arrow / middle-dot here again.
const RUPEE = "\u20B9";
const ARROW = "\u2193";
const DOT = "\u00B7";

type Ad = {
  id?: string;
  slug?: string;
  name?: string;
  image?: string;
  price?: number | string;
  salePrice?: number | string;
  mrp?: number | string;
  brand?: string | null; // route still returns it; intentionally NOT rendered here
};

/**
 * The feed's Featured card, stripped to pure composition per the reference review:
 * NO disclosure chip, NO illustration micro-line, NO brand stamp, NO radial glow
 * (a blue glow behind a white-canvas JPG is exactly the seam/halo we are removing).
 * The panel is a left blue wash that terminates to PURE WHITE before the product
 * starts, so a white-canvas studio photo merges with the stage (its background ==
 * the slide background) with zero rectangle; the product is enlarged and bled to the
 * top/bottom/right via object-CONTAIN (never cover -> nothing cropped) with only a
 * soft grounding shadow. Copy stays dark ink on the blue left. Data is one random
 * active+in-stock product fetched per mount, so anything published later is eligible
 * on the next draw. Slot / margins / fetch unchanged => page position identical.
 */
export function DynamicAdSlot() {
  const [ad, setAd] = useState<Ad | null>(null);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);

  // Sponsored product: fetched per mount, so every real load/refresh draws a fresh
  // uniform pick from the whole active, in-stock catalog (the route has no gate and
  // no row cap), which is what makes a product you add later eligible on the next draw.
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    fetch("/api/feed/random-ad")
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((json) => {
        if (!alive) return;
        const a = (json?.product ?? json ?? null) as Ad | null;
        setAd(a && (a.slug || a.id) ? a : null);
      })
      .catch(() => alive && setAd(null))
      .finally(() => alive && setLoaded(true));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const href = ad ? `/product/${ad.slug ?? ad.id}` : "/products/all";
  const price = ad ? Number(ad.price ?? ad.salePrice ?? 0) : 0;
  const mrp = ad ? Number(ad.mrp ?? price) : 0;
  const off = mrp > price ? Math.round(((mrp - price) / mrp) * 100) : 0;

  return (
    <section className="container-x mt-6 mb-8 md:mt-8 md:mb-10" aria-label="Featured">
      {!loaded ? (
        <div className="h-[156px] w-full animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-gray-200 sm:h-[184px]" />
      ) : ad ? (
        <Link
          href={href}
          className="group relative flex min-h-[156px] items-center overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-gray-200/70 bg-[linear-gradient(to_right,#d7eaff_0%,#e9f2ff_36%,#ffffff_48%,#ffffff_100%)] p-4 no-underline shadow-sm transition-shadow hover:shadow-md sm:min-h-[184px] sm:bg-[linear-gradient(to_right,#d7eaff_0%,#e9f2ff_30%,#ffffff_42%,#ffffff_100%)] sm:p-6"
        >
          {/* PRODUCT, bled large to top/bottom/right, CONTAINED on the white side so a
              white-canvas photo has no edge and nothing is cropped. Soft grounding
              shadow only (no halo) keeps it reading as a clean studio shot on white. */}
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-[-6%] -right-[4%] z-10 grid w-[54%] place-items-center sm:-right-[6%] sm:w-[60%]">
            {ad.image ? (
              // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
              <img
                src={ad.image}
                alt={ad.name ?? "Featured product"}
                className="size-full object-contain object-center drop-shadow-[0_14px_24px_rgba(2,6,23,0.12)] transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-[1.03]"
              />
            ) : (
              <span className="grid size-full place-items-center text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-300">
                {(ad.name ?? "").slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
              </span>
            )}
          </span>

          {/* LEFT copy in flow, constrained to the blue wash so it never underlaps the
              white product zone. Dark ink, no chip above it, no micro-line below it. */}
          <span className="relative z-20 flex w-[44%] min-w-0 flex-col justify-center sm:w-[38%]">
            <span className="block font-display text-[15px] font-extrabold leading-[1.12] text-gray-900 line-clamp-2 sm:text-[18px]">
              {ad.name ?? "Today's spotlight deal"}
            </span>
            <span className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5">
              <span className="text-[24px] font-black leading-none tabular-nums text-gray-900 sm:text-[28px]">
                {RUPEE}{Math.round(price).toLocaleString("en-IN")}
              </span>
              {mrp > price && (
                <span className="text-[12px] tabular-nums text-gray-400 line-through sm:text-[13px]">
                  {RUPEE}{Math.round(mrp).toLocaleString("en-IN")}
                </span>
              )}
              {off > 0 && (
                <span className="text-[12px] font-bold text-emerald-600 sm:text-[13px]">
                  {ARROW}{off}%
                </span>
              )}
            </span>
          </span>
        </Link>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex h-24 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-300 bg-white text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400">
          Featured slot {DOT} no active style
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, Fragment } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import Image from "next/image";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { CardVM } from "@/lib/catalog";
import { DynamicAdSlot } from "@/components/home/DynamicAdSlot";
import { HOME_FEATURES, type FeatureKey } from "@/lib/home-features";

function shuffle<T>(array: T[]): T[] {
  const arr = [...array];
  for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j]!, arr[i]!] as [T, T];
  }
  return arr;
}

type Curated = Partial<Record<FeatureKey, CardVM[]>>;

export function DynamicRails({
  deals,
  newArrivals,
  bestSellers,
  allProducts,
  curated = {},
}: {
  deals: CardVM[];
  newArrivals: CardVM[];
  bestSellers: CardVM[];
  allProducts: CardVM[];
  curated?: Curated;
}) {
  const [sections, setSections] = useState<any[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Curated lists win (order preserved from admin); shuffled pool is the
    // fallback so empty rails still render something rather than collapsing.
    const poolDeals = shuffle(deals).slice(0, 10);
    const poolNew = shuffle(newArrivals).slice(0, 10);
    const poolBest = shuffle(bestSellers).slice(0, 10);
    const poolMixed = shuffle(allProducts).slice(0, 20);

    const itemsFor = (key: FeatureKey, fallback: CardVM[]) => {
      const c = curated[key];
      return c && c.length ? c : fallback;
    };

    setSections([
      { def: HOME_FEATURES[0], items: itemsFor("HOT_DEALS", poolDeals) },
      { def: HOME_FEATURES[1], items: itemsFor("BEST_SELLERS", poolBest) },
      { def: HOME_FEATURES[2], items: itemsFor("WISHLIST", poolMixed.slice(0, 8)) },
      { def: HOME_FEATURES[3], items: itemsFor("NEW_ARRIVALS", poolNew) },
      { def: HOME_FEATURES[4], items: itemsFor("TRENDING", poolMixed.slice(8, 16)) },
    ]);
  }, [deals, newArrivals, bestSellers, allProducts, curated]);

  if (!sections.length) return null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 pb-8">
      {sections.map((section, idx) => (
        <Fragment key={section.def.key}>
          <section className="card overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
            <div className={cn("flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2.5", section.def.bg)}>
              <h2 className={cn("font-display text-[15px] font-bold", section.def.text)}>
                {section.def.title}
              </h2>
              <Link
                href="/products/all"
                className={cn("text-xs font-semibold opacity-90 hover:opacity-100", section.def.text)}
              >
                VIEW ALL →
              </Link>
            </div>

            <div className="no-scrollbar grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 p-3 bg-white sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-6">
              {section.items.map((p: CardVM) => (
                <Link
                  key={p.id}
                  href={`/product/${p.slug}`}
                  className="group relative"
                >
                  <div className="relative mb-2 aspect-square overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50">
                    <Image
                      src={p.image}
                      alt={p.name}
                      fill
                      sizes="160px"
                      className="object-contain p-2 transition-transform group-hover:scale-105"
                    />
                    {p.discountPercent > 0 && (
                      <span className="absolute bottom-1 left-1 rounded bg-green-600 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-white shadow-sm">
                        {p.discountPercent}% OFF
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="px-1">
                    <p className="line-clamp-2 h-8 text-[12px] font-medium leading-tight text-gray-800">
                      {p.name}
                    </p>
                    <div className="mt-1 flex items-baseline gap-1">
                      <span className="text-[14px] font-bold text-gray-900">₹{p.salePrice}</span>
                      {p.mrp > p.salePrice && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 line-through">₹{p.mrp}</span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </Link>
              ))}
            </div>
          </section>
          {idx === 0 && <DynamicAdSlot />}
        </Fragment>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowRight, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";

// ASCII-only glyph (see home-slides.ts): no literal rupee in source, ever.
const RUPEE = "\u20B9";

type SlideProduct = {
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  image: string;
  salePrice: number;
  /** ONLY the admin-supplied per-slide artwork; null when that input was empty. */
  slideImage?: string | null;
  discountPercent?: number;
  brand?: string | null;
  color?: string | null;
  storage?: string | null;
  ram?: string | null;
};

type Slide = {
  id: string;
  imageUrl: string;
  art?: boolean;
  headline: string;
  highlight?: string;
  description?: string;
  badge?: string | null;
  ctaLabel: string;
  ctaHref: string;
  products?: SlideProduct[];
};

// Flipkart-style strip: several rounded banner cards visible at once, sliding one
// card per step with neighbours peeking. Heights +~3% (186/227/288), shared by BOTH
// branches so the strip row stays aligned against the deal tiles below.
const CARD_VARS =
  "[--gap:8px] [--card-w:100%] sm:[--gap:16px] sm:[--card-w:60%] lg:[--card-w:47.5%]";

export function HeroCarousel({ slides }: { slides: Slide[] }) {
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(0);
  const [perView, setPerView] = useState(1);
  const total = slides.length;
  const maxIndex = Math.max(0, total - perView);

  useEffect(() => {
    const mqSm = window.matchMedia("(min-width: 640px)");
    const apply = () => setPerView(mqSm.matches ? 2 : 1);
    apply();
    mqSm.addEventListener("change", apply);
    return () => mqSm.removeEventListener("change", apply);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (maxIndex <= 0) return;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setCurrent((prev) => (prev >= maxIndex ? 0 : prev + 1));
    }, 4000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [maxIndex]);

  if (!slides.length) return null;

  const goTo = (n: number) => setCurrent(Math.min(Math.max(n, 0), maxIndex));

  return (
    <div className={`relative w-full ${CARD_VARS}`}>
      <div className="overflow-hidden">
        <div
          className="flex transition-transform duration-500 ease-out"
          style={{
            gap: "var(--gap)",
            transform: `translateX(calc(${current} * (var(--card-w) * -1 - var(--gap))))`,
          }}
        >
          {slides.map((slide, idx) => {
            // art=true  -> admin uploaded creative: full-bleed baked image, UNCHANGED.
            //            This is already the 31-32 look (text is part of the picture).
            // art=false -> auto product slide: NO pad, NO scrim. Recreate the 31-32
            //            *composition* live: a soft near-white tint on the left text
            //            field with DARK ink sitting directly on it, and the product
            //            CONTAINED on a pure-white right side so a white-canvas studio
            //            photo blends seamlessly (its background == the stage). The only
            //            residual is products whose photo carries its OWN dark/colored
            //            scene (those show a rectangle on white -> cure = cutout asset
            //            or a finished creative, see notes below; CSS cannot hide a dark
            //            rectangle on white without re-adding the gray wash you disliked).
            const isArt = !!slide.art;
            const prod = slide.products?.[0];
            const img = isArt ? slide.imageUrl : (prod?.image || slide.imageUrl);
            const disc = prod?.discountPercent ?? 0;
            const specParts: string[] = [];
            if (prod?.color) specParts.push(prod.color);
            if (prod?.storage) specParts.push(prod.storage + (prod.ram ? ` (${prod.ram} RAM)` : ""));
            else if (prod?.ram) specParts.push(`${prod.ram} RAM`);
            const specLine = specParts.join(", ");

            return (
              <Link
                key={idx}
                href={slide.ctaHref || "/products/all"}
                style={{ width: "var(--card-w)" }}
                className={`group relative block h-[186px] shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl shadow-sm ring-1 sm:h-[227px] lg:h-[288px] ${
                  isArt ? "bg-gray-900 ring-black/5" : "bg-white ring-gray-200/70"
                }`}
              >
                {isArt ? (
                  <>
                    {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                    <img
                      src={slide.imageUrl}
                      alt={slide.headline}
                      loading={idx === 0 ? "eager" : "lazy"}
                      className="absolute inset-0 size-full object-cover object-center transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-[1.02]"
                    />
                    <span className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 z-10 rounded bg-gray-200/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-600">
                      Featured
                    </span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    {/* Left text field: a gentle blue->white wash that fades to PURE white
                        by ~55% width, so the right (product) side is white and a white-
                        canvas photo merges into it with no edge. No box behind the text. */}
                    <span
                      aria-hidden
                      className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 left-0 z-0 w-[62%] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#eaf2ff] via-[#f5f9ff] to-transparent"
                    />
                    {/* LEFT copy: dark ink directly on the light wash - crisp, no pad. */}
                    <span className="relative z-20 flex h-full w-[46%] flex-col justify-center px-3 sm:px-5 lg:px-7">
                      {disc > 0 && (
                        <span className="mb-1.5 inline-flex w-fit items-center rounded-full bg-yellow-400 px-2 py-0.5 text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-wide text-[#1a1a2e] shadow-sm sm:text-[10px]">
                          {disc}% OFF
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {prod?.brand && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-gray-400 sm:text-[11px]">
                          {prod.brand}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <span className="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 font-display text-[15px] font-extrabold leading-[1.1] text-gray-900 sm:line-clamp-3 sm:text-[18px] lg:text-[21px]">
                        {slide.headline}
                      </span>
                      {specLine && (
                        <>
                          <span className="mt-1 hidden line-clamp-1 text-[11px] text-gray-500 sm:block sm:text-[12px]">
                            {specLine}
                          </span>
                          <span className="mt-1.5 hidden h-0.5 w-7 rounded-full bg-[#1a1a2e]/60 sm:block" />
                        </>
                      )}
                      <span className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-1.5 gap-y-0.5">
                        <span className="text-[15px] font-black leading-none tabular-nums text-gray-900 sm:text-[17px] lg:text-[19px]">
                          {RUPEE}{Math.round(prod?.salePrice ?? 0).toLocaleString("en-IN")}
                        </span>
                        {disc > 0 && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-600 sm:text-[11px]">
                            {disc}% off
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </span>
                      <span className="mt-2 inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-[#1a1a2e] px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-white shadow-sm transition-transform group-hover:scale-105 sm:px-3.5 sm:py-2 sm:text-[12px]">
                        Shop Now <ArrowRight className="size-3.5" />
                      </span>
                    </span>
                    {/* RIGHT product: CONTAINED on the white side, large, with a grounding
                        shadow. White-canvas photos vanish into the white stage (seamless,
                        like 31-32); nothing is cropped because it is contain, not cover. */}
                    <span className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 z-10 grid w-[56%] place-items-center sm:w-[52%]">

                      />
                    </span>

      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">

        aria-label="Next slide"
      >
        <ChevronRight className="size-5" />
      </button>
    </div>
  );

"use client";

import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Pause, Play } from "lucide-react";
import Image from "next/image";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { gradientFor } from "@/lib/slide-gradients";
import type { HeroSlideVM } from "@/lib/home-slides";
import { cn, inr } from "@/lib/utils";

export function HeroSlider({ slides }: { slides: HeroSlideVM[] }) {
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);
  const touchStart = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const count = slides.length;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (index >= count) setIndex(0);
  }, [count, index]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (count <= 1 || paused) return;

    const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    if (reduced) return;

    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      setIndex((i) => (i + 1) % count);
    }, 6000);

    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, [count, paused]);

  if (!count) return null;

  const go = (n: number) => setIndex((n + count) % count);

  return (
    <section
      aria-roledescription="carousel"
      aria-label="Featured collections"
      className="relative isolate overflow-hidden bg-ink-900 text-white"
      onMouseEnter={() => setPaused(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => setPaused(false)}
      onTouchStart={(e) => {
        touchStart.current = e.touches[0]?.clientX ?? null;
      }}
      onTouchEnd={(e) => {
        const start = touchStart.current;
        const end = e.changedTouches[0]?.clientX;
        if (start == null || end == null) return;

        const diff = end - start;
        if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
          go(diff > 0 ? index - 1 : index + 1);
        }

        touchStart.current = null;
      }}
    >
      <div className="relative min-h-[30rem] sm:min-h-[34rem] lg:min-h-[38rem]">
        {slides.map((slide, i) => {
          const g = gradientFor(slide.gradient);
          const main = slide.products[0];
          const extras = slide.products.slice(1, 3);

          return (
            <div
              key={slide.id}
              aria-hidden={i !== index}
              className={cn(
                "absolute inset-0 transition-opacity duration-700 ease-out",
                i === index ? "opacity-100" : "pointer-events-none opacity-0",
                g.stage,
              )}
            >
              <div className="container-x relative grid min-h-[30rem] items-center gap-8 py-10 sm:min-h-[34rem] lg:grid-cols-[1.05fr_0.95fr] lg:min-h-[38rem]">
                <div>
                  <span
                    className={cn(
                      "inline-flex rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-white shadow",
                      g.badge,
                    )}
                  >
                    {slide.badge}
                  </span>

                  <h1 className="mt-4 font-display text-[clamp(2rem,5vw,3.35rem)] font-bold leading-[1.05]">
                    {slide.headline}{" "}
                    {slide.highlight && (
                      <span
                        className={cn(
                          "bg-gradient-to-r bg-clip-text text-transparent",
                          g.headline,
                        )}
                      >
                        {slide.highlight}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </h1>

                  {slide.description && (
                    <p className="mt-4 max-w-xl text-[14.5px] leading-relaxed text-white/65">
                      {slide.description}
                    </p>
                  )}

                  <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-2.5">
                    <Link
                      href={slide.ctaHref ?? "/products/all"}
                      className="inline-flex h-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-white px-6 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-ink-900 transition-colors hover:bg-electric-50"
                    >
                      {slide.ctaLabel}
                    </Link>

                    {slide.secondaryLabel && (
                      <Link
                        href={slide.secondaryHref ?? "/offers"}
                        className="inline-flex h-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-white/25 bg-white/10 px-6 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-white/20"
                      >
                        {slide.secondaryLabel}
                      </Link>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {main && (
                    <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-[12.5px] text-white/55">
                      <span>Starting {inr(main.salePrice)}</span>
                      {main.discountPercent > 0 && (
                        <Badge
                          tone="deal"
                          className="bg-white/12 text-amber-300 ring-white/20"
                        >
                          {main.discountPercent}% off
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                      <span>{slide.products.length} highlighted</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="relative min-h-[18rem]">
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      "absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 size-[22rem] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full blur-3xl",
                      g.glow,
                    )}
                  />

                  {main ? (
                    <div className="relative mx-auto aspect-square w-full max-w-[24rem]">
                      <div
                        className={cn(
                          "absolute inset-4 rounded-[2rem] bg-white/5 ring-1 backdrop-blur",
                          g.ring,
                        )}
                      />

                      <Image
                        src={main.image}
                        alt={main.name}
                        fill
                        priority={i === 0}
                        sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 80vw, 420px"
                        className="relative z-10 object-contain p-6 drop-shadow-2xl"
                      />

                      <div className="absolute bottom-2 left-1/2 z-20 w-max max-w-[90%] -translate-x-1/2 truncate rounded-full bg-ink-950/70 px-3 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-bold text-white backdrop-blur">
                        {main.name}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center text-white/30">
                      No product linked
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <div className="absolute -bottom-2 right-0 flex gap-2">
                    {extras.map((p) => (
                      <Link
                        key={p.slug}
                        href={`/product/${p.slug}`}
                        className="group relative size-20 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white/10 ring-1 ring-white/15 backdrop-blur sm:size-24"
                      >
                        <Image
                          src={p.image}
                          alt={p.name}
                          fill
                          sizes="96px"
                          className="object-contain p-2 transition-transform group-hover:scale-105"
                        />
                        <span className="absolute inset-x-1 bottom-1 truncate rounded bg-ink-950/70 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9.5px] font-bold">
                          {inr(p.salePrice)}
                        </span>
                      </Link>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => go(index - 1)}
        aria-label="Previous slide"
        className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 z-20 hidden size-10 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded-full bg-white/10 text-white backdrop-blur transition-colors hover:bg-white/20 md:grid"
      >
        <ChevronLeft className="size-5" />
      </button>

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => go(index + 1)}
        aria-label="Next slide"
        className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 z-20 hidden size-10 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded-full bg-white/10 text-white backdrop-blur transition-colors hover:bg-white/20 md:grid"
      >
        <ChevronRight className="size-5" />
      </button>

      <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-4 z-20 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
        {slides.map((s, i) => (
          <button
            key={s.id}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => go(i)}
            aria-label={`Go to slide ${i + 1}`}
            aria-current={i === index}
            className={cn(
              "h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all",
              i === index ? "w-7 bg-white" : "w-2.5 bg-white/35 hover:bg-white/60",
            )}
          />
        ))}

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setPaused((p) => !p)}
          aria-label={paused ? "Resume carousel" : "Pause carousel"}
          className="ml-2 grid size-7 place-items-center rounded-full bg-white/10 text-white backdrop-blur hover:bg-white/20"
        >
          {paused ? <Play className="size-3.5" /> : <Pause className="size-3.5" />}
        </button>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\home\InfiniteProductFeed.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import Image from "next/image";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import type { CardVM } from "@/lib/catalog";

type Props = {
  initialProducts: CardVM[];
  pageSize?: number;
};

export function InfiniteProductFeed({ initialProducts, pageSize = 12 }: Props) {
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<CardVM[]>(initialProducts);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(true);
  
  // Ref for the sentinel element (triggers when visible)
  const observerTarget = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Fetch more products when sentinel is visible
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasMore || loading) return;

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      async (entries) => {
        if (entries[0]?.isIntersecting) {
          setLoading(true);
          try {
            const nextPage = page + 1;
            const res = await fetch(`/api/feed?page=${nextPage}&limit=${pageSize}`);
            const json = await res.json();

            if (json.ok && json.items?.length > 0) {
              setProducts((prev) => [...prev, ...json.items]);
              setPage(nextPage);
              
              // Stop if less than full page returned
              if (json.items.length < pageSize) setHasMore(false);
            } else {
              setHasMore(false);
            }
          } catch (e) {
            console.error("Feed error:", e);
            setHasMore(false);
          } finally {
            setLoading(false);
          }
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.1 }
    );

    if (observerTarget.current) observer.observe(observerTarget.current);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [page, hasMore, loading, pageSize]);

  return (
    <div className="container-x py-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
        <h2 className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-gray-900">Styles Picked For You</h2>
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500">Personalized picks</span>
      </div>

      {/* Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5">
        {products.map((p) => (
          <Link key={p.id} href={`/product/${p.slug}`} className="group card overflow-hidden transition-all hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg">
            <div className="relative aspect-square bg-gray-50 p-2">
              <Image src={p.image} alt={p.name} fill sizes="(max-width: 640px) 50vw, 20vw" className="object-contain mix-blend-multiply group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300" />
              
              {/* Badges */}
              {p.discountPercent >= 20 && (
                <span className="absolute left-2 top-2 rounded bg-green-600 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-white shadow-sm">
                  {p.discountPercent}% OFF
                </span>
              )}
              {p.stock <= 5 && p.stock > 0 && (
                <span className="absolute right-2 top-2 rounded bg-red-500 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-white shadow-sm animate-pulse">
                  Low Stock
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 space-y-1">
              <p className="line-clamp-2 h-10 text-[13px] leading-tight font-medium text-gray-800">{p.name}</p>
              
              <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900">₹{p.salePrice.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                {p.mrp > p.salePrice && (
                  <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 line-through">₹{p.mrp.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
                )}
              </div>

              {p.ratingAvg > 0 && (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-gray-500">
                  <span className="rounded bg-green-600 px-1 py-0.5 text-white font-bold">{p.ratingAvg.toFixed(1)} ★</span>
                  <span>({p.ratingCount})</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </Link>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Sentinel / Loader */}
      <div ref={observerTarget} className="mt-8 flex justify-center py-4">
        {loading && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-500">
            <Loader2 className="size-5 animate-spin" />
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">Loading more suggestions...</span>
          </div>
        )}
        {!hasMore && !loading && (
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 italic">You've seen all the styles!</p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { Check, Loader2, Send } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/Input";

export function NewsletterForm({ variant = "footer" }: { variant?: "footer" | "band" }) {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
  const [wa, setWa] = useState(false);
  const [state, setState] = useState<"idle" | "busy" | "done" | "error">("idle");
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState("");

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setState("busy");
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/newsletter", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email, phone: phone || undefined, whatsappOptIn: wa }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Failed");
      setState("done");
      setMsg("You're in. Expect drop alerts before the sale goes public.");
    } catch (err) {
      setState("error");
      setMsg(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Something went wrong.");
    }
  }

  if (state === "done") {
    return (
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.97 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl bg-mint-500/12 px-4 py-3 text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-emerald-700">
        <Check className="size-4" /> {msg}
      </motion.div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className={variant === "band" ? "mx-auto flex w-full max-w-xl flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row" : "space-y-3"}>
      <div className={variant === "band" ? "flex flex-1 gap-2" : "space-y-2"}>
        <input
          type="email"
          required
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="you@email.com"
          aria-label="Email address for deal alerts"
          className="h-11 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-xl border border-hairline bg-white px-3.5 text-[14px] text-ink-900 outline-none focus:border-electric-400 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-electric-500/10"
        />
        {variant === "band" && (
          <input
            value={phone}
            onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
            inputMode="numeric"
            maxLength={10}
            placeholder="Mobile (optional)"
            aria-label="Mobile number for WhatsApp alerts"
            className="h-11 w-40 rounded-xl border border-hairline bg-white px-3.5 text-[14px] outline-none focus:border-electric-400"
          />
        )}
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={state === "busy"}
          className="inline-flex h-11 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-electric-500 px-5 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-electric-600 disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {state === "busy" ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : <Send className="size-4" />}
          {variant === "band" ? "Subscribe" : "Notify me"}
        </button>
      </div>
      <Checkbox
        checked={wa}
        onChange={(e) => setWa(e.target.checked)}
        label={
          variant === "band" ? (
            "Also send offer alerts on WhatsApp"
          ) : (
            <span className="text-white/60">
              Enable WhatsApp alerts for new arrivals & flash deals
            </span>
          )
        }
        className={variant === "band" ? "text-ink-400" : ""}
      />
      {variant !== "band" && (
        <input
          value={phone}
          onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
          inputMode="numeric"
          maxLength={10}
          placeholder="Mobile number (for WhatsApp)"
          aria-label="Mobile number"
          className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-white/15 bg-white/10 px-3.5 text-[14px] text-white outline-none placeholder:text-white/40 focus:border-electric-400"
        />
      )}
      {msg && state === "error" && <p role="alert" className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-flame-500">{msg}</p>}
      <p className={`text-[11px] ${variant === "band" ? "text-ink-300" : "text-white/35"}`}>
        No spam. Unsubscribe in one tap. Read our privacy policy.
      </p>
    </form>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { Star } from "lucide-react";
import type { GridItem } from "@/lib/home-discovery";

const inr = (n?: number | null) => (typeof n === "number" && Number.isFinite(n) ? `₹${n.toLocaleString("en-IN")}` : "—");
const offPct = (mrp?: number | null, price?: number | null) =>
  typeof mrp === "number" && typeof price === "number" && mrp > 0 && price < mrp ? Math.round(((mrp - price) / mrp) * 100) : 0;

function MiniStars({ value }: { value?: number | null }) {
  const v = typeof value === "number" ? value : 0;
  return <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-px text-amber-400">{[1,2,3,4,5].map((i) => <Star key={i} className={`size-3 ${i <= Math.round(v) ? "fill-current" : "fill-none text-gray-300"}`} />)}</span>;
}

export function ProductGrid({ title, items }: { title: string; items: GridItem[] }) {
  if (!items.length) return null;
  return (
    <section className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4">
      <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-gray-900">{title}</h2>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
        {items.map((p) => {
          const off = offPct(p.mrp, p.price);
          return (
            <Link key={p.id} href={`/product/${p.slug}`} className="flex flex-col">
              <div className="relative mb-2 aspect-square overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50">
                {p.image
                  // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                  ? <img src={p.image} alt={p.name} loading="lazy" className="size-full object-contain" />
                  : null}
                {typeof p.rating === "number" ? (
                  <span className="absolute bottom-1.5 left-1.5 inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-white/95 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-900 shadow-sm">{p.rating.toFixed(1)} <MiniStars value={p.rating} /></span>
                ) : null}
              </div>
              {p.brand ? <p className="mb-0.5 truncate text-[10.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400">{p.brand}</p> : null}
              <p className="line-clamp-2 min-h-[2.1rem] text-[12.5px] font-medium leading-snug text-gray-900">{p.name}</p>
              <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-1.5">
                {off > 0 ? <span className="text-[12px] font-bold text-emerald-600">{off}% OFF</span> : null}
                {p.mrp && off > 0 ? <span className="text-[11.5px] text-gray-400 line-through">{inr(p.mrp)}</span> : null}
                <span className="text-[13px] font-bold text-gray-900">{inr(p.price)}</span>
              </div>
            </Link>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
export default ProductGrid;

"use client";

import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { useRef } from "react";
import { ProductCard } from "@/components/product/ProductCard";
import type { CardVM } from "@/lib/catalog";

export function ProductRail({ items }: { items: CardVM[] }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  if (!items.length) return null;

  const scroll = (dir: -1 | 1) => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    el.scrollBy({
      left: dir * el.clientWidth * 0.8,
      behavior: "smooth",
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => scroll(-1)}
        aria-label="Scroll left"
        className="absolute -left-2 top-1/2 z-10 hidden size-9 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded-full border border-hairline bg-white text-ink-700 shadow-soft hover:border-electric-300 md:grid"
      >
        <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />
      </button>

      <div
        ref={ref}
        className="no-scrollbar flex snap-x snap-mandatory gap-3 overflow-x-auto scroll-smooth pb-1"
      >
        {items.map((p) => (
          <div
            key={p.id}
            className="w-[62%] shrink-0 snap-start sm:w-[38%] md:w-[30%] lg:w-[23.5%] xl:w-[19%]"
          >
            <ProductCard product={p} compact />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => scroll(1)}
        aria-label="Scroll right"
        className="absolute -right-2 top-1/2 z-10 hidden size-9 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded-full border border-hairline bg-white text-ink-700 shadow-soft hover:border-electric-300 md:grid"

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { lsRead } from "@/context/CartContext";
import { ProductCard } from "@/components/product/ProductCard";
import { SectionHeading } from "@/components/ui/SectionHeading";
import type { CardVM } from "@/lib/catalog";

export function RecentlyViewedClient() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<CardVM[]>([]);
  const [recs, setRecs] = useState<CardVM[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const viewed = lsRead<{ slug: string }[]>("vk_recently_viewed", []);
    if (!viewed.length) return;
    fetch(`/api/search?slugs=${encodeURIComponent(viewed.map((v) => v.slug).join(","))}`, { cache: "no-store" })
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((d: { items?: CardVM[] }) => setItems(d.items ?? []))
      .catch(() => undefined);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!items.length) return;
    const brand = items[0]?.brand;
    if (!brand) return;
    fetch(`/api/search?brands=${encodeURIComponent(brand)}&limit=6`, { cache: "no-store" })
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((d: { items?: CardVM[] }) =>
        setRecs((d.items ?? []).filter((p) => !items.some((i) => i.id === p.id))),
      )
      .catch(() => undefined);
  }, [items]);

  if (!items.length && !recs.length) return null;

  return (
    <>
      {items.length > 0 && (
        <section className="container-x mt-12">
          <SectionHeading eyebrow="Pick up where you left" title="Recently viewed" href="/account/wishlist" hrefLabel="Wishlist" />
          <div className="no-scrollbar -mx-4 flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto px-4 pb-1 sm:mx-0 sm:px-0">
            {items.map((p) => (
              <div key={p.id} className="w-[62%] shrink-0 sm:w-[38%] md:w-[30%] lg:w-[23.5%] xl:w-[19%]">
                <ProductCard product={p} compact />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      )}
      {recs.length > 0 && (
        <section className="container-x mt-12">
          <SectionHeading eyebrow="For you" title="Recommended based on your browsing" href="/products/all?sort=popular" />
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6">
            {recs.map((p) => (
              <ProductCard key={p.id} product={p} compact />
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\layout\CategoryRail.tsx

"use client";

import { Suspense, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import {
  Sparkles, LayoutGrid, Shirt, Footprints, Watch, Gem, Layers, Wind, Ruler,
  Snowflake, Umbrella, Dumbbell, Smartphone, SprayCan, Star, Briefcase, Tag,
} from "lucide-react";

type NavItem = { label: string; href: string; image?: string | null };
type NavGroup = {
  slug: string; label: string; subtitle: string; icon: string;
  viewAll: string; image: string | null; items: NavItem[];
};

const ICONS: Record<string, any> = {
  shirt: Shirt, footprints: Footprints, watch: Watch, gem: Gem, layers: Layers,
  wind: Wind, ruler: Ruler, snowflake: Snowflake, umbrella: Umbrella,
  dumbbell: Dumbbell, smartphone: Smartphone, spray: SprayCan, star: Star,
  briefcase: Briefcase, hat: Tag,
};

/** Pull the decoded search term out of a `...?q=<term>` href ("" if not a q-link). */
const termOf = (href: string): string => {
  const i = href.indexOf("q=");
  return i === -1 ? "" : decodeURIComponent(href.slice(i + 2));
};

/**
 * Resolves which rail tile owns the dark "selected" shade from the URL.
 * Calls useSearchParams(), so it MUST be rendered inside a <Suspense> boundary
 * (Next 15 build rule: a bare useSearchParams() opts the page into a CSR bailout
 * and fails prerendering — notably the /_not-found page, which renders this rail
 * through the root layout).
 */
function useActiveSlug(groups: NavGroup[]): string | null {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const q = (searchParams.get("q") ?? "").trim();
  let activeSlug: string | null = null;
  if (pathname === "/") activeSlug = "for-you";
  else {
    const shop = groups.find((g) => pathname === `/shop/${g.slug}`);
    if (shop) activeSlug = shop.slug;
    else if (q) {
      for (const g of groups) {
        if (termOf(g.viewAll) === q || g.items.some((it) => termOf(it.href) === q)) {
          activeSlug = g.slug;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return activeSlug;
}

/** The horizontal tile row. Shade is passed in (null during prerender / on the 404). */
function RailRow({ groups, activeSlug, setOpen }: {
  groups: NavGroup[]; activeSlug: string | null; setOpen: (v: string | null) => void;
}) {
  const forYouActive = activeSlug === "for-you";
  return (
    <div className="flex items-stretch gap-2 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-[#c9a96e]/50 bg-white p-2 [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden">
      {/* For You — shaded only while it is the active selection */}
      <Link
        href="/"
        onMouseEnter={() => setOpen(null)}
        className={`flex min-w-[132px] shrink-0 items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 transition-colors ${
          forYouActive ? "bg-[#1a1a2e] text-white" : "text-ink-900 hover:bg-canvas"
        }`}
      >
        <span className={`grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg ${forYouActive ? "bg-white/10" : "bg-canvas text-ink-700"}`}>
          <Sparkles className="size-4" />
        </span>
        <span className="flex flex-col leading-tight">
          <span className="text-[12.5px] font-bold">For You</span>
          <span className={`text-[10px] ${forYouActive ? "opacity-70" : "text-ink-400"}`}></span>
        </span>
      </Link>

      {groups.map((g) => {
        const Icon = ICONS[g.icon] ?? Shirt;
        const active = activeSlug === g.slug;
        return (
          <div key={g.slug} className="shrink-0" onMouseEnter={() => setOpen(g.slug)}>
            <Link
              href={`/shop/${g.slug}`}
              className={`flex min-w-[150px] items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 transition-colors ${
                active ? "bg-[#1a1a2e] text-white" : "hover:bg-canvas"
              }`}
            >
              {g.image ? (
                // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                <img
                  src={g.image}
                  alt={g.label}
                  className={`size-9 shrink-0 rounded-lg object-cover ${active ? "border border-white/25" : "border border-hairline bg-canvas"}`}
                />
              ) : (
                <span className={`grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg ${active ? "bg-white/10 text-white" : "bg-canvas text-ink-700"}`}>
                  <Icon className="size-4" />
                </span>
              )}
              <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-col leading-tight">
                <span className={`truncate text-[12.5px] font-bold ${active ? "text-white" : "text-ink-900"}`}>{g.label}</span>
                <span className={`truncate text-[10px] ${active ? "text-white/60" : "text-ink-400"}`}>{g.subtitle}</span>
              </span>
            </Link>
          </div>
        );
      })}

      <Link
        href="/products/all"
        onMouseEnter={() => setOpen(null)}
        className="flex min-w-[64px] shrink-0 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 hover:bg-canvas"
      >
        <LayoutGrid className="size-4 text-ink-700" />
        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-ink-700">More</span>
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Suspended child: resolves the shade via the hook, then renders the row. */
function RailWithShade({ groups, setOpen }: {
  groups: NavGroup[]; setOpen: (v: string | null) => void;
}) {
  const activeSlug = useActiveSlug(groups);
  return <RailRow groups={groups} activeSlug={activeSlug} setOpen={setOpen} />;
}

export function CategoryRail() {
  const [groups, setGroups] = useState<NavGroup[]>([]);
    const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const pathname = usePathname();

  // Re-fetch on every route change (a full refresh also remounts the root layout),
  // with cache:"no-store" so the browser never reuses a stale payload. The server
  // re-rolls a RANDOM imaged product per group per request, so the rail + dropdown
  // thumbnails rotate on each navigation / refresh / login-redirect. Old groups are
  // kept until the new payload lands, so tiles never flash to the icon fallback.
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    fetch("/api/nav", { cache: "no-store" })
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((j) => { if (alive && j?.groups) setGroups(j.groups); })
      .catch(() => {});
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [pathname]);

  const openGroup = groups.find((g) => g.slug === open) ?? null;
  const OpenIcon = openGroup ? (ICONS[openGroup.icon] ?? Shirt) : Shirt;

  return (
    <div className="relative border-b border-hairline bg-white" onMouseLeave={() => setOpen(null)}>
      <div className="container-x py-2.5">
        {/* The row prerenders unshaded (fallback); hydration swaps in the shade.
            This is the Suspense boundary that satisfies the useSearchParams rule. */}
        <Suspense fallback={<RailRow groups={groups} activeSlug={null} setOpen={setOpen} />}>
          <RailWithShade groups={groups} setOpen={setOpen} />
        </Suspense>
      </div>

      {/* ── DROPDOWN: square photo tiles w/ gold underline; desktop-only (md:block) ── */}
      {openGroup && openGroup.items.length > 0 && (
        <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-full z-40 hidden border-b border-hairline bg-white shadow-lift md:block">
          <div className="container-x py-4">
            <div className="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-1 [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden">
              {openGroup.items.map((it) => {
                const term = termOf(it.href) || it.label;
                return (
                  <Link
                    key={it.label}
                    href={`/shop/${openGroup.slug}?q=${encodeURIComponent(term)}`}
                    className="flex w-[104px] shrink-0 flex-col items-center"
                  >
                    <span className="relative aspect-square w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-hairline bg-canvas">
                      {it.image ? (
                        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                        <img src={it.image} alt={it.label} className="size-full object-cover" />
                      ) : (
                        <OpenIcon className="absolute inset-0 m-auto size-6 text-ink-400" />
                      )}
                      <span className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-1.5 bg-[linear-gradient(90deg,#b8963f,#e0cfa8,#b8963f)]" />
                    </span>
                    <span className="mt-1.5 w-full truncate text-center text-[11px] font-semibold text-ink-700">
                      {it.label}
                    </span>
                  </Link>
                );
              })}

              {/* "Shop now" promo tile -> the group's full page */}
              <Link href={`/shop/${openGroup.slug}`} className="flex w-[104px] shrink-0 flex-col items-center">
                <span className="grid aspect-square w-full place-items-center rounded-lg bg-[#1a1a2e] px-2 text-center text-white">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-bold leading-tight">{openGroup.label}</span>
                </span>
                <span className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-ink-700 underline underline-offset-2">
                  Shop now
                </span>
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default CategoryRail;

FILE: src\components\layout\Footer.tsx

"use client";

import { Mail, MapPin, Phone, Send, Sparkles } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import { NAV_CATEGORIES } from "@/lib/nav";

export function Footer() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
  const [whatsappOptIn, setWhatsappOptIn] = useState(false);
  const [honeypot, setHoneypot] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function subscribe(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/newsletter", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email, phone, whatsappOptIn, honeypot }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Subscription failed.");
      toast.push({ title: "Subscribed", body: "You'll receive Urban Vogue style alerts." });
      setEmail(""); setPhone(""); setWhatsappOptIn(false);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.push({ tone: "error", title: "Subscription failed", body: err instanceof Error ? err.message : undefined });
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  return (
    <footer className="mt-12 border-t border-hairline bg-ink-900 text-white">

          </div>

function FooterCol({ title, links }: { title: string; links: { href: string; label: string }[] }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <h3 className="font-display text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white/70">{title}</h3>
      <ul className="mt-4 space-y-2.5">
        {links.map((l) => (
          <li key={l.href + l.label}>
            <Link href={l.href} className="text-[13.5px] text-white/55 transition-colors hover:text-white">{l.label}</Link>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Check, Copy } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import { copyText } from "@/lib/clipboard";

export function CopyCode({ code }: { code: string }) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  async function copy() {
    const ok = await copyText(code);
    if (ok) {
      setCopied(true);
      toast.push({ title: "Coupon copied", body: code });
      window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1800);
    } else {
      toast.push({
        tone: "error",
        title: "Couldn't copy automatically",
        body: "Long-press the code text and choose Copy.",
      });
    }
  }

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={copy}
      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-electric-400 bg-electric-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-[12px] font-bold tracking-wider text-electric-700 hover:bg-electric-100"
    >
      {copied ? <Check className="size-3.5" /> : <Copy className="size-3.5" />}
      {code}
    </button>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Check, Copy } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { copyText } from "@/lib/clipboard";

export function CouponCopy({ code, className }: { code: string; className?: string }) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<"idle" | "done" | "failed">("idle");

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={async () => {
        const ok = await copyText(code);
        setState(ok ? "done" : "failed");
        window.setTimeout(() => setState("idle"), 2000);
      }}
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-electric-400 bg-electric-50 px-3 text-[12.5px] font-bold text-electric-700 transition-colors hover:bg-electric-500 hover:text-white",
        state === "failed" && "border-rose-300 bg-rose-50 text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 hover:text-white",
        className,
      )}
    >
      {state === "done" ? <Check className="size-3.5" /> : <Copy className="size-3.5" />}
      {state === "done" ? "Copied" : state === "failed" ? "Copy failed" : "Copy code"}
    </button>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\order\CancelOrderButton.tsx
============================================================

"use client";

import { Ban } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";

export function CancelOrderButton({
  orderNumber,
  status,
}: {
  orderNumber: string;
  status: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  if (!["PENDING", "CONFIRMED"].includes(status)) return null;

  async function cancel() {
    const reason = window.prompt(
      "Reason for cancellation (optional)",
      "Customer requested cancellation",
    );

    if (reason === null) return;

    setBusy(true);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/orders/${orderNumber}/cancel`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ reason }),
      });

      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };

      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Could not cancel order.");

      toast.push({ title: "Order cancelled", body: orderNumber });
      router.refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      toast.push({
        tone: "error",
        title: "Cancellation failed",
        body: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined,
      });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Button
      type="button"
      variant="danger"
      size="sm"
      loading={busy}
      onClick={cancel}
      className="inline-flex print:hidden"
    >
      {!busy && <Ban className="size-3.5" />}
      Cancel order
    </Button>
  );
}
