FILE: src\components\order\OrderProductsForYou.tsx
============================================================

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";

type Rec = {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  image: string;
  salePrice: number;
  mrp: number;
  discountPercent: number;
  ratingAvg: number;
  sold: number;
};

// Flipkart's lakh/thousand compacting for the rating pill's count: 580000 -> "5.8L+",
// 400000 -> "4L+", 27300 -> "27.3K+", 1600 -> "1.6K+". Trims the trailing ".0".
function compact(n: number): string {
  const trim = (x: number) => {
    const s = x.toFixed(1);
    return s.endsWith(".0") ? s.slice(0, -2) : s;
  };
  if (n >= 1e5) return `${trim(n / 1e5)}L+`;
  if (n >= 1e3) return `${trim(n / 1e3)}K+`;
  return `${n}+`;
}

const inr = (n: number) => `₹${Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-IN")}`;

export function OrderProductsForYou({
  excludeIds = [],
  title = "Products For You",
  count = 10,
}: {
  excludeIds?: string[];
  title?: string;
  count?: number;
}) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Rec[] | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    const qs = new URLSearchParams({ n: String(count) });
    if (excludeIds.length) qs.set("exclude", excludeIds.join(","));
    fetch(`/api/feed/order-recommendations?${qs.toString()}`)
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((json) => {
        if (!alive) return;
        const list = (json?.products ?? null) as Rec[] | null;
        setItems(Array.isArray(list) ? list : []);
      })
      .catch(() => alive && setItems([]));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
    // excludeIds is treated as a stable signature; callers pass a memoised array.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [excludeIds.join(","), count]);

  // Loading: a 2-col skeleton so the layout doesn't jump when data lands.
  if (items === null) {
    return (
      <section aria-label={title} className="mt-6">
        <h2 className="mb-2 px-1 text-[15px] font-bold text-gray-900">{title}</h2>
        <div className="columns-2 gap-3">
          {Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="mb-3 break-inside-avoid">
              <div className="aspect-square w-full animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-gray-100" />
              <div className="mt-2 h-3 w-3/4 animate-pulse rounded bg-gray-100" />
              <div className="mt-1.5 h-3 w-1/2 animate-pulse rounded bg-gray-100" />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }

  // Empty pool (or fetch failure): hide the whole section, like Flipkart does when
  // there's nothing to recommend — never render an empty heading.
  if (items.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <section aria-label={title} className="mt-6">
      <h2 className="mb-2 px-1 text-[15px] font-bold text-gray-900">{title}</h2>

      {/* Masonry via CSS columns: the two columns flow independently, exactly like the
          video's uneven-height recommended cards, with no JS measuring. */}
      <div className="columns-2 gap-3">
        {items.map((p) => (
          <Link
            key={p.id}
            href={`/product/${p.slug}`}
            className="group mb-3 block break-inside-avoid overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-100 bg-white"
          >
            {/* Image area: light-gray panel, product contained (white-bg renders stay
                whole), rating pill overlaid bottom-left like the reference. */}
            <div className="relative aspect-square w-full bg-gray-50">
              {p.image ? (
                // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                <img
                  src={p.image}
                  alt={p.name}
                  loading="lazy"
                  className="size-full object-contain p-3 transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-105"
                />
              ) : (
                <span className="grid size-full place-items-center text-2xl font-black text-gray-300">
                  {p.name.charAt(0) || "V"}
                </span>
              )}
              {(p.ratingAvg > 0 || p.sold > 0) && (
                <span className="absolute bottom-1 left-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-white/95 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] font-semibold text-gray-700 shadow-sm">
                  {p.ratingAvg > 0 && (
                    <>
                      {p.ratingAvg.toFixed(1)} <span className="text-emerald-600">★</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                  {p.ratingAvg > 0 && p.sold > 0 && <span className="text-gray-300">|</span>}
                  {p.sold > 0 && compact(p.sold)}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Name (2-line clamp) then the price row: green ↓off% + struck mrp + bold
                sale price — the video's exact ordering. Our product names already lead
                with the brand, so no separate bold brand prefix is needed. */}
            <div className="p-2">
              <p className="line-clamp-2 min-h-[2rem] text-[12px] font-medium leading-snug text-gray-800">
                {p.name}
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-1.5">
                {p.discountPercent > 0 && (
                  <span className="text-[11.5px] font-bold text-emerald-600">↓{p.discountPercent}%</span>
                )}
                {p.mrp > p.salePrice && (
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 line-through">{inr(p.mrp)}</span>
                )}
                <span className="text-[13px] font-bold text-gray-900">{inr(p.salePrice)}</span>
              </p>
            </div>
          </Link>
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  );

FILE: src\components\order\ReturnRequestButton.tsx

"use client";

import { RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { Drawer } from "@/components/ui/Modal";
import { Select, Textarea } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";

type ReturnItem = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  slug: string;
};

export function ReturnRequestButton({ items }: { items: ReturnItem[] }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [orderItemId, setOrderItemId] = useState(items[0]?.id ?? "");
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("DAMAGED");
  const [resolution, setResolution] = useState("REFUND");
  const [details, setDetails] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  if (!items.length) return null;

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/returns", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          orderItemId,
          reason,
          resolution,
          details,
        }),
      });

      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string };

      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Could not create return.");

      toast.push({
        title: "Return requested",
        body: "Our team will review and contact you.",
      });

      setOpen(false);
      setDetails("");
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.push({
        tone: "error",
        title: "Return failed",
        body: err instanceof Error ? err.message : undefined,
      });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="outline"
        size="sm"
        className="inline-flex print:hidden"
        onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
      >
        <RotateCcw className="size-3.5" />
        Request return
      </Button>

      <Drawer
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        title="Return request"
        side="bottom"
      >
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4">
          <Select
            label="Item"
            value={orderItemId}
            onChange={(e) => setOrderItemId(e.target.value)}
            required
          >
            {items.map((item) => (
              <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>
                {item.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </Select>

          <Select
            label="Reason"
            value={reason}
            onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="DAMAGED">Damaged</option>
            <option value="WRONG_PRODUCT">Wrong product delivered</option>
            <option value="NOT_WORKING">Not working / dead on arrival</option>
            <option value="MISSING_ACCESSORY">Missing accessory</option>
            <option value="OTHER">Other</option>
          </Select>

          <Select
            label="Preferred resolution"
            value={resolution}
            onChange={(e) => setResolution(e.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="REFUND">Refund</option>
            <option value="REPLACEMENT">Replacement</option>
          </Select>

          <Textarea
            label="Details"
            value={details}
            onChange={(e) => setDetails(e.target.value)}
            rows={4}
            placeholder="Describe the issue. Include photos in support ticket if needed."
            maxLength={1000}
          />

          <Button block type="submit" loading={busy}>
            Submit return request
          </Button>
        </form>
      </Drawer>
    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Star } from "lucide-react";
import { inr } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { CardVM } from "@/lib/catalog";

// picsum/CDN guard: a dead URL degrades to a letter tile, never a broken icon.
export function GuardedImg({ src, name, className }: { src?: string | null; name: string; className?: string }) {
  const [bad, setBad] = useState(false);
  if (!src || bad)
    return <span aria-hidden className={`grid size-full place-items-center bg-gray-100 text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-400 ${className ?? ""}`}>{(name || "V").slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}</span>;
  return (
    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
    <img src={src} alt={name} loading="lazy" onError={() => setBad(true)} className={className ?? "size-full object-contain p-1"} />
  );
}

// "You May Also Like..." — same co-purchase -> category -> brand -> global draw the
// buy-now sheet uses, so the suggestions are REAL rows, never invented.
export function RecommendationsRail({ seedId }: { seedId: string }) {
  const [list, setList] = useState<CardVM[] | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    fetch(`/api/feed/upsell?id=${encodeURIComponent(seedId)}&n=8`, { cache: "no-store" })
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((j) => { if (alive) setList(((j?.products ?? []) as CardVM[]).slice(0, 8)); })
      .catch(() => { if (alive) setList([]); });
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [seedId]);

  if (!list || list.length === 0) return null; // hide the rail rather than show an empty box

  return (
    <section className="mt-6">
      <h2 className="mb-3 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">You May Also Like...</h2>
      <div className="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
        {list.map((p) => {
          const d = p.mrp > p.salePrice ? Math.round(((p.mrp - p.salePrice) / p.mrp) * 100) : 0;
          return (
            <a key={p.id} href={`/product/${p.slug}`} className="card flex w-[150px] shrink-0 flex-col p-2 no-underline transition-shadow hover:shadow-md">
              <span className="relative mb-2 aspect-square w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-canvas"><GuardedImg src={p.image} name={p.name} /></span>
              <p className="line-clamp-2 text-[12px] font-medium leading-snug text-ink-700">{p.name}</p>
              <p className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-1">
                <span className="text-[13px] font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">{inr(p.salePrice)}</span>
                {d > 0 && <span className="text-[10px] text-ink-300 line-through tabular-nums">{inr(p.mrp)}</span>}
                {d > 0 && <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-600">{d}% off</span>}
              </p>
              {p.ratingAvg != null && (
                <p className="mt-1 inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-600 px-1 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-white">
                  {Number(p.ratingAvg).toFixed(1)} <Star className="size-2.5 fill-white" />
                </p>
              )}
            </a>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export function BrandSummaryStrip({ brand, highlights, price, image, name }: {

  );
}

export function BrowseTiles({ title, tiles }: { title: string; tiles: Tile[] }) {

              // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element

            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">

"use client";

import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { Bell, Heart, ShoppingCart, Zap } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { useCart } from "@/context/CartContext";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import { inr } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { CardVM } from "@/lib/catalog";
import type { Offer } from "@prisma/client";

export function BuyBox({
  product,
  card,
  discount,
  savingsAmount,
  plans,
  offers,
}: {
  product: { id: string; stock: number; lowStockAt: number; returnableDays: number };
  card: CardVM;
  discount: number;
  savingsAmount: number;
  plans: { months: number; perMonth: number }[];
  offers: Offer[];
}) {
  const { add, toggleWishlist, inWishlist } = useCart();
  const toast = useToast();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<"cart" | "buy" | "wish" | null>(null);
  const out = product.stock === 0;
  const low = !out && product.stock <= product.lowStockAt;
  const wished = inWishlist(card.id);

  async function addToCart() {
    setBusy("cart");
    await add(card.id, 1);
    setBusy(null);
  }
  async function buyNow() {
    setBusy("buy");
    await add(card.id, 1);
    router.push(`/checkout?buy=${encodeURIComponent(card.id)}&upsell=1`);
  }
  async function wish() {
    setBusy("wish");
    await toggleWishlist(card.id);
    setBusy(null);
  }

  return (
    <motion.div layout className="card overflow-hidden">
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
          <span className="font-display text-[28px] font-bold leading-none tabular-nums text-ink-900 sm:text-3xl">
            {inr(card.salePrice)}
          </span>
          {card.mrp > card.salePrice && (
            <>
              <span className="text-[15px] tabular-nums text-ink-300 line-through">{inr(card.mrp)}</span>
              <span className="rounded-md bg-gradient-to-r from-flame-500 to-orange-deal px-2 py-0.5 text-[12px] font-bold text-white">
                {discount}% OFF
              </span>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[12.5px]">
          {savingsAmount > 0 && <Badge tone="save">You save {inr(savingsAmount)}</Badge>}
          <Badge tone="neutral">Incl. GST · {inr(Math.round(card.salePrice - card.salePrice / 1.18))} tax</Badge>
          {plans[0] && card.emiEligible && <Badge tone="info">EMI {inr(plans[0].perMonth)}/mo</Badge>}
        </div>

        <p className="mt-3 text-[13px] font-semibold">
          {out ? (
            <span className="text-flame-600">Out of Stock</span>
          ) : low ? (
            <span className="text-orange-600">Only {product.stock} left — order soon</span>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-emerald-600">In Stock — {product.stock} available</span>
          )}
        </p>

        {offers.length > 0 && (
          <ul className="mt-3 space-y-1.5 border-t border-hairline pt-3">
            {offers.slice(0, 3).map((o) => (
              <li key={o.id} className="flex gap-2 text-[12.5px] leading-snug text-ink-700">
                <span className="mt-1 size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-electric-500" />
                <span>
                  <strong>{o.title}.</strong> <span className="text-ink-400">{o.description}</span>
                </span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}

        <div className="mt-4 flex gap-2.5">
          {out ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                toast.push({ title: "We'll notify you", body: "You'll be alerted the moment this is back in stock." })
              }
              className={cnBtn("flex-1 bg-[#1a1a2e] text-white hover:bg-[#1f5fc9]", false)}
            >
              <Bell className="size-4" />
              Notify Me
            </button>
          ) : (
            <>
              <button
                onClick={addToCart}
                disabled={busy !== null}
                className={cnBtn("flex-1 bg-ink-900 text-white hover:bg-electric-600", false)}
              >
                <ShoppingCart className="size-4" />
                {busy === "cart" ? "Adding…" : "Add to Cart"}
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={buyNow}
                disabled={busy !== null}
                className={cnBtn("flex-1 bg-amber-offer text-white hover:brightness-105", false)}
              >
                <Zap className="size-4" />
                {busy === "buy" ? "Working…" : "Buy Now"}
              </button>
            </>
          )}
          <button
            onClick={wish}
            aria-pressed={wished}
            aria-label={wished ? "Remove from wishlist" : "Add to wishlist"}
            className={cnBtn("size-12 border border-hairline bg-white text-ink-400 hover:text-flame-500", false)}
          >
            <Heart className={cnFilled(wished)} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 border-t border-hairline pt-3.5 text-center">
          {[
            { t: `${product.returnableDays}-day`, d: "Replacement" },
            { t: card.codEligible ? "COD" : "Prepaid", d: card.codEligible ? "Available" : "Only" },
            { t: `${card.warrantyMonths} mo`, d: "Warranty" },
          ].map((x) => (
            <div key={x.t}>
              <p className="text-[12.5px] font-bold text-ink-900">{x.t}</p>
              <p className="text-[10.5px] text-ink-400">{x.d}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 bg-canvas px-4 py-2.5 text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">
        <span>Secure payments · Razorpay PCI-DSS</span>
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(location.href);
            toast.push({ tone: "info", title: "Link copied", body: "Share this product with anyone." });
          }}
          className="font-bold text-electric-600 hover:underline"
        >
          Share
        </button>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

function cnBtn(base: string, disabled: boolean) {
  return `inline-flex h-12 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl text-[13.5px] font-bold transition-all active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-50 disabled:pointer-events-none ${base}`;
}
function cnFilled(wished: boolean) {
  return `size-4.5 ${wished ? "fill-current text-flame-500" : ""}`;
}

FILE: src\components\product\CompareBlock.tsx
============================================================

import Link from "next/link";
import { Tag, Star, Cpu, HardDrive, Monitor, Server, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";

// Conforms to the page's house shape (base/peers with price/rating/screen/warranty/image).
// slug added so each column can link to /product/[slug]; optional so a missing slug degrades to plain text.
export type CompareItem = {
  id?: string;
  slug?: string;
  name?: string;
  price?: number | null;
  rating?: number | null;
  ram?: string | null;
  storage?: string | null;
  screen?: string | null;
  processor?: string | null;
  warranty?: number | null;
  image?: string | null;
};

const inr = (n?: number | null) =>
  typeof n === "number" && Number.isFinite(n) ? `₹${n.toLocaleString("en-IN")}` : "—";

const fmt = (v?: string | number | null) =>
  v == null || v === "" ? "—" : typeof v === "number" ? String(v) : v;

const band = (v?: number | null) =>
  v == null ? "" : v >= 4 ? "Very Good" : v >= 3 ? "Good" : v >= 2 ? "Average" : v > 0 ? "Poor" : "";

function MiniStars({ value }: { value?: number | null }) {
  const v = typeof value === "number" ? value : 0;
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 align-middle text-amber-400" aria-label={`${v} out of 5`}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => (
        <Star key={i} className={`size-3 ${i <= Math.round(v) ? "fill-current" : "fill-none text-gray-300"}`} />
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}

// green when cheaper than the baseline column, muted red when pricier, none if equal/unknown
function PriceDelta({ base, other }: { base?: number | null; other?: number | null }) {
  if (typeof base !== "number" || typeof other !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(base) || !Number.isFinite(other) || base <= 0 || other === base) return null;
  const pct = Math.round((Math.abs(base - other) / base) * 100);
  const cheaper = other < base;
  return (
    <span className={`ml-1.5 inline-block rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] font-semibold ${cheaper ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700" : "bg-rose-50 text-rose-600"}`}>
      {pct}% {cheaper ? "less" : "more"}
    </span>
  );
}

type RowDef = { key: string; label: string; Icon: typeof Tag; cell: (p: CompareItem) => React.ReactNode };

export function CompareBlock({ base, peers = [] }: { base?: CompareItem | null; peers?: (CompareItem | null | undefined)[] }) {
  // Defensive: drop falsy holes so an undefined entry can never reach the map and throw.
  const cols = ([base, ...(peers ?? [])].filter(Boolean) as CompareItem[]).slice(0, 3);
  if (!cols.length) return null;            // nothing to compare -> hide the block, never crash the page
  const baseline = cols[0]!;                // cols[0] exists (length>=1); ! silences noUncheckedIndexedAccess

  const rows: RowDef[] = [
  { key: "price", label: "Price", Icon: Tag, cell: (p) => (
    <span className="whitespace-nowrap font-bold text-gray-900">{inr(p.price)}<PriceDelta base={baseline.price} other={p.price} /></span>
  )},
  { key: "rating", label: "Rating", Icon: Star, cell: (p) => (
    <span className="inline-flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5">
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><span className="font-bold text-gray-900">{typeof p.rating === "number" ? p.rating.toFixed(1) : "—"}</span><MiniStars value={p.rating} /></span>
      {band(p.rating) ? <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-600">{band(p.rating)}</span> : null}
    </span>
  )},
  { key: "ram", label: "Size", Icon: Cpu, cell: (p) => <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{fmt(p.ram)}</span> },
  { key: "storage", label: "Fabric", Icon: HardDrive, cell: (p) => <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{fmt(p.storage)}</span> },
  { key: "display", label: "Fit", Icon: Monitor, cell: (p) => <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{fmt(p.screen)}</span> },
  { key: "cpu", label: "Occasion", Icon: Server, cell: (p) => <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{fmt(p.processor)}</span> },
  { key: "warranty", label: "Return Window", Icon: ShieldCheck, cell: (p) => <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{p.warranty != null ? `${p.warranty} days` : "—"}</span> },
];

  const colKey = (p: CompareItem, i: number) => p.id ?? p.slug ?? p.name ?? `c${i}`;

  const LabelCell = ({ children, tint }: { children: React.ReactNode; tint?: boolean }) => (
    <div className={`sticky left-0 z-10 flex w-[118px] shrink-0 items-center gap-2 px-3 py-3 text-[12.5px] font-medium text-gray-600 ${tint ? "bg-gray-50" : "bg-white"}`}>{children}</div>
  );
  const ValueCell = ({ children, tint }: { children: React.ReactNode; tint?: boolean }) => (
    <div className={`flex min-w-[140px] flex-1 items-center justify-center px-2 py-3 text-center text-[13px] ${tint ? "bg-gray-50" : ""}`}>{children}</div>
  );

  // the clickable column header (image + name + pills); plain block when no slug so it never 404s
  const ColHead = ({ p }: { p: CompareItem }) => {
    const inner = (
      <div className="flex w-full flex-col items-center gap-1.5 py-1">
        {p.image
          // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
          ? <img src={p.image} alt={p.name ?? ""} className="h-20 w-20 rounded-lg object-contain" />
          : <div className="grid h-20 w-20 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-gray-100 text-gray-300"><Monitor className="size-7" /></div>}
        <p className={`line-clamp-2 px-1 text-center text-[12px] font-semibold leading-tight text-gray-900 ${p.slug ? "group-hover/link:underline" : ""}`}>{p.name ?? "—"}</p>
      </div>
    );
    return p.slug
      ? <Link href={`/product/${p.slug}`} className="group/link block w-full">{inner}</Link>
      : inner;
  };

  return (
    <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white">
      {/* heading at the top of the card, matching the old "Compare with similar items" */}
      <h2 className="px-4 pb-1 pt-4 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-gray-900">Compare with similar items</h2>

      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <div className="flex border-b border-gray-100">
          <LabelCell tint><span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400">Features</span></LabelCell>
          {cols.map((p, i) => {
            const isBase = i === 0;
            return (
              <ValueCell key={colKey(p, i)} tint>
                <div className="flex w-full flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
                  {isBase ? (
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-violet-600 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] font-bold text-white"><Star className="size-3 fill-current" /> BEST CHOICE</span>
                  ) : <span className="h-[22px]" />}
                  <ColHead p={p} />
                  {isBase ? <span className="rounded-full bg-violet-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] font-semibold text-violet-700 ring-1 ring-violet-100">Current</span> : <span className="h-[20px]" />}
                </div>
              </ValueCell>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {rows.map((r, ri) => (
          <div key={r.key} className={`flex ${ri < rows.length - 1 ? "border-b border-gray-100" : ""}`}>
            <LabelCell><span className="grid size-6 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-md bg-violet-50 text-violet-600"><r.Icon className="size-3.5" /></span><span className="leading-tight">{r.label}</span></LabelCell>
            {cols.map((p, i) => <ValueCell key={colKey(p, i)}>{r.cell(p)}</ValueCell>)}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default CompareBlock;

import { CalendarDays, MapPin, RefreshCcw, Store, Truck } from "lucide-react";

type Props = {
  returnableDays: number;
  /** e.g. "Sunday, 25 Oct" — computed by the page from now + 4 days. */
  deliveryByLabel?: string | null;
  /** Single-seller store: shown as "Seller: UrbanVogue". */
  sellerName?: string | null;
  /** Truncated saved-address line, when the actor has one. */
  addressLine?: string | null;
  /** Admin override for the delivery detail bullets. Null/empty = built-in defaults. */
  items?: string[] | null;
};

export function DeliveryDetails({ returnableDays, deliveryByLabel, sellerName, addressLine, items }: Props) {
  const defaultBullets = [
    { icon: <Truck className="size-4 shrink-0 text-[#1a1a2e]" />, text: "Free delivery" },
    { icon: <Truck className="size-4 shrink-0 text-[#1a1a2e]" />, text: "Delivery in 3–5 business days" },
    { icon: <RefreshCcw className="size-4 shrink-0 text-[#1a1a2e]" />, text: `${returnableDays}-day replacement window` },
  ];

  const bullets = items && items.length
    ? items.map((text, i) => ({
        icon: i === items.length - 1 && text.toLowerCase().includes("replacement")
          ? <RefreshCcw className="size-4 shrink-0 text-[#1a1a2e]" />
          : <Truck className="size-4 shrink-0 text-[#1a1a2e]" />,
        text,
      }))
    : defaultBullets;

  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4">
      <h3 className="mb-2 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-gray-900">Delivery details</h3>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        {addressLine ? (
          <p className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-[#faf5eb] px-3 py-2.5 text-[13px] text-gray-800">
            <MapPin className="size-4 shrink-0 text-[#1a1a2e]" />
            <span className="truncate font-semibold">{addressLine}</span>
          </p>
        ) : null}

        {bullets.map((b, i) => (
          <p key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2.5 text-[13px] text-gray-800">
            {b.icon}
            {b.text}
          </p>
        ))}

        {deliveryByLabel ? (
          <p className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2.5 text-[13px] text-gray-800">
            <CalendarDays className="size-4 shrink-0 text-[#1a1a2e]" />
            <span>
              Delivery by <span className="font-bold">{deliveryByLabel}</span>
            </span>
          </p>
        ) : null}

        {sellerName ? (
          <p className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2.5 text-[13px] text-gray-800">
            <Store className="size-4 shrink-0 text-[#1a1a2e]" />
            <span>
              Seller: <span className="font-semibold">{sellerName}</span>
            </span>
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";
import { FACETS, PRICE_BUCKETS, type Facets } from "@/lib/catalog";
import { inr } from "@/lib/utils";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";

type Props = {
  facets: Facets;
  categorySlug: string; // "all" | real slug
  defaults: {
    brands?: string[];
    subtypes?: string[];
    ram?: string[];
    storage?: string[];
    screenSize?: string[];
    processor?: string[];
    color?: string[];
    minPrice?: number;
    maxPrice?: number;
    minRating?: number;
    minDiscount?: number;
    inStock?: boolean;
    warranty?: number;
  };
};

export function FilterPanel({ facets, categorySlug, defaults }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({ brand: true, price: true });

  const activeKeys = useMemo(
    () => FACETS[(categorySlug as keyof typeof FACETS)] ?? FACETS.all,
    [categorySlug],
  );

  // selected[key] holds the RAW values parsed from the URL. For `brand` those are
  // SLUGS (matches the server contract in products/all + products/[category]).
  const selected = useMemo(
    () => ({
      brand: (params.get("brands") ?? "").split(",").filter(Boolean),
      subtype: (params.get("subtypes") ?? "").split(",").filter(Boolean),
      ram: (params.get("ram") ?? "").split(",").filter(Boolean),
      storage: (params.get("storage") ?? "").split(",").filter(Boolean),
      screenSize: (params.get("screenSize") ?? "").split(",").filter(Boolean),
      processor: (params.get("processor") ?? "").split(",").filter(Boolean),
      color: (params.get("color") ?? "").split(",").filter(Boolean),
    }),
    [params],
  );

  const patch = useCallback(
    (updates: Record<string, string | number | null>) => {
      const next = new URLSearchParams(params.toString());
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(updates)) {
        if (v === null || v === "") next.delete(k);
        else next.set(k, String(v));
      }
      next.delete("page");
      router.push(`?${next.toString()}`, { scroll: false });
    },
    [params, router],
  );

  function toggle(key: keyof typeof selected, param: string, value: string) {
    const list = selected[key];
    const next = list.includes(value) ? list.filter((v) => v !== value) : [...list, value];
    patch({ [param]: next.join(",") || null });
  }

  const clearAll = () => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams();
    const q = params.get("q");
    const sort = params.get("sort");
    if (q) next.set("q", q);
    if (sort) next.set("sort", sort);
    router.push(`?${next.toString()}`, { scroll: false });
  };

  const activeCount =
    Object.values(selected).flat().length +
    (defaults.minPrice ? 1 : 0) +
    (defaults.maxPrice ? 1 : 0) +
    (params.get("minRating") ? 1 : 0) +
    (params.get("minDiscount") ? 1 : 0) +
    (params.get("inStock") ? 1 : 0);
    // (params.get("warranty") ? 1 : 0);

  const group = (id: string, title: string, body: React.ReactNode) => (
    <section className="border-b border-hairline py-3.5 last:border-0">
      <button
        onClick={() => setOpen((o) => ({ ...o, [id]: !o[id] }))}
        aria-expanded={Boolean(open[id])}
        className="flex w-full items-center justify-between text-left"
      >
        <span className="text-[12.5px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-700">{title}</span>
        <ChevronDown className={cn("size-4 text-ink-300 transition-transform", open[id] && "rotate-180")} />
      </button>
      {open[id] && <div className="mt-3">{body}</div>}
    </section>
  );

  // `values` = what goes in the URL (slugs for brand, raw data for the rest).
  // `labels` = optional pretty text shown beside the checkbox (names for brand).
  const checkList = (
    key: keyof typeof selected,
    param: string,
    values: string[],
    limit = 8,
    labels?: string[],
  ) => {
    if (!values.length) return null;
    const shown = open[`more-${key}`] ? values : values.slice(0, limit);
    return (
      <>
        <ul className="max-h-56 space-y-1.5 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
          {shown.map((v, i) => (
            <li key={v}>
              <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2.5 text-[13px] text-ink-700 hover:text-ink-900">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={selected[key].includes(v)}
                  onChange={() => toggle(key, param, v)}
                  className="size-3.5 rounded border-hairline accent-[#c9a96e]"
                />
                <span className="truncate">{labels?.[i] ?? v}</span>
              </label>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        {values.length > limit && (
          <button
            onClick={() => setOpen((o) => ({ ...o, [`more-${key}`]: !o[`more-${key}`] }))}
            className="mt-2 text-[12px] font-bold text-electric-600 hover:underline"
          >
            {open[`more-${key}`] ? "Show less" : `Show all ${values.length}`}
          </button>
        )}
      </>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="text-ink-900">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2">
        <h2 className="font-display text-sm font-bold">
          Filters {activeCount > 0 && <span className="text-electric-600">({activeCount})</span>}
        </h2>
        {activeCount > 0 && (
          <button
            onClick={clearAll}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[12px] font-semibold text-ink-400 hover:text-flame-600"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="size-3" /> Clear all
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {activeKeys.includes("price") &&
        group(
          "price",
          "Price",
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <ul className="space-y-1.5">
              {PRICE_BUCKETS.map((b) => {
                const on =
                  String(defaults.minPrice) === String(b.min) &&
                  String(defaults.maxPrice) === String(b.max);
                return (
                  <li key={b.label}>
                    <button
                      onClick={() =>
                        patch(on ? { minPrice: null, maxPrice: null } : { minPrice: b.min, maxPrice: b.max ?? null })
                      }
                      className={cn(
                        "w-full rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[13px] transition-colors",
                        on ? "bg-electric-50 font-bold text-electric-700" : "text-ink-700 hover:bg-canvas",
                      )}
                    >
                      {b.label}
                    </button>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <input
                type="number"
                defaultValue={defaults.minPrice ?? ""}
                min={0}
                placeholder="Min"
                aria-label="Minimum price"
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === "Enter") patch({ minPrice: (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value || null });
                }}
                onBlur={(e) => patch({ minPrice: e.target.value || null })}
                className="h-9 w-full rounded-lg border border-hairline px-2 text-[13px] outline-none focus:border-electric-400"
              />
              <span className="text-ink-300">—</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                defaultValue={defaults.maxPrice ?? ""}
                min={0}
                placeholder="Max"
                aria-label="Maximum price"
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === "Enter") patch({ maxPrice: (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value || null });
                }}
                onBlur={(e) => patch({ maxPrice: e.target.value || null })}
                className="h-9 w-full rounded-lg border border-hairline px-2 text-[13px] outline-none focus:border-electric-400"
              />
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-ink-300">
              Range in catalogue: {inr(facets.priceRange.min)} – {inr(facets.priceRange.max)}
            </p>
          </div>,
        )}

      {/* Brand: URL value = SLUG (server contract), displayed label = NAME. */}
      {activeKeys.includes("brand") &&
        group(
          "brand",
          "Brand",
          checkList(
            "brand",
            "brands",
            facets.brands.map((b) => b.slug),
            8,
            facets.brands.map((b) => b.name),
          ),
        )}

      {activeKeys.includes("subtype") && group("subtype", "Product type", checkList("subtype", "subtypes", facets.subtypes))}
      {activeKeys.includes("ram") && group("ram", "Size", checkList("ram", "ram", facets.ram))}
      {activeKeys.includes("storage") && group("storage", "Fabric", checkList("storage", "storage", facets.storage))}
      {activeKeys.includes("screenSize") && group("screenSize", "Fit", checkList("screenSize", "screenSize", facets.screenSize))}
      {activeKeys.includes("processor") && group("processor", "Occasion", checkList("processor", "processor", facets.processor, 6))}
      {activeKeys.includes("color") && group("color", "Colour", checkList("color", "color", facets.color))}

      {activeKeys.includes("rating") &&
        group(
          "rating",
          "Customer rating",
          <ul className="space-y-1">
            {[4, 3, 2].map((r) => {
              const on = params.get("minRating") === String(r);
              return (
                <li key={r}>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => patch({ minRating: on ? null : r })}
                    className={cn(
                      "w-full rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[13px]",
                      on ? "bg-electric-50 font-bold text-electric-700" : "hover:bg-canvas",
                    )}
                  >
                    {r}★ & above
                  </button>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>,
        )}

      {activeKeys.includes("discount") &&
        group(
          "discount",
          "Discount",
          <ul className="space-y-1">
            {[10, 20, 30, 40].map((d) => {
              const on = params.get("minDiscount") === String(d);
              return (
                <li key={d}>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => patch({ minDiscount: on ? null : d })}
                    className={cn(
                      "w-full rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[13px]",
                      on ? "bg-electric-50 font-bold text-electric-700" : "hover:bg-canvas",
                    )}
                  >
                    {d}% and above
                  </button>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>,
        )}

      {activeKeys.includes("availability") &&
        group(
          "availability",
          "Availability",
          <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2.5 text-[13px]">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={Boolean(defaults.inStock)}
              onChange={(e) => patch({ inStock: e.target.checked ? 1 : null })}
              className="size-3.5 accent-[#c9a96e]"
            />
            Exclude out of stock
          </label>,
        )}

      {/* {activeKeys.includes("warranty") &&
        group(
          "warranty",
          "Warranty",
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            {[6, 12, 24, 60].map((w) => {
              const on = params.get("warranty") === String(w);
              return (
                <button
                  key={w}
                  onClick={() => patch({ warranty: on ? null : w })}

                  )}
                >
                  {w >= 12 ? `${w / 12} yr` : `${w} mo`}+
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>,
        )} */}

      <div className="pt-4 lg:hidden">
        <Button block onClick={clearAll} variant="outline" size="sm">

    </div>
  );

"use client";

import { Plus, ShoppingCart } from "lucide-react";
import Image from "next/image";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import { useCart } from "@/context/CartContext";
import { inr } from "@/lib/utils";

type Primary = {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  image: string;
  salePrice: number;
};

type AddOn = {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  image: string;
  salePrice: number;
};

export function FrequentlyBought({
  primary,
  addOns,
}: {
  primary: Primary;
  addOns: AddOn[];
}) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const { add } = useCart();
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<string>>(
    new Set(addOns[0] ? [addOns[0].id] : []),
  );
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const selectedAddOns = addOns.filter((a) => selected.has(a.id));
  const total = primary.salePrice + selectedAddOns.reduce((s, a) => s + a.salePrice, 0);

  function toggle(id: string) {
    setSelected((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  }

  async function addBundle() {
    setBusy(true);

    try {
      await add(primary.id, 1);
      for (const a of selectedAddOns) {
        await add(a.id, 1);
      }

      toast.push({
        title: "Bundle added to cart",
        body: `${1 + selectedAddOns.length} item(s)`,
      });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  if (!addOns.length) return null;

  return (
    <section className="card overflow-hidden">
      <header className="border-b border-hairline px-4 py-3">
        <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">
          Frequently bought together
        </h2>
      </header>

      <div className="space-y-3 p-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Link
            href={`/product/${primary.slug}`}
            className="relative size-20 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-canvas"
          >
            <Image src={primary.image} alt={primary.name} fill sizes="80px" className="object-contain p-1" />
          </Link>

          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <Link href={`/product/${primary.slug}`} className="block truncate text-[13.5px] font-bold text-ink-900 hover:text-electric-600">
              {primary.name}
            </Link>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">
              {inr(primary.salePrice)}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {addOns.map((a) => (
          <div key={a.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-hairline p-3">
            <label className="flex size-5 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={selected.has(a.id)}
                onChange={() => toggle(a.id)}
                className="size-4 
accent-[#c9a96e]"
              />
            </label>

            <Link
              href={`/product/${a.slug}`}
              className="relative size-16 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-canvas"
            >
              <Image src={a.image} alt={a.name} fill sizes="64px" className="object-contain p-1" />
            </Link>

            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <Link href={`/product/${a.slug}`} className="block truncate text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink-900 hover:text-electric-600">
                {a.name}
              </Link>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12.5px] font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">
                {inr(a.salePrice)}
              </p>
            </div>

            <Plus className="size-4 text-ink-300" />
          </div>
        ))}

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-hairline pt-3">
          <div>
            <p className="text-[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">
              Bundle price
            </p>
            <p className="font-display text-xl font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">
              {inr(total)}
            </p>
          </div>

          <Button loading={busy} onClick={addBundle}>
            {!busy && <ShoppingCart className="size-4" />}
            Add bundle to cart
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\product\FrequentlyBoughtSheet.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { Check, Plus, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useCart } from "@/context/CartContext";
import { inr } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { CardVM } from "@/lib/catalog";

// Same picsum-403 guard as the cart/checkout rows: a truthy-but-dead URL degrades to a
// letter tile, never a broken icon.
function Thumb({ src, name }: { src: string; name: string }) {
  const [bad, setBad] = useState(false);
  if (!src || bad) return <span aria-hidden className="grid size-full place-items-center bg-gray-100 text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-400">{(name || "V").slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}</span>;
  return (
    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
    <img src={src} alt={name} loading="lazy" onError={() => setBad(true)} className="size-full object-contain p-1" />
  );
}

// Title is chosen by the tier that ACTUALLY returned data, so the literal
// "Frequently bought together" only appears when real orders back it.
const TITLE: Record<string, string> = {
  copurchase: "Frequently bought together",
  category: "Complete your order",
  brand: "Complete your order",
  global: "You may also like",
  none: "You may also like",
};

/**
 * Buy-now upsell interstitial. Rendered via a PORTAL to document.body at z-[100] so it
 * always paints above the app's fixed bottom tab bar (which previously covered the
 * Skip & Continue button when the sheet rendered deep inside the wizard's DOM).
 * Toggling + adds the accessory to cart AND scope; un-toggling removes it from the
 * scope and from the cart ONLY if this sheet added it. Zero candidates -> auto-continue.
 */
export function FrequentlyBoughtSheet({
  seedId,
  onContinue,
  onAbort,
}: {
  seedId: string;
  onContinue: (ids: string[]) => void;
  onAbort: () => void;
}) {
  const { add, remove, items, ready } = useCart();
  const [cands, setCands] = useState<CardVM[] | null>(null);
  const [scope, setScope] = useState<string>("none");
  const [groupName, setGroupName] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [addedHere, setAddedHere] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const settled = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => { const t = requestAnimationFrame(() => setMounted(true)); return () => cancelAnimationFrame(t); }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready) return;
    let alive = true;
    fetch(`/api/feed/upsell?id=${encodeURIComponent(seedId)}&n=4`, { cache: "no-store" })
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((j) => {
        if (!alive) return;
        const list = (j?.products ?? []) as CardVM[];
        setCands(list);
        setScope(typeof j?.scope === "string" ? j.scope : "none");
        setGroupName(typeof j?.groupName === "string" ? j.groupName : null);
        if (list.length === 0 && !settled.current) { settled.current = true; onContinue([seedId]); }
      })
      .catch(() => { if (alive) { setCands([]); if (!settled.current) { settled.current = true; onContinue([seedId]); } } });
    return () => { alive = false; };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [ready, seedId]);

  async function toggle(p: CardVM) {
    if (selected.has(p.id)) {
      setSelected((s) => { const n = new Set(s); n.delete(p.id); return n; });
      if (addedHere.has(p.id)) { setAddedHere((s) => { const n = new Set(s); n.delete(p.id); return n; }); await remove(p.id); }
      return;
    }
    const inCart = items.some((i) => i.productId === p.id && !i.savedForLater);
    if (!inCart) { await add(p.id, 1); setAddedHere((s) => new Set(s).add(p.id)); }
    setSelected((s) => new Set(s).add(p.id));
  }

  function skipAndContinue() {
    if (settled.current) return; settled.current = true;
    onContinue([seedId, ...Array.from(selected)]);
  }

  if (typeof document === "undefined") return null; // SSR safety; state-gated anyway

  const subtitle =
    scope === "copurchase" ? "From real Urban Vogue orders" :
    scope === "category" && groupName ? `More in ${groupName}` :
    scope === "brand" && groupName ? `More from ${groupName}` :
    "Add-ons for your order";

  return createPortal(
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex flex-col justify-end">
      <button type="button" aria-label="Close" onClick={onAbort} className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/40" />
      <div
        className={`relative flex max-h-[82vh] flex-col rounded-t-2xl bg-white shadow-2xl transition-transform duration-300 ${mounted ? "translate-y-0" : "translate-y-full"}`}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-hairline px-4 py-3.5">
          <button type="button" onClick={onAbort} aria-label="Close" className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-lg text-ink-500 hover:bg-canvas"><X className="size-5" /></button>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h2 className="font-display text-[16px] font-bold text-ink-900">{TITLE[scope] ?? TITLE.none}</h2>
            <p className="truncate text-[12px] text-ink-400">{subtitle}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
          {cands === null ? (
            <div className="space-y-3 p-4">{[0,1,2].map((i)=><div key={i} className="h-20 w-full animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-canvas" />)}</div>
          ) : cands.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="p-6 text-center text-[13px] text-ink-400">No add-ons to suggest right now.</p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="divide-y divide-hairline">
              {cands.map((p) => {
                const on = selected.has(p.id);
                const d = p.mrp > p.salePrice ? Math.round(((p.mrp - p.salePrice) / p.mrp) * 100) : 0;
                return (
                  <li key={p.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 p-4">
                    <span className="relative size-16 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-canvas"><Thumb src={p.image} name={p.name} /></span>
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p className="line-clamp-2 text-[13px] font-semibold leading-snug text-ink-900">{p.name}</p>
                      <p className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-1.5">
                        <span className="text-[13px] font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">{inr(p.salePrice)}</span>
                        {d > 0 && <span className="text-[11px] text-ink-300 line-through tabular-nums">{inr(p.mrp)}</span>}
                        {d > 0 && <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-600">↓{d}%</span>}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => void toggle(p)}
                      aria-pressed={on}
                      className={`inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-[12.5px] font-bold transition-colors ${on ? "bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-700" : "bg-[#1a1a2e] text-white hover:bg-[#1f5fc9]"}`}
                    >
                      {on ? <><Check className="size-4" /> Added</> : <><Plus className="size-4" /> Add</>}
                    </button>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="border-t border-hairline p-3 pb-[calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)+0.75rem)]">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={skipAndContinue}
            className="w-full rounded-xl bg-amber-offer py-3.5 text-[14px] font-black uppercase tracking-wide text-white transition-all hover:brightness-105"
          >
            Skip &amp; Continue
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body,
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, X } from "lucide-react";

export type LightboxImage = { url: string; alt?: string | null };

export function FullImageView({ images, index, onIndex, onClose }: {
  images: LightboxImage[];
  index: number;
  onIndex: (i: number) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const count = images.length;
  const prev = useCallback(() => onIndex((index - 1 + count) % count), [index, count, onIndex]);
  const next = useCallback(() => onIndex((index + 1) % count), [index, count, onIndex]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
      if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") prev();
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight") next();
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [prev, next, onClose]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const old = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => { document.body.style.overflow = old; };
  }, []);

  if (count === 0) return null;
  const cur = images[index] ?? images[0]!;

  return (
    // White field, exactly like Flipkart's /full-image-view: the product asset's
    // own white canvas blends in, so no rectangle/seam is visible around it.
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] bg-white" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Product image viewer">
      {/* Bare dark glyph (no chip) — reads on white just like the reference's ×. */}
      <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close full image view"
        className="absolute left-3 top-3 z-10 grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-full text-gray-700 transition-colors hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-900">
        <X className="size-5" />
      </button>

      {count > 1 && (
        <>
          {/* White chips need a ring to stay visible on a white page. */}
          <button type="button" onClick={prev} aria-label="Previous image"
            className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 z-10 grid size-11 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-white text-gray-800 shadow-md ring-1 ring-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50">
            <ChevronLeft className="size-5" />
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={next} aria-label="Next image"
            className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 z-10 grid size-11 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-white text-gray-800 shadow-md ring-1 ring-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50">
            <ChevronRight className="size-5" />
          </button>
        </>
      )}

      <div className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-center p-6 pb-16" onClick={onClose}>
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
        <img
          src={cur.url}
          alt={cur.alt ?? ""}
          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          className="max-h-[82vh] max-w-[92vw] select-none object-contain"
          draggable={false}
        />
      </div>

      {count > 1 && (
        <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
          {images.map((im, i) => (
            <button key={im.url + i} type="button" aria-label={`Go to image ${i + 1}`} onClick={() => onIndex(i)}
              className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all ${i === index ? "w-4 bg-gray-700" : "w-1.5 bg-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-400"}`} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default FullImageView;

"use client";

import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "framer-motion";
import { Maximize2, ZoomIn } from "lucide-react";
import Image from "next/image";
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function Gallery({ images, badge }: { images: { url: string; alt: string }[]; badge?: string }) {
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0);
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(false);
  const [origin, setOrigin] = useState({ x: 50, y: 50 });
  const frame = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const list = images.length ? images : [{ url: "/placeholder-banner-bg.jpg", alt: "Product" }];
  const current = list[Math.min(index, list.length - 1)]!;

  function onMove(e: React.MouseEvent) {
    const rect = frame.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!rect) return;
    setOrigin({ x: ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100, y: ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100 });
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <div
        ref={frame}
        onMouseEnter={() => setZoom(true)}
        onMouseLeave={() => setZoom(false)}
        onMouseMove={onMove}
        className="group relative aspect-square overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-hairline bg-white"
      >
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
          <motion.div
            key={current.url}
            initial={{ opacity: 0.6, scale: 0.985 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.22 }}
            className="absolute inset-0"
          >
            <Image
              src={current.url}
              alt={current.alt}
              fill
              priority
              sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 92vw, 520px"
              className={cn("object-contain p-4 transition-transform duration-200", zoom && "scale-[2.1]")}
              style={{ transformOrigin: `${origin.x}% ${origin.y}%` }}
            />
          </motion.div>
        </AnimatePresence>

        {badge && (
          <span className="absolute left-3 top-3 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-r from-flame-500 to-orange-deal px-2.5 py-1 text-[11.5px] font-bold text-white shadow">
            {badge}
          </span>
        )}
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-3 hidden items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-ink-900/80 px-2 py-1 text-[10.5px] font-semibold text-white opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100 sm:flex">
          <ZoomIn className="size-3" /> Hover to zoom
        </span>
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 bg-gradient-to-t from-white to-transparent py-3 text-[11px] font-semibold text-ink-300">
          <Maximize2 className="size-3" /> {list.length} photo{list.length > 1 ? "s" : ""}
        </span>
      </div>

      {list.length > 1 && (
        <div role="tablist" aria-label="Product images" className="no-scrollbar mt-3 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto">
          {list.map((img, i) => (
            <button
              key={img.url + i}
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={i === index}
              aria-label={`View image ${i + 1}`}
              onClick={() => setIndex(i)}
              className={cn(
                "relative size-16 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border-2 bg-white transition-all",
                i === index ? "border-electric-500 shadow-glow" : "border-hairline hover:border-electric-300",
              )}
            >
              <Image src={img.url} alt="" fill sizes="64px" className="object-contain p-1" />
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

  loading?: boolean;

  const params = useSearchParams();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const sort = params.get("sort") ?? "popular";

  return (
    <>
      <div className="sticky top-16 z-30 -mx-4 mb-4 flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-hairline bg-canvas/95 px-4 py-3 backdrop-blur sm:mx-0 sm:rounded-xl sm:border sm:bg-white/90 sm:px-4 lg:top-[68px]">

        </div>

        <button
          onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
          className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-hairline bg-white px-3 text-[12.5px] font-bold text-ink-700 lg:hidden"

          <SlidersHorizontal className="size-3.5" /> Filters

          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Sort by</span>
          <select
            value={sort}

              const next = new URLSearchParams(params.toString());
              next.set("sort", e.target.value);
              next.delete("page");
              router.push(`?${next.toString()}`, { scroll: false });
            }}
            className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-hairline bg-white px-2 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-ink-900 outline-none focus:border-electric-400"
          >
            {SORT_OPTIONS.map((o) => (
              <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>
                {o.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>

      {loading && (
        <div className="mb-3 h-0.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-electric-50">
          <div className="h-full w-1/3 animate-[marquee_1.2s_linear_infinite] bg-electric-500" />
        </div>
      )}

      <Drawer open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title="Filters" side="left">
        {filterSlot}
      </Drawer>
    </>
  );
}

export function ActiveChips() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const entries = Array.from(params.entries()).filter(
    ([k]) => !["sort", "page", "q"].includes(k),
  );
  if (!entries.length) return null;
  return (
    <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
      {entries.map(([k, v]) => (
        <button
          key={k + v}
          onClick={() => {
            const next = new URLSearchParams(params.toString());
            next.delete(k);
            next.delete("page");
            router.push(`?${next.toString()}`, { scroll: false });
          }}
          className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-hairline bg-white px-2.5 py-1 text-[11.5px] font-semibold text-ink-700 hover:border-flame-500/50 hover:text-flame-600")}
        >
          {k}: {decodeURIComponent(v).replace(/,/g, ", ")}
          <span aria-hidden>✕</span>
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Heart, ShoppingCart, Zap } from "lucide-react";
import Image from "next/image";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { RatingPill } from "@/components/ui/Rating";
import { useCart } from "@/context/CartContext";
import type { CardVM } from "@/lib/catalog";
import { cn, emiPlans, inr } from "@/lib/utils";

export function ProductCard({
  product,
  priority = false,
  compact = false,
  showBuyNow = true,
}: {
  product: CardVM;
  priority?: boolean;
  compact?: boolean;
  showBuyNow?: boolean;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { add, toggleWishlist, inWishlist } = useCart();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<null | "cart" | "buy" | "wish">(null);

  const out = product.stock <= 0;
  const wished = inWishlist(product.id);
  const plan = emiPlans(product.salePrice)[0];

  async function handleAdd() {
    setBusy("cart");
    await add(product.id, 1);
    setBusy(null);
  }

  async function handleBuy() {
    setBusy("buy");
    await add(product.id, 1);
    router.push("/checkout");
  }

  async function handleWish() {
    setBusy("wish");
    await toggleWishlist(product.id);
    setBusy(null);
  }

  return (
    <article
      className={cn(
        "group card relative flex flex-col overflow-hidden transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-lift",
        compact && "text-[13px]",
      )}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleWish}
        disabled={busy !== null}
        aria-label={wished ? "Remove from wishlist" : "Add to wishlist"}
        aria-pressed={wished}
        className="absolute right-2 top-2 z-10 grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full bg-white/90 text-ink-400 shadow transition-colors hover:text-flame-500 disabled:opacity-50"
      >
        <Heart
          className={cn("size-4", wished && "fill-current text-flame-500")}
        />
      </button>

      {product.discountPercent > 0 && (
        <span className="absolute left-2 top-2 z-10 rounded-md bg-gradient-to-r from-flame-500 to-orange-deal px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] font-bold text-white shadow">
          {product.discountPercent}% OFF
        </span>
      )}

      <Link
        href={`/product/${product.slug}`}
        className="relative block aspect-square bg-canvas"
      >
        <Image
          src={product.image}
          alt={product.name}
          fill
          priority={priority}
          sizes={
            compact
              ? "(max-width: 640px) 45vw, (max-width: 1024px) 30vw, 220px"
              : "(max-width: 640px) 45vw, (max-width: 1024px) 30vw, 260px"
          }
          className="object-contain p-3 transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105"
        />

        {out && (
          <span className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center bg-white/70 text-[12px] font-bold text-flame-600">
            Out of stock
          </span>
        )}
      </Link>

      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col p-3">
        <p className="truncate text-[10.5px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">
          {product.brand}
        </p>

        <Link
          href={`/product/${product.slug}`}
          className="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 text-[13px] font-semibold leading-snug text-ink-900 hover:text-electric-600"
        >
          {product.name}
        </Link>

        <div className="mt-1.5">
          <RatingPill value={product.ratingAvg} count={product.ratingCount} />
        </div>

        <div className="mt-auto pt-2">
          <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
            <span className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">
              {inr(product.salePrice)}
            </span>

            {product.mrp > product.salePrice && (
              <span className="text-[11.5px] text-ink-300 line-through tabular-nums">
                {inr(product.mrp)}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {!compact && plan && (
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10.5px] font-semibold text-ink-400">
              EMI {inr(plan.perMonth)}/mo
            </p>
          )}

          <div className="mt-2.5 flex gap-1.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleAdd}
              disabled={out || busy !== null}
              className="inline-flex h-9 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-ink-900 text-[11.5px] font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-electric-600 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <ShoppingCart className="size-3.5" />
              {busy === "cart" ? "Adding…" : "Add"}
            </button>

            {showBuyNow && !compact && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleBuy}
                disabled={out || busy !== null}
                className="inline-flex h-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-amber-offer px-2.5 text-[11.5px] font-bold text-white transition-all hover:brightness-105 disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <Zap className="size-3.5" />
                {busy === "buy" ? "…" : "Buy"}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useRef } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowRight, ChevronRight, Star } from "lucide-react";

export type CarouselItem = {
  id?: string;
  slug?: string;
  name?: string;
  brand?: string | null;
  image?: string | null;
  price?: number | null;
  mrp?: number | null;
  rating?: number | null;
  ratingCount?: number | null;
  badge?: "trending" | "bestseller" | null;
};

const inr = (n?: number | null) =>
  typeof n === "number" && Number.isFinite(n) ? `₹${n.toLocaleString("en-IN")}` : "—";

const offPct = (mrp?: number | null, price?: number | null) =>
  typeof mrp === "number" && typeof price === "number" && mrp > 0 && price < mrp
    ? Math.round(((mrp - price) / mrp) * 100) : 0;

function MiniStars({ value }: { value?: number | null }) {
  const v = typeof value === "number" ? value : 0;
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-px text-amber-400" aria-label={`${v} out of 5`}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => (
        <Star key={i} className={`size-3 ${i <= Math.round(v) ? "fill-current" : "fill-none text-gray-300"}`} />
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}

const BADGE: Record<string, string> = {
  trending: "bg-orange-500 text-white",
  bestseller: "bg-[#1a1a2e] text-white",
};

export function ProductCarousel({ title, items, actionHref, actionLabel, eta }: {
  title: string; items: CarouselItem[]; actionHref?: string; actionLabel?: string; eta?: string;
}) {
  const railRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  function scrollRail() {
    const el = railRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const max = el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth;
    const next = el.scrollLeft + el.clientWidth * 0.8;
    el.scrollTo({ left: next > max - 8 ? 0 : next, behavior: "smooth" });
  }

  if (!items.length) return null;
  return (
    <section className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4">
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
        <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-gray-900">{title}</h2>
        {actionHref ? (
          <Link href={actionHref} className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-[#1a1a2e] hover:underline">
            {actionLabel ?? "View all"}
          </Link>
        ) : (
          <button type="button" onClick={scrollRail} aria-label={`Scroll ${title}`}
            className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full bg-gray-900 text-white transition-colors hover:bg-gray-700">
            <ArrowRight className="size-4" />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="relative">
        <div ref={railRef} className="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-1 [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden">
          {items.map((p, i) => {
            const off = offPct(p.mrp, p.price);
            const card = (
              <div className="flex w-[150px] shrink-0 flex-col">
                <div className="relative mb-2 aspect-square overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50">
                  {p.badge ? (
                    <span className={`absolute left-1.5 top-1.5 z-10 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${BADGE[p.badge] ?? ""}`}>
                      {p.badge === "trending" ? "Trending" : "Bestseller"}
                    </span>
                  ) : null}
                  {p.image
                    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                    ? <img src={p.image} alt={p.name ?? ""} loading="lazy" className="size-full object-contain" />
                    : <div className="grid size-full place-items-center text-gray-300"><Star className="size-7" /></div>}
                  {typeof p.rating === "number" ? (
                    <span className="absolute bottom-1.5 left-1.5 inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-white/95 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-900 shadow-sm">
                      {p.rating.toFixed(1)} <MiniStars value={p.rating} />
                    </span>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
                {p.brand ? <p className="mb-0.5 truncate text-[10.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400">{p.brand}</p> : null}
                <p className="line-clamp-2 min-h-[2.1rem] text-[12.5px] font-medium leading-snug text-gray-900">{p.name ?? "—"}</p>
                <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-1.5">
                  {off > 0 ? <span className="text-[12px] font-bold text-emerald-600">{off}% OFF</span> : null}
                  {p.mrp && off > 0 ? <span className="text-[11.5px] text-gray-400 line-through">{inr(p.mrp)}</span> : null}
                  <span className="text-[13px] font-bold text-gray-900">{inr(p.price)}</span>
                </div>
                {eta ? <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-gray-500">Get it by <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700">{eta}</span></p> : null}
              </div>
            );
            return p.slug
              ? <Link key={p.id ?? i} href={`/product/${p.slug}`} className="block">{card}</Link>
              : <div key={p.id ?? i}>{card}</div>;
          })}
        </div>

        <button type="button" onClick={scrollRail} aria-label={`Next ${title}`}
          className="absolute -right-2 top-1/2 z-10 grid size-9 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded-full bg-white text-gray-700 shadow-md ring-1 ring-gray-200 transition-colors hover:text-gray-900">
          <ChevronRight className="size-5" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export default ProductCarousel;
