"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { SpecsTable, type Spec } from "@/components/product/SpecsTable";
import { ShowCaseDrawer } from "@/components/product/ShowCaseDrawer";

type Img = { url: string; alt?: string | null; kind?: "GALLERY" | "SHOWCASE" };
type SpecRow = Spec & { kind?: "SPEC" | "WARRANTY" | "MFG" };

type Props = {
  name: string;
  brandName?: string | null;
  categoryName?: string | null;
  subtype?: string | null;
  color?: string | null;
  ram?: string | null;
  storage?: string | null;
  screenSize?: string | null;
  processor?: string | null;
  warrantyMonths?: number | null;
  returnableDays?: number | null;
  images: Img[];
  specifications?: SpecRow[] | null;
  // Long-form copy from Product.description (admin-edited on the specs page).
  // Optional so existing call sites that don't pass it still compile.
  description?: string | null;
};

type TabKey = "showcase" | "specs" | "description" | "warranty" | "mfg";

const TABS: { key: TabKey; label: string }[] = [
  { key: "showcase", label: "Showcase" },
  { key: "specs", label: "Specifications" },
  { key: "description", label: "Description" },
  { key: "warranty", label: "Return & Exchange" },
  { key: "mfg", label: "Manufacturer Info" },
];

// Banners previewed on the PDP before "Show More" (the rest live in the immersive view).
const COLLAPSED = 1;
// How much of the first banner the collapsed teaser reveals. Tune to taste.
const TEASER_MAX_H = "max-h-[55vh]";

function Row({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-[42%_58%] gap-3 border-b border-gray-100 py-2.5 text-[13px] last:border-0">
      <span className="text-gray-500">{label}</span>
      <span className="font-medium text-gray-900">{value}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ProductDetails(props: Props) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<TabKey>("showcase");
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(true);
  const [showcaseOpen, setShowcaseOpen] = useState(false);
  const {
    name, brandName, categoryName, subtype, color, ram, storage,
    screenSize, processor, warrantyMonths, returnableDays, images, specifications,
    description,
  } = props;

  const allSpecs = specifications ?? [];
  const specRows   = allSpecs.filter((s) => (s.kind ?? "SPEC") === "SPEC");
  const warrantyDb = allSpecs.filter((s) => s.kind === "WARRANTY");
  const mfgDb      = allSpecs.filter((s) => s.kind === "MFG");
  const banners    = (images ?? []).filter((im) => (im.kind ?? "GALLERY") === "SHOWCASE");
  const teaser     = banners.slice(0, COLLAPSED);
  const descText   = (description ?? "").trim();

  // Fallbacks = the old hardcoded text, used only until admin adds rows.
  const warrantyRows: [string, string][] = warrantyDb.length
  ? warrantyDb.map((s) => [s.label, s.value])
  : [
      ["Return Policy", returnableDays ? `${returnableDays}-day easy return` : "7-day easy return"],
      ["Exchange Policy", "Free size exchange within return window"],
      ["Covered", "Manufacturing defects, colour bleeding, stitching issues"],
      ["Not Covered", "Normal wear & tear, alterations, misuse"],
      ["Brand Support", brandName ?? "Urban Vogue"],
    ];

  const mfgRows: [string, string][] = mfgDb.length
  ? mfgDb.map((s) => [s.label, s.value])
  : [
      ["Manufacturer", brandName ?? name],
      ["Marketed & Sold by", "Urban Vogue"],
      ["Country of Origin", "India"],
      ["Packed Quantity", "1"],
      ["Category", categoryName ?? "\u2014"],
      ["Style", subtype ?? name],
    ];

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}
        aria-expanded={open}
        className="flex w-full items-center justify-between px-4 py-3.5 text-left"
      >
        <span className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-gray-900">All details</span>
        <ChevronDown className={`size-5 text-gray-500 transition-transform ${open ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div className="border-t border-gray-100 px-4 pb-4 pt-3">
          <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-3 [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden">
            {TABS.map((t) => (
              <button
                key={t.key}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setTab(t.key)}
                className={`shrink-0 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-[13px] font-semibold transition-colors ${
                  tab === t.key
                    ? "bg-gray-900 text-white"
                    : "border border-gray-200 bg-white text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-400"
                }`}
              >
                {t.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Showcase = full-bleed clamped teaser + Show More -> immersive full-screen view */}
          {tab === "showcase" && (
            <div>
              {banners.length ? (
                <>
                  {/* -mx-4 bleeds edge-to-edge (matches the video width); the clamp crops the
                      first banner to a teaser. shrink-0 on the img stops the flex column from
                      squashing it - without it max-h would compress, not crop. */}
                  <div className={`-mx-4 flex flex-col overflow-hidden ${TEASER_MAX_H}`}>
                    {teaser.map((im, i) => (
                      // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                      <img
                        key={im.url + i}
                        src={im.url}
                        alt={im.alt ?? (i === 0 ? name : "")}
                        draggable={false}
                        loading="eager"
                        className="block h-auto w-full shrink-0 select-none"
                      />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowcaseOpen(true)}
                    className="mt-3 flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white py-3 text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-gray-700 transition-colors hover:bg-gray-50"
                  >
                    Show More <ChevronRight className="size-4 text-gray-500" />
                  </button>
                </>
              ) : (
                <p className="py-2 text-[12.5px] text-gray-400">No showcase banners added yet.</p>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {tab === "specs" && (
            <div className="pt-1">
              {specRows.length ? (
                <SpecsTable specifications={specRows} />
              ) : (
                <p className="py-3 text-[13px] text-gray-500">No detailed specifications listed.</p>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Description = long-form admin copy, line breaks preserved, plain text (no HTML). */}
          {tab === "description" && (
            <div className="pt-1">
              {descText ? (
                <div className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-gray-700">
                  {description}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="py-3 text-[13px] text-gray-500">No description provided.</p>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {tab === "warranty" && <div>{warrantyRows.map(([k, v]) => <Row key={k} label={k} value={v} />)}</div>}
          {tab === "mfg" && <div>{mfgRows.map(([k, v]) => <Row key={k} label={k} value={v} />)}</div>}
        </div>
      )}

      <ShowCaseDrawer
        images={banners.map((b) => b.url)}
        open={showcaseOpen}
        onClose={() => setShowcaseOpen(false)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

export default ProductDetails;

"use client";

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Heart, Plus, Send, Star } from "lucide-react";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import { FullImageView } from "@/components/product/FullImageView";

type GalleryImage = { url: string; isPrimary?: boolean; position?: number };
type Props = {
  images: GalleryImage[];
  name: string;
  productId: string;
  ratingAvg: number;
  ratingCount: number;
};

const compact = (n: number) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("en", { notation: "compact", maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(n);

/** Heart with a small + badge on the corner — Flipkart wishlist style. */
function WishlistIcon({ saved, className = "size-4" }: { saved: boolean; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <span className="relative inline-block">
      <Heart className={`${className} ${saved ? "fill-rose-500 text-rose-500" : ""}`} />
      {!saved && (
        <span className="absolute -bottom-0.5 -right-1 grid size-3.5 place-items-center rounded-full bg-white text-gray-700 ring-1 ring-gray-300">
          <Plus className="size-2" />
        </span>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

function OverlayButtons({ saved, onHeart, onShare }: {
  saved: boolean; onHeart: () => void; onShare: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="absolute right-2 top-2 z-10 flex flex-col gap-2">
      <button type="button" onClick={onHeart} aria-label={saved ? "Remove from wishlist" : "Add to wishlist"}
        className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full bg-white/95 text-gray-700 shadow-md ring-1 ring-gray-200 transition-colors hover:text-rose-500">
        <WishlistIcon saved={saved} className="size-4" />
      </button>
      <button type="button" onClick={onShare} aria-label="Share"
        className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full bg-white/95 text-gray-700 shadow-md ring-1 ring-gray-200 transition-colors hover:text-[#1a1a2e]">
        <Send className="size-4" />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ProductGallery({ images, name, ratingAvg, ratingCount }: Props) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const railRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [idx, setIdx] = useState(0);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const list = images && images.length ? images : [];
  const count = list.length;

  function goTo(i: number) {
    const el = railRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    el.scrollTo({ left: i * el.clientWidth, behavior: "smooth" });
  }

  function onRailScroll() {
    const el = railRef.current;
    if (!el || el.clientWidth === 0) return;
    const next = Math.min(count - 1, Math.max(0, Math.round(el.scrollLeft / el.clientWidth)));
    setIdx((cur) => (cur === next ? cur : next));
  }

  function onHeart() {
    setSaved((s) => !s);
    toast.push({ title: saved ? "Removed from wishlist" : "Saved to wishlist", body: name });
  }

  async function onShare() {
    const url = typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.location.href : "";
    try {
      if (navigator.share) await navigator.share({ title: name, url });
      else { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url); toast.push({ title: "Link copied", body: name }); }
    } catch { /* user dismissed the share sheet — ignore */ }
  }

  if (!count) {
    return <div className="h-[calc(100svh-21.5rem)] min-h-[20rem] w-full bg-gray-100" aria-label={name} />;
  }

  return (
    <>
      {/* MOBILE — Flipkart-style: full-bleed, near-full-height image,
          overlay actions, rating pill, dots. Selected Color label peeks in;
          swatch thumbnails stay below the fold until you scroll. */}
      <div className="md:hidden">
        <div className="relative -mx-4 bg-white">
          <div
            ref={railRef}
            onScroll={onRailScroll}
            className="flex snap-x snap-mandatory overflow-x-auto bg-white [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden"
          >
            {list.map((im, i) => (
              /* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */
              <img
                key={i}
                src={im.url}
                alt={`${name} image ${i + 1}`}
                onClick={() => setZoom(i)}
                className="h-[calc(100svh-21.5rem)] min-h-[20rem] w-full shrink-0 snap-center object-contain"
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          <OverlayButtons saved={saved} onHeart={onHeart} onShare={onShare} />

          <span className="absolute bottom-2 left-2 z-10 inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-white/95 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-900 shadow-sm">
            {Number(ratingAvg).toFixed(1)} <Star className="size-3 fill-emerald-600 text-emerald-600" />
            <span className="font-semibold text-gray-500">{compact(ratingCount)}+</span>
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Dots only — Flipkart mobile does not show a thumbnail strip */}
        <div className="mt-3 flex justify-center gap-1">
          {list.map((_, i) => (
            <button key={i} type="button" onClick={() => goTo(i)} aria-label={`Go to image ${i + 1}`}
              className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all ${i === idx ? "w-4 bg-[#1a1a2e]" : "w-1.5 bg-gray-300"}`}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* DESKTOP — uniform 2-col grid + right action rail (unchanged) */}
      <div className="hidden md:block">
        <div className="flex gap-3">
          <div className="grid flex-1 grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {list.map((im, i) => (
              <figure key={i} className="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50">
                {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                <img
                  src={im.url}
                  alt={`${name} image ${i + 1}`}
                  loading={i < 2 ? "eager" : "lazy"}
                  onClick={() => setZoom(i)}
                  className="aspect-[4/5] w-full object-contain transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-[1.04]"
                />
              </figure>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="flex w-14 shrink-0 flex-col items-center gap-3 pt-1">
            <button type="button" onClick={onHeart} aria-label={saved ? "Remove from wishlist" : "Add to wishlist"}
              className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-white text-gray-700 shadow-md ring-1 ring-gray-200 transition-colors hover:text-rose-500">
              <WishlistIcon saved={saved} className="size-5" />
            </button>
            <button type="button" onClick={onShare} aria-label="Share"
              className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-white text-gray-700 shadow-md ring-1 ring-gray-200 transition-colors hover:text-[#1a1a2e]">
              <Send className="size-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {zoom !== null && (
        <FullImageView
          images={list.map((im) => ({ url: im.url, alt: `${name} image` }))}
          index={zoom}
          onIndex={setZoom}
          onClose={() => setZoom(null)}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}

export default ProductGallery;

FILE: src\components\product\ProductJsonLd.tsx

type Product = {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  shortDescription?: string | null;
  mrp: number;
  salePrice: number;
  stock: number;
  ratingAvg: number;
  ratingCount: number;
  brand: { name: string };
  category: { name: string };
  images: { url: string }[];
};

type Review = {
  rating: number;
  title: string | null;
  body: string;
  author: string;
  at: string;
};

export function ProductJsonLd({
  product,
  reviews,
}: {
  product: Product;
  reviews: Review[];
}) {
  const data = {
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "Product",
    name: product.name,
    description: product.shortDescription ?? product.name,
    image: product.images.map((i) => i.url),
    sku: product.id,
    mpn: product.slug,
    brand: {
      "@type": "Brand",
      name: product.brand.name,
    },
    category: product.category.name,
    offers: {
      "@type": "Offer",
      url: `https://urbanvogue.in/product/${product.slug}`,
      priceCurrency: "INR",
      price: product.salePrice,
      availability: product.stock > 0
        ? "https://schema.org/InStock"
        : "https://schema.org/OutOfStock",
      itemCondition: "https://schema.org/NewCondition",
      seller: {
        "@type": "Organization",
        name: "Urban Vogue",
      },
    },
    aggregateRating:
      product.ratingCount > 0
        ? {
            "@type": "AggregateRating",
            ratingValue: product.ratingAvg,
            reviewCount: product.ratingCount,
          }
        : undefined,
    review: reviews.slice(0, 5).map((r) => ({
      "@type": "Review",
      reviewRating: {
        "@type": "Rating",
        ratingValue: r.rating,
        bestRating: 5,
        worstRating: 1,
      },
      name: r.title ?? undefined,
      reviewBody: r.body,
      author: {
        "@type": "Person",
        name: r.author,
      },
      datePublished: r.at,
    })),
  };

  return (
    <script
      type="application/ld+json"
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
        __html: JSON.stringify(data).replace(/</g, "\\u003c"),
      }}
    />
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import Image from "next/image";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import type { CardVM } from "@/lib/catalog";

type Props = {
  initialProducts: CardVM[];
  /** Size of the server-provided batch (the page passes products.length). */
  total: number;
  categorySlug?: string | null;
};

/** "" or garbage -> null so an empty price box never filters. */
const num = (s: string): number | null => {
  const n = Number(s);
  return s.trim() !== "" && Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
};

// Optional fields: if CardVM ever carries sold/createdAt these sorts become
// exact automatically; until then they degrade to sensible fallbacks.
const soldOf = (p: CardVM) => (p as { sold?: number }).sold ?? 0;
const createdAtOf = (p: CardVM) => (p as { createdAt?: string }).createdAt ?? "";

export function ProductListClient({ initialProducts, total, categorySlug }: Props) {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const [sort, setSort] = useState(searchParams.get("sort") || "popular");
  const [minPrice, setMinPrice] = useState(searchParams.get("minPrice") || "");
  const [maxPrice, setMaxPrice] = useState(searchParams.get("maxPrice") || "");

  // REAL filtering + sorting now: the grid renders this, not the raw batch.
  const products = useMemo(() => {
    const min = num(minPrice);
    const max = num(maxPrice);
    const filtered = initialProducts.filter(
      (p) => (min === null || p.salePrice >= min) && (max === null || p.salePrice <= max),
    );
    switch (sort) {
      case "priceLow":  return [...filtered].sort((a, b) => a.salePrice - b.salePrice);
      case "priceHigh": return [...filtered].sort((a, b) => b.salePrice - a.salePrice);
      case "rating":    return [...filtered].sort((a, b) => b.ratingAvg - a.ratingAvg);
      case "newest":    return [...filtered].sort((a, b) => createdAtOf(b).localeCompare(createdAtOf(a)));
      default:          return [...filtered].sort((a, b) => soldOf(b) - soldOf(a) || b.ratingCount - a.ratingCount);
    }
  }, [initialProducts, sort, minPrice, maxPrice]);

  // Keep the URL shareable WITHOUT triggering a server refetch.
  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    if (sort !== "popular") params.set("sort", sort); else params.delete("sort");
    if (minPrice) params.set("minPrice", minPrice); else params.delete("minPrice");
    if (maxPrice) params.set("maxPrice", maxPrice); else params.delete("maxPrice");
    window.history.replaceState({}, "", `/products/${categorySlug || "all"}?${params.toString()}`);
  }, [sort, minPrice, maxPrice, categorySlug]);

  const hasFilters = sort !== "popular" || minPrice !== "" || maxPrice !== "";

  return (
    <div className="container-x py-6">
      {/* FILTER BAR */}
      <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-xl bg-white p-4 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-gray-200">
        <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-gray-500">Filters:</span>

        <select
          value={sort}
          onChange={(e) => setSort(e.target.value)}
          className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 px-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#1a1a2e]"
        >
          <option value="popular">Popularity</option>
          <option value="newest">Newest First</option>
          <option value="priceLow">Price: Low to High</option>
          <option value="priceHigh">Price: High to Low</option>
          <option value="rating">Top Rated</option>
        </select>

        <input
          type="number"
          placeholder="Min ₹"
          value={minPrice}
          onChange={(e) => setMinPrice(e.target.value)}
          className="h-9 w-24 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 px-2 text-sm"
        />
        <span className="text-gray-400">-</span>
        <input
          type="number"
          placeholder="Max ₹"
          value={maxPrice}
          onChange={(e) => setMaxPrice(e.target.value)}
          className="h-9 w-24 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 px-2 text-sm"
        />

        <button
          onClick={() => { setSort("popular"); setMinPrice(""); setMaxPrice(""); }}
          className="ml-auto text-xs font-semibold text-red-500 hover:underline"
        >
          Clear All
        </button>
      </div>

      {hasFilters && (
        <p className="mb-3 text-[12.5px] text-gray-500">
          Showing {products.length} of {total} products
        </p>
      )}

      {/* PRODUCT GRID — scrolls; no numbered pager (matches the ref's mobile listing) */}
      {products.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-10 text-center">
          <p className="text-gray-500">No products found matching criteria.</p>
          <button
            onClick={() => { setSort("popular"); setMinPrice(""); setMaxPrice(""); }}
            className="mt-2 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-[#1a1a2e] hover:underline"
          >
            Clear filters
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5">
          {products.map((p) => (
            <Link key={p.id} href={`/product/${p.slug}`} className="group card overflow-hidden transition-all hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg">
              <div className="relative aspect-square bg-gray-50 p-2">
                <Image src={p.image} alt={p.name} fill sizes="(max-width: 640px) 50vw, 20vw" className="object-contain mix-blend-multiply transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-105" />
                {p.discountPercent >= 20 && (
                  <span className="absolute left-2 top-2 rounded bg-green-600 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-white shadow-sm">
                    {p.discountPercent}% OFF
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1 p-3">
                <p className="line-clamp-2 h-10 text-[13px] font-medium leading-tight text-gray-800">{p.name}</p>
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900">₹{p.salePrice.toLocaleString("en-IN")}</span>
                  {p.mrp > p.salePrice && (
                    <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 line-through">₹{p.mrp.toLocaleString("en-IN")}</span>
                  )}
                </div>
                {p.ratingAvg > 0 && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-gray-500">
                    <span className="rounded bg-green-600 px-1 py-0.5 font-bold text-white">{p.ratingAvg.toFixed(1)} ★</span>
                    <span>({p.ratingCount})</span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </Link>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\product\ProductPurchasePanel.tsx
============================================================

"use client";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Bell, Loader2, ShoppingCart, Zap } from "lucide-react";
import { useCart } from "@/context/CartContext";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";

export type PurchaseProduct = {
  id: string; slug: string; name: string; brand: string; category: string;
  subtype: string | null; hidePrice?: boolean; mrp: number; salePrice: number;
  discountPercent: number; stock: number; lowStockAt: number; ratingAvg: number;
  ratingCount: number; warrantyMonths: number; returnableDays: number;
  emiEligible: boolean; codEligible: boolean; exchangeEligible: boolean;
  ram: string | null; storage: string | null; screenSize: string | null;
  processor: string | null; color: string | null; shortDescription: string | null;
};

function useBuyHandlers(id: string, name: string) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { add } = useCart();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<null | "cart" | "buy">(null);
  async function addToCart() {
    setBusy("cart");
    await add(id, 1);
    setBusy(null);
    toast.push({ title: "Added to cart", body: name });
  }
  async function buyNow() {
    setBusy("buy");
    await add(id, 1);
    router.push(`/checkout?buy=${encodeURIComponent(id)}&upsell=1`);
  }
  return { busy, addToCart, buyNow };
}

/**
 * Purchase bar. Mobile: fixed to the *visible* bottom (a JS pin cancels the
 * Android URL-bar collapse so it can't bob) and promoted to its own GPU layer
 * (max-md:will-change-transform) so it can't tear mid-scroll.
 * Desktop (md+): sticky to the viewport bottom INSIDE the buy-box column, so its
 * width equals that column and it releases/scrolls away when the buybox ends.
 * Out of stock: the two CTAs collapse into a single Flipkart-blue Notify Me.
 */
export function ProductBuyBar({ id, name, salePrice, stock }: {
  id: string; name: string; salePrice: number; stock: number;
}) {
  const { busy, addToCart, buyNow } = useBuyHandlers(id, name);
  const toast = useToast();
  const out = stock <= 0;
  const barRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Pin to the visible bottom on mobile: recompute the bar's offset on every
  // visual-viewport change (toolbar show/hide, keyboard) via rAF, so the
  // layout-vs-visual desync that makes a fixed bottom-0 bar bob is cancelled
  // frame-for-frame. translate3d also forces the GPU layer (kills scroll-tear).
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = barRef.current;
    const vv = window.visualViewport;
    if (!el || !vv) return;
    const mq = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 767px)");
    let raf = 0;
    const apply = () => {
      raf = 0;
      if (!mq.matches) { el.style.transform = ""; return; } // desktop = sticky, leave alone
      const gap = window.innerHeight - (vv.height + vv.offsetTop); // chrome covering the bottom
      el.style.transform = `translate3d(0, ${-gap}px, 0)`;
    };
    const schedule = () => { if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(apply); };
    apply();
    vv.addEventListener("resize", schedule);
    vv.addEventListener("scroll", schedule);
    mq.addEventListener("change", schedule);
    return () => {
      if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      vv.removeEventListener("resize", schedule);
      vv.removeEventListener("scroll", schedule);
      mq.removeEventListener("change", schedule);
      el.style.transform = "";
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div ref={barRef} className="fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-40 flex gap-2 border-t border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 pt-2.5 pb-[max(0.625rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] shadow-[0_-2px_12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] max-md:will-change-transform md:sticky md:inset-x-auto md:bottom-0 md:z-30 md:mt-6 md:rounded-t-xl md:border-x md:border-t md:px-3 md:pt-2.5 md:pb-2.5 md:shadow-[0_-4px_16px_rgba(0,0,0,0.10)]">
      {out ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() =>
            toast.push({ title: "We'll notify you", body: "You'll be alerted the moment this is back in stock." })
          }
          className="inline-flex h-12 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#1a1a2e] text-[14px] font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-[#1f5fc9]"
        >
          <Bell className="size-4" />
          Notify Me
        </button>
      ) : (
        <>
          <button type="button" onClick={addToCart} disabled={busy !== null}
            className="inline-flex h-12 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-ink-900 text-[14px] font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-electric-600 disabled:opacity-50">
            {busy === "cart" ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : <ShoppingCart className="size-4" />}
            Add to Cart
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={buyNow} disabled={busy !== null}
            className="inline-flex h-12 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-offer text-[14px] font-bold text-white transition-all hover:brightness-105 disabled:opacity-50">
            {busy === "buy" ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : <Zap className="size-4" />}
            Buy now at ₹{Number(salePrice).toLocaleString("en-IN")}
          </button>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Inline buy-box content: stock status only (the bar moved to ProductBuyBar). */
export function ProductPurchasePanel(product: PurchaseProduct) {
  const out = product.stock <= 0;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {out ? (
        <p className="rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-bold text-flame-600">
          Out of stock. Check back soon or browse similar styles below.
        </p>
      ) : product.stock <= product.lowStockAt ? (
        <p className="rounded-xl bg-amber-offer/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-bold text-amber-700">
          Only {product.stock} left — grab your size!
        </p>
      ) : (
        <p className="rounded-xl bg-mint-500/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-bold text-emerald-700">
          In stock · {product.stock} available
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default ProductPurchasePanel;

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, MessageCircleQuestion, Send } from "lucide-react";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";

// Matches the VM page.tsx builds from the real rows (content column is `body`, not `text`;
// relations are flattened to asker/author/official so this file needs no `user` join).
type Answer = { id: string; body: string; author: string; official: boolean; at: string };
type Question = { id: string; body: string; askedAt: string; asker: string; answers: Answer[] };

export function QASection({ productId, questions: initial }: { productId: string; questions: Question[] }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(true);
  const [askOpen, setAskOpen] = useState(false);
  const [list, setList] = useState<Question[]>(initial);
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const toast = useToast();

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault(); setBusy(true); setErr(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/questions`, {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        // content field is `body` to match the column / read VM.
        // If a posted question comes back blank, your endpoint maps the other way -> change this one key to `text`.
        body: JSON.stringify({ body: text.trim() }),
      });
      const json = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || json.ok === false) throw new Error(json?.error || "Could not post");
      const created = json.question ?? json.data?.question;
      if (created) setList((l) => [created, ...l]);
      setAskOpen(false); setText("");
      toast.push({ title: "Question posted", body: "We'll notify you when it's answered." });
    } catch (e2) { setErr(e2 instanceof Error ? e2.message : "Save failed"); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white">
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)} aria-expanded={open}
        className="flex w-full items-center justify-between px-4 py-3.5 text-left">
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-gray-900"><MessageCircleQuestion className="size-4 text-gray-400" /> Questions &amp; answers</span>
        <ChevronDown className={`size-5 text-gray-500 transition-transform ${open ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div className="border-t border-gray-100 px-4 pb-4 pt-3">
          {list.length ? (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {list.slice(0, 8).map((q) => (
                <div key={q.id} className="rounded-xl border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50/60 p-3">
                  <p className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-gray-900">Q: {q.body}</p>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-gray-400">{q.asker} · {new Date(q.askedAt).toLocaleDateString()}</div>

                  {q.answers.length ? (
                    <div className="mt-2 space-y-2 border-t border-gray-100 pt-2">
                      {q.answers.map((a) => (
                        <div key={a.id}>
                          <p className="text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-gray-700">A: {a.body}</p>
                          <div className="mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-gray-400">
                            <span className="font-medium text-gray-600">{a.author}</span>
                            {a.official ? <span className="rounded bg-[#1a1a2e]/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-[#1a1a2e]">Seller</span> : null}
                            <span>· {new Date(a.at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <p className="mt-2 text-[12px] text-gray-400">No answer yet.</p>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p className="py-1 text-[12.5px] text-gray-400">No questions yet.</p>
          )}

          {!askOpen ? (
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setAskOpen(true)}
              className="mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-[13px] font-semibold text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-400">
              Ask a question
            </button>
          ) : (
            <form onSubmit={submit} className="mt-3 space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/60 p-3">
              <p className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-gray-700">Ask a question</p>
              <textarea value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} required placeholder="Example: Does this support 5G in India? Is installation included?" className="min-h-[72px] w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-200 px-2 py-1.5 text-[13px] outline-none focus:border-gray-400" />
              {err ? <p role="alert" className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-flame-600">{err}</p> : null}
              <button type="submit" disabled={busy} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-gray-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-[13px] font-bold text-white hover:bg-gray-700 disabled:opacity-50">
                <Send className="size-4" /> {busy ? "Posting…" : "Post question"}
              </button>
            </form>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default QASection;

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { ProductCarousel, type CarouselItem } from "@/components/product/ProductCarousel";

const KEY = "uv:recent:v1";

/**
 * Recently Viewed rail, placed after "You might be interested in".
 * - Account history (serverItems) wins when present.
 * - Otherwise renders the device-local history maintained on every PDP view,
 *   starting with the product being viewed — so logged-out mobile shows it too.
 * - Tolerates a missing/undefined `current` instead of silently rendering nothing.
 */
export function RecentlyViewedRail({ current, serverItems, eta }: {
  current?: CarouselItem | null;
  serverItems: CarouselItem[];
  eta?: string;
}) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<CarouselItem[]>(serverItems ?? []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (serverItems && serverItems.length > 0) return; // account history is the truth
    try {
      const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(KEY);
      const stored: CarouselItem[] = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
      const history = current
        ? [current, ...stored.filter((s) => s.id !== current.id)]
        : stored;
      const capped = history.slice(0, 10);
      if (current) window.localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(capped));
      if (capped.length > 0) setItems(capped);
    } catch {
      /* private mode / corrupt storage: leave whatever we had */
    }
  }, [current, serverItems]);

  if (items.length === 0) return null;
  return <ProductCarousel title="Recently Viewed" items={items} eta={eta} />;
}

export default RecentlyViewedRail;

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";

type Item = {
  slug?: string;
  id?: string;
  name?: string;
  image?: string;
  price?: number;
  mrp?: number;
  discountPercent?: number;
};

export function RelatedTicker({ items }: { items: Item[] }) {
  const [idx, setIdx] = useState(0);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (paused || items.length < 2) return;
    const t = setInterval(() => setIdx((i) => (i + 1) % items.length), 3000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [paused, items.length]);

  if (!items.length) return null;
  const it = items[idx % items.length] as any;
  const href = `/product/${it.slug ?? it.id}`;
  const price = Number(it.price ?? it.salePrice ?? 0);
  const mrp = Number(it.mrp ?? price);
  const off = Number(
    it.discountPercent ?? (mrp > price ? Math.round(((mrp - price) / mrp) * 100) : 0),
  );

  return (
    <div
      className="container-x pt-3"
      onMouseEnter={() => setPaused(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => setPaused(false)}
      aria-label="Similar products"
    >
      <Link
        key={idx}
        href={href}
        className="flex animate-[ticker-in_0.45s_ease] items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border bg-white px-3 py-2 shadow-sm transition-colors hover:bg-gray-50"
      >
        {it.image ? (
          // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
          <img src={it.image} alt="" className="size-10 shrink-0 rounded object-cover" />
        ) : (
          <span className="grid size-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded bg-gray-100 text-xs font-black text-gray-500">
            {String(it.name ?? "V").charAt(0)}
          </span>
        )}
        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <span className="block truncate text-[13px] font-semibold text-gray-900">{it.name}</span>
          <span className="block text-xs">
            {off > 0 && <span className="font-bold text-green-600">↓{off}% </span>}
            <span className="font-black text-gray-900">₹{price.toLocaleString("en-IN")}</span>
            {mrp > price && (
              <span className="ml-1 text-gray-400 line-through">₹{mrp.toLocaleString("en-IN")}</span>
            )}
          </span>
        </span>
        <span className="rounded bg-gray-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-500">
          Similar
        </span>
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
}

type Props = { urls: string[]; max?: number };

export function ReviewPhotoMosaic({ urls, max = 5 }: Props) {
  const list = (urls ?? []).filter(Boolean);
  if (list.length < 2) return null;
  const shown = list.slice(0, max);
  const extra = list.length - shown.length;
  return (
    <div className="grid auto-rows-[120px] grid-cols-3 gap-2 pb-3 md:auto-rows-[140px]">
      {shown.map((u, i) => (
        <div key={u + i} className={`relative overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-gray-100 ${i === 0 ? "row-span-2" : ""}`}>
          {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
          <img src={u} alt="" loading="lazy" className="size-full object-cover" />
          {i === shown.length - 1 && extra > 0 ? (
            <span className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center bg-black/45 text-[15px] font-bold text-white">+{extra}</span>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { BadgeCheck, ChevronDown, Star, ThumbsUp, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toaster";
import { ImageUploadButton } from "@/components/admin/ImageUploadButton";
import { ReviewPhotoMosaic } from "@/components/product/ReviewPhotoMosaic";

// Matches the VM page.tsx builds from the real rows (column is `body`, not `text`).
type Review = {
  id: string;
  rating: number;
  title: string | null;
  body: string;
  images: string[];
  author: string;
  verified: boolean;
  at: string;
  helpful: number;
};

// Optional per-aspect averages (Camera/Battery/…). Rendered only when supplied, so we
// never fabricate numbers — they appear once the schema + form carry aspect scores.
type AspectChip = { label: string; score: number };

function timeAgo(iso: string): string {
  const d = Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime();
  const m = Math.floor(d / 60000);
  if (m < 1) return "just now";
  if (m < 60) return `${m} min ago`;
  const h = Math.floor(m / 60); if (h < 24) return `${h} hr${h === 1 ? "" : "s"} ago`;
  const day = Math.floor(h / 24); if (day < 7) return `${day} day${day === 1 ? "" : "s"} ago`;
  const wk = Math.floor(day / 7); if (wk < 5) return `${wk} week${wk === 1 ? "" : "s"} ago`;
  const mo = Math.floor(day / 30); if (mo < 12) return `${mo} month${mo === 1 ? "" : "s"} ago`;
  const yr = Math.floor(day / 365); return `${yr} year${yr === 1 ? "" : "s"} ago`;
}

export function ReviewsSection({ productId, reviews, ratingAvg = 0, ratingCount = 0, aspectChips }: {
  productId: string; reviews: Review[]; ratingAvg?: number; ratingCount?: number; aspectChips?: AspectChip[];
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(true);
  const [showAll, setShowAll] = useState(false);
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [list, setList] = useState<Review[]>(reviews);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [rating, setRating] = useState(5);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [formImages, setFormImages] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const toast = useToast();

  const avg = ratingAvg || (list.length ? list.reduce((s, r) => s + r.rating, 0) / list.length : 0);
  const count = ratingCount || list.length;
  const band = avg >= 4.5 ? "Excellent" : avg >= 4 ? "Very Good" : avg >= 3 ? "Good" : avg >= 2 ? "Average" : avg > 0 ? "Poor" : "";
  const bandCls = avg >= 4 ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700" : avg >= 3 ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700" : "bg-flame-500/10 text-flame-600";

  const photoUrls = Array.from(new Set(list.flatMap((r) => r.images || []))).filter(Boolean);
  const visible = showAll ? list : list.slice(0, 12);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault(); setBusy(true); setErr(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/reviews`, {
        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        // body field is `body` to match the column / read VM / create route.
        body: JSON.stringify({ rating, title: title.trim(), body: text.trim(), images: formImages }),
      });
      const json = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || json.ok === false) throw new Error(json?.error || "Could not publish");
      const created = json.review ?? json.data?.review;
      if (created) setList((l) => [created, ...l]);
      setShowForm(false); setTitle(""); setText(""); setRating(5); setFormImages([]);
      toast.push({ title: "Review published", body: "Thanks for the feedback." });
    } catch (e2) { setErr(e2 instanceof Error ? e2.message : "Save failed"); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white">
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)} aria-expanded={open}
        className="flex w-full items-center justify-between px-4 py-3.5 text-left">
        <span className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-gray-900">Ratings &amp; reviews</span>
        <ChevronDown className={`size-5 text-gray-500 transition-transform ${open ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div className="border-t border-gray-100 px-4 pb-4 pt-3">
          {/* Score row — image 5: big number + green star + tone pill, then verified-buyers line */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-[22px] font-bold leading-none text-gray-900">{avg.toFixed(1)}</span>
            <Star className="size-4 fill-emerald-500 text-emerald-500" />
            {band ? <span className={`rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${bandCls}`}>{band}</span> : null}
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1 text-[12.5px] text-gray-500">
            based on {count.toLocaleString("en-IN")} rating{count === 1 ? "" : "s"} by{" "}
            <BadgeCheck className="size-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> Verified Buyers
          </p>

          {/* Customer photo mosaic (embedded here, was a standalone block) */}
          <div className="mt-3">
            <ReviewPhotoMosaic urls={photoUrls} />
          </div>

          {/* Per-aspect chips — rendered only when real data is supplied (never faked) */}
          {aspectChips && aspectChips.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pb-3">
              {aspectChips.map((c) => (
                <span key={c.label} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-2.5 py-1 text-[12px] text-gray-700">
                  {c.label}
                  <span className="font-bold text-gray-900">{c.score.toFixed(1)}</span>
                  <Star className="size-3 fill-emerald-500 text-emerald-500" />
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {list.length ? (
            <>
              <div className="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-1 [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden">
                {visible.map((r) => (
                  <article key={r.id} className="min-w-[260px] max-w-[260px] shrink-0 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-3">
                    <div className="mb-1 flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11.5px] font-bold text-emerald-700">
                          {r.rating} <Star className="size-3 fill-emerald-600 text-emerald-600" />
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-gray-900">{r.title || "Review"}</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="shrink-0 text-[11px] text-gray-400">{timeAgo(r.at)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="line-clamp-3 text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-gray-700">{r.body}</p>
                    <div className="mt-2 flex items-end justify-between gap-2 text-[11.5px]">
                      <span className="min-w-0">
                        <span className="block truncate font-medium text-gray-600">{r.author}</span>
                        {r.verified ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-emerald-600"><BadgeCheck className="size-3" /> Verified Buyer</span>
                        ) : null}
                      </span>
                      {r.helpful > 0 ? (
                        <span className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-0.5 text-gray-500"><ThumbsUp className="size-3.5" /> {r.helpful.toLocaleString("en-IN")}</span>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                  </article>
                ))}
              </div>
              {list.length > 12 && (
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowAll((x) => !x)}
                  className="mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[13px] font-semibold text-[#1a1a2e] hover:underline">
                  {showAll ? "Show fewer reviews" : "Show all reviews"} <ChevronDown className={`size-4 transition-transform ${showAll ? "rotate-180" : "-rotate-90"}`} />
                </button>
              )}
            </>
          ) : (
            <p className="py-2 text-[12.5px] text-gray-400">No reviews yet. Be the first to review.</p>
          )}

          {!showForm ? (
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowForm(true)}
              className="mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-[13px] font-semibold text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-400">
              <Star className="size-4" /> Write a review
            </button>
          ) : (
            <form onSubmit={submit} className="mt-3 space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50/60 p-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px]"><span className="font-semibold text-gray-700">Rating</span>
                <select value={rating} onChange={(e) => setRating(Number(e.target.value))} className="h-8 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white px-2 text-[13px]">
                  {[5,4,3,2,1].map((n) => <option key={n} value={n}>{n} ★</option>)}
                </select></div>
              <input value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder="Title (optional)" className="h-9 w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-200 px-2 text-[13px] outline-none focus:border-gray-400" />
              <textarea value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} required placeholder="What did you like or dislike? How was delivery and product quality?" className="min-h-[80px] w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-200 px-2 py-1.5 text-[13px] outline-none focus:border-gray-400" />

              {/* Photo upload — reuses the same ImageUploadButton the gallery/showcase editors use */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-gray-600">Photos (optional, up to 5)</span>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  {formImages.map((src, k) => (
                    <span key={k} className="relative">
                      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                      <img src={src} alt="" className="size-14 rounded-md border border-gray-200 object-cover" />
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => setFormImages((a) => a.filter((_, i) => i !== k))} aria-label="Remove photo"
                        className="absolute -right-1.5 -top-1.5 grid size-5 place-items-center rounded-full bg-gray-900 text-white hover:bg-flame-600">
                        <X className="size-3" />
                      </button>
                    </span>
                  ))}
                  {formImages.length < 5 && (
                    <ImageUploadButton onUploaded={(url) => setFormImages((a) => [...a, url])} />
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {err ? <p role="alert" className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-flame-600">{err}</p> : null}
              <button type="submit" disabled={busy} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-gray-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-[13px] font-bold text-white hover:bg-gray-700 disabled:opacity-50">
                <Star className="size-4" /> {busy ? "Publishing…" : "Publish review"}

      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";

export type ComboItem = { name?: string | null; image?: string | null; price?: number | null; slug?: string | null };
export type ComboPair = { primary: ComboItem; addOn: ComboItem };

const inr = (n?: number | null) =>
  typeof n === "number" && Number.isFinite(n) ? `₹${n.toLocaleString("en-IN")}` : "—";

export function SaveCombos({ pairs }: { pairs: ComboPair[] }) {
  if (!pairs.length) return null;
  return (
    <section className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4">

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { ArrowLeft, X } from "lucide-react";

/**
 * Showcase viewer, responsive by design:
 *  - MOBILE (<md): full-screen opaque "← Product Details" sheet (Fade in). UNCHANGED.
 *  - DESKTOP (>=md): right-side drawer (~28rem) over a dimmed backdrop, slides in from
 *    the right, closed by an ✕ — matching Flipkart's desktop "Product Details" panel.
 *
 * Both variants are always in the DOM but exactly one is `display:none` at a time
 * (`md:hidden` / `hidden md:block`), so there is no matchMedia/hydration flash and the
 * hidden branch is absent from the accessibility tree. Shared state (open/onClose/images)
 * and the Esc + body-scroll-lock behaviour are identical across breakpoints.
 */
export function ShowCaseDrawer({ images, open, onClose, title = "Product Details" }: {
  images: string[];
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title?: string;
}) {
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) { setShown(false); return; }
    const r = requestAnimationFrame(() => setShown(true));
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === "Escape") onClose(); };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    const prevOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(r);
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      document.body.style.overflow = prevOverflow;
    };
  }, [open, onClose]);

  if (!open) return null;
  const list = Array.isArray(images) ? images.filter(Boolean) : [];

  // One banner stack, reused by both layouts so the image rendering never diverges.
  const stack = list.length === 0 ? (
    <p className="p-6 text-center text-[13px] text-gray-500">No showcase images yet.</p>
  ) : (
    <div className="flex flex-col">
      {list.map((url, i) => (
        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
        <img key={url + i} src={url} alt={`Showcase ${i + 1}`}
          className="block h-auto w-full select-none" draggable={false} loading={i === 0 ? "eager" : "lazy"} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <>
      {/* MOBILE — full-screen sheet (exactly the previous behaviour, + md:hidden) */}
      <div
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-label={title}
        className={`fixed inset-0 z-[80] flex flex-col bg-white transition-opacity duration-200 md:hidden ${
          shown ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0"
        }`}
      >
        <header className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-3 bg-[#1a1a2e] px-3 py-3 text-white">
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Back"
            className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-full transition-colors hover:bg-white/15">
            <ArrowLeft className="size-5" />
          </button>
          <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold">{title}</h2>
        </header>
        <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain bg-white">{stack}</div>
      </div>

      {/* DESKTOP — backdrop + right drawer that slides in from the edge */}
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[80] hidden md:block" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={title}>
        <div
          onClick={onClose}
          className={`absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 transition-opacity duration-200 ${
            shown ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0"
          }`}
        />
        <aside
          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          className={`absolute right-0 top-0 flex h-full w-[28rem] max-w-[92vw] flex-col bg-white shadow-2xl transition-transform duration-300 ease-out ${
            shown ? "translate-x-0" : "translate-x-full"
          }`}
        >
          <header className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-3 bg-[#1a1a2e] px-4 py-3 text-white">
            <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close"
              className="grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full transition-colors hover:bg-white/15">
              <X className="size-5" />
            </button>
            <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold">{title}</h2>
          </header>
          <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain bg-white">{stack}</div>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

export function SizeChart({ subtype, garment, productName, images = [] }: Props) {
  const key = garment ?? garmentForSubtype(subtype);
  const chart = key ? SIZE_CHARTS[key] : undefined;

  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [unit, setUnit] = useState<"cm" | "in">("cm");
  const [idx, setIdx] = useState(0);

  const imgs = useMemo(() => images.filter(Boolean), [images]);
  const prev = useCallback(() => setIdx((i) => (imgs.length ? (i - 1 + imgs.length) % imgs.length : 0)), [imgs.length]);
  const next = useCallback(() => setIdx((i) => (imgs.length ? (i + 1) % imgs.length : 0)), [imgs.length]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === "Escape" && setOpen(false);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    const prevOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      document.body.style.overflow = prevOverflow;
    };
  }, [open]);

  if (!chart || chart.rows.length === 0) return null;

  const fmt = (cm: number) => (unit === "cm" ? cm : toInches(cm));
  const unitCols = new Set(chart.unitCols ?? chart.columns.map((_, i) => i));

  return (
    <>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => { setIdx(0); setOpen(true); }}
        className="text-[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-900 underline underline-offset-4 hover:text-gray-500"
      >
        Size Chart
      </button>

      {open && chart && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-6" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Size chart">
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/50" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} />

          <div className="relative z-10 flex max-h-[92vh] w-full max-w-5xl flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-white shadow-2xl">
            <div className="border-b border-gray-200 px-5 py-3 text-center">
              <p className="line-clamp-1 text-[13px] font-semibold text-gray-900">
                {productName ? `${productName} — ` : ""}Size Charts
              </p>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} aria-label="Close"
                className="absolute right-3 top-3 grid size-8 place-items-center rounded-full text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-100">
                <X className="size-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="grid min-h-0 flex-1 grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2">
              <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-50 p-4">
                {imgs.length > 0 ? (
                  <>
                    {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                    <img src={imgs[idx]} alt="Garment" className="max-h-[70vh] w-auto object-contain" />
                    <button type="button" onClick={prev} aria-label="Previous"
                      className="absolute left-2 top-1/2 grid size-9 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded bg-black/40 text-white hover:bg-black/60">
                      <ChevronLeft className="size-5" />
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" onClick={next} aria-label="Next"
                      className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 grid size-9 -translate-y-1/2 place-items-center rounded bg-black/40 text-white hover:bg-black/60">
                      <ChevronRight className="size-5" />
                    </button>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <div className="grid h-[40vh] w-full place-items-center text-[12px] text-gray-400">No preview image</div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="min-h-0 overflow-y-auto px-5 py-4">
                <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setUnit("cm")}
                    className={unit === "cm" ? "text-emerald-600 underline underline-offset-4" : "text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"}>cm</button>
                  <span className="text-gray-300">|</span>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setUnit("in")}
                    className={unit === "in" ? "text-emerald-600 underline underline-offset-4" : "text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"}>inches</button>
                </div>

                <table className="w-full border-collapse text-[12.5px]">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-gray-200 text-[10.5px] uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500">
                      <th className="py-2 pl-1 text-left font-bold">{chart.sizeHeader ?? "Size"}</th>
                      {chart.columns.map((c) => (
                        <th key={c} className="py-2 text-center font-bold">{c}</th>
                      ))}
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {chart.rows.map((r) => (
                      <tr key={r.size} className="border-b border-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-50">
                        <td className="py-2 pl-1 font-bold text-gray-900">{r.size}</td>
                        {r.cm.map((v, i) => (
                          <td key={i} className="py-2 text-center tabular-nums text-gray-700">
                            {unitCols.has(i) ? fmt(v) : v}
                          </td>
                        ))}
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>

                <div className="mt-4 flex justify-center text-gray-900">
                  <BrandLogo emblemClass="size-10" wordmarkClass="text-[13px]" taglineClass="text-[6.5px]" />
                </div>

                <div className="mt-3 space-y-8">
                  <div>
                    <p className="mb-2 text-center text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-gray-500">Front view</p>
                    <Diagram kind={chart.diagram} />
                  </div>
                  {chart.diagram === "shirt" && (
                    <div>
                      <p className="mb-2 text-center text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-gray-500">Back view</p>
                      <ShirtBackDiagram />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {chart.howTo && chart.howTo.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="mt-6">
                    <p className="text-[12px] font-bold text-gray-900">How to Measure:</p>
                    <ol className="mt-2 list-decimal space-y-1.5 pl-5 text-[11.5px] leading-relaxed text-gray-700">
                      {chart.howTo.map((s) => (
                        <li key={s}>{s}</li>
                      ))}
                    </ol>
                    {chart.tip && (
                      <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] italic leading-relaxed text-gray-500">
                        💡 Tip: {chart.tip}
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

export default SizeChart;

export type Spec = {
  group: string;
  label: string;
  value: string;
};

export function SpecsTable({ specifications }: { specifications: Spec[] }) {
  if (!specifications.length) return null;

  const grouped = specifications.reduce<Record<string, Spec[]>>((acc, spec) => {
    acc[spec.group] ??= [];
    acc[spec.group]?.push(spec);
    return acc;
  }, {});

  return (
    <section className="card overflow-hidden">
      <header className="border-b border-hairline px-4 py-3">
        <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">Specifications</h2>
      </header>

      <div className="divide-y divide-hairline">
        {Object.entries(grouped).map(([group, rows]) => (
          <div key={group} className="p-4">
            <h3 className="mb-2.5 text-[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">
              {group}
            </h3>

            <dl className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div
                  key={`${r.group}-${r.label}`}
                  className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg bg-canvas px-3 py-2"
                >
                  <dt className="text-[12.5px] text-ink-400">{r.label}</dt>
                  <dd className="text-right text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-ink-900">
                    {r.value}
                  </dd>
                </div>
              ))}
            </dl>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  );

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "framer-motion";

export type AdCandidate = {
  id: string; slug: string; name: string;
  image: string | null; mrp: number; salePrice: number;
};

const ROTATE_MS = 3500;

function hash(seed: string): number {
  let h = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < seed.length; i++) h = (h * 31 + seed.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
  return h;
}

const inr = (n: number) => `₹${Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-IN")}`;

export function SponsoredAdCard({ seed, products }: { seed: string; products: AdCandidate[] }) {
  const list = useMemo(() => (products ?? []).filter(Boolean), [products]);
  const start = useMemo(() => (list.length ? hash(seed) % list.length : 0), [seed, list.length]);
  const [idx, setIdx] = useState(start);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);

  // Advance through the candidates on an interval; pause while hovered/focused so a
  // shopper can actually click the one they're aiming at (real ad behaviour).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (list.length <= 1 || paused) return;
    const t = window.setInterval(() => setIdx((i) => (i + 1) % list.length), ROTATE_MS);
    return () => window.clearInterval(t);
  }, [list.length, paused]);

  if (list.length === 0) return null;
  const ad = list[idx] ?? list[0]!;
  const d = ad.mrp > ad.salePrice ? Math.round(((ad.mrp - ad.salePrice) / ad.mrp) * 100) : 0;

  return (
    <div
      className="relative min-h-[76px] overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white"
      onMouseEnter={() => setPaused(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => setPaused(false)}
      onFocusCapture={() => setPaused(true)}
      onBlurCapture={() => setPaused(false)}
    >
      {/* Static AD tag — never rotates, exactly like the reference. */}
      <span className="pointer-events-none absolute right-2 top-2 z-10 rounded bg-gray-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-500">
        Ad
      </span>

      {/* Whole card is one clickable link to the currently-shown product. */}
      <Link href={`/product/${ad.slug}`} className="absolute inset-0 z-20" aria-label={`Sponsored: ${ad.name}`} />

      {/* Rotating content: thumb + name + price row, slide-faded on each swap. */}
      <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
        <motion.div
          key={ad.id}
          initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 18 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -18 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.32, ease: "easeOut" }}
          className="flex items-center gap-3 p-2.5 pr-12"
        >
          <span className="size-14 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-md bg-gray-50">
            {ad.image ? (
              // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
              <img src={ad.image} alt={ad.name} className="size-full object-contain" />
            ) : (
              <span className="grid size-full place-items-center bg-gray-100 text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400">
                {ad.name.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
              </span>
            )}
          </span>
          <span className="min-w-0">
            <span className="block truncate text-[12.5px] font-medium text-gray-800">{ad.name}</span>
            <span className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-1.5">
              {d > 0 && <span className="text-[11.5px] font-bold text-emerald-600">↓{d}%</span>}
              {d > 0 && <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 line-through">{inr(ad.mrp)}</span>}
              <span className="text-[12.5px] font-bold text-gray-900">{inr(ad.salePrice)}</span>
            </span>
          </span>
        </motion.div>
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

export default SponsoredAdCard;

"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";

export type SiblingVariant = {
  label: string;
  add: number;
  mrpAdd?: number;
  available?: boolean;
  note?: string;
};

export type SiblingProduct = {
  id: string; slug: string; name: string;
  color: string | null; storage: string | null; ram: string | null;
  salePrice: number; mrp: number; stock: number; lowStockAt: number;
  image: string | null;
  /** Size rows from the admin "Sizes" editor (variants JSON). */
  variants?: SiblingVariant[] | null;
};

const inr = (n: number) => `₹${Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-IN")}`;
const colorOf = (s: SiblingProduct) => s.color?.trim() || "Default";
const variantKey = (s: SiblingProduct) =>
  [s.storage, s.ram].map((x) => x?.trim()).filter(Boolean).join(" + ") || "Single variant";
const isOut = (s: SiblingProduct) => s.stock <= 0;
const isLow = (s: SiblingProduct) => s.stock > 0 && s.stock <= s.lowStockAt;

export function VariantNavigator({ siblings, currentId }: {
  siblings: SiblingProduct[];
  currentId: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sizeIdx, setSizeIdx] = useState(0);
  const current = siblings.find((s) => s.id === currentId) ?? siblings[0];
  if (!current) return null;

  const colorOrder: string[] = [];
  for (const s of siblings) if (!colorOrder.includes(colorOf(s))) colorOrder.push(colorOf(s));
  const ofColor = (c: string) => siblings.filter((s) => colorOf(s) === c);
  const repOf = (c: string): SiblingProduct => {
    const list = ofColor(c);
    return (
      list.find((s) => variantKey(s) === variantKey(current) && !isOut(s)) ??
      list.find((s) => variantKey(s) === variantKey(current)) ??
      list.find((s) => !isOut(s)) ??
      list[0]!
    );
  };
  const go = (slug: string, id: string) => {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(id);
    router.push(`/product/${slug}`);
  };

  const curColor = colorOf(current);
  const sameColorSiblings = ofColor(curColor);

  // SIZE source of truth = this product's own size variants (admin "Sizes" rows).
  // The fabric+fit sibling cards remain ONLY as a fallback for products with no sizes.
  const sizes = (current.variants ?? []).filter((v) => v && v.label);
  const selIdx = Math.min(sizeIdx, Math.max(0, sizes.length - 1));
  const selSize = sizes[selIdx];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div>
        <p className="mb-2 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-gray-900">
          Selected Color: <span className="font-medium text-gray-700">{curColor}</span>
        </p>
        <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1 [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden">
          {colorOrder.map((c) => {
            const rep = repOf(c);
            const out = ofColor(c).every(isOut);
            const sel = c === curColor;
            return (
              <button key={c} type="button" onClick={() => go(rep.slug, rep.id)} disabled={busy !== null}
                aria-label={c}
                className={`relative size-16 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border-2 bg-gray-50 p-1 transition-colors ${sel ? "border-gray-900" : "border-gray-200 hover:border-gray-400"}`}>
                {rep.image
                  // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                  ? <img src={rep.image} alt={c} className="size-full rounded-lg object-contain" />
                  : <span className="grid size-full place-items-center rounded-lg bg-gray-100 text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-500">{c.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}</span>}
                {out && (
                  <span className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 bg-white/90 py-0.5 text-center text-[8.5px] font-bold text-gray-600">
                    Out of stock
                  </span>
                )}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {sizes.length > 0 ? (
        <div>
          <p className="mb-2 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-gray-900">Select Size:</p>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {sizes.map((v, i) => {
              const avail = v.available !== false;
              const sel = i === selIdx;
              return (
                <button
                  key={`${v.label}-${i}`}
                  type="button"
                  disabled={!avail}
                  onClick={() => setSizeIdx(i)}
                  className={`rounded-lg border px-3.5 py-2 text-[12.5px] font-semibold transition-colors ${
                    sel
                      ? "border-gray-900 bg-white text-gray-900"
                      : avail
                        ? "border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 text-gray-600 hover:border-gray-400"
                        : "border-dashed border-gray-300 bg-gray-50 text-gray-400 line-through"
                  }`}
                >
                  {v.label}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          {selSize && (selSize.add ?? 0) !== 0 && (
            <p className="mt-2 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-gray-700">
              Price for {selSize.label}: {inr(current.salePrice + (selSize.add ?? 0))}
            </p>
          )}
          {selSize && selSize.available === false && (
            <p className="mt-2 text-[11.5px] text-gray-500">{selSize.note || "Unavailable in this size"}</p>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div>
          <p className="mb-2 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-gray-900">
            Size: <span className="font-medium text-gray-700">{variantKey(current)}</span>
          </p>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
            {sameColorSiblings.map((s) => {
              const sel = s.id === current.id;
              const out = isOut(s);
              const d = s.mrp > s.salePrice ? Math.round(((s.mrp - s.salePrice) / s.mrp) * 100) : 0;
              return (
                <button key={s.id} type="button" onClick={() => go(s.slug, s.id)} disabled={busy !== null}
                  className={`rounded-xl border p-2.5 text-left transition-colors ${sel ? "border-gray-900 bg-white" : "border-gray-200 bg-white hover:border-gray-400"}`}>
                  <p className="text-[12px] font-bold text-gray-900">{variantKey(s)}</p>
                  {out ? (
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-orange-500">Out of stock</p>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      {d > 0 && (
                        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-600">
                          ↓{d}% <span className="font-medium text-gray-400 line-through">{inr(s.mrp)}</span>
                        </p>
                      )}
                      <p className="text-[12.5px] font-bold text-gray-900">{inr(s.salePrice)}</p>
                      {isLow(s) && <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-orange-500">{s.stock} left</p>}
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default VariantNavigator;
