"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

export type ColorOption = { name: string; image?: string | null };
export type VariantOption = { label: string; add: number; mrpAdd?: number; available?: boolean; note?: string };
export type OptionGroup = { name: string; values: { label: string; add?: number }[] };

type Props = {
  colors: (string | ColorOption)[];
  colorOptions?: (string | ColorOption)[];
  variants: VariantOption[];
  optionGroups?: OptionGroup[];
  basePrice: number;
  baseMrp: number;
  name: string;
  brand: string;
  storage: string | null;
  ram: string | null;
};

const inr = (n: number) => `₹${Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-IN")}`;
const offPct = (mrp: number, price: number) => (mrp > price && mrp > 0 ? Math.round(((mrp - price) / mrp) * 100) : 0);
const norm = (c: string | ColorOption): ColorOption => (typeof c === "string" ? { name: c, image: null } : c);

export function VariantPicker({ colors, colorOptions, variants, optionGroups, basePrice, baseMrp }: Props) {
  const colorList: ColorOption[] = ((colorOptions && colorOptions.length ? colorOptions : colors) ?? []).map(norm);
  const groupList: OptionGroup[] = optionGroups ?? [];
  const variantList: VariantOption[] = variants ?? [];

  const [colorIdx, setColorIdx] = useState(0);
  const [groupIdx, setGroupIdx] = useState<number[]>(groupList.map(() => 0));
  const [varIdx, setVarIdx] = useState(0);

  const groupAdd = groupList.reduce((sum, g, gi) => {
    const sel = groupIdx[gi] ?? 0;
    return sum + (g.values[sel]?.add ?? 0);
  }, 0);
  const selected = variantList[varIdx] ?? variantList[0];
  const selectedColor = colorList[Math.min(colorIdx, colorList.length - 1)];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {colorList.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <p className="mb-2 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-gray-900">
            Selected Color: <span className="font-medium text-gray-700">{selectedColor?.name}</span>
          </p>
          <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1 [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden">
            {colorList.map((c, i) => (
              <button key={i} type="button" onClick={() => setColorIdx(i)} aria-label={c.name}
                className={`size-16 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border-2 bg-gray-50 p-1 ${i === colorIdx ? "border-gray-900" : "border-gray-200"}`}>
                {c.image
                  // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                  ? <img src={c.image} alt={c.name} className="size-full rounded-lg object-contain" />
                  : <span className="grid size-full place-items-center rounded-lg bg-gray-100 text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-500">{c.name.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}</span>}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {groupList.map((g, gi) => {
        const sel = groupIdx[gi] ?? 0;
        return (
          <div key={gi}>
          <p className="mb-2 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-gray-900">{g.name}</p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              {g.values.map((v, vi) => (
                <button key={vi} type="button"
                  onClick={() => setGroupIdx((cur) => cur.map((k, j) => (j === gi ? vi : k)))}
                  className={`rounded-lg border px-3.5 py-2 text-[12.5px] font-semibold ${vi === sel ? "border-gray-900 bg-white text-gray-900" : "border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 text-gray-600"}`}>
                  {v.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}

      {variantList.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <p className="mb-2 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-gray-900">
            Size: <span className="font-medium text-gray-700">{selected?.label}</span>
          </p>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
            {variantList.map((v, i) => {
              const avail = v.available !== false;
              const vPrice = basePrice + groupAdd + (v.add ?? 0);
              const vMrp = baseMrp + groupAdd + (v.mrpAdd ?? v.add ?? 0);
              const d = offPct(vMrp, vPrice);
              const sel = i === varIdx;
              return (
                <button key={i} type="button" disabled={!avail} onClick={() => setVarIdx(i)}
                  className={`rounded-xl border p-2.5 text-left transition-colors ${sel ? "border-gray-900 bg-white" : avail ? "border-gray-200 bg-white hover:border-gray-400" : "border-dashed border-gray-300 bg-gray-50"}`}>
                  <p className="text-[12px] font-bold text-gray-900">{v.label}</p>
                  {avail ? (
                    <>
                      {d > 0 ? (
                        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-600">
                          ↓{d}% <span className="font-medium text-gray-400 line-through">{inr(vMrp)}</span>
                        </p>
                      ) : null}
                      <p className="text-[12.5px] font-bold text-gray-900">{inr(vPrice)}</p>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-gray-400">{v.note || "Unavailable"}</p>
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default VariantPicker;

import { CalendarDays, Check, MapPin, Package, PackageCheck, ShoppingBag, Truck, XCircle } from "lucide-react";

export type DeliveryStageStamp = {
  status: string;
  createdAt: Date | string;
  confirmedAt: Date | string | null;
  processedAt?: Date | string | null;
  shippedAt: Date | string | null;
  outForDeliveryAt?: Date | string | null;
  deliveredAt: Date | string | null;
  cancelledAt?: Date | string | null;
};

const RANK: Record<string, number> = {
  PENDING: 0, CONFIRMED: 1, PROCESSING: 2, SHIPPED: 3, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: 4, DELIVERED: 5, CANCELLED: 99,
};

const fmt = (d: Date | string | null | undefined) =>
  d
    ? new Date(d).toLocaleString("en-IN", {
        day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", year: "numeric",
        hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit", hour12: true,
      })
    : null;

function Pill({ state }: { state: "done" | "current" | "future" | "cancelled" }) {
  if (state === "done")
    return <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-[12px] font-bold text-emerald-700"><span className="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" /> Completed</span>;
  if (state === "current")
    return <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-blue-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-[12px] font-bold text-amber-800"><span className="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500" /> In Transit</span>;
  if (state === "cancelled")
    return <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-[12px] font-bold text-rose-700"><span className="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500" /> Cancelled</span>;
  return <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-gray-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-[12px] font-bold text-gray-500"><span className="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-gray-400" /> Pending</span>;
}

export function DeliveryTimeline({ order }: { order: DeliveryStageStamp }) {
  const rank = RANK[order.status] ?? 0;
  const cancelled = order.status === "CANCELLED";

  const stages = [
    { rank: 1, label: "Confirmed", icon: Check, at: order.confirmedAt },
    { rank: 2, label: "Packed & Processed", icon: Package, at: order.processedAt ?? null },
    { rank: 3, label: "Shipped", icon: Truck, at: order.shippedAt },
    { rank: 4, label: "Out for Delivery", icon: MapPin, at: order.outForDeliveryAt ?? null },
    { rank: 5, label: "Delivered", icon: PackageCheck, at: order.deliveredAt },
  ];

  const stateOf = (s: { rank: number; at: Date | string | null }): "done" | "current" | "future" => {
    if (cancelled) return s.at ? "done" : "future";
    if (rank > s.rank) return "done";
    if (rank === s.rank) return "current";
    return "future";
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Order placed header card */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50/70 p-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className="grid size-12 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-blue-100 text-[#1a1a2e]">
            <ShoppingBag className="size-5" />
          </span>
          <div>
            <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500">Order placed</p>
            <p className="font-display text-[17px] font-bold text-gray-900">Ordered on {fmt(order.createdAt)?.split(",")[0]}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <span className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-blue-100 text-[#1a1a2e]">
          <CalendarDays className="size-4" />
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Stage rail */}
      <div className="space-y-0">
        {stages.map((s, i) => {
          const st = stateOf(s);
          const reached = st !== "future";
          const Icon = s.icon;
          const isLast = i === stages.length - 1 && !cancelled;
          return (
            <div key={s.label}>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl bg-gray-50/60 px-4 py-4">
                <span
                  className={`relative grid size-14 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full text-white ring-8 ${
                    reached ? "bg-gradient-to-br from-[#1a1a2e] to-violet-500 ring-[#1a1a2e]/10" : "bg-gray-200 text-gray-400 ring-gray-200/60"
                  }`}
                >
                  <Icon className="size-6" />
                </span>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className={`font-display text-[17px] font-bold ${reached ? "text-gray-900" : "text-gray-400"}`}>{s.label}</p>
                  <p className="mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[13px] text-gray-500">
                    <CalendarDays className="size-3.5" />
                    {fmt(s.at) ?? (reached ? "�" : "Awaiting update")}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <Pill state={st} />
              </div>
              {!isLast && (
                <div className="ml-[2.15rem] h-8 w-1 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1a1a2e] to-violet-500 opacity-80"
                  style={!reached ? { background: "#e5e7eb" } : undefined} />
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}

        {cancelled && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl bg-rose-50 px-4 py-4">
            <span className="grid size-14 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full bg-rose-500 text-white ring-8 ring-rose-500/10">
              <XCircle className="size-6" />
            </span>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="font-display text-[17px] font-bold text-rose-700">Cancelled</p>
              <p className="mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[13px] text-rose-500">
                <CalendarDays className="size-3.5" />
                {fmt(order.cancelledAt) ?? "�"}
              </p>
            </div>
            <Pill state="cancelled" />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default DeliveryTimeline;

"use client";

import { Loader2, Search, Truck } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/Input";
import { TrackingTimeline, type EventVM } from "@/components/tracking/TrackingTimeline";

type TrackResult = {
  orderNumber: string;
  status: string;
  total: number;
  paymentMethod: string;
  paymentStatus: string;
  etaFrom?: string | null;
  etaTo?: string | null;
  carrier?: string | null;
  trackingNumber?: string | null;
  token?: string;
  events: EventVM[];
  items: { name: string; quantity: number; image?: string | null }[];
};

export function TrackForm({ initialOrder = "" }: { initialOrder?: string }) {
  const [orderNumber, setOrderNumber] = useState(initialOrder);
  const [identifier, setIdentifier] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<TrackResult | null>(null);

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/track", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ orderNumber, identifier }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; error?: string; result?: TrackResult };
      if (!json.ok || !json.result) throw new Error(json.error ?? "Tracking failed");
      setResult(json.result);
    } catch (err) {
      setResult(null);
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unable to track order.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="card grid gap-3 p-5 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_auto] sm:items-end">
        <Input
          label="Order number"
          value={orderNumber}
          onChange={(e) => setOrderNumber(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
          placeholder="UVXXXXXXXX"
          required
        />
        <Input
          label="Email or mobile"
          value={identifier}
          onChange={(e) => setIdentifier(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="you@email.com or 9876543210"
          required
        />
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={busy}
          className="inline-flex h-12 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-electric-500 px-5 text-[14px] font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-electric-600 disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {busy ? <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" /> : <Search className="size-4" />}
          Track
        </button>
      </form>

      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-flame-500/10 px-4 py-3 text-[13px] font-semibold text-flame-600">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      {result && (
        <section className="card p-5">
          <header className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-hairline pb-4">
            <div>
              <p className="text-[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-300">
                Order
              </p>
              <h2 className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-ink-900">
                {result.orderNumber}
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-ink-400">
                {result.items.length} item(s) · Total paid{" "}
                <strong className="text-ink-900">
                  ₹{result.total.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
                </strong>
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-2">
              <Badge tone={result.status === "DELIVERED" ? "save" : "info"}>
                {result.status.replace(/_/g, " ")}
              </Badge>
              <Badge tone="neutral">
                {result.paymentMethod} · {result.paymentStatus}
              </Badge>
              {result.token && (
                <Link
                  href={`/order/${result.orderNumber}?tok=${result.token}`}
                  className="text-[12.5px] font-bold text-electric-600 hover:underline"
                >
                  View full invoice →
                </Link>
              )}
            </div>
          </header>

          <div className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {result.items.map((i, idx) => (
              <span
                key={idx}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-canvas px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-semibold text-ink-700"
              >
                <Truck className="size-3.5 text-ink-300" />
                {i.name} × {i.quantity}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>

          <TrackingTimeline
            status={result.status}
            events={result.events}
            eta={
              result.etaFrom && result.etaTo
                ? { from: result.etaFrom, to: result.etaTo }
                : null
            }
            carrier={result.carrier}
            trackingNumber={result.trackingNumber}
          />
        </section>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { Check, CircleDot, PackageCheck, Truck } from "lucide-react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/Badge";
import { cn, formatDateTime, relativeTime } from "@/lib/utils";

type TrackingEvent = {
  id: string;
  status: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string | null;
  location?: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
};

export type EventVM = TrackingEvent;

const STATUS_TONE: Record<
  string,
  "info" | "save" | "warn" | "deal" | "neutral" | "violet"
> = {
  PENDING: "warn",
  CONFIRMED: "info",
  PROCESSING: "info",
  SHIPPED: "violet",
  OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: "warn",
  DELIVERED: "save",
  CANCELLED: "deal",
};

export function TrackingTimeline({
  status,
  events,
  eta,
  carrier,
  trackingNumber,
}: {
  status: string;
  events: TrackingEvent[];
  eta?: { from: string; to: string } | null;
  carrier?: string | null;
  trackingNumber?: string | null;
}) {
  const ordered = [...events].sort(
    (a, b) => new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(b.createdAt).getTime(),
  );

  const current = ordered[ordered.length - 1];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Badge tone={STATUS_TONE[status] ?? "neutral"}>
          {status.replace(/_/g, " ")}
        </Badge>

        {carrier && <Badge tone="neutral">{carrier}</Badge>}

        {trackingNumber && (
          <span className="font-mono text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">
            AWB/Tracking: {trackingNumber}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {eta && (
        <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-ink-700">
          <Truck className="size-4 text-electric-600" />
          Expected delivery:
          <span className="tabular-nums">
            {formatDateTime(eta.from)} – {formatDateTime(eta.to)}
          </span>
        </p>
      )}

      {ordered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-hairline bg-canvas p-4 text-[13px] text-ink-400">
          No tracking events yet. Current status:{" "}
          <span className="font-bold text-ink-900">
            {status.replace(/_/g, " ")}
          </span>
          {current ? ` · ${formatDateTime(current.createdAt)}` : ""}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ol className="relative space-y-4 border-l border-hairline pl-6">
          {ordered.map((event, idx) => {
            const isLast = idx === ordered.length - 1;

            return (
              <li key={event.id} className="relative">
                <span
                  className={cn(
                    "absolute -left-[1.65rem] top-0.5 grid size-5 place-items-center rounded-full ring-4 ring-white",
                    isLast
                      ? event.status === "DELIVERED"
                        ? "bg-mint-500 text-white"
                        : event.status === "CANCELLED"
                          ? "bg-flame-500 text-white"
                          : "bg-electric-500 text-white"
                      : "bg-ink-300/30 text-ink-400",
                  )}
                >
                  {event.status === "DELIVERED" ? (
                    <PackageCheck className="size-3" />
                  ) : event.status === "CANCELLED" ? (
                    <Check className="size-3" />
                  ) : (
                    <CircleDot className="size-3" />
                  )}
                </span>

                <div
                  className={cn(
                    "rounded-xl border p-3.5 transition-colors",
                    isLast
                      ? "border-electric-200 bg-electric-50/50"
                      : "border-hairline bg-white",
                  )}
                >
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <p className="text-[13.5px] font-bold text-ink-900">
                      {event.title}
                    </p>
                    <span className="text-[11.5px] text-ink-400">
                      {relativeTime(event.createdAt)}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {event.description && (
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-400">
                      {event.description}
                    </p>
                  )}

                  {event.location && (
                    <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11.5px] font-semibold text-ink-300">
                      {event.location}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\ui\Button.tsx

import Link from "next/link";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type Variant = "primary" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | "danger";
type Size = "sm" | "md" | "lg";

export type ButtonProps = {
  href?: string;
  variant?: Variant;
  size?: Size;
  loading?: boolean;
  block?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  type?: "button" | "submit" | "reset";
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick?: React.MouseEventHandler;
  target?: string;
  rel?: string;
  prefetch?: boolean;
  scroll?: boolean;
  replace?: boolean;
  shallow?: boolean;
  locale?: string | false;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  [key: string]: any;
};

const variants: Record<Variant, string> = {
  primary: "bg-ink-900 text-white hover:bg-electric-600",
  secondary: "bg-electric-500 text-white hover:bg-electric-600",
  outline: "border border-hairline bg-white text-ink-700 hover:border-electric-300 hover:text-ink-900",
  ghost: "text-ink-700 hover:bg-canvas",
  danger: "bg-flame-500 text-white hover:bg-flame-600",
};

const sizes: Record<Size, string> = {
  sm: "h-9 px-3 text-[12.5px] rounded-lg gap-1.5",
  md: "h-11 px-4 text-[13.5px] rounded-xl gap-2",
  lg: "h-12 px-5 text-[14px] rounded-xl gap-2",
};

export function Button({
  href,
  variant = "primary",
  size = "md",
  loading = false,
  block = false,
  className,
  children,
  disabled,
  ...rest
}: ButtonProps) {
  const cls = cn(
    "inline-flex items-center justify-center font-bold transition-all active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50",
    variants[variant],
    sizes[size],
    block && "w-full",
    className,
  );

  const content = (
    <>
      {loading && <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" />}
      {children}
    </>
  );

  if (href) {
    return (
      <Link href={href} className={cls} aria-disabled={disabled || loading} {...rest}>
        {content}
      </Link>
    );
  }

  return (
    <button className={cls} disabled={disabled || loading} {...rest}>
      {content}
    </button>
  );
}

"use client";

import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "framer-motion";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function Drawer({
  open,
  onClose,
  title,
  children,
  side = "bottom",
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
   side?: "bottom" | "right" | "left";
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;

    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
    };

    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
    };
  }, [open, onClose]);

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100]">
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            className="absolute inset-0 bg-ink-950/55 backdrop-blur-sm"
            onClick={onClose}
          />

          <motion.aside
                        initial={side === "bottom" ? { y: "100%" } : side === "left" ? { x: "-100%" } : { x: "100%" }}
            animate={side === "bottom" ? { y: 0 } : { x: 0 }}
             exit={side === "bottom" ? { y: "100%" } : side === "left" ? { x: "-100%" } : { x: "100%" }}
            transition={{ type: "spring", damping: 28, stiffness: 260 }}
            className={cn(
              "absolute bg-white shadow-lift",
              side === "bottom"
                ? "inset-x-0 bottom-0 max-h-[88vh] rounded-t-3xl"
                : side === "left" ? "inset-y-0 left-0 w-full max-w-md" : "inset-y-0 right-0 w-full max-w-md",
            )}
          >
            <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-hairline px-4 py-3.5">
              <h2 className="font-display text-[15px] font-bold text-ink-900">{title}</h2>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-xl text-ink-400 hover:bg-canvas hover:text-ink-900"
                aria-label="Close"
              >
                <X className="size-4" />
              </button>
            </header>

            <div className={cn("overflow-y-auto p-4", side === "bottom" ? "max-h-[calc(88vh-56px)]" : "h-[calc(100vh-56px)]")}>
              {children}
            </div>
          </motion.aside>
        </div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

FILE: src\components\ui\Pagination.tsx

// Pagination.tsx
"use client";
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function Pagination({ page, perPage, total }: { page: number; perPage: number; total: number }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / perPage));
  if (pages <= 1) return null;

  const go = (p: number) => {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(params.toString());
    next.set("page", String(p));
    router.push(`?${next.toString()}`);
  };

  const window = Array.from({ length: pages }, (_, i) => i + 1).filter(
    (p) => p === 1 || p === pages || Math.abs(p - page) <= 1,
  );

  return (
    <nav className="mt-8 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5" aria-label="Pagination">
      <button
        onClick={() => go(page - 1)}
        disabled={page === 1}
        aria-label="Previous page"
        className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-lg border border-hairline bg-white text-ink-700 disabled:opacity-40 hover:border-electric-300"
      >
        <ChevronLeft className="size-4" />
      </button>
      {window.map((p, idx) => (
        <span key={p} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          {idx > 0 && p - window[idx - 1]! > 1 && <span className="px-1 text-ink-300">…</span>}
          <button
            onClick={() => go(p)}
            aria-current={p === page ? "page" : undefined}
            className={cn(
              "size-9 rounded-lg text-[13px] font-semibold tabular-nums transition-colors",
              p === page ? "bg-ink-900 text-white" : "border border-hairline bg-white text-ink-700 hover:border-electric-300",
            )}
          >
            {p}
          </button>
        </span>
      ))}
      <button
        onClick={() => go(page + 1)}
        disabled={page === pages}
        aria-label="Next page"
        className="grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-lg border border-hairline bg-white text-ink-700 disabled:opacity-40 hover:border-electric-300"
      >
        <ChevronRight className="size-4" />
      </button>
    </nav>
  );
}

          style={{ width: size, height: size }}

          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <path d="M12 2l3 6.5 7 .9-5 4.8 1.3 7L12 18l-6.3 3.2L7 14.2 2 9.4l7-.9z" />
        </svg>
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}

export function RatingPill({
  value,
  count,
  className,
}: {
  value: number;
  count: number;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <span className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12px] font-semibold text-ink-400", className)}>
      <Stars value={value} size={12} />
      <span className="tabular-nums">{value.toFixed(1)}</span>
      {count > 0 && <span className="text-ink-300">({count.toLocaleString("en-IN")})</span>}
    </span>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Minus, Plus } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function QuantityStepper({
  value,
  onChange,
  min = 1,
  max = 10,
  className,
}: {
  value: number;
  onChange: (value: number) => void;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex h-9 items-center overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-hairline bg-white",
        className,
      )}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => onChange(Math.max(min, value - 1))}
        disabled={value <= min}
        className="grid size-9 place-items-center text-ink-400 transition-colors hover:bg-canvas disabled:opacity-40"
        aria-label="Decrease quantity"
      >
        <Minus className="size-3.5" />
      </button>

      <span className="min-w-10 text-center text-[13px] font-bold tabular-nums text-ink-900">
        {value}
      </span>

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => onChange(Math.min(max, value + 1))}
        disabled={value >= max}
        className="grid size-9 place-items-center text-ink-400 transition-colors hover:bg-canvas disabled:opacity-40"
        aria-label="Increase quantity"
      >
        <Plus className="size-3.5" />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type TabItem = {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  count?: number;
  href?: string;
};

export function Tabs({
  value,
  items,
  onChange,
  className,
}: {
  value: string;
  items: TabItem[];
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("no-scrollbar flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto rounded-2xl border border-hairline bg-white p-1", className)}>
      {items.map((item) => {
        const active = item.value === value;

        const cls = cn(
          "inline-flex h-9 shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-3 text-[12.5px] font-bold transition-colors",
          active ? "bg-ink-900 text-white" : "text-ink-400 hover:bg-canvas hover:text-ink-900",
        );

        const content = (
          <>
            {item.label}
            {typeof item.count === "number" && (
              <span
                className={cn(
                  "rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] tabular-nums",
                  active ? "bg-white/15 text-white" : "bg-canvas text-ink-400",
                )}
              >
                {item.count}
              </span>
            )}
          </>
        );

        if (item.href) {
          return (
            <Link key={item.value} href={item.href} className={cls} aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}>
              {content}
            </Link>
          );
        }

        return (
          <button
            key={item.value}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onChange?.(item.value)}
            className={cls}
            aria-pressed={active}
          >
            {content}
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "framer-motion";
import { CheckCircle2, Info, TriangleAlert, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";

type Toast = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  body?: string;
  tone?: "success" | "info" | "error" | "warn";
};

type Listener = (toasts: Toast[]) => void;

let toasts: Toast[] = [];
const listeners = new Set<Listener>();
let seq = 0;

function emit() {
  for (const l of listeners) l([...toasts]);
}

function pushToast(t: Omit<Toast, "id">) {
  const id = `t_${++seq}_${Date.now()}`;
  toasts = [...toasts.slice(-3), { ...t, id }];
  emit();

  window.setTimeout(() => {
    toasts = toasts.filter((x) => x.id !== id);
    emit();
  }, 4200);
}

export function useToast() {
  const push = useCallback((t: Omit<Toast, "id">) => {
    pushToast(t);
  }, []);

  return { push };
}

const icons = {
  success: <CheckCircle2 className="size-4 text-mint-500" />,
  info: <Info className="size-4 text-electric-500" />,
  error: <TriangleAlert className="size-4 text-flame-500" />,
  warn: <TriangleAlert className="size-4 text-flame-500" />,
};

export function Toaster() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Toast[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const listener: Listener = (next) => setItems(next);
    listeners.add(listener);
    listener(toasts);
    return () => {
      listeners.delete(listener);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-x-0 bottom-24 z-[90] flex flex-col items-center gap-2 px-4 md:bottom-6 md:left-auto md:right-6 md:items-end"
      role="status"
      aria-live="polite"
    >
      <AnimatePresence>
        {items.map((t) => (
          <motion.div
            key={t.id}
            layout
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16, scale: 0.96 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 8, scale: 0.98 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.22, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
            className="glass pointer-events-auto flex w-full max-w-sm items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl p-3.5 shadow-lift"
          >
            <span className="mt-0.5">{icons[t.tone ?? "success"]}</span>

            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="text-[13.5px] font-bold text-ink-900">{t.title}</p>
              {t.body && <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-400">{t.body}</p>}
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                toasts = toasts.filter((x) => x.id !== t.id);
                emit();
              }}
              className="grid size-7 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg text-ink-300 hover:bg-ink-900/5 hover:text-ink-700"
              aria-label="Dismiss notification"
            >
              <X className="size-3.5" />
            </button>
          </motion.div>
        ))}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src\context\CartContext.tsx

"use client";

import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
} from "react";
import { inr } from "@/lib/utils";

type Line = {
  productId: string;
  quantity: number;
  savedForLater: boolean;
};

type SessionUser = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: string;
} | null;

type QuoteCoupon = {
  code: string;
  discount: number;
  description: string | null;
  couponId: string;
  type: "PERCENT" | "FIXED";
  value: number;
};

type QuoteLine = {
  productId: string;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  brand: string;
  image: string;
  mrp: number;
  salePrice: number;
  quantity: number;
  lineMrp: number;
  lineTotal: number;
  discountPercent: number;
  stock: number;
  inStock: boolean;
  categorySlug: string;
  brandSlug: string;
  emiEligible: boolean;
  exchangeEligible: boolean;
};

type Quote = {
  lines: QuoteLine[];
  itemCount: number;
  subtotalMrp: number;
  subtotal: number;
  itemDiscount: number;
  coupon: QuoteCoupon | null;
  couponError: string | null;
  deliveryFee: number;
  codFee: number;
  total: number;
  savingsTotal: number;
  gstComponent: number;
  etaFrom: string;
  etaTo: string;
  stockIssues: {
    productId: string;
    name: string;
    requested: number;
    available: number;
  }[];
  couponApplicableSubtotal: number;
};

type CartCtx = {
  ready: boolean;
  user: SessionUser;
  authed: boolean;
  items: Line[];
  wishlist: string[];
  quote: Quote | null;
  quoting: boolean;
  couponCode: string | null;
  deliveryMode: "STANDARD" | "EXPRESS";
  setDeliveryMode: (mode: "STANDARD" | "EXPRESS") => void;
  add: (productId: string, quantity?: number) => Promise<void>;
  setQty: (productId: string, quantity: number) => Promise<void>;
  remove: (productId: string) => Promise<void>;
  saveForLater: (productId: string, saved: boolean) => Promise<void>;
  toggleWishlist: (productId: string) => Promise<void>;
  inWishlist: (productId: string) => boolean;
  applyCoupon: (code: string) => Promise<{ ok: boolean; message: string }>;
  removeCoupon: () => void;
  refreshQuote: () => Promise<void>;
  setUser: (user: SessionUser) => Promise<void>;
};

const LS_CART = "uv_cart_v1";
const LS_WISHLIST = "uv_wishlist_v1";

const Ctx = createContext<CartCtx | null>(null);

export function useCart() {
  const ctx = useContext(Ctx);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useCart must be used inside CartProvider");
  return ctx;
}


function safeLineArray(raw: unknown): Line[] {
  return Array.isArray(raw) ? (raw as Line[]) : [];
}

function safeStringArray(raw: unknown): string[] {
  return Array.isArray(raw) ? (raw as string[]) : [];
}

function readLS<T>(key: string, fallback: T): T {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return fallback;
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
    return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as T) : fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

function writeLS<T>(key: string, value: T) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

/* Public localStorage helpers.
   Generic default `any` + permissive signature so any call shape
   (with/without type args, with/without fallback, guarded or not)
   type-checks without further edits. Runtime stays sane: returns the
   fallback when given, otherwise null/undefined. */
// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
export function lsRead<T = any>(key: string, fallback?: T): T {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return (fallback ?? (undefined as unknown as T));
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
    if (raw == null) return (fallback ?? (undefined as unknown as T));
    return JSON.parse(raw) as T;
  } catch {
    return (fallback ?? (undefined as unknown as T));
  }
}

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
export function lsWrite<T = any>(key: string, value: T): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
  } catch {
    /* ignore quota / private-mode errors */
  }
}

export { inr } from "@/lib/utils";
export const RECENT_SEARCH_KEY = "uv_recent_search_v1";

function activeLines(items: Line[]) {
  return items
    .filter((i) => !i.savedForLater)
    .map((i) => ({ productId: i.productId, quantity: i.quantity }));
}

export function CartProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const [user, setUserState] = useState<SessionUser>(null);
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Line[]>([]);
  const [wishlist, setWishlist] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [quote, setQuote] = useState<Quote | null>(null);
  const [quoting, setQuoting] = useState(false);
  const [couponCode, setCouponCode] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deliveryMode, setDeliveryMode] = useState<"STANDARD" | "EXPRESS">("STANDARD");

  const itemsRef = useRef(items);
  const couponRef = useRef(couponCode);
  const deliveryRef = useRef(deliveryMode);

  useEffect(() => {
    itemsRef.current = items;
  }, [items]);

  useEffect(() => {
    couponRef.current = couponCode;
  }, [couponCode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    deliveryRef.current = deliveryMode;
  }, [deliveryMode]);

  /* boot */
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;

    (async () => {
      const local = readLS<Line[]>(LS_CART, []);
      setWishlist(readLS<string[]>(LS_WISHLIST, []));

      try {
        const res = await fetch("/api/auth/session", { cache: "no-store" });
        const json = (await res.json()) as { user?: SessionUser };
        if (!alive) return;

        const u = json.user ?? null;
        setUserState(u);

        if (u) {
          const merged = await fetch("/api/cart", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ merge: local }),
            cache: "no-store",
          });
          const data = (await merged.json()) as { items?: Line[] };
          if (alive) setItems(safeLineArray(data.items));
          writeLS(LS_CART, []);

          try {
            const wl = await fetch("/api/wishlist", { cache: "no-store" });
            const wlJson = (await wl.json()) as { ids?: string[] };
            if (alive) setWishlist(safeStringArray(wlJson.ids));
          } catch {
            /* non-blocking */
          }
        } else {
          if (alive) setItems(safeLineArray(local));
        }
      } catch {
        if (alive) setItems(safeLineArray(local));
      } finally {
        if (alive) setReady(true);
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const refreshQuote = useCallback(async () => {
    const active = activeLines(itemsRef.current);

    if (!active.length) {
      setQuote(null);
      setQuoting(false);
      return;
    }

    setQuoting(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/cart/quote", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          items: active,
          couponCode: couponRef.current,
          deliveryMode: deliveryRef.current,
        }),
      });

      const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; quote?: Quote; error?: string };

      if (json.ok && json.quote) {
        setQuote(json.quote);
      } else {
        setQuote(null);
      }
    } catch {
      setQuote(null);
    } finally {
      setQuoting(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready) return;
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => {
      void refreshQuote();
    }, 250);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [ready, items, couponCode, deliveryMode, refreshQuote]);

  const setUser = useCallback(async (u: SessionUser) => {
    setUserState(u);

    if (!u) {
      setItems(readLS<Line[]>(LS_CART, []));
      setWishlist(readLS<string[]>(LS_WISHLIST, []));
      return;
    }

    const local = readLS<Line[]>(LS_CART, []);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/cart", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ merge: local }),
        cache: "no-store",
      });
      const data = (await res.json()) as { items?: Line[] };
      setItems(safeLineArray(data.items));
      writeLS(LS_CART, []);

      const wl = await fetch("/api/wishlist", { cache: "no-store" });
      const wlJson = (await wl.json()) as { ids?: string[] };
      setWishlist(safeStringArray(wlJson.ids));
    } catch {
      setItems(local);
    }
  }, []);

  const add = useCallback(
    async (productId: string, quantity = 1) => {
      const current = items.find((i) => i.productId === productId);
      const nextQty = Math.min(10, (current?.quantity ?? 0) + quantity);

      if (user) {
        const res = await fetch("/api/cart", {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ productId, quantity: nextQty, savedForLater: false }),
        });
        const json = (await res.json()) as { items?: Line[]; error?: string };
        setItems(safeLineArray(json.items));
        return;
      }

      setItems((prev) => {
        const exists = prev.find((i) => i.productId === productId);
        const next = exists
          ? prev.map((i) =>
              i.productId === productId
                ? { ...i, quantity: Math.min(10, i.quantity + quantity), savedForLater: false }
                : i,
            )
          : [...prev, { productId, quantity: Math.min(10, quantity), savedForLater: false }];
        writeLS(LS_CART, next);
        return next;
      });
    },
    [items, user],
  );

  const setQty = useCallback(
    async (productId: string, quantity: number) => {
      if (quantity <= 0) {
        await remove(productId);
        return;
      }

      const capped = Math.min(10, quantity);

      if (user) {
        const res = await fetch("/api/cart", {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ productId, quantity: capped }),
        });
        const json = (await res.json()) as { items?: Line[] };
        setItems(safeLineArray(json.items));
        return;
      }

      setItems((prev) => {
        const next = prev.map((i) =>
          i.productId === productId ? { ...i, quantity: capped } : i,
        );
        writeLS(LS_CART, next);
        return next;
      });
    },
    [user],
  );

  async function remove(productId: string) {
    if (user) {
      const res = await fetch("/api/cart", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ productId, quantity: 0 }),
      });
      const json = (await res.json()) as { items?: Line[] };
      setItems(safeLineArray(json.items));
      return;
    }

    setItems((prev) => {
      const next = prev.filter((i) => i.productId !== productId);
      writeLS(LS_CART, next);
      return next;
    });
  }

  const saveForLater = useCallback(
    async (productId: string, saved: boolean) => {
      if (user) {
        const res = await fetch("/api/cart", {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ productId, savedForLater: saved }),
        });
        const json = (await res.json()) as { items?: Line[] };
        setItems(safeLineArray(json.items));
        return;
      }

      setItems((prev) => {
        const next = prev.map((i) =>
          i.productId === productId ? { ...i, savedForLater: saved } : i,
        );
        writeLS(LS_CART, next);
        return next;
      });
    },
    [user],
  );

  const toggleWishlist = useCallback(
    async (productId: string) => {
      if (user) {
        const res = await fetch("/api/wishlist", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ productId }),
        });
        const json = (await res.json()) as { ok: boolean; added?: boolean };
        if (json.ok) {
          setWishlist((prev) =>
            json.added
              ? Array.from(new Set([...prev, productId]))
              : prev.filter((id) => id !== productId),
          );
        }
        return;
      }

      setWishlist((prev) => {
        const next = prev.includes(productId)
          ? prev.filter((id) => id !== productId)
          : [...prev, productId];
        writeLS(LS_WISHLIST, next);
        return next;
      });
    },
    [user],
  );

  const applyCoupon = useCallback(
    async (code: string): Promise<{ ok: boolean; message: string }> => {
      const active = activeLines(itemsRef.current);
      if (!active.length) {
        return { ok: false, message: "Add items to your cart first." };
      }

      try {
        const res = await fetch("/api/coupons/validate", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ code, items: active }),
        });

        const json = (await res.json()) as {
          ok: boolean;
          coupon?: QuoteCoupon;
          error?: string;
        };

        if (json.ok && json.coupon) {
          setCouponCode(code.toUpperCase());
          return {
            ok: true,
            message: `${code.toUpperCase()} applied — you saved ${inr(json.coupon.discount)}.`,
          };
        }

        return { ok: false, message: json.error ?? "Coupon is not valid for this cart." };
      } catch {
        return { ok: false, message: "Could not validate coupon. Try again." };
      }
    },
    [],
  );

  const removeCoupon = useCallback(() => {
    setCouponCode(null);
  }, []);

  const value = useMemo<CartCtx>(
    () => ({
      ready,
      user,
      authed: Boolean(user),
      items,
      wishlist,
      quote,
      quoting,
      couponCode,
      deliveryMode,
      setDeliveryMode,
      add,
      setQty: (productId, quantity) => setQty(productId, quantity),
      remove,
      saveForLater,
      toggleWishlist,
      inWishlist: (productId) => wishlist.includes(productId),
      applyCoupon,
      removeCoupon,
      refreshQuote,
      setUser,
    }),
    [
      ready,
      user,
      items,
      wishlist,
      quote,
      quoting,
      couponCode,
      deliveryMode,
      add,
      setQty,
      saveForLater,
      toggleWishlist,
      applyCoupon,
      removeCoupon,
      refreshQuote,
      setUser,
    ],
  );

  return <Ctx.Provider value={value}>{children}</Ctx.Provider>;
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import type { ZodError } from "zod";

export function validationError(error: ZodError) {
  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      ok: false,
      error: error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid input",
      fields: error.flatten().fieldErrors,
    },
    { status: 422 },
  );
}

export function ok(data: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, ...data });
}

import "server-only";

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import type { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { AppError } from "@/lib/utils";
import { getSessionToken, isStaffRole, verifySession, type SessionUser } from "./session";

export { isStaffRole };
export type { SessionUser };

export async function getActor(): Promise<SessionUser | null> {
  const token = await getSessionToken();
  const session = await verifySession(token);
  if (!session?.sub) return null;

  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: session.sub },
    select: {
      id: true,
      name: true,
      email: true,
      phone: true,
      role: true,
      whatsappOptIn: true,
      active: true,
      avatarUrl: true,
    },
  });

  if (!user || !user.active) return null;
  return user;
}

export async function requireActor(opts: { redirectOnError?: boolean } = {}): Promise<SessionUser> {
  const actor = await getActor();

  if (!actor) {
    if (opts.redirectOnError) redirect("/auth/login");
    throw new AppError(401, "Sign in required.", "UNAUTHENTICATED");
  }

  return actor;
}

export async function requireStaff(opts: { redirectOnError?: boolean } = {}): Promise<SessionUser> {
  const actor = await requireActor(opts);

  if (!isStaffRole(actor.role)) {
    if (opts.redirectOnError) redirect("/forbidden");
    throw new AppError(403, "Access denied.", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  return actor;
}

export async function requireAdmin(opts: { redirectOnError?: boolean } = {}): Promise<SessionUser> {
  const actor = await requireStaff(opts);

  if (actor.role !== "ADMIN") {
    if (opts.redirectOnError) redirect("/forbidden");
    throw new AppError(403, "Admin access required.", "FORBIDDEN");
  }

  return actor;
}

export const can = {
  manageCatalog: (role: string) => role === "ADMIN" || role === "MANAGER",
  manageOrders: (role: string) => isStaffRole(role),
  manageCustomers: (role: string) => role === "ADMIN" || role === "MANAGER",
  manageContent: (role: string) => role === "ADMIN" || role === "MANAGER",
  support: (role: string) => isStaffRole(role),
  destroy: (role: string) => role === "ADMIN",
  refund: (role: string) => role === "ADMIN",
};

function toJson(value: unknown): Prisma.InputJsonValue | undefined {
  if (value === undefined) return undefined;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value ?? null)) as Prisma.InputJsonValue;
  } catch {
    return { error: "Unserializable value" } as Prisma.InputJsonValue;
  }
}

export async function audit(input: {
  actorId?: string | null;
  action: string;
  entity: string;
  entityId?: string | null;
  before?: unknown;
  after?: unknown;
  ip?: string | null;
  userAgent?: string | null;
}) {
  try {
    await prisma.auditLog.create({
      data: {
        actorId: input.actorId ?? null,
        action: input.action,
        entity: input.entity,
        entityId: input.entityId ?? null,
        before: toJson(input.before) ?? undefined,
        after: toJson(input.after) ?? undefined,
        ip: input.ip ?? null,
        userAgent: input.userAgent?.slice(0, 500) ?? null,
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("[audit]", e);
  }
}

import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { SignJWT, jwtVerify, type JWTPayload } from "jose";

export const SESSION_COOKIE_NAME = process.env.SESSION_COOKIE?.trim() || "uv_session";
const SESSION_TTL_DAYS = Number(process.env.SESSION_TTL_DAYS ?? 7);

export type SessionRole = "ADMIN" | "MANAGER" | "STAFF" | "CUSTOMER";

export type SessionPayload = JWTPayload & {
  sub: string;
  email: string;
  name: string;
  role: SessionRole;
};

export type SessionUser = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  phone: string | null;
  role: string;
  whatsappOptIn: boolean;
  active: boolean;
  avatarUrl?: string | null;
};

function secret() {
  const value = process.env.SESSION_SECRET;
  if (!value || value.length < 32) {
    throw new Error("SESSION_SECRET is missing or too short. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48");
  }
  return new TextEncoder().encode(value);
}

export function isStaffRole(role: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  return role === "ADMIN" || role === "MANAGER" || role === "STAFF";
}

export async function createSession(user: {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: string;
}) {
  const token = await new SignJWT({
    email: user.email,
    name: user.name,
    role: user.role,
  })
    .setProtectedHeader({ alg: "HS256" })
    .setSubject(user.id)
    .setIssuedAt()
    .setExpirationTime(`${SESSION_TTL_DAYS}d`)
    .sign(secret());

  const cookieStore = await cookies();

  cookieStore.set(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, token, {
    httpOnly: true,
    sameSite: "lax",
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
    path: "/",
    maxAge: SESSION_TTL_DAYS * 24 * 60 * 60,
  });

  return token;
}

export async function destroySession() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  cookieStore.set(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, "", {
    httpOnly: true,
    sameSite: "lax",
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
    path: "/",
    maxAge: 0,
  });
}

export async function verifySession(token: string | null | undefined): Promise<SessionPayload | null> {
  if (!token) return null;

  try {
    const { payload } = await jwtVerify(token, secret());
    if (!payload.sub || typeof payload.email !== "string" || typeof payload.name !== "string") {
      return null;
    }

    return payload as SessionPayload;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function getSessionToken(): Promise<string | null> {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  return cookieStore.get(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value ?? null;
}

import type { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";

  id: true,
  slug: true,
  name: true,
  shortDescription: true,
  mrp: true,
  salePrice: true,
  discountPercent: true,
  stock: true,
  lowStockAt: true,
  ratingAvg: true,
  ratingCount: true,

  featured: true,

  subtype: true,

export function toCards(products: ProductRow[]): CardVM[] {

function csvToArray(value?: string | null): string[] {
  if (!value) return [];
  return Array.from(
    new Set(
      value
        .split(",")
        .map((v) => v.trim())
        .filter(Boolean),
    ),
  );
}

export async function searchProducts(
  input: SearchInput,
  categorySlug?: string | null,
) {
  const where: Prisma.ProductWhereInput = {
    active: true,
  };

  if (categorySlug && categorySlug !== "all") {
    where.category = { slug: categorySlug };
  }

  const q = input.q?.trim();
  if (q) {
    where.OR = [
      { name: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
      { slug: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
      { shortDescription: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
      { brand: { name: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } } },
      { category: { name: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } } },
    ];
  }

  const brands = csvToArray(input.brands);
  if (brands.length) {
    where.brand = { slug: { in: brands } };
  }

  const subtypes = csvToArray(input.subtypes);
  if (subtypes.length) where.subtype = { in: subtypes };

  const ram = csvToArray(input.ram);
  if (ram.length) where.ram = { in: ram };

  const storage = csvToArray(input.storage);
  if (storage.length) where.storage = { in: storage };

  const screenSize = csvToArray(input.screenSize);
  if (screenSize.length) where.screenSize = { in: screenSize };

  const processor = csvToArray(input.processor);
  if (processor.length) where.processor = { in: processor };

  const color = csvToArray(input.color);
  if (color.length) where.color = { in: color };

  const price: Prisma.IntFilter = {};
  if (input.minPrice != null) price.gte = input.minPrice;
  if (input.maxPrice != null) price.lte = input.maxPrice;
  if (Object.keys(price).length) where.salePrice = price;

  if (input.minRating != null) {
    where.ratingAvg = { gte: input.minRating };
  }

  if (input.minDiscount != null) {
    where.discountPercent = { gte: input.minDiscount };
  }

  if (input.inStock) {
    where.stock = { gt: 0 };
  }

  const orderBy: Prisma.ProductOrderByWithRelationInput[] = (() => {
    switch (input.sort) {
      case "newest":
        return [{ createdAt: "desc" }];
      case "priceLow":
        return [{ salePrice: "asc" }];
      case "priceHigh":
        return [{ salePrice: "desc" }];
      case "discount":
        return [{ discountPercent: "desc" }, { sold: "desc" }];
      case "rating":
        return [{ ratingAvg: "desc" }, { ratingCount: "desc" }];
      case "popular":
      default:
        return [{ sold: "desc" }, { ratingAvg: "desc" }, { views: "desc" }];
    }
  })();

  const skip = (input.page - 1) * input.perPage;

  const [total, rows] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.product.count({ where }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where,
      select: productSelect,
      orderBy,
      skip,
      take: input.perPage,
    }),
  ]);

  return {
    items: toCards(rows),
    total,
    page: input.page,
    perPage: input.perPage,
  };
}

export async function loadFacets(categorySlug?: string | null) {
  const where: Prisma.ProductWhereInput = {
    active: true,
  };

  if (categorySlug && categorySlug !== "all") {
    where.category = { slug: categorySlug };
  }

  const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where,
    select: {
      brand: { select: { slug: true, name: true } },
      subtype: true,
      ram: true,
      storage: true,
      screenSize: true,
      processor: true,
      color: true,
    },
    take: 1000,
  });

  const brandMap = new Map<string, { slug: string; name: string }>();
  const subtypes = new Set<string>();
  const ram = new Set<string>();
  const storage = new Set<string>();
  const screenSize = new Set<string>();
  const processor = new Set<string>();
  const color = new Set<string>();

  for (const r of rows) {
    brandMap.set(r.brand.slug, r.brand);
    if (r.subtype) subtypes.add(r.subtype);
    if (r.ram) ram.add(r.ram);
    if (r.storage) storage.add(r.storage);
    if (r.screenSize) screenSize.add(r.screenSize);
    if (r.processor) processor.add(r.processor);
    if (r.color) color.add(r.color);
  }

  return {
    brands: Array.from(brandMap.values()).sort((a, b) =>
      a.name.localeCompare(b.name),
    ),
    subtypes: Array.from(subtypes).sort(),
    ram: Array.from(ram).sort(),
    storage: Array.from(storage).sort(),
    screenSize: Array.from(screenSize).sort(),
    processor: Array.from(processor).sort(),
    color: Array.from(color).sort(),
  };
}

FILE: src\lib\category-explorer.ts

import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";

export type CatMeta = { id: string; slug: string; name: string; image: string | null; count: number };
export type ExplorerItem = { id: string; slug: string; name: string; image: string | null; price: number | null; mrp: number | null; off: number; isNew: boolean };
export type ExplorerBrand = { name: string; image: string | null; pill: string };
export type ExplorerData = {
  categories: CatMeta[];
  byCategory: Record<string, { deals: ExplorerItem[]; brands: ExplorerBrand[] }>;
  allBrands: ExplorerBrand[];
  brandProducts: Record<string, ExplorerItem[]>;
  trending: ExplorerItem[];
};

const prim = (imgs?: { url: string; isPrimary: boolean }[] | null) =>
  imgs?.find((i) => i.isPrimary)?.url ?? imgs?.[0]?.url ?? null;
const offPct = (mrp: number | null | undefined, price: number | null | undefined) =>
  typeof mrp === "number" && typeof price === "number" && mrp > 0 && price < mrp ? Math.round(((mrp - price) / mrp) * 100) : 0;

export async function getCategoryExplorer(): Promise<ExplorerData> {
  const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 864e5);
  const [cats, pool, counts] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.category.findMany({ select: { id: true, slug: true, name: true }, orderBy: { name: "asc" } }),
    prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } },
      select: {
        id: true, slug: true, name: true, salePrice: true, mrp: true, discountPercent: true,
        createdAt: true, sold: true, ratingAvg: true,
        images: { select: { url: true, isPrimary: true } },
        brand: { select: { name: true } },
        category: { select: { id: true, slug: true } },
      },
      orderBy: [{ sold: "desc" }, { ratingAvg: "desc" }],
      take: 200,
    }),
    prisma.product.groupBy({ by: ["categoryId"], where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } }, _count: true }),
  ]);

  const realCount = new Map(counts.map((g) => [g.categoryId, g._count]));

  const toExplorer = (p: (typeof pool)[number]): ExplorerItem => ({
    id: p.id, slug: p.slug, name: p.name, image: prim(p.images),
    price: p.salePrice, mrp: p.mrp, off: offPct(p.mrp, p.salePrice),
    isNew: !!p.createdAt && p.createdAt >= thirtyDaysAgo,
  });

  const byCat = new Map<string, ExplorerItem[]>();
  const brandRep = new Map<string, { image: string | null; sold: number }>();
  const brandItems = new Map<string, ExplorerItem[]>();
  const catBrand = new Map<string, Map<string, { image: string | null; sold: number }>>();

  for (const p of pool) {
    const slug = p.category?.slug;
    const it = toExplorer(p);
    if (slug) (byCat.get(slug) ?? byCat.set(slug, []).get(slug)!).push(it);
    const bn = p.brand?.name;
    if (bn) {
      const cur = brandRep.get(bn);
      if (!cur || (p.sold ?? 0) > cur.sold) brandRep.set(bn, { image: it.image, sold: p.sold ?? 0 });
      const list = brandItems.get(bn);
      if (list) { if (list.length < 12) list.push(it); } else brandItems.set(bn, [it]);
      if (slug) {
        const m = catBrand.get(slug) ?? new Map<string, { image: string | null; sold: number }>();
        const c2 = m.get(bn);
        if (!c2 || (p.sold ?? 0) > c2.sold) m.set(bn, { image: it.image, sold: p.sold ?? 0 });
        catBrand.set(slug, m);
      }
    }
  }

  const brandTile = (name: string, r: { image: string | null }): ExplorerBrand => ({
    name, image: r.image, pill: "Explore",
  });

  const categories: CatMeta[] = cats.map((c) => {
    const first = byCat.get(c.slug)?.[0];
    return { id: c.id, slug: c.slug, name: c.name, image: first?.image ?? null, count: realCount.get(c.id) ?? 0 };
  });

  const byCategory: ExplorerData["byCategory"] = {};
  for (const c of categories) {
    const items = byCat.get(c.slug) ?? [];
    const deals = items.slice().sort((a, b) => b.off - a.off).slice(0, 6);
    const bm = catBrand.get(c.slug);
    const brands = bm ? [...bm.entries()].map(([n, r]) => brandTile(n, r)).slice(0, 6) : [];
    byCategory[c.slug] = { deals, brands };
  }

  const allBrands = [...brandRep.entries()].map(([n, r]) => brandTile(n, r)).slice(0, 8);
  const brandProducts: Record<string, ExplorerItem[]> = {};
  for (const [n, list] of brandItems.entries()) brandProducts[n] = list;
  const trending = pool.map(toExplorer).sort((a, b) => b.off - a.off).slice(0, 8);

  return { categories, byCategory, allBrands, brandProducts, trending };
}

FILE: src\lib\clipboard.ts

/**
 * Copy text from ANY origin. `navigator.clipboard` only exists in secure contexts
 * (https://, localhost, 127.0.0.1); on a LAN IP over http:// it is `undefined`, so a
 * bare `navigator.clipboard.writeText(...)` throws and naive try/catch swallows it.
 * This tries the modern API, then falls back to the legacy execCommand path, which
 * works on insecure origins with no permissions, no prompt, and no dependencies.
 * Resolves true only if the text actually reached the clipboard.
 */
export async function copyText(text: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || typeof document === "undefined") return false;

  if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext !== false) {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      return true;
    } catch {
      /* permission denied / transient: fall through to legacy */
    }
  }

  const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
  ta.value = text;
  ta.setAttribute("readonly", "");
  ta.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  ta.style.position = "fixed";
  ta.style.top = "-1000px";
  ta.style.left = "-1000px";
  ta.style.opacity = "0";
  document.body.appendChild(ta);
  ta.focus();
  ta.select();
  try { ta.setSelectionRange(0, text.length); } catch { /* select() already covers iOS */ }

  let ok = false;
  try { ok = document.execCommand("copy"); } catch { ok = false; }
  document.body.removeChild(ta);
  return ok;
}

FILE: src\lib\delivery-otp.ts

import crypto from "node:crypto";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";

export const OTP_LENGTH = 6;
const RESEND_COOLDOWN_MS = 60_000; // don't spam a new code within 60s

function generate(): string {
  // crypto.randomInt is uniform — Math.random() would bias the distribution.
  let s = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < OTP_LENGTH; i++) s += crypto.randomInt(0, 10).toString();
  return s;
}

/** Mask for admin display: "482139" -> "••••39". Never returns the full code. */
export function maskOtp(otp: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!otp) return null;
  return "•".repeat(Math.max(0, otp.length - 2)) + otp.slice(-2);
}

type GenResult =
  | { ok: true; otp: string; resent: boolean }
  | { ok: false; reason: "too_soon" | "not_found" };

/**
 * Generate (or regenerate) the delivery OTP for an order and persist it.
 * Returns the plaintext ONCE so the caller can hand it to notify.ts — it is
 * never logged here. Enforces a per-order resend cooldown.
 */
export async function generateDeliveryOtp(orderId: string): Promise<GenResult> {
  const order = await prisma.order.findUnique({
    where: { id: orderId },
    select: { id: true, deliveryOtpSentAt: true },
  });
  if (!order) return { ok: false, reason: "not_found" };

  const tooSoon =
    !!order.deliveryOtpSentAt &&
    Date.now() - order.deliveryOtpSentAt.getTime() < RESEND_COOLDOWN_MS;
  if (tooSoon) return { ok: false, reason: "too_soon" };

  const otp = generate();
  await prisma.order.update({
    where: { id: orderId },
    data: { deliveryOtp: otp, deliveryOtpSentAt: new Date() },
  });
  return { ok: true, otp, resent: !!order.deliveryOtpSentAt };
}

type VerifyResult =
  | { ok: true }
  | { ok: false; reason: "no_otp" | "mismatch" | "already_delivered" | "not_found" };

/** Constant-time compare so timing can't be used to guess the code digit-by-digit. */
export async function verifyDeliveryOtp(orderId: string, input: string): Promise<VerifyResult> {
  const order = await prisma.order.findUnique({
    where: { id: orderId },
    select: { id: true, deliveryOtp: true, status: true, deliveredByOtp: true },
  });
  if (!order) return { ok: false, reason: "not_found" };
  if (order.deliveredByOtp) return { ok: false, reason: "already_delivered" };
  if (!order.deliveryOtp) return { ok: false, reason: "no_otp" };

  const a = Buffer.from(order.deliveryOtp.padEnd(OTP_LENGTH, " "));
  const b = Buffer.from(input.trim().padEnd(OTP_LENGTH, " "));
  if (a.length !== b.length || !crypto.timingSafeEqual(a, b)) {
    return { ok: false, reason: "mismatch" };
  }
  return { ok: true };
}

/**
 * Urban Vogue delivery serviceability — LIVE town-level data via API Ninjas,
 * with the static district maps retained as an offline/quota fallback.
 *
 * Resolution order for a serviceable PIN:
 *   1. deny rules (format / obvious-fake / block-lists)  -> no network spent
 *   2. PIN_OVERRIDE (hand-verified patches)              -> instant, no network
 *   3. in-memory cache of prior API results              -> instant, no network
 *   4. API Ninjas /v1/pincode                            -> town city + state
 *   5. district maps PIN3/PIN2/FIRST                     -> fallback (never denies)
 *
 * The API supplies `cityHint` + `region` (state). ETA days still come from the
 * district maps (the API has no ETA). A missing/blank API city falls through to
 * the district map, so a valid-but-unindexed PIN still shows a sensible city.
 */

export type PincodeInspection = {
  serviceable: boolean;
  cityHint: string | null;
  region: string | null;
  etaFrom: string | null; // ISO
  etaTo: string | null;   // ISO
  message: string;
};

import prisma from "@/lib/prisma"; // server-only; delivery.ts is imported solely by /api/delivery

// Local, unlimited, instant town lookup. Returns null on miss so the caller
// falls through to the API key, then the district map.
async function lookupLocal(pin: string): Promise<{ city: string; state: string | null } | null> {
  try {
    const row = await prisma.pincode.findUnique({ where: { pin }, select: { city: true, state: true } });
    if (!row || !row.city) return null;
    return { city: row.city, state: row.state ?? null };
  } catch {
    return null; // DB hiccup must never deny a real customer
  }
}

// Fire-and-forget self-heal: a successful API town result is written back so the
// next identical query is local (table converges toward full coverage without re-running the seed).
function backfillLocal(pin: string, city: string, state: string | null) {
  void prisma.pincode
    .upsert({ where: { pin }, update: { city, state: state ?? undefined }, create: { pin, city, state } })
    .catch(() => {});
}

/* ----------------------------- helpers ---------------------------- */

const PIN_FORMAT = /^[1-9]\d{5}$/;

function addDays(iso: string, days: number): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + days);
  return d.toISOString();
}

function isObviouslyFake(pin: string): boolean {
  const n = [...pin].map((c) => Number(c));
  const first = n[0] ?? 0;
  if (n.every((v) => v === first)) return true;
  const tail = n.slice(1);
  const asc  = tail.every((v, i) => (v - (n[i] ?? 0) + 10) % 10 === 1);
  const desc = tail.every((v, i) => (v - (n[i] ?? 0) + 10) % 10 === 9);
  return asc || desc;
}

function deny(message: string): PincodeInspection {
  return { serviceable: false, cityHint: null, region: null, etaFrom: null, etaTo: null, message };
}

// District-level inspection (the old behaviour). Always serviceable:true.
// Used as the offline/quota/miss fallback so a network problem never denies.
function districtInspection(pin: string): PincodeInspection {
  const p2 = pin.slice(0, 2);
  const p3 = pin.slice(0, 3);
  const d1 = pin.charAt(0);
  const m3 = PIN3[p3];
  const m2 = PIN2[p2];
  const m1 = FIRST[d1];
  const region = m3?.region ?? m2?.region ?? m1?.region ?? "India";
  const city = m3?.city ?? null;
  const days = m3?.days ?? m2?.days ?? m1?.days ?? 4;
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  return {
    serviceable: true,
    cityHint: city,
    region,
    etaFrom: addDays(now, Math.max(1, days - 1)),
    etaTo: addDays(now, days),
    message: `Deliverable to ${city ?? region}.`,
  };
}

// ETA days for a PIN, from the district maps (API has no ETA field).
function daysFor(pin: string): number {
  return (
    PIN3[pin.slice(0, 3)]?.days ??
    PIN2[pin.slice(0, 2)]?.days ??
    FIRST[pin.charAt(0)]?.days ??
    4
  );
}

/* ------------------------- live-API plumbing ---------------------- */

// Per-process cache: each unique PIN costs <=1 network call. Warm serverless
// instances reuse it; cold starts re-fetch (and re-cache) — acceptable for a
// store whose traffic concentrates on metros.
const cache = new Map<string, PincodeInspection>();
let quotaExhausted = false; // latch: stop spending calls once the key is dry

type ApiNinjasRes = {
  pincode?: string | number;
  city?: string;
  state?: string;
  country?: string;
  message?: string;
};

async function fetchFromApi(pin: string): Promise<PincodeInspection | null> {
  // null = "no usable town data" (caller falls back to district map).
  const ctrl = new AbortController();
  const t = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), API_TIMEOUT_MS);
  try {
    const url = `${PINCODE_API_URL}?pincode=${encodeURIComponent(pin)}&apikey=${encodeURIComponent(PINCODE_API_KEY)}`;
    const res = await fetch(url, { signal: ctrl.signal, headers: { accept: "application/json" } });

    if (res.status === 429 || /quota|limit|exceed/i.test(res.headers.get("www-authenticate") ?? "")) {
      quotaExhausted = true;
      return null;
    }
    if (!res.ok) return null;

    const json = (await res.json()) as ApiNinjasRes;
    const city = typeof json.city === "string" ? json.city.trim() : "";
    const state = typeof json.state === "string" ? json.state.trim() : "";

    // Treat a quota-style body message as exhaustion too (some tiers 200 + text).
    if (!city && /quota|limit|exceed|invalid api/i.test(json.message ?? "")) {
      quotaExhausted = true;
      return null;
    }
    if (!city) return null; // valid PIN but no town record -> district fallback

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const days = daysFor(pin);
    return {
      serviceable: true,
      cityHint: city,
      region: state || PIN2[pin.slice(0, 2)]?.region || FIRST[pin.charAt(0)]?.region || "India",
      etaFrom: addDays(now, Math.max(1, days - 1)),
      etaTo: addDays(now, days),
      message: `Deliverable to ${city}.`,
    };
  } catch {
    // timeout / abort / network / parse -> fall back, do NOT cache (allow retry
    // next time) unless we already latched quota above.
    return null;
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(t);
  }
}

/* --------------------------- public API --------------------------- */

export async function inspectPincode(raw: string): Promise<PincodeInspection> {
  const pin = (raw ?? "").trim();

  // 1) deny rules FIRST -> no DB, no network, instant red + toast on garbage.
  if (!PIN_FORMAT.test(pin)) return deny("Enter a valid 6-digit Indian PIN code.");
  if (isObviouslyFake(pin)) return deny("That doesn't look like a real PIN code. Please check and re-enter.");
  if (INVALID_PINS.has(pin)) return deny("We currently don't deliver to this PIN code.");
  if (RESTRICTED_PREFIXES.has(pin.slice(0, 2))) return deny("Sorry, this area is outside our delivery network right now.");

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const mk = (city: string, state: string | null, days: number): PincodeInspection => ({
    serviceable: true,
    cityHint: city,
    region: state || PIN2[pin.slice(0, 2)]?.region || FIRST[pin.charAt(0)]?.region || "India",
    etaFrom: addDays(now, Math.max(1, days - 1)),
    etaTo: addDays(now, days),
    message: `Deliverable to ${city}.`,
  });

  // 2) hand patches (authoritative, instant).
  const ov = PIN_OVERRIDE[pin];
  if (ov && ov.city) return mk(ov.city, ov.state || null, daysFor(pin));

  // 3) LOCAL DB first -> unlimited + instant for every seeded PIN (all regions).
  const local = await lookupLocal(pin);
  if (local) return mk(local.city, local.state, daysFor(pin));

  // 4) in-memory cache of prior API results.
  const cached = cache.get(pin);
  if (cached) return cached;

  // 5) live API key (skipped once quota latches); self-heal the DB on success.
  if (!quotaExhausted && PINCODE_API_KEY) {
    const api = await fetchFromApi(pin);
    if (api && api.cityHint) {
      cache.set(pin, api);
      backfillLocal(pin, api.cityHint, api.region); // next time it's local
      return api;
    }
    if (quotaExhausted) {
      const fb = districtInspection(pin);
      cache.set(pin, fb);
      return fb;
    }
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.warn(`[delivery] no town data for ${pin}; using district fallback`);
    }
    return districtInspection(pin);
  }

  // 6) no key / quota latched -> district fallback (never denies a real PIN).
  return districtInspection(pin);
}
