import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";

export type Tile = { label: string; pill: string; image: string | null; href: string };
export type DealTile = { label: string; price: number | null; image: string | null; href: string };
export type GridItem = {
  id: string; slug: string; name: string; brand: string | null; image: string | null;
  price: number | null; mrp: number | null; rating: number | null; ratingCount: number | null;
};

const prodSelect = {
  id: true, slug: true, name: true, salePrice: true, mrp: true, ratingAvg: true, ratingCount: true,
  sold: true, images: { select: { url: true, isPrimary: true } },
} as const;

const prim = (r: { images?: { url: string; isPrimary: boolean }[] }) =>
  r.images?.find((i) => i.isPrimary)?.url ?? r.images?.[0]?.url ?? null;
const offPct = (mrp: number | null | undefined, price: number | null | undefined) =>
  typeof mrp === "number" && typeof price === "number" && mrp > 0 && price < mrp
    ? Math.round(((mrp - price) / mrp) * 100) : 0;

/** 3-col "Suggested For You" grid — top selling, in-stock, active. */
export async function getSuggested(take = 12): Promise<GridItem[]> {
  const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } },
    select: { ...prodSelect, brand: { select: { name: true } } },
    orderBy: [{ sold: "desc" }, { ratingAvg: "desc" }],
    take,
  });
  return rows.map((r: any) => ({
    id: r.id, slug: r.slug, name: r.name, brand: r.brand?.name ?? null, image: prim(r),
    price: r.salePrice, mrp: r.mrp, rating: r.ratingAvg, ratingCount: r.ratingCount,
  }));
}

/** Category collection tiles ("Popular picks" / "Lowest Prices…"): per category, best discount + rep image. */
export async function getCategoryCollections(limit = 4): Promise<Tile[]> {
  const pool = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } },
    select: { ...prodSelect, salePrice: true, mrp: true, category: { select: { slug: true, name: true } } },
    orderBy: [{ sold: "desc" }], take: 60,
  });
  const byCat = new Map<string, any[]>();
  for (const r of pool as any[]) { const k = r.category?.slug; if (!k) continue; (byCat.get(k) ?? byCat.set(k, []).get(k)!).push(r); }
  return [...byCat.entries()].map(([slug, rs]) => {
    const best = rs.slice().sort((a, b) => offPct(b.mrp, b.salePrice) - offPct(a.mrp, a.salePrice))[0];
    const maxOff = Math.max(0, ...rs.map((x: any) => offPct(x.mrp, x.salePrice)));
    return { label: best.category?.name ?? slug, pill: maxOff > 0 ? `Up to ${maxOff}% Off` : "Explore", image: prim(best), href: `/products/${slug}` };
  }).slice(0, limit);
}

/** Compact horizontal deal tiles ("Jump in"): per category, name + lowest live price + rep image. */
export async function getDealTiles(limit = 6): Promise<DealTile[]> {
  const pool = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } },
    select: { ...prodSelect, salePrice: true, category: { select: { slug: true, name: true } } },
    orderBy: [{ salePrice: "asc" }], take: 80,
  });
  const byCat = new Map<string, any>();
  for (const r of pool as any[]) { const k = r.category?.slug; if (!k || byCat.has(k)) continue; byCat.set(k, r); } // cheapest-first ⇒ first seen per cat is the floor price
  return [...byCat.values()].map((r: any) => ({
    label: r.category?.name ?? "", price: r.salePrice, image: prim(r), href: `/products/${r.category.slug}`,
  })).slice(0, limit);
}

/** Brand spotlight cards: per brand, min discount across its products + rep image. */
export async function getBrandSpotlight(limit = 4): Promise<Tile[]> {
  const pool = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } },
    select: { ...prodSelect, salePrice: true, mrp: true, brand: { select: { name: true } } },
    orderBy: [{ sold: "desc" }], take: 80,
  });
  const byBrand = new Map<string, any[]>();
  for (const r of pool as any[]) { const k = r.brand?.name; if (!k) continue; (byBrand.get(k) ?? byBrand.set(k, []).get(k)!).push(r); }
  return [...byBrand.entries()].map(([name, rs]) => {
    const best = rs.slice().sort((a, b) => (b.sold ?? 0) - (a.sold ?? 0))[0];
    const minOff = Math.max(0, ...rs.map((x: any) => offPct(x.mrp, x.salePrice)));
    return { label: name, pill: minOff > 0 ? `Min. ${minOff}% Off` : "Explore", image: prim(best), href: `/products/all?q=${encodeURIComponent(name)}` };
  }).slice(0, limit);
}

FILE: src\lib\home-slides.ts

import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";

// ASCII-only source. \u escapes decode to real glyphs at runtime but are plain bytes
// in the file, so the CP1252 mojibake that keeps re-infecting pasted files can never
// return. NEVER hardcode a literal middle-dot or rupee sign in source again.
const DOT = "\u00B7";
const RUPEE = "\u20B9";
// Known-existing public asset so an <img>/<Image> src is never empty.
const IMG_FALLBACK = "/placeholder-banner-bg.jpg";

export type HeroSlideProduct = {
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  image: string; // non-empty: consumers feed it straight to an <img>/<Image> src
  salePrice: number;
  mrp: number;
  discountPercent: number;
  // real Product columns so the hero can compose the reference's spec line + brand eyebrow
  brand?: string | null;
  color?: string | null;
  storage?: string | null;
  ram?: string | null;
};

// The exact contract HeroSlider.tsx imports. `image` is OPTIONAL and only set for a
// designed full-bleed banner; product-led slides leave it null so page.tsx's existing
// `art: Boolean(s.image)` correctly distinguishes "creative" from "product" WITHOUT
// editing page.tsx. HeroSlider never reads `image`, so adding it is backward-safe.
export type HeroSlideVM = {
  id: string;
  gradient: string;
  badge: string;
  headline: string;
  highlight: string | null;
  description: string | null;
  ctaLabel: string;
  ctaHref: string | null;
  secondaryLabel: string | null;
  secondaryHref: string | null;
  image?: string | null;
  products: HeroSlideProduct[];
};

export async function buildHeroSlides(take: number = 15, opts?: { categorySlug?: string | null }): Promise<HeroSlideVM[]> {
  const cat = opts?.categorySlug ?? null;
  const now = new Date();

  // 1. ADMIN CAMPAIGNS FIRST - the real table is heroSlide (NOT banner), kind:"CUSTOM",
  //    active, inside the nullable startsAt/endsAt window, ordered by sortOrder, with the
  //    HeroSlideProduct join flattened into the chips HeroSlider/HeroCarousel render.
  const custom = await prisma.heroSlide.findMany({
    where: {
      kind: "CUSTOM",
      active: true,
      AND: [
        { OR: [{ startsAt: null }, { startsAt: { lte: now } }] },
        { OR: [{ endsAt: null }, { endsAt: { gte: now } }] },
        ...(cat ? [{ ctaHref: { contains: '/products/' + cat } }] : []),
      ],
    },
    orderBy: { sortOrder: "asc" },
    include: {
      products: {
        orderBy: { position: "asc" },
        include: {
          product: {
            select: {
              id: true, name: true, slug: true,
              salePrice: true, mrp: true, discountPercent: true,
              color: true, storage: true, ram: true,
              brand: { select: { name: true } },
              images: { take: 1, orderBy: { position: "asc" }, select: { url: true } },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  });

  const customSlides: HeroSlideVM[] = custom.slice(0, take).map((s) => ({
    id: s.id,
    gradient: String(s.gradient),
    badge: s.badge,
    headline: s.headline,
    highlight: s.highlight ?? null,
    description: s.description ?? null,
    ctaLabel: s.ctaLabel ?? "Shop Now",
    ctaHref: s.ctaHref ?? null,
    secondaryLabel: s.secondaryLabel ?? null,
    secondaryHref: s.secondaryHref ?? null,
    // top-level image = the admin's full-bleed artwork ONLY. Null when the admin left it
    // empty, which makes this slide product-led (cinematic) instead of a cropped banner.
    image: s.image ?? null,
    products: s.products.map((jp) => ({
      slug: jp.product.slug,
      name: jp.product.name,
      image: (jp.image && jp.image.length ? jp.image : jp.product.images[0]?.url) || IMG_FALLBACK,
      salePrice: jp.product.salePrice,
      mrp: jp.product.mrp,
      discountPercent: jp.product.discountPercent ?? 0,
      brand: jp.product.brand?.name ?? null,
      color: jp.product.color ?? null,
      storage: jp.product.storage ?? null,
      ram: jp.product.ram ?? null,
    })),
  }));

  // 2. AUTOMATIC CATALOG TOP-UP - fill the remainder from live in-stock products so the
  //    carousel is never thin, a brand-new active product can appear immediately, and when
  //    the admin has zero in-window campaigns this IS the whole carousel (your fallback).
  //    image:null here is deliberate: it routes these to HeroCarousel's cinematic branch.
  const remaining = take - customSlides.length;
  if (remaining <= 0) return customSlides;

  const pool = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: cat ? { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 }, category: { slug: cat } } : { active: true, stock: { gt: 0 } },
    select: {
      id: true, name: true, slug: true,
      salePrice: true, mrp: true, discountPercent: true,
      color: true, storage: true, ram: true,
      images: { take: 1, orderBy: { position: "asc" }, select: { url: true } },
      brand: { select: { name: true } },
      category: { select: { name: true } },
    },
    take: Math.max(remaining * 4, 24), // oversample so the shuffle has variety
  });

  const autoSlides: HeroSlideVM[] = pool
    .sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5)
    .slice(0, remaining)
    .map((p) => {
      const disc = p.discountPercent ?? (p.mrp > p.salePrice ? Math.round(((p.mrp - p.salePrice) / p.mrp) * 100) : 0);
      const sub = `${p.brand?.name ?? ""} ${p.category?.name ? DOT + " " + p.category.name : ""}`.trim();
      return {
        id: p.id,
        gradient: "MIDNIGHT",
        badge: disc > 0 ? `${disc}% OFF` : "Bestseller",
        headline: p.name,
        highlight: null,
        description: disc > 0 ? `${disc}% off ${DOT} Save ${RUPEE}${p.mrp - p.salePrice}` : sub || "Top rated in stock",
        ctaLabel: "Shop Now",
        ctaHref: `/product/${p.slug}`,
        secondaryLabel: null,
        secondaryHref: null,
        image: null, // product-led -> HeroCarousel renders it as a cinematic composed slide
        products: [{
          slug: p.slug,
          name: p.name,
          image: p.images[0]?.url || IMG_FALLBACK,
          salePrice: p.salePrice,
          mrp: p.mrp,
          discountPercent: disc,
          brand: p.brand?.name ?? null,
          color: p.color ?? null,
          storage: p.storage ?? null,
          ram: p.ram ?? null,
        }],
      };
    });

  return [...customSlides, ...autoSlides];
}

/**

import prisma from "./prisma";
import { siteUrl, toE164 } from "./utils";

type Ctx = Record<string, unknown>;

type NotifyInput = {
  template: string;
  userId?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
  phone?: string | null;
  whatsappOptIn?: boolean | null;
  ctx?: Ctx;
  href?: string | null;
};

type StaffInput = {
  template: string;
  ctx?: Ctx;
  href?: string | null;
};

function str(v: unknown): string {
  if (v == null) return "";
  if (typeof v === "string") return v;
  if (typeof v === "number" || typeof v === "boolean") return String(v);
  return "";
}

function render(template: string, ctx: Ctx = {}) {
  return template.replace(/\{\{(\w+)\}\}/g, (_, key: string) => str(ctx[key]));
}

type TemplateDef = {
  title: string;
  body: string;
  href?: string;
  whatsappTemplate?: string;
};

function getTemplate(template: string, ctx: Ctx) {
  const def = TEMPLATES[template] ?? {
    title: "Urban Vogue update",
    body: render("{{message}}", ctx),
  };

  return {
    title: render(def.title, ctx),
    body: render(def.body, ctx),
    href: def.href ?? null,
    whatsappTemplate: def.whatsappTemplate ?? null,
  };
}

async function sendEmail(input: { to: string; subject: string; text: string }) {
  const key = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY;
  const from = process.env.EMAIL_FROM ?? "Urban Vogue <no-reply@urbanvogue.in>";

  if (!key) return;

  try {
    await fetch("https://api.resend.com/emails", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        from,
        to: [input.to],
        subject: input.subject,
        text: input.text,
      }),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("[notify:email]", e);
  }
}

async function sendSms(input: { phone: string; message: string }) {
  const key = process.env.MSG91_AUTH_KEY;
  if (!key) return;

  try {
    await fetch("https://api.msg91.com/api/v5/sendsms", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        auth_key: key,
        sender: process.env.MSG91_SENDER_ID ?? "UVGT",
                country: "91",
        route: "4",
        message: input.message.slice(0, 320),
        mobiles: input.phone,
      }),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("[notify:sms]", e);
  }
}

async function sendWhatsApp(input: {
  phone: string;
  template: string;
  variables: string[];
}) {
  const token = process.env.WHATSAPP_TOKEN;
  const phoneNumberId = process.env.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID;
  if (!token || !phoneNumberId) return;

  const to = toE164(input.phone);
  if (!to) return;

  try {
    await fetch(`https://graph.facebook.com/v21.0/${phoneNumberId}/messages`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        messaging_product: "whatsapp",
        to,
        type: "template",
        template: {
          name: input.template,
          language: { code: "en_US" },
          components: [
            {
              type: "body",
              parameters: input.variables.map((v) => ({
                type: "text",
                text: v.slice(0, 200),
              })),
            },
          ],
        },
      }),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("[notify:whatsapp]", e);
  }
}

export async function notify(input: NotifyInput) {
  const t = getTemplate(input.template, input.ctx ?? {});
  const href = input.href ?? t.href ?? null;

  if (input.userId) {
    await prisma.notification.create({
      data: {
        userId: input.userId,
        audience: "USER",
        title: t.title,
        body: t.body,
        href,
        channel: "IN_APP",
        template: input.template,
      },
    });
  }

  if (input.email) {
    await sendEmail({
      to: input.email,
      subject: t.title,
      text: `${t.body}\n\n${siteUrl(href ?? "/")}`,
    });
  }

  if (input.phone) {
    await sendSms({
      phone: input.phone,
      message: `${t.title}: ${t.body}`,
    });

    if (input.whatsappOptIn) {
      const template =
        process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_ORDER_UPDATE ??
        t.whatsappTemplate ??
        "order_status_update";

      await sendWhatsApp({
        phone: input.phone,
        template,
        variables: [t.title, t.body],
      });
    }
  }
}

export async function notifyStaff(input: StaffInput) {
  const t = getTemplate(input.template, input.ctx ?? {});
  const href = input.href ?? t.href ?? "/admin/dashboard";

  await prisma.notification.create({
    data: {
      audience: "STAFF",
      title: t.title,
      body: t.body,
      href,
      channel: "SYSTEM",
      template: input.template,
    },
  });

  const supportEmail = process.env.SUPPORT_EMAIL;
  if (supportEmail) {
    await sendEmail({
      to: supportEmail,
      subject: `[Urban Vogue Admin] ${t.title}`,
      text: `${t.body}\n\n${siteUrl(href)}`,
    });
  }
}

export async function broadcast(input: {
  template: string;
  ctx?: Ctx;
}) {
  const t = getTemplate(input.template, input.ctx ?? {});

  const subscribers = await prisma.subscriber.findMany({
    where: { active: true },
    take: 1000,
    select: {
      email: true,
      phone: true,
      whatsappOptIn: true,
    },
  });

  await Promise.all(
    subscribers.map(async (s) => {
      await sendEmail({
        to: s.email,
        subject: t.title,
        text: `${t.body}\n\n${siteUrl(t.href ?? "/offers")}`,
      });

      if (s.whatsappOptIn && s.phone) {
        const template =
          process.env.WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_NEW_ARRIVAL ??
          t.whatsappTemplate ??
          "new_arrival_alert";

        await sendWhatsApp({
          phone: s.phone,
          template,
          variables: [t.title, t.body],
        });
      }
    }),
  );
}

/**
 * Order-status notifications (WhatsApp + email), with optional delivery OTP.
 *
 * Rules:
 *  - Never throws to the caller (fire-and-forget + try/catch): a provider
 *    outage or missing key must NOT fail an admin's status click.
 *  - No per-user opt-in gate: phone present -> WhatsApp, email present -> email.
 *  - Without provider keys it LOGS the exact message (DRY-RUN) so you can see
 *    the real payload in the terminal. Add keys in .env -> it actually sends.
 *  - The OTP (when passed) appears ONLY in the customer message, never in logs.
 */
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";

const APP_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000";

function trackingLink(orderNumber: string) {
  return `${APP_URL}/account/orders/${encodeURIComponent(orderNumber)}`;
}

function humanStatus(s: string) {
  return s.replace(/_/g, " ").toLowerCase().replace(/^./, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
}

function buildMessage(orderNumber: string, status: string, name: string | null, otp?: string) {
  const hi = name ? `Hi ${name.split(" ")[0]}, ` : "";
  const link = trackingLink(orderNumber);
  let text = `${hi}your Urban Vogue order #${orderNumber} is now ${humanStatus(status)}.\nTrack it here: ${link}`;
  if (otp) {
    text += `\n\nYour delivery OTP is ${otp}. Share it ONLY with the delivery agent to confirm handover.`;
  }
  return { text, link };
}

/** Normalize an Indian mobile to E.164 (+91…) for WhatsApp providers. */
function toE164(raw: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  const d = raw.replace(/\D/g, "");
  if (d.length === 10) return `+91${d}`;
  if (d.length === 11 && d.startsWith("0")) return `+91${d.slice(1)}`; // legacy leading-zero rows
  if (d.length === 12 && d.startsWith("91")) return `+${d}`;
  if (raw.trim().startsWith("+")) return raw.trim();
  return null;
}

/* ----------------------------- channels ----------------------------- */

async function sendWhatsApp(to: string, body: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const sid = process.env.TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID;
  const token = process.env.TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN;
  const from = process.env.TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM; // e.g. whatsapp:+15005550006 (sandbox)
  if (!sid || !token || !from) {
    console.log(`[notify:whatsapp:DRY-RUN] to=${to}\n  ${body}`);
    return false;
  }
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/${sid}/Messages.json`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: "Basic " + Buffer.from(`${sid}:${token}`).toString("base64"),
        "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
      },
      body: new URLSearchParams({ From: from, To: `whatsapp:${to}`, Body: body }).toString(),
    });
    if (!res.ok) console.error("[notify:whatsapp] HTTP", res.status, await res.text());
    return res.ok;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("[notify:whatsapp] failed", e);
    return false;
  }
}

export async function sendEmail(to: string, subject: string, body: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const key = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY;
  const from = process.env.MAIL_FROM ?? process.env.EMAIL_FROM ?? "Urban Vogue <onboarding@resend.dev>";
  if (!key) {
    console.log(`[notify:email:DRY-RUN] to=${to} subject="${subject}"\n  ${body}`);
    return false;
  }
  try {
    const res = await fetch("https://api.resend.com/emails", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ from, to: [to], subject, text: body }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) console.error("[notify:email] HTTP", res.status, await res.text());
    return res.ok;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("[notify:email] failed", e);
    return false;
  }
}

/* ----------------------------- SMS (MSG91) ----------------------------- */

/**
 * Transactional/OTP SMS via MSG91, mirroring sendEmail's never-throws contract.
 * Dry-run (logs a MASKED body, never the raw code) when MSG91 keys are absent, so
 * an unprovisioned env degrades to local logging instead of throwing into a route.
 *
 * VERIFY BEFORE RELYING ON LIVE SENDS: MSG91 exposes several send endpoints
 * (v5/flow template send, v2/sendsms plain, OTP short-link). The env names
 * (TEMPLATE_ID + SENDER_ID + AUTH_KEY) point at the template/flow send encoded
 * below. Confirm in your MSG91 dashboard that this template is an OTP or
 * Transactional type and that the variable key matches (commonly {{OTP}} or
 * ##OTP##); if your template differs, swap endpoint/body to match. A wrong shape
 * 400s but fails safe here (returns false, never throws), so signup degrades to
 * the route's dev-code path rather than breaking. India transactional SMS also
 * requires a DLT/TFP-registered header + approved template - that is provisioning,
 * not code, and no body shape fixes an unapproved template at the carrier.
 */
export async function sendSms(to: string, body: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const authKey = process.env.MSG91_AUTH_KEY;
  const templateId = process.env.MSG91_TEMPLATE_ID;
  const senderId = process.env.MSG91_SENDER_ID;
  if (!authKey || !templateId || !senderId) {
    // Mask any 6-digit run so an unconfigured env never prints a live OTP to console.
    const masked = body.replace(/\b\d{6}\b/g, "______");
    console.log(`[notify:sms:DRY-RUN] to=${to}\n  ${masked}`);
    return false;
  }
  // MSG91 India typically expects 91XXXXXXXXXX; normalize defensively.
  const d = to.replace(/\D/g, "");
  const mobile = d.length === 10 ? `91${d}` : d.length === 12 && d.startsWith("91") ? d : d;
  try {
    const res = await fetch("https://api.msg91.com/api/v5/flow/", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { authorization: authKey, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        sender: senderId,
        template_id: templateId,
        template_type: "otp",
        auth_key: authKey,
        flows: [{ mobile, message: body }],
      }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) console.error("[notify:sms] HTTP", res.status, await res.text());
    return res.ok;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("[notify:sms] failed", e);
    return false;
  }
}

/* --------------------------- public entry --------------------------- */

/**
 * Call after an order's status changes. Fire-and-forget: returns immediately.
 * Pass `otp` only when a delivery code was just minted (SHIPPED /
 * OUT_FOR_DELIVERY); it is appended to the customer message and nowhere else.
 */
export function notifyStatusChange(orderId: string, otp?: string): void {
  void (async () => {
    try {
      const order = await prisma.order.findUnique({
        where: { id: orderId },
        select: {
          orderNumber: true,
          status: true,
          user: { select: { name: true, email: true, phone: true } },
        },
      });
      if (!order?.user) return; // guest order / no account -> nothing to notify

      const { text } = buildMessage(order.orderNumber, order.status, order.user.name, otp);
      const subject = `Order #${order.orderNumber} — ${humanStatus(order.status)}`;

      const phone = toE164(order.user.phone);
      const email = order.user.email?.trim();

      await Promise.allSettled([
        phone ? sendWhatsApp(phone, text) : Promise.resolve(false),
        email ? sendEmail(email, subject, text) : Promise.resolve(false),
      ]);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[notify] unexpected failure (swallowed)", e);
    }
  })();
}

import { type OrderStatus, type PaymentMethod, Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import prisma from "./prisma";
import { computeQuote, type Quote } from "./quote";
import { AppError, addDays, inr, orderNumber, trackingNumber } from "./utils";
import { notify, notifyStaff } from "./notifications";

export type CreateOrderInput = {
  userId: string | null;
  guestEmail?: string | null;
  guestPhone?: string | null;
  addressSnapshot: Prisma.JsonObject;
  quote: Quote;
  paymentMethod: PaymentMethod;
  payment?: {
    razorpayOrderId: string;
    razorpayPaymentId: string;
    razorpaySignature: string;
    amountPaise: number;
    raw?: Prisma.JsonObject;
  } | null;
  ip?: string | null;
  note?: string | null;
};

export class StockConflictError extends AppError {
  constructor(public conflicts: { productId: string; name: string; available: number }[]) {
    super(409, "Stock levels changed while placing your order. Please review your cart.", "STOCK_CONFLICT");
  }
}

export async function createOrderTx(input: CreateOrderInput) {
  const isCod = input.paymentMethod === "COD";
  const initialStatus: OrderStatus = isCod ? "PENDING" : "CONFIRMED";
  const initialPayment = isCod ? "PENDING" : "PAID";
  const num = orderNumber();

  const result = await prisma.$transaction(
    async (tx) => {
      for (const line of input.quote.lines) {
        const res = await tx.product.updateMany({
          where: { id: line.productId, stock: { gte: line.quantity }, active: true },
          data: {
            stock: { decrement: line.quantity },
            sold: { increment: line.quantity },
          },
        });

        if (res.count !== 1) {
          const p = await tx.product.findUnique({
            where: { id: line.productId },
            select: { name: true, stock: true },
          });

          throw new StockConflictError([
            {
              productId: line.productId,
              name: p?.name ?? line.name,
              available: p?.stock ?? 0,
            },
          ]);
        }
      }

      if (input.quote.coupon) {
        const c = await tx.coupon.findUnique({ where: { id: input.quote.coupon.couponId } });
        if (!c || !c.active) throw new AppError(400, "Coupon is no longer valid.", "COUPON_INVALID");
        if (c.usageLimit && c.usedCount >= c.usageLimit) {
          throw new AppError(409, "Coupon usage limit reached.", "COUPON_EXHAUSTED");
        }
      }

      const order = await tx.order.create({
        data: {
          orderNumber: num,
          userId: input.userId,
          guestEmail: input.guestEmail ?? null,
          guestPhone: input.guestPhone ?? null,
          status: initialStatus,
          paymentMethod: input.paymentMethod,
          paymentStatus: initialPayment,
          subtotalMrp: input.quote.subtotalMrp,
          subtotal: input.quote.subtotal,
          itemDiscount: input.quote.itemDiscount,
          couponDiscount: input.quote.coupon?.discount ?? 0,
          couponCode: input.quote.coupon?.code ?? null,
          deliveryFee: input.quote.deliveryFee,
          codFee: input.quote.codFee,
          total: input.quote.total,
          gstRate: 18,
          gstComponent: input.quote.gstComponent,
          deliveryMode: input.quote.deliveryMode,
          etaFrom: input.quote.etaFrom,
          etaTo: input.quote.etaTo,
          addressSnapshot: input.addressSnapshot,
          note: input.note ?? null,
          ip: input.ip ?? null,
          items: {
            create: input.quote.lines.map((l) => ({
              productId: l.productId,
              name: l.name,
              slug: l.slug,
              brand: l.brand,
              image: l.image,
              unitMrp: l.mrp,
              unitPrice: l.salePrice,
              quantity: l.quantity,
              lineTotal: l.lineTotal,
              warrantyMonths: 12,
            })),
          },
          trackingEvents: {
            create: [
              {
                status: initialStatus,
                title: "Order placed",
                description: isCod
                  ? "We'll confirm your order over SMS/call shortly."
                  : "Payment received. Your order is confirmed.",
                location: "Urban Vogue",
              },
            ],
          },
          ...(input.payment
            ? {
                payments: {
                  create: {
                    method: input.paymentMethod,
                    status: "PAID",
                    amountPaise: input.payment.amountPaise,
                    razorpayOrderId: input.payment.razorpayOrderId,
                    razorpayPaymentId: input.payment.razorpayPaymentId,
                    razorpaySignature: input.payment.razorpaySignature,
                    capturedAt: new Date(),
                    rawJson: (input.payment.raw ?? undefined) as never,
                  },
                },
              }
            : {}),
          ...(input.quote.coupon
            ? {
                couponLinks: {
                  create: {
                    couponId: input.quote.coupon.couponId,
                    discount: input.quote.coupon.discount,
                  },
                },
              }
            : {}),
        },
        include: { items: true },
      });

      if (input.quote.coupon) {
        await tx.coupon.update({
          where: { id: input.quote.coupon.couponId },
          data: { usedCount: { increment: 1 } },
        });

        await tx.couponRedemption.create({
          data: {
            couponId: input.quote.coupon.couponId,
            userId: input.userId,
            orderId: order.id,
            discount: input.quote.coupon.discount,
          },
        });
      }

      if (input.userId) {
        const cart = await tx.cart.findUnique({ where: { userId: input.userId } });
        if (cart) {
          await tx.cartItem.deleteMany({
            where: { cartId: cart.id, productId: { in: input.quote.lines.map((l) => l.productId) } },
          });
        }
      }

      return order;
    },
    { isolationLevel: Prisma.TransactionIsolationLevel.ReadCommitted, maxWait: 8000, timeout: 20000 },
  );

  try {
    const customerName =
      ((input.addressSnapshot as { fullName?: string }).fullName ?? "there").split(" ")[0] ?? "there";

    await notify({
      template: "ORDER_PLACED",
      userId: input.userId,
      email: input.guestEmail ?? undefined,
      phone: input.guestPhone ?? undefined,
      ctx: {
        name: customerName,
        orderNumber: result.orderNumber,
        total: inr(result.total),
      },
    });

    if (!isCod) {
      await notify({
        template: "PAYMENT_SUCCESS",
        userId: input.userId,
        ctx: {
          orderNumber: result.orderNumber,
          total: inr(result.total),
          paymentId: input.payment?.razorpayPaymentId ?? "-",
        },
      });
    }

    await notifyStaff({
      template: "ADMIN_NEW_ORDER",
      ctx: {
        orderNumber: result.orderNumber,
        total: inr(result.total),
        items: String(result.items.length),
        customer: input.guestEmail ?? "Guest",
        method: input.paymentMethod,
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("[order:notify]", e);
  }

  return result;
}

export async function refundForConflict(opts: {
  razorpayPaymentId: string;
  amountPaise: number;
  reason: string;
  orderNumber?: string;
}) {
  const { createRefund } = await import("./razorpay");

  try {
    const refund = await createRefund({
      paymentId: opts.razorpayPaymentId,
      amountPaise: opts.amountPaise,
      note: opts.reason,
      speed: "optimum",
    });

    await prisma.notification.create({
      data: {
        audience: "STAFF",
        title: "Auto-refund issued",
        body: `${opts.reason}. Refund ${refund.id} for ₹${(opts.amountPaise / 100).toLocaleString("en-IN")}.`,
        channel: "SYSTEM",
        href: "/admin/orders",
      },
    });

    return refund;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("[refund:conflict]", e);

    await prisma.notification.create({
      data: {
        audience: "STAFF",
        title: "Manual refund required",
        body: `Auto-refund failed for ${opts.orderNumber ?? opts.razorpayPaymentId}: ${String(e)}`,
        channel: "SYSTEM",
        href: "/admin/orders",
      },
    });

    return null;
  }
}

const STATUS_TITLES: Record<OrderStatus, string> = {
  PENDING: "Order placed",
  CONFIRMED: "Order confirmed",
  PROCESSING: "Processing at fulfilment centre",
  SHIPPED: "Shipped",
  OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: "Out for delivery",
  DELIVERED: "Delivered",
  CANCELLED: "Order cancelled",
};

const ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS: Record<OrderStatus, OrderStatus[]> = {
  PENDING: ["CONFIRMED", "CANCELLED"],
  CONFIRMED: ["PROCESSING", "CANCELLED"],
  PROCESSING: ["SHIPPED", "CANCELLED"],
  SHIPPED: ["OUT_FOR_DELIVERY", "DELIVERED"],
  OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: ["DELIVERED"],
  DELIVERED: [],
  CANCELLED: [],
};

export async function advanceStatus(opts: {
  orderId: string;
  status: OrderStatus;
  actorId?: string | null;
  carrier?: string | null;
  tracking?: string | null;
  note?: string | null;
  location?: string | null;
}) {
  const order = await prisma.order.findUnique({
    where: { id: opts.orderId },
    include: {
      items: true,
      user: { select: { id: true, name: true, email: true, phone: true, whatsappOptIn: true } },
      payments: { where: { status: "PAID" }, orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }, take: 1 },
    },
  });

  if (!order) throw new AppError(404, "Order not found.", "NOT_FOUND");

  const current = order.status;
  const next = opts.status;

  if (current !== next && !ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS[current]?.includes(next)) {
    throw new AppError(409, `Cannot move order from ${current} to ${next}.`, "INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION");
  }

  const carrier = opts.carrier ?? order.carrier ?? null;
  const trk = next === "SHIPPED" && !opts.tracking ? trackingNumber() : opts.tracking ?? order.trackingNumber ?? null;

  const updated = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    if (next === "CANCELLED") {
      for (const item of order.items) {
        await tx.product.update({
          where: { id: item.productId },
          data: { stock: { increment: item.quantity } },
        });
      }
    }

    const o = await tx.order.update({
      where: { id: order.id },
      data: {
        status: next,
        carrier,
        trackingNumber: trk,
        deliveredAt: next === "DELIVERED" ? new Date() : order.deliveredAt,
        cancelledAt: next === "CANCELLED" ? new Date() : order.cancelledAt,
        cancelReason: next === "CANCELLED" ? opts.note ?? "Cancelled" : order.cancelReason,
      },
      include: { items: true },
    });

    await tx.trackingEvent.create({
      data: {
        orderId: o.id,
        status: next,
        title: STATUS_TITLES[next],
        description:
          opts.note ??
          (next === "SHIPPED"
            ? `Shipped via ${carrier ?? "partner network"}. Tracking ID ${trk ?? "-"}.`
            : next === "CANCELLED"
              ? "Order cancelled. Stock restored."
              : undefined),
                 location: opts.location ?? (next === "CANCELLED" ? "Urban Vogue" : undefined),
        actorId: opts.actorId ?? null,
      },
    });

    return o;
  });

  try {
    const templateMap: Partial<Record<OrderStatus, Parameters<typeof notify>[0]["template"]>> = {
      CONFIRMED: "ORDER_CONFIRMED",
      PROCESSING: "PROCESSING",
      SHIPPED: "SHIPPED",
      OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY",
      DELIVERED: "DELIVERED",
      CANCELLED: "CANCELLED",
    };

    const template = templateMap[next];

    if (template) {
      await notify({
        template,
        userId: order.userId,
        email: order.user?.email ?? order.guestEmail ?? undefined,
        phone: order.user?.phone ?? order.guestPhone ?? undefined,
        whatsappOptIn: order.user?.whatsappOptIn,
        ctx: {
          name: order.user?.name?.split(" ")[0] ?? "there",
          orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
          total: inr(order.total),
          carrier: carrier ?? "Urban Vogue Partner",
          trackingNumber: trk ?? "-",
          reason: opts.note ?? "Not specified",
          date: updated.etaTo ? addDays(updated.etaTo, 0).toLocaleDateString("en-IN") : "soon",
        },
      });
    }

    if (next === "CANCELLED") {
      await notifyStaff({
        template: "ADMIN_CANCELLATION",
        ctx: {
          orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
          customer: order.user?.name ?? order.guestEmail ?? "Guest",
          reason: opts.note ?? "Cancelled",
        },
      });

      const payment = order.payments[0];

      if (payment?.razorpayPaymentId && order.paymentStatus === "PAID") {
        const { createRefund, razorpayConfigured } = await import("./razorpay");

        if (razorpayConfigured) {
          try {
            const refund = await createRefund({
              paymentId: payment.razorpayPaymentId,
              amountPaise: payment.amountPaise,
              note: `Order cancelled ${order.orderNumber}`,
              speed: "optimum",
            });

            await prisma.payment.update({
              where: { id: payment.id },
              data: {
                status: "REFUNDED",
                refundId: refund.id,
                refundedAmountPaise: payment.amountPaise,
              },
            });

            await prisma.order.update({
              where: { id: order.id },
              data: { paymentStatus: "REFUNDED" },
            });

            await notify({
              template: "REFUND_PROCESSED",
              userId: order.userId,
              email: order.user?.email ?? order.guestEmail ?? undefined,
              ctx: {
                orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
                amount: inr(order.total),
              },
            });
          } catch (e) {
            console.error("[order:cancel:refund]", e);

            await notifyStaff({
              template: "ADMIN_PAYMENT",
              ctx: {
                orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
                total: inr(order.total),
                method: "REFUND_FAILED",
                paymentId: payment.razorpayPaymentId,
              },
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("[order:status:notify]", e);
  }

  return updated;
}

// src/lib/otp.ts
import "server-only";
import crypto from "node:crypto";
import type { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
import { OtpPurpose } from "@prisma/client";
import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { sendSms } from "@/lib/notify";
import { normalizeMobile } from "@/lib/utils";

const DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES = 5;
const DEFAULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
const DEFAULT_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS = 60;

function numEnv(name: string, fallback: number): number {
  const raw = process.env[name];
  if (!raw) return fallback;
  const n = Number(raw);
  return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : fallback;
}

const TTL_MS = numEnv("AUTH_OTP_TTL_MINUTES", DEFAULT_TTL_MINUTES) * 60_000;
const MAX_ATTEMPTS = numEnv("AUTH_OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS", DEFAULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS);
const RESEND_COOLDOWN_MS =
  numEnv("AUTH_OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS", DEFAULT_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS) *
  1000;

function secret(): string {
  const value = process.env.OTP_SECRET || process.env.SESSION_SECRET;
  if (!value || value.length < 32) {
    throw new Error(
      "OTP_SECRET (or SESSION_SECRET) is missing or too short. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 48",
    );
  }
  return value;
}

function hashOtp(purpose: OtpPurpose, phone: string, code: string): string {
  return crypto
    .createHmac("sha256", secret())
    .update(`${purpose}:${phone}:${code}`)
    .digest("hex");
}

function generateCode(): string {
  let s = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) s += crypto.randomInt(0, 10).toString();
  return s;
}

export function maskPhone(phone: string | null | undefined): string {
  const normalized = normalizeMobile(phone);
  if (!normalized) return "***";
  return `${normalized.slice(0, 5)}***${normalized.slice(-2)}`;
}

export type OtpSendResult =
  | {
      ok: true;
      purpose: OtpPurpose;
      phoneMasked: string;
      expiresAt: string;
      resendAfter: string;
      sent: boolean;
      devCode?: string;
    }
  | {
      ok: false;
      error: string;
      code?: "OTP_COOLDOWN" | "INVALID_PHONE" | "SEND_FAILED";
      resendAfter?: string;
    };

export type OtpVerifyResult =
  | { ok: true }
  | {
      ok: false;
      reason:
        | "no_otp"
        | "expired"
        | "invalid"
        | "too_many_attempts"
        | "already_used";
      error: string;
    };

export async function createAndSendOtp(input: {
  purpose: OtpPurpose;
  phone: string;
  userId?: string | null;
  ip?: string | null;
  userAgent?: string | null;
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}): Promise<OtpSendResult> {
  const phone = normalizeMobile(input.phone);
  if (!phone) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      code: "INVALID_PHONE",
      error: "A valid 10-digit Indian mobile number is required.",
    };
  }

  const now = new Date();

  const activeWhere = {
    purpose: input.purpose,
    phone,
    userId: input.userId ?? null,
    consumedAt: null,
    expiresAt: { gt: now },
  } satisfies Prisma.OtpCodeWhereInput;

  const active = await prisma.otpCode.findFirst({
    where: activeWhere,
    orderBy: { sentAt: "desc" },
    select: {
      sentAt: true,
      resendAfter: true,
    },
  });

  if (active) {
    const resendAfter =
      active.resendAfter ??
      new Date(active.sentAt.getTime() + RESEND_COOLDOWN_MS);

    if (resendAfter > now) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        code: "OTP_COOLDOWN",
        error: "Please wait before requesting another code.",
        resendAfter: resendAfter.toISOString(),
      };
    }
  }

  // Invalidate any prior unconsumed code for this purpose/phone/user.
  await prisma.otpCode.updateMany({
    where: activeWhere,
    data: { consumedAt: now },
  });

  const code = generateCode();
  const expiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + TTL_MS);
  const resendAfter = new Date(now.getTime() + RESEND_COOLDOWN_MS);

  await prisma.otpCode.create({
    data: {
      purpose: input.purpose,
      phone,
      userId: input.userId ?? null,
      codeHash: hashOtp(input.purpose, phone, code),
      expiresAt,
      attempts: 0,
      maxAttempts: MAX_ATTEMPTS,
      consumedAt: null,
      sentAt: now,
      resendAfter,
      ip: input.ip ?? null,
      userAgent: input.userAgent?.slice(0, 500) ?? null,
      meta: (input.meta ?? undefined) as Prisma.InputJsonValue | undefined,
    },
  });

  const minutes = Math.round(TTL_MS / 60_000);
  const message = `Your Urban Vogue verification code is ${code}. It expires in ${minutes} minutes. Do not share this code.`;

  const sent = await sendSms(phone, message);

  if (!sent && process.env.NODE_ENV === "production") {
    return {
      ok: false,
      code: "SEND_FAILED",
      error: "Could not send the OTP right now. Please try again.",
    };
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    purpose: input.purpose,
    phoneMasked: maskPhone(phone),
    expiresAt: expiresAt.toISOString(),
    resendAfter: resendAfter.toISOString(),
    sent,
    devCode: !sent && process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production" ? code : undefined,
  };
}

export async function verifyOtp(input: {
  purpose: OtpPurpose;
  phone: string;
  code: string;
  userId?: string | null;
  consume?: boolean;
}): Promise<OtpVerifyResult> {
  const phone = normalizeMobile(input.phone);
  if (!phone) {
    return { ok: false, reason: "invalid", error: "Invalid mobile number." };
  }

  const code = input.code.trim();
  if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(code)) {
    return { ok: false, reason: "invalid", error: "Enter the 6-digit code." };
  }

  const now = new Date();

  const otp = await prisma.otpCode.findFirst({
    where: {
      purpose: input.purpose,
      phone,
      userId: input.userId ?? null,
      consumedAt: null,
    },
    orderBy: { sentAt: "desc" },
  });

  if (!otp) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "no_otp",
      error: "No active code was sent to this number.",
    };
  }

  if (otp.expiresAt <= now) {
    await prisma.otpCode
      .update({
        where: { id: otp.id },
        data: { consumedAt: now },
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);

    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "expired",
      error: "This code has expired. Request a new one.",
    };
  }

  if (otp.attempts >= otp.maxAttempts) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "too_many_attempts",
      error: "Too many incorrect attempts. Request a new code.",
    };
  }

  const incremented = await prisma.otpCode.updateMany({
    where: {
      id: otp.id,
      attempts: { lt: otp.maxAttempts },
      consumedAt: null,
      expiresAt: { gt: now },
    },
    data: {
      attempts: { increment: 1 },
    },
  });

  if (incremented.count !== 1) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "too_many_attempts",
      error: "Too many incorrect attempts. Request a new code.",
    };
  }

  const expected = Buffer.from(otp.codeHash, "utf8");
  const actual = Buffer.from(hashOtp(input.purpose, phone, code), "utf8");

  const match =
    expected.length === actual.length &&
    crypto.timingSafeEqual(expected, actual);

  if (!match) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: "invalid",
      error: "Incorrect OTP. Please try again.",
    };
  }

  if (input.consume !== false) {
    await prisma.otpCode.update({
      where: { id: otp.id },
      data: { consumedAt: new Date() },
    });
  }

  return { ok: true };
}

export async function purgeExpiredOtps(): Promise<{
  expired: number;
  consumed: number;
}> {
  const now = Date.now();

  const expired = await prisma.otpCode.deleteMany({
    where: {
      expiresAt: {
        lt: new Date(now - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
      },
    },
  });

  const consumed = await prisma.otpCode.deleteMany({
    where: {
      consumedAt: {
        lt: new Date(now - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
      },
    },
  });

  return {
    expired: expired.count,
    consumed: consumed.count,
  };
}

/**
 * Per-product PDP info blocks: live defaults + optional admin overrides.
 * Rule: an ABSENT/EMPTY override means "use the default", so dynamic defaults
 * (the delivery date) keep updating; a non-empty override freezes that section.
 * Pure functions, no imports — safe on server and client.
 */
export type PdpBlocksOverride = {
  deliveryDetails?: string[] | null;
  deliveryBy?: string | null;
  soldBy?: string | null;
  peaceOfMind?: string[] | null;
  highlights?: string[] | null;
};

export const DEFAULT_DELIVERY_DETAILS = [
  "Free delivery",
  "Delivery in 3-5 business days",
  "7-day replacement window",
];

export const DEFAULT_PEACE_OF_MIND = [
  "7-day brand support",
  "Cash on Delivery",
  "Urban Vogue Assured",
];

/** "Delivery by Saturday, 14 Nov" — today + 4 days, en-IN formatting. */
export function defaultDeliveryBy(): string {
  const d = new Date(Date.now() + 4 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  const s = d.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "short" });
  return `Delivery by ${s}`;
}

export function defaultSoldBy(): string {
  return "Sold by Urban Vogue";
}

/**
 * Highlight lines derived from product columns. Field names are probed
 * defensively (return-window column name varies) so this module never hard-depends
 * on a column I can't see; missing fields simply omit their line.
 */
export function defaultHighlightsFromProduct(p: any): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  if (p?.ram) out.push(`Size: ${p.ram}`);
  if (p?.storage) out.push(`Fabric: ${p.storage}`);
  if (p?.screenSize) out.push(`Fit: ${p.screenSize}`);
  if (p?.processor) out.push(`Occasion: ${p.processor}`);
  if (p?.color) out.push(`Colour: ${p.color}`);
  const days = p?.returnDays ?? p?.returnWindowDays ?? p?.returnPolicyDays ?? p?.easyReturnDays ?? null;
  if (days) out.push(`${days} day(s) easy return`);
  if (p?.exchangeEligible) out.push("7-day exchange");
  return out;
}

const clean = (v: unknown): string => (typeof v === "string" ? v.trim() : "");
const cleanList = (v: unknown): string[] | null => {
  if (!Array.isArray(v)) return null;
  const out = v.map(clean).filter(Boolean);
  return out.length ? out : null;
};

/** Strip anything unexpected from admin/API input; empty sections are dropped. */
export function sanitizePdpBlocks(raw: unknown): PdpBlocksOverride {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") return {};
  const r = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  const out: PdpBlocksOverride = {};
  const dd = cleanList(r.deliveryDetails); if (dd) out.deliveryDetails = dd;
  const db = clean(r.deliveryBy); if (db) out.deliveryBy = db;
  const sb = clean(r.soldBy); if (sb) out.soldBy = sb;
  const pm = cleanList(r.peaceOfMind); if (pm) out.peaceOfMind = pm;
  const hl = cleanList(r.highlights); if (hl) out.highlights = hl;
  return out;
}

export type ResolvedPdpBlocks = {
  deliveryDetails: string[];
  deliveryBy: string;
  soldBy: string;
  peaceOfMind: string[];
  highlights: string[];
};

/**
 * What the PDP renders. `opts.highlights` = the line list the page derives from
 * product fields today, so resolution never needs to know those columns.
 */
export function resolvePdpBlocks(
  override: PdpBlocksOverride | null | undefined,
  opts: { highlights?: string[] | null } = {},
): ResolvedPdpBlocks {
  const o = override ?? {};
  return {
    deliveryDetails: cleanList(o.deliveryDetails) ?? DEFAULT_DELIVERY_DETAILS,
    deliveryBy: clean(o.deliveryBy) || defaultDeliveryBy(),
    soldBy: clean(o.soldBy) || defaultSoldBy(),
    peaceOfMind: cleanList(o.peaceOfMind) ?? DEFAULT_PEACE_OF_MIND,
    highlights: cleanList(o.highlights) ?? (opts.highlights?.length ? opts.highlights : []),
  };
}

export type ColorOption = { name: string; image: string };
export type VariantOption = { label: string; add: number; mrpAdd: number; available: boolean; note: string };
export type OptionGroup = { name: string; values: { label: string; add: number }[] };

export type ParsedOptions = Partial<{
  colors: string[];
  colorOptions: ColorOption[];
  variants: VariantOption[];
  optionGroups: OptionGroup[];
}>;

const str = (v: unknown, fallback = ""): string => (typeof v === "string" ? v : fallback);
const num = (v: unknown, fallback = 0): number => (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v) ? v : fallback);
const bool = (v: unknown, fallback = true): boolean => (typeof v === "boolean" ? v : fallback);

const normColor = (c: unknown): ColorOption =>
  typeof c === "string"
    ? { name: c.slice(0, 60), image: "" }
    : {
        name: str((c as { name?: unknown })?.name).slice(0, 60),
        image: (c as { image?: unknown })?.image ? str((c as { image?: unknown }).image).slice(0, 500) : "",
      };

/**
 * Sanitizes admin-submitted options. `colors` (String[] column) is derived from the
 * rich list so the two columns can never disagree. Returns only keys present in the
 * body, so spreading into Prisma `data` is a no-op otherwise. All values are
 * string/number/boolean/arrays only, so they satisfy Prisma's Json input type.
 */
export function parseProductOptions(body: any): ParsedOptions {
  if (!body || typeof body !== "object") return {};
  const out: ParsedOptions = {};

  const richSrc: unknown[] = Array.isArray(body.colorOptions)
    ? body.colorOptions
    : Array.isArray(body.colors)
      ? body.colors
      : [];
  if (Array.isArray(body.colorOptions) || Array.isArray(body.colors)) {
    const rich = richSrc.map(normColor).filter((c: ColorOption) => c.name !== "");
    out.colorOptions = rich;
    out.colors = rich.map((c: ColorOption) => c.name);
  }

  if (Array.isArray(body.variants)) {
    out.variants = body.variants
      .map((v: any): VariantOption => ({
        label: str(v?.label).slice(0, 80),
        add: num(v?.add),
        mrpAdd: num(v?.mrpAdd, num(v?.add)),
        available: bool(v?.available),
        note: str(v?.note).slice(0, 120),
      }))
      .filter((v: VariantOption) => v.label !== "");
  }

  if (Array.isArray(body.optionGroups)) {
    out.optionGroups = body.optionGroups
      .map((g: any): OptionGroup => ({
        name: str(g?.name).slice(0, 60),
        values: Array.isArray(g?.values)
          ? g.values
              .map((x: any): { label: string; add: number } => ({ label: str(x?.label).slice(0, 60), add: num(x?.add) }))
              .filter((x: { label: string; add: number }) => x.label !== "")
          : [],
      }))
      .filter((g: OptionGroup) => g.name !== "" && g.values.length > 0);
  }

  return out;
}

import prisma from "./prisma";
import { inspectPincode } from "./delivery";
import {

export type QuoteLine = {
  productId: string;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  brand: string;
  brandSlug: string;
  categorySlug: string;
  categoryName: string;
  image: string;
  mrp: number;

export type QuoteInput = {

  couponCode?: string | null;
  deliveryMode?: "STANDARD" | "EXPRESS";
  paymentMethod?: "UPI" | "CARD" | "NETBANKING" | "WALLET" | "COD";

const FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD = 999;
const STANDARD_DELIVERY_FEE = 49;
const EXPRESS_DELIVERY_FEE = 99;
const COD_FEE = 49;
const GST_RATE = 18;

function imageFromProduct(images: { url: string; isPrimary: boolean }[], slug: string) {
  const primary = images.find((i) => i.isPrimary) ?? images[0];
  return primary?.url ?? "/placeholder-banner-bg.jpg";
}

export async function computeQuote(input: QuoteInput): Promise<Quote> {
  const deliveryMode = input.deliveryMode ?? "STANDARD";
  const paymentMethod = input.paymentMethod ?? "UPI";
  const now = new Date();

  const requested = input.items.filter((i) => i.productId && i.quantity > 0);

  if (!requested.length) {
    return {
      lines: [],
      itemCount: 0,
      subtotalMrp: 0,
      subtotal: 0,
      itemDiscount: 0,
      coupon: null,
      couponError: null,
      deliveryFee: 0,
      codFee: 0,
      total: 0,
      savingsTotal: 0,
      gstComponent: 0,
      deliveryMode,
      etaFrom: businessDays(now, 3),
      etaTo: businessDays(now, 6),
      stockIssues: [],
      couponApplicableSubtotal: 0,
    };
  }

  const ids = Array.from(new Set(requested.map((i) => i.productId)));

  const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: { id: { in: ids } },
    select: {
      id: true,
      slug: true,
      name: true,
      mrp: true,
      salePrice: true,
      discountPercent: true,
      ratingAvg: true,
      ratingCount: true,
      stock: true,
      active: true,
      emiEligible: true,
      exchangeEligible: true,
      codEligible: true,
      category: { select: { slug: true, name: true } },
      brand: { select: { slug: true, name: true } },
      images: {
        select: { url: true, isPrimary: true, position: true },
        orderBy: { position: "asc" },
      },
    },
  });

  const productMap = new Map(products.map((p) => [p.id, p]));
  const lines: QuoteLine[] = [];
  const stockIssues: Quote["stockIssues"] = [];

  for (const req of requested) {
    const p = productMap.get(req.productId);

    if (!p || !p.active) {
      stockIssues.push({
        productId: req.productId,
        name: "Unavailable product",
        requested: req.quantity,
        available: 0,
      });
      continue;
    }

    if (p.stock < req.quantity) {
      stockIssues.push({
        productId: p.id,
        name: p.name,
        requested: req.quantity,
        available: p.stock,
      });
    }

    lines.push({
      productId: p.id,
      slug: p.slug,
      name: p.name,
      brand: p.brand.name,
      brandSlug: p.brand.slug,
      categorySlug: p.category.slug,
      categoryName: p.category.name,
      image: imageFromProduct(p.images, p.slug),
      mrp: p.mrp,
      salePrice: p.salePrice,
      quantity: req.quantity,
      lineMrp: p.mrp * req.quantity,
      lineTotal: p.salePrice * req.quantity,
            discountPercent: p.discountPercent || discountPercent(p.mrp, p.salePrice),
      ratingAvg: p.ratingAvg,
      ratingCount: p.ratingCount,
      stock: p.stock,
      inStock: p.stock > 0,
      emiEligible: p.emiEligible,
      exchangeEligible: p.exchangeEligible,
      codEligible: p.codEligible,
    });
  }

  const itemCount = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.quantity, 0);
  const subtotalMrp = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.lineMrp, 0);
  const subtotal = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.lineTotal, 0);
  const itemDiscount = subtotalMrp - subtotal;

  let coupon: CouponResult | null = null;
  let couponError: string | null = null;
  let couponApplicableSubtotal = subtotal;

  if (input.couponCode && lines.length) {
    const code = input.couponCode.trim().toUpperCase();

    const c = await prisma.coupon.findUnique({
      where: { code },
      include: {
        category: { select: { slug: true, name: true } },
        brand: { select: { slug: true, name: true } },
      },
    });

    if (!c) {
      couponError = "Coupon code not found.";
    } else if (!c.active) {
      couponError = "This coupon is no longer active.";
    } else if (c.startsAt > now) {
      couponError = "This coupon is not active yet.";
    } else if (c.endsAt && c.endsAt < now) {
      couponError = "This coupon has expired.";
    } else if (subtotal < c.minOrderValue) {
      couponError = `Minimum order value of ₹${c.minOrderValue.toLocaleString("en-IN")} required.`;
    } else if (c.usageLimit && c.usedCount >= c.usageLimit) {
      couponError = "This coupon has reached its usage limit.";
    } else {
      if (input.userId && c.perUserLimit) {
        const usedByUser = await prisma.couponRedemption.count({
          where: { couponId: c.id, userId: input.userId },
        });

        if (usedByUser >= c.perUserLimit) {
          couponError = "You have already used this coupon.";
        }
      }

      if (!couponError) {
        const applicableLines =
          c.scope === "ALL"
            ? lines
            : c.scope === "CATEGORY"
              ? lines.filter((l) => l.categorySlug === c.category?.slug)
              : lines.filter((l) => l.brandSlug === c.brand?.slug);

        couponApplicableSubtotal = applicableLines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.lineTotal, 0);

        if (couponApplicableSubtotal <= 0) {
          couponError =
            c.scope === "ALL"
              ? "Coupon not applicable to this cart."
              : `Coupon applies only to ${c.category?.name ?? c.brand?.name ?? "selected products"}.`;
        } else {
          let discount =
            c.type === "PERCENT"
              ? Math.round((couponApplicableSubtotal * c.value) / 100)
              : c.value;

          if (c.maxDiscount) discount = Math.min(discount, c.maxDiscount);
          discount = Math.min(discount, couponApplicableSubtotal);

          coupon = {
            couponId: c.id,
            code: c.code,
            description: c.description,
            type: c.type,
            value: c.value,
            discount,
          };
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const couponDiscount = coupon?.discount ?? 0;
  const payableAfterCoupon = Math.max(0, subtotal - couponDiscount);

  const deliveryFee =
    lines.length === 0
      ? 0
      : deliveryMode === "EXPRESS"
        ? EXPRESS_DELIVERY_FEE
        : payableAfterCoupon >= FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD
          ? 0
          : STANDARD_DELIVERY_FEE;

  const codFee =
    paymentMethod === "COD" && lines.length > 0 && lines.every((l) => l.codEligible)
      ? COD_FEE
      : 0;

  const total = payableAfterCoupon + deliveryFee + codFee;

  let etaFrom = businessDays(now, deliveryMode === "EXPRESS" ? 1 : 3);
  let etaTo = businessDays(now, deliveryMode === "EXPRESS" ? 2 : 6);

      if (input.pincode) {
      const inspection = await inspectPincode(input.pincode); // ✅ Awaited
            if (inspection.serviceable) {
        // etaFrom/etaTo are Date here (from businessDays above); inspection
        // returns ISO strings that may be null -> coerce + keep prior value on null.
        if (inspection.etaFrom) etaFrom = new Date(inspection.etaFrom);
        if (inspection.etaTo)   etaTo   = new Date(inspection.etaTo);
      }
    }
  return {
    lines,
    itemCount,
    subtotalMrp,
    subtotal,
    itemDiscount,
    coupon,
    couponError,
    deliveryFee,
    codFee,
    total,
    savingsTotal: itemDiscount + couponDiscount,
    gstComponent: gstComponent(total, GST_RATE),
    deliveryMode,
    etaFrom,
    etaTo,
    stockIssues,
    couponApplicableSubtotal,
  };
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

export type RateLimitResult = {
  success: boolean;
  limit: number;
  remaining: number;
  reset: number;
};

const WINDOW_SECONDS = 60;

const LIMITS: Record<string, number> = {
  login: 10,
  register: 5,
  forgot: 5,
  reset: 5,
  order: 10,
  search: 120,
  track: 30,
  form: 10,
  adminMutation: 120,
  // Read-only shopping operations (quote revalidation, pincode serviceability) need
  // higher limits than write-form operations (address save, order placement) because
  // shoppers legitimately trigger them rapidly via steppers, delivery-mode toggles,
  // and payment-method flips. 60/min is 1 request/second sustained, which handles
  // normal human speed with headroom for coalesced bursts.
  quote: 60,
  delivery: 60,
  otpSend: 5,
  otpVerify: 10,
};

type MemoryEntry = {
  count: number;
  reset: number;
};

const memory = new Map<string, MemoryEntry>();

let redis: unknown | null | undefined;

async function getRedis() {
  if (redis !== undefined) return redis;

  const url = process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL;
  const token = process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN;

  if (!url || !token) {
    redis = null;
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const mod = (await import("@upstash/redis")) as {
      Redis: new (config: { url: string; token: string }) => unknown;
    };

    redis = new mod.Redis({ url, token });
    return redis;
  } catch {
    redis = null;
    return null;
  }
}

export function clientIp(req: Request): string {
  const forwarded = req.headers.get("x-forwarded-for");
  if (forwarded) return forwarded.split(",")[0]?.trim() ?? "unknown";

  const real = req.headers.get("x-real-ip");
  if (real) return real.trim();

  return "unknown";
}

export async function rateLimit(
  name: string,
  identifier: string,
): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
  const limit = LIMITS[name] ?? 30;
  const key = `urbanvogue:rl:${name}:${identifier}`;
  const r = await getRedis() as {
    incr?: (key: string) => Promise<number>;
    expire?: (key: string, seconds: number) => Promise<unknown>;
    ttl?: (key: string) => Promise<number>;
  } | null;

  if (r?.incr) {
    const count = await r.incr(key);

    if (count === 1 && r.expire) {
      await r.expire(key, WINDOW_SECONDS);
    }

    const ttl = r.ttl ? await r.ttl(key) : WINDOW_SECONDS;
    const reset = Math.ceil((Date.now() + Math.max(0, ttl) * 1000) / 1000);

    return {
      success: count <= limit,
      limit,
      remaining: Math.max(0, limit - count),
      reset,
    };
  }

  const now = Date.now();
  const existing = memory.get(key);

  if (!existing || existing.reset <= now) {
    const reset = now + WINDOW_SECONDS * 1000;
    memory.set(key, { count: 1, reset });

    return {
      success: true,
      limit,
      remaining: limit - 1,
      reset: Math.ceil(reset / 1000),
    };
  }

  existing.count += 1;

  return {
    success: existing.count <= limit,
    limit,
    remaining: Math.max(0, limit - existing.count),
    reset: Math.ceil(existing.reset / 1000),
  };
}

export function tooMany(result: RateLimitResult) {
  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      ok: false,
      error: "Too many requests. Please slow down and try again.",
      code: "RATE_LIMITED",
    },
    {
      status: 429,
      headers: {
        "Retry-After": String(Math.max(1, result.reset - Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000))),
        "X-RateLimit-Limit": String(result.limit),
        "X-RateLimit-Remaining": String(result.remaining),
        "X-RateLimit-Reset": String(result.reset),
      },
    },
  );
}

// One source of truth for the demo rating scheme. Used by the admin create route
// (future products) AND the backfill seed (today's products) so both agree exactly.

export const SAMPLE_REVIEWS = [
  { rating: 5, title: "Excellent build", body: "Arrived in two days, packaging was solid. The aluminium body feels premium and the screen is genuinely bright. No complaints so far." },
  { rating: 5, title: "Worth the price", body: "Upgraded from a 3-year-old machine and the difference is night and day. Boots fast, runs my dev stack without the fan screaming." },
  { rating: 4, title: "Very good, minor nit", body: "Performance and display are great. Only gripe is the charger brick is bulky — would have liked a smaller adapter. Otherwise happy." },
  { rating: 5, title: "Smooth and quiet", body: "Keyboard travel is comfortable, trackpad is accurate, and it stays cool during long sessions. Delivery was on time too." },
  { rating: 4, title: "Solid laptop", body: "Does everything I need for work and light editing. Speakers are average but the panel and battery life make up for it." },
  { rating: 5, title: "Highly recommend", body: "GST invoice came through cleanly and warranty registration was easy. Build quality matches what Urban Vogue listed. Happy buyer." },
];

export const REVIEW_TARGET = 6; // max sample cards per product (capped by your user pool)

/** Deterministic, varied, ALWAYS >= 1200. Spread straight into a Prisma create/update `data`. */
export function seedRating(name: string): { ratingCount: number; ratingAvg: number } {
  const h = hash(name) >>> 0;
  return {
    ratingCount: 1200 + (h % 301),          // 1200..1500
    ratingAvg: +(((41 + ((h >>> 3) % 7))) / 10).toFixed(1), // 4.1..4.7
  };
}

/** Build review rows from a DISTINCT userId list (caller guarantees freshness -> @@unique safe). */
export function buildReviewPicks(productId: string, userIds: string[], count = userIds.length) {
  const n = Math.min(count, userIds.length, SAMPLE_REVIEWS.length);
  const off = hash(productId) >>> 0;
  return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => {
    const r = SAMPLE_REVIEWS[(off + i) % SAMPLE_REVIEWS.length]!;
    const u = userIds[i]!;
    return { productId, userId: u, rating: r.rating, title: r.title, body: r.body };
  });
}

function hash(s: string) { let h = 0; for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) h = (h * 31 + s.charCodeAt(i)) | 0; return h; }

import crypto from "node:crypto";

export const razorpayConfigured = Boolean(
  process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_ID && process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET,
);

export function publicKeyId(): string | null {
  return process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_ID ?? null;
}

function basicAuth() {
  const key = process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_ID;
  const secret = process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET;

  if (!key || !secret) {
    throw new Error("Razorpay is not configured.");
  }

  return Buffer.from(`${key}:${secret}`).toString("base64");
}

function safeEqual(a: string, b: string) {
  const bufA = Buffer.from(a ?? "", "utf8");
  const bufB = Buffer.from(b ?? "", "utf8");

  if (bufA.length !== bufB.length) return false;
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(bufA, bufB);
}

export async function createRazorpayOrder(input: {
  amountPaise: number;
  receipt: string;
  notes?: Record<string, string>;
}) {
  const res = await fetch("https://api.razorpay.com/v1/orders", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Basic ${basicAuth()}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      amount: input.amountPaise,
      currency: "INR",
      receipt: input.receipt,
      notes: input.notes ?? {},
    }),
  });

  const json = (await res.json()) as {
    id?: string;
    error?: { description?: string };
  };

  if (!res.ok || !json.id) {
    throw new Error(json.error?.description ?? "Could not create Razorpay order.");
  }

  return json as { id: string; amount: number; currency: string; status: string };
}

export function verifyPaymentSignature(input: {
  razorpay_order_id: string;
  razorpay_payment_id: string;
  razorpay_signature: string;
}) {
  const secret = process.env.RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET;
  if (!secret) return false;

  const expected = crypto
    .createHmac("sha256", secret)
    .update(`${input.razorpay_order_id}|${input.razorpay_payment_id}`)
    .digest("hex");

  return safeEqual(expected, input.razorpay_signature);
}

export function verifyWebhookSignature(rawBody: string, signature: string | null) {
  const secret = process.env.RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET;
  if (!secret || !signature) return false;

  const expected = crypto
    .createHmac("sha256", secret)
    .update(rawBody)
    .digest("hex");

  return safeEqual(expected, signature);
}

export async function createRefund(input: {
  paymentId: string;
  amountPaise: number;
  note?: string;
  speed?: "normal" | "optimum";
}) {
  const res = await fetch(`https://api.razorpay.com/v1/payments/${input.paymentId}/refund`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Basic ${basicAuth()}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      amount: input.amountPaise,
      note: input.note ?? "Urban Vogue refund",
      speed: input.speed ?? "optimum",
    }),
  });

  const json = (await res.json()) as {
    id?: string;
    status?: string;
    error?: { description?: string };
  };

  if (!res.ok || !json.id) {
    throw new Error(json.error?.description ?? "Could not create Razorpay refund.");
  }

  return json as { id: string; status: string; amount: number };
}

/**
 * SIZE CHART REGISTRY — the ONLY place garment measurements live.
 *
 * ── DATA HONESTY ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * The `tshirt` rows below are a STANDARD INDIAN‑MENSWEAR BASELINE (monotonic
 * XS→3XL ladder in centimetres). They are NOT any brand's published spec.
 * Swap each `cm` array for the brand‑official chart when you have it — the
 * INCHES column is derived from cm at render time, so fixing cm fixes both.
 *
 * Garments other than `tshirt` are intentionally EMPTY (rows: []). The modal and
 * the trigger hide themselves for an empty chart, so no broken/blank chart ever
 * reaches a shopper. To enable one later: fill `rows` (and set `diagram`), done.
 * ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 */

export type ChartColumn = string;            // header text, e.g. "CHEST"
export type ChartRow = { size: string; cm: number[] }; // cm aligned to columns

export type DiagramKey = "tee" | "shirt" | "blazer" | "sweater" | "trouser" | "shoe" | "generic";

export type SizeChart = {
  label: string;            // shown in the modal header line, e.g. "T‑Shirt"
  columns: ChartColumn[];   // measurement columns AFTER the SIZE column
  rows: ChartRow[];         // empty => chart disabled
  diagram: DiagramKey;
  /** Header for the first (size) column; defaults to "SIZE". */
  sizeHeader?: string;
  /** Indices of columns that are physical lengths converted by the CM|INCHES
      toggle. Defaults to EVERY column. Size-code columns (IND/UK/US/EURO) opt
      out so the toggle never divides a UK 6 by 2.54. */
  unitCols?: number[];
  /** Optional numbered measuring steps rendered under the diagram. */
  howTo?: string[];
  /** Optional italic tip rendered after the steps. */
  tip?: string;
};

/** cm → inches, one decimal. Derived so the file stores cm only. */
export const toInches = (cm: number) => Number((cm / 2.54).toFixed(1));

/**
 * Map a product's `subtype` (the value you already store) to a chart key.
 * Returns null when there's no chart → the Size Chart link is not rendered.
 * Today only knit tees resolve; woven shirts/blazers/etc. return null until
 * their rows are filled above.
 */
export function garmentForSubtype(subtype?: string | null): string | null {
  if (!subtype) return null;
  const s = subtype.toLowerCase();
  if (s.includes("t-shirt") || s.includes("tshirt") || s.includes("polo")) return "tshirt";
  if (s.includes("shirt")) return "shirt";          // hidden until rows filled
  if (s.includes("blazer") || s.includes("jacket")) return "blazer";
  if (s.includes("sweater") || s.includes("hoodie")) return "sweater";
  if (s.includes("trouser") || s.includes("chino") || s.includes("jean") || s.includes("denim")) return "trouser";
  if (s.includes("sneaker") || s.includes("shoe") || s.includes("loafer") || s.includes("boot")) return "shoe";
  return null;
}

export type GradientThemeId =

import crypto from "node:crypto";

function secretKey(): Uint8Array | null {
  const value = process.env.SESSION_SECRET;
  if (!value || value.length < 32) return null;
  return new TextEncoder().encode(value);
}

export function createGuestTrackToken(orderNumber: string): string {
  const key = secretKey();
  if (!key) return "";

  return crypto
    .createHmac("sha256", key)
    .update(`urbanvogue:track:${orderNumber}`)
    .digest("base64url");
}

export function verifyGuestTrackToken(
  orderNumber: string,
  token?: string | null,
): boolean {
  const key = secretKey();
  if (!key || !token) return false;

  const expected = crypto
    .createHmac("sha256", key)
    .update(`urbanvogue:track:${orderNumber}`)
    .digest();

  const actual = Buffer.from(token, "base64url");

  if (expected.length !== actual.length) return false;

  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(expected, actual);
}

import { clsx, type ClassValue } from "clsx";
import { twMerge } from "tailwind-merge";

export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs));
}

export const PINCODE_RE = /^[1-9]\d{5}$/;
export const MOBILE_RE = /^[6-9]\d{9}$/;

export class AppError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public status: number,
    message: string,
    public code?: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "AppError";
  }
}

export function siteUrl(path = "/"): string {
  const base =
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL?.replace(/\/$/, "") ||
    "http://localhost:3000";

  const cleanPath = path.startsWith("/") ? path : `/${path}`;
  return `${base}${cleanPath === "/" ? "" : cleanPath}`;
}

export function inr(value: number | null | undefined): string {
  const n = Number(value ?? 0);
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "INR",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(n);
}

export function paise(rupees: number): number {
  return Math.round(Number(rupees || 0) * 100);
}

export function savings(mrp: number, sale: number): number {
  return Math.max(0, Number(mrp || 0) - Number(sale || 0));
}

export function discountPercent(mrp: number, sale: number): number {
  const m = Number(mrp || 0);
  const s = Number(sale || 0);
  if (m <= 0 || s >= m) return 0;
  return Math.round(((m - s) / m) * 100);
}

export function gstComponent(gross: number, rate = 18): number {
  const g = Number(gross || 0);
  return Math.round(g - g / (1 + rate / 100));
}

export function slugify(input: string): string {
  return input
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize("NFKD")
    .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, "")
    .trim()
    .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
    .replace(/-+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, "");
}

export function sanitizeText(input: string, max = 2000): string {
  return String(input ?? "")
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, max);
}

export function excerpt(input: string, max = 160): string {
  const text = sanitizeText(input, max + 20);
  if (text.length <= max) return text;
  return `${text.slice(0, max).trim()}…`;
}

export function normalizeMobile(input: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  const raw = String(input ?? "").replace(/\D/g, "");
  if (!raw) return null;

  let digits = raw;
  if (digits.length === 12 && digits.startsWith("91")) digits = digits.slice(2);
  if (digits.length === 11 && digits.startsWith("0")) digits = digits.slice(1);
  if (digits.length > 10) digits = digits.slice(-10);

  return MOBILE_RE.test(digits) ? digits : null;
}

export function toE164(input: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  const mobile = normalizeMobile(input);
  return mobile ? `91${mobile}` : null;
}

export function formatDate(value: string | Date | null | undefined): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  return new Date(value).toLocaleDateString("en-IN", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

export function formatDateTime(value: string | Date | null | undefined): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  return new Date(value).toLocaleString("en-IN", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

export function relativeTime(value: string | Date | null | undefined): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  const d = new Date(value);
  const diff = Date.now() - d.getTime();
  const sec = Math.round(diff / 1000);

  if (sec < 60) return "just now";
  const min = Math.round(sec / 60);
  if (min < 60) return `${min}m ago`;
  const hr = Math.round(min / 60);
  if (hr < 24) return `${hr}h ago`;
  const day = Math.round(hr / 24);
  if (day < 30) return `${day}d ago`;
  return formatDate(d);
}

export function addDays(date: Date | string, days: number): Date {
  const d = new Date(date);
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + days);
  return d;
}

export function businessDays(from: Date | string, days: number): Date {
  let d = new Date(from);
  let added = 0;

  while (added < days) {
    d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1);
    const day = d.getDay();
    if (day !== 0 && day !== 6) added += 1;
  }

  return d;
}

export function emiPlans(
  price: number,
): { months: number; perMonth: number; total: number }[] {
  const p = Number(price || 0);
  if (p < 2500) return [];

  const months = [3, 6, 9, 12];
  return months.map((m) => {
    const perMonth = Math.ceil(p / m);
    return {
      months: m,
      perMonth,
      total: perMonth * m,
    };
  });
}

export function reference(prefix = "UVREF"): string {
  return `${prefix}-${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase().slice(-6)}${Math.random()
    .toString(36)
    .slice(2, 5)
    .toUpperCase()}`;
}

export function orderNumber(): string {
  return `VK${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase().slice(-8)}${Math.random()
    .toString(36)
    .slice(2, 5)
    .toUpperCase()}`;
}

export function trackingNumber(): string {
  return `UVTRK${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase().slice(-7)}${Math.random()
    .toString(36)
    .slice(2, 5)
    .toUpperCase()}`;
}

export async function jsonError(error: unknown, fallback = "Something went wrong.") {
  const { NextResponse } = await import("next/server");

  if (error instanceof AppError) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        ok: false,
        error: error.message,
        code: error.code,
      },
      { status: error.status },
    );
  }

  if (
    error &&
    typeof error === "object" &&
    "issues" in error &&
    Array.isArray((error as { issues?: unknown[] }).issues)
  ) {
    const issues = (error as { issues: { message?: string }[] }).issues;
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        ok: false,
        error: issues[0]?.message ?? fallback,
      },
      { status: 422 },
    );
  }

  console.error("[jsonError]", error);

  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      ok: false,
      error: fallback,
    },
    { status: 500 },
  );
}
