import { z } from "zod";

const MOBILE_RE = /^[6-9]\d{9}$/;
const PINCODE_RE = /^[1-9]\d{5}$/;

export const email = z.string().trim().email("Enter a valid email").toLowerCase();

export const mobile = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .regex(MOBILE_RE, "Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number");

export const optionalMobile = z
  .union([mobile, z.literal("")])
  .optional()
  .transform((v) => (v === "" ? undefined : v));

export const pincode = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .regex(PINCODE_RE, "Enter a valid 6-digit Indian PIN code");

export const nonNegInt = z.coerce.number().int().min(0);
export const positiveInt = z.coerce.number().int().min(1);

export const booleanParam = z.preprocess((v) => {
  if (v === "true" || v === true) return true;
  if (v === "false" || v === false) return false;
  return undefined;
}, z.boolean().optional());

export const PASSWORD_RULES = [
  {
    id: "length",
    label: "At least 10 characters",
    test: (v: string) => v.length >= 10,
  },
  {
    id: "upper",
    label: "One uppercase letter",
    test: (v: string) => /[A-Z]/.test(v),
  },
  {
    id: "lower",
    label: "One lowercase letter",
    test: (v: string) => /[a-z]/.test(v),
  },
  {
    id: "number",
    label: "One number",
    test: (v: string) => /\d/.test(v),
  },
  {
    id: "special",
    label: "One special character",
    test: (v: string) => /[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(v),
  },
] as const;

export const password = z
  .string()
  .min(10, "Password must be at least 10 characters")
  .superRefine((v, ctx) => {
    for (const rule of PASSWORD_RULES) {
      if (!rule.test(v)) {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
          message: rule.label,
        });
      }
    }
  });

FILE: src\middleware.ts
============================================================

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { verifySession, SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, isStaffRole } from "@/lib/auth/session";

const PROTECTED_PAGES = ["/account"];
const ADMIN_PUBLIC = ["/admin/login"];

function securityHeaders(res: NextResponse): NextResponse {
  res.headers.set("X-Frame-Options", "DENY");
  res.headers.set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
  res.headers.set("Referrer-Policy", "strict-origin-when-cross-origin");
  res.headers.set(
    "Permissions-Policy",
    "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(self), interest-cohort=()",
  );
  return res;
}

export async function middleware(req: NextRequest) {
  const { pathname, search } = req.nextUrl;
  const token = req.cookies.get(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME)?.value;
  const session = token ? await verifySession(token) : null;

  const isApi = pathname.startsWith("/api");
  const wantsJson = isApi || req.headers.get("accept")?.includes("application/json");

  const upstream = NextResponse.next({
    request: {
      headers: new Headers(req.headers),
    },
  });

  if (session) {
    upstream.headers.set("x-vk-user", session.sub);
    upstream.headers.set("x-vk-role", session.role);
  }

  securityHeaders(upstream);

  /* Admin surface */
  if (pathname.startsWith("/admin")) {
    const isPublicAdminPage = ADMIN_PUBLIC.some(
      (p) => pathname === p || pathname.startsWith(`${p}/`),
    );

    if (!isPublicAdminPage) {
      if (!session) {
        if (wantsJson) {
          return NextResponse.json(
            { ok: false, code: "UNAUTHENTICATED", error: "Sign in required." },
            { status: 401 },
          );
        }
        return redirectTo(req, `/admin/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(pathname + search)}`);
      }

      if (!isStaffRole(session.role)) {
        if (wantsJson) {
          return NextResponse.json(
            { ok: false, code: "FORBIDDEN", error: "Access denied." },
            { status: 403 },
          );
        }
        return redirectTo(req, "/forbidden");
      }
    } else if (session && isStaffRole(session.role)) {
      return redirectTo(req, "/admin/dashboard");
    }

    return upstream;
  }

  if (pathname.startsWith("/forbidden") || pathname.startsWith("/auth")) {
    return upstream;
  }

  /* Customer protected pages. Checkout is intentionally guest-friendly. */
  if (PROTECTED_PAGES.some((p) => pathname === p || pathname.startsWith(`${p}/`))) {
    if (!session) {
      if (wantsJson) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { ok: false, code: "UNAUTHENTICATED", error: "Sign in required." },
          { status: 401 },
        );
      }
      return redirectTo(req, `/auth/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(pathname + search)}`);
    }
  }

  /* Only hard-gate admin APIs here. Other APIs enforce their own auth. */
  if (isApi && pathname.startsWith("/api/admin")) {
    if (!session) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, code: "UNAUTHENTICATED", error: "Sign in required." },
        { status: 401 },
      );
    }
    if (!isStaffRole(session.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { ok: false, code: "FORBIDDEN", error: "Access denied." },
        { status: 403 },
      );
    }
  }

  return upstream;
}

function redirectTo(req: NextRequest, dest: string) {
  const res = NextResponse.redirect(new URL(dest, req.url));
  return securityHeaders(res);
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ["/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|robots.txt|sitemap.xml|api/webhooks).*)"],
};

// src/scripts/probe-rail-groups.ts
// READ-ONLY. Reports, per arrow-targeted rail group: matcher, item-label match
// pass/fail, current active matching-product count, and a reusable primary image.
// Changes nothing. Run: npx tsx src/scripts/probe-rail-groups.ts
import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
import { MEN_GROUPS } from "../lib/men-taxonomy";

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

const TARGET = [
  "Sports & Fitness Store", "Smart Watches", "Smart Bands", "Personal Care Appliances",
  "Featured", "Men's Grooming", "Fabrics", "Ethnic wear", "Raincoats & Windcheaters",
];

const termOf = (href: string) => {
  const i = href.indexOf("q=");
  return i === -1 ? "" : decodeURIComponent(href.slice(i + 2));
};

async function main() {
  const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: { active: true },
    select: {
      name: true, subtype: true,
      brand: { select: { name: true } },
      images: { where: { kind: "GALLERY" }, orderBy: [{ isPrimary: "desc" }, { position: "asc" }], take: 1, select: { url: true } },
    },
  });
  const hay = (r: any) => `${r.name} ${r.subtype ?? ""}`.toLowerCase();
  const hayBrand = (r: any) => `${r.name} ${r.brand?.name ?? ""}`.toLowerCase();

  for (const label of TARGET) {
    const g = MEN_GROUPS.find((x) => x.label.toLowerCase() === label.toLowerCase());
    if (!g) { console.log(`\n### ${label}  -> NOT FOUND in MEN_GROUPS (check exact label)`); continue; }
    const re = g.matcher ? new RegExp(g.matcher, "i") : null;
    const matched = re
      ? rows.filter((r) => re.test(hay(r)))
      : rows.filter((r) => g.items.some((it) => { const t = termOf(it.href).toLowerCase(); return t && hayBrand(r).includes(t); }));
    const img = matched.find((r) => r.images[0]?.url)?.images[0]?.url ?? null;
    console.log(`\n### ${g.label}  (slug: ${g.slug})`);
    console.log(`    matcher: ${g.matcher ?? "(none — brand/item-term group)"}`);
    console.log(`    current matching active products: ${matched.length}`);
    console.log(`    reusable primary image: ${img ?? "(none -> tile stays icon until upload)"}`);
    console.log(`    item labels -> would a product NAMED like this match the group?`);
    for (const it of g.items) {
      const ok = re ? re.test(it.label) : g.items.some((x) => { const t = termOf(x.href).toLowerCase(); return t && it.label.toLowerCase().includes(t); });
      console.log(`      ${ok ? "PASS" : "fail"}  "${it.label}"`);
    }
  }
}
main().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); }).finally(async () => { await prisma.$disconnect(); });

FILE: src\scripts\seed-all-specs.ts

import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
import { APPLIANCE_TEMPLATES, PHONE_TEMPLATES } from "../../prisma/spec-templates";

const prisma = new PrismaClient();

async function main() {
  const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
    include: { brand: true, category: true },
  });

  for (const product of products) {
    // Determine template based on category slug or product name
    const cat = product.category.slug.toLowerCase();
    let template;
    if (cat.includes("wash") || product.name.toLowerCase().includes("washing")) {
      template = APPLIANCE_TEMPLATES["washing-machine"];
    } else if (cat.includes("phone") || cat.includes("mobile") || (product.subtype ?? "").includes("Smartphone")) {
      template = PHONE_TEMPLATES.smartphone;
    } else {
      continue; // skip categories without templates yet
    }

    // Replace placeholders with actual product data
    const specs = template.map((spec) => ({
      productId: product.id,
      group: spec.group,
      label: spec.label,
      value: spec.value
        .replace("{brand}", product.brand.name)
        .replace("{subtype}", product.subtype ?? product.name)
        .replace("{categoryName}", product.category.name)
        .replace("{screenSize}", product.screenSize ?? "—")
        .replace("{processor}", product.processor ?? "—")
        .replace("{ram}", product.ram ?? "—")
        .replace("{storage}", product.storage ?? "—")
        .replace("{warrantyMonths}", String(product.warrantyMonths)),
    }));

    // Delete old specs for this product, then insert fresh ones
    await prisma.productSpecification.deleteMany({ where: { productId: product.id } });
    await prisma.productSpecification.createMany({ data: specs });
    console.log(`✓ Seeded ${specs.length} specs for ${product.name}`);
  }
}

main()
  .catch(console.error)
  .finally(() => prisma.$disconnect());

async function ensureRef(model: "brand" | "category", ref: Ref): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    if (model === "brand") {
      const found = await prisma.brand.findFirst({ where: { slug: ref.slug } });
      if (found) { await prisma.brand.update({ where: { id: found.id }, data: { name: ref.name } }); return found.id; }
      const created = await prisma.brand.create({ data: { name: ref.name, slug: ref.slug } });
      return created.id;
    } else {
      const found = await prisma.category.findFirst({ where: { slug: ref.slug } });
      if (found) { await prisma.category.update({ where: { id: found.id }, data: { name: ref.name } }); return found.id; }
      const created = await prisma.category.create({ data: { name: ref.name, slug: ref.slug } });
      return created.id;
    }
  } catch (e) { errors.push(`${model} "${ref.slug}": ${msg(e)}`); return null; }
}

async function ensureProduct(p: Prod, brandId: string, categoryId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const discountPercent = p.mrp > p.salePrice ? Math.round(((p.mrp - p.salePrice) / p.mrp) * 100) : 0;
  const data = {
    name: p.name, slug: p.slug, shortDescription: p.short, description: "",
    subtype: p.subtype, groupId: "", ram: p.size, storage: "", screenSize: "", processor: "",
    color: p.color, mrp: p.mrp, salePrice: p.salePrice, discountPercent,
    stock: 20, lowStockAt: 5, warrantyMonths: 12, hsnCode: "", tags: [] as string[],
    codEligible: true, emiEligible: true, exchangeEligible: true, featured: false, active: true,
    categoryId, brandId,
  };
  try {
    const found = await prisma.product.findFirst({ where: { slug: p.slug } });
    if (found) await prisma.product.update({ where: { id: found.id }, data });
    else await prisma.product.create({ data });
    return true;
  } catch (e) { errors.push(`product "${p.slug}": ${msg(e)}`); return false; }
}

async function countFor(groupSlug: string): Promise<number> {
  const g = MEN_GROUPS.find((x) => x.slug === groupSlug);
  if (!g) return -1;
  const rows = await prisma.product.findMany({ where: { active: true }, select: { name: true, subtype: true, brand: { select: { name: true } } } });
  const hay = (r: any) => `${r.name} ${r.subtype ?? ""}`.toLowerCase();
  const hayBrand = (r: any) => `${r.name} ${r.brand?.name ?? ""}`.toLowerCase();
  const termOf = (href: string) => { const i = href.indexOf("q="); return i === -1 ? "" : decodeURIComponent(href.slice(i + 2)); };
  const re = g.matcher ? new RegExp(g.matcher, "i") : null;
  const matched = re
    ? rows.filter((r: any) => re.test(hay(r)))
    : rows.filter((r: any) => g.items.some((it) => { const t = termOf(it.href).toLowerCase(); return t && hayBrand(r).includes(t); }));
  return matched.length;
}

async function main() {
  const before: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const s of SPECS) before[s.group] = await countFor(s.group);

  if (DRY) {
    console.log("DRY RUN — intended writes (no DB touched):\n");
    for (const s of SPECS) for (const p of s.products)
      console.log(`  [${s.group}] ${p.slug}  "${p.name}" / ${p.subtype}  brand=${p.brand.name} cat=${p.category.name}  ₹${p.salePrice} (₹${p.mrp})`);
    console.log(`\nTotal: ${SPECS.reduce((n, s) => n + s.products.length, 0)} products across ${SPECS.length} groups.`);
    return;
  }

  let created = 0, updated = 0;
  for (const s of SPECS) {
    for (const p of s.products) {
      const brandId = await ensureRef("brand", p.brand);
      if (!brandId) continue;
      const categoryId = await ensureRef("category", p.category);
      if (!categoryId) continue;
      const existed = await prisma.product.findFirst({ where: { slug: p.slug } });
      const ok = await ensureProduct(p, brandId, categoryId);
      if (ok) existed ? updated++ : created++;
    }
  }

  console.log(`\nSeeded: ${created} created, ${updated} updated, ${errors.length} skipped.`);
  console.log("\nPer-group matching count (before -> after):");
  for (const s of SPECS) {
    const after = await countFor(s.group);
    console.log(`  ${s.group.padEnd(16)} ${String(before[s.group]).padStart(2)} -> ${String(after).padStart(2)}${after < 2 ? "   <-- STILL SHORT" : ""}`);
  }
  if (errors.length) {
    console.log("\n⚠ Skipped rows (Prisma named the missing/invalid field — paste these to me and I'll add the column to the create object):");
    for (const e of errors) console.log("  - " + e);
  } else {
    console.log("\n✅ All targeted groups now have >=2 active products. Upload a photo to one product per group in admin to light its tile.");
  }
}

main().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); }).finally(async () => { await prisma.$disconnect(); });

FILE: src\scripts\seed-reviews.ts

import prisma from "@/lib/prisma";
import { seedRating, buildReviewPicks, REVIEW_TARGET } from "@/lib/rating-seed";

async function main() {
  let users = await prisma.user.findMany({ where: { role: { not: "ADMIN" } }, select: { id: true } });
  if (!users.length) users = await prisma.user.findMany({ select: { id: true } });
  if (!users.length) { console.log("No users in DB — cannot author reviews. Seed one user first."); return; }
  const userIds = users.map((u) => u.id);

  // Probe aggregate column names up front: throws "Unknown field" BEFORE any write if wrong.
  const products = await prisma.product.findMany({ select: { id: true, name: true, ratingAvg: true, ratingCount: true } });

  // existing reviewers per product (one round trip) -> pick only fresh authors, keep @@unique intact
  const taken = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const rowCount = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const r of await prisma.review.findMany({ select: { productId: true, userId: true } })) {
    if (!taken.has(r.productId)) taken.set(r.productId, new Set());
    taken.get(r.productId)!.add(r.userId);
    rowCount.set(r.productId, (rowCount.get(r.productId) ?? 0) + 1);
  }

  let counterSet = 0, rowsAdded = 0, productsTouched = 0;
  for (const p of products) {
    // 1) counter — unconditional & deterministic (same formula as the route) -> idempotent, >=1200
    const { ratingCount, ratingAvg } = seedRating(p.name);
    try {
      await prisma.product.update({ where: { id: p.id }, data: { ratingCount, ratingAvg } });
      counterSet++;
    } catch (e) { console.error(`✗ agg ${p.id}:`, e instanceof Error ? e.message : e); continue; }

    // 2) top up visible cards to target, from users who haven't reviewed THIS product
    const used = taken.get(p.id) ?? new Set<string>();
    const fresh = userIds.filter((id) => !used.has(id));
    const need = Math.max(0, REVIEW_TARGET - (rowCount.get(p.id) ?? 0));
    const picks = buildReviewPicks(p.id, fresh, Math.min(need, fresh.length));
    if (!picks.length) continue;
    try {
      await prisma.review.createMany({ data: picks });
      rowsAdded += picks.length; productsTouched++;
    } catch (e) { console.error(`✗ rows ${p.id}:`, e instanceof Error ? e.message : e); }
  }
  console.log(`Done. Counter set on ${counterSet}/${products.length}; added ${rowsAdded} review row(s) across ${productsTouched} product(s).`);
}

main().catch(console.error).finally(() => prisma.$disconnect());
